papers.title: Gravitational Waves from Collisions of Fuzzy Dark Matter Solitons
papers.abstract: According to the Schr\"odinger-Poisson (SP) equations, fuzzy dark matter (FDM) can form a stable equilibrium configuration, the so-called FDM soliton. The SP system can also determine the evolution of FDM solitons, such as head-on collision. In this paper, we first propose a new adimensional unit of length, time and mass. And then, we simulate the adimensional SP system with $\mathtt{PyUltraLight}$ to study the GWs from collision of FDM solitons when the linearized theory is valid and the GW back reaction on the evolution of FDM solitons is ignored. Finally, we find that the GWs from collisions have a frequency of (few ten-years)$^{-1}$ or (few years)$^{-1}$ when FDM mass is $m=10^{-18}\rm{eV}/c^2$ or $m=10^{-17}\rm{eV}/c^2$. Therefore, future detection of such GWs will constrain the property of FDM particle and solitons.

classification.title_zh: 模糊暗物质孤子碰撞产生的引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 根据薛定谔-泊松（SP）方程，模糊暗物质（FDM）可以形成稳定的平衡结构，即FDM孤子。SP系统也可描述FDM孤子的演化，例如正碰。本文首先提出新的无量纲长度、时间和质量单位，然后用PyUltraLight模拟无量纲SP系统，在线性理论有效且忽略引力波对FDM孤子演化的反作用时，研究FDM孤子碰撞产生的引力波。最后发现，当FDM质量分别为m=10^{-18}eV/c^2或m=10^{-17}eV/c^2时，碰撞产生的引力波频率为（几十纳年）^{-1}或（几年）^{-1}量级；因此未来对此类引力波的探测将约束FDM粒子和孤子的性质。
classification.one_liner: 用无量纲薛定谔-泊松模拟研究模糊暗物质孤子碰撞产生的低频引力波及其对FDM参数的约束意义。

papers.title: Bayesian Inference of Fermionic Dark Matter Admixed Neutron Stars Informed by Galaxy Cluster Constraints
papers.abstract: Self-interacting dark matter is constrained on galactic and cluster scales by its elastic scattering cross section per unit mass, $\sigma/m_\chi \sim 0.1-10\ {\rm cm^2/g}$. We incorporate this cross section into the equation of state of an asymmetric, self-interacting fermionic dark matter component and perform a Bayesian inference of dark matter admixed neutron stars in the two-fluid framework at $\sigma/m_\chi = 0.1$, $1$ and $10\ {\rm cm^2/g}$. Seven nuclear matter parameters are sampled together with the dark particle mass and mass fraction, and confronted with nuclear theory and neutron star observations. The nuclear sector and the global observables are statistically indistinguishable across the whole range of cross sections, while the data constrain the dark matter mass to $m_\chi \simeq 1.45-1.88$~GeV and its mass fraction to $f_\chi \simeq 0.05-0.09$, depending on the cross section. Finally, comparing runs built from the same parameter draws, so that only the cross section differs, we find that it does change the baryonic radius appreciably, but only for light dark matter, a region the astrophysical data largely disfavor. The self-interaction is therefore not too weak to be seen; however its effect is hidden in the region of parameter space that the present observational data already disfavor.

classification.title_zh: 星系团约束下费米子暗物质混合中子星的贝叶斯推断
classification.abstract_zh: 自相互作用暗物质在星系和星系团尺度上受到每单位质量弹性散射截面 σ/mχ～0.1-10 cm^2/g 的约束。作者将该截面纳入非对称、自相互作用费米子暗物质组分的状态方程，并在双流体框架下对暗物质混合中子星进行贝叶斯推断，取 σ/mχ=0.1、1、10 cm^2/g。对七个核物质参数以及暗粒子质量和质量分数进行采样，并与核理论和中子星观测对照。结果表明核部分与整体观测量在整个截面范围内统计上不可区分；数据将暗物质质量限制在约1.45-1.88 GeV，质量分数约0.05-0.09，具体依赖截面。比较相同参数抽取但仅截面不同的运行，发现截面会明显改变重子半径，但仅对轻暗物质，而该区域被天文数据大多排除。因此自相互作用并非弱到不可见，但其效应隐藏在现有观测已不利的参数区域。
classification.one_liner: 用贝叶斯推断和双流体框架约束自相互作用费米子暗物质混合中子星，发现截面效应被现有观测不利的轻暗物质区域掩盖。

papers.title: Particle dynamics in rotating charged Bumblebee black holes: An analytical correspondence with Kerr-Newman
papers.abstract: In this paper, we establish an analytical correspondence between the equatorial dynamics of spinless and spinning test particles in a slowly rotating charged Einstein--Bumblebee black hole spacetime and those in an effective Kerr--Newman spacetime. For spinning particles, the correspondence is established within the Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon framework under appropriate parameter matching. We show that corresponding circular orbits have identical radii and coordinate angular velocities, while their radial dynamics and local instability rates exhibit a Lorentz-violation-dependent scaling. Nevertheless, the correspondence does not imply complete dynamical equivalence, as orbital trajectories and radial perturbation growth over an azimuthal period generally differ. These results delineate the scope and limitations of the effective Kerr--Newman correspondence by distinguishing the dynamical properties preserved under parameter matching from those modified by the Lorentz-violating radial deformation.

classification.title_zh: 旋转带电Bumblebee黑洞中的粒子动力学：与Kerr-Newman的解析对应
classification.abstract_zh: 本文建立了慢旋转带电Einstein--Bumblebee黑洞时空中无自旋与自旋检验粒子的赤道面动力学与有效Kerr--Newman时空之间的解析对应。对于自旋粒子，该对应在Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon框架下通过适当的参数匹配建立。我们表明，对应圆轨道具有相同的半径和坐标角速度，而其径向动力学与局部不稳定率表现出依赖于洛伦兹破坏的标度行为。然而，该对应并不意味着完全动力学等价，因为轨道轨迹和每方位角周期内的径向扰动增长通常不同。这些结果通过区分参数匹配下保持的动力学性质与被洛伦兹破坏径向形变修改的性质，界定了有效Kerr--Newman对应的适用范围与局限。
classification.one_liner: 该文给出旋转带电Bumblebee黑洞中检验粒子动力学与有效Kerr-Newman时空的解析对应，并指出洛伦兹破坏导致径向动力学不完全等价。

papers.title: Black objects in a five-dimensional swirling spacetime
papers.abstract: We use the Ehlers symmetry of the five-dimensional Ernst equation to embed the Myers-Perry black hole and the rotating black ring in a five-dimensional swirling spacetime. We show that both solutions can be made free of conical singularities, and that the swirl modifies the balance condition of the black ring. We compute horizon areas, surface gravities and Komar charges, which satisfy a Smarr relation, and study the ergoregions.

classification.title_zh: 五维涡旋时空中的黑洞天体
classification.abstract_zh: 本文利用五维 Ernst 方程的 Ehlers 对称性，将 Myers-Perry 黑洞和旋转黑洞环嵌入五维涡旋时空。作者表明这两个解均可消除锥形奇点，并且涡旋会修改黑洞环的平衡条件。文中计算了视界面积、表面引力和 Komar 荷，它们满足 Smarr 关系，并研究了能层区域。
classification.one_liner: 利用 Ehlers 对称性在五维涡旋时空中构造并研究 Myers-Perry 黑洞与旋转黑洞环的经典解及其热力学量。

papers.title: Revisiting the Frolov--Zelnikov solution for Majumdar--Papapetrou black holes
papers.abstract: We revisit Frolov and Zelnikov's electrostatic Green function for a test charge in a multi-center Majumdar--Papapetrou spacetime, correcting its horizon-charge condition and extending the result to higher dimensions. In four dimensions, we derive the exact Dirichlet-to-Neumann map for a minimally coupled spectator Maxwell field with independently prescribed horizon potentials. The horizon flux charges obey a capacitance matrix with entries $C_{AA}=M_A+\sum_{B\ne A}M_AM_B/R_{AB}$ and $C_{AB}=-M_AM_B/R_{AB}$, where $M_A$ are center masses and $R_{AB}$ their separations. This matrix is a positive diagonal term plus a weighted graph Laplacian, yielding an exact common-mode/differential-mode decomposition of the field energy. The grounded Dirichlet Green function partitions a point charge's flux among infinity and the horizons through harmonic measures. We show that the diagonal condition imposed by Frolov and Zelnikov [Eq.~(4.14)] preserves only the total horizon charge, allowing redistribution between individual horizons. A corrected symmetric Green function preserving each horizon charge instead involves the inverse capacitance matrix. For two centers, the correction produces a finite, negative-semidefinite self-energy shift and an exact self-force difference, without additional ultraviolet subtraction. Finally, we extend the capacitance matrix, flux partition, and fixed-charge Green function to $D=n+3$ dimensions, where the graph weights contain the universal factor $\pi^{n/2}/\Gamma(n/2)$.

classification.title_zh: 重新审视Majumdar--Papapetrou黑洞的Frolov--Zelnikov解
classification.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视Frolov与Zelnikov给出的多中心Majumdar--Papapetrou时空中试探电荷的静电格林函数，修正其视界电荷条件并推广到高维。在四维中，作者对具有独立指定视界势的最小耦合旁观Maxwell场导出精确的Dirichlet-to-Neumann映射。视界通量电荷满足电容矩阵，其对角元为 C_AA=M_A+∑_{B≠A}M_AM_B/R_AB，非对角元为 C_AB=-M_AM_B/R_AB；该矩阵可写成正对角项加加权图Laplacian，从而给出场能的精确共模/差模分解。接地Dirichlet格林函数通过调和测度将点电荷通量分配到无穷远与各视界。文章指出Frolov--Zelnikov的对角条件仅保持总视界电荷，允许电荷在各视界间重分配；保持每个视界电荷的修正对称格林函数涉及逆电容矩阵。对双中心情形，修正给出有限且负半定的自能移动以及精确的自作用力差，无需额外紫外减除。最后将电容矩阵、通量分配和固定电荷格林函数推广到 D=n+3 维，其中图权重含普适因子 π^{n/2}/Γ(n/2)。
classification.one_liner: 修正多中心Majumdar--Papapetrou黑洞静电格林函数的视界电荷条件，给出电容矩阵、通量分配与高维推广。

papers.title: Lyapunov-controlled thermalization: an exact real-time example
papers.abstract: A verified Kubo-Martin-Schwinger (KMS) relation, after a drive has ceased, is not sufficient evidence to prove equilibrium. We demonstrate this in a large-$N$ large-$q$ Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) quench protocol. Although all post-quench fermion correlators are exactly thermal, a second quench back to the initial Hamiltonian reveals hidden memory of the initial state. It is encoded in correlators connecting to times before the first quench. This memory is an extensive nonequilibrium (NEQ) witness with its decay rate being the Lyapunov exponent $\lambda_L$. Thus $\lambda_L$ sets the rate at which the state becomes effectively indistinguishable from a Gibbs state. Despite being a unitary interacting many-body system, the complete NEQ real-time evolution is obtained exactly in the large-$N$, large-$q$ limit, making the setup ideal for analytically studying thermalization.

classification.title_zh: Lyapunov 控制的热化：一个精确的实时例子
classification.abstract_zh: 一个在驱动停止后被验证的 Kubo-Martin-Schwinger（KMS）关系，并不足以证明系统达到平衡。我们在 large-N large-q Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SYK）淬火协议中展示了这一点。尽管淬火后的所有费米子关联函数都严格是热性的，第二次淬火回到初始哈密顿量会揭示初始态的隐藏记忆。该记忆编码在连接第一次淬火之前时间的关联函数中。这种记忆是一个广延的非平衡（NEQ）见证，其衰减率就是 Lyapunov 指数 λ_L。因此，λ_L 决定了态在多大速率上变得实际上与 Gibbs 态不可区分。尽管这是一个幺正相互作用多体系统，完整的 NEQ 实时演化在 large-N、large-q 极限下可以精确获得，使该设置非常适合解析研究热化。
classification.one_liner: 在 large-N large-q SYK 淬火中证明 KMS 热性不保证平衡，并给出由 Lyapunov 指数控制的热化记忆衰减的精确实时描述。

papers.title: Universal Structure of Horizon Formation in Generic Binary Black Hole Mergers
papers.abstract: A new common apparent horizon forms during a binary black hole merger and gives rise to outer and inner branches of marginally outer trapped surfaces. We derive the local structure of these branches. This event occurs in the fully nonlinear regime, outside the standard regimes of post-Newtonian inspiral theory and perturbations of a stationary black hole, yet it admits a universal description. Without assuming symmetry, we show that the stability operator of the marginally outer trapped surface must lose invertibility at formation. Outermost stability then implies that the vanishing eigenvalue is the principal one, with a strictly positive eigenfunction. Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction yields square-root branch separation with a shared linear drift. The outer and inner common horizons lie on a smooth marginally outer trapped tube along which slice time has a local minimum at formation, and nearby later slices intersect it in outer and inner branches whose separation scales as $(t-t_*)^{1/2}$. Sufficiently smooth quasilocal scalar functionals with nonzero first variation along the principal zero mode inherit the square-root separation and a shared linear term. We test these predictions in three binary black hole simulations, including an eccentric, precessing, unequal-mass system. In all three, the worldtube geometry and quasilocal scalars follow the predicted scaling. With the next-order term included, free-exponent fits to the surface geometry and quasilocal functionals recover the square-root exponent, $1/2$, to within half a percent, and diagnostics agree on the formation time within $5\times10^{-5}M$. The correlation between horizon shear and gravitational-wave news raises the possibility that common horizon formation has a signature in a short segment of the merger waveform.

classification.title_zh: 一般双黑洞并合中视界形成的普适结构
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞并合过程中会形成新的公共表观视界，并产生边缘外陷获面的外层与内层分支。本文推导这些分支的局部结构。该事件发生在完全非线性区域，超出后牛顿旋进理论和稳态黑洞微扰的标准适用范围，却具有普适描述。作者不假设对称性，证明边缘外陷获面的稳定性算符在形成时必须失去可逆性。最外层稳定性进而表明，消失的本征值是主本征值，且对应严格正的本征函数。Lyapunov-Schmidt 约化给出具有共同线性漂移的平方根分支分离。外层与内层公共视界位于光滑的边缘外陷获管上，沿该管切片时间在形成处有局部极小值，附近较晚切片与它相交成外层和内层分支，其间隔按 (t-t_*)^{1/2} 标度。沿主零模具有非零一阶变分的足够光滑准局域标量泛函继承平方根分离和共同线性项。作者在三个双黑洞数值模拟中检验这些预言，包括一个偏心、进动、不等质量系统。三者中世界管几何和准局域标量均遵循预言标度。计入下一阶项后，对表面几何和准局域泛函的自由指数拟合在百分之零点五以内恢复平方根指数 1/2，各诊断对形成时间的符合程度在 5×10^{-5}M 以内。视界剪切与引力波 news 之间的相关性提示，公共视界形成可能在并合波形的短片段中留下特征。
classification.one_liner: 证明双黑洞并合时公共表观视界形成具有普适的平方根分支结构，并在三个数值模拟中验证。

papers.title: How much averaged null energy must an anisotropic bounce violate?
papers.abstract: We show that in Einstein gravity a null-complete, non-static Bianchi I universe (homogeneous, spatially flat and anisotropic) violates the averaged null energy condition (ANEC) along every complete light ray outside at most four null directions, and along all of them if its total energy density, cosmological constant included, is ever positive. Along each complete ray the averaged null energy is at most $-J_p/(8\pi G)$, with equality whenever the integral converges, where $J_p$ is the squared expansion and shear accumulated by a thin bundle of light rays. With spatial sections $\mathbb{R}^3$ the achronal ANEC therefore leaves only Minkowski space, as for flat and open Friedmann models. Under the pointwise null energy condition, every null geodesic of a non-static Bianchi I universe is incomplete. The isotropic bounce of effective loop quantum cosmology has $J_p=1.478\,\omega_B H_{\max}$ (light frequency at the bounce times largest Hubble rate), and at the same critical density the cheapest ray of a strongly anisotropic bounce pays four to five times as much. A Casimir-supported turning point on a three-torus has a deficit of the same order, but at Hubble rates well below the Planck scale its light rays circumnavigate the torus and are not achronal, so the achronal ANEC does not apply to them.

classification.title_zh: 一个各向异性反弹必须违反多少平均零能量？
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在 Einstein 引力中，一个零完备、非静态的 Bianchi I 宇宙（均匀、空间平坦且各向异性）沿每一条完整光线都会违反平均零能量条件（ANEC），至多只有四个零方向例外；若其总能量密度（包括宇宙学常数）曾经为正，则沿所有完整光线都违反。沿每条完整光线，平均零能量至多为 $-J_p/(8\pi G)$，当积分收敛时取等号，其中 $J_p$ 是一束细光线所累积的膨胀与剪切的平方。对于空间截面为 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 的情形，非时序 ANEC 因此只留下 Minkowski 空间，这与平坦和开放 Friedmann 模型相同。在逐点零能量条件下，非静态 Bianchi I 宇宙的每条零测地线都不完备。有效圈量子宇宙学的各向同性反弹给出 $J_p=1.478\,\omega_B H_{\max}$（反弹时光频率乘以最大 Hubble 率），而在相同临界密度下，强各向异性反弹最便宜的光线要付出四到五倍的代价。一个三环面上由 Casimir 效应支撑的转折点具有同量级的亏欠，但在远低于 Planck 尺度的 Hubble 率下，其光线绕环面传播而不是非时序的，因此非时序 ANEC 不适用于它们。
classification.one_liner: 该文在 Einstein 引力中给出各向异性 Bianchi I 反弹违反平均零能量条件的普适下界，并比较圈量子宇宙学与 Casimir 环面反弹的代价。

papers.title: Binary black hole scattering with generic spins
papers.abstract: We study generic-spin black-hole scattering with orbital-plane precession, whose dynamics require more than one scattering angle. From numerical relativity (NR), we extract the polar scattering angle and precession of the orbital plane, the latter characterised by asymptotic Euler angles. A dictionary relating post-Minkowskian (PM) observables to scattering and Euler angles is presented, enabling the first precessing PM-NR comparisons. Our results provide a key benchmark for generic-spin resummations and provide the foundations for exploring boundary-to-bound maps in the generic case.

classification.title_zh: 一般自旋的双黑洞散射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有轨道平面进动的一般自旋黑洞散射，其动力学需要不止一个散射角。利用数值相对论，我们提取极角散射角以及轨道平面的进动，后者由渐近欧拉角刻画。我们给出将后闵可夫斯基观测量与散射角及欧拉角联系起来的字典，从而实现首次进动情形下的 PM-NR 比较。结果为由一般自旋重求和提供关键基准，并为探索一般情形下的边界到束缚态映射奠定基础。
classification.one_liner: 利用数值相对论提取一般自旋双黑洞散射的极角与轨道平面进动，并建立与后闵可夫斯基量的对应以进行首次进动 PM-NR 比较。

papers.title: The Vacuum Displacement Principle: Theoretical Framework and Local Phenomenology
papers.abstract: We present a modified gravitational framework in which the standard Einstein field equations are sourced by a classical matter sector coupled to a Higgs-type scalar field $\chi$ modeling a dynamic vacuum substrate. By introducing a phenomenological covariant coupling we implement a physical displacement principle where massive baryonic matter drives the vacuum field away from its vacuum expectation value. We show that this coupling leads to a field-dependent modulation of a particle's inertial rest mass alongside a spatial fifth force, yielding localized violations of the Einstein Equivalence Principle while preserving universal free fall for fundamental point masses. In the weak-field, non-relativistic limit, this interaction manifests as a Yukawa-type correction to the Newtonian potential. We test the viability of this framework against local gravitational constraints, including planetary perihelion precession and E\"otv\"os parameter limits. Finally, we model the steady-state, non-relativistic spherical accretion of dust, demonstrating that the competing effects of vacuum-induced mass modulation and fifth-force acceleration yield distinct density and velocity profiles.

classification.title_zh: 真空位移原理：理论框架与局域现象学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个修改引力框架：标准 Einstein 场方程由经典物质部门作为源，该物质部门与一个模拟动态真空基底的 Higgs 型标量场 χ 耦合。通过引入唯象的协变耦合，我们实现一个物理的位移原理，其中大质量重子物质驱动真空场偏离其真空期望值。我们表明，该耦合导致粒子惯性静止质量随场调制，并产生空间第五力，从而在保持基本点质量普遍自由下落的同时，造成局域性的 Einstein 等效原理违反。在弱场非相对论极限下，该相互作用表现为对 Newton 势的 Yukawa 型修正。我们用局域引力约束检验该框架的可行性，包括行星近日点进动和 Eötvös 参数极限。最后，我们建模稳态、非相对论球对称尘埃吸积，证明真空诱导质量调制与第五力加速的竞争效应会产生不同的密度和速度剖面。
classification.one_liner: 提出以 Higgs 型标量真空场与物质协变耦合的修改引力框架，产生质量调制、第五力和 Yukawa 修正，并用局域引力约束与尘埃吸积剖面检验。

papers.title: Dressed Newton-Cartan geometry and Euclidean thermal configurations in 3D
papers.abstract: We report a new class of solutions of three-dimensional Galilean Anti-de Sitter gravity. The theory can be formulated as a topological gauge theory invariant under the doubly extended Newton-Hooke group in three dimensions. The solution can be interpreted as a dressed Newton-Cartan geometry, which is endowed with four conserved charges: energy, angular momentum, spin and rest mass. Interestingly, the magnitude of the spin turns out to be bounded from above by the rest mass. The Euclidean continuation of the solution exhibits well--defined thermal properties in terms of its gauge theoretical description. Temperature, angular velocity and other chemical potentials are obtained from suitable regularity conditions associated with the topology of a solid torus.

classification.title_zh: 三维中的修饰Newton-Cartan几何与欧几里得热构型
classification.abstract_zh: 我们报告了三维伽利略反德西特引力的一类新解。该理论可表述为在三维双重扩展Newton-Hooke群下不变的拓扑规范理论。该解可解释为修饰的Newton-Cartan几何，带有能量、角动量、自旋和静质量四个守恒荷；有趣的是，自旋的大小受静质量上界限制。该解的欧几里得延拓在其规范理论描述下展现出良好定义的热性质；温度、角速度及其他化学势由与实心环面拓扑相关的适当正则性条件得到。
classification.one_liner: 报告三维伽利略AdS引力的一类新解，表现为修饰Newton-Cartan几何，并通过欧几里得延拓与实心环面正则性获得热力学量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于三维伽利略反德西特引力和Newton-Cartan几何，属于非相对论引力/经典引力方向；摘要未明确涉及全息对偶、超导、相变气泡或探针膜等用户重点内容，因此相关性中等。

papers.title: The 't Hooft model on (A)dS$_2$
papers.abstract: We solve large-$N$ two-dimensional QCD with fundamental quarks---the 't Hooft model---on rigid AdS$_2$ and dS$_2$. Their isometries preserve the null gauge $A_-=0$ and in affine coordinates the curvature enters the light-front Hamiltonian only through the special-conformal generator of the null line. The $SL(2,\mathbb{R)}$ Casimir then results in an exact meson equation: 't Hooft's equation plus a Legendre operator whose sign is determined by the curvature. On AdS$_2$ it is related to equations proposed in the context of folded/segmented strings and light-front holography. The pion is massless in the chiral limit and obeys a Gell-Mann--Oakes--Renner relation that fixes the chiral condensate, the dimensions cross over from Regge to logarithmic growth once the flux tube exceeds the curvature radius, and the flat-space integrable structure survives. We also solve the problem of a quark interacting with an antiquark placed at the boundary: beyond a critical coupling the string pulls it back to the boundary, resulting in a scattering phase. On dS$_2$ and due to the expansion of space, the mesons are unstable resonances even at $N=\infty$ and eventually dissociate. Their widths are given by Boltzmann factors at the de Sitter temperature.

classification.title_zh: 在 (A)dS2 上的 't Hooft 模型
classification.abstract_zh: 我们求解了在刚性 AdS2 与 dS2 上的大 N 二维 QCD（含基本夸克），即 't Hooft 模型。其等距变换保持零规范 A_-=0；在仿射坐标中，曲率仅通过零线上的特殊共形生成元进入光前哈密顿量。SL(2,R) Casimir 给出精确介子方程：'t Hooft 方程加上一个符号由曲率决定的 Legendre 算符。在 AdS2 上，该方程与折叠/分段弦及光前全息背景中提出的方程相关。手征极限下 π 介子无质量，并满足固定手征凝聚的 Gell-Mann–Oakes–Renner 关系；一旦通量管超过曲率半径，维数从 Regge 行为过渡到对数增长，而平空间可积结构仍然保留。我们还求解了位于边界处的夸克与反夸克相互作用问题：超过临界耦合后，弦将其拉回边界，产生散射相移。在 dS2 上，由于空间膨胀，介子即使在 N=∞ 也是不稳定共振态并最终解离；其宽度由 de Sitter 温度的 Boltzmann 因子给出。
classification.one_liner: 论文在刚性 AdS2/dS2 上精确求解大 N 't Hooft 模型，给出曲率修正的介子方程、手征凝聚关系以及 dS2 中由膨胀导致的不稳定介子共振。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD/光前全息与 AdS2/dS2 上的强耦合模型，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超导、p波、multi-trace、探针膜或经典引力等具体重点标签，因此相关性中等。

papers.title: Mechanical angular momentum loss at $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ from static and radiative gravitons
papers.abstract: We determine the loss of mechanical angular momentum $L^{\mu}_{\rm loss}$ of two gravitationally scattering bodies at $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ using worldline quantum field theory (WQFT). The gravitational memory effect, a phenomenon of the early- and late-time behaviour of the gravitational field, leads to static contributions to $L^{\mu}_{\rm loss}$. We illuminate how these arise: the linear memory contributes through so-called static correlators, while the nonlinear memory vanishes at this order due to symmetry considerations. The computation of the remaining, dynamical part resembles that of the $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ impulse. We generate its integrand using a reformulation of the WQFT Feynman rules that conserves four-momentum at every vertex and plainly exhibits the classical loops. The three-loop integrals are reduced to master integrals, whose differential equations and boundary matching in the post-Newtonian limit we describe in some detail. In contrast to conservative effects at this order, only polylogarithms appear. While individual contributions to the dynamical part are divergent, these cancel in $L^{\mu}_{\rm loss}$. The quadratic-in-radiation part of our result reproduces earlier results, while the complete result agrees with existing post-Newtonian results.

classification.title_zh: 静态与辐射引力子导致的 O(G^4) 机械角动量损失
classification.abstract_zh: 本文使用世界线量子场论（WQFT）确定两个引力散射物体在 O(G^4) 的机械角动量损失 L^μ_loss。引力记忆效应——引力场早时与晚时行为的一种现象——给出对 L^μ_loss 的静态贡献。作者说明其来源：线性记忆通过所谓的静态关联子贡献，而非线性记忆在此阶因对称性考虑而消失。其余动力学部分的计算类似于 O(G^4) 冲量的计算。作者用重新表述的 WQFT 费曼规则生成被积函数，该规则在每一个顶点守恒四动量并清楚显示经典圈。三圈积分被约化为主积分，文中较详细描述了其微分方程以及在 post-Newtonian 极限下的边界匹配。与同阶保守效应不同，这里只出现多重对数函数。尽管动力学部分的个别贡献发散，这些发散在 L^μ_loss 中相消。结果的辐射二次部分重现了早先结果，而完整结果与现有 post-Newtonian 结果一致。
classification.one_liner: 用世界线量子场论计算两体引力散射在 O(G^4) 的机械角动量损失，区分静态记忆与辐射贡献并与后牛顿结果一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究引力散射中的角动量损失与辐射记忆效应，但不涉及全息对偶或 AdS/CFT。

papers.title: AI for BMN Strings
papers.abstract: With the assistance of AI (Artificial Intelligence) tools, we revisit some mathematically well-formulated problems from our previous studies of BMN (Berenstein-Maldacena-Nastase) strings on type IIB string theory pp-wave background. These mathematical problems have important physical implications, relating to the computations of higher-genus critical superstring amplitudes, possible estimate of the cosmological constant. We make significant progress on some problems, while others remain unresolved.

classification.title_zh: 人工智能辅助 BMN 弦研究
classification.abstract_zh: 借助人工智能（AI）工具，我们重新审视此前在 IIB 型弦理论 pp-wave 背景中研究 BMN（Berenstein-Maldacena-Nastase）弦时提出的一些数学表述良好的问题。这些数学问题具有重要物理意义，涉及高亏格临界超弦振幅的计算，以及对宇宙学常数的可能估计。我们在部分问题上取得显著进展，另一些问题仍未解决。
classification.one_liner: 利用 AI 工具重新研究 BMN pp-wave 弦中的数学问题，涉及高亏格超弦振幅与宇宙学常数的可能估计。

papers.title: Alternative Boundary Conditions in Asymptotically Anti-de Sitter Spacetimes
papers.abstract: Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes are not globally hyperbolic, so boundary conditions are generally needed for well-defined dynamics. Ishibashi and Wald (IW) determined boundary conditions yielding well-posed dynamics with conserved positive energy for scalar, electromagnetic, and linearized gravitational fields, using nonlocal potentials and individual spherical harmonic modes. In this paper, we determine which IW conditions are local in the primary fields and which are AdS-invariant. In four spacetime dimensions, the standard AdS-invariant boundary conditions set the rescaled magnetic field to zero for electromagnetism and the rescaled magnetic Weyl tensor to zero for Einstein gravity on the conformal boundary. We generalize these standard boundary conditions by setting arbitrary linear combinations of the electric and magnetic fields, or the corresponding Weyl tensors, to zero, and we conjecture that these exhaust the local, AdS-invariant, conservative boundary conditions in AdS$_{1,3}$. Boundary conditions with non-AdS-invariance and in different spacetime dimensions are also studied. The AdS-invariant conditions in AdS$_{1,3}$ extend to Yang-Mills theory and nonlinear gravity in a general Fefferman-Graham setting. We construct phase spaces for these general boundary conditions. The covariant phase spaces for general conditions are naturally associated with Lagrangians containing Pontryagin terms and, in gravity, a Gauss-Bonnet term. In gravity, except for the standard boundary condition, no nontrivial asymptotic symmetries exist and all conserved charges such as ADM mass vanish identically, as in a closed universe. Spacetimes with Killing fields including AdS then exhibit linearization instability in the sense of Fischer and Marsden and Moncrief. For nonstandard boundary conditions, the modified symplectic structure yields new expressions for the entropy formula of black holes.

classification.title_zh: 渐近反德西特时空中的替代边界条件
classification.abstract_zh: 反德西特时空不是全局双曲的，因此通常需要边界条件才能使动力学良定义。Ishibashi 和 Wald 曾用非局域势与各球谐模确定标量、电磁和线性化引力场的良定义且能量守恒正定的边界条件。本文判定哪些 IW 条件在基本场中是局域的、哪些是 AdS 不变的。在四维时空中，标准 AdS 不变边界条件在共形边界上令电磁场的重标度磁场为零、令爱因斯坦引力的重标度磁外尔张量为零；作者将其推广为令电场与磁场或相应外尔张量的任意线性组合为零，并猜测这些条件穷尽了 AdS_{1,3} 中局域、AdS 不变且保守的边界条件。文中还研究了非 AdS 不变条件及其他维数，并将 AdS_{1,3} 的 AdS 不变条件推广到 Yang-Mills 理论及一般 Fefferman-Graham 设定下的非线性引力。作者为这些一般边界条件构造相空间；一般条件的协变相空间自然联系到含 Pontryagin 项的拉格朗日量，在引力中还联系到 Gauss-Bonnet 项。在引力情形，除标准边界条件外不存在非平凡渐近对称性，ADM 质量等所有守恒荷恒为零，类似闭合宇宙；含包括 AdS 的 Killing 场的时空则在 Fischer-Marsden 与 Moncrief 意义下出现线性化不稳定性。对非标准边界条件，修改后的辛结构给出黑洞熵公式的新表达式。
classification.one_liner: 研究渐近 AdS 时空中标量、电磁与引力场的局域且 AdS 不变边界条件、相空间、渐近对称性及黑洞熵修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，聚焦 AdS 边界条件、相空间、渐近对称性与黑洞熵；虽不直接做 AdS/CFT 对偶计算，但为 AdS 引力基础问题。

papers.title: Fortuitous ABJM Operators as Black Holes
papers.abstract: Given a superconformal gauge theory at a fixed loop order, BPS states can be studied in two ways --- by enumerating cohomology classes of a nilpotent supercharge or by diagonalizing the anomalous dimension matrix. The second one allows for a deeper look at how holographic theories distinguish between operators based on whether they are dual to horizonless geometries or black holes. To this end, we carry out the diagonalization in $\mathrm{U}(N)_k \times \mathrm{U}(N)_{-k}$ ABJM theory with $N$ as a formal parameter. This makes it possible to define trajectories of operators and focus on the fortuitous ones which are characterized by being BPS at only finitely many values of $N$. In contrast to $\mathcal{N} = 4$ Super Yang-Mills, where it has been numerically prohibitive to study more than one of these, ABJM gives us access to 16 such trajectories along with their descendants. We show that they take an especially simple form at large $N$ where they agree with the predictions of integrability. We also show that many of them, as with black holes, can only be dressed by certain types of gravitons and comment on how this exercise in cohomology also has implications for properties of the full operators. Finally, we show that the gap to the first non-BPS state in ABJM theory qualitatively differs from that of $\mathcal{N} = 4$ Super Yang-Mills in the expected way.

classification.title_zh: 作为黑洞的偶然 ABJM 算符
classification.abstract_zh: 给定固定圈阶的超共形规范理论，BPS 态可通过枚举幂零超荷的上同调类或对角化反常维数矩阵来研究。后者可深入考察全息理论如何依据算符对偶于无地平几何还是黑洞来区分算符。为此，作者在 U(N)_k × U(N)_{-k} ABJM 理论中把 N 作为形式参数进行对角化，从而定义算符轨迹，并聚焦于仅在有限多个 N 值为 BPS 的“偶然”算符。与 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中数值研究多个此类轨迹困难不同，ABJM 可访问 16 条此类轨迹及其后代。作者表明这些轨迹在大 N 下形式尤其简单，并与可积性预言一致；许多轨迹如黑洞一样只能由特定类型的引力子修饰，并讨论了该上同调练习对完整算符性质的启示。最后指出，ABJM 中到首个非 BPS 态的能隙与 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论定性不同，且符合预期。
classification.one_liner: 在 ABJM 中构造并研究仅在有限 N 为 BPS 的偶然算符轨迹，揭示其与黑洞对偶及与 N=4 SYM 的差异。

papers.title: The facts on quantum self-dual Einstein gravity and self-dual Yang-Mills theory
papers.abstract: Self-dual Einstein gravity is a one-loop exact, UV and IR finite, diffeomorphism invariant, non-unitary theory of quantum gravity in four dimensions. The only generically non-zero amplitudes are the one-loop-all-plus amplitudes, and they are equal to those of pure Einstein gravity. In these notes we review SDG and SDYM pedagogically. We walk the reader through key calculations, fill in some gaps in the literature, and point out directions for future research. Topics include: derivation of the self-dual actions from the full Einstein gravity/YM actions in lightcone gauge, decoupling of ghosts, Berends-Giele currents, vanishing of tree-level-one-minus amplitudes, celestial $\Lw$ symmetry, perturbiners, double-off-shell current calculation of one-loop-all-plus SDYM and SDG amplitudes, dimension shifting, unitarity cuts, the BDPR gravity formula, one-loop color ordering, perturbative dilatation symmetry of SDG, and the covariant formulations of the self-dual theories as well as their their gauge fixing. We also review some selected results from the celestial holography program.

classification.title_zh: 关于量子自对偶爱因斯坦引力与自对偶杨-米尔斯理论的事实
classification.abstract_zh: 自对偶爱因斯坦引力是一个单圈精确、紫外和红外有限、微分同胚不变、非幺正的四维量子引力理论。唯一一般非零的振幅是单圈全正振幅，且它们等于纯爱因斯坦引力的相应振幅。这些讲义以教学方式综述 SDG 和 SDYM，逐步展示关键计算，填补文献中的一些空白，并指出未来研究方向。主题包括：在光锥规范下从完整爱因斯坦引力/YM 作用量推导自对偶作用量、鬼场解耦、Berends-Giele 流、树级单负振幅消失、天球 \Lw 对称性、perturbiners、通过双离壳流计算单圈全正 SDYM 和 SDG 振幅、维数移动、幺正切割、BDPR 引力公式、单圈色序、SDG 的微扰伸缩对称性，以及自对偶理论的协变表述及其规范固定。我们还综述天球全息纲领的一些选定结果。
classification.one_liner: 教学性综述四维量子自对偶爱因斯坦引力与自对偶杨-米尔斯理论，涵盖光锥推导、振幅计算、天球对称性与协变表述。

papers.title: On the Nucleon Effective Mass in Neutron Stars Cooling
papers.abstract: The cooling of neutrons stars, which are composed of ultra-high-density nuclear matter, strongly depends on the equation of state because the dominant cooling sources are neutrinos produced in their interiors. Here, we investigate the cooling properties of neutron stars, focusing on effective nucleon masses, whose impacts have been recently examined in supernova explosion and proto-neutron star cooling. The uncertainties of effective masses originate from the difference in the attractive interaction of scalar meson and the definition of the Dirac and Landau masses. At first, we employ so-called Walecka models that allow these two masses to be introduced within a unified framework and evaluate the resulting cooling curves. Based on the Walecka model, we compute the emissivity of the neutrons and the direct Urca process and their cooling curves. We demonstrate that the Dirac and Landau masses affect cooling of massive neutron stars, although most previous cooling simulations do not distinguish them. We also perform cooling simulations with two realistic equation of states based on relativistic mean-field (RMF) theory, whose differences arise from properties of only effective masses among characteristic parameters. These results are broadly consistent with those obtained from the Walecka models, indicating that the treatment of effective nucleon masses may be an important source of uncertainty in neutron-star cooling.

classification.title_zh: 中子星冷却中的核子有效质量
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星冷却强烈依赖超高密度核物质的状态方程，因为主要冷却源是内部中微子产生。本文聚焦核子有效质量对冷却性质的影响；有效质量的不确定性来自标量介子吸引相互作用差异以及Dirac质量与Landau质量定义的不同。作者首先采用可在统一框架中引入这两种质量的Walecka模型，计算中子与直接Urca过程的中微子发射率及冷却曲线，表明Dirac和Landau质量会影响大质量中子星冷却，而以往多数冷却模拟未区分二者。随后使用两个基于相对论平均场理论的实际状态方程进行冷却模拟，二者差异仅来自有效质量相关性质；结果与Walecka模型基本一致，说明核子有效质量的处理可能是中子星冷却不确定性的重要来源。
classification.one_liner: 在Walecka模型和相对论平均场状态方程下，核子Dirac/Landau有效质量差异会改变大质量中子星冷却曲线，是冷却模拟的重要不确定性来源。

papers.title: Thermal Double-Twist Data in Holography
papers.abstract: We explain how to extract thermal OPE coefficients of double-twist operators in scalar two-point functions at infinite spatial volume from suitably regularized integrals of thermal response functions in momentum space. As a specific application, we implement the proposed approach to four-dimensional holographic CFTs with an Einstein bulk action, where the finite-temperature state is captured by an AdS$_5$ black-brane geometry. In that case, the thermal response function can be computed on the gravitational side by solving numerically a radial ODE reduction of the Klein-Gordon equation. We obtain accurate values of double-twist data from this solution, completing previous holographic and bootstrap studies of thermal two-point functions. Some of the reported spin-resolved data that we compute are new.

classification.title_zh: 全息中的热双扭数据
classification.abstract_zh: 我们说明如何从动量空间热响应函数的适当正则化积分中，提取无限空间体积下标量两点函数中双扭算符的热OPE系数。作为具体应用，我们将该方法用于具有Einstein体作用量的四维全息CFT，其中有限温度态由AdS5黑膜几何描述。在该情形下，热响应函数可在引力侧通过数值求解Klein-Gordon方程的径向ODE约化来计算。我们由该解获得高精度的双扭数据，补全了先前对热两点函数的全息与bootstrap研究。所报告的部分自旋分辨数据是新的。
classification.one_liner: 从AdS5黑膜热响应函数中数值提取四维全息CFT标量两点函数的双扭算符热OPE系数，并给出部分新自旋分辨数据。
classification.relevance_reason: 本文研究热全息CFT两点函数与双扭OPE系数，属于AdS/CFT基础字典；未直接涉及所列重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变、QNM、探针膜或经典引力。

papers.title: An algebra of proper observables at null infinity: Dirac brackets, Memory and Goldstone probes
papers.abstract: We develop a rigorous evaluation of Dirac brackets for classical observables on the phase space of radiative gravitational modes at null infinity that naturally incorporates memory effects. Considering the Ashtekar-Streubel phase space, with boundary conditions in time given by vanishing {\it news} and purely electric {\it shear}, and taking into account the infinite dimensionality of the phase space, we identify the algebra of proper observables (understood as functions on phase space that can be associated with smooth symplectic flows). We show that the action of supertranslation charges generate the correct transformations on the shear. We also show that the conventional definition of the ``Goldstone mode'' adopted in the literature cannot be associated with a proper observable, but nevertheless there exists an infinite family of proper observables, which we call {\it Goldstone probes}, that are capable of measuring the Goldstone mode. We notice that there are no Goldstone probes constructed only out of the shear {\it or} the news, providing a possible explanation for why attempts to construct a (separable) Hilbert space with different memory states have failed so far. Finally, we derive formulas for distributional Dirac brackets between local shear and news, and show that they contain non-local corrections.

classification.title_zh: 零无穷处恰当可观测量的代数：狄拉克括号、记忆与戈德斯通探针
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在零无穷处辐射引力模式相空间上，对经典可观测量的狄拉克括号进行严格计算，并自然纳入记忆效应。考虑 Ashtekar-Streubel 相空间，时间边界条件为 news 消失且 shear 为纯电性，并考虑相空间的无穷维性，我们确定了恰当可观测量的代数（恰当可观测量理解为可与光滑辛流相关联的相空间函数）。我们证明超平移荷的作用在 shear 上生成正确变换。我们还证明文献中采用的“Goldstone 模”常规定义不能与恰当可观测量相联系，但存在无穷族恰当可观测量——我们称为 Goldstone 探针——能够测量 Goldstone 模。我们注意到不存在仅由 shear 或 news 构造的 Goldstone 探针，这为迄今构造具有不同记忆态的可分 Hilbert 空间的尝试失败提供了一种可能解释。最后，我们导出局域 shear 与 news 之间分布型狄拉克括号的公式，并证明它们包含非局域修正。
classification.one_liner: 在零无穷 Ashtekar-Streubel 相空间上严格定义恰当可观测量代数，并用 Goldstone 探针讨论引力记忆与超平移变换。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/渐近对称性与引力记忆的形式研究，涉及 Goldstone 探针但并非 AdS/CFT 全息或全息凝聚态；与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线相关。

papers.title: Carrollian quantum states and flat space holography
papers.abstract: We study free Carrollian quantum field theories from an algebraic perspective and explore their implications for flat space holography. As explicit examples, we construct the electric and magnetic Carrollian Weyl algebras obtained from Carroll limits of the relativistic scalar field and analyze their states, including vacuum and thermal configurations. For the massive electric theory, we find a regular Carroll-invariant vacuum state and a regular KMS state, yielding a consistent Carrollian thermodynamic system. By contrast, the massless electric and magnetic theories are more subtle: depending on the quantization, they admit either no regular distinguished vacuum or only nonregular Carroll-invariant ground states, while still supporting nonregular thermal states. We further analyze alternative classes of states in the massless electric theory, including spatially homogeneous quasifree pure states and Sorkin--Johnston states. Motivated by these results, we discuss consequences for flat space holography. We construct a well-defined state relevant for Carrollian holography whose Hilbert-space representation factorizes into a standard Fock sector and a nonseparable zero-mode sector, thereby highlighting the role of infrared degrees of freedom in the boundary theory.

classification.title_zh: Carrollian量子态与平直空间全息
classification.abstract_zh: 我们从代数视角研究自由Carrollian量子场论，并探讨其对平直空间全息的含义。作为显式例子，我们由相对论标量场的Carroll极限构造电性与磁性Carrollian Weyl代数，并分析其态，包括真空态与热态。对于有质量电性理论，我们找到一个正则的Carroll不变真空态和一个正则的KMS态，从而给出自洽的Carrollian热力学系统。相比之下，无质量电性理论与磁性理论更为微妙：依赖于量子化方式，它们要么没有正则的 distinguished vacuum，要么只拥有非正则的Carroll不变基态，同时仍支持非正则热态。我们进一步分析无质量电性理论中的替代态类，包括空间均匀的准自由纯态与Sorkin--Johnston态。受这些结果启发，我们讨论其对平直空间全息的后果。我们构造一个与Carrollian全息相关的良定义态，其Hilbert空间表示分解为一个标准Fock部分和一个不可分零模部分，从而突显边界理论中红外自由度所起的作用。
classification.one_liner: 从代数视角构造Carrollian Weyl代数并分析真空/KMS等态，讨论平直空间全息中边界红外零模的作用。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题为Carrollian量子场论与平直空间全息的基础态构造，不涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或D3-D7探针膜等方向；也未以经典广义相对论为主要内容。

papers.title: All-order structure of static gravitational interactions and the seventh post-Newtonian potential
papers.abstract: We present a closed formula for the computation of static post-Newtonian corrections to the two-body gravitational dynamics at any odd order, assuming the lower-order results are known. The formula is derived within a correlation function framework and exploits the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry of the static sector, leading to a novel theoretical interpretation of the factorization theorem. As an application, we compute the gravitational interaction of two compact coalescing objects at the seventh post-Newtonian order in the static limit, which receives contributions from seven-loop graphs at order $\mathcal{O}(G_N^8 v^0)$, and find complete agreement with the results obtained using the diagrammatic approach of the factorization theorem.

classification.title_zh: 静态引力相互作用的全阶结构与七阶后牛顿势
classification.abstract_zh: 我们给出一个闭式公式，用于在已知低阶结果的情况下计算任意奇数阶的静态后牛顿修正对两体引力动力学的贡献。该公式在关联函数框架内推导，并利用静态扇区的 Z2 对称性，从而对因子化定理给出新的理论解释。作为应用，我们计算了两个致密并合天体在静态极限下第七阶后牛顿阶的引力相互作用；该结果在 O(G_N^8 v^0) 阶接收到七圈图贡献，并与使用因子化定理的图方法所得结果完全一致。
classification.one_liner: 利用关联函数框架与静态扇区 Z2 对称性给出任意奇数阶静态后牛顿修正的闭式公式，并计算至七阶后牛顿势。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题为经典引力中的后牛顿两体动力学与引力相互作用计算，直接属于“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息或 AdS/CFT。

papers.title: A Holographic Model for Soft Photons and Gravitons in Four Dimensions
papers.abstract: We construct a two-dimensional action on the celestial sphere that describes the infrared sector of Abelian gauge and gravitational theories in four dimensions. In particular, we use the holographic model to reproduce (1) antipodal matching conditions for the superphaserotation and supertranslation Goldstone modes in four dimensions, (2) leading soft photon and graviton theorems, and (3) infrared factorization of amplitudes with generic dressed $in$ and $out$ states. Using (3), we reproduce the infrared divergences that plague the standard undressed amplitudes, and show that amplitudes involving Faddeev-Kulish dressed states are infrared finite. As a corollary, we use our holographic model to construct an infinite class of dressed states that give rise to infrared finite scattering amplitudes.

classification.title_zh: 四维软光子与软引力子的全息模型
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在天球上构造一个二维作用量，用于描述四维阿贝尔规范理论与引力理论的红外部分。利用该全息模型，作者重现了四维中超相位旋转与超平移 Goldstone 模式的对跖匹配条件、领头软光子与软引力子定理，以及具有一般 dressing 的 in/out 态的振幅红外因子化。借助红外因子化，作者重现了标准未 dressing 振幅中的红外发散，并表明包含 Faddeev-Kulish dressing 态的振幅是红外有限的。作为推论，该模型构造出一大类使散射振幅红外有限的 dressing 态。
classification.one_liner: 构造天球二维全息模型，统一描述四维软光子/软引力子定理、渐近对称性匹配与红外有限 dressing 态。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于天球全息/平直时空渐近对称性与软定理方向，与所列全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7探针膜等具体研究支线无直接交集。

papers.title: Crossing symmetry of OPE statistics
papers.abstract: We study the crossing symmetry of the ensemble of large-$c$ 2D CFTs defined through 3D gravity. A central observation is that statistical moments of OPE coefficients are not independent; rather, lower and higher moments are strongly correlated. Using Virasoro TQFT, we clarify how these correlations arise and how they guarantee consistency across OPE channels. Our analysis introduces the new notion of pseudo-hyperbolic manifolds, which are a certain class of non-hyperbolic manifolds whose partition functions are nevertheless related to those of hyperbolic ones. These manifolds serve as bridges that help manifest the crossing symmetry of the CFT ensemble.

classification.title_zh: OPE 统计的交叉对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究由三维引力定义的大 c 二维 CFT 系综的交叉对称性。一个核心观察是，OPE 系数的统计矩并非彼此独立；相反，低阶与高阶矩之间存在强关联。利用 Virasoro TQFT，我们阐明这些关联如何产生，以及它们如何保证不同 OPE 通道之间的一致性。我们的分析引入了伪双曲流形的新概念；这是一类非双曲流形，其配分函数仍与双曲流形的配分函数相关。这些流形作为桥梁，帮助显现 CFT 系综的交叉对称性。
classification.one_liner: 用 Virasoro TQFT 和伪双曲流形说明 3D 引力定义的大 c 二维 CFT 系综中 OPE 统计矩的关联如何保证交叉对称性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS3/CFT2 与全息基础方向，讨论 OPE 统计与 Virasoro TQFT，但不直接匹配列出的重点标签（如全息超流超导、探针膜、QNM、经典引力等）。

papers.title: Automorphism-weighted ensembles from TQFT gravity
papers.abstract: We study the recent proposal of arXiv:2405.20366 which poses a precise holographic duality between a 3d TQFT summed over all topologies and a unitary ensemble of boundary 2d CFTs. In that proposal, the sum over topologies is obtained via genus reduction from topologies with a large genus boundary Riemann surface, while the boundary ensemble is given by all CFTs described by Lagrangian condensations of the bulk TQFT. The main result of this work is to show that each member of this ensemble is weighted by a symmetry factor given by the invertible symmetry group of its categorical symmetry relative to the bulk TQFT as its SymTFT. This is the natural $\unicode{x2014}$ uniform up to isomorphism $\unicode{x2014}$ measure on the groupoid of Lagrangian algebras that describe the boundary theories. We also write the sum over topologies more explicitly in terms of equivalence classes of Heegaard splittings of 3-manifolds with a given boundary and comment on their weights. The holographic duality in this framework can then be viewed as a generalization of the Siegel-Weil formula. We discuss the implications of the main result for non-compact TQFTs. In particular, for the Virasoro case, this implies an ensemble of all CFTs at a given central charge in which CFTs are weighted by their full invertible symmetry. Finally, we show how this TQFT gravity framework gives a natural construction of the baby universe Hilbert space.

classification.title_zh: TQFT 引力中的自同构加权系综
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究 arXiv:2405.20366 提出的三维 TQFT 对所有拓扑求和与边界二维 CFT 幺正系综之间的精确全息对偶。主要结果是证明该系综中每个成员的权重由以其范畴对称为 SymTFT 时相对于体 TQFT 的可逆对称群给出的对称因子决定；这是描述边界理论的 Lagrangian 代数 groupoid 上自然且在同构意义下均匀的测度。文章还用给定边界三维流形的 Heegaard 分裂等价类更显式地写出拓扑求和并讨论其权重，指出该框架下的全息对偶可视为 Siegel-Weil 公式的推广。文中讨论非紧 TQFT 的含义；在 Virasoro 情形下，这意味着给定中心电荷的所有 CFT 组成的系综按完整可逆对称性加权。最后展示该 TQFT 引力框架如何自然构造 baby universe Hilbert 空间。
classification.one_liner: 证明 TQFT 引力全息系综中边界 CFT 按可逆对称群自同构因子加权，并构造 baby universe Hilbert 空间。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦 TQFT 引力的全息系综与范畴对称权重，不涉及用户重点的全息超流超导、p波/多分量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子或经典引力。

papers.title: Generating Hodges' Graviton MHV Formula with an $Lw_{1+\infty}$ Ward Identity
papers.abstract: Hodges' formula expresses the tree-level all-multiplicity Einstein gravity MHV amplitude as a matrix determinant. In this work, we prove that Hodges' determinant is generated by an $Lw_{1+\infty}$ Ward identity on the celestial sphere. The Ward identity takes the form of a recursion relation that has not previously appeared in the literature and is unrelated to BCFW. The proof makes use of the matrix-tree theorem.

classification.title_zh: 用 Lw_{1+∞} Ward 恒等式生成 Hodges 的引力子 MHV 公式
classification.abstract_zh: Hodges 公式将树级任意多重数 Einstein 引力 MHV 振幅表示为一个矩阵行列式。本文证明 Hodges 行列式可由天球上的一个 Lw_{1+∞} Ward 恒等式生成。该 Ward 恒等式采取一种此前文献中未出现的递推关系形式，且与 BCFW 无关。证明使用了矩阵-树定理。
classification.one_liner: 证明天球 Lw_{1+∞} Ward 恒等式可递推生成 Hodges 的树级引力子 MHV 行列式，且不依赖 BCFW。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于天球全息/散射振幅形式理论，未涉及用户重点列出的全息凝聚态、超流超导、多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D-brane 探针等方向；仅与全息/引力形式研究有宽泛关联。

papers.title: The Cauchy problem for skew-torsion-parallel spinors with applications to supergravity
papers.abstract: We solve the Cauchy problem for an irreducible real spinor parallel with respect to a metric connection with skew-symmetric torsion on a globally hyperbolic Lorentzian four-manifold, proving that it is well-posed modulo an obstruction that we identify explicitly, and obtaining an initial-data characterization of such spinors. Our proof relies on the theory of spinorial forms, which we use to explicitly integrate the coupled flow for the spinor and underlying metric via a rotated pull-back action of the flow generated by a vector field on the Cauchy hypersurface $\Sigma$. We characterize the corresponding constraint equations as an explicit exterior differential system and describe all its solutions in terms of contact structures and flat foliations, obtaining a complete classification in the compact case. In particular, we conclude that every oriented compact three-manifold arises as the Cauchy hypersurface of a globally hyperbolic Lorentzian four-manifold equipped with a skew-torsion parallel spinor. Building on these results, we study the interaction between the four-dimensional Neveu-Schwarz supergravity evolution flow on an abelian bundle gerbe and the spinorial evolution flow determined by its supersymmetric conditions, which we prove to be well-posed and compatible. This establishes the well-posedness of the supersymmetric Neveu-Schwarz system in four dimensions and provides an initial-data characterization of supersymmetry. Furthermore, we obtain a strong rigidity result stating that every globally hyperbolic supersymmetric Neveu-Schwarz solution with a compact Cauchy hypersurface is flat and has vanishing bundle-gerbe curvature.

classification.title_zh: 斜挠率平行旋量的 Cauchy 问题及其在超引力中的应用
classification.abstract_zh: 本文求解全局双曲洛伦兹四维流形上关于带斜对称挠率度量联络平行的不可约实旋量的 Cauchy 问题，证明在显式指出的障碍模掉后适定，并给出此类旋量的初始数据刻画。证明基于旋量形式理论，通过在 Cauchy 超曲面 Σ 上由向量场生成流的旋转拉回作用显式积分旋量与度规的耦合流。将约束方程刻画为显式外微分系统，并用接触结构和平坦叶状结构描述其全部解，在紧致情形给出完全分类；特别地，每个定向紧致三维流形都可作为某个带斜挠率平行旋量的全局双曲洛伦兹四维流形的 Cauchy 超曲面。进一步研究四维 Neveu-Schwarz 超引力在阿贝尔丛 gerbe 上的演化流与其超对称条件决定的旋量演化流的相互作用，证明其适定且相容，从而建立四维超对称 NS 系统的适定性并给出超对称的初始数据刻画；还得到刚性结果：每个具有紧致 Cauchy 超曲面的全局双曲超对称 NS 解都是平坦的且丛 gerbe 曲率为零。
classification.one_liner: 证明带斜挠率平行旋量的 Cauchy 问题适定并给出初始数据刻画，进而建立四维超对称 Neveu-Schwarz 系统的适定性与刚性。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/洛伦兹几何与超引力初值问题，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”标签；但不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息字典，因此与全息重点支线关联较弱。

papers.title: A Universal Law for Horizon Formation in Black Hole Mergers
papers.abstract: When two black holes merge, a common horizon appears around them as a single surface, which immediately splits into an outer and an inner one. We show that this event has a universal local form. Without any symmetry assumption, the two surfaces separate as $(t-t_*)^{1/2}$ along a single, everywhere positive mode and share a drift linear in $t-t_*$. Three numerical simulations, including an eccentric, precessing one, confirm the exponent to half a percent, and the reconstructed formation surface is marginally stable, as predicted.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞并合中视界形成的普适定律
classification.abstract_zh: 当两个黑洞并合时，它们周围会出现一个共同视界，作为一个单一曲面，并立即分裂为外视界和内视界。作者证明该事件具有普适的局域形式：在无任何对称性假设下，两个曲面沿单一且处处为正的模以 (t-t_*)^{1/2} 分离，并共享一个正比于 t-t_* 的漂移。三个数值模拟（包括一个偏心、进动的模拟）将指数验证到 0.5% 精度，且重建的形成曲面如预测那样是边缘稳定的。
classification.one_liner: 黑洞并合时共同视界形成与分裂具有普适局域标度形式，并由数值模拟验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的黑洞并合与视界形成研究，匹配用户的“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息、量子信息或其他重点支线。

papers.title: U(1)-Symmetric Spin SYK Models: Ordering, Chaos, and Transport
papers.abstract: The Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (SYK) model provides an analytically controlled setting for strongly interacting quantum dynamics and holography, but its fermionic formulation leads to nonlocal encoding overheads on qubit-based quantum processors. We study a U(1)-symmetric spin analogue of the complex SYK model, constructed from random charge-conserving $q$-spin interactions that are native to a qubit Hilbert space. In the large-$N$, large-$q$ limit, the model reproduces the leading saddle-point structure of complex fermionic SYK under the identification of chemical potential with magnetic field and charge density with magnetization. We investigate the finite-$N$, finite-$q$ regime using exact diagonalization. A U(1)-invariant ordering susceptibility increases with system size for $q = 2, 4$ but decreases for $q = 6$, while bulk-spectrum level statistics are consistent with the Gaussian orthogonal ensemble at half filling and the Gaussian unitary ensemble in the adjacent magnetization sector. We further construct coupled-cluster chains and obtain domain-wall dynamics consistent with diffusive magnetization transport in a small-cluster regime accessible to matrix-product-state simulations. These results establish analytical benchmarks and finite-size signatures of ordering, quantum chaos, and magnetization transport in U(1)-symmetric spin-SYK models, and they motivate quantum simulation of the low-temperature, large-system regime, which remains difficult for classical methods.

classification.title_zh: U(1) 对称自旋 SYK 模型：有序、混沌与输运
classification.abstract_zh: Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (SYK) 模型为强相互作用量子动力学与全息提供了可解析控制的设定，但其费米子表述在基于量子比特的量子处理器上会带来非局域编码开销。本文研究复 SYK 模型的 U(1) 对称自旋类比，该模型由量子比特希尔伯特空间天然具有的、保持电荷的随机 q-自旋相互作用构成。在大 N、大 q 极限下，该模型在将化学势等同于磁场、电荷密度等同于磁化的识别下，重现复费米子 SYK 的主导鞍点结构。我们使用精确对角化研究有限 N、有限 q 区域。U(1) 不变的序参量磁化率在 q=2,4 时随系统尺寸增大而增大，但在 q=6 时减小；体谱能级统计在半填充时与高斯正交系综一致，在相邻磁化 sector 中与高斯酉系综一致。我们进一步构造耦合链，并得到与磁化扩散输运一致的小团簇区域畴壁动力学，该区域可由矩阵乘积态模拟访问。这些结果建立了 U(1) 对称自旋 SYK 模型中有序、量子混沌与磁化输运的解析基准和有限尺寸特征，并推动对经典方法仍困难的低温大系统区域进行量子模拟。
classification.one_liner: 研究 U(1) 对称自旋 SYK 模型的大 N/大 q 鞍点对应以及有限尺寸下的有序、量子混沌与磁化输运。

papers.title: Cubic Curvature Deformations to the Kerr Black Hole Shadow
papers.abstract: We investigate the effects of cubic curvature corrections on the shadows of rotating black holes within the effective field theory of gravity. Starting from a perturbatively corrected Kerr metric incorporating two independent cubic curvature couplings, we construct black hole shadows through numerical integration of null geodesics, without assuming separability of the geodesic equations. Using a Hamiltonian ray-tracing approach, we systematically examine the dependence of the shadow geometry on the higher-curvature couplings, black hole spin, and observer inclination. We find that cubic curvature interactions can produce discernible deviations from the Kerr shadow, modifying its apparent size and shape. In particular, the two cubic interactions exhibit distinct effects on the shadow boundary, with the magnitude of the deviations depending sensitively on the coupling strengths and black hole spin. We validate our numerical results through independent convergence tests of the geodesic integration and shadow-boundary determination, and recover the analytical Kerr shadow in the vanishing-coupling limit. Our results provide a complementary probe of higher-curvature gravity in the strong-field regime and illustrate the potential of black hole shadow observations to constrain departures from general relativity.

classification.title_zh: 立方曲率修正对Kerr黑洞阴影的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在引力有效场论框架下研究立方曲率修正对旋转黑洞阴影的影响。从包含两个独立立方曲率耦合的微扰修正Kerr度规出发，不假设测地线方程可分离，通过数值积分零测地线构造黑洞阴影。采用哈密顿光线追踪方法，系统考察阴影几何对高阶曲率耦合、黑洞自旋和观测者倾角的依赖。我们发现立方曲率相互作用会产生可辨别的偏离Kerr阴影的效应，改变其视大小和形状；两个立方相互作用对阴影边界的影响不同，偏离幅度敏感依赖于耦合强度和黑洞自旋。我们通过测地线积分与阴影边界确定的独立收敛测试验证数值结果，并在耦合趋于零时恢复解析Kerr阴影。结果提供了强场区域高阶曲率引力的互补探针，并说明黑洞阴影观测约束广义相对论偏离的潜力。
classification.one_liner: 数值光线追踪表明，立方曲率修正会改变Kerr黑洞阴影的大小和形状，且效应依赖耦合强度与黑洞自旋。

papers.title: Integrable Singularity Black Holes without Inner Horizons in Asymptotically Safe Inspired Gravity and NFW Dark Matter Effects
papers.abstract: We investigate an alternative ultraviolet (UV) structure for Renormalization Group improved (RG) black holes within a phenomenological framework inspired by asymptotically safe gravity. In several regular RG constructions, regularity at the origin is associated with a dS core and an additional inner horizon, raising issues of spacetime predictability and possible mass inflation instabilities. Motivated by this problem, we relate the RG scale to the radially weighted effective quantum gravitational source entering the volume integrand of the quantum corrected Ricci scalar. This prescription yields a Bessel type running Newton coupling with $G_I(r)\sim r$ in the UV, rather than the usual $G(r)\sim r^3$ behavior, and supports an integrable central singularity. The inner branch is matched through the Israel Darmois conditions to an exterior RG solution with $G_{II}\to G_0$ in the infrared, where $G_0$ is the Newton constant. Within the numerical range investigated, the resulting geometry has a single event horizon and no additional inner horizon. We then incorporate an NFW dark matter distribution coupled to the same running coupling. Since $\rho_{\rm NFW}\sim r^{-1}$ while $G_I(r)\sim r$ near the origin, the effective matter contribution entering the field equations remains finite, producing a cored effective behavior without modifying the NFW profile by hand. The gravitational decoupling algorithm keeps the quantum gravitational and dark matter sectors separately conserved within the same geometry. For the configurations considered, the NFW sector shifts the event horizon while preserving the single horizon structure. Thus, the same running coupling governs both the integrable UV black hole geometry and the softening of the central gravitational response of the NFW source.

classification.title_zh: 渐近安全启发引力中无内视界的可积奇点黑洞及NFW暗物质效应
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在受渐近安全引力启发的唯象框架内，研究重整化群改进黑洞的一种替代紫外结构。针对若干正则RG构造中原点正则性伴随dS核心与额外内视界、从而引发可预测性和质量膨胀不稳定性问题，作者将RG标度与进入量子修正Ricci标量体积被积函数的径向加权有效量子引力源相联系。该方案给出Bessel型跑动牛顿耦合，在紫外为G_I(r)~r而非通常的G(r)~r^3，并支持可积中心奇点。内部支通过Israel-Darmois条件匹配到红外G_II→G_0的外部RG解。在所研究数值范围内，所得几何具有单一事件视界且无额外内视界。随后作者将NFW暗物质分布与同一跑动耦合耦合；由于原点附近ρ_NFW~r^{-1}而G_I(r)~r，场方程中的有效物质贡献保持有限，产生核化有效行为而无需手动修改NFW轮廓。引力解耦算法使量子引力与暗物质部门在同一几何中分别守恒。对所考虑构型，NFW部门移动事件视界但保持单视界结构。
classification.one_liner: 构建一种渐近安全启发的RG改进黑洞：以Bessel型跑动耦合实现可积中心奇点并避免内视界，同时用同一耦合软化NFW暗物质中心响应。

papers.title: On JT boundary algebras
papers.abstract: We construct the canonical boundary algebras of Jackiw--Teitelboim gravity coupled to free bosonic matter. For a nonempty finite or countable family of species with lowest weights greater than one half, the two boundary algebras are mutual commutants and nonhyperfinite type $\mathrm{II}_\infty$ factors. Their nonzero finite corners are nonhyperfinite type $\mathrm{II}_1$ factors. The construction uses bounded heat-regularized fields and a Hilbert algebra, which gives a faithful normal semifinite trace without a path-integral argument. The weight restriction is sharp: elementary point fields remain unbounded after positive heat regularization when $0<d\leq1/2$. For one massless scalar, specified bounded observables and normal states have a high energy limit described by a hyperfinite continuous core. We explain why this limit does not preserve the nonhyperfiniteness of the exact algebra.

classification.title_zh: 论 JT 边界代数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了与自由玻色物质耦合的 Jackiw-Teitelboim 引力的正则边界代数。对于最低权重大于 1/2 的非空有限或可数物种族，两个边界代数为互为交换子且非超有限的 II∞ 型因子；其非零有限角为 II1 型因子。构造使用有界热正则化场和 Hilbert 代数，从而无需路径积分论证给出忠实正规半有限迹。权重限制是尖锐的：当 0<d≤1/2 时，基本点场在正的热正则化后仍无界。对于单个无质量标量，指定有界可观测量和正规态具有由超有限连续核心描述的高能极限。我们解释为何该极限不保持精确代数的非超有限性。
classification.one_liner: 构造 JT 引力耦合自由玻色物质的边界 von Neumann 代数，得到非超有限 II∞ 型因子并给出权重限制的尖锐性。

papers.title: Exact model of a gravitational wave and electromagnetic radiation in DHOST gravity theory: wave solutions and testable effects
papers.abstract: Within an analytical non-perturbative framework based on a single exact model, the coupled dynamics of gravitational waves and high-frequency electromagnetic fields is investigated in General Relativity and DHOST gravity. Using an exact gravitational-wave spacetime in an isotropic (null) wave coordinate system, Maxwell's equations are integrated analytically. This analysis provides an exact non-perturbative confirmation from the full field equations that a gravitational wave acts as a waveguide, forming a propagation channel for electromagnetic radiation co-directional with the gravitational wave and generating an effective pure-radiation source. Applying this exact electrodynamic solution to the nonlinear field equations of DHOST class~Ia gravity reveals that the algebraic structure of the DHOST constraint equations enforces a modification of the electromagnetic-wave parameters. Based on this mechanism, an observationally testable effect of scalar frequency drift is derived, providing a direct way to discriminate between General Relativity and modified gravity theories even when their metric tensors share identical functional forms.

classification.title_zh: DHOST引力理论中引力波与电磁辐射的精确模型：波解与可检验效应
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在一个基于单一精确模型的解析非微扰框架内，研究广义相对论与DHOST引力中引力波和高频电磁场的耦合动力学。利用各向同性（零）波坐标系中的精确引力波时空，解析积分麦克斯韦方程。该分析从完整场方程给出精确非微扰确认：引力波可作为波导，形成与引力波同向传播的电磁辐射通道，并产生有效纯辐射源。将此精确电动力学解应用于DHOST Ia类引力的非线性场方程后可见，DHOST约束方程的代数结构强制修改电磁波参数。基于该机制，作者导出一个观测上可检验的标量频率漂移效应，为区分广义相对论与修改引力理论提供直接途径，即使二者的度规张量具有相同函数形式。
classification.one_liner: 在DHOST Ia类引力中给出引力波与高频电磁场耦合的精确非微扰解，并推出可检验的标量频率漂移效应。

papers.title: FOORT: Flexible Object-Oriented Ray Tracing
papers.abstract: We present FOORT (Flexible Object-Oriented Ray Tracing), an open C++ code for ray-tracing images of black holes and other compact objects in arbitrary spacetimes. FOORT is designed to offer flexibility and can handle horizons, naked singularities and numerical metrics, allowing it to ray-trace numerous different metrics including Kerr and other black holes, as well as horizonless objects such as fuzzballs and boson stars. New metrics, analytical or numerical, can be added with minimal effort, and geodesics are initialized at the camera without reference to conserved quantities, so no special structure of the metric is required. Besides the intensity observed from a geometrically and optically thin equatorial disk, FOORT is set up to track a number of diagnostics along each geodesic, such as the number of equatorial crossings and the radius of closest approach. Its adaptive mesh can refine the image on any of these diagnostics, efficiently resolving narrow features such as higher-order photon rings. Accompanying Python tools convert the output into images and interferometric visibility amplitudes. We describe the main features of the code, validate it against analytic results in the Schwarzschild and Kerr spacetimes, demonstrate it on several non-Kerr metrics, and characterize its scaling with the number of OpenMP threads. FOORT is lightweight, requiring only C++17 and OpenMP, and has already been used in a number of studies of black hole and compact-object imaging. The code is publicly available in a GitHub repository.

classification.title_zh: FOORT：灵活面向对象的光线追踪
classification.abstract_zh: 我们介绍 FOORT（Flexible Object-Oriented Ray Tracing），一个用于在任意时空中对黑洞及其他致密天体进行光线追踪成像的开源 C++ 代码。FOORT 以灵活性为设计目标，可处理视界、裸奇点和数值度规，因而能对包括 Kerr 及其他黑洞，以及 fuzzball、boson star 等无视界天体在内的众多不同度规进行光线追踪。新增解析或数值度规所需工作量很小；测地线从相机处初始化而不依赖守恒量，因此不需要度规具有特殊结构。除了几何薄且光学薄赤道盘所观测到的强度外，FOORT 还能沿每条测地线追踪多种诊断量，例如赤道穿越次数和最近接近半径。其自适应网格可依据这些诊断量对图像进行细化，从而高效分辨高阶光子环等窄特征。配套 Python 工具可将输出转换为图像和干涉可见度振幅。我们描述代码的主要功能，用 Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 时空的解析结果进行验证，在若干非 Kerr 度规上作演示，并刻画其随 OpenMP 线程数的扩展性。FOORT 轻量，仅需 C++17 和 OpenMP，并已被用于多项黑洞与致密天体成像研究。代码已在 GitHub 仓库公开。
classification.one_liner: 发布并验证一个用于任意时空中黑洞与致密天体成像的灵活 C++ 光线追踪代码 FOORT。

papers.title: Ernst-Potential Driven Recovery of Kerr with Neural Networks
papers.abstract: We use artificial neural networks to recover the Kerr solution by directly minimizing a regularized Ernst sigma-model action. Reduction along the axial Killing direction avoids the divergence at the ergosphere. Compactified coordinates cover the entire black-hole exterior, while the network parametrization enforces the asymptotic data and axis regularity. For dimensionless spins $0.1 \le a/M \le 0.99$, the median maximum relative error in the recovered metric component $g_{\phi\phi}$ remains below $7.2\times10^{-4}$. When only the horizon rod length and angular momentum are prescribed, the networks also predict the mass with median relative errors below $1.8\times10^{-3}$. These results demonstrate the practicality of direct variational training for rotating black-hole geometries.

classification.title_zh: Ernst 势驱动的神经网络恢复 Kerr 解
classification.abstract_zh: 利用人工神经网络，通过直接最小化正则化 Ernst sigma-model 作用量来恢复 Kerr 解。沿轴向 Killing 方向约化避免能层处发散；紧致坐标覆盖整个黑洞外部，网络参数化强制渐近数据和轴正则性。对无量纲自旋 0.1≤a/M≤0.99，恢复的度规分量 g_φφ 的中位最大相对误差低于 7.2×10^-4。仅给定视界杆长和角动量时，网络预测质量的中位相对误差低于 1.8×10^-3。结果表明直接变分训练对旋转黑洞几何具有实用性。
classification.one_liner: 用神经网络最小化正则化 Ernst 作用量，从变分训练中高精度恢复 Kerr 黑洞度规。

papers.title: Gravitational observables from a post-Carrollian expansion
papers.abstract: Einstein gravity, with a few exceptions, only admits nonlocal observables. This feature is often attributed to diffeomorphism invariance, since a gravitational field can thereby locally be transformed away. We show this attribution to be incorrect by constructing infinitely many exact ultralocal Dirac observables in (velocity dominated aka electric) Carroll gravity. The latter describes Einstein gravity's ultrarelativistic limit, is fully diffeomorphism invariant, and of independent interest in a variety of contexts. Starting from these Carroll observables a systematic construction of Dirac observables for Einstein gravity is outlined. The resulting "post-Carrollian" expansion is organized by the number of spatial gradients or fractional inverse powers of Newton's constant, where each partial sum is local.

classification.title_zh: 来自post-Carrollian展开的引力可观测量
classification.abstract_zh: 爱因斯坦引力除少数例外只允许非局域可观测量。这一特征常被归因于微分同胚不变性，因为引力场可由此被局域地变换掉。我们通过在（速度主导/电型）Carroll引力中构造无穷多精确的超局域Dirac可观测量，表明这种归因是不正确的。后者描述爱因斯坦引力的超相对论极限，具有完全微分同胚不变性，并在多种语境中具有独立意义。从这些Carroll可观测量出发，我们概述了爱因斯坦引力Dirac可观测量的系统构造。所得的“post-Carrollian”展开按空间梯度数或牛顿常数的分数逆幂组织，其中每个部分和都是局域的。
classification.one_liner: 该文在Carroll引力中构造超局域Dirac可观测量，并以此提出系统构造Einstein引力可观测量的post-Carrollian展开。

papers.title: Decoupling Dynamics: A Tale of Two Limits
papers.abstract: The symmetries of a $d$-dimensional QFT are known to be captured by a topological theory in one dimension higher, the Symmetry Topological Field Theory (SymTFT), which is invariant under gauging finite symmetries of the QFT, but not under dynamical gauging of continuous symmetries. We show that the distinct SymTFTs of a $d$-dimensional QFT before and after dynamical gauging of a continuous Abelian symmetry arise as different topological limits of the same dynamical holographic gauge theory in $(d+1)$-dimensions. Gauging changes the boundary condition of this dynamical theory and thereby selects a different topological limit, explaining why the associated SymTFT changes. We give a fully quantum definition of these SymTFTs at the level of Hilbert spaces and operators by combining suitable limits of the bulk holographic theory with photon truncation. This construction clarifies how topological symmetry defects, charges, and anomalies survive while the dynamical information carried by currents is discarded. We study non-anomalous and anomalous examples, providing a complete quantum analysis for $(2+1)$-dimensional bulks. For a four-dimensional boundary theory with a mixed axial-vector anomaly, we recover the SymTFT of the non-invertible chiral symmetry that remains after gauging the vector symmetry.

classification.title_zh: 解耦动力学：两个极限的故事
classification.abstract_zh: d维QFT的对称性已知可由高一维的拓扑理论——对称拓扑场论（SymTFT）——捕获，该理论在QFT的有限对称性规范化下不变，但在连续对称性的动力学规范化下并不不变。我们证明，d维QFT在连续阿贝尔对称性动力学规范化前后不同的SymTFT，可作为同一(d+1)维动力学全息规范理论的不同拓扑极限出现。规范化改变该动力学理论的边界条件，从而选择不同的拓扑极限，解释了相关SymTFT为何改变。通过将体全息理论的适当极限与光子截断相结合，我们在希尔伯特空间和算符层面给出这些SymTFT的完全量子定义。该构造阐明了拓扑对称性缺陷、电荷和反常如何在电流所携带的动力学信息被丢弃时存活。我们研究非反常和反常例子，对(2+1)维体给出完整的量子分析。对于具有混合轴矢反常的四维边界理论，我们恢复了在规范化矢量对称性后残留的非可逆手征对称性的SymTFT。
classification.one_liner: 该文把连续对称性规范化前后不同的SymTFT解释为同一全息规范理论的不同拓扑极限，并给出量子定义。
