papers.title: Bound States of Two D0-Branes and the Three-Graviton Coupling
papers.abstract: We numerically solve for the ground state of the $SU(2)$ BFSS matrix model for M-theory. This state corresponds to the zero-energy bound state of two D0-branes or, by the BFSS conjecture, to the eleven-dimensional graviton with two units of momentum along the M-theory circle. The wavefunction exhibits a strongly coupled core, as well as an asymptotic power-law tail where the D0-branes are well separated. The coefficient of this power-law decay is the three-graviton coupling, previously computed by Herderschee and Maldacena, which our numerical solution reproduces with high accuracy. We also show that this coupling is protected by supersymmetry in the matrix model, and derive its value from the non-renormalized one-loop interaction of the two D0-branes. Lastly, we provide a simple representation-theoretic argument regarding the recently proposed excited bound states of the model.

classification.title_zh: 两个D0膜的束缚态与三引力子耦合
classification.abstract_zh: 我们数值求解了M理论SU(2) BFSS矩阵模型的基态。该态对应两个D0膜的零能束缚态，或者按BFSS猜想，对应沿M理论圆具有两单位动量的十一维引力子。波函数呈现强耦合核心，以及在D0膜分离较远处的渐近幂律尾部。该幂律衰减的系数即三引力子耦合，此前由Herderschee和Maldacena计算；我们的数值解以高精度重现了它。我们还证明该耦合在矩阵模型中受超对称保护，并从两个D0膜未重整化的一圈相互作用导出其数值。最后，我们就该模型近期提出的激发束缚态给出一个简单的表示论论证。
classification.one_liner: 数值求解BFSS SU(2)矩阵模型基态，并用D0膜波函数幂律尾部高精度验证三引力子耦合及其超对称保护。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究BFSS矩阵模型、D0膜束缚态与M理论三引力子耦合，属于矩阵模型/量子引力方向；未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息凝聚态、全息QCD、非平衡输运、经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: A precision bound for gravitational transseries
papers.abstract: We propose that the large $N$ transseries of a holographic observable above the black hole threshold admits a precision bound, a limit on how precisely the transseries can determine the observable at finite $N$, set by the data of its D-brane instanton sectors. In doing so, we develop methods in large $N$ resurgence, based on the work of \'{E}calle, that capture the $e^{-N^2}$ asymptotics of gravitational saddles beyond the $e^{-N}$ instantons. Under an assumption on the growth of the D-brane instanton sums that we expect in the black hole phase, we find an analytic obstruction to the resummation of the large $N$ transseries. This obstruction sets the precision bound. As our main example and consistency check, we study the $\frac{1}{16}$-BPS index of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills and its black hole. We derive relations between the D-brane instanton data on thermal AdS and on the black hole, in the form of a duality that exchanges the numbers of D-brane instantons on the two backgrounds. In the index, these relations reproduce the actions of D3-branes wrapped on the black hole. We conclude with our expectations for generic situations and their relation to the double-cone wormhole.

classification.title_zh: 引力 transseries 的精度界限
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出，在黑洞阈值之上，全息可观测量的 large N transseries 存在一个精度界限：有限 N 下 transseries 确定该可观测量的精度受其 D-brane 瞬子扇区数据限制。为此，作者基于 Écalle 的工作发展 large N resurgence 方法，以捕捉超出 e^{-N} 瞬子的引力鞍点 e^{-N^2} 渐近。在关于黑洞相中 D-brane 瞬子求和增长的假设下，发现 large N transseries 重求和的解析障碍，该障碍给出精度界限。主要例子和一致性检验是 N=4 超 Yang-Mills 的 1/16-BPS 指标及其黑洞。作者导出热 AdS 与黑洞上 D-brane 瞬子数据之间的关系，形式为交换两个背景上 D-brane 瞬子数的对偶；在指标中这些关系重现了包裹黑洞的 D3-brane 作用。最后讨论一般情形预期及其与双锥虫洞的关系。
classification.one_liner: 提出全息大N transseries受D-brane瞬子数据限制的精度界，并在N=4 SYM黑洞指标中检验。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题属于全息/黑洞量子引力与非微扰 resurgence，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Love numbers for the Myers-Perry geometry
papers.abstract: We analyze Love numbers for scalar fields in the Myers-Perry geometry in arbitrary dimensions. The tidal responses of black holes are specified by two constants which encode a potential logarithmic running and the Love number. We argue that the parameter specifying the running is not sensitive to the structure of the horizon, and we explicitly compute this parameter for Myers-Perry black holes in arbitrary dimensions by utilizing the asymptotic expansion of the wave equation. The Love numbers rely on the details of the boundary conditions at the horizon, and we compute them using several distinct approximations.

classification.title_zh: Myers-Perry 几何中的 Love 数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析任意维 Myers-Perry 几何中标量场的 Love 数。黑洞的潮汐响应由两个常数刻画，分别编码势的对数跑动与 Love 数。我们认为，指定跑动的参数对事件视界结构不敏感，并利用波动方程的渐近展开，对任意维 Myers-Perry 黑洞显式计算该参数。Love 数依赖于事件视界处边界条件的细节，我们用几种不同近似计算它们。
classification.one_liner: 计算任意维 Myers-Perry 黑洞中标量场的潮汐 Love 数及对数跑动参数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究 Myers-Perry 黑洞的经典潮汐 Love 数与视界边界条件，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: De Sitter Gravity and Emergent Time from Fusion Matrix Product States and SYK
papers.abstract: We propose a quantum-mechanical model dual to two-dimensional de Sitter (dS) gravity. It is a quantum channel, defined by a matrix product state that fuses one spin at each step, and is related to a limit of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model without chord crossings. Its simplest part is a random walk with an emergent $SL(2,\mathbb R)$ symmetry, which we identify with the symmetry of the future boundary of dS. It selects a time variable in which the walk obeys the Schwarzian action and yields the disk amplitude of dS Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity. As the simplest case, we consider free massless scalar fields in the fixed background of dS$_2$. We find the agreement of the two-point function in the Bunch-Davies vacuum and the matching of symmetry. Our construction provides a concrete model for the dS/CFT correspondence for two-dimensional de Sitter gravity.

classification.title_zh: 来自融合矩阵乘积态与SYK的de Sitter引力及涌现时间
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个对偶于二维de Sitter（dS）引力的量子力学模型。该模型是一个量子信道，由每一步融合一个自旋的矩阵乘积态定义，并与无弦交叉极限下的Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev模型相关。其最简单部分是一个具有涌现SL(2,R)对称性的随机行走，我们将该对称性认定为dS未来边界的对称性。它选取一个时间变量，使该随机行走满足Schwarzian作用量，并给出dS Jackiw-Teitelboim引力的圆盘振幅。作为最简单情形，我们考虑固定dS2背景中的自由无质量标量场，发现其Bunch-Davies真空两点函数与对称性匹配。我们的构造为二维de Sitter引力的dS/CFT对应提供了一个具体模型。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于融合矩阵乘积态与无弦交叉SYK极限的二维dS引力对偶模型，并匹配dS JT引力与Bunch-Davies两点函数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究dS/CFT、SYK/JT引力与二维de Sitter引力的全息对偶，属于全息理论核心方向，但不直接涉及用户列出的全息超流、探针膜、QNM或经典引力等具体重点支线。

papers.title: Holographic viscous transport in scalar-coupled Gauss-Bonnet gravity
papers.abstract: We test horizon formulas for the shear and bulk viscosities of a holographic plasma against viscosities extracted directly from retarded stress-tensor correlators. We work in a five-dimensional Einstein-dilaton-Gauss-Bonnet model calibrated to the lattice QCD equation of state at zero baryon density. UV-finite renormalized correlators are obtained by including the required curvature and scalar counterterms, and the fluctuation equations are solved while retaining the full dependence on the Gauss-Bonnet coupling $\alpha$, without using a horizon conservation law or an entropy-production formula. For constant coupling, the horizon conserved-current calculation reproduces the boundary Kubo results in both channels. For the scalar-dependent coupling studied here, both methods find a minimum in the shear-viscosity-to-entropy-density ratio $\eta/s$. In the bulk channel, the conserved-current calculation truncated at first order in $\alpha$ yields a lower peak height in $\zeta/s$, with the peak temperature nearly unchanged relative to the boundary result. For both couplings, the unmodified Eling-Oz (EO) formula, $\zeta/s=(4\pi)^{-1}(\partial\phi_h/\partial\ln s)^2$, reproduces the boundary result for $\zeta/s$, where $\phi_h$ is the horizon value of the scalar. The prefactor $1/(4\pi)$ is thus retained even when the Gauss-Bonnet interaction shifts $\eta/s$ from this value. These results provide a direct boundary benchmark for horizon prescriptions and support the unmodified EO formula beyond constant coupling.

classification.title_zh: 标量耦合 Gauss-Bonnet 引力中的全息粘性输运
classification.abstract_zh: 我们检验全息等离子体剪切粘度和体粘度的视界公式，并将其与直接从推迟应力张量关联子提取的粘度进行对比。工作于五维 Einstein-dilaton-Gauss-Bonnet 模型，该模型校准到零重子密度格点 QCD 状态方程。通过包含所需曲率和标量抵消项获得 UV 有限的重整化关联子，并在保留对 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合 α 完整依赖的情况下求解涨落方程，不使用视界守恒律或熵产生公式。对于常数耦合，视界守恒流计算在两种通道中重现边界 Kubo 结果。对于此处研究的标量依赖耦合，两种方法都发现剪切粘度与熵密度比 η/s 的极小值。在体通道中，截断到 α 一阶的守恒流计算给出较低的 ζ/s 峰高，峰温相对边界结果几乎不变。对于两种耦合，未修改的 Eling-Oz (EO) 公式 ζ/s=(4π)^(-1)(∂φ_h/∂ln s)^2 重现边界 ζ/s 结果，其中 φ_h 是标量的视界值。因此即使 Gauss-Bonnet 相互作用使 η/s 偏离该值，前因子 1/(4π) 仍保留。这些结果为视界处方提供直接边界基准，并支持未修改 EO 公式在常数耦合之外成立。
classification.one_liner: 用边界推迟关联子基准检验标量耦合 Gauss-Bonnet 全息等离子体的剪切与体粘性视界公式。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦全息等离子体的剪切/体粘性输运与视界公式基准，不涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM/非线性演化、冷原子、探针膜/Floquet 或经典引力主线。

papers.title: Finite cyclic monodromy in BMS3 gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate inducing data for three dimensional asymptotically flat BMS gravity on hyperbolic Virasoro orbits with winding, which contain no constant supermomentum, and the restriction of formal smooth equivariant sections to global Lorentz orbits. Using the developing map of the associated Hill operator we rederive their stabilizer and show that, in the spin double cover, it is the direct product of a line with a cyclic group of even order. The character of the cyclic factor is therefore a discrete inducing label independent of the continuous one, unlike for the massive BMS particles, where it is fixed by the spin. At points with the corresponding finite rotational symmetry, restriction of formal smooth equivariant sections to a global Lorentz orbit yields the finite cyclic equivariance condition, while an independently defined unitary global branch realizes the associated finite difference equation. At points with timelike projected momentum we derive the resulting ladder of Poincare helicities, show that the projected rest energy is not an orbit invariant, construct locally flat winding BMS geometries with hyperbolic Lorentz holonomy, prove that the smooth real periodic near horizon current model excludes these winding orbits, and obtain selection rules and closed form expressions for finite monodromy resolved orbital functionals. A unitary realization on the full infinite dimensional orbit is not constructed, and the interpretation of the cyclic sectors in quantum gravity remains conjectural.

classification.title_zh: BMS3 引力中的有限循环单值性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究三维渐近平坦 BMS 引力在带绕数的双曲 Virasoro 轨道上的诱导数据；这些轨道不含常数超动量，并研究形式光滑等变截面到整体 Lorentz 轨道的限制。利用相关 Hill 算子的发展映射，我们重新导出其稳定子，并证明在自旋双覆盖中它是直线与偶数阶循环群的直积。因此循环因子的特征是一个与连续标号无关的离散诱导标号，这不同于大质量 BMS 粒子中由自旋固定的情形。在具有相应有限旋转对称性的点处，形式光滑等变截面到整体 Lorentz 轨道的限制给出有限循环等变条件，而一个独立定义的酉整体分支实现相关的有限差分方程。在投影动量为类时的点处，我们导出由此产生的 Poincaré 螺旋度阶梯，证明投影静止能量不是轨道不变量，构造具有双曲 Lorentz holonomy 的局部平坦绕数 BMS 几何，证明光滑实周期近视界流模型排除这些绕数轨道，并获得有限单值性分辨的轨道泛函的选择定则与闭式表达式。未构造完整无限维轨道上的酉实现，循环扇区在量子引力中的解释仍是猜测性的。
classification.one_liner: 研究 BMS3 引力中带绕数双曲 Virasoro 轨道上的诱导数据，导出有限循环单值性、Poincaré 螺旋度阶梯与选择定则，但未构造完整酉实现。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 BMS3/渐近平坦全息表示论，与用户列出的全息超流、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7 等具体支线无直接重合；虽属全息大方向，但未触及这些重点标签。

papers.title: Thermodynamics within and across AdS Gauss--Bonnet holographic CFTs
papers.abstract: We study thermal competition within individual holographic conformal field theories (CFTs) and across theories with different anomaly coefficients in five-dimensional AdS Gauss--Bonnet gravity. We derive the work term conjugate to the dimensionless coupling from the boundary first law and use a common boundary clock to compare charged spherical saddles at fixed external source. Varying this source drives a first-order switch between the CFTs at the endpoints of the chosen coupling interval. In the unit-lapse cylinder clock with the zero-type-D vacuum energy, strict concavity at fixed radius reduces the global comparison to these two endpoints. The preferred coupling jumps across the coexistence line, whose slope is related to the entropy difference by a generalized Clapeyron relation. Where the Einstein endpoint itself undergoes small--large coexistence, a third saddle joins the competition and produces a kink in the cross-theory boundary. A compensating change of the external control preserves saddle ordering under finite energy shifts. Within fixed CFTs, we determine the neutral Hawking--Page line and the charged small--large black hole coexistence surface. The critical charge tends to zero at a finite coupling. The entropy gap closes with exponent one half, and the heat capacity diverges with exponent two thirds along a temperature sweep at the critical charge.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: AdS Gauss-Bonnet 全息 CFT 内部及跨理论的热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究五维 AdS Gauss-Bonnet 引力中单个全息共形场论（CFT）内部、以及具有不同反常系数的理论之间的热竞争。由边界第一定律导出与无量纲耦合共轭的功项，并用共同的边界时钟在固定外源下比较带电球对称鞍点。改变该外源会在所选耦合区间端点处的 CFT 之间驱动一阶切换。在具有零 type-D 真空能量的单位 lapse 柱面时钟下，固定半径处的严格凹性将全局比较约化为这两个端点。偏好耦合跃过共存线，其斜率通过广义 Clapeyron 关系与熵差相联系。当 Einstein 端点本身经历小-大共存时，第三个鞍点加入竞争，并在跨理论边界中产生扭结。外部控制量的补偿变化在有限能量移动下保持鞍点排序。在固定 CFT 内，我们确定中性 Hawking-Page 线以及带电小-大黑洞共存面。临界电荷在有限耦合处趋于零。熵隙以 1/2 指数闭合，而在临界电荷处沿温度扫描热容以 2/3 指数发散。
classification.one_liner: 在五维 AdS Gauss-Bonnet 全息 CFT 中比较单理论内与跨理论的黑洞鞍点热力学，并给出共存线、Hawking-Page 线及临界指数。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接涉及全息 CFT/AdS Gauss-Bonnet 黑洞热力学、Hawking-Page 转变、带电小-大黑洞共存与临界指数，与“相变与气泡成核”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签高度相关；但不涉及超流超导、畴壁/涡旋或 Floquet 探针膜。

papers.title: Holographic Counterterms from Restricted Weyl Symmetry in Even-Dimensional Einstein-AdS Gravity
papers.abstract: We develop a symmetry-based approach to renormalization for even-dimensional Einstein-AdS gravity based on infinitesimal bulk Weyl transformations that preserve its field equations asymptotically. We determine a bulk-covariant completion of the Einstein-Hilbert density by requiring its variation under restricted Weyl transformations with parameter $\Sigma(X)$ to vanish modulo terms whose integrals remain finite as the radial cutoff is removed. This requirement induces two types of compensating terms with fixed couplings: the Euler density and a hierarchy of covariant total derivatives. The resulting recursive relations admit a factorized solution in terms of shifted Laplacians, yielding a closed-form completion in arbitrary even bulk dimensions. On Einstein backgrounds, these expressions agree, after matching normalizations, with those obtained through the ambient construction of conformal invariants. The associated renormalized-volume identity establishes on-shell finiteness for Euclidean AlAdS Einstein geometries in arbitrary even dimensions. The prescription reproduces the known conformally renormalized actions in four, six and eight dimensions and provides an explicit ten-dimensional completion involving powers of the Laplacian up to $\Box^3$. Applications to eight- and ten-dimensional AdS black holes with non-conformally-flat Einstein horizons yield finite on-shell actions in agreement with Holographic Renormalization.

classification.title_zh: 偶数维 Einstein-AdS 引力中来自限制 Weyl 对称性的全息抵消项
classification.abstract_zh: 本文基于保持场方程渐近成立的无穷小体 Weyl 变换，为偶数维 Einstein-AdS 引力发展了一种基于对称性的重整化方法。通过要求 Einstein-Hilbert 密度的体协变完备项在参数为 Σ(X) 的限制 Weyl 变换下，其变分在径向截断移除后仅余有限项积分时消失，诱导出两类耦合固定的补偿项：Euler 密度和一列协变全导数。所得递推关系可用平移 Laplacian 的因子化解表示，从而给出任意偶数体维数下的闭式完备项。在 Einstein 背景上，匹配归一化后，这些表达式与通过共形不变量的 ambient 构造所得结果一致。相关的重整化体积恒等式确立了任意偶数维欧几里得 AlAdS Einstein 几何在 on-shell 下的有限性。该方案重现了四维、六维和八维已知的共形重整化作用量，并给出一个显式的十维完备项，其中包含最高至 □^3 的 Laplacian 幂次。对具有非共形平坦 Einstein 视界的八维和十维 AdS 黑洞的应用给出有限 on-shell 作用量，并与全息重整化结果一致。
classification.one_liner: 基于限制体 Weyl 对称性构造任意偶数维 Einstein-AdS 引力的全息抵消项，并验证 AdS 黑洞的有限 on-shell 作用量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 AdS/CFT 全息重整化与抵消项构造，并涉及经典 Einstein-AdS 引力及 AdS 黑洞 on-shell 作用量；与全息字典和经典引力支线相关，但不直接涉及所列超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子或探针膜等具体重点方向。

papers.title: Holographic Wilsonian RG of Yang-Mills theory in AdS
papers.abstract: In this work, we extend the equilibrium-evolution duality between stochastic quantization and Wilsonian renormalization to non-abelian gauge theories in anti-de Sitter space, for which the radial coordinate of AdS plays the role of the stochastic time. We show, to all orders in the fields for bulk theories without explicit radial dependence, that the Langevin distribution at time $t$ is the product of the ultraviolet and infrared radial wavefunctions at the cutoff $\epsilon=t$. We therefore identify this Langevin process as the ground-state (Doob) transform of the radial evolution. By explicit calculation, we also extend the existing dictionary in the stochastic-renormalization duality: the radial component of the bulk field is Zwanziger's stochastic gauge-fixing function; radial gauge is Parisi-Wu quantization; and the bulk gauge $A_z=\alpha^{-1}\partial_iA_i$ is Zwanziger's gauge. We also obtain the expressions for the triple-trace and quadruple-trace couplings of the holographic Wilsonian action at finite cutoff in closed form; in the infrared, they reduce to the known gluon correlators and, at the total-energy pole, to flat-space Yang-Mills amplitudes as expected. Although our explicit results are provided at tree-level and derived in AdS$_4$, we also comment on the de Sitter counterpart of these statements and on the loop corrections.

classification.title_zh: AdS 中 Yang-Mills 理论的全息 Wilsonian 重整化群
classification.abstract_zh: 本文将随机量子化与 Wilsonian 重整化之间的平衡-演化对偶推广到反 de Sitter 空间中的非阿贝尔规范理论，其中 AdS 的径向坐标扮演随机时间。对于没有显式径向依赖的体理论，我们证明在任意场阶数下，时刻 t 的 Langevin 分布是截断 ε=t 处紫外与红外径向波函数的乘积；因此将该 Langevin 过程识别为径向演化的基态（Doob）变换。通过显式计算，我们扩展了随机-重整化对偶中已有的字典：体场的径向分量是 Zwanziger 随机规范固定函数；径向规范是 Parisi-Wu 量子化；体规范 A_z=α^{-1}∂_i A_i 是 Zwanziger 规范。我们还以闭式给出有限截断下全息 Wilsonian 作用的三迹和四迹耦合表达式；在红外它们约化为已知胶子关联函数，并在总能量极点处如预期约化为平直空间 Yang-Mills 振幅。尽管显式结果是在树级并基于 AdS_4 得到，我们也评论了这些陈述的 de Sitter 对应以及圈修正。
classification.one_liner: 把随机量子化-Wilsonian RG 对偶推广到 AdS 非阿贝尔规范理论，并给出全息 Wilsonian 作用三/四迹耦合的闭式结果。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 Wilsonian RG 与 AdS/CFT 字典方向，并直接涉及重点标签 multi-trace；但不涉及全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、QNM、气泡成核或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Imaging the two-sided black hole interior with four-point correlators
papers.abstract: We propose a boundary four-point function smeared with wavepackets, which probes local physics behind the horizon of a two-sided AdS black hole. At high frequencies, boundary wavepackets aimed at an interior bulk point travel along geodesics and scatter locally about the bulk point, factorizing the correlator into a flat-space like scattering amplitude. To obtain this configuration, we utilize a non-trivial time ordering of operators, and also use one state-dependent operator insertion moved halfway across the thermal circle. An interesting property of this observable is that it also probes features of nontrivial states: null shocks and matter shells behind the horizon show up as jumps in the observed signal as the bulk point crosses them, thereby imaging the black hole interior.

classification.title_zh: 用四点关联函数成像双侧黑洞内部
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种用波包涂抹的边界四点函数，用于探测双侧 AdS 黑洞视界后的局域物理。在高频下，瞄准内部体点的边界波包沿测地线传播，并在该体点附近发生局域散射，使关联函数因子化为类平时空的散射振幅。为获得该构型，我们采用非平凡算符时序，并使用一个跨越热圆移动一半的态依赖算符插入。该可观测量的一个有趣性质是它也能探测非平凡态的特征：当体点穿过视界后的零激波和物质壳时，它们表现为观测信号中的跳变，从而成像黑洞内部。

papers.title: Magnetic-slope crossovers in the QCD bulk-to-shear viscosity ratio
papers.abstract: How a magnetic field alters dissipation in quark--gluon matter is almost unconstrained from first principles, since real-time transport is not directly accessible to lattice simulation. Using a top-down MQGP-inspired M/string-theory construction of a QCD-like thermal plasma, together with a kinetic-theory identity within a specified single-mode quasiparticle truncation and a compatibility construction using available lattice equation-of-state data, we propose a normalization-insensitive sign prediction that the field slope of the longitudinal bulk-to-shear viscosity ratio \zeta_\parallel/\eta_\parallel reverses sign twice with temperature---below and above the deconfinement pseudo-critical temperature T_0, at T_1<T_0<T_2 (the lower reversal T_1 conditional on a stated pion-gas rate inequality). A kinetic-theory identity with phase-appropriate carriers, a quark--gluon plasma above T_0 and a chiral pion gas below, reproduces the same pattern, and lattice speed-of-sound data can be shown to be consistent as well. The bottom-up VQCD in the deconfined phase supports a negative slope for large temperatures; the slope crossover is not resolvable from the available \zeta_\parallel/s, \eta_\parallel/s plots.

classification.title_zh: QCD 体粘滞与剪切粘滞比中的磁斜率交叉
classification.abstract_zh: 磁场如何改变夸克-胶子物质中的耗散，几乎无法从第一性原理直接约束，因为格点模拟不能直接访问实时输运。本文采用受 MQGP 启发的自上而下 M/弦论构造来描述类 QCD 热等离子体，并结合指定单模准粒子截断下的动能论恒等式以及与现有格点物态方程数据的相容性构造，提出一个对归一化不敏感的信号预言：纵向体粘滞与剪切粘滞之比 ζ_∥/η_∥ 随磁场的斜率会随温度发生两次符号反转——分别在退禁闭伪临界温度 T_0 之下和之上，即 T_1<T_0<T_2（较低的 T_1 反转依赖于文中给出的π介子气体速率不等式）。采用相appropriately的载流子（T_0 以上的夸克-胶子等离子体和 T_0 以下的手征π介子气体）的动能论恒等式可重现同样的图样，格点声速数据也可显示为相容。退禁闭相中的自下而上 VQCD 支持大温度下斜率为负；该斜率交叉无法从现有 ζ_∥/s、η_∥/s 图中分辨。

papers.title: Exact Infrared Triangle in Gravity with Long-Range Interactions
papers.abstract: Einstein gravity coupled to massless matter exhibits universality in the infrared. In the presence of long-range interactions we show that a novel superrotation charge conservation is equivalent to the massless limit of the classical logarithmic soft graviton theorem, and we propose a formula for the corresponding tail to the displacement memory. These results, which extend earlier work on gravity coupled to massive matter in a qualitatively different way, are exact in the gravitational coupling and reveal that long-range gravitational dressings resum. We also compute higher-order corrections to the known superrotation charge which are exact in the gravitational coupling and would correspond to a 1-loop exact correction to the Cachazo-Strominger subleading soft graviton theorem.

classification.title_zh: 长程相互作用引力中的精确红外三角
classification.abstract_zh: 与无质量物质耦合的 Einstein 引力在红外表现出普适性。我们证明，在存在长程相互作用时，一种新的超旋转荷守恒等价于经典对数软引力子定理的无质量极限，并提出位移记忆相应尾项的公式。这些结果以定性不同的方式推广了此前关于引力与有质量物质耦合的工作，在引力耦合下是精确的，并表明长程引力 dressing 会发生重求和。我们还计算了已知超旋转荷的高阶修正，这些修正在引力耦合下精确，并将对应于 Cachazo-Strominger 次领头软引力子定理的单圈精确修正。

papers.title: Swing Surfaces in AdS/CFT
papers.abstract: We study holographic entanglement entropy in the flat limit of AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$, and clarify the relation between Ryu-Takayanagi surfaces and the swing surfaces proposed for flat-space holography. We show that the ordinary RT formula does not admit a well-defined flat-space limit and connect this to subtleties of the state-operator map in the flat limit. We then construct an AdS$_3$ uplift of the swing prescription and develop its corresponding information-theoretic interpretation through two complementary approaches. First, we show that the swing surface length computes the mutual information between suitably chosen nearly null boundary intervals in a special class of pure CFT states. The gravity interpretation of this result involves scattering processes which take place deep inside of the AdS$_3$ bulk. Second, we reduce the problem of finding an information-theoretic interpretation for swing surfaces to the more general problem of finding an information-theoretic interpretation of black hole inner horizons in holography.

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT 中的 Swing 曲面

papers.title: Entropy and charge transport limit Mpemba preparation in holography
papers.abstract: We study Mpemba relaxation and its preparation cost in a holographic superconductor with full backreaction. At matched final energy and charge, boundary drives can reverse the ordering of the remaining horizon entropy after source removal. In separate numerical comparisons, some protocols reach a given tolerance earlier even when driving and waiting times are included. To examine the limits of preparation, we consider critical states that already carry a slow scalar field and exterior charge. Along the critical slow branch at fixed energy and charge, horizon displacement cancels the quadratic area response, leaving an entropy reserve of $O(\varepsilon^4)$ for an initial scalar amplitude $\varepsilon$. The same coefficient connects this reserve to the entropy advantage of the nearby superconducting equilibrium and the entropy weight of the slow tail on the normal side. This limited reserve constrains how quickly the existing field can be removed. For releases that suppress the leading horizon field and exterior charge, the preparation time grows at least as $\varepsilon^{-2}$ under horizon regularity and uniform radial control. Charge transport constrains the same covariant scalar flux that produces horizon entropy, raising the minimum flux cost and strengthening the time bound.

classification.title_zh: 熵与电荷输运限制全息中的 Mpemba 制备

papers.title: 1-loop partition function of 11d supergravity on $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$: matching $A(k)$ in ABJM free energy
papers.abstract: The function $A(k)$ appearing in the large $N$ expansion of free energy of ABJM theory on $S^3$ is known exactly from localization. An earlier calculation of the 1-loop partition function of 11d supergravity on $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$, based on the standard KK spectrum on $S^7$, did not reproduce it. We identify a missing 1-loop supergravity contribution as that of the 3-form field fluctuations built from square-integrable harmonic 2-forms on Euclidean $\mathrm{AdS}_4$ tensored with $S^7$ modes, which are not captured by the KK spectrum. Adding it to the KK tower contribution expressed in terms of superconformal characters and applying the $\mathbb{Z}_k$ projection, the total expression simplifies, and its evaluation in a zeta-function prescription reproduces the expression for $A(k)$. We also apply a similar approach to the 3d ADHM theory whose M-theory dual is the orbifold $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_p$, which has singularity along the fixed locus $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^3$, supporting a 7d $SU(p)$ vector multiplet. Adding the localized KK modes of this multiplet to the $\mathbb{Z}_p$-projected supergravity spectrum gives a 1-loop free energy that reproduces the ADHM localization counterpart of $A(k)$.

classification.title_zh: AdS4×S7/Z_k 上 11 维超引力的 1 圈配分函数：匹配 ABJM 自由能中的 A(k)
classification.abstract_zh: ABJM 理论在 S^3 上自由能的大 N 展开中出现的函数 A(k) 已由局域化精确给出。此前基于 S^7 上标准 KK 谱对 AdS4×S7/Z_k 上 11 维超引力 1 圈配分函数的计算未能重现它。我们识别出一个缺失的 1 圈超引力贡献：由欧氏 AdS4 上平方可积调和 2-形式与 S^7 模式张量构造的 3-形式场涨落，这些涨落不被 KK 谱捕获。将其加入用超共形特征表示的 KK 塔贡献并施加 Z_k 投影后，总表达式简化，并在 zeta 函数方案下求值可重现 A(k) 的表达式。我们还将类似方法应用于 3d ADHM 理论，其 M 理论对偶为 orbifold AdS4×S7/Z_p，该 orbifold 沿固定轨迹 AdS4×S^3 具有奇异性，并支持一个 7d SU(p) 矢量多重态。将该多重态的局域化 KK 模式加入 Z_p 投影后的超引力谱，得到的 1 圈自由能重现了 A(k) 的 ADHM 局域化对应物。
classification.one_liner: 补上 AdS4×S7/Z_k 上未被 KK 谱包含的 3-形式涨落，使 11 维超引力 1 圈配分函数重现 ABJM 局域化给出的 A(k)。

papers.title: Holographic dual of the 2d Ising model
papers.abstract: We propose a holographic dual of the 2d Ising model on a torus as the Turaev-Viro TQFT on a solid torus. The bulk spacetime is divided into the ``core'' region and the ``sandwich'' region. The core region prepares a defect state $|\mathcal{D}\rangle$ on the topological boundary $\mathbb{D}$. The sandwich region computes the Turaev-Viro state sum $\langle\mathcal{D}|\Pi|\mathcal{F}\rangle$ between the state $|\mathcal{D}\rangle$ on $\mathbb{D}$ and the state $|\mathcal{F}\rangle$ on the physical boundary $\mathbb{B}$. The fusion diagram (or string-net) $\mathcal{F}$ on $\mathbb{B}$ is given by the Aasen-Fendley-Mong construction. There is also a ``bedding surface'' $\mathbb{S}$ between $\mathbb{D}$ and $\mathbb{B}$, and the height variables (or Ising spins inside/outside of the domain wall) are naturally living on $\mathbb{S}$. The bulk spacetime is discretized by the 2-skeleton $P$ which interpolates $\mathcal{D}$ and $\mathcal{F}$. When the defect $\mathcal{D}$ is absent, the 2-skeleton $P$ ends on the bedding surface $\mathbb{S}$ and $P$ is interpreted as the bulk worldsheet of the string-net $\mathcal{F}$.

papers.title: Numerical Thermodynamics of AdS Black Holes with Higher-Order Mass Corrections
papers.abstract: Inspired by noncommutative geometry and quintessence, we construct a new class of asymptotically anti-de Sitter black hole solutions characterized by a higher-order mass deformation term $\frac{aM^{n-1}}{r^n}$ involving two parameters, $a$ and $n$. Due to analytical difficulties, we approach the underlying thermodynamics through parallel programming simulations using CUDA codes. By considering models with $n=3$, $n=4$, and $n=5$, we numerically study certain thermodynamic properties, including the stability, the $P$-$v$ criticality, and the phase transitions.

papers.title: Spectra and Central Charges of Gauged Curvature Squared Supergravities in Five Dimensions
papers.abstract: We study the spectra and the central charges of off-shell gauged five-dimensional $\mathcal N=2$ supergravity extended by the Weyl squared, Ricci tensor squared and Ricci scalar squared invariants, and by their Gauss-Bonnet combination. Working exactly in the couplings and keeping all auxiliary fields, we organize the spectra around the maximally supersymmetric AdS$_5$ vacuum into supermultiplets. With the Ricci scalar squared invariant, the spectrum gains a long vector multiplet and is free of ghosts in a finite range of the coupling, while with the Weyl squared or Ricci tensor squared invariant, it gains a long spin-2 multiplet and always contains ghosts or instabilities. The Gauss-Bonnet combination adds no new modes: around its supersymmetric vacuum, the quadratic action is a rescaled copy of that of the two-derivative theory, and this fixes the spectrum of the Ricci tensor squared extension. We also compute the central charges $a$ and $c$ and the flavor central charge exactly in the couplings. The vacuum equation is $a$-maximization, and the kinetic terms of the massless graviton and vector multiplets are proportional to $c$ and to the flavor central charge, so that the critical points, where the massive spin-2 multiplet becomes degenerate with the graviton multiplet, are zeros of $c$. Finally, around supersymmetric AdS$_3\times\Sigma_2$ backgrounds of the Gauss-Bonnet extension, the two-dimensional central charges are reproduced by $c$-extremization, while the spectrum is generically not unitary and contains towers of states whose energies stay bounded at large Kaluza-Klein levels. In part of the parameter space, the tower of spin-2 multiplets has positive norm, so that the spectrum has no finite density of states.

classification.title_zh: 五维规范曲率平方超引力的谱与中心荷
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究将Weyl张量平方、Ricci张量平方和Ricci标量平方不变量及其Gauss-Bonnet组合扩展到离壳五维N=2规范超引力后的谱与中心荷。精确到耦合常数并保留所有辅助场，我们将最大超对称AdS5真空附近的谱组织成超多重态。Ricci标量平方不变量使谱获得一个长矢量多重态，并在有限耦合范围内无鬼；Weyl平方或Ricci张量平方不变量则获得长自旋2多重态且总含鬼或不稳定。Gauss-Bonnet组合不添加新模：在其超对称真空附近，二次作用量是二导数理论的重标度拷贝，并固定Ricci张量平方扩展的谱。我们还在耦合中精确计算中心荷a、c和味中心荷。真空方程是a最大化；无质量引力子和矢量多重态的动能项分别正比于c和味中心荷，因此临界点（大质量自旋2多重态与引力子多重态简并）是c的零点。最后，在Gauss-Bonnet扩展的超对称AdS3×Σ2背景附近，二维中心荷由c极值化重现，而谱一般非酉并包含在大的Kaluza-Klein能级上能量有界的态塔。在部分参数空间，自旋2多重态塔具有正模，因此谱没有有限态密度。

papers.title: Simplicity of the Three-Loop Six-Point ABJM Amplitude
papers.abstract: We compute the three-loop six-point amplitude in planar ABJM theory using negative geometries. At this order, only a single bipartite chain contributes to the logarithm of the amplitude, and we find that its dual-conformally invariant integrand is locally finite. The integrated chain is therefore infrared finite and, remarkably, equals exactly $-\pi^2$ times the one-loop amplitude. Hence the collinear anomalous dimension, like the cusp, receives no three-loop correction. Restoring the disconnected products of lower-loop contributions, which carry all the infrared divergences, we obtain the full three-loop amplitude, fixed entirely by lower-loop data and the coefficient $-\pi^2$. These results reveal an unexpected simplicity of the six-point ABJM amplitude and suggest an iterative relation between its odd- and even-loop terms.

classification.title_zh: 三圈六点ABJM振幅的简洁性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用负几何计算平面ABJM理论中的三圈六点振幅。在此阶，只有一条二分链对振幅的对数有贡献，并且我们发现其对偶共形不变的被积函数是局部有限的。因此，积分后的链是红外有限的，并且显著地恰好等于负π平方乘以一圈振幅。因此，共线反常维度与尖点一样没有三圈修正。恢复携带全部红外发散的低圈非连通乘积后，我们得到完整的三圈振幅，它完全由低圈数据和系数负π平方确定。这些结果揭示了六点ABJM振幅的意外简洁性，并暗示其奇圈项与偶圈项之间存在迭代关系。
classification.one_liner: 三圈六点ABJM振幅由低圈数据和负π平方系数完全确定，显示意外简洁性。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要涉及ABJM全息理论的散射振幅计算，属于AdS/CFT基础研究，但未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流、非均匀态、QNM、经典引力等具体支线，因此相关性低。

papers.title: Solving spectral flow in AdS$_3$: from covering maps to pencils
papers.abstract: Strings in AdS$_3$ with pure NS-NS flux are described by the exactly solvable SL(2,$\mathbb{R}$) WZW model, yet correlators of winding strings, given by spectrally flowed operators, were so far known only up to three points. We obtain all of them, for any number of insertions and windings, in terms of unflowed correlators, proving the four-point conjecture of Dei and Eberhardt. The key ingredient is a pencil of rational maps from the worldsheet to the boundary which exists for generic insertion points, unwinds all insertions at once, and collapses to the covering map when the latter exists.

classification.title_zh: 求解 AdS$_3$ 中的谱流：从覆盖映射到线性系
classification.abstract_zh: 具有纯 NS-NS 通量的 AdS$_3$ 中的弦由可精确求解的 SL(2,R) WZW 模型描述，但由谱流算符给出的绕弦关联函数此前仅已知到三点。我们以未谱流关联函数的形式得到了任意插入数和绕数的所有关联函数，证明了 Dei 和 Eberhardt 的四点猜想。关键要素是一个从世界面到边界的有理映射线性系，它存在于一般插入点，能一次性解开所有插入，并在覆盖映射存在时退化为覆盖映射。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3/CFT2 中利用有理映射线性系求解任意绕数弦关联函数，证明四点谱流猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文研究 AdS3 中纯 NS-NS 通量弦在 SL(2,R) WZW 模型中的谱流关联函数，属于全息弦论基础，与用户列出的全息凝聚态、QCD、非平衡、经典引力等重点标签无直接关联。

papers.title: Self-gravitating spinning mesonic tubes
papers.abstract: In this paper, we construct new self-gravitating solutions for the four-dimensional $SU(2)$ Einstein non-linear sigma model and the Einstein-Skyrme model, both minimally coupled to the Maxwell field, which describes spinning pulsed mesonic tubes. These solutions are gyratonic in the sense that they are characterized by a propagation axis and possess angular momentum. The gyratonic solutions are described by a smooth matter distribution, which is free of curvature singularities. The maximum of the energy density is concentrated on a tube around the propagation axis. We first consider the $SU(2)$ non-linear sigma model minimally coupled to General Relativity and the Maxwell field, constructing asymptotically flat, spinning, pulsed gyratonic solutions. Subsequently, we include the Skyrme term in the analysis. In this case, we show that in order to maintain the resolvability of the matter field equations, the spacetime must be asymptotically de Sitter. It is also shown that, despite the fact that the total topological charge is zero, these solutions possess a non-zero topological charge density.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 自引力旋转介子管
classification.abstract_zh: 本文为四维 SU(2) Einstein 非线性 sigma 模型和 Einstein-Skyrme 模型构造了新的自引力解，二者均与 Maxwell 场最小耦合，描述旋转脉冲介子管。这些解是 gyratonic 的，即具有传播轴并携带角动量。gyratonic 解由光滑物质分布描述，无曲率奇点。能量密度最大值集中在传播轴周围的管上。我们首先考虑与广义相对论和 Maxwell 场最小耦合的 SU(2) 非线性 sigma 模型，构造渐近平直、旋转、脉冲 gyratonic 解。随后在分析中加入 Skyrme 项。在这种情况下，我们表明为保持物质场方程的可解性，时空必须是渐近 de Sitter 的。还表明，尽管总拓扑荷为零，这些解具有非零拓扑荷密度。
classification.one_liner: 构造了四维 Einstein 非线性 sigma/Einstein-Skyrme 与 Maxwell 耦合的自引力旋转介子管解，并讨论渐近平直/渐近 dS 及拓扑荷密度。

papers.title: Anatomy of AdS black hole on-shell actions
papers.abstract: We revisit the regularized on-shell actions of rotating electrically charged AdS black holes of gauged supergravity via holographic renormalization and background subtraction, with a particular emphasis on the frame in which the radial cutoff is placed. For holographic renormalization, the asymptotically global AdS frame, recently employed in seven dimensions, works equally well in five and six dimensions: the renormalized on-shell action of the AdS$_d$ black holes with $S^1\times S^{d-2}$ conformal boundaries satisfies the quantum statistical relation, up to a parameter-independent Casimir term in odd dimensions, and thereby places the holographic comparisons that so far relied on this relation on a first-principles footing. Background subtraction, in contrast, fails to reproduce this result in the same frame; the mismatch, which we identify exactly in terms of the Casimir term and the counterterms, demands a criterion for the cutoff surface yet to be established. For precision holography, our results settle the choice of frame for holographic renormalization with conformally flat boundaries and delineate the ambiguities that remain in background subtraction and in holographic renormalization for boundaries that are not conformally flat.

classification.title_zh: AdS黑洞在壳作用量的解剖
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过全息重整化和背景减除重新审视规范超引力中旋转带电AdS黑洞的正则化在壳作用量，特别强调径向截断所选取的标架。对于全息重整化，最近在七维使用的渐近全局AdS标架在五维和六维同样适用：具有 S^1×S^{d-2} 共形边界的 AdS_d 黑洞的重整化在壳作用量满足量子统计关系，奇维数下相差一个与参数无关的Casimir项，从而为此前依赖该关系的全息比较提供第一性原理基础。相反，背景减除在同一标架下无法重现该结果；我们精确指出该不匹配体现在Casimir项和抵消项上，这要求尚未建立的截断面判据。面向精密全息，我们的结果确定了共形平坦边界下全息重整化的标架选择，并刻画了背景减除以及非共形平坦边界全息重整化中仍存在的歧义。
classification.one_liner: 通过全息重整化与背景减除比较旋转带电AdS黑洞在壳作用量，确定共形平坦边界下的标架选择并揭示剩余歧义。

papers.title: Galilean cosmologies in two dimensions
papers.abstract: Inspired by Carroll black holes, we consider the most general theory of Galilean dilaton gravity in two dimensions. We find generically that the solution space describes cosmological spacetimes. From a limiting perspective, these Galilean geometries connect the white and black hole singularities through the bifurcation surface. The latter turns into a Galilean extremal surface in the limit of infinite speed of light. We also discuss aspects of Galilean tachydynamics and find that the entropy is given by the dilaton evaluated at the Galilean extremal surface.

classification.title_zh: 二维伽利略宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 受 Carroll 黑洞启发，我们考虑二维中最一般的伽利略伸缩子引力理论。我们发现其解空间通常描述宇宙学时空。从极限角度看，这些伽利略几何通过分叉面连接白洞与黑洞奇点；在光速无穷大的极限下，该分叉面变为伽利略极端面。我们还讨论伽利略快子动力学的若干方面，并发现熵由在伽利略极端面处求值的伸缩子给出。
classification.one_liner: 研究二维伽利略伸缩子引力的最一般理论，发现其解通常为宇宙学时空，并给出由伽利略极端面处伸缩子决定的熵。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典/非洛伦兹引力与二维伸缩子引力，涉及黑洞/宇宙学极限和熵，但不是 AdS/CFT 全息研究；与用户所列经典引力/广义相对论支线相关。

papers.title: Conformal boundary rigidity from null geodesic travel times
papers.abstract: The gravitational field of a distant, isolated system is manifested by the conformally invariant Weyl tensor. Thus the conformal structure far from the system encodes the system's gravitational mass. It also encodes the causal structure, thereby linking it to the mass. For asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes, this link led to a novel positive mass theorem of Page, Surya, and the second author \cite{PSW} which did not rely on any traditional energy condition. Here we ask whether that theorem has a rigidity case. Specifically, we consider all null geodesics in an asymptotically AdS spacetime that depart from the Penrose conformal infinity, travel through spacetime, and return to conformal infinity. If all such geodesics from a given point refocus at an antipodal point at infinity, is the spacetime conformal to anti-de Sitter space? It is easy to answer the question if the asymptotically AdS spacetime either (i) obeys the null energy condition in 3 or 4 spacetime dimensions, or (ii) is static (in any dimension), and we give simple proofs in those cases. We then answer the question in the case of globally stationary, asymptotically AdS spacetimes, by applying the theory of magnetic geodesics on the Riemannian manifold-with-boundary obtained by quotienting by the stationary Killing vector field. The question has an analogue for asymptotically flat spacetimes, which we also discuss.

classification.title_zh: 从零测地线旅行时间看共形边界刚性
classification.abstract_zh: 一个遥远、孤立系统的引力场由共形不变的Weyl张量体现。因此，远离系统的共形结构编码了系统的引力质量。它也编码了因果结构，从而将其与质量联系起来。对于渐近反德西特（AdS）时空，这种联系导致了Page、Surya和第二作者提出的新颖正质量定理，该定理不依赖于任何传统能量条件。这里我们问该定理是否有刚性情况。具体来说，我们考虑渐近AdS时空中所有从Penrose共形无穷远出发、穿过时空并返回共形无穷远的零测地线。如果从给定点出发的所有此类测地线都在无穷远的对跖点重新聚焦，那么时空是否共形于反德西特空间？如果渐近AdS时空（i）在3或4维时空中满足零能量条件，或（ii）是静态的（任意维度），则问题很容易回答，我们在这些情况下给出简单证明。然后，我们通过应用在由平稳Killing向量场商得到的带边界黎曼流形上的磁测地线理论，回答了全局平稳渐近AdS时空中的问题。该问题在渐近平坦时空中也有类似，我们也进行了讨论。
classification.one_liner: 研究渐近AdS时空中零测地线重新聚焦是否意味着时空共形于AdS，并给出多种情况下的证明。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文属于经典引力/广义相对论主题，研究渐近AdS时空的共形结构与零测地线性质，与用户重点标签中的‘经典引力/广义相对论’直接相关。

papers.title: QPEs from Warped Disk Collisions with EMRIs: Brightness-Recurrence Diagram and Gravitational-Wave Follow-up
papers.abstract: Quasi-Periodic Eruptions (QPEs) display correlated long/short and strong/weak patterns that remain unexplained by existing flat-disk collision models. We propose that these features arise from an extreme-mass-ratio inspiral (EMRI) colliding with a warped accretion disk, likely formed after a tidal disruption event. The warp modulates both recurrence time and burst energy, encoding the disk geometry -- and thus the spin of the central supermassive black hole (SMBH) -- into the X-ray light curve. We introduce the Brightness-Recurrence Diagram (BRD) to visualize this correlation, where QPE bursts trace an elliptical trajectory driven by the EMRI's apsidal precession; the tilt of this ellipse encodes whether the EMRI is prograde or retrograde relative to the SMBH spin. Applying this model to the prototypical QPE source GSN 069 successfully reproduces the observed patterns. The data are consistent with either a prograde stellar secondary or a retrograde stellar-mass black hole. In the stellar-mass black hole scenario, ongoing orbital decay could render the EMRI detectable by LISA within a few decades, facilitating gravitational-wave follow-up and independent multimessenger constraints on the system.

classification.title_zh: 翘曲盘与EMRI碰撞产生的QPE：亮度-复发图与引力波后续观测
classification.abstract_zh: 准周期爆发（QPEs）呈现相关的长短和强弱模式，现有平盘碰撞模型无法解释。我们提出这些特征源于极端质量比旋近（EMRI）与翘曲吸积盘碰撞，该盘可能形成于潮汐瓦解事件之后。翘曲同时调制复发时间和爆发能量，将盘几何——进而中心超大质量黑洞（SMBH）自旋——编码进X射线光变曲线。我们引入亮度-复发图（BRD）可视化这种相关性，其中QPE爆发沿椭圆轨迹，由EMRI的拱线进动驱动；椭圆倾斜编码EMRI相对SMBH自旋是顺行还是逆行。将该模型应用于原型QPE源GSN 069，成功再现观测模式。数据与顺行恒星次级或逆行恒星质量黑洞一致。在恒星质量黑洞情形下，持续轨道衰减可能使EMRI在几十年内被LISA探测到，促进引力波后续观测及对系统的独立多信使约束。
classification.one_liner: 用EMRI与翘曲吸积盘碰撞解释QPE长短/强弱关联，并以亮度-复发图编码黑洞自旋和LISA可探测性。

papers.title: Light Ring Stability Across Spacetime Dimensions and Theories of Gravity
papers.abstract: The light ring theorem states that four-dimensional stationary, axisymmetric, horizonless ultracompact objects (UCOs) possess light rings (LRs) in pairs, one of which is stable if the Null Energy Condition (NEC) holds in General Relativity (GR). The existence of a stable LR may trigger nonlinear spacetime instabilities, thereby raising questions about the viability of UCOs as long-lived black hole mimickers. We extend the LR existence and stability theorem beyond four-dimensional GR to modified gravity theories, in particular, $f(R)$ gravity, scalar-tensor theories, restricted Horndeski gravity and Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (EGB) gravity, in ($d \geq 4$) dimensional spacetimes. Our findings show that in four-dimensional modified gravities, the stability of LRs is governed by theory-specific coupling parameters in addition to the NEC. Consequently, a stable LR is not guaranteed to occur in certain parameter regimes. In higher dimensions ($d>4$), we confirm using topological arguments that LRs still emerge in pairs; however, the topological charges are now associated with four distinct types of LRs, including two types of saddle points. The stability analysis further constrains the allowed LR pairings, implying that, unlike in four-dimensional GR, the emergent pair does not necessarily include a stable LR. Our findings directly impact tests of GR using UCOs, demonstrating that LR stability is highly sensitive to both the underlying gravitational theory and spacetime dimensionality.

classification.title_zh: 跨时空维度与引力理论的光环稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 光环定理指出，在四维广义相对论中，若零能量条件（NEC）成立，四维稳态、轴对称、无视界的超紧凑天体（UCOs）会成对拥有光环（LRs），其中一个是稳定的。稳定LR的存在可能触发非线性时空不稳定性，从而对UCOs作为长寿命黑洞模仿者的可行性提出疑问。我们将LR存在性与稳定性定理从四维GR推广到修改引力理论，特别是f(R)引力、标量-张量理论、受限Horndeski引力和Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet（EGB）引力，并在d≥4维时空中讨论。结果表明，在四维修改引力中，LR的稳定性除NEC外还受理论特定耦合参数支配；因此，在某些参数区域不保证出现稳定LR。在高维（d>4）情形下，我们通过拓扑论证确认LR仍成对出现；然而，拓扑荷现在与四类不同的LR相关，其中包括两类鞍点。稳定性分析进一步限制了允许的LR配对，这意味着与四维GR不同，出现的LR配对不一定包含稳定LR。我们的结果直接影响使用UCOs检验GR，表明LR稳定性对底层引力理论与时空维度高度敏感。
classification.one_liner: 将光环存在性与稳定性定理推广到高维修改引力，发现稳定光环并非必然出现，从而影响UCOs作为黑洞模仿者及GR检验。

papers.title: Constraining deviations from the Teukolsky equation with GW250114
papers.abstract: The recent gravitational-wave detection GW250114 by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) Collaboration provides unprecedented precision for testing general relativity (GR) through black hole ringdowns. In this study, we provide the first bounds on theory-agnostic deviations from the Teukolsky equation as described by the beyond-Teukolsky formalism. It directly connects deviations in the perturbation equations on the level of the effective potential in the Teukolsky equation with changes in the quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum. We incorporate information on the final mass and spin from a full LVK inspiral-merger-ringdown analysis as parametrized priors in our analysis, reflecting theoretical uncertainties. Using publicly available LVK posterior information on agnostic damped sinusoid parameters, we then demonstrate how much beyond-Teukolsky potentials can be constrained. The high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) allows us to avoid the expensive full Bayesian analysis of all parameters and to work directly with a simplified likelihood for the fundamental QNM only. This strategy is promising for future events with even higher SNR and allows, in principle, for a quick and simple test of theories beyond GR without performing the full data analysis procedure. We report that current bounds on deviation parameters are in agreement with the Teukolsky equation.

classification.title_zh: 用GW250114约束对Teukolsky方程的偏离
classification.abstract_zh: 利用LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA合作组对GW250114的观测，首次给出对Teukolsky方程理论无关偏离的约束。beyond-Teukolsky形式将Teukolsky方程有效势层面的扰动偏离与准正模（QNM）谱变化直接联系。分析中把完整inspiral-merger-ringdown分析得到的最终质量和自旋信息作为参数化先验，并使用公开的agnostic damped sinusoid后验参数，展示可约束的beyond-Teukolsky势范围。高信噪比允许避免对全部参数进行昂贵的完整贝叶斯分析，而直接采用仅含基频QNM的简化似然。当前对偏离参数的约束与Teukolsky方程一致。
classification.one_liner: 利用GW250114高信噪比ringdown数据，首次对beyond-Teukolsky有效势偏离给出理论无关约束，结果与Teukolsky方程一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力、黑洞ringdown与QNM，并给出对广义相对论/Teukolsky方程的观测约束，与“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM”重点标签相关；但不涉及全息/AdS-CFT研究。

papers.title: Static Black Holes and Iyer-Wald Entropy in $f(\mathcal{R},\mathcal{K})$ Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate static, spherically symmetric black hole solutions in a class of {nonpolynomial} gravitational theories described by a {Lagrangian $f=-X^{1-n}$, where $X = \mathcal{R} + \sqrt{6\mathcal{K} - \mathcal{R}^2}$ is a function of the Ricci and Kretschmann scalars.} The modified Einstein equations contain {nonpolynomial} curvature terms. We develop a perturbative scheme to look for a black hole solution that deviates parametrically from the Schwarzschild geometry. We obtain first-order corrections to the metric by solving the resulting coupled differential equations. The corresponding Iyer--Wald entropy is then evaluated consistently to first order in the perturbative coupling. We show that the {nonpolynomial} contribution gives rise to a power-law correction to the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy.

classification.title_zh: f(R,K)引力中的静态黑洞与Iyer-Wald熵
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一类由拉格朗日量 f=-X^{1-n} 描述的非多项式引力理论中的静态球对称黑洞解，其中 X = R + sqrt(6K - R^2) 是 Ricci 标量 R 与 Kretschmann 标量 K 的函数。修改后的 Einstein 方程包含非多项式曲率项。我们发展一种微扰方案来寻找参数上偏离 Schwarzschild 几何的黑洞解。通过求解相应的耦合微分方程，我们得到度规的一阶修正。随后在微扰耦合的一阶一致地计算相应的 Iyer-Wald 熵。我们表明非多项式贡献导致 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵的幂律修正。
classification.one_liner: 在 f(R,K) 非多项式引力中微扰构造偏离 Schwarzschild 的静态黑洞，并计算 Iyer-Wald 熵的幂律修正。

papers.title: A First-Order Gauge Approach to de Sitter General Relativity
papers.abstract: We propose a first-order gauge formulation of de Sitter relativity in which the pseudo-radius l(x) is promoted to a spacetime field, locally breaking SO(4,1) to SO(3,1). Here, l(x) is a geometric compensator and dl(x) the associated order parameter. This modifies the Strong Equivalence Principle: the local vacuum follows the matter distribution instead of remaining fixed, while the propagating degrees of freedom of General Relativity are unchanged. At fixed l(x), the action is SO(3,1)-gauge invariant, but varying l(x) destroys covariance under the full translational sector of SO(4,1). Through the Inonu-Wigner contraction, abstract generators become explicit spacetime transformations, yielding nonlinear Killing vectors in both the macroscopic l tends to infinity and microscopic l tends to 0 limits. The generalized Noether theorem gives a unified energy-momentum current coupling the standard tensor to the proper conformal matter current. It vanishes identically without matter, causing the asymptotic extinction of local vacuum energy and the decay of the background to Minkowski spacetime. Independent variations yield the coupled de Sitter field equations, and we algebraically prove their equivalence to the tensorial splitting on the coordinate manifold. Gauge Bianchi identities further show that Lambda(x) is an intrinsic source of spacetime torsion, consistently identifying it with the local order parameter of the symmetry breaking. The cosmological constant problem is therefore recast, not numerically solved: deriving the decay of Lambda(x) from early-universe densities to its observed value remains future work.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 广义相对论的一阶规范方法
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出 de Sitter 相对论的一阶规范表述，其中伪半径 l(x) 被提升为时空场，并使 SO(4,1) 局域破缺到 SO(3,1)。l(x) 是几何补偿子，dl(x) 是对应序参量。该框架修改强等效原理：局域真空跟随物质分布而非保持固定，但广义相对论的传播自由度不变。在固定 l(x) 时作用量具有 SO(3,1) 规范不变性，而变分 l(x) 会破坏 SO(4,1) 完整平移部分的协变性。通过 Inonu-Wigner 收缩，抽象生成元成为显式时空变换，并在宏观 l→∞ 与微观 l→0 极限给出非线性 Killing 矢量。推广的 Noether 定理给出统一能量-动量流，将标准张量与恰当共形物质流耦合；无物质时该流恒为零，导致局域真空能渐近消失、背景衰减到 Minkowski 时空。独立变分得到耦合的 de Sitter 场方程，并代数证明其与坐标流形上的张量分解等价。规范 Bianchi 恒等式进一步表明 Λ(x) 是时空挠率的內禀源，并一致地将其等同于对称破缺的局域序参量。因此宇宙学常数问题被重新表述而非数值解决：从早期宇宙密度推导 Λ(x) 衰减到观测值仍是未来工作。
classification.one_liner: 提出把 de Sitter 伪半径提升为时空场的一阶规范表述，证明其场方程与张量分解等价，并将宇宙学常数问题重述为 Λ(x) 的动力学衰减问题而非数值解决。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究 de Sitter 广义相对论的一阶规范表述与经典场方程，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Horizon-scale intensity and polarization images of rotating Konoplya-Zhidenko black holes with thick accretion flows
papers.abstract: We investigate the shadow and polarization images of a Konoplya--Zhidenko rotating non-Kerr black hole surrounded by a geometrically thick and optically thin accretion flow. The accretion flow is described by an analytical ballistic approximation accretion flow model. The numerical results show that the shadow image exhibits two main features, an outer bright ring and an inner dark region. The former corresponds to higher-order images, while the latter is associated with photon capture by the black hole. Increasing the deformation parameter $\eta$ does not significantly change the overall shape of the higher-order images, but it enlarges their size. Increasing either the spin parameter $a$ or the observer inclination angle $\theta_o$ enhances the asymmetry of the higher-order images and makes the intensity on the left side much larger than that on the right side. This behavior is associated with frame dragging and the relativistic Doppler effect. In the polarization images, the degree of linear polarization is much smaller in the higher-order image region than in other regions, and the polarization vectors extend over the whole image plane. Within the framework used in this work, these results illustrate how the spacetime geometry and near-horizon accretion dynamics jointly influence the intensity and polarization images.

classification.title_zh: 旋转 Konoplya-Zhidenko 黑洞在厚吸积流下的视界尺度强度与偏振图像
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究被几何厚、光学薄吸积流包围的 Konoplya-Zhidenko 旋转非 Kerr 黑洞的阴影与偏振图像。吸积流采用解析弹道近似模型。数值结果表明，阴影图像具有外亮环和内暗区两个主要特征：外亮环对应高阶像，内暗区对应光子被黑洞捕获。增大形变参数 η 不会显著改变高阶像的整体形状，但会增大其尺寸；增大自旋参数 a 或观测倾角 θ_o 会增强高阶像的不对称性，并使左侧强度远大于右侧，这与参考系拖曳和相对论多普勒效应有关。在偏振图像中，高阶像区域的线偏振度明显低于其他区域，且偏振矢量覆盖整个像平面。论文说明时空几何与近视界吸积动力学如何共同影响强度与偏振图像。
classification.one_liner: 用厚吸积流模型计算旋转 Konoplya-Zhidenko 非 Kerr 黑洞的阴影强度与偏振图像，并分析形变、自旋和倾角对高阶像的影响。

papers.title: SPLIT: Loosely-coherent inference of long-inspiral gravitational-wave sources for robustness against modeling and data outliers
papers.abstract: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will detect gravitational waves (GWs) from dozens of extreme- and intermediate-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs/IMRIs). These sources will stay in-band for months to years, offering extraordinary scientific potential. However, their fully phase-coherent analysis standard in current pipelines imposes stringent waveform accuracy requirements; failing to model the signal over such long durations can result in significant systematic biases. To address this, we formulate a robust Bayesian inference framework that segments the data into blocks, infers each block coherently, and recombines the results using loosely-coherent phase information. By restricting full phase-tracking to much shorter block durations, this approach prevents significant accumulation of phase errors. We implement this methodology in \textsc{SPLIT} (Segmented Posteriors for Long-Inspiral Templates), a GPU-accelerated Python package. Applying \textsc{SPLIT} to an environment-rich injection, we demonstrate that while a fully-coherent vacuum-GR analysis incurs a maximum 1D systematic bias of $\approx 4.8\sigma$ from the truth, the shorter integration window of our loosely-coherent approach restricts such biases to $\lesssim 0.5\sigma$. Overall, despite a fractional loss of optimal signal-to-noise ratio, the substantial improvement in parameter accuracy offered by our method presents a highly advantageous trade-off for LISA and other future GW detectors.

classification.title_zh: SPLIT：面向长旋进引力波源的弱相干推断，以增强对建模误差和数据异常值的鲁棒性
classification.abstract_zh: LISA 将探测数十个极端/中等质量比旋进（EMRI/IMRI）引力波源，这些源可在带内持续数月至数年。传统全相位相干分析对波形精度要求极高，长时标建模失败会导致显著系统偏差。本文提出一种稳健贝叶斯推断框架：将数据分段，对每段进行相干推断，并用弱相干相位信息重组结果；通过把完整相位跟踪限制在更短的块时长内，避免相位误差大量累积。作者在 GPU 加速的 Python 包 SPLIT 中实现该方法，并用于一个环境丰富的注入案例：全相干真空-GR 分析相对真值的最大一维系统偏差约为 4.8σ，而弱相干方法将偏差限制在约 0.5σ 以内。尽管最优信噪比有少量损失，参数精度的显著改善对 LISA 和未来引力波探测器是有利的权衡。
classification.one_liner: 提出分段弱相干贝叶斯推断框架 SPLIT，降低 LISA 长旋进引力波源对波形建模误差和数据异常值的系统偏差。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为 LISA 引力波数据分析和贝叶斯推断方法，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力理论。

papers.title: Quasinormal modes and tidal responses of black holes in generic anisotropic matter environments
papers.abstract: We develop a perturbative framework for a black hole embedded in a generic, possibly anisotropic, matter environment under spherical symmetry. Our approach extends previous analyses restricted to vanishing radial pressure or to perturbative matter configurations. Within this framework, we derive an analytical generalization of the Einstein cluster that incorporates a polytropic radial pressure, and we investigate the properties of this solution. We show that both the geodesic structure and the axial quasinormal-mode spectrum remain predominantly governed by an overall gravitational redshift effect, while the radial pressure systematically enhances the environmental corrections. In contrast, the tidal Love numbers are substantially more sensitive, and can exhibit order-unity deviations, including vanishing and negative strictly static magnetic Love numbers for sufficiently large anisotropy. We present the full linearized equations, which can be applied to various extensions, including ringdown analysis and extreme-mass-ratio inspirals.

classification.title_zh: 一般各向异性物质环境中黑洞的准正规模与潮汐响应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为嵌入球对称、可能各向异性的一般物质环境中的黑洞建立了一个微扰框架。该方法扩展了此前仅限于零径向压力或微扰物质位形的分析。在此框架内，我们推导了包含多方径向压力的 Einstein cluster 的解析推广，并研究了该解的性质。我们表明，测地线结构和轴向准正规模谱仍主要受整体引力红移效应支配，而径向压力会系统性增强环境修正。相比之下，潮汐 Love 数敏感得多，并可能出现量级为一的偏离，包括在足够大各向异性下严格静态磁 Love 数消失甚至为负。我们给出了完整的线性化方程，可应用于包括 ringdown 分析和极端质量比旋近在内的多种扩展。
classification.one_liner: 建立一般各向异性球对称物质环境中的黑洞微扰框架，发现 QNM 主要受引力红移控制而潮汐 Love 数对各向异性高度敏感。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究黑洞准正规模与潮汐响应，属于经典引力与 QNM 重点支线，且不涉及全息方法。

papers.title: Going into a tailspin near the abyss: analytic solutions for spinning particles on near equatorial, plunging orbits in Kerr spacetime
papers.abstract: This work presents, the first time, analytic solutions for the nearly equatorial, plunging motion of a spinning test-particle in Kerr spacetime. The equations of motion are solved at first-order in the small-body spin for all classes of plunging orbits with energy $E < 1$. The solutions incorporate the small precession of the orbital plane caused by the precession of the particle's spin. Additionally, we present the correction to the radius of the innermost bound circular orbit in closed form, and introduce a novel, Keplerian-like parametrization for generic plunging orbits. Our solutions will be useful in the modelling of inspiral-merger-ringdown waveforms with self-force methods and black hole perturbation theory.

classification.title_zh: 坠入深渊前的自旋尾旋：Kerr时空中近赤道坠落自旋粒子的解析解
classification.abstract_zh: 本工作首次给出Kerr时空中自旋测试粒子在近赤道、坠落运动中的解析解。作者在粒子自旋一阶近似下求解了所有能量 E<1 的坠落轨道类别，并纳入由粒子自旋进动引起的轨道面小进动。文中还给出了最内束缚圆轨道半径修正的闭式表达，并为一般坠落轨道引入一种新的类开普勒参数化。这些解将有助于使用自力方法和黑洞微扰论对旋进-并合-铃宕波形进行建模。
classification.one_liner: 给出Kerr时空中近赤道坠落自旋测试粒子的自旋一阶解析轨道解，并用于黑洞波形建模。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，直接研究Kerr时空中的测试粒子轨道与黑洞微扰应用，但不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Periodic orbits and gravitational waveforms of spinning particles in nonlocal gravity
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the dynamics and gravitational-wave signatures of periodic orbits of spinning test particles moving in the equatorial plane around static, spherically symmetric black holes within the framework of Deser-Woodard nonlocal gravity. Based on the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon equations, combined with the Tulczyjew spin supplementary condition, we derive the orbital dynamic equations for spinning particles moving in the equatorial plane and impose a timelike constraint to exclude unphysical superluminal trajectories. By comparing with the classical Schwarzschild black hole, we systematically analyze the effects of the nonlocal gravitational parameters $\zeta$ and $b$ on the effective potential governing the radial motion of particles and the innermost stable circular orbit. In addition, gravitational waveforms exhibit significant phase differences: an increase in $\zeta$ induces a phase delay, whereas an increase in $b$ results in a phase advance. Using periodic-orbit waveforms extended over a one-year interval with fixed orbital parameters, we obtain an order-of-magnitude estimate of the sensitivity of the waveform mismatch to nonlocal corrections. For the configurations considered, this estimate suggests sensitivity to $\zeta$ of order $10^{-6}$ when $b=2$.

classification.title_zh: 非局域引力中自旋粒子的周期轨道与引力波波形
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究在Deser-Woodard非局域引力框架下，自旋试验粒子在静态球对称黑洞赤道面附近运动的动力学及其引力波信号。基于Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon方程并结合Tulczyjew自旋补充条件，推导赤道面内自旋粒子的轨道动力学方程，并施加类时约束以排除非物理的超光速轨迹。通过与经典Schwarzschild黑洞比较，系统分析非局域引力参数ζ和b对径向运动有效势及最内稳定圆轨道的影响。引力波波形表现出显著相位差异：ζ增大会导致相位延迟，而b增大会导致相位提前。利用固定轨道参数、扩展至一年间隔的周期轨道波形，对波形失配对非局域修正的敏感性给出量级估计；在所考虑构型下，当b=2时对ζ的敏感性约为10^-6量级。
classification.one_liner: 在Deser-Woodard非局域引力中计算自旋试验粒子的周期轨道与引力波波形，并估计波形对非局域参数的敏感性。

papers.title: Chaotic Dynamics around a Hairy Black Hole in Horndeski Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate the chaotic dynamics of a spinning test particle in a static, spherically symmet- ric hairy black hole (BH) in Horndeski gravity, using the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon equations closed by the Tulczyjew-Dixon condition. Bound orbits are identified by fixing the angular momen- tum and setting the energy according to the effective potential, so that the accessible parameter range is bounded by a critical hair parameter, hcrit, which varies non-monotonically with the spin. We analyze the resulting chaotic behavior using Lyapunov exponents, Poincare sections, and re- constructed attractors. We find that the response of these indicators to scalar hair is orbit- and spin-dependent rather than universally monotonic. An analysis of orbital frequency ratios shows that, at physically maximal spin (S = 1), an approaching 2:1 azimuthal resonance overlapping a persistent 1:1 polar lock amplifies chaos, while the hair-driven erosion of potential saddles tends to suppress it. At non-physical spin (S = 1.5), the Lyapunov exponent decreases monotonically. Gravitational waveforms constructed via the quadrupole formula inherit the same state-specific pattern: the correlation between the two polarization modes varies non-monotonically with h, in step with the Lyapunov exponent. These results show that chaotic indicators respond to scalar hair in an orbit- and resonance-dependent manner rather than through simple monotonic suppres- sion, and identify the spin-dependent resonance structure as an essential ingredient for interpreting chaos around hairy black holes.

classification.title_zh: Horndeski 引力中带毛黑洞周围的混沌动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 本文利用由 Tulczyjew-Dixon 条件闭合的 Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon 方程，研究 Horndeski 引力中静态球对称带毛黑洞周围自旋测试粒子的混沌动力学。通过固定角动量并按有效势设定能量来确定束缚轨道，发现可及参数范围受临界毛参数 hcrit 限制，且 hcrit 随自旋非单调变化。作者用 Lyapunov 指数、Poincaré 截面和重构吸引子分析混沌行为，发现这些指标对标量毛的响应依赖轨道与自旋，而非普遍单调。轨道频率比分析表明，在物理最大自旋 S=1 时，接近 2:1 的方位角共振与持续存在的 1:1 极向锁定重叠会增强混沌，而标量毛驱动的势鞍侵蚀倾向于抑制混沌；在非物理自旋 S=1.5 时 Lyapunov 指数单调下降。通过四极公式构造的引力波形继承相同状态依赖模式：两种极化模式间的相关性随 h 非单调变化，并与 Lyapunov 指数同步。结果表明混沌指标以轨道和共振依赖的方式响应标量毛，而非简单单调抑制，并指出自旋依赖的共振结构是解释带毛黑洞周围混沌的关键要素。
classification.one_liner: 研究 Horndeski 带毛黑洞中自旋测试粒子的混沌轨道，发现标量毛对混沌指标的影响依赖轨道与自旋/共振结构，而非单调抑制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与黑洞时空中的混沌动力学，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线，但不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或全息凝聚态等核心方向。

papers.title: Popcorn EMRIs: Transient Gravitational Wave Signals and Their Analysis in Schwartz Space
papers.abstract: This study investigates extreme-mass ratio inspirals (EMRIs) with orbital periods exceeding the observation windows of mHz gravitational wave detectors. During their early, highly eccentric stages, these systems produce periodic gravitational wave eruptions at pericentre, separated by long quiescent periods. We define these systems as ``popcorn EMRIs''--bound, coherent binaries in a deterministic evolutionary phase. This distinguishes them from stochastic, non-coherent bursts associated with parabolic fly-bys. Using a steady-state model based on the phase-space continuity equation, we estimate the population within a Milky Way-like galaxy. Because these estimates depend on sensitive astrophysical variables like stellar relaxation and density profiles, our figures are illustrative rather than absolute. For a one-year observation baseline, we estimate a steady-state population of 200 to 2,000 popcorn EMRIs, significantly outnumbering the 10 to 88 continuously observable EMRIs. This yields an expected rate of 5 to 44 detectable eruptions per year. Despite high signal-to-noise ratios (exceeding 700 for Galactic Centre events), the low duty cycle confirms their transient nature. Standard data processing techniques, designed for continuous signals, often employ windowing that distorts eruption morphology and artificially reduces the signal-to-noise ratio. To address this, we establish a mathematical apparatus using based on standard smoothing techniques, in the theory of tempered distributions. We demonstrate that standard windowing techniques irreversibly degrade the signal-to-noise ratio of transient sources when the taper overlaps the eruption, and we utilize Schwartz space regularization to justify the direct Fourier transform as the energy-preserving estimator.

classification.title_zh: 爆米花EMRIs：瞬态引力波信号及其在Schwartz空间中的分析
classification.abstract_zh: 研究轨道周期超过mHz引力波探测器观测窗口的极端质量比旋近（EMRIs）。这类系统在早期高偏心率阶段于近星点产生周期性引力波爆发，中间有长静默期，作者将其定义为“爆米花EMRIs”，即处于确定性演化阶段的束缚相干双星，以区别于抛物线飞掠产生的随机非相干爆发。基于相空间连续性方程的稳态模型，估计银河系类星系中一年观测基线下的种群数为200至2000个，显著多于10至88个连续可观测EMRIs，对应每年5至44次可探测爆发。尽管银心事件信噪比可超过700，低占空比确认其瞬态性质。标准数据处理为连续信号设计，加窗会扭曲爆发形态并人为降低信噪比；作者用tempered distributions理论中的标准平滑技术建立数学框架，证明当窗函数与爆发重叠时标准加窗会不可逆降低瞬态源信噪比，并用Schwartz空间正则化论证直接傅里叶变换是保能估计量。
classification.one_liner: 定义并统计“爆米花EMRI”瞬态引力波爆发，指出常规加窗处理会降低信噪比，并用Schwartz空间正则化论证直接傅里叶变换为保能估计量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与引力波/黑洞天体物理，涉及EMRI瞬态信号和数据分析，与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线相关；但不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Relativistic second gradient theory of continuous media
papers.abstract: Variational Relativity is a framework developed by Souriau in the sixties to better formulate General Relativity and its classical limit\,: Classical Continuum Mechanics. It has been used, for instance, to formulate elasticity from a Lagrangian (or Action) in General Relativity. In that case, two primary variables are involved, the universe (Lorentzian) metric $g$ and the matter field $\Psi$. A Lagrangian density depending on the 1-jet of these variables is then introduced which must satisfy the principle of General Covariance. Souriau proved in 1958 that under these hypotheses, the Lagrangian density depends only on the punctual value of the matter field $\Psi$ and of a secondary variable $\mathbf{K}$, the conformation, an invariant of the diffeomorphism group, which is the Relativistic analog of the inverse of the right Cauchy--Green tensor. In the present work, an extension of Souriau's results to a second order gradient theory in General Relativity is presented. Accordingly, new higher order diffeomorphisms invariants are found. Their classical limits are calculated, showing that the 3-dimensional Continuum Mechanics second gradient theory can be derived from such a relativistic theory. Some of these invariants converge to objective quantities in the Galilean limit (such as the fundamental variables of finite strain second gradient theory, modeling solids), others to non-objective quantities (such as those encountered in the modeling of fluids): objectivity is thus natural for the constitutive variables of solids and unnatural for those of fluids. The present work contributes to clarify the theoretical foundation of higher gradient Continuum Mechanics theory.

classification.title_zh: 连续介质的相对论二阶梯度理论
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在 Souriau 变分相对论框架下，将广义相对论中连续介质的一阶梯度结果推广到二阶梯度理论。论文构造新的高阶微分同胚不变量，计算其经典极限，并说明三维连续介质力学二阶梯度理论可由该相对论理论导出；部分不变量在伽利略极限下趋于客观量（如有限应变二阶梯度固体理论的基本变量），另一些则趋于非客观量（如流体建模中出现的量），从而澄清高阶梯度连续介质力学的理论基础。
classification.one_liner: 将 Souriau 变分相对论推广到广义相对论中的二阶梯度连续介质，并给出新微分同胚不变量及其经典极限。

papers.title: Localization of gravitational-wave source behind galaxy clusters by gravitational-wave lensing
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave observations have opened new opportunities to study massive object events like merging binary black holes. When combined with electromagnetic counterparts, accurate localization of gravitational-wave sources could allow us to identify their host galaxies and carry out follow-up studies, such as study the environment of merging black holes and determine the Hubble constant. One of the possible methods for precise localization is strong gravitational-wave lensing. Previous studies have considered strong gravitational-wave lensing with galaxy lenses. However, galaxy clusters have yet to be investigated due to the complexity of their mass structures. Here we take the list of known cluster lenses from the Hubble Frontier Fields, simulate lensing properties of gravitational waves from their reconstructions as they would be observed by the ground-based gravitational-wave detectors. When same model family is used in simulation and localization, we find that the correct lens is identified for around 90\% of the simulated events. We also show that the source positions within the cluster can be pinpointed at sub-arcsecond precision with an estimate on source redshift. When we marginalize over all possible lens models for the clusters, the lens identification and localizations remain valid as long as the correct lens model is contained in the available cluster lens models. However, most localization attempts fail at initialization if the correct cluster model is excluded. These tests establish a proof of concept of localization under idealized conditions, while more work is needed to understand the cluster lens modeling discrepancies and reconstruction bias to validate the approach further.

classification.title_zh: 利用引力波透镜定位星系团后方的引力波源
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波观测为研究双黑洞并合等大质量天体事件提供了新途径。结合电磁对应体，精确的引力波源定位可用于证认宿主星系并开展后续研究，例如研究并合黑洞环境与测定哈勃常数。强引力波透镜效应是实现精确定位的可能方法之一；已有研究考虑星系透镜，但由于星系团质量结构复杂，星系团透镜尚未被充分研究。本文采用哈勃前沿场中已知的星系团透镜样本，基于其质量重构模拟地面引力波探测器将观测到的引力波透镜性质。当模拟与定位使用同一模型族时，约90%的模拟事件能正确证认透镜。作者还表明，可将星系团内源位置 pinpoint 到亚角秒精度，并估计源红移。当对所有可能的星系团透镜模型进行边缘化时，只要可用模型包含正确透镜模型，透镜证认与定位仍然有效；但若正确星系团模型被排除，大多数定位尝试会在初始化阶段失败。这些测试在理想化条件下建立了概念验证，仍需进一步理解星系团透镜建模差异与重构偏差以验证该方法。
classification.one_liner: 基于哈勃前沿场星系团透镜模拟，展示地面引力波探测器对星系团后方引力波源进行透镜证认与亚角秒定位的概念验证。

papers.title: Lense-Thirring induced repeating blast trains in continuous gravitational waves
papers.abstract: We characterise gravitational lensing induced by the Lense-Thirring effect in a continuous gravitational-wave source orbiting a spinning supermassive black hole. This scenario is very likely to generate lensing events, as long as the source's orbital inclination is not aligned with the black hole's spin axis and the Lense-Thirring timescale is shorter than the observational window. The signal appears as short-duration ($T_{\rm blast}$) gravitational-wave "blasts" that repeat after every orbit ($T_{\rm orb}$) within a limited time window ($T_{\rm train}$). The blasts' signal strength depends on the system's geometry and not on the black hole mass. The signal will go silent and renew twice in a full Lense-Thirring precession period.

classification.title_zh: 连续引力波中由 Lense-Thirring 效应诱导的重复爆发序列
classification.abstract_zh: 我们刻画了连续引力波源绕旋转超大质量黑洞轨道运动时，由 Lense-Thirring 效应诱导的引力透镜效应。只要源轨道倾角不与黑洞自旋轴对齐，且 Lense-Thirring 时标短于观测窗口，该场景很可能产生透镜事件。信号表现为短持续时间（T_blast）的引力波“爆发”，在有限时间窗口（T_train）内每绕轨一周（T_orb）重复一次。爆发信号强度取决于系统几何而非黑洞质量。在一个完整的 Lense-Thirring 进动周期内，信号会消失并再现两次。
classification.one_liner: Lense-Thirring 进动使绕转连续引力波源产生重复短爆发，信号强度只依赖系统几何而非黑洞质量。

papers.title: The $w$-mode instability of strangeon ergostars and its impact on energy extraction
papers.abstract: Rapidly rotating compact ergostars have been proposed as alternative central engines for short gamma-ray bursts. However, competing energy-loss channels, such as gravitational-wave emission driven by non-axisymmetric instabilities, could curtail the power available for relativistic electromagnetic outflows. In this work, we investigate the $w$-mode instability of rapidly rotating strangeon ergostars by solving the coupled spacetime and fluid perturbation equations in the Hilbert gauge using a spectral method, without relying on a slow-rotation approximation. We calculate the complex eigenvalues of the axial-led and polar-led $w$-mode branches originating from the fundamental $l=m=2$ modes of nonrotating stars along the maximum-energy-extraction paths of twelve representative strangeon equations of state. We find that both branches remain damped throughout these paths, despite the presence of ergoregions. We further vary the stellar angular velocity to determine the instability thresholds. In every case with an identified threshold, the angular velocity at the corresponding extraction-path endpoint remains below the critical value, with the largest ratio being $0.926$. Our results indicate that the $w$-mode instabilities examined here do not provide a growing gravitational-wave emission channel along the considered energy-extraction paths, supporting the availability of the previously estimated rotational energy reservoirs for electromagnetic extraction.

classification.title_zh: strangeon 能星的 w 模不稳定性及其对能量提取的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 快速旋转的致密能星被提出可作为短伽马射线暴的替代中心引擎，但非轴对称不稳定性驱动的引力波辐射等能量损失通道可能削弱可用于相对论性电磁外流的功率。本文在 Hilbert 规范下用谱方法求解耦合的时空与流体扰动方程，不依赖慢旋转近似，研究快速旋转 strangeon 能星的 w 模不稳定性。作者沿 12 个代表性 strangeon 状态方程的最大能量提取路径，计算源于非旋转星基频 l=m=2 模的轴向主导与极向主导 w 模分支的复本征值，发现尽管存在能层，两个分支在这些路径上均保持阻尼。进一步改变恒星角速度以确定不稳定性阈值；在所有识别出阈值的情形中，对应提取路径端点的角速度均低于临界值，最大比值为 0.926。结果表明，在所考虑的能量提取路径上，这些 w 模不稳定性并不提供增长的引力波辐射通道，从而支持此前估计的转动能库可供电磁提取使用。
classification.one_liner: 该文用谱方法计算快速旋转 strangeon 能星的 w 模复本征值与不稳定性阈值，发现沿最大能量提取路径 w 模保持阻尼，不构成增长的引力波能量损失通道。

papers.title: Residual ellipticity driven by intense magnetic stress in the hot neutron star era
papers.abstract: A neutron star with a nonaxisymmetric mass distribution continuously radiates gravitational waves. The amplitude depends on the magnitude of the deformation, and is crucial for gravitational-wave astronomy. We studied an evolutionary effect on the magnetically induced ellipticity in the neutron star crust. A large deformation at the hot era before solidification is assumed to be produced magneto-hydrodynamically, and the fate at later time follows owing to the decrease in the force associated with the decay and redistribution of the current. Instead of simulating the evolution of deformation with the magnetic field over a long timescale, we estimate the ellipticity that remains after the formation of the solid crust by comparing two equilibrium models before and after solidification. The relic ellipticity is $\sim 10^{-8} (B_0/10^{13}{\rm{G}})^2$ in the magnitude for dipole field strength $B_{0}$ at the surface. This value was primarily determined by the magnetic field at the later time, with a weak dependence on the initial large deformation. The memory of the presolidification state was retained, but was small because the elastic force contributes little to the equilibrium.

classification.title_zh: 热中子星时代强磁应力驱动的残余椭率
classification.abstract_zh: 具有非轴对称质量分布的中子星会持续辐射引力波，其振幅取决于形变大小，对引力波天文学至关重要。本文研究了中子星壳层中磁致椭率的一种演化效应。假设在凝固前的热时代，磁流体动力学过程产生了较大形变；随后，随着电流衰减和重新分布导致相关力减小，形变在后期如何演化。作者没有对长时标下形变与磁场的演化进行模拟，而是通过比较凝固前后的两个平衡模型，估计固体壳层形成后残余的椭率。对于表面偶极场强 B0，残余椭率量级为约 10^{-8}(B0/10^{13}G)^2。该值主要由后期磁场决定，对初始大形变的依赖较弱。凝固前状态的记忆被保留下来，但由于弹力对平衡贡献很小，这种记忆较小。
classification.one_liner: 通过比较凝固前后平衡模型，估计中子星壳层残余磁致椭率约为 10^{-8}(B0/10^{13}G)^2，并指出其主要由后期磁场决定。

papers.title: Tendex Lines and Short-Time Deformation: The Geometry of Lunar Tides
papers.abstract: Tendex lines and the stretchlines and squeezelines of Lagrangian coherent structure theory share a geometric construction: they integrate eigenvector fields of symmetric tensors. We connect their dynamical interpretations through the short-time deformation of particles released with zero initial velocity relative to a freely falling reference in an autonomous gravitational field. The leading departure of the Cauchy--Green tensor from the identity is quadratic in time and equals the tidal tensor multiplied by the squared observation time. The tidal tensorlines therefore give the limiting principal stretching and squeezing directions. For the planar lunar field, these tensorlines are radial lines and concentric circles centered on the Moon. The same tidal tensor defines a Lorentzian metric whose null directions have no quadratic change in line-element length. Its null geodesics are logarithmic spirals, describing the short-time limit of finite-time unit-stretch geometry. Near Earth, the principal tensorlines clarify the two outward tidal tendencies, while the null directions distinguish vanishing leading extension from vanishing relative acceleration.

classification.title_zh: Tendex线与短时变形：月球潮汐的几何
classification.abstract_zh: Tendex线与拉格朗日相干结构理论中的拉伸线和挤压线具有相同的几何构造：它们都积分对称张量的本征矢量场。本文通过在自治引力场中相对于自由下落参考系以零初速度释放粒子的短时变形，连接它们的动力学解释。柯西-格林张量偏离单位阵的首阶项是时间的二次项，并等于潮汐张量乘以观测时间的平方。因此潮汐张量线给出极限主拉伸和主挤压方向。对于平面月球引力场，这些张量线是以月球为中心的径向线和同心圆。同一潮汐张量定义一个洛伦兹度规，其零方向在线元长度上没有二次变化；其零测地线是对数螺线，描述有限时间单位拉伸几何的短时极限。在地球附近，主张量线澄清了两种向外的潮汐趋势，而零方向区分了首阶伸长消失与相对加速度消失。
classification.one_liner: 文章用短时粒子变形把tendex线与拉格朗日相干结构联系起来，并以月球潮汐场为例说明潮汐张量线及由潮汐张量定义的洛伦兹度规零测地线的几何。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论中的潮汐张量与时空几何研究，并涉及自由下落参考系、张量线和零测地线；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Shear, vorticity, and $f(R)$ theories
papers.abstract: We study how an extended spherical collapse model (ESCM), including shear, vorticity and chameleon screening, modifies the collapse threshold $\delta_c(z)$ and $\delta_c(M)$, the turnaround density $\delta_t$, the turnaround radius $R_t$ and the halo mass function in the Hu-Sawicki $f(R)$ model, and whether these quantities can distinguish $f(R)$ from General Relativity (GR). Unlike the standard spherical collapse model (SSCM), in the ESCM $\delta_c$ depends on mass, redshift and $|f_{R0}|$; we use it to compute the halo mass function with the excursion set approach. Between GR and the large-field (LF) limit of $f(R)$, $\delta_c$ differs by a few percent within the ESCM and by about 20% between GR in the ESCM and the LF limit in the SSCM; $\delta_t$ differs by about 27-29% and $R_t$ by about 6.5%. With screening, the difference between GR and screened $\delta_c$ is 2.5% for $|f_{R0}|=10^{-4}$ (F4) and vanishes for $|f_{R0}|=10^{-6}$ (F6); for $\delta_t$ it is larger than 20% (F4), about 10% (F5) and 0 (F6); for $R_t$ about 6.5% (F4), 3% (F5) and 0 (F6). Since observations exclude F4 and F6 is practically identical to GR, only F5 could discriminate, but the ~20% uncertainty on measured turnaround radii rules out $R_t$ and related quantities as tests of $f(R)$. The halo abundance predicted by $f(R)$, especially at high redshift, can instead distinguish $f(R)$ from GR.

classification.title_zh: 剪切、涡旋与 f(R) 理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个包含剪切、涡旋和 chameleon 屏蔽的扩展球对称坍缩模型（ESCM）如何修改 Hu-Sawicki f(R) 模型中的坍缩阈值 δ_c(z) 和 δ_c(M)、 turnaround 密度 δ_t、 turnaround 半径 R_t 以及晕质量函数，并考察这些量能否区分 f(R) 与广义相对论（GR）。与标准球对称坍缩模型（SSCM）不同，在 ESCM 中 δ_c 依赖于质量、红移和 |f_R0|；我们用其通过 excursion set 方法计算晕质量函数。在 GR 与 f(R) 的大场（LF）极限之间，ESCM 内 δ_c 相差百分之几，而 ESCM 中的 GR 与 SSCM 中的 LF 极限之间相差约 20%；δ_t 相差约 27–29%，R_t 相差约 6.5%。考虑屏蔽时，对于 |f_R0|=10^-4（F4），GR 与屏蔽 δ_c 的差异为 2.5%，而对于 |f_R0|=10^-6（F6）差异消失；对 δ_t，差异大于 20%（F4）、约 10%（F5）、0（F6）；对 R_t 约 6.5%（F4）、3%（F5）、0（F6）。由于观测排除 F4，而 F6 实际上与 GR 相同，只有 F5 可能具有区分能力，但 turnaround 半径测量约 20% 的不确定度使 R_t 及相关量无法作为 f(R) 的检验。相反，f(R) 预测的晕丰度，尤其在高红移，可以区分 f(R) 与 GR。
classification.one_liner: 在含剪切、涡旋与 chameleon 屏蔽的扩展球坍缩模型中，f(R) 对坍缩阈值和 turnaround 量的修正多被观测误差或屏蔽掩盖，但高红移晕丰度仍有区分力。
