papers.title: Toward the minimal set of states in axion superradiance
papers.abstract: Observational searches for black hole superradiance require predicting the growth and evolution of quasi-bound states on astrophysical timescales. For axions (and most light spin-0 particles), self-interactions efficiently redistribute energy and angular momentum from the fastest-growing superradiant states into higher-order, more weakly bound states, and do so on short timescales. This has made it difficult to compute even the most mundane of observables across large regions of parameter space. In this work we extend the study of self-interacting systems, following the evolution of nearly 300 coupled quasi-bound states. We evolve a $10\,M_\odot$ black hole over a Salpeter timescale, and $10^4$ and $10^8\,M_\odot$ black holes over a Gyr, identifying for each axion mass the minimal set of states required to describe the evolution of the black hole and the shape of the superradiant cloud. In most cases the evolution converges as increasingly weakly bound states are added; we identify no less than 203 distinct quasi-bound states that play a role in establishing this convergence. In small regions of parameter space, however, we find no converged solution, and show that broad resonant features and nearly degenerate scattering rates redistribute mass to bound states with principal quantum numbers $n \gtrsim 45$. We further show that the cloud can extend to radii orders of magnitude larger than usually assumed, that gravitational-wave level transitions can prevent the growth of superradiant states, and that both the gravitational-wave spectrum and the interaction with the environment are far richer than previously appreciated.

classification.title_zh: 迈向轴子超辐射中的最小态集合
classification.abstract_zh: 对黑洞超辐射的观测搜寻需要预测准束缚态在天文时间尺度上的增长和演化。对于轴子（以及大多数轻的spin-0粒子），自相互作用会在短时间内有效地把能量和角动量从增长最快的超辐射态重新分配到更高阶、束缚更弱的态，这使得在很大参数范围内即便计算最普通的观测量也很困难。本工作扩展了自相互作用系统的研究，追踪近300个耦合准束缚态的演化。我们对10太阳质量黑洞演化一个Salpeter时标，对10^4和10^8太阳质量黑洞演化一个Gyr，并对每个轴子质量确定描述黑洞演化和超辐射云形状所需的最小态集合。多数情况下，随着加入越来越弱的束缚态，演化收敛；我们识别出不少于203个不同准束缚态在建立这种收敛中起作用。然而在小片参数区域，我们未找到收敛解，并表明宽共振特征和近简并散射率会把质量重新分配到主量子数n≳45的束缚态。我们进一步表明，云可延伸到比通常假设大若干数量级的半径，引力波能级跃迁可阻止超辐射态增长，并且引力波谱和与环境相互作用都比此前认识的丰富得多。
classification.one_liner: 通过追踪近300个耦合准束缚态，确定轴子超辐射演化所需的最小态集合，并揭示高n态、共振及引力波跃迁的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为黑洞轴子超辐射与准束缚态演化，不属于全息/AdS-CFT；若关注经典黑洞引力与引力波现象则有一定相关性。

papers.title: Slow Macroscopic Rotations of Neutron Stars With a Deformed Effective Surface
papers.abstract: The macroscopic model for a neutron star (NS) as a finite perfect fluid at the equilibrium is extended to rotating deformed systems by incorporating the linear perturbation expansion over a small frequency $\omega$ near the Schwarzschild gravitational metric within the effective-surface (ES) approach. The NS angular momentum $I$ and moment of inertia (MI) for a slow stationary azimuthal rotation around the symmetry axis is calculated by using the Kerr metric approach in spheroidal coordinates, and compared with the spherical results. The gradient surface terms of the macroscopic NS energy density $\mathcal{E}(\rho)$ (Equation of State) are taken into account along with the volume ones at the leading order of the leptodermic parameter $a/R \ll 1$, where $a$ is the ES crust thickness and $R$ is the NS effective radius. The analytical macroscopic NS MI expressions, $\Theta = dI/d\omega = \widetilde{\Theta}/(1-\mathcal{T}_{t\varphi})$, have been obtained in terms of the statistically averaged MI, $\tilde{\Theta}$, and its time and azimuthal-angle $t,\varphi$ correlation, $\mathcal{T}_{t\varphi}$, as sums of the volume and surface components. The MI $\Theta$ is changed significantly as function of the effective radius $R$ and deformation parameter because of a strong gravity. We found the additional narrower constraints for the NS radius due mainly to the $t,\varphi$ correlations and surface contributions and NS surface deformation. The adiabaticity conditions for application of the linear perturbation theory is carried out for several neutron stars with a strong gravity and relatively large rotation periods.

classification.title_zh: 具有变形有效表面的中子星的慢速宏观旋转
classification.abstract_zh: 本文将平衡态下作为有限理想流体的中子星宏观模型推广到旋转变形系统：在有效表面方法中，围绕 Schwarzschild 引力度规对小幅频率 ω 作线性微扰展开；采用椭球坐标下的 Kerr 度规方法计算绕对称轴慢速稳定方位旋转的中子星角动量 I 与转动惯量，并与球对称结果比较。在薄层参数 a/R≪1 的领头阶，同时考虑宏观中子星能量密度 E(ρ)（状态方程）的梯度表面项与体项。文章得到解析的宏观转动惯量表达式 Θ=dI/dω=Θ̃/(1−T_{tφ})，其以统计平均转动惯量 Θ̃ 及其时间与方位角 t,φ 关联 T_{tφ} 的体和表面分量之和表示。由于强引力，转动惯量 Θ 随有效半径 R 和变形参数显著变化；发现主要由 t,φ 关联、表面贡献和中子星表面变形带来的对中子星半径的额外更窄限制。并对若干强引力且旋转周期相对较长的中子星检验了线性微扰理论的绝热条件。

papers.title: Magnetically Deformed Neutron Stars and Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: We study the geometric figures of neutron stars and magnetars with spin periods from milliseconds to seconds and magnetic fields from $10^{12}$-$10^{15}$ G to hypothetical values near the Chandrasekhar-Fermi virial scale, $10^{18}$ G. In Newtonian theory, we find the equilibrium figure of a rotating incompressible fluid with a current-free uniform interior magnetic field matched to an exterior dipole field by surface currents. For aligned axes, an oblate spheroid is obtained by minimizing the total gravitational, rotational and magnetic energy at fixed mass, volume, angular momentum and frozen magnetic flux. Its ellipticity is the sum of rotational and magnetic contributions, recovers the Ferraro limit for a weak magnetic field, and has a magnetic weight that depends on the eccentricity for large deformation. For misaligned magnetic and spin axes, we introduce a quadrupolar shape tensor and diagonalize it to find a triaxial ellipsoid whose principal axes are tilted by magnetic pressure. The tilt angle and eccentricities are computed analytically as functions of the rotational and magnetic eccentricities and the misalignment angle. The magnetic energy of the misaligned configuration is obtained in closed form in oblate spheroidal harmonics for arbitrary eccentricity and obliquity. Its weak-field deformation, up to $10^{15}$ G, is proportional to $P_2(\cos\alpha)$, which fixes the magnetic forcing tensor, and its finite-eccentricity form gives a generalized Ferraro-Maclaurin relation for rotation-dominated misaligned stars. In the weak-field regime, the triaxial eccentricity is determined by the Ferraro eccentricity and the harmonic mean of order 2 of the rotational and magnetic eccentricities. The deformation parameters give the quadrupole moments and hence the continuous gravitational-wave amplitudes, luminosity and spin-down torque of the triaxial configuration.

classification.title_zh: 磁变形中子星与引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在牛顿理论框架下研究中子星和磁星的平衡形状，考虑毫秒到秒的自转周期以及10^12–10^15 G、直至接近Chandrasekhar-Fermi virial尺度10^18 G的磁场。对于自转轴与磁场轴对齐情形，通过固定质量、体积、角动量和冻结磁通下最小化总引力、转动与磁能，得到由表面电流匹配内部无电流均匀磁场与外部偶极场的不可压流体扁球平衡形变；其椭率是转动和磁贡献之和，弱场回到Ferraro极限。对于两轴不对齐情形，引入四极形状张量并对角化，得到主轴受磁压倾斜的三轴椭球，解析给出倾角和椭率。错位构型的磁能以扁球谐函数闭式表示，弱场形变正比于P_2(cosα)，并给出旋转主导错位星的广义Ferraro-Maclaurin关系。形变参数给出四极矩，从而得到连续引力波振幅、光度和自旋减慢力矩。
classification.one_liner: 用牛顿平衡形状方法计算磁变形中子星/磁星的扁球与三轴椭球形变，并由此给出连续引力波四极矩预言。

papers.title: Rapidly Spinning Primordial Black Holes from Confinement
papers.abstract: Confinement can turn widely separated particles into rapidly spinning primordial black holes. A flux tube pulls a heavy quark--antiquark pair together, converting its stored energy into relativistic motion. The same mechanism is possible in the magnetic dual, where a Higgs phase confines magnetic flux into a string joining a monopole--antimonopole pair. As the particles approach, cosmological tides and string bends can deflect their motion and make them miss. These disturbances can originate during inflation or be generated later. Black-hole formation then requires rare close passages from a smooth, broad encounter distribution. The resulting natal spin density therefore rises linearly to extremality, with mean dimensionless spin two thirds. Numerical string evolutions recover this law. Pairs that miss can remain bound, radiate and later collapse into lighter, near-extremal holes, sourcing a stochastic gravitational-wave background. Although the abundance remains model dependent, confinement leaves a unique spin signature that gravitational-wave observations can test.

classification.title_zh: 禁闭产生快速旋转的原初黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 禁闭可以把相距遥远的粒子变成快速旋转的原初黑洞。一根磁通管把重的夸克—反夸克对拉到一起，将其储存的能量转化为相对论性运动。同样的机制在磁对偶中也可能发生：在希格斯相中，磁通量被禁闭成一根连接单极子—反单极子对的弦。当粒子相互接近时，宇宙学潮汐和弦的弯曲会使它们的运动偏转，导致它们彼此错过。这些扰动可以起源于暴胀期间，也可以在之后产生。于是黑洞形成需要来自光滑、宽泛的相遇分布的罕见近距离掠过。由此产生的出生自旋密度线性上升到极端值，平均无量纲自旋为三分之二。数值弦演化重现了这一规律。错过的粒子对可以保持束缚、辐射，并在之后坍缩成更轻的、近极端黑洞，产生随机引力波背景。尽管丰度仍依赖于模型，禁闭留下了引力波观测可以检验的独特自旋特征。
classification.one_liner: 禁闭磁通管将重夸克对（磁对偶下为单极子对）拉近，使其在罕见近距离掠过时坍缩为高自旋原初黑洞，给出线性升至极端值的自旋分布及随机引力波背景预言。

papers.title: Impact of dynamical, quadratic, and higher-order tidal effects on gravitational-wave observations of binary neutron stars
papers.abstract: Neutron-star binaries are prime gravitational-wave sources for current and next-generation detectors, and provide a unique probe for the behaviour of nuclear matter at supranuclear densities. Extracting information about this requires accurate waveform models that capture tidal effects during the late inspiral. We incorporate state-of-the-art tidal corrections into a post-Newtonian inspiral waveform, including dynamical tides and nonlinear contributions from quadratic Love numbers through eighth post-Newtonian (8PN) order. Using Bayesian model comparison, we find that these corrections can significantly affect the gravitational-wave signal, with the 8PN tidal response becoming comparable to lower-PN tidal contributions in the subsolar-mass regime. For exceptionally loud GW170817-like binaries observed by third-generation detectors such as the Einstein Telescope, higher-order tidal effects can be distinguished with high statistical significance, while neglecting them can introduce substantial biases in the inferred tidal deformabilities and, consequently, in constraints on the neutron-star equation of state. These corrections are particularly relevant for putative subsolar-mass binaries: the lower compactness of their constituents enhances tidal effects and makes them potentially important even for current detectors. Our results highlight the importance of higher-order tidal corrections for precision gravitational-wave measurements of dense nuclear matter.

classification.title_zh: 动力学、二次及高阶潮汐效应对双中子星引力波观测的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 双中子星是当前和下一代探测器的重要引力波源，为研究超核密度核物质行为提供了独特探针。准确提取相关信息需要能刻画晚期旋近阶段潮汐效应的波形模型。作者将最先进的潮汐修正纳入后牛顿旋近波形，包括动力学潮汐以及通过八阶后牛顿（8PN）的二次Love数非线性贡献。利用贝叶斯模型比较，发现这些修正可显著影响引力波信号，其中8PN潮汐响应在亚太阳质量区域可与较低PN潮汐贡献相比。对于第三代探测器如爱因斯坦望远镜观测到的极响亮类GW170817双星，高阶潮汐效应能以高统计显著性被区分；忽略它们会在推断潮汐形变率及由此对中子星状态方程的约束中引入显著偏差。这些修正对假定的亚太阳质量双星尤其相关：其组分致密度较低会增强潮汐效应，使其甚至对当前探测器也可能重要。结果表明高阶潮汐修正对致密核物质的精确引力波测量十分重要。
classification.one_liner: 将动力学潮汐和二次Love数等高阶潮汐修正纳入后牛顿波形，评估其对双中子星引力波参数估计及中子星状态方程约束的影响。

papers.title: Effects of Lensing by Sgr A* on Semicoherent Searches for Continuous Gravitational Waves. I. Signal Model and Mismatch Studies
papers.abstract: Continuous gravitational waves (CWs) from neutron stars beyond the Galactic Center can be lensed by the supermassive black hole in Sgr A$^*$. Since the signal lasts far longer than the lensing time delay, the two geometric-optics images overlap and interfere. Transverse source motion during the observation makes their magnifications and relative time delay evolve, producing evolving amplitude and phase modulations absent from standard CW templates. Using lensed and unlensed injections in Gaussian noise, we quantify their effect on a Hough-based semicoherent search through a semicoherent mismatch. Recovery is governed by the competition between lensing amplification and waveform modulation. Smaller impact parameters generally improve recovery through stronger magnification, while higher transverse velocities partially offset this gain through faster modulation, especially at small impact parameters and short source-lens distances, where image interference is appreciable. The response also depends on the intrinsic signal strength. Loud signals exhibit small fractional changes, with net losses in some configurations, whereas weaker signals yield broader mismatch distributions extending to more negative values, indicating greater enhancement. A population study, sampling lensing parameters from astrophysically motivated velocity and source-lens distance distributions, reproduces the strong dependence on signal strength. Differences between populations are modest, but high-velocity, short source-lens distance populations tend towards larger mismatches. Lensing effects therefore cannot be accounted for by rescaling search sensitivity with the magnification alone; reinterpreting directed Galactic Center search sensitivities and upper limits under the lensing hypothesis requires injection studies with the full lensed waveform across the lensing parameter space.

classification.title_zh: Sgr A* 引力透镜对连续引力波半相干搜索的影响 I. 信号模型与失配研究
classification.abstract_zh: 来自银河系中心之外中子星的连续引力波可被 Sgr A* 的超大质量黑洞引力透镜化。由于信号持续时间远长于透镜时间延迟，两个几何光学像会重叠并干涉；观测期间源的横向运动使放大率和相对时间延迟演化，产生标准连续波模板中不存在的振幅与相位调制。作者在高斯噪声中注入透镜化和未透镜化信号，通过半相干失配量化这些效应对基于 Hough 的半相干搜索的影响。恢复效果由透镜放大与波形调制的竞争决定：较小碰撞参数通常因更强放大而改善恢复，而较高横向速度会通过更快调制部分抵消这一增益，尤其在小碰撞参数和短源-透镜距离、像干涉显著时。响应还依赖 intrinsic 信号强度：强信号表现出较小的相对变化，某些配置下净损失；弱信号给出更宽、延伸至更负值的失配分布，表明增强更大。按天体物理启发的速度和源-透镜距离分布抽样透镜参数的人群研究重现了对信号强度的强依赖；人群间差异不大，但高速度、短源-透镜距离人群倾向更大失配。因此透镜效应不能仅通过用放大率重标搜索灵敏度来考虑；在透镜假设下重新解释银河系中心定向搜索的灵敏度和上限，需要在完整透镜参数空间上进行全透镜波形注入研究。
classification.one_liner: 研究 Sgr A* 引力透镜及源横向运动对连续引力波波形的调制，并量化其对 Hough 半相干搜索失配的影响。

papers.title: Gauge aspects of teleparallel gravity and Noether's second theorem
papers.abstract: We examine the gauge structure of the Teleparallel Equivalent of General Relativity (TEGR) from the perspective of Noether's second theorem. We show that diffeomorphisms and local Lorentz transformations are the gauge symmetries of TEGR, as these are the only variational symmetries that give rise to Noether identities. We then discuss the distinct roles of these two symmetries and their implications for the gauge-theoretic interpretation of gravity. Finally, we discuss consequences of these observations for the role of translations in gauge theories of gravity and the coupling of matter in TEGR. In particular, we demonstrate that the matter coupling prescription is uniquely determined and coincides with that of general relativity, including in the case of spinor fields.

classification.title_zh: 远平行引力的规范方面与诺特第二定理
classification.abstract_zh: 我们从诺特第二定理的视角考察广义相对论远平行等价（TEGR）的规范结构。我们表明，微分同胚和局部洛伦兹变换是TEGR的规范对称性，因为它们是唯一产生诺特恒等式的变分对称性。随后我们讨论这两种对称性的不同作用及其对引力规范论解释的含义。最后，我们讨论这些观察对引力规范理论中平移的作用以及TEGR中物质耦合的影响。特别地，我们证明物质耦合规定是唯一确定的，并与广义相对论一致，包括旋量场情形。
classification.one_liner: 从诺特第二定理分析TEGR的规范对称性，澄清微分同胚与局部洛伦兹变换的角色及物质耦合。

papers.title: Rapid Multiparameter Gravitational-Wave Tests of General Relativity with Neural Posterior Estimation
papers.abstract: Multiparameter gravitational-wave tests of general relativity (GR) are limited by strong correlations among post-Newtonian (PN) phase deformations and the computational cost of Bayesian inference. We present DINGO-TGR, a neural posterior estimation framework that jointly infers binary-source parameters and six PN phase deformations within the TIGER parametrization, using IMRPhenomXPHM waveforms with spin precession and higher-order modes. Importance sampling reweights the neural proposal samples, while principal component analysis (PCA) identifies two well-constrained combinations of PN deformations. We validate the framework using 16 zero-noise GR injections and 12 beyond-GR injections, recovering GR-consistent posteriors in the former and leading-mode shifts consistent with the injected deformations in the latter. For GW150914 and GW250114, our results agree with independent \texttt{bilby-tgr} analyses using \texttt{dynesty}. After training, inference including importance sampling takes approximately 38 minutes and 4.4 hours, respectively, compared with 177 and 238 hours for conventional sampling. GW150914 exhibits a mild offset from GR in the leading PCA mode, whereas GW250114 is consistent with GR. To assess the significance of the GW150914 offset, we analyze 1000 GW150914-like GR injections with independent Gaussian-noise realizations and fixed detector power spectral densities. The resulting empirical upper-tail $p$-value is $11.5\%$, indicating that the observed offset does not reject the adopted GR null model at the 5\% significance level. Our results demonstrate the potential of importance-sampling-corrected neural inference for efficient multiparameter GR tests and large-scale injection-based significance assessments.

classification.title_zh: 基于神经后验估计的快速多参数引力波广义相对论检验
classification.abstract_zh: 多参数引力波广义相对论检验受限于后牛顿相位形变之间的强相关以及贝叶斯推断的计算成本。我们提出 DINGO-TGR，一个神经后验估计框架，在 TIGER 参数化下联合推断双星源参数和六个后牛顿相位形变，并使用包含自旋进动和高阶模式的 IMRPhenomXPHM 波形。重要性采样对神经提议样本重加权，主成分分析识别出两个约束较好的后牛顿形变组合。我们用 16 个零噪声广义相对论注入和 12 个超出广义相对论注入验证框架：前者恢复与广义相对论一致的后验，后者恢复与注入形变一致的主模偏移。对 GW150914 和 GW250114，结果与使用 dynesty 的独立 bilby-tgr 分析一致。训练后，包含重要性采样的推断分别约需 38 分钟和 4.4 小时，而传统采样需 177 和 238 小时。GW150914 在主 PCA 模上显示相对广义相对论的轻微偏移，而 GW250114 与广义相对论一致。为评估 GW150914 偏移的显著性，我们分析了 1000 个类似 GW150914 的广义相对论注入，使用独立高斯噪声实现和固定探测器功率谱密度；得到的经验上尾 p 值为 11.5%，表明在 5% 显著性水平下该偏移不能拒绝所采用的广义相对论零模型。结果表明，重要性采样校正的神经推断可用于高效多参数广义相对论检验和大规模注入显著性评估。
classification.one_liner: 提出 DINGO-TGR 神经后验估计框架，将重要性采样与 PCA 结合，实现快速多参数后牛顿形变引力波广义相对论检验并用于 GW150914/GW250114 分析。

papers.title: Lurkers at the Threshold: GWTC-4.0's near-threshold events
papers.abstract: We present the first systematic parameter-estimation analysis of 42 candidate gravitational-wave signals identified in GWTC-4.0 with a probability of astrophysical origin $p_\mathrm{astro} \geq 0.5$, but a false-alarm rate of at least $1\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$, which were therefore not selected for parameter estimation in the catalogue. We use a catalogue-style analysis workflow and publicly available strain data to obtain posterior samples for these candidates, of which 29 pass our validation criteria. Of the remaining 13 candidates, seven are consistent with noise or impacted by instrumental artefacts, while six yield results that cannot be reliably interpreted. We identify several interesting candidates: a possible neutron star-black hole merger, GW230920_064709, and two candidates with evidence for non-zero effective spin: GW230902_172430 and GW230823_142524. The latter also shows mild evidence of precession, although further analysis is needed to establish the robustness of this result. We quantify the information gained from these observations using the Kullback-Leibler divergence, finding that the inferred spin parameters are generally only weakly constrained. We present a reproducible analysis workflow that uses publicly available data and software, without access to LVK collaboration resources, and incorporates automated posterior-validation tools. We also provide a data release containing results in a format compatible with those from GWTC-4.0. Our results demonstrate that useful parameter constraints can be obtained for many candidates below the catalogue's parameter-estimation significance threshold, while highlighting the challenges of analysing marginal signals and the importance of careful validation.

classification.title_zh: 阈值边缘的潜伏者：GWTC-4.0 的近阈值事件
classification.abstract_zh: 本文首次对 GWTC-4.0 中识别出的 42 个候选引力波信号进行系统性参数估计分析；这些信号具有天体物理起源概率 p_astro ≥ 0.5，但虚警率至少为 1 yr^-1，因此未被目录选入参数估计。作者采用目录式分析流程和公开应变数据，为这些候选信号获得后验样本，其中 29 个通过验证标准；其余 13 个中，7 个与噪声一致或受仪器伪影影响，6 个结果无法可靠解释。研究指出若干有趣候选：可能的双星系统 GW230920_064709，以及两个具有非零有效自旋证据的候选 GW230902_172430 和 GW230823_142524；后者还显示轻微的进动证据，但需要进一步分析确认稳健性。作者用 Kullback-Leibler 散度量化这些观测带来的信息增益，发现推断的自旋参数通常约束较弱。文中给出一个可重复的分析流程，使用公开数据和软件、无需 LVK 合作资源，并包含自动后验验证工具；还发布了与 GWTC-4.0 格式兼容的结果数据。结果表明，许多低于目录参数估计显著性阈值的候选仍可获得有用参数约束，同时凸显分析边缘信号的挑战和仔细验证的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 对 GWTC-4.0 中 42 个近阈值引力波候选进行系统参数估计，验证 29 个并发布可重复流程与结果数据。

papers.title: Tricritical Dynamics Reveal Black Hole Interior Geometry
papers.abstract: We reconstruct the interior Kasner exponents of a scalarized black-hole equilibrium from the growth rate of a radial perturbation outside the horizon. The equal-entropy coexistence line of Reissner--Nordstr\"om and scalarized phases ends at a tricritical point. We follow the intermediate equilibrium separating the two phases along the coexistence line. The radial growth rate $\Omega_u$ is proportional to the magnitude of the entropy-potential curvature. As the tricritical point is approached, the curvature vanishes as the fourth power of the horizon scalar amplitude. The interior logarithmic scalar gradient grows inversely with the horizon amplitude. Eliminating the amplitude connects exterior dynamics to interior geometry, giving the angular Kasner exponent $p\sim2\sqrt{\Omega_u/C}$. The static source expansion and the critical Reissner--Nordstr\"om zero mode fix $C$ before the scalarized interior is integrated. We compute the growth rate from linear radial perturbations on asymptotically flat and anti-de Sitter black-hole backgrounds. At the sampled equilibria closest to tricriticality, the reconstructed angular exponent agrees with the result of independent inward integration at about the $0.5\%$ level.

classification.title_zh: 三临界动力学揭示黑洞内部几何
classification.abstract_zh: 本文从视界外径向扰动的增长率重构标量化黑洞平衡态内部的Kasner指数。Reissner-Nordström相与标量化相的等熵共存线终止于一个三临界点，我们沿共存线追踪分隔两相的中间平衡态。径向增长率Ω_u正比于熵势曲率的大小；接近三临界点时，该曲率按视界标量振幅的四次方消失，而内部对数标量梯度与视界振幅成反比。消去振幅可将外部动力学与内部几何联系起来，得到角向Kasner指数 p∼2√(Ω_u/C)。静态源展开和临界Reissner-Nordström零模可在积分标量化内部之前确定C。我们在渐近平直和反de Sitter黑洞背景上计算线性径向扰动的增长率；在最接近三临界的采样平衡态上，重构的角向指数与独立向内积分结果在约0.5%水平上一致。

papers.title: Exceptional point excitation by a plunging particle
papers.abstract: We investigate the excitation of a second-order exceptional point (EP) in the quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum by a plunging particle. Starting from a gravitational action, we derive the master equation with a Gaussian bump modified potential. For the odd-parity mode $(\ell,m)=(2,1)$, we compute the waveform numerically and derive an analytic expression for the EP contribution to the ringdown waveform directly from the particle source. Comparison with the numerical waveform shows that the particle excites the EP response, which, together with its mirror contribution, dominates the intermediate ringdown stage. We use waveform fitting and Bayesian analysis to assess the limitations of conventional QNM templates for EP ringdown. In the fitting, the EP template recovers the complex frequency $\omega$ more accurately than the ordinary template. In Bayesian analysis, at a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of $\rho=100$, the ordinary template yields a narrow frequency posterior whose $90\%$ credible region excludes the true EP frequency, whereas the broader EP-template region contains it. The Bayes factor nevertheless favors the ordinary template at lower SNRs and the EP template only at higher SNRs. These results show that in the EP case a narrow posterior and favorable Bayesian evidence do not guarantee accurate frequency inference when a conventional template omits the characteristic EP ringdown structure.

classification.title_zh: 由坠落粒子激发例外点
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究坠落粒子对准正规模谱中二阶例外点的激发。我们从引力作用量出发，推导带有高斯凸起修正势的主方程；对奇宇称 (ℓ,m)=(2,1) 模式数值计算波形，并直接从粒子源给出例外点对铃宕波形贡献的解析表达式。与数值波形比较表明，粒子会激发例外点响应，该响应及其镜像贡献主导中间铃宕阶段。我们利用波形拟合和贝叶斯分析评估传统 QNM 模板在例外点铃宕情形下的局限：拟合中例外点模板比普通模板更准确地恢复复频率；在信噪比 ρ=100 的贝叶斯分析中，普通模板给出窄频后验，其 90% 可信区间排除真实例外点频率，而较宽的例外点模板区间包含该频率；但贝叶斯因子在较低信噪比下仍支持普通模板，仅在较高信噪比下支持例外点模板。结果表明，当传统模板遗漏特征性例外点铃宕结构时，窄后验和有利贝叶斯证据并不保证频率推断准确。
classification.one_liner: 坠落粒子会激发黑洞铃宕中的二阶例外点响应，且传统 QNM 模板在 EP 情形下可能给出误导性的窄后验。

papers.title: Machine learning and high accuracy: Neural preconditioners for computational gravity
papers.abstract: Machine learning (ML) developments have empowered valuable calculations in many areas of theoretical physics. Certain topics involving moderate-to-low accuracy requirements have been particularly fortunate because many ML techniques, such as neural networks, introduce a noise floor that would be difficult to penetrate with stricter tolerances. For this reason, topics requiring high accuracy can be hesitant to pursue ML. One prominent example is gravitational wave modeling, which relies on traditional methods that accommodate the high sensitivities of detectors such as LISA. However, recent progress in applied mathematics has identified hybrid methods where fast-but-noisy ML mechanisms are inserted into otherwise traditional numerical schemes to accelerate convergence in a way that ultimately meets or exceeds the accuracy of standard methods. We develop an optimized hybrid ML method to tackle a class of challenging PDEs; specifically, we demonstrate ML implementations for gravitational waves from asymmetric-mass black hole binaries and elastic waves. These require solving sparse linear algebra systems with Helmholtz features that are especially difficult for traditional iterative methods. Our new approach is to train a graph neural network (GNN) as a significantly faster preconditioner using a novel loss function based on the true residual of the iterative algorithm. For the most difficult regions of parameter space, our neural preconditioner decreases iteration counts by 2-15x compared to traditional preconditioners. Because the GNN operates directly on the sparse matrix and needs only modest physical context, it generalizes beyond its training domain and can be adapted to new problems across physics by retraining rather than redesign. Hybrid ML methods such as this offer a new and compelling avenue to handle high accuracy and speed requirements in gravitational wave modeling and beyond.

classification.title_zh: 机器学习与高精度：计算引力中的神经预条件子
classification.abstract_zh: 机器学习已在理论物理多个领域推动有价值的计算，但神经网络等方法常引入噪声下限，使高精度需求领域对采用 ML 较为谨慎，引力波建模即是一例。本文借鉴应用数学中的混合方法，将快速但含噪的 ML 机制嵌入传统数值格式，以加速收敛并最终达到或超过标准方法的精度。作者针对一类困难 PDE 开发优化的混合 ML 方法，具体演示了非对称质量黑洞双星引力波与弹性波的计算；这些问题需要求解具有 Helmholtz 特征的稀疏线性代数系统，传统迭代方法尤其困难。其新做法是训练图神经网络作为更快的预条件子，损失函数基于迭代算法的真实残差。在最困难的参数区域，神经预条件子相较传统预条件子将迭代次数降低 2–15 倍。由于 GNN 直接作用于稀疏矩阵且只需少量物理背景，它能泛化到训练域之外，并可通过重新训练适配新问题。
classification.one_liner: 用图神经网络预条件子加速高精度引力波等 PDE 数值求解，同时保持或超过传统方法精度。

papers.title: Degeneracies in the quasinormal mode spectrum of the Kerr-Sen black hole
papers.abstract: The non-Hermitian nature of the eigenvalue problem underlying black hole perturbations can induce the presence of exceptional points (EPs) in the quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum. EPs are points in parameter space where QNMs become degenerate. Near an EP, QNMs are resonantly excited, leaving imprints on the ringdown signal. In this work, we investigate the exceptional structure of scalar perturbations of the Kerr-Sen black hole, a rotating, charged solution of the low-energy limit of heterotic string theory, and compare it with the EP structure of the Kerr-Newman black hole in General Relativity. Starting from the EP associated with a massive scalar field in the Kerr limit, we trace exceptional lines in the parameter space spanned by the black hole spin, charge, and field mass. We locate these degeneracies directly by imposing double-root conditions on the QNM secular equation, thus avoiding the need for parameter space scans. We also investigate the hysteresis phenomenon, showing that encircling an EP in parameter space leads to an exchange of the associated QNMs.
authors: S\'ergio V. M. C. B. Xavier

classification.title_zh: Kerr-Sen 黑洞准正规模谱中的简并
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞微扰所对应的本征值问题具有非厄米性质，这可能在准正规模（QNM）谱中导致例外点（EP）。EP 是参数空间中 QNM 发生简并的点。在 EP 附近，QNM 会被共振激发，并在铃宕信号中留下印记。本文研究 Kerr-Sen 黑洞标量微扰的例外结构；Kerr-Sen 黑洞是异质弦理论低能极限下的一个旋转带电解，并将其与广义相对论中 Kerr-Newman 黑洞的 EP 结构进行比较。从 Kerr 极限下大质量标量场对应的 EP 出发，我们在由黑洞自旋、电荷和场质量张成的参数空间中追踪例外线。我们通过对 QNM 久期方程施加双根条件直接定位这些简并，从而避免参数空间扫描。我们还研究了滞后现象，表明在参数空间中环绕一个 EP 会导致相关 QNM 的交换。

papers.title: Einstein Reconstruction Scheme: Metric Reconstruction by Direct Inversion of the Einstein Operator
papers.abstract: We propose a metric reconstruction scheme that computes the metric directly from the linearized Einstein equations for noncompact sources. Working in a traceful radiation gauge, we hierarchically solve four Einstein transport equations, with the remaining six enforced by suitable homogeneous data. Unlike previous Newman-Penrose approaches, we show how the homogeneous data are fixed, thereby closing the full set of Einstein equations. We conclude by relating our scheme to existing sourced reconstruction methods, thus establishing a connection between the Newman-Penrose and Hertz-potential approaches.

classification.title_zh: 爱因斯坦重构方案：通过直接反演爱因斯坦算符进行度规重构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种度规重构方案，对非紧致源直接从线性化爱因斯坦方程计算度规。在有迹辐射规范下，我们层级式求解四个爱因斯坦输运方程，其余六个方程由合适的齐次数据强制满足。与以往的Newman-Penrose方法不同，我们展示了如何确定齐次数据，从而闭合整套爱因斯坦方程。最后，我们将该方案与现有的有源重构方法联系起来，从而建立Newman-Penrose方法与Hertz势方法之间的联系。

papers.title: Population inference of eccentric binary black holes using asymptotic constants of motion
papers.abstract: In standard gravitational-wave population analyses of compact binaries, source parameters are defined at a reference frequency. For quantities that evolve during the inspiral, this means constructing a population of systems at different evolutionary stages, which complicates the astrophysical interpretation of the results. The past-time infinity, or zero-frequency, limit provides a mathematically well-defined reference where all sources enter the population fit on equal footing. This approach was first proposed for spin tilts, which evolve due to spin precession but converge to constant values as binaries are back-propagated. The orbital eccentricity also evolves throughout the inspiral and approaches unity in the zero-frequency limit for all binaries, making it unsuitable as a common reference point for population analyses. On the other hand, the Newtonian orbital angular momentum is an asymptotic constant of motion of the relativistic two-body problem and remains finite in this limit. In this paper, we make use of this known asymptotic behavior to reformulate eccentric population inference in terms of orbital angular momentum rather than eccentricity and demonstrate this approach on simulated gravitational-wave data. Our work constitutes the first example of eccentric population inference using only asymptotic constants of motion. Importantly, after the inference has been performed using this consistent reference, the results can be propagated to any preferred frequency for comparison with astrophysical predictions.

classification.title_zh: 利用渐近运动常数对偏心双黑洞进行群体推断
classification.abstract_zh: 在致密双星的标准引力波群体分析中，源参数定义在某一参考频率处。对于在旋进过程中演化的量，这意味着所构建的群体对应处于不同演化阶段的系统，从而使结果的 astrophysical 解释复杂化。过去时间无穷，即零频率极限，提供了一个数学上良好定义的参考点，使所有源以同等基础进入群体拟合。该方法最初针对自旋倾角提出：自旋倾角因自旋进动而演化，但将双星反向演化时收敛到常数值。轨道偏心率也在整个旋进过程中演化，并且在零频率极限下对所有双星都趋近于 1，因此不适合作为群体分析的共同参考。另一方面，牛顿轨道角动量是相对论两体问题的渐近运动常数，并在此极限下保持有限。本文利用这一已知渐近行为，将偏心群体推断改写为基于轨道角动量而非偏心率的推断，并在模拟引力波数据上展示了该方法。我们的工作构成了首个仅使用渐近运动常数进行偏心群体推断的例子。重要的是，在使用这一自洽参考完成推断后，结果可以被传播到任何偏好的频率，以与 astrophysical 预测进行比较。
classification.one_liner: 该文提出以零频率极限下的牛顿轨道角动量作为共同参考量，对偏心双黑洞引力波数据进行群体推断，并可将结果映射回任意观测频率。

papers.title: Eccentricity detectability in Extreme Mass-Ratio Inspirals
papers.abstract: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) consist of a stellar-mass compact object orbiting a massive black hole and are among the primary targets for the future space-based gravitational-wave detector LISA. Their orbital eccentricity carries valuable information about their astrophysical origins, making its detection particularly important. However, increasing eccentricity has competing effects on detectability: it makes eccentric waveforms easier to distinguish from circular ones, but also redistributes signal power across multiple harmonics, reducing the power captured by single-harmonic searches. In this work, we quantify this trade-off within a semi-coherent framework for a source with fixed total SNR of $50$. Eccentricity becomes distinguishable from zero for final eccentricities $e_f \gtrsim 0.05$, while single-harmonic sensitivity declines beyond $e_f \simeq 0.1$. In noise-free analyses, including enough harmonics to recover at least $50\%$ of the total SNR avoids this degradation, but adds statistical freedom when calibrating detection thresholds. We apply the framework to two astrophysical EMRI populations, showing how these competing effects interact with their eccentricity distributions under simplified assumptions. The balance among eccentricity-driven distinguishability, harmonic power loss, and the statistical cost of additional harmonics is an important consideration for future EMRI search developments.

classification.title_zh: 极端质量比旋近中的偏心率可探测性
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋近（EMRI）由一个恒星级致密天体绕大质量黑洞运动构成，是未来空间引力波探测器 LISA 的主要目标之一。其轨道偏心率携带有关天体物理起源的重要信息，因此探测偏心率尤为重要。然而，偏心率增加对可探测性有相互竞争的影响：一方面使偏心波形更容易与圆轨道波形区分，另一方面会把信号功率重新分配到多个谐波中，降低单谐波搜索捕获的功率。本文在半相干框架下，对总信噪比固定为 50 的源量化这一权衡。当最终偏心率 e_f 约大于 0.05 时，偏心率可与零区分；而当 e_f 约超过 0.1 后，单谐波灵敏度下降。在无噪声分析中，包含足够多谐波以恢复至少 50% 的总信噪比可避免这种退化，但会在校准探测阈值时增加统计自由度。作者将该框架应用于两个天体物理 EMRI 群体，在简化假设下展示这些竞争效应如何与其偏心率分布相互作用。偏心率驱动的可区分性、谐波功率损失以及额外谐波的统计代价之间的平衡，是未来 EMRI 搜索发展的重要考虑。
classification.one_liner: 该文在半相干搜索框架下量化 EMRI 偏心率带来的可区分性增益与谐波功率分散损失之间的权衡。

papers.title: Highly spinning binary black holes: promise and pitfalls for parameterized tests of general relativity
papers.abstract: Highly spinning binary black holes exhibit complex inspiral dynamics and offer a powerful opportunity to probe gravity in a stronger-field and more dynamical regime than non-spinning binaries. Gravitational-wave signals from such systems enable stringent parameterized tests of deviations from the source dynamics predicted by general relativity. We show that highly spinning, mass-asymmetric binaries can provide enhanced sensitivity to deviations entering at higher post-Newtonian orders, which remain comparatively poorly constrained. Using NR simulations from the SXS catalog, we first recover the injected signals within general relativity using $\texttt{IMRPhenomXPHM-SpinTaylor}$, $\texttt{IMRPhenomXPNR}$, and $\texttt{SEOBNRv5PHM}$, finding model-dependent biases in the inferred masses, spins, and spin orientations. We then analyze the same signals with the $\texttt{IMRPhenomXPHM}$-based inspiral parameterized test of general relativity framework, TIGER, and find that these waveform-systematic biases can lead to apparent deviations from general relativity, which become significant for loud signals. Our results highlight that highly spinning binaries offer powerful tests of higher-order post-Newtonian deviations, but waveform inaccuracies can lead to false signs of new physics.

classification.title_zh: 高自旋双黑洞：广义相对论参数化检验的机遇与陷阱
classification.abstract_zh: 高自旋双黑洞具有复杂的旋近动力学，为在比非自旋双星更强场、更动态的区域检验引力提供了机会。此类系统的引力波信号可用于对广义相对论预言的源动力学偏离做严格的参数化检验。作者指出，高自旋且质量不对称的双星能增强对更高后牛顿阶偏离的敏感度，而这些阶目前约束相对较弱。利用SXS目录的数值相对论模拟，他们首先用IMRPhenomXPHM-SpinTaylor、IMRPhenomXPNR和SEOBNRv5PHM在广义相对论内恢复注入信号，发现推断的质量、自旋和自旋取向存在模型依赖偏差；随后用基于IMRPhenomXPHM的旋近参数化广义相对论检验框架TIGER分析同一批信号，发现这些波形系统偏差可导致表观偏离广义相对论，且对高信噪比信号变得显著。结果强调高自旋双星能有力检验高阶后牛顿偏差，但波形不准确可能造成新物理的假信号。

papers.title: Maximal force bounds in general relativity and beyond
papers.abstract: Gibbons and Schiller proposed the maximal force conjecture in general relativity, according to which the maximum force is bounded by $c^4/G$. In this work, we derive upper bounds on the force for stable, self-gravitating, spatially regular and horizonless compact objects in $d$-dimensional general relativity, braneworld gravity, pure Lovelock gravity and Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity. Our analysis uses the connection between photon-ring structure and the stability of horizonless compact objects, adopting the absence of light rings as a criterion for stability. We investigate how the resulting force bounds depend on the spacetime dimension and on modifications to gravitational dynamics arising from extra dimensions and higher curvature corrections. We study how the bounds for such systems change under alternative higher curvature theories of gravity or in higher dimensions. Throughout this work, we consider a static and spherically symmetric spacetime sourced by anisotropic matter for which the radial and tangential pressures may differ.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论及其扩展中的最大力界限
classification.abstract_zh: Gibbons和Schiller在广义相对论中提出最大力猜想，认为最大力受 c^4/G 限制。本文针对 d 维广义相对论、膜世界引力、纯 Lovelock 引力和 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中稳定、自引力、空间规则且无视界的致密天体，推导力的上界。分析利用光子环结构与无视界致密天体稳定性之间的联系，以不存在光环作为稳定性判据。研究所得力界如何依赖时空维数以及额外维和高曲率修正对引力动力学的修改，并考察在这些替代高曲率引力理论或更高维中力界如何变化。全文考虑由各向异性物质源产生的静态球对称时空，其径向和切向压强可以不同。
classification.one_liner: 利用光子环缺失作为稳定性判据，在广义相对论、膜世界、Lovelock和Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet理论中推导无视界致密天体的最大力上界。

papers.title: Conserved gravitational-wave Stress-Energy Tensor in General Metric Theories
papers.abstract: We construct a gravitational-wave (GW) stress-energy tensor for general metric theories and show that it is conserved after averaging in the wave zone. In metric theories involving a vector field, we find that the conventional GW stress-energy tensor is generally not conserved. Combining the diffeomorphism identity, we identify the vector-field contribution required in addition to the conventional GW stress-energy tensor. On this basis, in a flat vacuum wave zone with constant background fields and after short-wavelength averaging, the perturbed field equation, perturbed action, Landau-Lifshitz, and Noether current methods yield equivalent tensors. In this setting, the completed tensor is generally nonsymmetric and satisfies $\partial_\mu\tau^{\mu\nu}=0$, with energy flux $c\tau^{i0}$. It also does not depend on whether a covariant or contravariant vector is chosen as the fundamental variable. Applying this framework to Einstein-\ae ther theory, we derive the orbital energy losses of an adiabatic quasicircular compact binary, and provide a possible explanation for the discrepancies among previous results in this theory. These results establish a consistent radiation balance that allows additional gravitational degrees of freedom to be connected to the evolution of astrophysical systems and to observational tests of gravity.

classification.title_zh: 一般度规理论中守恒的引力波应力能量张量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为一般度规理论构造引力波应力能量张量，并证明其在波区平均后守恒。对于含矢量场的度规理论，传统引力波应力能量张量一般不守恒；结合微分同胚恒等式，我们确定了除传统张量外所需的矢量场贡献。在此基础上，在具有常量背景场且经短波平均的平直真空波区中，微扰场方程、微扰作用量、Landau-Lifshitz 和 Noether 流方法给出等价张量。此时完备张量一般非对称并满足 ∂_μτ^{μν}=0，能量通量为 cτ^{i0}，且不依赖于选取协变还是逆变矢量作为基本变量。将框架应用于 Einstein-æther 理论，我们推导绝热准圆致密双星的轨道能量损失，并为该理论以往结果间的差异提供一种可能解释。
classification.one_liner: 在一般度规理论（含矢量场）中构造波区平均后守恒的引力波应力能量张量，并应用于 Einstein-æther 理论的双星轨道能量损失。

papers.title: Quasinormal Modes of a Black Hole in a Dehnen-Type Dark Matter Halo with Radial Pressure
papers.abstract: We investigate the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of scalar and (axial) gravitational perturbations of a black hole spacetime surrounded by a Dehnen-type dark matter (DM) halo with nonvanishing radial pressure. Our results reveal that the real and imaginary parts of the QNMs exhibit distinct redshift coefficients with respect to the DM halo compactness $M/a_0$, in contrast to the vanishing radial pressure case. The magnitude of this effect is dominated by the profile parameter $\gamma$, and the damping rate is more sensitive to the DM halo compactness than the oscillation frequency. In the eikonal limit, the redshift deviations are well captured by the light ring angular velocity $\Omega_c$ and the Lyapunov exponent $\lambda$.

classification.title_zh: 具有径向压强的Dehnen型暗物质晕中黑洞的准正模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了被具有非零径向压强的Dehnen型暗物质晕包围的黑洞时空中标量扰动和（轴）引力扰动的准正模。结果表明，与径向压强为零的情形不同，QNM的实部和虚部相对于暗物质晕致密度 M/a0 表现出不同的红移系数。该效应的大小由轮廓参数 gamma 主导，阻尼率比振荡频率更敏感于暗物质晕致密度。在半经典极限下，红移偏差可由光环绕角速度 Ωc 和Lyapunov指数 λ 很好描述。
classification.one_liner: 研究Dehnen型暗物质晕（含径向压强）中黑洞标量与轴引力QNM，并用光环绕角速度和Lyapunov指数解释eikonal极限红移偏差。

papers.title: Astrometric effects of anisotropic gravitational wave backgrounds
papers.abstract: Precise astrometric observations of distant objects such as stars and quasars can be used to probe gravitational wave signals at nanohertz frequencies. A stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) produces correlated apparent motions of pairs of objects on the sky. That correlation as a function of their angular separation is the astrometric analog of the Hellings-Downs curve in the context of pulsar timing measurements. Upper limits on the SGWB have been obtained from very-long baseline interferometry and Gaia astrometry, and future Gaia data releases are expected to improve them. An astrophysical background from inspiraling supermassive black hole binaries is expected to be significantly anisotropic. In this work, we compute the astrometric correlation functions for an anisotropic SGWB, known as the generalized overlap reduction functions, for all six gravitational wave polarizations. We present closed-form expressions in all cases where the distant-light source limit can be applied, following the approach used for pulsar timing arrays. We find that the correlations differ qualitatively between the tensor, vector, and scalar polarizations. Finally, we discuss the applicability of these results in future astrometry searches for arbitrarily polarized anisotropic gravitational wave backgrounds.

classification.title_zh: 各向异性引力波背景的天体测量效应
classification.abstract_zh: 对恒星和类星体等遥远天体的精确天体测量观测可用于探测纳赫兹频率的引力波信号。随机引力波背景（SGWB）会在天球上产生成对天体视运动的关联。这种关联随角间隔的变化，是脉冲星计时测量中 Hellings-Downs 曲线的天体测量类比。甚长基线干涉测量和 Gaia 天体测量已给出 SGWB 的上限，未来 Gaia 数据释放有望改进这些限制。由旋近的超大质量黑洞双星产生的天体物理背景预计会显著各向异性。本文计算各向异性 SGWB 的天体测量相关函数，即广义重叠约化函数，涵盖全部六种引力波偏振。我们在可应用远光源极限的所有情形下给出闭式表达式，方法沿用脉冲星计时阵列的处理方式。我们发现张量、矢量和标量偏振之间的相关函数存在定性差异。最后，我们讨论这些结果在未来任意偏振各向异性引力波背景天体测量搜寻中的适用性。
classification.one_liner: 计算各向异性随机引力波背景在六种偏振下的天体测量相关函数，为未来天体测量搜寻提供理论模板。

papers.title: Magnetized strange quark matter in hypersurface-homogeneous $f(R,T)$ cosmology: physical closure, isotropization and late-time observational constraints
papers.abstract: Cosmological models of magnetized strange quark matter in $f(R,T)$ gravity have so far relied on kinematic ansatzes and lacked observational tests. We revisit them for $f(R,T)=R+2\mu T$ on a hypersurface-homogeneous background containing the locally rotationally symmetric Bianchi I, Kantowski--Sachs and Bianchi III geometries. Treated exactly, the Maxwell field couples minimally. Because kinematic ansatzes contradict a magnetized source, we close the field equations with the bag-model equation of state and magnetic flux freezing and, adding dust and radiation, solve them exactly in limiting cases and numerically in general. Without primordial shear, the field-induced anisotropy keeps, as in general relativity, a nearly constant radiation-era level for $\mu\ge0$, then decays as the model approaches de Sitter space; an assumed present field of 1 nG leaves $(\sigma/H)_0\simeq5.8\times10^{-11}$ today. A joint fit to 32 cosmic chronometers, 1590 Pantheon+ supernova light curves and baryon acoustic oscillations from the second data release of the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument gives $\mu=1.12^{+0.65}_{-0.58}$ and $H_0=69.1\pm3.2$~\kmsMpc, and the null, weak and dominant energy conditions hold throughout. Relative to the flat $\Lambda$ cold dark matter model, the Akaike (AIC) and Bayesian (BIC) information criteria give $\Delta\mathrm{AIC}=-1.4$ and $\Delta\mathrm{BIC}=+4.0$, and the Bayes factor is inconclusive. The fitted bag term, $B_c^{1/4}=2.15$ meV, is an effective vacuum energy, not the quantum chromodynamics bag constant. The preference for $\mu>0$ depends on the supernova sample and the prior, a constant coupling would shift matter--radiation equality, and the sign of $\mu$ depends on the matter Lagrangian; $\mu$ is therefore an effective late-time parameter.

classification.title_zh: 超曲面均匀 f(R,T) 宇宙学中的磁化奇异夸克物质：物理闭合、各向同性化与晚期观测约束
classification.abstract_zh: 磁化奇异夸克物质在 f(R,T) 引力中的宇宙学模型迄今依赖运动学假设且缺乏观测检验。我们在包含局部旋转对称 Bianchi I、Kantowski-Sachs 和 Bianchi III 几何的超曲面均匀背景上，针对 f(R,T)=R+2μT 重新研究这些模型。精确处理时，Maxwell 场为最小耦合。由于运动学假设与磁化源矛盾，我们用袋模型状态方程和磁通量冻结来闭合场方程，并在加入尘埃与辐射后，对极限情形精确求解、对一般情形数值求解。无原初剪切时，场致各向异性在 μ≥0 下如同广义相对论中那样在辐射时代保持近常量水平，随后在模型趋近 de Sitter 空间时衰减；假设当前场为 1 nG，则今天得到 (σ/H)_0≃5.8×10^{-11}。对 32 个宇宙计时器、1590 条 Pantheon+ 超新星光变曲线以及来自暗能量光谱仪第二次数据释放的重子声学振荡进行联合拟合，得到 μ=1.12^{+0.65}_{-0.58} 和 H_0=69.1±3.2 km/s/Mpc，且零、弱和主导能量条件在整个过程中成立。相对于平坦 ΛCDM 模型，Akaike 信息准则和贝叶斯信息准则给出 ΔAIC=-1.4 和 ΔBIC=+4.0，贝叶斯因子无定论。拟合的袋项 B_c^{1/4}=2.15 meV 是有效真空能，而非量子色动力学袋常数。对 μ>0 的偏好依赖于超新星样本和先验，常数耦合会移动物质—辐射相等时期，而 μ 的符号依赖于物质拉格朗日量；因此 μ 是有效晚期参数。
classification.one_liner: 该文在超曲面均匀 f(R,T) 宇宙学中用袋模型状态方程与磁通量冻结闭合磁化奇异夸克物质场方程，并联合宇宙计时器、Pantheon+ 与 DESI BAO 给出晚期观测约束。

papers.title: From Matched Black-Hole Scalar Charges to Gravitational-Wave Inspirals in a Massive Scalar--Gauss--Bonnet Effective Theory
papers.abstract: Massive scalar fields introduce a finite interaction range in scalar--Gauss--Bonnet (sGB) gravity and can modify the gravitational waves (GWs) emitted by binary black holes (BBHs). We develop a matched description that relates the curvature-sourced scalar field of an isolated black hole (BH) to the scalar charge entering the effective binary dynamics. The massive field contains a distributed curvature-forced contribution and a homogeneous Yukawa sector. By matching the near- and far-zone solutions, we determine the local static coefficient and derive its finite conversion to a renormalized worldline coupling. The static coefficient has no linear scalar-mass correction, and its first correction is quadratic. We use the leading matched charges in the leading post-Newtonian dynamics and GW phasing of nonspinning, quasicircular BBHs while retaining the finite Yukawa range and massive-radiation kinematics. The scalar mass modifies the conservative dynamics, produces distinct dipole and quadrupole radiation thresholds, and changes the accumulated inspiral phase. We also construct the associated breathing and longitudinal tidal responses and treat dispersive massive propagation separately. These results connect the finite-mass BH scalar response to source and propagation observables for BBH inspirals.

classification.title_zh: 从匹配的黑洞标量荷到有质量标量–Gauss–Bonnet 有效理论中的引力波旋进
classification.abstract_zh: 大质量标量场在有质量标量–Gauss–Bonnet（sGB）引力中引入有限相互作用程，并可改变双黑洞（BBH）发出的引力波。我们建立一种匹配描述，将孤立黑洞由曲率源产生的标量场与进入有效双星动力学的标量荷联系起来。大质量场包含曲率强迫的分布贡献和齐次 Yukawa 部分。通过匹配近区和远区解，我们确定局域静态系数，并推导其到重整化世界线耦合的有限转换。该静态系数没有线性标量质量修正，其首个修正为二次阶。我们将领先的匹配标量荷用于无自旋准圆 BBH 的领先后牛顿动力学和引力波相位，同时保留有限 Yukawa 程和大质量辐射运动学。标量质量修改保守动力学，产生不同的偶极和四极辐射阈值，并改变累积的旋进相位。我们还构造相应的呼吸型和纵向潮汐响应，并单独处理色散的大质量传播。这些结果将有质量黑洞标量响应与 BBH 旋进的源和传播观测量联系起来。
classification.one_liner: 在有质量标量–Gauss–Bonnet 引力中匹配黑洞曲率源标量场与双星有效标量荷，并计算其对无自旋准圆双黑洞旋进相位及潮汐响应的修正。

papers.title: Binary black holes with non-orthogonal reference metrics
papers.abstract: To our knowledge, numerical relativity (NR) simulations in the covariant moving-puncture formalism have only been performed with orthogonal reference metrics. Here, we demonstrate a new general non-orthogonal reference 3-metric implementation. We first validate this reference metric implementation by numerically evolving the exact Kasner initial data with a fisheye-style reference 3-metric, demonstrating numerical results that converge to the exact solution with increasing grid resolution. Next, we validate our approach by evolving binary black holes (BBHs) in the moving-puncture formulation, from inspiral through merger and ringdown. Even with a large deformation in the reference geometry, introduced to allow a large change in grid refinement to enable the simulation to span the relevant length scales, from high resolutions near the BHs to low resolutions in the wave zone, no pathologies are observed. Smooth waveforms for up to $\ell=8$ are extracted on a grid without mesh refinement boundaries. We demonstrate the flexibility of tuning structured grids through the reference metric by employing spheroidal modifications of the spherical fisheye map to reduce the number of grid points in the $z$ direction when the orbit is in the $xy$-plane. These results support the use of smoothly derefined structured grids for BBH evolutions.

classification.title_zh: 具有非正交参考度规的双黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在协变 moving-puncture 数值相对论框架中实现了新的通用非正交参考三维度规。作者首先用鱼眼型参考度规数值演化精确 Kasner 初值，验证结果随网格分辨率收敛到精确解；随后演化双黑洞从旋近到并合和铃宕的过程。即使参考几何存在较大变形以支持从黑洞附近高分辨率到波区低分辨率的网格粗化，也未观察到病态行为，并提取出直到 ℓ=8 的平滑波形。作者还通过球状鱼眼映射的椭球修改展示参考度规调节结构化网格的灵活性。
classification.one_liner: 在 moving-puncture 数值相对论中实现非正交参考度规，并用于双黑洞并合模拟与波形提取。

papers.title: Post-adiabatic effects sourced by radiation reaction for inspiraling, eccentric binaries in post-Newtonian theory
papers.abstract: The adiabatic approximation, in which eccentric binaries evolve under orbit-averaged fluxes, is widely used in gravitational-wave and astrophysical modeling. We use resummed multiple-scale analysis, which is closely related to near-identity averaging transformations, to derive post-adiabatic corrections from leading-order radiation reaction and explain how the accuracy of the adiabatic approximation depends on the initial orbital phase. While the secular evolution equations for the eccentricity and semi-major axis receive no explicit first post-adiabatic corrections, their solutions acquire such corrections through the initial conditions. We also derive the change in the functional form of the gravitational-wave polarizations that cancels the gauge dependence of the orbital elements at first post-adiabatic order, ensuring agreement between waveforms evaluated at the same physical event in different coordinates. At a radial turning point, the first post-adiabatic oscillations of the semi-major axis and eccentricity vanish, so the initial osculating energy and angular momentum agree with their orbit-averaged values up to second post-adiabatic corrections. When initialized elsewhere along the orbit, the adiabatic approximation can accumulate significant dephasing, which the first post-adiabatic approximation can substantially reduce. Both dephasings can change sign across parameter space, consistent with competing contributions from successive orders. Accounting for initialization is therefore essential for assessing the accuracy of these approximations, particularly for long-lived, highly eccentric binaries.

classification.title_zh: 后牛顿理论中旋进偏心双星由辐射反作用产生的后绝热效应
classification.abstract_zh: 绝热近似（偏心双星在轨道平均通量下演化）广泛用于引力波和天体物理建模。我们采用重求和多尺度分析（与近恒等平均变换密切相关），从领头阶辐射反作用推导后绝热修正，并解释绝热近似精度如何依赖初始轨道相位。尽管偏心率和半长轴的长期演化方程没有显式的一阶后绝热修正，其解通过初始条件获得此类修正。我们还推导引力波极化函数形式的变化，以在一阶后绝热阶抵消轨道根数的规范依赖性，确保在不同坐标中同一物理事件处评估的波形一致。在径向转折点，半长轴和偏心率的一阶后绝热振荡消失，因此初始密切能量和角动量与轨道平均值在二阶后绝热修正内一致。若在轨道其他位置初始化，绝热近似可累积显著退相位，而一阶后绝热近似可大幅减小。两种退相位均可在参数空间中变号，与相继阶的竞争贡献一致。因此，考虑初始化对评估这些近似精度至关重要，尤其对长寿命高偏心双星。
classification.one_liner: 用重求和多尺度分析推导偏心双星辐射反作用的后绝热修正，并说明初始轨道相位对绝热近似退相位精度的影响。

papers.title: Spins do not add: why rotating stars do not help spin-up black holes in binaries
papers.abstract: It is well-known that in the merger of a black-hole binary with spins aligned with the orbital angular momentum, the spin of the final black hole always increases with the spin of the components. We show that this very intuitive behavior is violated in black hole--neutron star binaries, where the spin of the final black hole actually decreases as the spin of the neutron star increases. Using a large set of binaries with different spins and mass ratios, we identify the mechanism behind this surprising result in the nonlinear dynamics of the tidal disruption, which drives a substantial loss of angular momentum via dynamical ejecta, in some cases comparable to that radiated via gravitational waves. Our results highlight that the spin evolution of stellar-mass black holes involved in binary mergers is different from what normally assumed, far more complex, and interesting.

classification.title_zh: 自旋并不相加：为何旋转中子星无助于双星中黑洞的自旋提升
classification.abstract_zh: 众所周知，在自旋与轨道角动量对齐的双黑洞并合中，最终黑洞的自旋总是随组分自旋的增加而增加。我们证明，这一非常直观的行为在黑洞-中子星双星中被违反：最终黑洞的自旋实际上随着中子星自旋的增加而减小。利用大量具有不同自旋和质量比的双星，我们在潮汐瓦解的非线性动力学中确定了这一惊人结果背后的机制；该机制通过动力学抛射物导致角动量的显著损失，在某些情况下可与通过引力波辐射的角动量相当。我们的结果表明，参与双星并合的恒星级黑洞的自旋演化不同于通常假设，远为复杂且有趣。
classification.one_liner: 黑洞-中子星并合中，中子星自旋增大会降低最终黑洞自旋，潮汐瓦解和动力学抛射导致显著角动量损失。

papers.title: Joint Bayesian Inference of Dense Matter and f(Q) Gravity with Nuclear and Neutron Star Constraints
papers.abstract: We investigate neutron star (NS) properties in symmetric teleparallel $f(Q)$ gravity while consistently accounting for uncertainties in the dense matter equation of state (EOS). We focus on the linear $f(Q)$ model and perform a joint Bayesian inference of the nuclear matter and modified gravity parameters using a Taylor expansion EOS around nuclear saturation density. The analysis incorporates complementary constraints from nuclear saturation properties, chiral effective field theory calculations of pure neutron matter, heavy-ion collision, and empirical nuclear data, the GW170817 tidal deformability posterior, and NICER mass--radius measurements. The resulting posterior distributions simultaneously constrain the dense matter and gravity sectors and quantify their correlations within a common framework. For a canonical $1.4\,M_\odot$ NS, we obtain $R_{1.4}=11.28^{+0.35}_{-0.31}\,\mathrm{km}$ and $\Lambda_{1.4}=151.4^{+44.9}_{-31.2}$, while the maximum mass is constrained to $M_{\rm max}=2.22^{+0.29}_{-0.16}\,M_\odot$. The modified gravity parameters exhibit only weak direct correlations with most stellar observables, while a pronounced degeneracy remains within the gravity sector. Our results show that accounting for EOS uncertainties is essential for quantifying the interplay between dense matter physics and modified gravity and provide a systematic framework for confronting symmetric teleparallel gravity with nuclear and multimessenger NS observations.

classification.title_zh: 致密物质与 f(Q) 引力的联合贝叶斯推断：结合核物理与中子星约束
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究对称远平行 f(Q) 引力中的中子星性质，并同时考虑致密物质状态方程的不确定性。作者采用核饱和密度附近的泰勒展开状态方程，对核物质参数与线性 f(Q) 修正引力参数进行联合贝叶斯推断，纳入核饱和性质、手征有效场论对纯中子物质的计算、重离子碰撞、经验核数据、GW170817 潮汐形变后验以及 NICER 质量—半径测量。所得后验分布同时约束致密物质与引力部分，并量化二者关联。对典型 1.4 倍太阳质量中子星给出 R_{1.4}=11.28^{+0.35}_{-0.31} km、Λ_{1.4}=151.4^{+44.9}_{-31.2}，最大质量约束为 M_max=2.22^{+0.29}_{-0.16} M_⊙；修正引力参数与多数恒星观测量仅弱相关，而引力部分内部存在明显简并。结果表明，计入状态方程不确定性对于量化致密物质物理与修正引力之间的相互影响至关重要。
classification.one_liner: 用核物理、GW170817 与 NICER 数据联合约束 f(Q) 引力与致密物质状态方程，并给出中子星质量半径与潮汐形变后验。

papers.title: Generalized Fermat's principle and Snell's law for cone structures and applications
papers.abstract: Fermat's principle is fully generalized to the case where a smooth interface separates two cone structures -- Lorentz-Finsler lightcones -- representing wave propagation in a potentially inhomogeneous, anisotropic, time-dependent and discontinuous medium. The interface, wave source and receiver are assumed to be a hypersurface, a submanifold and a curve in the spacetime, respectively, of any causal character. For a trajectory to fulfill Fermat's principle -- i.e., to be a critical point of the arrival time functional -- its direction must change at the interface, obeying a precise condition that generalizes Snell's law of refraction when the wave crosses the interface, or the law of reflection when it remains in a single medium. Both laws are analyzed in detail to establish the conditions ensuring the existence and uniqueness of refracted and reflected trajectories, and to determine whether they actually minimize the arrival time. Applications to Zermelo's navigation problem and the determination of geodesics in discretized spacetimes are also emphasized.

classification.title_zh: 锥结构的广义费马原理与斯涅尔定律及其应用
classification.abstract_zh: 本文把费马原理推广到由光滑界面分隔的两个锥结构——洛伦兹-芬斯勒光锥——的情形，用以描述在可能非均匀、各向异性、含时且不连续介质中的波传播。界面、波源和接收者分别假设为时空中的超曲面、子流形和曲线，且具有任意因果性质。轨迹满足费马原理即成为到达时间泛函的临界点，其方向必须在界面处改变，并满足一个精确条件：波穿过界面时推广斯涅尔折射定律，留在单一介质中时则给出反射定律。文章详细分析这两条定律，建立折射与反射轨迹存在性和唯一性的条件，并判定它们是否确实使到达时间最小，还强调在Zermelo导航问题和离散化时空中测地线确定方面的应用。
classification.one_liner: 将费马原理与斯涅尔定律推广到洛伦兹-芬斯勒光锥及光滑界面，并分析折射/反射轨迹的存在唯一性与到达时间极小性。

papers.title: Wormhole geometries in Einstein-aether theory
papers.abstract: We present the first analysis of traversable wormholes within the framework of Einstein-aether theory. We show that the corresponding field equations admit three distinct wormhole geometries, obtained by adopting three different classes of combinations for the aether coupling constants. We examine the null and weak energy conditions for three types of wormhole shape functions. Our results show that, for appropriate choices of the wormhole parameters and the coupling constants of the theory, these wormhole geometries can satisfy the null and weak energy conditions. Furthermore, we find that the satisfaction of these energy conditions is restricted to certain ranges of the aether coupling constants, which can be interpreted as constraints arising from the requirement of avoiding exotic matter. However, these ranges are incompatible with the constraints imposed by physical considerations and observational bounds. This suggests that, as in Einstein gravity, exotic matter is necessary to support traversable wormhole geometries in Einstein-aether theory.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-aether 理论中的虫洞几何
classification.abstract_zh: 本文首次在 Einstein-aether 理论框架内分析可穿越虫洞。作者通过采用三类不同的 aether 耦合常数组合，证明相应场方程允许三种不同的虫洞几何。针对三种虫洞形状函数，考察了零能量条件与弱能量条件。结果表明，在适当选择虫洞参数和理论耦合常数时，这些虫洞几何可以满足零能量条件和弱能量条件；而且这些能量条件的满足被限制在特定的 aether 耦合常数范围内，这可被解释为避免奇异物质的要求所带来的约束。然而，这些范围与物理考量和观测限制所施加的约束不相容。这表明，如同在 Einstein 引力中一样，在 Einstein-aether 理论中支持可穿越虫洞几何仍需要奇异物质。
classification.one_liner: Einstein-aether 理论中的可穿越虫洞在特定耦合范围内可满足能量条件，但这些范围与物理及观测约束不相容，仍需要奇异物质。

papers.title: Weyl Rescalings: A First Order Approach
papers.abstract: Weyl transformations, --local rescalings in which the metric transforms as $g_{\mu\nu}(x)\longrightarrow \Omega^2(x)\, g_{\mu \nu}(x)$--, are expected to be a symmetry of nature at extremely high energy, that should be (spontaneously) broken at low energy. In Cartan's first order formulation of gravity this translates into the condition that the local frames (vielbein) scale as $e^a(x) \longrightarrow \Omega(x) e^a(x)$. In this construction, the Lorentz connection one-form fields $\omega^a{}_b$ are independent from $e^a$, and since Lorentz transformations and dilatations commute, $\omega$ and $R(\omega)$ must be Weyl invariant, while in the second order metric formalism the Ricci tensor undergoes a non-homogeneous transformation. This generates a tension between the two formulations, which should be equivalent in the vanishing torsion limit. Here we show how the puzzle can be resolved taking into account the role of torsion. This also sheds some light on the conformal coupling of matter fields to gravity.

classification.title_zh: Weyl 重标度：一阶方法
classification.abstract_zh: 本文讨论 Weyl 变换（度规的局域重标度 g_{\mu\nu}(x)\to\Omega^2(x)g_{\mu\nu}(x)）在 Cartan 一阶引力表述中的实现：标架按 e^a(x)\to\Omega(x)e^a(x) 缩放，而 Lorentz 联络一形式与 e^a 独立；由于 Lorentz 变换与伸缩变换对易，联络及其曲率必须 Weyl 不变，这与二阶度规形式中 Ricci 张量的非齐次变换产生张力。作者说明引入挠率如何解决这一矛盾，并讨论物质场与引力的共形耦合。
classification.one_liner: 在 Cartan 一阶引力中通过挠率解决 Weyl 重标度与二阶度规表述之间的变换张力，并讨论物质共形耦合。

papers.title: Carrollian bosonic supergravity at order $\alpha'$ and the universal cancellation of higher-curvature divergences
papers.abstract:
We prove that the Carrollian limit of bosonic supergravity remains finite after including the complete set of four-derivative terms arising from the first $\alpha'$-correction, for an arbitrary Carrollian geometry, i.e., without imposing compatibility conditions on the Carrollian fields. The proof rests on a small set of exact identities satisfied by the leading term of the relativistic Riemann tensor, which is entirely controlled by the intrinsic torsion $K_{\mu

We then show that higher-curvature contributions obey a universal scaling rule: every scalar built from $N$ relativistic Riemann tensors grows at most as $w^{2N}$ in the Carrollian expansion, so that all purely gravitational $\alpha'^{N-1}$-corrections admit a finite Carrollian limit for arbitrary Carrollian geometries. classification.title_zh: α' 阶的 Carrollian 玻色超引力与高曲率发散的普适抵消
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在包含来自首个 α' 修正的完整四导数项后，玻色超引力的 Carrollian 极限对任意 Carrollian 几何仍然有限，即不要求 Carrollian 场满足兼容性条件。证明基于相对论 Riemann 张量首项满足的一组少量精确恒等式，该项完全由 Carrollian 结构的内禀挠率 K_{μν}=1/2 L_τ h_{μν} 控制。我们以明显协变形式显式构造有限作用量：引力部分为纯电型，仅依赖 K_{μν} 及其沿 τ^μ 的导数，而 Carrollian 曲率和 τ_μ 的 twist 消失。随后证明高曲率贡献服从普适标度规则：由 N 个相对论 Riemann 张量构成的每个标量在 Carrollian 展开中至多按 w^{2N} 增长，因此所有纯引力 α'^{N-1} 修正对任意 Carrollian 几何都有有限 Carrollian 极限。作为应用，我们证明玻色弦理论的 α'^2 与 α'^3 修正（包括正比于 ζ(3) 的项）在此极限下有限且非零，而兼容性条件 ∇_μ h_{νρ}=∇_μ τ^ν=0 会使整个引力部分平凡化。
classification.one_liner: 该文证明玻色超引力的 Carrollian 极限在完整 α' 高曲率修正下保持有限，并给出高曲率项按 w^{2N} 增长的普适规则。

papers.title: 3d QFT IR divergences as UV divergences in 4d Holographic Cosmology
papers.abstract: In this paper we consider IR divergences in a 3d toy model field theory for 4d holographic cosmology, and we analyze them by introducing a mass term in a way that preserves a certain form of the generalized conformal structure. This allows us to compute 2- and 3-point functions at 2-loops and study their IR structure below the mass scale, from which we argue for a possible IR finiteness beyond perturbation theory, consistent with lattice results. In the holographically dual 4d cosmology, this corresponds to UV finiteness, i.e., the absence of cosmological singularities. The 3d IR field theory methods could be extended beyond this specific application.

classification.title_zh: 3d QFT 红外发散作为 4d 全息宇宙学中的紫外发散
classification.abstract_zh: 本文考虑 4d 全息宇宙学对应的 3d 玩具模型场论中的红外发散，通过引入保持某种广义共形结构形式的质量项来分析。这允许计算 2 点和 3 点函数至两圈，并研究其在质量标度以下的红外结构；由此论证微扰论之外可能存在红外有限性，与格点结果一致。在全息对偶的 4d 宇宙学中，这对应紫外有限性，即不存在宇宙学奇点。3d 红外场论方法可推广到该特定应用之外。
classification.one_liner: 通过 3d 玩具场论的红外发散研究 4d 全息宇宙学中的紫外有限性与宇宙学奇点回避。

papers.title: Wormholes and Averaging over N
papers.abstract: The gravitational path integral produces an asymptotic expansion in $G_N$, a fact which is puzzling in the case of observables that are expected to fluctuate wildly. Wormholes appear to compute ensemble averages of functions of such observables, though in typical constructions of AdS/CFT, there are no parameters to average over except, in some examples, a single integer $N$. We introduce a procedure that we call ``Mellin averaging'' to define a sort of asymptotic average of a function of $N$. We argue that Mellin averaging over $N$ may suffice to reproduce the apparent randomness seen in wormhole physics, provided that the dual theory admits an analytic continuation in $N$ and the relevant observables fluctuate on superpolynomially small scales in $N$. As a test case, we consider the spectral form factor in the regime where the double cone is believed to dominate the gravitational path integral and compare to a random matrix theory in which $N$ behaves as a continuous variable. We also describe some toy models of analytic continuation in $N$: a qubit model that can be analytically continued in $N$, and an explicit construction of a deterministic function of $N$ that simulates a sequence of independent draws from a Gaussian ensemble.

classification.title_zh: 虫洞与对 N 的平均
classification.abstract_zh: 引力路径积分产生关于 G_N 的渐近展开，这对于预期会剧烈涨落的可观测量来说令人困惑。虫洞似乎计算这类可观测量的函数的系综平均，但在 AdS/CFT 的典型构造中，除了某些例子中的单个整数 N 之外，没有可供平均的参数。我们引入一种称为“Mellin 平均”的程序，用来定义 N 的函数的某种渐近平均。我们论证，对 N 进行 Mellin 平均可能足以复现虫洞物理中看到的表观随机性，前提是对偶理论允许在 N 上解析延拓，且相关可观测量在 N 的超多项式小尺度上涨落。作为检验案例，我们考虑双锥被认为主导引力路径积分区域中的谱形式因子，并与 N 表现为连续变量的随机矩阵理论进行比较。我们还描述了一些 N 解析延拓的玩具模型：一个可在 N 上解析延拓的量子比特模型，以及一个显式构造的 N 的确定性函数，它模拟从高斯系综独立抽取的序列。
classification.one_liner: 提出 Mellin 平均以定义对 N 的渐近平均，探讨虫洞路径积分如何复现系综平均并与随机矩阵谱形式因子比较。

papers.title: On the stability of holographic confinement with magnetic fluxes
papers.abstract: We analyze the stability properties of a simple holographic model for a confining field theory. The gravity dual consists of an Abelian gauge field, with non-trivial magnetic flux, coupled to six-dimensional gravity with a negative cosmological constant. We construct a one-parameter family of regular solitonic solutions, where the gauge field carries flux along a compact circle that smoothly shrinks. The free energy of these solitonic backgrounds is compared to that of domain-wall solutions. This reveals a zero-temperature first-order phase transition in the dual field theory, separating confining and conformal phases. We compute the spectrum of bound states by analysing field fluctuations in the gravity background, after dimensional reduction on the circle. A tachyonic instability emerges near a turning point in the free energy. The phase transition prevents the realisation of this instability. Near the phase transition and beyond, in metastable and unstable regions, we find evidence that the lightest scalar may be interpreted as an approximate dilaton.

classification.title_zh: 论带磁通的全息禁闭的稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析一个简单全息禁闭场论模型的稳定性。其引力对偶由带非平凡磁通的阿贝尔规范场与具有负宇宙学常数的六维引力耦合构成。我们构造了一族正则孤子解，其中规范场沿一个光滑收缩的紧致圆携带磁通。将这些孤子背景的自由能与畴壁解比较，揭示出对偶场论中存在零温一阶相变，分隔禁闭相与共形相。在紧致圆上做维度约化后，通过分析引力背景中的场涨落，我们计算束缚态谱。在自由能的转折点附近出现快子不稳定性。该相变阻止了这种不稳定性的实现。在相变附近以及越过相变进入亚稳和不稳定区域时，我们找到证据表明最轻标量可解释为近似伸缩子。

papers.title: Gravitational radiation from a particle in circular orbit around a wormhole: the nonrotating case
papers.abstract: In this paper, we have generalized Poisson's(1993) calculation for the case of gravitational radiation from a particle in a circular orbit around a black hole to the case of the wormhole. Considering the motion of a test particle around a Schwarzschild like wormhole and using Teukolsky formalism, we have obtained an analytical result of flux at infinity under the assumption of small velocities. Focusing on the 22-mode, we have found a novel 0.5PN order term beyond the quadrupole order, which vanishes in the black hole limit. On the other hand, all higher order terms are getting modified in such a way that they give correct correspondence in the black hole limit. We have further corroborated our results with the numerical investigations, which show that the two waveforms match well when the particle lies far from ISCO. Thus, our work provides one of the first attempts toward the study of the post-Newtonian waveforms involving wormholes (ECOs).

classification.title_zh: 绕虫洞圆轨道粒子的引力辐射：非旋转情形
classification.abstract_zh: 本文将 Poisson（1993）关于黑洞周围粒子圆轨道引力辐射的计算推广到虫洞情形。考虑测试粒子绕类 Schwarzschild 虫洞运动，并在小速度近似下利用 Teukolsky 形式得到无穷远处通量的解析结果。聚焦 22 模，发现在四极阶之外出现一个新颖的 0.5PN 阶项，该项在黑洞极限下消失；同时所有更高阶项均被修正，并在黑洞极限下给出正确对应。数值研究进一步证实，当粒子远离 ISCO 时两种波形吻合良好。因此，本工作是对涉及虫洞（ECO）的后牛顿波形研究的首批尝试之一。
