papers.title: Thin-shell wormholes from magnetic black holes in exponential electrodynamics
papers.abstract: Transparent magnetic wormholes can share a black hole exterior while their supporting matter controls the response of the throat. We construct symmetric thin shells from the magnetic black hole of exponential nonlinear electrodynamics and derive their equilibrium stresses and linear radial stability criterion. Restricting the seed to its zero-bare-mass magnetic branch ties the charge and coupling along the fixed-mass family. In the sampled configurations, calibrated linear barotropic shells are unstable, whereas variable phantom and variable Chaplygin laws admit locally stable radial sectors. Explicit radius dependence strengthens the phantom restoring term; the Chaplygin response cancels the divergent inverse lapse contribution and permits stable sectors close to a non-extremal seed horizon. The surface density remains negative, although an inner interval satisfies the tangential null and intrinsic strong energy conditions. At the seed photon sphere, the two variable laws share an exact stabilization threshold. The complete radial averaged null energy remains negative even when the proper shell energy tends to zero. Numerical null geodesic imaging uses independent, minimally coupled light and transparent junctions, with celestial sources and rotating thin disks truncated at the ISCO. For observer-side disk emission with the prescribed ISCO truncation and a throat below the seed photon sphere, inclined images coincide with the seed black hole image. A throat above that sphere removes selected returning contributions while preserving much of the bright primary structure. Illuminating the opposite exterior adds inner disk arcs, but a central dark region can survive because the disk does not illuminate every transmitted direction. The resulting image degeneracy depends jointly on the retained null trajectories and the emitting support, rather than on the presence of a horizon alone.

classification.title_zh: 指数电动力学中磁黑洞产生的薄壳虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: 本文从指数非线性电动力学的磁黑洞出发构造对称薄壳虫洞，推导平衡应力与径向线性稳定性判据。将种子限制在零裸质量磁分支上，使电荷与耦合沿固定质量族关联。在所采样构型中，标定线性正压壳不稳定，而变幻影和变Chaplygin物态方程允许局部稳定的径向扇区；显式半径依赖增强幻影恢复项，Chaplygin响应抵消发散的逆 lapse 贡献，并允许在非极端种子视界附近存在稳定扇区。表面密度保持为负，尽管内部区间满足切向零能量条件和内禀强能量条件。在种子光子球处，两种变物态律共享精确稳定阈值。即使固有壳能量趋于零，完整径向平均零能量仍为负。数值零测地线成像采用独立、最小耦合的光和透明连接，并使用截断于ISCO的天体源与旋转薄盘。对于观察者侧盘发射、给定ISCO截断且喉部低于种子光子球的情形，倾斜图像与种子黑洞图像重合；喉部高于该光子球会移除部分返回贡献，但保留大部分明亮主结构。照亮对侧外部会增加内盘弧，但中心暗区仍可存在，因为盘并不照亮所有透射方向。由此得到的图像简并共同取决于保留的零测地线和发射支撑，而不只取决于视界是否存在。

papers.title: New interpretation of the Minkowski limit of $R^2$ gravity
papers.abstract: It is well-established that the Minkowski limit of pure $f(R)=R^2$ gravity breaks down, unlike that of full Starobinsky theory $f(R)=R+\alpha R^2$. We provide a novel interpretation of this phenomenon using the recent thermal analogy between scalar-tensor gravity and Eckart's relativistic dissipative fluids. In this framework, we show that approaching the Minkowski background corresponds to a diverging effective ``gravitational temperature'' along certain non-stationary FLRW trajectories, while the gravitational temperature remains identically zero along the exact de Sitter family. This perspective naturally rephrases the strong coupling problem as a thermal singularity, demonstrating that $R^2$ gravity departs infinitely far from General Relativity rather than recovering it.

classification.title_zh: R^2 引力 Minkowski 极限的新解释
classification.abstract_zh: 众所周知，纯 f(R)=R^2 引力的 Minkowski 极限会破缺，而完整 Starobinsky 理论 f(R)=R+αR^2 的 Minkowski 极限不会破缺。我们利用标量-张量引力与 Eckart 相对论耗散流体之间最近的热类比，对这种现象给出新的解释。在此框架中，我们表明趋近 Minkowski 背景对应于沿某些非定常 FLRW 轨迹上有效“引力温度”的发散，而在精确的 de Sitter 族中引力温度恒为零。这一视角自然地将强耦合问题重述为热奇点，表明 R^2 引力无限远离广义相对论，而不是恢复广义相对论。

papers.title: Radial Oscillations of Viscous Stars at Finite Temperature
papers.abstract: We study the radial oscillation spectrum of relativistic stars within Israel-Stewart and Navier-Stokes theories, extending previous analyses to include heat diffusion and a thermodynamically consistent finite-temperature equation of state. The inclusion of heat flux gives rise to a distinct thermal sector in the mode spectrum, whose structure closely mirrors the dispersion relations of an infinite dissipative fluid. Within Israel-Stewart theory, the thermal modes transition from purely damped to propagating behavior above a critical overtone number, providing a finite-size realization of relativistic second sound in compact stars. Remarkably, the finite stellar geometry can push even the fundamental thermal mode into the propagating regime -- a feature with no continuum analogue. For the class of equations of state considered here, where finite-temperature corrections enter as controlled, Sommerfeld-type perturbations of a cold polytrope, the thermal sector couples only weakly to the ordinary fluid oscillation spectrum, with the coupling being of second order in a suitable temperature parameter. We further show that the discrete stellar spectrum is well captured by an analytic ansatz constructed from the flat-spacetime dispersion relations, with the star's finite radius discretizing the continuous mode structure. Our results complete the analysis of radial oscillations of viscous stars by incorporating the last remaining dissipative degree of freedom within the Israel-Stewart framework.

classification.title_zh: 有限温度下粘性恒星的径向振荡
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在 Israel-Stewart 与 Navier-Stokes 理论框架内研究相对论恒星的径向振荡谱，并将分析扩展到包含热扩散以及热力学一致的有限温度状态方程。热流引入一个独特的热模式部门，其结构与无限耗散流体的色散关系密切相关。在 Israel-Stewart 理论中，热模式在超过临界泛音数后由纯阻尼转变为传播行为，从而在致密星中给出相对论第二声的有限尺度实现；并且有限恒星几何甚至可将基本热模式推入传播区，这是连续谱中没有的对应现象。对于本文考虑的状态方程类，有限温度修正表现为冷 polytrope 的受控 Sommerfeld 型扰动，热部门与普通流体振荡谱仅弱耦合，耦合在适当温度参数中为二阶。作者进一步表明，离散恒星谱可由基于平直时空色散关系构造的解析 ansatz 很好地描述，而恒星的有限半径使连续模式结构离散化。该结果补全了 Israel-Stewart 框架内粘性恒星径向振荡分析中最后一个耗散自由度。
classification.one_liner: 研究有限温度粘性相对论恒星径向振荡谱中热扩散与 Israel-Stewart 热模式的行为。

papers.title: Red/Blue shifts of photons in a Hayward black hole immersed in perfect fluid dark matter
papers.abstract: We investigate the red/blue shifts of photons emitted by particles moving along stable circular orbits around a Hayward black hole immersed in perfect fluid dark matter (PFDM). The PFDM contribution modifies the horizon structure and the characteristic radii associated with circular motion, such as the photon-sphere radius and the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). While massive particles follow geodesics of the background spacetime, photon propagation is described by an effective optical metric arising from nonlinear electrodynamics (NLED), which we use to determine the photon sphere and the critical impact parameter. The corresponding redshift and blueshift are sensitive to both the magnitude and sign of the PFDM parameter, providing potentially observable signatures of the surrounding dark matter distribution. Finally, we analyze the black hole shadow and compare its size with observational constraints from Sgr A*. Our results show that positive values of the PFDM parameter decrease the shadow radius, whereas negative values generally lead to larger shadows. The comparison with the observational bounds indicates that only certain negative ranges of the PFDM parameter are consistent with the data, suggesting that black hole shadow measurements can constrain the surrounding dark matter distribution.

classification.title_zh: Hayward黑洞浸没于完美流体暗物质中的光子红移/蓝移
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究沿Hayward黑洞（浸没于完美流体暗物质PFDM中）稳定圆轨道运动的粒子所发射光子的红移/蓝移。PFDM项改变视界结构以及光子球半径、ISCO等圆轨道特征半径。大质量粒子沿背景时空测地线运动，而光子传播由非线性电动力学（NLED）产生的有效光学度规描述，并据此确定光子球和临界碰撞参数。相应的红移和蓝移对PFDM参数的大小和符号敏感，可能成为周围暗物质分布的观测特征。最后分析黑洞阴影，并与Sgr A*观测约束比较：PFDM参数为正值使阴影半径减小，负值通常使阴影变大；只有某些负参数范围与观测数据一致，表明黑洞阴影测量可约束周围暗物质分布。
classification.one_liner: 研究PFDM中Hayward黑洞的光子红/蓝移、光子球与阴影，并给出Sgr A*对PFDM参数的约束。

papers.title: How much dark matter really matters?
papers.abstract: Strong gravitational lensing is a key probe to trace dark matter. It assumes that mass curves spacetime so that light from a background source is deflected on its way to the observer. If dark matter contributes the major part to a massive cosmic structure, reconstructing the latter from strong-lensing observables allows us to infer characteristics of dark matter. Standard reconstructions fit a pre-defined mass-density model to the data. In this essay, I show how these mass models over-estimate the dark-matter contents of light-deflecting masses. Eliminating these models from the reconstruction reveals that observations directly constrain local properties of light-deflecting masses. How much dark matter is really needed in strong-gravitational-lensing effects and how much do we make up by our model choices?

classification.title_zh: 暗物质究竟有多重要？
classification.abstract_zh: 强引力透镜是追踪暗物质的关键探针。它假设质量弯曲时空，使背景源发出的光在到达观察者途中发生偏折。如果暗物质对巨大宇宙结构贡献主要部分，那么从强透镜可观测量重建该结构便可推断暗物质特征。标准重建将预定义的质量密度模型拟合到数据。在这篇短文中，我展示这些质量模型如何高估偏折光的质量中的暗物质含量。从重建中消除这些模型表明，观测直接约束偏折光质量的局域性质。强引力透镜效应中究竟需要多少暗物质，以及有多少是我们通过模型选择补上的？
classification.one_liner: 指出强透镜质量重建模型会高估暗物质含量，主张无模型重建直接约束透镜质量的局域性质。

papers.title: Classical tests of New General Relativity
papers.abstract: In New General Relativity (NGR), the static spherically symmetric vacuum solution is characterized by two parameters, unlike General Relativity (GR), where the Schwarzschild solution has only one parameter. In this work, using the five classical tests of relativistic gravity (perihelion precession, light bending, Shapiro time delay and de Sitter geodetic precession effect, as well as gravitational redshift), a more stringent constraint on the value of the second parameter was derived compared to the original work [1].

classification.title_zh: 新广义相对论的经典检验
classification.abstract_zh: 在新广义相对论（NGR）中，静态球对称真空解由两个参数刻画，而广义相对论（GR）中 Schwarzschild 解只有一个参数。本工作利用相对论引力的五项经典检验（近日点进动、光线偏折、Shapiro 时间延迟与 de Sitter 测地进动效应，以及引力红移），相较于原始工作[1]得到了对第二个参数取值的更严格限制。
classification.one_liner: 利用五项经典引力检验对 New General Relativity 的第二个静态球对称真空解参数给出更严格限制。

papers.title: Long before plunge: Uncovering intermediate-mass black holes through their inspiralling compact object companions with LISA
papers.abstract: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will provide novel capability to discover and study intermediate-mass (~$10^2-10^5 M_\odot$) black holes at the centres of dwarf galaxies and in dense stellar environments. We systematically map out the LISA-detectable parameter space of binaries consisting of a low-mass compact object spiralling into an intermediate-mass black hole (mass ratio ~$10^{-5} - 10^{-2}$) on equatorial orbits with generic eccentricity. The depth of the LISA survey reaches a redshift ~$5$ ($0.1$) for binaries with a primary black hole mass $m_1$ ~$10^4 M_\odot$ ($10^3 M_\odot$). If the orbital companion is a white dwarf, which could be disrupted prior to plunge, LISA's survey depth is well matched to (and, in many cases, exceeds) the one of electro-magnetic surveys. Although the maximum distance at which a source can be detected depends weakly on the orbital eccentricity, the latter strongly affects the portion of the binary inspiral over which a source is detectable. The instrument's sensitivity time-volume varies by many orders of magnitude depending on the binary's component masses: it reaches ~$1 - 10^3 Gpc^3 yr$ (~$10^{-2} - 10^3 Gpc^3 yr$) for the more massive systems with $m_1 = 10^5 M_\odot$ ($10^4 M_\odot$) and decreases to ~$10^{-4} - 1 Gpc^3 yr$ for lighter primary black holes with $m_1 = 10^3 M_\odot$. Importantly, from tens of percent to the overwhelming majority of the total sensitivity time-volume (and therefore number of potential detections) comes from sources that do not plunge during the yr-long mission lifetime and are observed at an earlier stage of their inspiral. Despite the poorly known merger rates of this class of sources, our results show that LISA could identify from a handful to ~$10^3$ intermediate-mass black holes providing a new observational avenue for studying these elusive objects and the environments in which they reside.

classification.title_zh: plunge 之前很久：用旋近的致密天体伴星通过 LISA 揭示中等质量黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: LISA 将具备发现和研究矮星系中心及致密恒星环境中中等质量黑洞（约 10^2–10^5 倍太阳质量）的新能力。我们系统绘制了由低质量致密天体沿赤道轨道、具有一般偏心率旋近进入中等质量黑洞（质量比约 10^-5–10^-2）的双星系统的 LISA 可探测参数空间。对于主黑洞质量 m1 约 10^4 倍太阳质量（10^3 倍太阳质量）的系统，LISA 巡天深度可达红移约 5（0.1）。若伴星是白矮星（可能在 plunge 前被潮汐瓦解），LISA 的巡天深度与电磁巡天相当，且在许多情况下超过后者。最大可探测距离对轨道偏心率依赖较弱，但偏心率强烈影响双星旋近过程中可被探测的部分。仪器的灵敏度时间体积随双星组分质量变化许多数量级：对于 m1=10^5 倍太阳质量（10^4 倍太阳质量）的较高质量系统，达到约 1–10^3 Gpc^3 yr（约 10^-2–10^3 Gpc^3 yr）；对于 m1=10^3 倍太阳质量的较轻主黑洞，降至约 10^-4–1 Gpc^3 yr。重要的是，总灵敏度时间体积（因而潜在探测数）的数十个百分点至绝大多数来自那些在一年任务期内并未发生 plunge、而是在旋近较早阶段被观测到的源。尽管这类源的并合率未知，结果表明 LISA 可识别数个至约 10^3 个中等质量黑洞，为研究这些难以捕捉的天体及其所处环境提供新的观测途径。
classification.one_liner: 系统评估 LISA 对中等质量黑洞—小质量致密天体旋近双星的探测能力，并指出 plunge 前的旋近阶段贡献了主要探测体积。

papers.title: Reabsorbed Urca neutrinos suppress bulk-viscous damping of neutron star merger oscillations
papers.abstract: Reabsorption of Urca neutrinos suppresses the bulk-viscous damping predicted for neutron star merger oscillations. Below the direct-Urca threshold the capture neutrinos have mean energies of 19-46 MeV and are absorbed within metres. An energy-resolved kinetic treatment gives 2.7 s for a 1-kHz, 10-km oscillation at nuclear density and 4 MeV, against 19 ms for freely escaping neutrinos. It holds across the sampled states, three equations of state and the rate variations, with nearly frozen composition. This absorption is present in full-kinematics rates and absent from elastic opacity tables.

classification.title_zh: 重吸收的Urca中微子抑制中子星并合振荡的体粘滞阻尼
classification.abstract_zh: Urca中微子的重吸收会抑制中子星并合振荡中预测的体粘滞阻尼。在直接Urca阈值以下，俘获中微子平均能量为19-46 MeV，并在米级距离内被吸收。能量分辨的动理学处理给出：在核密度和4 MeV条件下，1 kHz、10 km振荡的阻尼时间为2.7 s，而自由逃逸中微子情形为19 ms。该结果在采样状态、三种物态方程和速率变化下均成立，且成分几乎冻结。这种吸收存在于完整运动学速率中，而不在弹性不透明度表中。
classification.one_liner: Urca中微子重吸收显著抑制中子星并合振荡的体粘滞阻尼，使阻尼时间远长于自由逃逸中微子估计。

papers.title: What an Observer Reads off a Holographic Screen
papers.abstract: What does an observer read off a holographic screen that is an array of qubits rather than a surface? In the generalized holographic principle the interaction between two separable systems acts on such a screen as a weighted sum, up to an overall prefactor, of commuting observables with values plus and minus one. When the weights are nonnegative and the prefactor is one and the joint eigenspaces are lines, everything a probe reads off the spectrum depends only on the list of weights, which we call the profile. On the screen with equal weights summing to one the running dimension read by a diffusion probe falls short of two at unit time by at most twice the reciprocal of the number of qubits; a geometric profile gives instead, through its level count, a plateau of any positive height. An observer correlates sets of qubits; its readout carries a profile at a given weighting when the levels it reads, counted with multiplicity, are those of a screen with one weight per set. We prove that a readout carries a profile at every weighting exactly when the distinct nonzero traces of its qubits are linearly independent over the field with two elements, the trace of a qubit being the list of sets that contain it; such a readout is a partition of the qubits it covers up to an invertible recoding, and a dependent one carries a profile only on finitely many proper linear subspaces of weightings. Refining a grouping without end builds a tower whose boundary is a profinite set and hence a condensed set, on which a strictly positive compatible profile separates the locally constant functions by a distance. Applications certify probabilistic and strong contextuality and give the leading shortfall of the distance between the poles of the fuzzy sphere; in a model of monogamous entanglement the pairs that weight-one threads representing operational ER=EPR can occupy at once are exactly the partial matchings.

classification.title_zh: 观察者从全息屏上读到什么
classification.abstract_zh: 如果全息屏不是曲面而是量子比特阵列，观察者能从屏上读到什么？在广义全息原理中，两个可分离系统之间的相互作用在全息屏上表现为一组取值正负一的 commuting observables 的加权和（乘以整体前因子）。当权重非负、前因子为一且联合本征空间为一维线时，探针从谱中读到的一切只依赖于权重列表，称为 profile。在权重相等且总和为一的屏上，扩散探针在单位时间读到的 running dimension 比二维最多小两倍量子比特数的倒数；几何 profile 则通过其能级计数给出任意正高度的平台。观察者关联量子比特集合；若其读到的按重数计数的能级等同于每个集合一个权重的屏的能级，则该读出在给定权重下携带一个 profile。我们证明：读出在所有权重下都携带 profile 当且仅当其量子比特的不同非零 trace 在二元域上线性无关；量子比特的 trace 是包含它的集合列表。这样的读出在可逆重编码意义下是其覆盖量子比特的一个划分；而依赖的读出只在权重的有限多个真线性子空间上携带 profile。不断细化分组会构造一座塔，其边界是 profinite set，从而是 condensed set；在其上严格正的可相容 profile 通过一个距离分离局部常函数。应用包括证明概率语境性和强语境性，并给出模糊球两极间距离的首阶亏损；在单配纠缠模型中，表示 operational ER=EPR 的 weight-one threads 可同时占据的配对恰好是部分匹配。
classification.one_liner: 将全息屏建模为量子比特阵列，刻画观察者读出的权重剖面及其在语境性、模糊球与 ER=EPR 模型中的应用。

papers.title: Self-bound quantum dark fermion stars: saturation, a coupling-capped maximum mass, and tidal signatures of a vector dark sector
papers.abstract: I show that a dark sector whose fermions couple to both a scalar and a vector mediator saturates in close analogy with nuclear matter: the energy per particle develops a minimum at finite density, cold dark matter of this kind is self-bound, and its stars, computed here in full general relativity, possess the sharp surfaces of strange quark stars. Saturation makes the maximum stellar mass a property of the Lagrangian rather than an inheritance of the Chandrasekhar scaling: it rises eightfold across the saturation window, which a critical vector coupling closes, so the theory caps its own maximum mass, at $3.9\,M_\odot$ for a fermion of $1\,\mathrm{GeV}$ and the fiducial saturation density, a ceiling shared by the whole family of couplings rather than by any single parameter set. Metastable couplings support two disconnected stable families, one dilute and gravitationally bound, the other dense and self-bound. The quantum-pressure correction, confined by saturation to a surface layer a few Compton wavelengths thick, governs the smallest dark nuggets whilst shifting stellar masses by less than one part in $10^{21}$. A $1.4\,M_\odot$ member of the fiducial family has a radius of $13.3\,\mathrm{km}$, a compactness of $0.155$, and a tidal deformability of $1.6\times 10^{3}$, almost an order of magnitude above the measured neutron-star value, so at a given particle mass and couplings a single well-measured inspiral distinguishes these stars from neutron stars and from their scalar-only counterparts, whilst the deformability surviving at the maximum mass separates them, in principle, from black holes.

classification.title_zh: 自束缚量子暗费米子星：饱和、耦合封顶的最大质量与矢量暗扇区的潮汐特征
classification.abstract_zh: 本文表明，费米子同时耦合到标量和矢量媒介子的暗扇区会以类似核物质的方式达到饱和：每粒子能量在有限密度处出现极小值，这类冷暗物质是自束缚的，并且本文在完整广义相对论下计算得到的星体具有类似奇异夸克星的锐利表面。饱和使最大恒星质量成为拉格朗日量的性质，而不是继承钱德拉塞卡标度：最大质量在饱和窗口内上升八倍，而临界矢量耦合会关闭该窗口，因此理论自身封顶最大质量；对于 1 GeV 费米子和基准饱和密度，该上限为 3.9 倍太阳质量，并且是整个耦合族共享的上限，而非某一组参数独有。亚稳耦合支持两个不连通稳定族：一个稀薄且引力束缚，另一个致密且自束缚。量子压强修正被饱和限制在几个康普顿波长厚的表面层内，支配最小的暗 nugget，但对恒星质量的移动小于 10^21 分之一。基准族中一个 1.4 倍太阳质量的成员半径为 13.3 km、致密度为 0.155、潮汐形变为 1.6×10^3，比测得的中子星值高近一个量级，因此在给定粒子质量和耦合时，一次良测的旋进过程即可将这些星与中子星及其仅标量对应物区分开；而在最大质量处仍存在的潮汐形变原则上可将它们与黑洞区分开。
classification.one_liner: 标量-矢量暗扇区费米子饱和形成自束缚暗星，完整 GR 计算给出耦合封顶最大质量与可区分中子星/黑洞的潮汐形变。

papers.title: Cosmic Corpses: Dead stars as Factories of the most Extreme Objects in the Universe
papers.abstract: The apparent serenity of the night sky conceals a long history of stellar evolution, in which gravity and the properties of matter determine the remarkable fates of stars. In this pedagogical account, we discuss white dwarfs, neutron stars, and black holes, explaining how quantum mechanics, nuclear interactions, and General Relativity govern their formation and distinctive properties. We also highlight the possibility of primordial black holes, which may have formed from rare large density fluctuations in the early Universe, and briefly discuss their potential role as constituents of dark matter.

classification.title_zh: 宇宙残骸：死星作为宇宙中最极端天体的工厂
classification.abstract_zh: 夜空看似宁静，却隐藏着恒星演化的漫长历史；在这一历史中，引力和物质性质决定了恒星的不同命运。这篇教学性综述讨论白矮星、中子星和黑洞，解释量子力学、核相互作用和广义相对论如何支配它们的形成及独特性质。文章还强调原初黑洞的可能性，这类黑洞可能由早期宇宙中罕见的大密度涨落形成，并简要讨论它们作为暗物质组成部分的潜在作用。
classification.one_liner: 一篇关于白矮星、中子星、黑洞及原初黑洞的教学性综述，重点解释量子力学、核物理与广义相对论如何决定致密天体的形成和性质。

papers.title: Quasi-spherical fallback in binary neutron-star mergers: fuel and obstacle for extended emission
papers.abstract: Extended emission (EE) lasting hundreds of seconds has been observed in a fraction of short gamma-ray bursts (sGRB) containing both nonthermal and thermal components, and representing a significant puzzle for models involving binary neutron stars (BNSs). Recent GRMHD simulations of BNS mergers found that the late-time fallback is approximately quasi-spherical and motivated an r-process powered thermal model for EE. However, the available radioactive-heating power may be insufficient to sustain the luminosity inferred by such a model. We therefore propose a fallback-fed secondary-jet scenario in which a fraction of the fallback material circularizes on the black-hole equatorial plane and powers the jet, while polar fallback impedes its propagation. Using a semi-analytic toy model, we follow the propagation of the jet-head through the fallback envelope and identify jet-dominated, cocoon-dominated, and choked scenarios. The boundaries of these regimes depend primarily on the circularization fraction $f_{\rm circ}$, on the jet half-opening angle $\theta_j$, and on the polar refilling factor $\xi_{\rm pol}$, with the approximate scaling $\widetilde{L}\propto f_{\rm circ}/(\xi_{\rm pol}\theta_j^2)$. By post-processing data from BNS-merger simulations we find that the fraction of bound fallback material that avoids prompt capture is $f_{\rm npc}\simeq0.52$, thus providing an upper bound on the circularizable fallback supply. Under suitable prescriptions for nonthermal jet emission and thermal emission from the jet head, the estimated isotropic-equivalent $0.3$--$10$ keV energies reproduce well both the observed EE distribution for the jet-dominated branch and its low-energy end for the cocoon-dominated branch. Overall, these results suggest that fallback-fed secondary jets represent a dynamically feasible and energetically consistent explanation of the EE in sGRBs.

classification.title_zh: 双中子星并合中的准球形回落：延展辐射的燃料与障碍
classification.abstract_zh: 短伽马暴中的延展辐射（EE）持续数百秒，并同时具有非热与热成分，对双中子星并合模型构成挑战。近期双中子星并合 GRMHD 模拟发现晚期回落近似准球形，这启发了 r 过程供能的热辐射模型，但可用放射性加热功率可能不足以维持观测光度。本文提出回落供给的次级喷流场景：部分回落物质在黑洞赤道面圆化并供能喷流，而极向回落阻碍喷流传播。作者用半解析玩具模型追踪喷流头穿过回落包层，识别出喷流主导、茧主导和窒息三种情形；其边界主要依赖圆化分数 f_circ、喷流半张角 θ_j 和极向再填充因子 ξ_pol，并给出近似标度 L~ ∝ f_circ/(ξ_pol θ_j^2)。后处理双中子星并合模拟数据得到避免即时俘获的束缚回落物质比例 f_npc≈0.52，从而给出可圆化回落供给的上限。在适当的非热喷流辐射与喷流头热辐射 prescription 下，估计的 0.3–10 keV 各向同性等效能量能较好复现喷流主导分支的 EE 分布及其茧主导分支的低能端。结果表明，回落供给的次级喷流是短伽马暴延展辐射在动力学上可行且能量上自洽的解释。
classification.one_liner: 提出回落物质供给的次级喷流场景，用半解析模型解释短伽马暴延展辐射，并给出喷流主导、茧主导与窒息情形的判据。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为中子星并合与短伽马暴喷流的经典天体物理建模，不涉及全息对偶；仅与经典引力/黑洞天体物理支线弱相关。

papers.title: Mapping of Spacetimes with Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Gauge freedom in numerical relativity complicates the interpretation of simulation coordinates and the comparison of different descriptions of the same spacetime. We present a data-driven neural network method for learning coordinate maps from numerical metric data to a prescribed target gauge. The network is trained by matching the transformed source metric to the target metric, without assuming a functional form for the coordinate transformation. We first validate the method on analytical Schwarzschild and Kerr geometries, recovering known transformations up to the isometries of the target spacetime. We then apply it to numerical black hole evolutions in moving-puncture coordinates. For a non-spinning black hole, the learned map relates the time-dependent numerical metric to a stationary Schwarzschild metric in ingoing Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates. For a spinning puncture, the method provides an approximate identification with a Kerr background despite departures from Kerr in the numerical spacetime. We use this identification to construct curvature perturbations and evolve them with the Teukolsky equation, obtaining waveforms that closely match those extracted from the full nonlinear simulation. These results demonstrate that learned coordinate maps can relate numerical spacetimes to analytical backgrounds, with potential applications to cross-code validation and black hole perturbation theory.

classification.title_zh: 用神经网络映射时空
classification.abstract_zh: 数值相对论中的规范自由度使模拟坐标的解释以及同一时空不同描述之间的比较变得复杂。我们提出一种数据驱动的神经网络方法，从数值度规数据学习坐标映射到指定目标规范。通过将变换后的源度规与目标度规匹配来训练网络，而不假设坐标变换的函数形式。我们首先在解析 Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 几何上验证该方法，恢复已知变换至目标时空的等距变换。然后将其应用于移动穿刺坐标下的数值黑洞演化。对于非旋转黑洞，学习到的映射将随时间变化的数值度规联系到入射 Eddington-Finkelstein 坐标下的静态 Schwarzschild 度规。对于旋转穿刺，尽管数值时空偏离 Kerr，该方法提供了与 Kerr 背景的近似识别。我们利用这一识别构造曲率扰动并用 Teukolsky 方程演化，得到与从完整非线性模拟提取的波形密切匹配的波形。这些结果表明，学习到的坐标映射可以将数值时空与解析背景联系起来，并有望应用于跨代码验证和黑洞微扰理论。
classification.one_liner: 提出神经网络学习数值相对论坐标映射到目标规范，并在 Schwarzschild/Kerr 黑洞模拟中用于匹配解析背景和 Teukolsky 波形。

papers.title: Numerical-Relativity Particle-in-Cell Simulations: Self-Gravitating Collisionless Matter in Dynamical Spacetimes
papers.abstract: Gravitational collapse and instability, black-hole dynamics in systems with large scale separations, and questions surrounding extremal black hole formation require full nonlinear studies using accurate and adapted numerical tools. To this end, we present a new algorithm to study collisionless relativistic systems using a fully kinetic description of matter coupled to the evolving spacetime. In detail, we present a numerical-relativity particle-in-cell (NRPIC) framework for solving the Einstein--Vlasov system in three spatial dimensions. Implemented on top of the performance-portable \texttt{AthenaK} code, the method couples particle dynamics to Z4c spacetime evolution in moving puncture gauge through conservative stress-energy deposition on adaptively refined meshes. Our implementation makes use of advances in the computational modeling of relativistic plasmas using modern PIC models, now made available to general-relativistic gravity via an equivalent electrodynamic formulation. We introduce a Boris-type particle pusher that exploits the electrodynamic (Lorentz force) form of the geodesic force. We validate the coupled evolution against spherical dust collapse, follow prolate collapse through collisionless caustics into black-hole formation, and investigate the stability and nonlinear migration of relativistic clusters. Highlighting its potential to study gravitational instability in NR, we simulate the collapse of two overdensities within a common collisionless envelope, following black-hole formation, binary inspiral and merger, and subsequent mass accretion onto the remnant.

classification.title_zh: 数值相对论粒子网格模拟：动态时空中的自引力无碰撞物质
classification.abstract_zh: 引力坍缩与不稳定性、大尺度分离系统中的黑洞动力学以及极端黑洞形成等问题，需要精确且适配的数值工具进行完全非线性研究。为此，我们提出一种新算法，采用完全动理学描述与演化时空耦合来研究无碰撞相对论系统。具体而言，我们提出了一个在三个空间维度上求解 Einstein–Vlasov 系统的数值相对论粒子网格（NRPIC）框架。该方法实现在性能可移植的 AthenaK 代码之上，通过自适应细化网格上的守恒应力-能量沉积，将粒子动力学与移动 puncture 规范下的 Z4c 时空演化耦合。我们的实现利用了现代 PIC 模型在相对论等离子体计算建模方面的进展，并通过等价的电动力学表述将其引入广义相对论引力。我们引入一种 Boris 型粒子推进器，利用测地力的电动力学（洛伦兹力）形式。我们针对球对称尘埃坍缩验证耦合演化，追踪长椭球坍缩经过无碰撞焦散进入黑洞形成的过程，并研究相对论团簇的稳定性与非线性迁移。为突出其在数值相对论中研究引力不稳定性的潜力，我们模拟了共同无碰撞包层内两个过密区的坍缩，跟踪黑洞形成、双星旋进与并合以及随后向残余黑洞的质量吸积。
classification.one_liner: 提出并验证三维数值相对论-粒子网格框架，用于求解动态时空中的 Einstein–Vlasov 系统并模拟无碰撞引力坍缩、黑洞形成和双黑洞并合。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论与数值相对论，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；涉及黑洞形成、双星并合和非线性演化，但不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Next-to-next-to-leading gravitational radiation-reaction corrections to quasi-elliptic and quasi-hyperbolic compact binary orbits
papers.abstract: We apply the Lagrange method of variation of constants to compute the radiation-reaction (RR) corrections to the quasi-elliptic and quasi-hyperbolic motion of compact binary systems at 4.5PN order, i.e., at next-to-next-to-leading order in the RR. We rely on the recent determination of the 4.5PN RR acceleration, in a general frame and in the center-of-mass frame, in harmonic coordinates. The non-local effects, due to the tails at 4PN order and to the gravitational-wave recoil at 4.5PN order, are carefully evaluated. Although the calculation is implemented differently in the quasi-elliptic and quasi-hyperbolic cases (different perturbation equations and choices of orbital parameters), we verify by analytic continuation that the results for the local effects are equivalent in the two cases.

classification.title_zh: 致密双星准椭圆与准双曲轨道的次次领头阶引力辐射反作用修正
classification.abstract_zh: 我们采用拉格朗日变常量法，计算致密双星系统准椭圆和准双曲运动在4.5PN阶的辐射反作用修正，即辐射反作用的次次领头阶。我们基于最近在谐和坐标下、一般参考系和质心系中确定的4.5PN辐射反作用加速度。仔细评估了由4PN阶尾项和4.5PN阶引力波反冲引起的非局域效应。尽管准椭圆和准双曲情形的计算实现方式不同（扰动方程和轨道参数选择不同），我们通过解析延拓验证了两种情形下局域效应的结果是等价的。
classification.one_liner: 计算致密双星准椭圆/准双曲轨道在4.5PN阶的辐射反作用修正，并验证两类轨道局域效应的等价性。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论中的后牛顿双星辐射反作用计算，与全息对偶无直接关系；可作为经典引力支线的参考。

papers.title: Deviations from Kerr: Critical curves and photon-ring critical parameters for general observer inclinations
papers.abstract: We study critical curves and photon-ring critical parameters in stationary, axisymmetric spacetimes with separable null geodesics and Kerr angular structure. A Kerr-relative decomposition of the radial metric functions gives analytic first-order departures of these observables for observers at general inclination. The critical curve's signed normal displacement factorizes as $\tilde u_n=\tilde F_{\mathrm K}\mathscr C$, where $\tilde F_{\mathrm K}$ depends only on the Kerr reference geometry and $\mathscr C$ is an explicit combination of optical metric deviations. The demagnification exponent, time delay, and azimuthal advance are evaluated at a common position angle on the observer screen. Intrinsic relations among the exact observables express the optical information shared by the curve, time delay, and azimuthal advance, while demagnification additionally depends on radial instability. Applications to representative metrics illustrate how different radial deformations produce distinct departures from Kerr around the critical curve. Comparisons with exact finite-deformation profiles and independent numerical calculations verify the first-order predictions on regular, accessible exterior photon-shell branches.

classification.title_zh: 偏离Kerr：一般观测倾角下的临界曲线与光子环临界参数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有可分离零测地线和Kerr角结构的稳态轴对称时空中的临界曲线和光子环临界参数。通过对径向度规函数作Kerr相对分解，得到观测者在一般倾角下这些可观测量的解析一阶偏离。临界曲线的带符号法向位移因子化为仅依赖Kerr参考几何的因子与光学度规偏差显式组合的乘积。在观测屏上的公共位置角处计算去放大率指数、时间延迟和方位角推进。精确观测量之间的内在关系表达了曲线、时间延迟和方位角推进共享的光学信息，而去放大率额外依赖径向不稳定性。对代表性度规的应用说明不同径向形变如何在临界曲线周围产生不同的Kerr偏离。与精确有限形变剖面和独立数值计算的比较验证了在规则、可及的外部光子壳分支上的一阶预言。
classification.one_liner: 在稳态轴对称时空中解析给出临界曲线和光子环临界参数相对Kerr的一阶偏离，并用代表性度规验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究Kerr时空中黑洞临界曲线和光子环临界参数的解析偏离，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”直接相关。

papers.title: Quasinormal Modes of Black holes in the generalized Schwarzschild-de Sitter solution of $f(R)$ gravity
papers.abstract: We analyze scalar, vector, and {axial} tensor perturbations in a Schwarzschild-type static spherically symmetric solution of modified $f(R)$ gravity. This solution differs from the Schwarzschild metric of general relativity through the presence of a linearly growing term and a logarithmic correction, and it depends on four integration constants. Using the higher-order Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin (WKB) approximation and an analytical method, we calculate the quasinormal modes (QNMs) for all three types of perturbations. Our results show that, for appropriately chosen parameter values, the QNMs closely match those of the Schwarzschild black hole. In particular, the model parameter $A$ produces a nonlinear increase in both the oscillation frequency and damping rate of ringdown gravitational waves. A similar effect arises for the parameter $\eta$ when $A$ is small, while for larger $A$ values the effects are opposite, where the scalar perturbations display a distinct deviation compared to the vector and {axial} tensor cases. Contour plots of QNMs in the parameter space support these findings. Finally, time-domain profiles are obtained to illustrate the dynamical evolution of the gravitational wave signal.

classification.title_zh: f(R)引力中广义Schwarzschild-de Sitter解的黑洞准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析了修正f(R)引力中一类Schwarzschild型静态球对称解的标量、矢量和轴向张量扰动。该解与广义相对论Schwarzschild度规的差异在于含线性增长项和对数修正，并依赖四个积分常数。利用高阶WKB近似和一种解析方法，我们计算了三类扰动的准正规模（QNMs）。结果表明，在适当选取参数时，QNMs与Schwarzschild黑洞的结果十分接近。特别地，模型参数A会使铃宕引力波的振荡频率和阻尼率均呈非线性增加。当A较小时，参数η产生类似效应；而当A较大时效应相反，其中标量扰动相对矢量与轴向张量情形表现出明显偏离。QNMs在参数空间中的等高线图支持这些发现。最后，我们给出时域演化曲线以展示引力波信号的动力学演化。
classification.one_liner: 在f(R)引力广义Schwarzschild-de Sitter黑洞背景中计算标量、矢量与轴向张量扰动的准正规模，并分析参数对铃宕频率和阻尼的影响。

papers.title: Quasinormal modes of a scale-dependent black hole in 5D spacetime with cosmological constant
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of a scale-dependent black hole in five dimensions with a positive cosmological constant, considering i) scalar, ii) electromagnetic, and iii) Dirac perturbations. After deriving exact analytical solutions within the framework of scale-dependent gravity in five dimensions and selecting a different family of solutions (cf. \cite{Contreras:2019fwu}), we analyze the corresponding effective potentials (given by the lapse function) for each perturbation type. We employ a first-order approximation for the lapse function, as it closely matches the exact case for small $\varepsilon$. Since quantum corrections are expected to be small, our focus is on a relatively low range of the scale-dependent parameter $\varepsilon$. We confirm that the WKB semi-analytical approach can be used to compute the QNMs for these perturbations to the background geometry. We calculate the QNM frequencies for the classical case (for comparison) and for cases where the scale-dependent parameter $\varepsilon$, which quantifies deviations from General Relativity, is non-zero. The results are summarized in a series of tables and figures. Finally, we find that, regardless of the perturbation type, the solutions are stable, as the imaginary part of each QNM frequency is negative.

classification.title_zh: 五维含宇宙学常数的尺度依赖黑洞准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究五维正宇宙学常数下尺度依赖黑洞的准正规模，考虑标量、电磁和狄拉克扰动。作者在五维尺度依赖引力框架下导出精确解析解，选取不同于 Contreras:2019fwu 的解族，并分析各类扰动对应的有效势。对小尺度依赖参数 ε 采用 lapse function 一阶近似，使用 WKB 半解析方法计算 QNM 频率，并比较经典情形与非零 ε 偏离广义相对论的情形。结果表明，无论何种扰动类型，QNM 频率虚部均为负，解稳定。
classification.one_liner: 研究五维正宇宙学常数尺度依赖黑洞在标量、电磁和狄拉克扰动下的准正规模，WKB计算显示其稳定。

papers.title: Smooth Rigidity Near Extremal Horizons
papers.abstract: The Einstein equations constrain the transverse Taylor series at a degenerate Killing horizon, but even complete knowledge of that series need not determine a smooth spacetime: a nonzero difference can vanish to every order at the horizon. We show that this ambiguity disappears when the limiting metric on the space of Killing orbits admits a spacelike graph over a compact horizon section. In dimensions $d\geq4$, smooth vacuum Einstein germs with the same marked transverse jets are then locally isometric on a two-sided neighborhood of the whole section. The proof combines a terminal wave-map gauge with energy estimates on the orbit cylinder and yields a finite weighted matching criterion. For unwarped horizons with positive-Einstein sections, a condition on the full Lichnerowicz spectrum reduces the smooth classification to parallel first transverse data. All such data have convergent multiwarped Einstein realizations, including examples whose sections have negative sectional-curvature directions. We also obtain a finite-regularity version for round sections. The continuation argument extends to four-dimensional Einstein--Maxwell theory and gives smooth charged-Nariai rigidity. Finally, rotating Nariai data admit the required spacelike graph throughout the regular branch; an all-order tensor estimate yields smooth Kerr--de Sitter or rotating-Nariai rigidity for $a^2/r_0^2\leq1/8$, without assuming ambient axial symmetry.

classification.title_zh: 近极端视界附近的平滑刚性
classification.abstract_zh: Einstein 方程会约束退化 Killing 视界处的横向 Taylor 级数，但仅知道该级数未必能确定光滑时空：非零差异可以在视界处到任意阶消失。本文证明，当 Killing 轨道空间上的极限度规可在紧致视界截面上表示为类空图时，这种模糊性消失。在 d≥4 维中，具有相同标记横向喷流的光滑真空 Einstein 胚于是在整个截面两侧邻域内局部等距。证明结合终端波映射规范与轨道柱上的能量估计，并给出有限加权匹配判据。对于具有正 Einstein 截面的非翘曲视界，完整 Lichnerowicz 谱上的条件把光滑分类约化为平行的一阶横向数据；所有这些数据都有收敛的多翘曲 Einstein 实现，包括截面具有负截面曲率方向的例子。作者还得到圆截面的有限正则性版本。延续论证可推广到四维 Einstein--Maxwell 理论，并给出光滑带电 Nariai 刚性。最后，旋转 Nariai 数据在正则分支上满足所需类空图条件；全阶张量估计给出当 a^2/r_0^2≤1/8 时光滑 Kerr--de Sitter 或旋转 Nariai 刚性，且不假设环境轴对称性。
classification.one_liner: 证明在轨道空间极限度规可表为紧致视界截面上类空图时，具有相同横向喷流的光滑真空 Einstein 胚在视界两侧局部等距，并给出 Nariai/Kerr--de Sitter 等刚性结果。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典广义相对论中的极端视界刚性、Einstein 方程与 Nariai/Kerr--de Sitter 时空，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Pushing the accuracy of the quasi-circular baseline for the SEOBNR family of models
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave observations have opened a new era of astronomy, with accurate modeling of binary black hole signals becoming increasingly important for source characterization and astrophysical inference as detector sensitivities improve. We present SEOBNRv5iHM, an updated quasi-circular, aligned-spin inspiral-merger-ringdown gravitational-waveform model with higher-order modes, constructed within the effective-one-body formalism and building upon SEOBNRv5HM. The improvements mainly concern the late inspiral and the merger-ringdown: we remove the non-quasi-circular corrections used in previous models and instead introduce a phenomenological intermediate region between the inspiral and the ringdown, which allows the ringdown attachment time to be chosen independently for each mode, including at the peak of the mode's amplitude. The model is calibrated and validated against 591 quasi-circular aligned-spin waveforms from the third Simulating eXtreme Spacetimes catalog. For the $(2,2)$ mode, when considering the maximum unfaithfulness against numerical relativity over a total mass range of 10-300$M_\odot$, SEOBNRv5iHM achieves a median of $4.25\times10^{-5}$, a factor of 4.5 below SEOBNRv5HM, and a factor of 3-8 below other semi-analytical models, with $84\%$ of cases below $10^{-4}$. For $M\ge150 M_\odot$, the median drops to $9.7\times10^{-6}$, comparable to the numerical-relativity surrogate NRHybSur3dq8. For polarization mismatches at inclination $\pi/3$, with modes up to $\ell_\mathrm{max} = 5$, the median maximum unfaithfulness is $4.2\times10^{-4}$, a factor of 2.6 below SEOBNRv5HM, 1.9 below IMRPhenomTHM, and 6-11 below the other semi-analytical models. Since spin-precessing and eccentric models are built on top of the quasi-circular, aligned-spin baseline, these improvements will make future SEOBNR models more accurate, reducing waveform systematics in upcoming analyses.

classification.title_zh: 提升SEOBNR模型族准圆基线精度的研究
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波观测开启了天文学的新时代；随着探测器灵敏度提高，双黑洞信号的精确建模对源参数刻画和天体物理推断愈发重要。本文提出SEOBNRv5iHM，这是基于有效单体形式、在SEOBNRv5HM基础上构建的更新版准圆、对齐自旋、包含高阶模式的旋近-并合-铃宕引力波波形模型。改进主要涉及旋近晚期和并合-铃宕阶段：移除了先前模型中的非准圆修正，并在旋近与铃宕之间引入现象学中间区域，使每个模式的铃宕衔接时间可独立选择，包括选在该模式振幅峰值处。该模型利用第三版Simulating eXtreme Spacetimes目录中的591个准圆对齐自旋波形进行校准和验证。对于(2,2)模式，在总质量10-300M⊙范围内相对数值相对论的最大非保真度中位数达到4.25×10^-5，比SEOBNRv5HM低4.5倍，比其他半解析模型低3-8倍，84%的情形低于10^-4。对于M≥150M⊙，中位数降至9.7×10^-6，与数值相对论代理模型NRHybSur3dq8相当。对于倾角π/3、模式至ℓmax=5的极化失配，最大非保真度中位数为4.2×10^-4，比SEOBNRv5HM低2.6倍，比IMRPhenomTHM低1.9倍，比其他半解析模型低6-11倍。由于进动自旋和偏心模型建立在该准圆对齐自旋基线之上，这些改进将使未来SEOBNR模型更精确，并减少 upcoming 分析中的波形系统误差。
classification.one_liner: 该文发布并验证了更精确的SEOBNRv5iHM准圆对齐自旋双黑洞引力波波形模型，显著降低了相对数值相对论的失配。

papers.title: Exceptional Points in Scalar Quasinormal Modes of Rastall String-Fluid Black Holes
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study exceptional points (EPs) in scalar quasinormal modes(QNMs) of Rastall string-fluid black holes by adding a localized P\"oschl--Teller perturbation to the scalar potential, with the bump position $a$ and amplitude $\eb$ serving as independent controls. We solve the hyperboloidal problem with two-domain Chebyshev collocation and arbitrary-precision linear algebra, and use the complex discriminant, eigenvector coalescence, Jordan-chain residuals, square-root splitting and closed-loop mode exchange as complementary tests of defectiveness. For the regular $A=1$, $\eR=-1$ branch, the two-parameter search locates a resolution-stable second-order EP from $N=24$ to $N=60$, while constrained semidiscrete evolution gives the Jordan response $(C+Dt)e^{\ii\omega_{\rm EP}t}$. For the logarithmic $A=2$ branch, defective points occur in each finite truncation but their coordinates do not converge, so we make no continuum claim for this branch.

classification.title_zh: Rastall 弦流体黑洞标量准正规模中的例外点
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过在标量势中加入局域 Pöschl-Teller 微扰，研究 Rastall 弦流体黑洞标量准正规模中的例外点，并以凸起位置 a 和幅度 eb 作为独立控制参数。作者用双域 Chebyshev 配点法和任意精度线性代数求解超双曲问题，并用复判别式、本征矢合并、Jordan 链残差、平方根劈裂和闭环模式交换作为缺陷性的补充检验。对于正则 A=1、eR=-1 分支，双参数搜索在 N=24 到 N=60 间定位到一个分辨率稳定的二阶例外点，约束半离散演化给出 Jordan 响应 (C+Dt)e^{iω_EP t}。对于对数 A=2 分支，每个有限截断中都出现缺陷点，但其坐标不收敛，因此作者不对该分支作连续谱断言。
classification.one_liner: 该文用数值方法在 Rastall 弦流体黑洞的标量准正规模中寻找例外点，并仅在正则分支给出分辨率稳定的二阶例外点证据。

papers.title: Covariant Hamiltonian Gravity in Spherical Symmetry
papers.abstract: Building upon the covariant Hamiltonian gravity in spherical symmetry, we construct the effective Einstein equation governing gravitational dynamics. For any prescribed one-parameter family of static, spherically symmetric metrics, this equation can be constructed such that the prescribed family constitutes their vacuum solutions. As an application, we construct generalized Vaidya solutions to the effective Einstein equation and show that the corresponding energy-momentum tensor takes precisely the standard Vaidya form. The results demonstrate that standard null dust sources can serve as matter source for dynamical black-hole geometries beyond general relativity, including regular black holes. Furthermore, this work suggests that quantum gravity corrections alone may not account for Hawking-like evaporation, as mass loss in the ingoing Vaidya solution necessarily requires a violation of the null energy condition within our effective framework.

classification.title_zh: 球对称下的协变哈密顿引力
classification.abstract_zh: 基于球对称情形下的协变哈密顿引力，我们构造了支配引力动力学的有效爱因斯坦方程。对于任意给定的一参数静态球对称度规族，可以构造该方程，使得给定度规族成为其真空解。作为应用，我们构造了有效爱因斯坦方程的广义 Vaidya 解，并证明相应的能量动量张量恰好取标准 Vaidya 形式。结果表明，标准零尘埃源可以作为超越广义相对论的动力学黑洞几何（包括正则黑洞）的物质源。此外，这项工作暗示，仅靠量子引力修正可能无法解释类霍金蒸发，因为在我们有效框架内，入射 Vaidya 解中的质量损失必然要求零能量条件被破坏。

papers.title: Dynamical entropy on local causal horizons: the Einstein equation of state and canonical-energy flux
papers.abstract: For a twist-free null hypersurface, the Hollands-Wald-Zhang (HWZ) representative $S_{\rm loc}=(4G)^{-1}\int(1-V\theta)dA$, local on each cross-section (cut), obeys an exact off-shell Raychaudhuri identity with no term linear in the expansion, so no final equilibrium cut is needed. Given an entropy density $1/4G$, the Unruh temperature $\kappa/2\pi$ of an approximate local boost, local equilibrium cuts, and stress-tensor conservation, equating the leading equilibrium change of $S_{\rm loc}$ to matter boost heat yields $R_{kk}=8\pi GT_{kk}$ for every null direction, hence the Einstein equation with undetermined cosmological constant, an equation of state in Jacobson's conditional sense. On a fixed caustic-free generator bundle with $dA=J\,dA_{\rm ref}$, the functional $S_{\rm L}=(4G)^{-1}\int(1+\ln J-V\theta)dA_{\rm ref}$ obeys an exact balance per reference cell with curvature, shear, and expansion terms all positive, so under null convergence $S_{\rm L}$ is nondecreasing for $V\geq0$ until the first caustic. Conversely, requiring this balance for positive affine parameter on every small bundle and null direction is equivalent to the Einstein equation, given conservation and the stated normalization. Cut-locality, positivity, and first-order HWZ normalization select the density $1+\ln J-V\theta$ uniquely within a two-function class. Both functionals depend on the affine origin; we give their shift laws, identify the anchoring-invariant content, and show the origin is physical data fixed by the equilibrium cut. Near equilibrium, $S_{\rm L}$ agrees with the HWZ dynamical entropy at first order, and the temperature-weighted change of its Hessian equals the HWZ modified canonical-energy flux for stationary-vacuum perturbations. At finite amplitude, $S_{\rm L}$ is only a monotone geometric functional; reading it as entropy requires a coarse-graining postulate, stated but not derived.

classification.title_zh: 局部因果视界上的动力学熵：爱因斯坦状态方程与正则能量通量
classification.abstract_zh: 对于无扭零超曲面，Hollands-Wald-Zhang（HWZ）代表量 S_loc = (4G)^(-1) ∫(1 - Vθ)dA 在每个截面（cut）上局部定义，并满足一个精确的离壳 Raychaudhuri 恒等式，其中没有正比于膨胀的项，因此不需要最终的平衡截面。给定熵密度 1/4G、近似局部 boost 的 Unruh 温度 κ/2π、局部平衡截面以及应力张量守恒，将 S_loc 的领头平衡变化等同于物质的 boost 热量，可对每个零方向得到 R_kk = 8πG T_kk，从而得到宇宙学常数未定的爱因斯坦方程，这是 Jacobson 条件意义下的状态方程。在固定的无焦散生成元束上，dA = J dA_ref，泛函 S_L = (4G)^(-1) ∫(1 + ln J - Vθ)dA_ref 对每个参考元胞满足精确平衡，其中曲率、剪切和膨胀项均为正，因此在零收敛下，当 V ≥ 0 时 S_L 在首个焦散前非减。反之，若要求每个小束和每个零方向上正仿射参数下的这种平衡，则在守恒和所述归一化下等价于爱因斯坦方程。截面局部性、正性以及一阶 HWZ 归一化在双函数类中唯一选出密度 1 + ln J - Vθ。两个泛函都依赖仿射原点；文中给出其平移规律，识别锚定不变内容，并表明该原点是平衡截面固定的物理数据。近平衡时，S_L 在一阶上与 HWZ 动力学熵一致，其 Hessian 的温度加权变化等于稳态真空扰动下的 HWZ 修正正则能量通量。在有限振幅下，S_L 只是一个单调几何泛函；将其解读为熵需要额外声明但未推导的粗粒化假设。
classification.one_liner: 在无扭零超曲面上构造局部动力学熵泛函，并证明其平衡变分给出爱因斯坦状态方程，同时讨论单调性、仿射原点与正则能量通量对应。

papers.title: Scalable early warning for binary neutron-star mergers in third-generation gravitational-wave detectors
papers.abstract: Third-generation gravitational-wave observatories will observe binary neutron-star coalescences for hours before merger. Over these extended time windows, Earth's motion and the long signal durations make standard search methods computationally demanding for low-latency detection. We propose an approach based on short-time Fourier transforms and convolutional neural networks that implicitly marginalizes over extrinsic parameters, effectively reducing the search to the chirp mass. The network learns the signals' nonlinear time-frequency morphology, approximating the optimal Bayesian detection statistic. Using a large-scale campaign of simulated signal injections, we compare the network's performance with a GPU-optimized matched-filtering baseline for both the ET$\Delta$ and ET2L configurations of the Einstein Telescope and signal durations from approximately 25 minutes ($f_{\rm min} = 5$ Hz) to approximately 6 hours ($f_{\rm min} = 2$ Hz). The network achieves comparable detection sensitivity while reducing computational costs by over four orders of magnitude, bringing processing times from minutes to milliseconds. This efficiency paves the way for rapid early-warning alerts for multi-messenger astronomy in the third-generation detector era.

classification.title_zh: 第三代引力波探测器中双中子星并合的可扩展早期预警
classification.abstract_zh: 第三代引力波天文台将在双中子星并合前数小时观测到信号。在如此长的时间窗口内，地球运动和长信号持续时间使标准搜索方法在低延迟检测中计算负担很重。我们提出一种基于短时傅里叶变换和卷积神经网络的方法，隐式边缘化外部参数，从而将搜索有效约化为啁啾质量。网络学习信号的非线性时频形态，近似最优贝叶斯检测统计量。利用大规模模拟信号注入活动，我们将网络性能与针对爱因斯坦望远镜 ETΔ 和 ET2L 配置、信号持续时间从约25分钟（f_min=5 Hz）到约6小时（f_min=2 Hz）的 GPU 优化匹配滤波基线进行比较。网络达到可比检测灵敏度，同时将计算成本降低四个数量级以上，将处理时间从分钟级降至毫秒级。这种效率为第三代探测器时代多信使天文学的快速早期预警铺平道路。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于短时傅里叶变换与卷积神经网络的低延迟搜索方法，将第三代探测器双中子星并合预警计算成本降低四个数量级以上。

papers.title: Observational signatures of Bardeen black holes under nonlinear electrodynamics
papers.abstract: We investigate the shadow and optical appearance of the Bardeen black hole (BH) within nonlinear electrodynamics (NLED). Since photon propagation in nonlinear electromagnetic field can be equivalently described as null-geodesic motion in the effective metric induced by NLED, we derive the corresponding effective optical geometry of the NLED-Bardeen BH. Furthermore, by examining the horizon-photon sphere-shadow inequality, we demonstrate that the NLED-Bardeen BH does not satisfy the complete inequality chain. In addition, we investigate photon dynamics and the corresponding optical images generated by both thin disk and spherical accretion models. Increasing $g/M$ reduces the photon sphere radius and critical impact parameter, resulting in a more compact shadow and an inward shift of the emission peak. For the thin disk accretion model, photon trajectories are classified into direct emission, lensing ring, and photon ring components according to the corresponding impact parameter. We find that Model 1 exhibits three distinct intensity peaks, whereas Models 2 and 3 display two and one peaks. The systematic dependence of these features on the magnetic charge indicates that the NLED-Bardeen BH may exhibit observational signatures distinguishable from those of the Bardeen BH. In static spherical accretion, the intensity peaks near the critical impact parameter because of the enhanced optical path length, while infalling spherical accretion introduces an additional Doppler redshift that suppresses the observed intensity. These results indicate that the shadow size, ring structure, and intensity distribution can serve as potential observational signatures of NLED effects in the strong-field regime.

classification.title_zh: 非线性电动力学下Bardeen黑洞的观测特征
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究非线性电动力学（NLED）中Bardeen黑洞的阴影与光学外观。作者利用NLED诱导的有效度规，将光子传播等价描述为类光测地线运动，并推导相应的有效光学几何；通过检验视界-光子球-阴影不等式，指出NLED-Bardeen黑洞不满足完整的不等式链。文章进一步分析薄盘与球对称吸积模型下的光子动力学和光学图像，发现增大g/M会减小光子球半径和临界碰撞参数，使阴影更紧凑且发射峰内移；薄盘情形下按碰撞参数将光子轨迹分为直接辐射、透镜环和光子环，三个模型分别呈现三、二、一个强度峰。静态球对称吸积中强度峰因光程增强而靠近临界碰撞参数，内落球对称吸积则因额外多普勒红移压低观测强度。结果表明阴影大小、环结构和强度分布可作为强场区NLED效应的潜在观测特征。

papers.title: Periodic orbits and gravitational wave radiation of a phantom Dirac--Born--Infeld regular black hole Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate periodic orbits and gravitational wave radiation in the spacetime of an asymptotically flat regular black hole supported by a phantom Dirac--Born--Infeld scalar field. Starting from the timelike geodesic equations, we examine the effective potential and the characteristic circular orbits and construct periodic zoom--whirl trajectories. We further explore the sensitivity of orbital closure to small energy perturbations and examine the periastron advance of the $S2$ star around Sgr A$^*$ to assess possible constraints on the regular core parameter. The gravitational wave signals associated with representative periodic trajectories are then calculated within a quadrupole based numerical kludge approximation, considering both polarization modes. Particular attention is given to the influence of the regular core on orbital configurations and waveform characteristics, providing a complementary perspective on gravitational aspects of phantom Dirac--Born--Infeld regular black holes.

classification.title_zh: Phantom Dirac--Born--Infeld 正则黑洞的周期轨道与引力波辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究由 phantom Dirac--Born--Infeld 标量场支持的渐近平直正则黑洞时空中的周期轨道和引力波辐射。从类时测地线方程出发，考察有效势和特征圆轨道，并构造周期 zoom--whirl 轨迹。进一步探讨轨道闭合对微小能量扰动的敏感性，并考察 Sgr A* 周围 S2 恒星的近星点进动，以评估对正则核心参数的可能限制。随后在基于四极矩的数值 kludge 近似下计算代表性周期轨迹对应的引力波信号，考虑两种偏振模式。特别关注正则核心对轨道构型和波形特征的影响，为 phantom Dirac--Born--Infeld 正则黑洞的引力方面提供补充视角。

papers.title: Surface Enhanced Anisotropy and Its Impacts on Massive Neutron Star Configurations in Einstein Gravity : Stability, Structure, and Multimessenger Consistency
papers.abstract: Anisotropic neutron-star configurations are investigated within Einstein's General Relativity using a third-order polynomial equation of state, (p_r=A\rho+B\rho^2+C\rho^3), and the Buchdahl class-I metric ansatz, (e^{q(r)}=\frac{L(1+\tau r^2)}{L-\tau r^2}). Physically viable interior solutions are constructed and smoothly matched to the exterior Schwarzschild spacetime using the Darmois-Israel junction conditions. The stellar properties are examined through the matter distribution, pressure anisotropy, hydrostatic equilibrium, compactness, surface redshift, tidal deformability, causality, and dynamical stability. The energy density and radial and tangential pressures remain finite, positive, and monotonically decreasing throughout the interior, while the anisotropy vanishes at the centre and increases smoothly toward the surface. Generalized Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equation confirms equilibrium through the balance of gravitational, hydrostatic, and anisotropic forces. Furthermore, adiabatic index satisfies the Chandrasekhar stability criterion, and both sound speeds obey the causality and Herrera cracking conditions. The compactness remains below the Buchdahl limit, with physically acceptable surface redshifts. The predicted maximum masses exceed the corresponding observed masses, with some configurations extending into the lower mass-gap region. The tidal deformabilities are consistent with multimessenger constraints from GW170817 and NICER. In addition, the theoretical mass-compactness relation and its prediction intervals show good agreement with observational estimates. Finally, Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo analysis provides statistically reliable constraints on the tidal Love number, compactness, and perturbation parameter. These results establish a physically viable and observationally compatible framework for describing anisotropic neutron stars within General Relativity.

classification.title_zh: 表面增强各向异性及其对爱因斯坦引力中巨质量中子星位形的影响：稳定性、结构与多信使一致性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在爱因斯坦广义相对论框架下研究各向异性中子星位形，采用三阶多项式状态方程 p_r=Aρ+Bρ^2+Cρ^3 与 Buchdahl class-I 度规拟设 e^{q(r)}=L(1+τr^2)/(L-τr^2)。作者构造物理可行的内部解，并通过 Darmois-Israel 衔接条件光滑匹配到外部 Schwarzschild 时空。文章考察物质分布、压强各向异性、流体静力学平衡、致密度、表面红移、潮汐形变、因果性与动力学稳定性；广义 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程确认引力、流体静力学与各向异性力的平衡，绝热指数满足 Chandrasekhar 稳定性判据，声速满足因果性与 Herrera cracking 条件。致密度低于 Buchdahl 极限，表面红移物理可接受。预测最大质量超过相应观测质量，部分位形进入较低质量间隙区域；潮汐形变与 GW170817 和 NICER 多信使约束一致。质量-致密度关系及预测区间与观测估计相符，Bayesian MCMC 分析给出潮汐 Love 数、致密度和扰动参数的统计约束。

papers.title: Neutron Star Mass-Radius Constraints for EXO 0748$-$676 from 2008-2025 Quiescent X-ray Spectra
papers.abstract: We present new constraints on the mass and radius of the neutron star in the neutron star low-mass X-ray binary EXO 0748$-$676 obtained from a joint analysis of 20 quiescent X-ray observations obtained between 2008 and 2025, including 14 Chandra and 6 XMM-Newton exposures. These data sample two quiescent episodes separated by the 2024$-$2025 outburst. We model the 0.5$-$10 keV spectra with a hydrogen-atmosphere model, assuming a source distance of 7.1 kpc. In a global Markov Chain Monte Carlo analysis in which the hydrogen column density, neutron star mass, and radius are tied across all observations, we obtain a neutron-star mass of $1.77^{+0.17}_{-0.22}\,M_\odot$ and a radius of $12.62^{+0.56}_{-0.74}$ km ($1\sigma$ credible intervals). We further perform independent fits to the first and second quiescent epochs and find that the combined data set significantly reduces the low-mass tail in the posterior distribution, leading to tighter lower bounds on the neutron-star mass. Incorporating the distance uncertainty of $7.1\pm1.2$ kpc, we conservatively constrain the neutron-star mass and radius to $M\simeq 1.41-2.11~M_{\odot}$ and $R\simeq 10.15-15.13$ km, favoring relatively stiff dense-matter equations of state. We also trace the thermal evolution across two quiescent epochs and find evidence for renewed crust cooling following the 2024$-$2025 outburst, providing a unique opportunity to compare the thermal relaxation behavior after two distinct accretion episodes.

classification.title_zh: EXO 0748−676 中子星质量-半径约束：来自 2008–2025 年宁静态 X 射线谱
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过联合分析 2008 年至 2025 年间获得的 20 次宁静态 X 射线观测（包括 14 次 Chandra 和 6 次 XMM-Newton 曝光），给出了中子星低质量 X 射线双星 EXO 0748−676 中中子星质量和半径的新约束。这些数据覆盖了 2024–2025 年爆发前后两个宁静态时段。我们采用氢大气模型拟合 0.5–10 keV 能谱，并假设源距离为 7.1 kpc。在全局马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛分析中，将氢柱密度、中子星质量和半径在所有观测间绑定，得到中子星质量为 1.77^{+0.17}_{-0.22} M⊙，半径为 12.62^{+0.56}_{-0.74} km（1σ 可信区间）。我们还对第一和第二个宁静态时段分别进行独立拟合，发现联合数据集显著降低了后验分布中的低质量尾部，从而给出更紧的中子星质量下限。考虑 7.1±1.2 kpc 的距离不确定性后，我们保守地将中子星质量和半径约束为 M≃1.41–2.11 M⊙ 和 R≃10.15–15.13 km，倾向于相对较硬的致密物质状态方程。我们还追踪了两个宁静态时段的热演化，并发现 2024–2025 年爆发后地壳重新冷却的证据，这为比较两次不同吸积事件后的热弛豫行为提供了独特机会。
classification.one_liner: 联合分析 EXO 0748−676 的 20 次宁静态 X 射线观测，给出中子星质量半径约束并偏好较硬的致密物质状态方程。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及中子星质量半径与致密物质状态方程，属于致密天体/经典引力相关观测；但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力理论。

papers.title: Particle dynamics in rotating charged Bumblebee black holes: An analytical correspondence with Kerr-Newman
papers.abstract: In this paper, we establish an analytical correspondence between the equatorial dynamics of spinless and spinning test particles in a slowly rotating charged Einstein--Bumblebee black hole spacetime and those in an effective Kerr--Newman spacetime. For spinning particles, the correspondence is established within the Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon framework under appropriate parameter matching. We show that corresponding circular orbits have identical radii and coordinate angular velocities, while their radial dynamics and local instability rates exhibit a Lorentz-violation-dependent scaling. Nevertheless, the correspondence does not imply complete dynamical equivalence, as orbital trajectories and radial perturbation growth over an azimuthal period generally differ. These results delineate the scope and limitations of the effective Kerr--Newman correspondence by distinguishing the dynamical properties preserved under parameter matching from those modified by the Lorentz-violating radial deformation.

classification.title_zh: 旋转带电Bumblebee黑洞中的粒子动力学：与Kerr-Newman的解析对应
classification.abstract_zh: 论文在慢旋转带电Einstein-Bumblebee黑洞时空中，建立无自旋与有自旋检验粒子赤道面动力学同有效Kerr-Newman时空之间的解析对应；有自旋情形在Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon框架下通过参数匹配实现。对应圆轨道具有相同半径和坐标角速度，但径向动力学与局部不稳定性率呈现依赖洛伦兹破坏的标度。该对应并不意味完全动力学等价，因为轨道轨迹和每方位角周期的径向扰动增长通常不同。结果界定了有效Kerr-Newman对应的适用范围与局限。
classification.one_liner: 该文建立Bumblebee黑洞检验粒子动力学与有效Kerr-Newman时空的解析对应，并指出洛伦兹破坏导致的非等价性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典黑洞时空中的检验粒子动力学，与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线相关；但不涉及全息、量子信息、超流超导等其余重点方向。

papers.title: Massive Scalar Quasinormal Modes and Quasibound States of Charged Black Holes with Logarithmic corrections
papers.abstract: We study how long-range deformations in a black-hole metric affect the oscillation, trapping, and decay of a neutral, minimally coupled massive scalar field. We choose a logarithmic deformation of Reissner-Nordstr\"om (RN) sourced by nonlinear electrodynamics, arising as an exact solution of Einstein gravity. The same geometry also arises in a phenomenological perfect-fluid dark-matter model. We provide several exact completions of this geometry with finite Arnowitt-Deser-Misner (ADM) mass. Focusing on the original logarithmic geometry, we analyze both quasinormal modes (QNMs), which describe relaxation, and quasibound states (QBSs), which describe trapped modes with small horizon absorption. We first show that a small scalar mass moves the potential barrier outward, raises it, and reduces its curvature. First-order WKB then predicts weaker damping at every fixed finite multipole and overtone. We then compare several approaches, namely sixth-order WKB, global matching, a generalized Leaver method (adapted to the logarithmic geometry) and time-domain evolution. All methods yield consistent QNM estimates within their ranges of validity. Global matching and Leaver also agree closely for QBSs. Further analytic estimates with a reference trapped state show that a local Pad\'e approximation gives a binding-energy error of about $0.04\%$, while leading Gamow tunnelling underestimates damping by about $25\%$. Across the sampled QBSs, increasing the scalar mass or nonlinear coupling strengthens binding but shortens the lifetime through greater horizon absorption. Finally, using an appropriate horizon regularization and a common complex radial contour, we demonstrate orthogonality of an independently computed QNM-QBS pair using a suitable relativistic bilinear framework.

classification.title_zh: 带对数修正的带电黑洞的大质量标量准正规模与准束缚态
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究黑洞度规中的长程变形如何影响一个中性、最小耦合的大质量标量场的振荡、束缚与衰减。我们选取由非线性电动力学产生、作为 Einstein 引力精确解的 Reissner-Nordström（RN）黑洞的对数变形；同一几何也出现在一个唯象的完美流体暗物质模型中。我们给出该几何的若干具有有限 ADM 质量的精确完备化。聚焦于原始对数几何，我们分析描述弛豫的准正规模（QNMs）以及描述具有小视界吸收的束缚模式的准束缚态（QBSs）。我们首先表明，小的标量质量会把势垒向外移动、抬高并降低其曲率；一阶 WKB 随后预言在任意固定有限多极子和泛音下阻尼更弱。然后我们比较六阶 WKB、全局匹配、适应对数几何的广义 Leaver 方法以及时域演化；所有方法在其有效范围内给出一致的 QNM 估计。全局匹配与 Leaver 对 QBS 也高度一致。利用一个参考束缚态做进一步解析估计表明，局部 Padé 近似给出的束缚能误差约为 0.04%，而领头 Gamow 隧穿把阻尼低估约 25%。在所采样的 QBS 中，增加标量质量或非线性耦合会增强束缚，但通过更强的视界吸收缩短寿命。最后，利用适当的视界正则化和共同的复径向围道，我们在合适的相对论双线性框架下证明了一对独立计算的 QNM-QBS 的正交性。
classification.one_liner: 在带对数修正的带电黑洞时空中比较多种方法计算大质量标量准正规模与准束缚态，并讨论质量与非线性耦合对束缚和阻尼的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为经典黑洞时空中的标量 QNM/QBS 计算与方法比较，与 QNM 和经典引力支线相关；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息。

papers.title: How does geometry shape quantum emission in rotating bumblebee gravity?
papers.abstract: We compare propagation and static emission estimates in a rotating metric geometry and a stationary metric-affine bumblebee geometry. Their distinct constructions and spatial asymptotics are kept, and normalized Killing times define the physical frequencies and angular velocities. Direct invariant calculations identify the metric-affine outer root and open exterior axes as curvature singularities for generic rotation. The obstruction at bifurcation surface poles concerns the smoothness of the bumblebee field independently. Its mixed meridional component couples angular channels; finite transverse energy fixes the adopted axial condition and defines a self adjoint stationary operator on bounded exterior annuli. For the metric geometry, we construct normalized radiative scalar modes with specified Unruh data, evaluate the horizon frequency transformation, and include spontaneous superradiant emission through the radial scattering map. We prove positivity of the axisymmetric potential and compute numerical transmission factors and a partial scalar energy spectrum alongside an analytical lower bound. The static emission estimates use the stated Stefan-Boltzmann model.

classification.title_zh: 几何如何塑造旋转 bumblebee 引力中的量子发射？
classification.abstract_zh: 本文比较旋转度规几何与稳态度规-仿射 bumblebee 几何中的传播与静态发射估计。保留二者不同构造和空间渐近行为，并用归一化 Killing 时间定义物理频率和角速度。直接不变量计算表明，在一般旋转下，度规-仿射外根和开放外部轴为曲率奇点。分叉面极点处的阻碍另涉及 bumblebee 场的光滑性。其混合子午分量耦合角向通道；有限横向能量固定所采用的轴向条件，并在有界外部环域上定义自伴稳态算符。对度规几何，构造具有指定 Unruh 数据的归一化辐射标量模，评估视界频率变换，并通过径向散射映射纳入自发超辐射发射。证明轴对称势的正性，计算数值透射因子和部分标量能谱及解析下界。静态发射估计采用所述 Stefan-Boltzmann 模型。
classification.one_liner: 比较旋转度规与度规-仿射 bumblebee 黑洞几何中的标量传播、超辐射与静态量子发射。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于修改引力旋转黑洞与曲率背景中标量辐射的研究，非 AdS/CFT 全息工作，但与经典引力/广义相对论支线有部分交集。

papers.title: ACT-DR6 consistent inflation in generalised entropic cosmology and $f(Q)$ gravity
papers.abstract: Within the framework of generalised entropic cosmology and its equivalent $f(Q)$ gravity, we construct inflationary scenarios consistent with recent Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) observations combined with Planck-BAO data. We work with $f(Q)$ gravity and use the reconstruction scheme from which one can obtain an arbitrary cosmological evolution consistent with desirable theoretical or observational considerations. Explicit inflationary cosmologies of the above theory, which pass ACT-Data Release 6 (DR6) data combined with Planck and BAO, are obtained. For $f(Q)$ gravity coupled with scalar, we obtain ACT inflation for large classes of $f(Q)$ via the choice of the scalar potentials. The entropic cosmology based on generalised entropy, which includes most of the known entropies like Tsallis, R\'{e}nyi, Barrow, etc as a particular case, is investigated. The corresponding FRW equations, depending on the parameters of generalised entropy, are presented. Using the correspondence between the generalised entropy and $f(Q)$ gravity, we obtain generalised entropic inflation, which is consistent with the ACT-DR6. At the next step, the entropic gravity coupled with scalar is considered. It is demonstrated how one can obtain ACT-DR6-consistent inflation for such a theory based on any generalised entropy considered in this paper via the choice of scalar potentials. These findings may point towards the correct unifying entropy of the early universe.

classification.title_zh: 广义熵宇宙学与 f(Q) 引力中与 ACT-DR6 一致的暴胀
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在广义熵宇宙学及其等效 f(Q) 引力框架下，构建与最新 Atacama 宇宙学望远镜（ACT）观测及 Planck-BAO 数据一致的暴胀情景。作者采用重构方案，获得与理论或观测要求相符的任意宇宙学演化，并给出通过 ACT-DR6 结合 Planck 与 BAO 数据的显式暴胀宇宙学。对于 f(Q) 引力与标量场耦合的情形，通过选择标量势，可在大量 f(Q) 模型中实现 ACT 暴胀。文中还研究基于广义熵的熵宇宙学，涵盖 Tsallis、Rényi、Barrow 等已知熵作为特例，给出依赖于广义熵参数的 FRW 方程；利用广义熵与 f(Q) 引力之间的对应关系，得到与 ACT-DR6 一致的广义熵暴胀。随后考虑熵引力与标量场耦合，并展示如何通过选择标量势，对文中考虑的任何广义熵获得 ACT-DR6 一致的暴胀。作者认为这些结果可能指向早期宇宙的正确统一熵。
classification.one_liner: 在广义熵宇宙学及其等效 f(Q) 引力框架中构建并通过 ACT-DR6+Planck+BAO 检验的暴胀模型。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题为修改引力与熵宇宙学中的早期宇宙暴胀及观测约束，与 AdS/CFT 全息及所列全息重点支线无直接关联；仅在经典引力/宇宙学大类上相邻。

papers.title: Energy Extraction via Magnetic Reconnection from a Rotating Dyonic Black Hole in $N = 2, \ U(1)^2$ Gauged Supergravity
papers.abstract: We study energy extraction via magnetic reconnection from a rotating dyonic black hole in four-dimensional $N=2$, $U(1)^2$ gauged supergravity. Using the Comisso-Asenjo mechanism in the ZAMO frame, we derive the asymptotic hydrodynamic energy per unit enthalpy $\epsilon^{\infty}_\pm$ and determine when reconnection outflows attained negative energy at infinity. By varying the spin $a$, electric and magnetic charges, NUT parameter $N_g$, and gauge coupling $g$, we compute the cutoff magnetization $\sigma_0^{\rm cutoff}$ and map the region of parameter space that admits $\epsilon^{\infty}_-<0$. We find that $\sigma_0^{\rm cutoff}$ and the very existence of Comisso-Asenjo extraction are tightly controlled by $g$ and the dyonic charges: increasing $g$ or pushing the charges toward extremality raises $\sigma_0^{\rm cutoff}$ and shrinks the CA-active part of the ergoregion. Unlike Kerr, the spin enters through the normalization factor $\Xi$, and the quartic horizon function $\Delta_g$, so geometric effects from the AdS/NUT deformation dominate the usual frame-dragging enhancement. As a result, the extracted power and efficiency are non-monotonic in $a$ and peak at intermediate spin ($a\sim0.8$); near-extremal rotation is not required for high efficiency, provided $g$ is small and $Q$ is moderate. Efficient extraction further demands extreme magnetization and nearly radial outflows, confining the active reconnection layer to a thin shell, just outside the horizon.

classification.title_zh: N=2, U(1)^2 规范超引力中旋转双荷黑洞的磁重联能量提取
classification.abstract_zh: 在四维 N=2、U(1)^2 规范超引力中，研究旋转双荷黑洞通过磁重联的能量提取。采用 ZAMO 系中的 Comisso-Asenjo 机制，推导单位焓的渐近流体能量 ε∞±，并确定重联外流在无穷远具有负能量的条件。通过改变自旋 a、电磁荷、NUT 参数 Ng 和规范耦合 g，计算截断磁化 σ0cutoff，并映射允许 ε∞−<0 的参数区域。发现 σ0cutoff 及 CA 提取的存在性受 g 和双荷强烈控制：增大 g 或使荷趋于极端会提高 σ0cutoff 并缩小 ergoregion 中 CA 活跃部分。与 Kerr 不同，自旋通过归一化因子 Ξ 和四次视界函数 Δg 进入，AdS/NUT 形变的几何效应主导通常的参考系拖曳增强；提取功率和效率对 a 非单调，在中间自旋 a~0.8 处峰值；若 g 小且 Q 适中，不需要近极端旋转即可获得高效率。高效提取还要求极端磁化和近径向外流，使活跃重联层限制在视界外薄壳。
classification.one_liner: 研究 N=2 U(1)^2 规范超引力旋转双荷黑洞中磁重联能量提取的参数依赖，发现规范耦合与双荷控制提取阈值。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典黑洞时空中的磁重联能量提取，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；未涉及 AdS/CFT 全息字典，因此不属于理论全息。

papers.title: Electromagnetic duality degeneracy in dynamical black hole mergers
papers.abstract: Electromagnetic duality is a symmetry of the source-free Einstein-Maxwell equations that rotates electric and magnetic fields while leaving the stress-energy tensor invariant. We present the first fully nonlinear realization of this symmetry in dynamical strong-gravity regimes by performing numerical relativity simulations of charged black hole mergers across a continuous duality family. Starting from electrically charged binaries, we generate dyonic and magnetically charged configurations via duality rotations and evolve them within a common numerical framework. We find that all dual configurations exhibit identical spacetime dynamics, while the emitted electromagnetic radiation is related by a rotation of its polarization equal to the duality angle. Our results demonstrate a degeneracy of gravitational observables under electromagnetic duality and provide a concrete mapping between dual configurations at the level of radiation, establishing electromagnetic duality as an organizing principle for dynamical Einstein-Maxwell solutions.

classification.title_zh: 动力学黑洞并合中的电磁对偶简并
classification.abstract_zh: 电磁对偶是源自由 Einstein-Maxwell 方程的一种对称性，它旋转电场与磁场而保持应力-能量张量不变。作者通过对带电黑洞并合进行数值相对论模拟，在一个连续的电磁对偶族上首次实现了该对称性在动力学强引力区域的全非线性体现。从电带电双星出发，他们利用对偶旋转生成 dyonic 与磁带电构型，并在同一数值框架中演化。结果表明，所有对偶构型具有相同的时空动力学，而发出的电磁辐射仅相差一个等于对偶角的偏振旋转。这些结果展示了电磁对偶下引力可观测量的简并，并在辐射层面给出了对偶构型之间的具体映射，从而将电磁对偶确立为动力学 Einstein-Maxwell 解的组织原则。
classification.one_liner: 数值相对论表明，Einstein-Maxwell 带电黑洞并合的电磁对偶族具有相同时空动力学，电磁辐射仅差一个偏振旋转。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典 Einstein-Maxwell 理论中的带电黑洞并合与数值相对论，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力，因此与全息分类核心兴趣的相关性为中等。

papers.title: Inaccessibility of the Schwarzschild Singularity to Quantum Probes
papers.abstract: We revisit the Schwarzschild singularity in a semiclassical setting where the background geometry is classical and quantum effects enter through Bohmian (quantal) trajectories associated with a Klein-Gordon wave function. Using the Madelung-Bohm decomposition of the Klein-Gordon wavefunction, we show that the quantum-modified motion is equivalent to geodesic motion in an effective metric conformally related to Schwarzschild, with a conformal factor fixed by the wavefunction amplitude. Solving the wavefunction equation near $r\to 0$ determines this factor and yields finite curvature invariants, in suitable coordinates the interior extends smoothly and the effective spacetime is geodesically complete. Our result suggests that quantum probes on a prescribed classical background can experience an operationally regular effective geometry, even though the underlying Schwarzschild spacetime itself remains classically singular.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild 奇点对量子探针的不可及性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在半经典框架下重新审视 Schwarzschild 奇点：背景几何为经典，量子效应通过与该 Klein-Gordon 波函数相关的 Bohmian（量子）轨迹进入。利用 Klein-Gordon 波函数的 Madelung-Bohm 分解，我们表明量子修正后的运动等价于在一个与 Schwarzschild 共形相关的有效度规中的测地线运动，共形因子由波函数振幅确定。求解 r→0 附近的波函数方程可确定该因子，并给出有限的曲率不变量；在合适坐标下内部可光滑延伸，且有效时空是测地完备的。我们的结果表明，在给定的经典背景上，量子探针可以经历操作上规则的有效几何，尽管底层 Schwarzschild 时空本身在经典意义上仍是奇异的。
classification.one_liner: 用 Bohmian 轨迹构造共形有效度规，表明量子探针在经典 Schwarzschild 背景上经历规则且测地完备的有效几何。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息研究；主要涉及 Schwarzschild 经典背景与半经典量子探针的有效几何，只与“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关。

papers.title: Hall Viscosity in the Quark-Gluon Plasma
papers.abstract: We study the Hall viscosity of the quark gluon plasma (QGP) created in non-central heavy-ion collisions. In the presence of a strong magnetic field or vorticity, rotational symmetry is broken from $O(3)$ to $O(2)$, allowing for two independent Hall viscosities associated with shear deformations transverse and parallel to the symmetry-breaking direction. We find the corresponding constitutive relations by extending the kinetic-theory mechanism to three spatial dimensions and provide parametric estimates of the Hall viscosities under realistic QGP conditions. Both kinetic-theory and holographic estimates indicate that Hall viscosities are comparable in magnitude to the shear viscosity at zero magnetic field. We further show that Hall viscous stresses at hydrodynamic initialization can be as large as standard viscous corrections and identify observable consequences in flow and event-plane correlations.

classification.title_zh: 夸克-胶子等离子体中的霍尔黏度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究非中心重离子碰撞产生的夸克-胶子等离子体（QGP）的霍尔黏度。在强磁场或涡度存在时，旋转对称性从 O(3) 破缺到 O(2)，允许两个独立的霍尔黏度，分别对应横向和平行于对称性破缺方向的剪切形变。我们将动理学机制推广到三维空间，得到相应的本构关系，并在现实 QGP 条件下给出霍尔黏度的参数估计。动理学和全息估计均表明，霍尔黏度在量级上与零磁场时的剪切黏度相当。我们还表明，流体力学初始化时的霍尔黏性应力可与标准黏性修正一样大，并指出其在流和事件平面关联中的可观测效应。
classification.one_liner: 研究 QGP 中磁场/涡度诱导的霍尔黏度及其对重离子碰撞流与事件平面关联的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为 QGP 霍尔黏度与输运，虽包含全息估计，但不直接涉及所列重点分支（全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D-brane 探针或经典引力）。

papers.title: Resummed energy loss in extreme-mass-ratio scattering using critical orbits
papers.abstract: Motivated by recent efforts to bridge between weak-field and strong-field descriptions of black-hole binary dynamics, we develop a resummation scheme for post-Minkowskian radiative observables in extreme-mass-ratio scattering, augmented with post-Newtonian terms. Specifically, we derive universal interpolation formulas for the total energy emitted in gravitational waves out to infinity and down the event horizon of the large black hole, valid to leading order in the small mass ratio. We test our formulas using numerical results from direct calculations in black hole perturbation theory. The central idea of our approach is to utilize as a strong-field diagnostic the known form of divergence in the radiated energy along geodesics near the parameter-space separatrix between scattering and plunge. The dominant, logarithmic term of this divergence can be expressed in terms of instantaneous energy fluxes calculated along the unstable circular geodesics that form the separatrix, fluxes that we obtain using interpolation of highly accurate numerical data. The same idea could be applied to bound-orbit radiative observables via either unbound-to-bound mapping or a direct resummation of bound-orbit post-Newtonian expressions.

classification.title_zh: 利用临界轨道重求和的极端质量比散射能量损失
classification.abstract_zh: 受近期连接黑洞双星弱场与强场描述的尝试启发，本文为极端质量比散射中的后闵可夫斯基辐射可观测量发展了一种重求和方案，并加入后牛顿项。具体地，作者在小质量比领头阶推导了辐射到无穷远和落入大黑洞视界的引力波总能量的通用插值公式，并用黑洞微扰理论的直接数值计算检验。方法核心是把散射与坠落之间参数空间分界线附近测地线辐射能量已知的发散形式作为强场诊断；该发散的主导对数项可用分界线（不稳定圆测地线）上的瞬时能量通量表示，而这些通量由高精度数值数据插值获得。相同思想也可通过无界到有界轨道映射或对有界轨道后牛顿表达式直接重求和，用于有界轨道辐射可观测量。
classification.one_liner: 利用散射/坠落分界线附近不稳定圆轨道的能量通量构造插值重求和公式，描述极端质量比散射中辐射到无穷远与视界的引力波总能量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要属于经典引力、黑洞微扰与引力波辐射，不涉及全息对偶；但直接匹配用户“经典引力/广义相对论”支线标签，因此给予中等相关性。

papers.title: On the consistency of non-commutative geometry inspired Reissner-Nordstr\"{o}m black hole solution
papers.abstract: We revisit the non-commutative geometry inspired Reissner-Nordstr\"{o}m black hole solution obtained by smearing the point sources with a Gaussian distribution. We show that while the form of the metric function and the physical properties derived from that remain valid, not all the components of Einstein equations are satisfied: the angular components fail by exactly the Lorentz force density exerted by the electric field on the smeared charge, which the standard electromagnetic energy-momentum tensor leaves unbalanced. We construct an improved energy-momentum tensor that consistently satisfies Einstein equations. It is the unique conserved completion: the standard Maxwell tensor supplemented by an interaction stress supported on the smeared source. The improved tensor leads to a different prediction for the region where the strong energy condition is violated. For certain choice of parameters, our proposal predicts the violation of the energy condition outside the Cauchy horizon, which might be relevant for the stability of the inner horizon and strong cosmic censorship.

classification.title_zh: 论非交换几何启发的 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞解的一致性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视通过高斯分布涂抹点源得到的非交换几何启发 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞解。作者表明，虽然度规函数形式及由此导出的物理性质仍然有效，但 Einstein 方程并非所有分量都满足：角向分量恰好差一个由电场对涂抹电荷施加的 Lorentz 力密度，而标准电磁能量-动量张量无法平衡这一项。作者构造了一个改进的能量-动量张量，使其一致满足 Einstein 方程；该张量是唯一的守恒完成，即在标准 Maxwell 张量上补充一个支撑于涂抹源上的相互作用应力。改进张量对强能量条件被违反的区域给出不同预言；对某些参数选择，该方案预言能量条件在 Cauchy 视界之外被违反，这可能与内视界稳定性及强宇宙监督有关。
classification.one_liner: 该文指出非交换几何启发的 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞解的标准能量-动量张量不能使全部 Einstein 方程成立，并构造唯一守恒的改进张量以修正强能量条件违反区域。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的黑洞解与能量条件研究，并使用经典引力重点标签；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息方法。

papers.title: Effect of ultralight dark matter on compact binary mergers
papers.abstract: The growing catalogue of gravitational wave events enables a statistical analysis of compact binary mergers, typically quantified by the binary merger rate density. This quantity can be influenced by ambient factors, following which, in this work we have investigated the impact of dark matter environment on the merger statistics. We construct a baseline astrophysical model of eccentric and quasi-circular compact binary mergers and extend it by incorporating a model of ultra light dark matter, which affects the orbital evolution of binaries through accretion and dynamical friction. Our analysis of the merged population of binary progenitors demonstrates that, compared to the baseline model, ULDM can potentially alter the merger statistics for ambient non-zero densities, with the best agreement with GWTC-3 obtained for $\rho_0\sim10^6$ GeV/cm$^3$ and eccentricity $\sim0.5$. A comparison with the gravitational wave data from the GWTC-3 catalogue provides crucial insight into potential observational signatures of the ULDM in merger events, leading to possible constraints on the existence and density of dark matter distribution in galaxies.

classification.title_zh: 超轻暗物质对致密双星并合的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 不断增长的引力波事件目录使对致密双星并合的统计分析成为可能，通常用双星并合率密度来量化。该量可能受到环境因素的影响，因此本工作研究了暗物质环境对并合统计的影响。我们构建了一个偏心与准圆致密双星并合的基线天体物理模型，并通过引入超轻暗物质模型对其加以扩展；该模型通过吸积和动力学摩擦影响双星的轨道演化。对并合双星前身星群体的分析表明，与基线模型相比，ULDM 在环境密度非零时可能改变并合统计，而与 GWTC-3 最一致的参数为 ρ0∼10^6 GeV/cm^3 和偏心率∼0.5。与 GWTC-3 目录引力波数据的比较，为 ULDM 在并合事件中的潜在观测特征提供了关键线索，并可能导致对星系中暗物质分布的存在性和密度施加限制。
classification.one_liner: 用超轻暗物质的吸积与动力学摩擦模型修正致密双星轨道演化，并对比 GWTC-3 并合统计。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究引力波致密双星并合与超轻暗物质环境，属于经典引力/引力波天体物理，但不涉及全息、量子引力或用户列出的其他全息重点支线。

papers.title: Symmetry breaking from conformality loss on holographic R\'enyi defects
papers.abstract: The R\'enyi entropies of a ball are computed by the R\'enyi defect (the twist operator viewed as a conformal defect), which in holography is dual to a hyperbolic black hole. We identify hyperbolic black holes with homogeneous charged scalar hair as conformal defects that break the U(1) symmetry. At large $N$ and for repulsive self-interactions, conformality loss of the R\'enyi defect turns explicit symmetry breaking into spontaneous breaking: below a critical index $n_*$ the symmetry-breaking defect is reached only with an explicit source on the entangling surface; at $n_*$ the dimension of a defect operator from a light charged scalar turns complex; beyond $n_*$ the R\'enyi defect flows to the symmetry-breaking defect with no source. The condensate, expected to break the symmetries of hyperbolic space, instead preserves them outside a layer at the entangling surface, whose width diverges at $n_*$ with Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless scaling. The universal term of the R\'enyi entropy therefore jumps at $n_*$ to that of the symmetry-breaking defect. We demonstrate this mechanism in the probe Abelian Higgs model in AdS$_5$ at the Bogomolny point, with closed-form saddles and defect data, and numerical flows. For a ball we prove that a positive source-free flow exists exactly when $n>n_*$ and the radius is large enough, and that it ends at the symmetry-breaking defect as the radius grows.
