classification.title_zh: 全息 Rényi 缺陷上共形性丧失引发的对称性破缺
classification.abstract_zh: 球的 Rényi 熵可由 Rényi 缺陷（将 twist operator 视为共形缺陷）计算；在全息中它对偶于双曲黑洞。我们指出，具有均匀带电标量毛的双曲黑洞可作为破坏 U(1) 对称性的共形缺陷。在大 N 和排斥自相互作用下，Rényi 缺陷的共形性丧失会把显式对称性破缺转变为自发破缺：当指标低于临界值 n_* 时，只能通过在纠缠面上加入显式源达到对称破缺缺陷；在 n_* 处，来自轻带电标量的某个缺陷算符维度变复；高于 n_* 时，Rényi 缺陷无源地流向对称破缺缺陷。该凝聚本应破坏双曲空间对称性，却在纠缠面附近一层之外保持这些对称性，且该层宽度在 n_* 处以 BKT 标度发散。因此 Rényi 熵的普适项在 n_* 处跳变为对称破缺缺陷的值。我们在 AdS5 的 probe Abelian Higgs 模型 Bogomolny 点展示此机制，给出闭式鞍点和缺陷数据以及数值流。对于球，我们证明正的无源流恰好当 n>n_* 且半径足够大时存在，并且随半径增大终止于对称破缺缺陷。
classification.one_liner: 全息 Rényi 缺陷在共形性丧失时把显式 U(1) 破缺转变为自发破缺，并在临界指标处产生 BKT 标度和 Rényi 熵普适项跳变。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及全息带电标量凝聚、缺陷上的相变与对称性破缺，与用户关注的全息超流超导、相变及非均匀凝聚态支线相关。

papers.title: Transgression branes in seven dimensions
papers.abstract: A seven dimensional theory with branes, described by a Transgression Action is investigated. The theory has special properties owing to the factorization of the trace used to define the Transgression form. It is shown that in some cases the theory is similar to the models of branes proposed by Nepomechie, Wu and Zee as a higher dimensional generalization of models of particles with fractional statistics of Wilczek, Wu and Zee. Static Euclidean solutions are presented, and compared with similar solutions of Nepomechie,Wu and Zee. Then Lorentzian static solutions are considered, based in solutions of constant curvature black holes presented by Ba\~nados and further studied by Guilleminot, Olea and Petrov. Topological phases and their implications for quantum statistics are discussed.

classification.title_zh: 七维中的 Transgression 膜
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究七维中由 Transgression 作用量描述、包含膜的理论。由于定义 Transgression 形式的迹可因子化，该理论具有特殊性质。文中表明在某些情形下该理论与 Nepomechie、Wu 和 Zee 提出的膜模型相似，后者是 Wilczek、Wu 和 Zee 分数统计粒子模型的高维推广。文章给出静态欧氏解，并与 Nepomechie、Wu 和 Zee 的类似解比较；随后考虑洛伦兹静态解，其基于 Bañados 提出并由 Guilleminot、Olea 和 Petrov 进一步研究的常曲率黑洞解。文中还讨论拓扑相及其对量子统计的含义。
classification.one_liner: 研究七维 Transgression 膜作用量、静态解与拓扑相。
classification.relevance_reason: 文章包含静态黑洞解，触及经典引力/广义相对论支线，但主焦点为七维膜与拓扑相，与其他全息支线无关，故相关性低。

papers.title: Exact holographic superfluid at the Bogomolny point: transport, large charge, and R\'enyi entropies
papers.abstract: The probe-limit Abelian Higgs model in AdS$_5$ is a standard holographic model of a strongly coupled superfluid, usually solved numerically. With the scalar mass at the Breitenlohner-Freedman bound and the quartic coupling at the Bogomolny value, its condensed phase has a closed form on every static, uncharged AdS$_5$ background with maximally symmetric spatial sections. We prove that it is the global minimum of the free energy at fixed charge, and linearly stable, as is any nodeless condensate of the model in standard quantization with nonnegative quartic coupling and no superflow. On the planar black brane it is the superfluid at all temperatures below $T_c$: the superfluid fraction follows the Gorter-Casimir two-fluid law exactly, and the speed and attenuation of sound are in closed form. In global AdS$_5$ it is the lowest state of charge $Q$ on $\mathbb{R}\times S^3$ within the model, with its scaling dimension in closed form at all $Q$, classically in the bulk. Its excitations include towers, from an infrared fixed point of the probe sector, that the superfluid effective theory does not describe. On the hyperbolic black holes that compute charged R\'enyi entropies of a ball, it is a homogeneous hairy phase whose condensate does not fall off toward the entangling surface. With a pinning field there, the phase sets in at R\'enyi index exactly one at zero chemical potential, as found for a neutral scalar. Well below a bound on the quartic coupling, the static, homogeneous solutions computed at other couplings and masses keep an infrared fixed point with towers, but not the exact two-fluid law.

classification.title_zh: Bogomolny 点上的精确全息超流：输运、大电荷与 Rényi 熵
classification.abstract_zh: AdS5 中探针极限的 Abelian Higgs 模型是强耦合超流体的标准全息模型，通常需数值求解。当标量质量取 Breitenlohner-Freedman 界、四次耦合取 Bogomolny 值时，其凝聚相在具有最大对称空间截面的每个静态、不带电 AdS5 背景上都有闭式表达式。我们证明它在固定电荷下是自由能的全局最小，并且线性稳定；该模型中标准量子化、非负四次耦合且无超流的任何无节点凝聚也都如此。在平面黑洞膜上，它在所有低于 Tc 的温度下都是超流体：超流组分精确遵循 Gorter-Casimir 双流体定律，声速和衰减有闭式形式。在整体 AdS5 中，它是模型内 R×S3 上电荷 Q 的最低态，其标度维数在所有 Q 下都有闭式形式（体中是经典结果）。其激发包括来自探针部分红外不动点的塔，而超流有效理论不描述这些塔。在计算球的带电 Rényi 熵的双曲黑洞上，它是均匀有毛相，其凝聚不向纠缠面衰减。若在该处加钉扎场，则在零化学势下相恰在 Rényi 指数为一处出现，与中性标量的结果相同。远低于四次耦合的某个界时，在其他耦合和质量下计算的静态均匀解仍保留带塔的红外不动点，但不保留精确的双流体定律。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS5 探针 Abelian Higgs 模型的 Bogomolny 点得到闭式全息超流解，并证明其稳定性、导出精确双流体输运、大电荷标度维数及带电 Rényi 熵行为。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究全息超流体的精确解析解、稳定性、输运性质与 Rényi 熵，与重点标签“全息超流超导”高度契合；但未涉及 p 波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace 或 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜等支线。

papers.title: Beyond the Fock Vacuum in Finite-$N$ Bilocal Algebras of Vector Models
papers.abstract: We discuss the finite-$N$ Hilbert space of bilocal operators that underlies bilocal holography of vector models, beyond the sector built on the Fock vacuum. If the microscopic oscillator Fock space carries a multiplicity-free dual action of a compact color group $G$ and a bilocal algebra, Howe duality implies that projection to the derived subgroup $[G,G]$ selects precisely the characters of the abelianization $G^{\rm ab}=G/[G,G]$ that occur in the Fock space. Thus $O(N)/SO(N)=\mathbb Z_2$ gives two sectors, $U(N)/SU(N)=U(1)$ gives integer determinant-charge sectors, while $Sp(N)$ is perfect and gives no additional sector; Bose/Fermi statistics and the number of modes determine which sectors are actually realized. We construct the epsilon and determinant backgrounds that generate these sectors, together with their finite-$N$ constraints and Casimirs, and find that the two bosonic $O(N)$ sectors are not distinguished by any Casimir. Using group-integral projectors, we derive explicit sector-resolved characters for the $O(N)$ and $U(N)$ theories. Around each new background we solve the constraints with auxiliary oscillators, which form a Fermi sea for bosonic matter. In the free vector model on $\mathbb R\times S^2$ the lowest states in the new sectors are baryonic primaries; we determine their energies, degeneracies and spin content exactly at finite $N$, together with their lowest energy at fixed angular momentum.

classification.title_zh: 超越Fock真空：矢量模型有限N双局域代数
classification.abstract_zh: 讨论矢量模型双局域全息所依赖的有限N双局域算符希尔伯特空间，超越建立在Fock真空上的扇区。若微观振子Fock空间带有紧致色群G与双局域代数的无重数对偶作用，Howe对偶表明投影到导群[G,G]会精确选出Fock空间中出现的阿贝尔化G^ab=G/[G,G]的特征。因此O(N)/SO(N)=Z2给出两个扇区，U(N)/SU(N)=U(1)给出整数行列式荷扇区，而Sp(N)为完美群不给出额外扇区；Bose/Fermi统计和模数决定实际实现的扇区。我们构造产生这些扇区的epsilon与行列式背景及其有限N约束和Casimir，发现O(N)的两个玻色扇区不被任何Casimir区分。利用群积分投影子，导出O(N)和U(N)理论的显式分扇区特征。围绕每个新背景，用辅助振子求解约束，这些振子对玻色物质形成Fermi海。在R×S^2上的自由矢量模型中，新扇区最低态为重子原初态；我们精确确定其在有限N下的能量、简并度和自旋内容，以及固定角动量下的最低能量。
classification.one_liner: 研究矢量模型双局域全息中有限N希尔伯特空间的新扇区，用Howe对偶和群积分投影构造O(N)/U(N)背景并精确求解低激发态。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息对偶基础与字典的正式研究，涉及矢量模型双局域全息的有限N结构；但未直接涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、探针膜、QNM、气泡成核或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Mapping AdS$_4$ quantum gravity via the Bethe Ansatz formula
papers.abstract: The topologically twisted index of 3d ADHM theory can be written as a sum over solutions to the Bethe Ansatz Equations (BAEs) of the XXZ-type model constructed from quantum toroidal $\mathfrak{gl}_1$. Via a novel numerical algorithm, we solve for all $p(N)$ physical solutions at $N\leq 21$, where $p(N)$ denotes the number of partitions of $N$. Surveying these solutions, we find that in addition to the known "1-cut" solution dual to dyonic black holes, where the gauge holonomies are distributed along a single curve in the complex plane, there are "dressed" 1-cut solutions dual to combined configurations of the black hole and M2-branes, $m$-cut solutions dual to $\mathbb{Z}_m$ orbifolds of the black hole, a discrete family of solutions interpolating between the 1-cut and 3-cut solutions whose bulk dual is not yet identified, together with other exotic solutions, at each value of $N$. We show that the $1,2,3$-cut solutions and interpolating solutions all have a well-defined large $N$ limit, and analytically compute their leading order distribution of gauge holonomies. Whenever possible, we fit the contributions of the solutions to the index to all orders in the $1/N$ expansion with high-precision numerics, and extract the leading non-perturbative correction. With exceptions, these are matched with the results of equivariant localization in the bulk, and the action of wrapped M2-branes respectively.

classification.title_zh: 通过Bethe Ansatz公式映射AdS4量子引力
classification.abstract_zh: 3d ADHM理论的拓扑扭化指标可写成由量子环面gl1构造的XXZ型模型Bethe Ansatz方程解之和。本文用新的数值算法求解N≤21时全部p(N)个物理解，其中p(N)为N的分拆数。遍历这些解后，除已知对偶于双荷黑洞的“1-cut”解外，还发现对偶于黑洞与M2膜组合的“dressed”1-cut解、对偶于黑洞Z_m orbifold的m-cut解、在1-cut与3-cut之间插值且体对偶尚未确定的离散解族，以及其他奇异解。作者证明1、2、3-cut解和插值解都有良好定义的大N极限，并解析计算其规范holonomy的领头分布。在可能时，用高精度数值将各解对指标的贡献按1/N展开拟合到全阶，并提取领头非微扰修正；这些修正大多分别与体中等变局域化结果及包裹M2膜作用量相符。
classification.one_liner: 系统求解并分类3d ADHM理论拓扑扭化指标的Bethe Ansatz解，将其对应到AdS4量子引力中的黑洞、M2膜、orbifold及插值等鞍点。

papers.title: Boundary preparation of strong Mpemba states in holography
papers.abstract: We study the boundary preparation of strong Mpemba states in a probe Abelian Higgs model on a fixed AdS black brane. Different drives ending at the same charge density can prepare states with different slow mode amplitudes. Two pulses cancel the slowest mode at linear order, but charge exchange during preparation and radial Maxwell feedback regenerate a slow tail at cubic order. We derive the complete cubic response from the lower order field equations, including feedback after source removal, and use it to predict a compensating pulse. Full nonlinear evolution confirms that the compensation reduces the residual slow amplitude from third to fifth order in the source strength. For a representative protocol, the slow amplitude is reduced by a factor of about 600 relative to linear cancellation. This extends the fast relaxation window without changing the final quasinormal mode spectrum. Further nonlinear tuning suppresses the estimated residual amplitude to the level of numerical resolution. The prepared states can overtake a weakly driven reference despite having a larger excess free energy at source removal. Three pulses also suppress a second slow channel over the resolved time window and reveal interference between faster modes. Starting from a common initial state, controls with zero net charge transfer reach a given relaxation threshold sooner than passive relaxation, even when the full control duration is included.

classification.title_zh: 全息中强 Mpemba 态的边界制备
classification.abstract_zh: 研究在固定 AdS 黑膜上的探针阿贝尔希格斯模型中强 Mpemba 态的边界制备。不同驱动终止于相同电荷密度时，可制备具有不同慢模振幅的态。两脉冲在线性阶消除最慢模，但制备过程中的电荷交换和径向 Maxwell 反馈会在三次阶重新产生慢尾。我们从低阶场方程推导完整的立方响应，包括源移除后的反馈，并用它预测补偿脉冲。完整非线性演化证实，补偿将残余慢振幅从源强度的三阶降低到五阶。对一个代表性协议，慢振幅相对线性抵消减小约 600 倍。这扩展了快弛豫窗口而不改变最终准正规模谱。进一步的非线性调谐将估计的残余振幅压到数值分辨率水平。所制备的态尽管在源移除时具有更大的超额自由能，仍可超过弱驱动参考态。三脉冲也在分辨的时间窗口内抑制第二个慢通道，并揭示更快模式之间的干涉。从共同初始态出发，零净电荷转移的控制即使计入完整控制时长，也比被动弛豫更早达到给定弛豫阈值。
classification.one_liner: 在探针 AdS 阿贝尔希格斯模型中，通过边界驱动与三次非线性补偿制备强 Mpemba 态，显著抑制慢模并加速弛豫。

papers.title: All Order Gravitational Wave Tails from Classical Soft Theorem for Subleading Post-Newtonian Expansion
papers.abstract: The low-frequency gravitational waveform emitted in a classical scattering process contains an infinite tower of late- and early-time tail terms of the form $u^{-r}(\ln|u|)^{r-1}$, $r \geq 1$. In the Newtonian limit, the coefficients of this entire tower have recently been shown to be universal, i.e. fixed by the asymptotic data of the scattering objects alone. At the retained order in the velocity expansion, these leading-logarithmic tails are determined to all orders in Newton's constant $G$. We extend this result to the first subleading order in the post-Newtonian expansion of the asymptotic states. We consider scattering of an arbitrary number of incoming and outgoing nonrelativistic objects interacting only through gravity at long range, and we derive the complete tower of tail terms at this order. The correction arises from the first subleading term in the retardation expansion and is determined by the asymptotic Newtonian trajectories of the massive particles. Its coefficients are again determined entirely by the asymptotic trajectories and are independent of the details of the interaction. For $2\to2$ scattering, the leading-logarithmic series can be summed in closed form. Our results agree with a relativistic conjecture proposed in earlier work arXiv:2610.07134.

classification.title_zh: 次领头后牛顿展开下经典软定理给出的全阶引力波尾
classification.abstract_zh: 经典散射过程中发射的低频引力波形包含形式为 u^{-r}(\ln|u|)^{r-1}, r≥1 的无限多个晚时和早时尾项。在牛顿极限下，最近已证明整个尾项塔的系数是普适的，即仅由散射天体的渐近数据决定。在速度展开中保留的阶上，这些领头对数尾项被确定到牛顿常数 G 的所有阶。我们将其结果推广到渐近态的后牛顿展开的第一个次领头阶。我们考虑任意数量入射和出射非相对论物体的散射，这些物体仅在长程上通过引力相互作用，并推导出该阶的完整尾项塔。修正来自延迟展开中的第一个次领头项，并由大质量粒子的渐近牛顿轨迹决定。其系数同样完全由渐近轨迹决定，且与相互作用细节无关。对于 2→2 散射，领头对数级数可以闭式求和。我们的结果与早期工作 arXiv:2610.07134 中提出的相对论性猜想一致。
classification.one_liner: 将经典软定理给出的普适引力波尾项塔从牛顿极限推广到后牛顿展开的次领头阶。

papers.title: Post-Newtonian theory in de Sitter and anti-de Sitter spacetimes
papers.abstract: We develop the post-Newtonian framework for the near-zone dynamics of a binary in de Sitter and anti-de Sitter spacetime. We consider a binary interacting via a free scalar field in a fixed (A)dS background in $D+1$ spacetime dimensions, with $D\ge3$ and odd. Using a novel multipole re-summation technique, we solve for the field degrees of freedom to obtain an effective particle description in the form of a Fokker action. We derive the equations of motion for the binary up to second post-Newtonian (2PN) order, and obtain the corresponding 2PN Hamiltonian and conserved charges in phase space. We show that the conformal algebra, corresponding to the isometry algebra of the (A)dS background, is realised in phase space as a curvature-dependent deformation of the Poincare algebra at each PN order. This serves as a non-trivial check on our results. Our results provide a systematic extension of post-Newtonian effective dynamics to finite-curvature backgrounds. This could serve as a useful framework for studying bound-state dynamics in (A)dS as well as in the corresponding holographic CFT.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 与 anti-de Sitter 时空中的后牛顿理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为 de Sitter 和 anti-de Sitter 时空中双星的近区动力学建立后牛顿框架。考虑 D+1 维固定 (A)dS 背景中通过自由标量场相互作用的双星，其中 D≥3 且为奇数。利用一种新的多极重求和技术求解场自由度，得到 Fokker 作用量形式的有效粒子描述。我们推导至二阶后牛顿（2PN）阶的运动方程，并获得相应的 2PN Hamiltonian 与相空间守恒荷。我们证明，对应于 (A)dS 背景等距代数的共形代数在相空间中实现为每个 PN 阶的曲率依赖 Poincaré 代数形变，这作为对结果的非平凡检验。我们的结果将后牛顿有效动力学系统扩展到有限曲率背景，可作为研究 (A)dS 中束缚态动力学以及相应全息 CFT 的有用框架。
classification.one_liner: 在固定 (A)dS 背景中建立双星 2PN 有效动力学，并显示共形等距代数在相空间中的曲率形变实现。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为 (A)dS 固定背景中的经典后牛顿二体动力学，属于经典引力；摘要仅在结尾提及可作为全息 CFT 中束缚态研究的框架，未实际进行全息计算。

papers.title: Holographic Pseudo Entropy from the Rindler Method in AdS and Flat Space
papers.abstract: Via the Rindler method, we study holographic timelike entanglement entropy (TEE) for a general timelike interval in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ and flat$_3$/CCFT$_2$. The TEE is the pseudo entropy of a timelike interval. In the bulk, the imaginary part of the TEE comes from a timelike geodesic. After a Rindler transformation to a rotating BTZ black hole, the two spacelike extremal curves lie on the inner and outer horizons, and exchanging $l_u\leftrightarrow \ell l_\phi$ takes one to the other. We clarify the geometric role of the timelike extremal curve in the Rindler frame. We show that it is the line $\tilde U=\tilde V=0$ stretched between the two horizons, starting on the inner horizon, touching the outer horizon at its midpoint, and returning to the inner one. No such curve exists outside the region between the horizons. Its length, $i\pi\ell$, is independent of the interval, and it alone produces the imaginary part $i\pi c/6$. We follow the same procedure in flat space holography, where the spacelike curve sits on the cosmological horizon and the timelike curve lies between the cosmological horizon and timelike infinity. Evaluating the holographic TEE for a timelike interval in CCFT$_2$ on the plane, we find that, in contrast with the cylinder, the real and imaginary parts are equal.

classification.title_zh: AdS 与平直空间中 Rindler 方法下的全息伪熵
classification.abstract_zh: 本文用 Rindler 方法研究 AdS3/CFT2 与平直3/CCFT2 中一般类时间隔的全息类时纠缠熵（TEE），即类时间隔的伪熵。体时 TEE 的虚部来自类时测地线；经 Rindler 变换到旋转 BTZ 黑洞后，两条类空极值曲线分别位于内外视界，交换 l_u 与 ℓ l_φ 可互换。作者澄清了 Rindler 框架中类时极值曲线的几何角色：它是两视界间 Ũ=Ṽ=0 的线，从内视界出发、在中点触及外视界并返回内视界；视界之间区域外不存在此类曲线。其长度为 iπℓ，与间隔无关，并单独给出虚部 iπc/6。平直空间全息中同样地，类空曲线位于宇宙视界，类时曲线位于宇宙视界与类时无穷之间。计算平面上 CCFT2 的类时间隔全息 TEE 发现，与柱面情形不同，实部与虚部相等。
classification.one_liner: 用 Rindler 方法在 AdS3 与平直3 全息中计算类时间隔的伪熵，并给出类时极值曲线的几何解释。

papers.title: Modular Flow and Holographic Timelike Entanglement Entropy in AdS and Flat Holography
papers.abstract: Timelike entanglement entropy provides a useful probe of holographic theories, yet an explicit bulk realization of the modular flow underlying its timelike extremal curve construction has so far been lacking. We construct modular flows associated with spacelike and timelike intervals in AdS$_{3}$/CFT$_{2}$ and extend this framework to flat$_{3}$/CCFT$_{2}$. Beginning with the boundary symmetry generators, we explicitly derive the boundary modular flows and extend them into the bulk, providing a systematic procedure that relates bulk modular flows to the extremal curves and holographic (timelike) entanglement entropy. For spacelike intervals, the resulting bulk modular flows determine the extremal curves, whose integrated line elements reproduce the standard holographic entanglement entropy. We then generalize this approach to timelike intervals, explicitly constructing the modular flows whose fixed points reproduce the extremal spacelike and timelike curves, which give the holographic timelike entanglement entropy. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first explicit construction of the modular flow associated with a timelike extremal curve for a timelike interval. The same procedure is then carried over to flat$_{3}$/CCFT$_{2}$, which gives rise to the holographic (timelike) entanglement entropy. Finally, we show that the flat space results obtained in this work can be recovered from their AdS$_3$ counterparts in the flat space limit.

classification.title_zh: AdS与平直全息中的模流与全息类时纠缠熵
classification.abstract_zh: 类时纠缠熵为全息理论提供了有用探针，但其类时极值曲线构造背后的模流一直缺乏明确的体实现。我们在 AdS3/CFT2 中构造与类空间隔和类时间隔相关的模流，并将框架推广到 flat3/CCFT2。从边界对称性生成元出发，显式推导边界模流并将其延拓到体，给出将体模流与极值曲线及全息（类时）纠缠熵联系起来的系统程序。对于类空间隔，所得体模流决定极值曲线，其线元积分重现标准全息纠缠熵。随后推广到类时间隔，显式构造其不动点重现极值类空与类时曲线的模流，这些曲线给出全息类时纠缠熵。据我们所知，这是首次显式构造与类时间隔的类时极值曲线相关的模流。相同程序随后用于 flat3/CCFT2，得到全息（类时）纠缠熵。最后，展示本文得到的平直空间结果可由 AdS3 对应结果在平直空间极限下恢复。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3/CFT2 与 flat3/CCFT2 中显式构造边界/体模流，并联系类空与类时全息纠缠熵。

papers.title: $q$-deformed Weil-Petersson volumes from the spectral edge of DSSYK and supersymmetric extensions
papers.abstract: The $q$-deformed Weil-Petersson volumes of Do and Norbury are the top-degree parts of Okuyama's discrete volumes, which are defined by topological recursion on the spectral curve of the double-scaled SYK (DSSYK) model. We show that the same $q$-deformed volumes can also be obtained from a double-scaled matrix model whose disk density is found by zooming in on the soft edges of the DSSYK density. Applying the same procedure to the hard edge of $\mathcal{N}=1$ DSSYK, we obtain candidate $q$-deformed $\mathcal{N}=1$ super Weil-Petersson volumes. They are polynomials of fixed degree, and they reduce to $\mathcal{N}=1$ super Weil-Petersson volumes in a scaled $q\to1$ limit. These candidate volumes differ from the $\mathcal{N}=1$ volumes of Do and Norbury in (arXiv:2510.12431) up to what we call ``irrelevant'' contributions which exactly vanish in the scaled $q\to 1$ limit. Together, these results demonstrate how $q$-deformed volumes can be naturally associated to the spectral edges of various DSSYK models and provides an intuitive way to construct them in supersymmetric contexts.

classification.title_zh: 从 DSSYK 谱边缘得到的 q-变形 Weil-Petersson 体积及其超对称扩展
classification.abstract_zh: Do 和 Norbury 的 q-变形 Weil-Petersson 体积是 Okuyama 离散体积的最高次数部分，后者由双标度 SYK（DSSYK）模型谱曲线上的拓扑递归定义。我们证明，同样的 q-变形体积也可由双标度矩阵模型得到，其圆盘密度通过放大 DSSYK 密度的软边缘求得。将同一步骤应用于 N=1 DSSYK 的硬边缘，我们得到候选的 q-变形 N=1 超 Weil-Petersson 体积。它们是固定次数的多项式，并在缩放的 q→1 极限下约化为 N=1 超 Weil-Petersson 体积。这些候选体积与 Do 和 Norbury 在 (arXiv:2510.12431) 中的 N=1 体积相差我们称为“无关”的贡献，这些贡献在缩放的 q→1 极限下精确消失。这些结果共同表明，q-变形体积如何自然地与各种 DSSYK 模型的谱边缘相联系，并提供了一种在超对称情境中构造它们的直观方式。
classification.one_liner: 论文证明 q-变形 Weil-Petersson 体积可从 DSSYK 密度谱边缘的双标度矩阵模型导出，并构造 N=1 超对称候选体积。

papers.title: Trinity of Carrollian Gravity: Dynamically Equivalent Formulations of Magnetic Carrollian Gravity
papers.abstract: In this paper, we extend the paradigm of the Geometrical Trinity of Gravity to the Carrollian geometry to construct a comprehensive framework of dynamically equivalent theories for Magnetic Carrollian gravity. Utilizing the inherent ambiguities and freedoms of affine connections on degenerate metrics, we systematically relax the metric-compatibility and zero-torsion constraints of the rigid magnetic sector. By imposing global flatness on these modified connections, we prove that the curvature of a Magnetic Carrollian universe can be dynamically traded for isolated kinetic energy densities of torsion and non-metricity. Unlike the Lorentzian Trinity which maps gravity to alternative gravitational frameworks, the Carrollian equivalences can also map spacetime geometry to non-gravitational theories. Specifically, we demonstrate that intrinsic torsion recovers Electric Carrollian gravity as the Teleparallel equivalent of Magnetic Carroll gravity; purely spatial torsion reproduces kinetic terms stracturally similar to the magnetic Hamiltonian of scalar-charge Fracton gauge theory; and temporal torsion sectors map independently to $U(1)$ Maxwell electric fields and Carroll-Weyl conformal dilaton theories. Finally, by formulating a Symmetric Teleparallel Carroll connection with minimal non-metricity, we show that the Magnetic Carrollian Lagrangian is dynamically equivalent to an ultralocal, isotropic Electric Carrollian gravity upon exploiting the present freedoms in connection. These results establish a geometric dictionary translating Carrollian gravitational dynamics into the language of tensor gauge theories, electromagnetism, and dilaton theory.

classification.title_zh: Carroll引力的三位一体：磁Carroll引力的动力学等价表述
classification.abstract_zh: 本文将引力几何三位一体推广到Carroll几何，以构造磁Carroll引力的动力学等价理论框架。利用退化度规上仿射联络的歧义与自由度，系统放松刚性磁部门的度规相容性和零挠率约束。通过要求修改后的联络全局平坦，证明磁Carroll宇宙的曲率可以动力学地替换为挠率和非度规性的孤立动能密度。与洛伦兹三位一体将引力映射到替代引力框架不同，Carroll等价也可将时空几何映射到非引力理论。具体而言，内禀挠率给出电Carroll引力作为磁Carroll引力的远平行等价；纯空间挠率重现结构上类似标量电荷fracton规范理论磁哈密顿量的动能项；时间挠率部分分别独立映射到U(1) Maxwell电场和Carroll-Weyl共形膨胀子理论。最后，通过构造具有最小非度规性的对称远平行Carroll联络，表明在利用现有联络自由度后，磁Carroll拉格朗日量动力学等价于超局域、各向同性的电Carroll引力。这些结果建立了几何词典，将Carroll引力动力学翻译为张量规范理论、电磁学和膨胀子理论的语言。
classification.one_liner: 把引力几何三位一体推广到Carroll几何，证明磁Carroll引力可等价改写为挠率/非度规性、fracton型张量规范场、Maxwell场与膨胀子理论。

papers.title: Relative entropy of entanglement and tripartite minimal surface
papers.abstract: We propose a holographic dual of the relative entropy of entanglement for a boundary tripartition $A:B:C$. Our proposal is that, at the leading order, \begin{align} E_R(\rho_{AB}) = \frac{1}{4G_N}\Big[\mathrm{Area}(\Gamma_{\min}) - \mathrm{Area}(\gamma_{AB})\Big] \notag \end{align} where $\Gamma_{\min}$ is the minimal bulk tripartition surface and $\gamma_{AB}$ is the minimal surface homologous to $AB$. For a general random tensor network, we prove the corresponding upper bound by constructing a separable state associated with $\Gamma_{\min}$ and evaluating its relative entropy. We also establish the matching lower bound rigorously for networks of one, two, and three Haar random tensors by bounding the maximal tripartite product-state overlap. In appropriate geometries, the minimal tripartition surface can form a nontrivial tri-junction resembling the Mercedes logo.

classification.title_zh: 相对纠缠熵与三部分极小曲面
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为边界三分 A:B:C 的纠缠相对熵提出全息对偶。我们的提议是，在领头阶，E_R(ρ_AB)=1/(4G_N)[Area(Γ_min)-Area(γ_AB)]，其中 Γ_min 是体内部极小三分曲面，γ_AB 是与 AB 同调的极小曲面。对于一般随机张量网络，我们通过构造与 Γ_min 相关的可分态并计算其相对熵，证明了相应的上界。我们还通过界定最大三分乘积态重叠，对一、二、三个 Haar 随机张量网络严格建立了匹配的下界。在适当的几何中，极小三分曲面可以形成类似梅赛德斯标志的非平凡三交界面。
classification.one_liner: 提出边界三分纠缠相对熵的全息对偶，并用随机张量网络证明上下界，揭示三交界面结构。

papers.title: Holography for integrable field theories
papers.abstract: We develop a holographic dual to the integrable field theories built from $4d$ Chern-Simons theory. The dual theory is a topological string on a generalized Calabi-Yau manifold, which is entirely encoded in a geometric object we call a planar spectral curve. We describe the RG flow for a planar integrable field theory as a geometric flow on the moduli of planar spectral curves. This description is valid at all orders in the 't Hooft coupling. We compute this flow explicitly up to two loops in many examples, and find an exact match with known field theory results. At one loop this includes a wide class of models. At two loops we reproduce the RG flow for the principal chiral model with WZ term, and for a class of integrable $\sigma$-models with target $U(N) \times U(N)$.

classification.title_zh: 可积场论的全息对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为由四维Chern-Simons理论构建的可积场论发展了一个全息对偶。对偶理论是广义Calabi-Yau流形上的拓扑弦，它完全编码在一个我们称为平面谱曲线的几何对象中。我们将平面可积场论的重整化群流描述为平面谱曲线模空间上的几何流。该描述在't Hooft耦合的所有阶都有效。我们在许多例子中显式计算该流至两圈，并发现与已知场论结果精确匹配。一圈时这包括一大类模型。两圈时我们重现了带WZ项的主手征模型以及一类目标为U(N)×U(N)的可积sigma模型的RG流。
classification.one_liner: 文章提出基于四维Chern-Simons理论的可积场论全息对偶，用拓扑弦和平面谱曲线几何描述RG流并进行两圈验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于可积场论的全息对偶与拓扑弦方向，不直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、探针膜、相变气泡成核、QNM或经典引力等主题。

papers.title: Metric Source Completions and Integrability in Celestial Gravity
papers.abstract: Opposite-helicity soft limits carry ordering information, whereas a metric generating functional has a symmetric mixed response. We compare these structures for Einstein tree amplitudes, retaining the full momentum-conservation distribution. Normalized transport of primary sources fixes the metric response, and a common Banerjee--Pasterski prescription fixes the two ordered scattering currents on compact regular hard packets. At the reference metric, both ordered scattering responses agree with the transport Hessian, so the two matching defects vanish separately. A four-hard-particle example displays the same nonzero recoil coefficient in both orders and in the transport Hessian; an overlapping-source packet resolves the lower-order spin-frame contact. Six-graviton factorization independently tests the recoil and undifferentiated coefficients of the ordering difference. At seven points, angular integration produces a nonzero relative current whose connector variation contains a conjugate bulk term. We derive this term and its cancellation under coherent transport; global cubic scattering matching still requires the physical Ward comparison on the remaining singular overlaps. Transporting the states, kernels and inverse chains together gives a finite Ward identity and coefficientwise reconstruction for that chosen family. Regular packets leave extensions supported solely on excluded hard--hard coincidences undetermined, and the vacuum functional, independent of the hard sources, remains free.

classification.title_zh: 天球引力中的度规源补全与可积性
classification.abstract_zh: 相反螺旋度的软极限携带次序信息，而度规生成泛函具有对称的混合响应。我们比较 Einstein 树振幅中的这些结构，并保留完整的动量守恒分布。初级源的归一化输运固定度规响应，而共同的 Banerjee–Pasterski 处方在紧致正则硬包上固定两个有序散射流。在参考度规处，两个有序散射响应都与输运 Hessian 一致，因此两个匹配缺陷分别消失。四硬粒子例子在两种次序以及输运 Hessian 中显示相同的非零反冲系数；重叠源包解决了低阶自旋标架接触项。六引力子因子化独立检验次序差的反冲系数与未微分系数。在七点，角积分产生非零相对流，其连接变分包含一个共轭体项。我们导出该项及其在相干输运下的抵消；全局三次散射匹配仍需要对剩余奇异重叠做物理 Ward 比较。将态、核和逆链一起输运会给出有限 Ward 恒等式，并对所选族做逐系数重构。正则包使仅支撑在被排除的硬-硬重合上的延拓保持未定，而不依赖硬源的真空泛函仍自由。
classification.one_liner: 在天球引力框架下比较相反螺旋度软极限的有序结构与度规源补全，并检验 Einstein 树振幅的匹配、Ward 恒等式与逐系数重构。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题属于天球/平直时空全息与引力散射振幅，未涉及用户重点的全息超流、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7 或经典 GR 分支。

papers.title: Critical and multicritical Kasner scaling in holographic phase transitions
papers.abstract: We study how holographic phase transitions imprint their scaling laws on the local Kasner geometry inside Einstein-scalar black holes. At fixed double-trace coupling, we derive the near-critical scaling of the deviation of the first-epoch Kasner exponent from the Schwarzschild value: $p_t^{(1)}+\frac{1}{3} \propto O^2 \propto (T_c-T)^{1/r}$, where $O$ denotes the boundary condensate and $r$ labels ordinary criticality ($r=1$), tricriticality ($r=2$), and higher multicriticality ($r\geq3$). A super-exponential scalar potential generates a sequence of Kasner epochs separated by scalar-field bounces. We further find that any later epoch that can be tracked continuously across the transition inherits the same temperature exponent, while its coefficient depends on the epoch. Numerical solutions confirm these predictions for the ordinary and tricritical cases. Finally, we show analytically that the leading irrelevant exponent of the infrared fixed point governs the low-temperature Kasner scaling, and verify the resulting scaling numerically for the first Kasner exponent.

classification.title_zh: 全息相变中的临界与多临界 Kasner 标度
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究全息相变如何把标度律印刻到 Einstein-scalar 黑洞内部的局部 Kasner 几何上。固定双迹耦合时，导出第一 Kasner epoch 指数相对 Schwarzschild 值偏离的近临界标度 p_t^(1)+1/3 ∝ O^2 ∝ (T_c-T)^{1/r}，其中 O 为边界凝聚，r=1,2,≥3 分别对应普通临界、三临界和更高多临界。超指数标量势产生由标量场反弹分隔的一系列 Kasner epoch。进一步发现，任何可连续跨越相变追踪的后续 epoch 继承相同温度指数，但系数依赖 epoch。数值解验证普通与三临界情形。最后解析证明红外不动点的领头无关指数控制低温 Kasner 标度，并对第一 Kasner 指数数值验证。
classification.one_liner: 固定双迹耦合下，全息临界/多临界相变的凝聚标度决定黑洞内部 Kasner 指数偏离，并延续到后续 epoch 与低温标度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究双迹耦合下全息临界/多临界相变及 Kasner 标度，命中 multi-trace、相变与经典引力支线；但不涉及超流/p波/探针膜等其它重点。

papers.title: Krylov complexity and spectral density of BMN matrix model
papers.abstract: We use Krylov complexity as a typical diagnostic of quantum many body dynamics in the context of BMN matrix model at large mass gap. We calculate several physical entities, for example, the moments and return amplitudes at large mass deformation. We calculate them for both spread complexity of states as well as Krylov growth of operators in the matrix model. We propose a general expression for the moments at any given order $n$. We also discuss orthogonal polynomials for spread as well as operator Krylov complexity. In the context of the Krylov operator growth we further compute the spectral function and the density of states. A careful analysis of the spectral function near the resonance reveals various IR divergences in addition to the physical collective modes. These collective modes appear to be exceptionally stable due to large mass gap. On the other hand, the UV of the theory appears to be extremely damped due to higher scattering rates. We carefully diagnose these IR divergences near resonance which reveals that these collective modes are in fact non-propagating and should be thought of as diffusion modes or relaxation modes with infinite relaxation time. We also calculate the Krylov variance and Krylov entropy for the matrix model and in particular at early time. The linear early time growth of the Krylov entropy confirms the onset of quantum chaos in the matrix model at large mass gap.

classification.title_zh: BMN矩阵模型的Krylov复杂度与谱密度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在BMN矩阵模型大质量间隙背景下，将Krylov复杂度作为量子多体动力学的典型诊断量。计算大质量变形下的矩和回归振幅等物理量，涵盖态的扩展复杂度与算符的Krylov增长。我们给出任意n阶矩的一般表达式，并讨论扩展复杂度与算符Krylov复杂度的正交多项式。在算符Krylov增长语境下，进一步计算谱函数和态密度。对共振附近谱函数的细致分析揭示出除物理集体模式外的多种红外发散；这些集体模式因大质量间隙而异常稳定，而理论的紫外因更高散射率而极度阻尼。我们仔细诊断共振附近的红外发散，表明这些集体模式实际上非传播，应视为具有无限弛豫时间的扩散或弛豫模式。我们还计算矩阵模型的Krylov方差与Krylov熵，特别是在早期；Krylov熵的线性早期增长证实大质量间隙下矩阵模型中量子混沌的出现。
classification.one_liner: 利用Krylov复杂度研究大质量间隙BMN矩阵模型的量子多体动力学、谱函数、集体模式与量子混沌。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文主题为BMN矩阵模型的Krylov复杂度、谱密度与量子混沌，与用户重点列出的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜及经典引力等支线无直接交集。

papers.title: Projections and topological classification of black hole thermodynamics
papers.abstract: Black hole thermodynamic topology has evolved from classifications based on global topological numbers to more refined schemes including boundary behavior. This development motivates a deeper question: how are different topological manifestations connected within the complete thermodynamic structure? In this paper, we propose the thermodynamic projection conjecture, which seeks to address this question by examining different topological manifestations in the context of the complete thermodynamic structure and exploring their underlying physical connections and formation mechanisms. As a representative application of this idea, we investigate temperature-dependent thermodynamic topological phase transitions, in which the topological number varies with temperature while the physical parameters are held fixed. We examine how the complete thermodynamic structure gives rise to different topological outcomes on different temperature slices. Our results demonstrate that temperature-dependent thermodynamic topological phase transitions arise from boundary effects, whereas the pairwise generation or annihilation of equilibrium states in the interior leaves the total topological number unchanged. These results establish that, at fixed physical parameters, the topological differences observed on different temperature slices originate from the same complete thermodynamic structure and can be understood within a unified framework of thermodynamic projections. Furthermore, this study offers a new approach to understanding black hole thermodynamic structures and their rich physical behavior through the interplay between global structures and their local manifestations.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 黑洞热力学的投影与拓扑分类
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞热力学拓扑已从基于全局拓扑数的分类，发展到包括边界行为在内的更精细方案。这一发展引出一个更深层的问题：不同拓扑表现如何在完整热力学结构内相互联系？本文提出热力学投影猜想，试图在完整热力学结构的背景下考察不同拓扑表现，并探索其潜在物理联系与形成机制。作为该思想的一个代表性应用，我们研究温度依赖的热力学拓扑相变，其中拓扑数随温度变化而物理参数保持固定。我们考察完整热力学结构如何在不同温度切片上产生不同拓扑结果。结果表明，温度依赖的热力学拓扑相变源于边界效应，而内部平衡态的成对产生或湮灭不改变总拓扑数。这些结果确立：在固定物理参数下，不同温度切片上观察到的拓扑差异源于同一完整热力学结构，并可在热力学投影的统一框架内理解。此外，本研究通过全局结构与其局部表现之间的相互作用，为理解黑洞热力学结构及其丰富物理行为提供了一种新途径。
classification.one_liner: 提出热力学投影猜想，用完整热力学结构统一解释黑洞热力学拓扑分类及温度依赖的拓扑相变。

papers.title: Spinning States and Unitarity in 3D Gravity
papers.abstract: We revisit the proposal to cure the negative density of states in the three-dimensional gravitational path integral by adding spinning states whose spin scales with the central charge. We show that sub-extremal and extremal spinning states below the black hole threshold can cancel the known negativities, and interpret these states as bulk spinning defects. Additionally, certain overspinning states above the black hole threshold can cure these negativities while preserving the spectral gap. The overspinning states were previously interpreted as classical spinning strings; we instead identify them as overspinning BTZ geometries, which are smooth pure gravity quotients of AdS$_3$ with no fixed points. All of these spinning geometries exhibit causal pathologies in their Lorentzian continuations. Moreover, the overspinning geometries arise from mixed elliptic-hyperbolic identifications and contain a formally real chiral temperature. We also generalize the computation of scalar correlators to the extremal background and propose a quotient-motivated image expression for the overspinning geometries.

classification.title_zh: 三维引力中的自旋态与幺正性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视通过加入自旋随中心荷标度的自旋态来修复三维引力路径积分中负态密度的提议。我们表明，低于黑洞阈值的亚极端和极端自旋态可以抵消已知的负性，并将这些态解释为体自旋缺陷。此外，高于黑洞阈值的某些过自旋态可以在保持谱隙的同时修复这些负性。此前过自旋态被解释为经典自旋弦；我们转而将其识别为过自旋BTZ几何，即无固定点的AdS3光滑纯引力商。所有这些自旋几何在其洛伦兹连续延拓中都表现出因果病态。而且，过自旋几何来自混合椭圆-双曲识别，并包含一个形式上为实的手征温度。我们还将标量关联子的计算推广到极端背景，并为过自旋几何提出一个受商几何启发的镜像表达式。
classification.one_liner: 论文通过引入自旋随中心荷标度的自旋态来抵消三维引力路径积分中的负态密度，并将过自旋态重新解释为具有因果病态的过自旋BTZ商几何。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于三维量子引力与AdS3/CFT2的谱密度、幺正性研究，并非用户重点的全息超流、探针膜、QNM等方向；但其中对过自旋BTZ商几何的分类和因果病态分析触及经典引力/广义相对论支线，故相关性中等。

papers.title: Scattering and bound observables for spinning particles in Kerr spacetime with generic spin orientations
papers.abstract: We derive the radial action of a spinning probe particle in Kerr spacetime from the worldline formalism in the first-order form, focusing on linear in spin effects. We then develop a novel covariant Dirac bracket formalism to compute the impulse and the spin kick directly from the radial action, generalizing some conjectural results in the literature and providing ready-to-use expressions for amplitude calculations with generic spin orientations. This allows, for the first time, to find new covariant expressions for scattering observables in the probe limit up to $\mathcal{O}(G^6 s_1 s_2^4)$. Finally, we use the action-angle representation to compute the fundamental frequencies for generic bound orbits, including the intrinsic spin precession, the periastron advance and the precession of the orbital plane.

classification.title_zh: Kerr时空中具有一般自旋取向的自旋粒子散射与束缚可观测量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们从一阶形式的世界线形式推导Kerr时空中自旋探针粒子的径向作用量，重点研究自旋线性效应。随后，我们发展了一种新的协变Dirac括号形式，可直接从径向作用量计算冲量和自旋反冲，推广了文献中的一些猜想性结果，并为一般自旋取向的振幅计算提供了可直接使用的表达式。这首次给出了探针极限下直至 O(G^6 s_1 s_2^4) 的散射可观测量新协变表达式。最后，我们利用作用量-角变量表示计算了一般束缚轨道的基本频率，包括内禀自旋进动、近星点进动和轨道平面进动。
classification.one_liner: 从世界线形式和一阶自旋推导Kerr时空中自旋探针粒子的径向作用量，并用协变Dirac括号给出散射冲量、自旋反冲及束缚轨道频率。

papers.title: Scalar quasinormal modes of the exact spinning Morris--Thorne wormhole
papers.abstract: We study the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of a minimally coupled massless scalar field on the exact spinning Morris-Thorne wormhole. The problem is posed on the complete two-ended geometry, whose asymptotic rest frames rotate relative to each other. After extracting the axis behaviour and the outgoing phases at both infinities, we compactify the radial coordinate and construct a quadratic eigenvalue problem by two-dimensional Chebyshev collocation. The analytic background yields exact constraints on the spectrum. At fixed azimuthal number $m$, the frequencies $\widehat{\omega}=r_0\omega$ are mirror symmetric about $\operatorname{Re}\widehat{\omega}=3\pi jm/2$, where $r_0$ is the throat radius and $j=J/r_0^2$ is the dimensionless angular momentum. Each multipole family depends on $m$ and $j$ only through $mj$ and three angular Chebyshev polynomials represent exactly the multipoles $L=|m|,|m|+1,|m|+2$. A conserved flux confines nonthreshold real quasinormal frequencies to the superradiant window $0<\omega/(m\Omega_-)<1$, where $\Omega_-=3\pi J/r_0^3$. For the sampled sectors $m=1,2,3$ and spins up to $j=19$, every converged frequency is damped and lies outside this window. Independent integration verifies the low-lying modes, while Kerr spectra provide a separate benchmark for the two-dimensional solver. A limiting radial equation explains why the computed mode frequencies approach the upper edge of the superradiant window with frequency offsets proportional to $(mj)^{-1/2}$ at large $mj$. A complete stability assessment requires further analysis of the unresolved scalar spectrum and of perturbations of the coupled metric-matter system.

classification.title_zh: 精确旋转 Morris-Thorne 虫洞的标量准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究最小耦合无质量标量场在精确旋转 Morris-Thorne 虫洞上的准正规模。问题定义在两端渐近静止系相对旋转的完整双端几何上。提取轴线行为与两端无穷远出射相位后，作者紧致化径向坐标，并用二维 Chebyshev 配点法构造二次特征值问题。解析背景给出谱的精确约束：固定方位角数 m 时，频率 ω̂=r0ω 关于 Reω̂=3πjm/2 镜像对称，其中 r0 为喉半径、j=J/r0^2 为无量纲角动量；各多极族仅通过 mj 依赖 m 和 j，三个角向 Chebyshev 多项式精确表示 L=|m|,|m|+1,|m|+2 的多极。守恒通量将非阈值实准正规模限制在超辐射窗口 0<ω/(mΩ_-)<1 内，其中 Ω_-=3πJ/r0^3。对采样扇区 m=1,2,3 及自旋至 j=19，所有收敛频率均为阻尼且位于该窗口之外。独立积分验证了低阶模，Kerr 谱为二维求解器提供基准。一个极限径向方程解释了在大的 mj 下计算模频率趋近超辐射窗口上边缘、频移正比于 (mj)^(-1/2) 的现象。完整稳定性评估仍需对未解析标量谱及耦合度规-物质系统扰动作进一步分析。
classification.one_liner: 用二维 Chebyshev 配点法计算精确旋转 Morris-Thorne 虫洞上的标量准正规模，发现采样模均为阻尼并位于超辐射窗口外，同时给出谱的精确对称性与大 mj 渐近行为。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson black holes from background subtraction
papers.abstract: The non-asymptotic flatness of charged rotating black holes immersed in the Bertotti-Robinson magnetic field causes the ambiguity in the gauge choice for the time generator and the horizon electric potential. By using the newly established form of the integrability condition together with the gauge choice for the asymptotically flat charged rotating black holes as the initial condition, we have found that the gauge can be uniquely fixed. With this fixed gauge, we further obtain the mass and angular momentum by the background subtraction method with the Minkowski spacetime as the reference spacetime. As a result, not only is the first law of black hole thermodynamics automatically satisfied, but also both the CR relation and the Smarr formula are obeyed.

classification.title_zh: 背景减除法下 Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson 黑洞的热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 论文研究浸没在 Bertotti-Robinson 磁场中的带电旋转黑洞因非渐近平直性导致的时间生成元规范选择和视界电势歧义。作者利用新建立的积分条件形式，并以渐近平直带电旋转黑洞的规范选择为初始条件，确定唯一规范；随后以 Minkowski 时空为参考，通过背景减除法得到质量和角动量。结果表明第一定律自动满足，同时 CR 关系和 Smarr 公式也成立。

papers.title: Direct product geometries in $n$-dimensional linear, quadratic, and conformal gravity
papers.abstract: Direct-product spacetimes offer a tractable route to exact solutions in gravity theories beyond general relativity. We study $n$-dimensional direct-product spacetimes of $(m_1+m_2)$, $(2+m)$, and $(2+\ldots+2)$ type in linear gravity, general pure quadratic-curvature gravity, and one of the recently proposed higher-dimensional extensions of conformal gravity, allowing the two-dimensional subspaces to have nonconstant curvature. We classify the resulting solution spaces and determine how the allowed geometries depend on the gravitational theory and, in quadratic gravity, on the curvature couplings. Metrics containing two-dimensional part(s) of nonconstant curvature are governed either by algebraic conditions on a curvature profile or, in one special class of quadratic gravity, by a differential equation. Relations governing metrics with only constant-curvature $m$-dimensional subspaces are purely algebraic. We further examine conformal relations to linear-gravity solutions, generalized Petrov types, and compatibility with electromagnetic sources. Particularly noteworthy is that standard static black-hole geometries are absent from the direct-product sector of the considered form of conformal gravity for $n>4$. Four- and six-dimensional cases are analyzed in detail, and explicit analytic solutions illustrating the resulting structure are presented whenever possible.

classification.title_zh: n维线性、二次和共形引力中的直积几何
classification.abstract_zh: 直积时空为研究超越广义相对论的引力理论中的精确解提供了一条可行途径。本文研究(m1+m2)、(2+m)和(2+…+2)型n维直积时空，在线性引力、一般纯二次曲率引力和近期提出的一种高维共形引力扩展中，允许二维子空间具有非常数曲率。我们分类所得解空间，并确定允许的几何如何依赖于引力理论，以及在二次引力中如何依赖于曲率耦合。含非常数曲率二维部分的度规由曲率剖面的代数条件控制，或在二次引力的一个特殊类中由微分方程控制。仅含常数曲率m维子空间的度规关系是纯代数的。我们进一步考察与线性引力解的共形关系、广义Petrov型以及与电磁源的相容性。特别值得注意的是，对于n>4，所考虑形式的共形引力的直积扇区中不存在标准静态黑洞几何。文中详细分析了四维和六维情形，并在可能时给出说明所得结构的显式解析解。
classification.one_liner: 系统分类了n维直积时空在线性引力、纯二次曲率引力和共形引力中的精确解，并分析其与电磁源、Petrov型及共形关系的相容性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与修改引力中的精确解研究，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息、量子信息、凝聚态或QCD等全息研究支线。

papers.title: Nonlinear Scalarization of Reissner-Nordstr\"om Black Holes in Scalar-Torsion-Maxwell Teleparallel Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate the nonlinear scalarization of Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes in scalar-torsion-Maxwell teleparallel gravity, in which the scalar field is nonminimally coupled to the Weitzenb\"ock invariant. We consider polynomial coupling functions that avoid tachyonic instabilities at the linear level, thereby exploring a scalarization mechanism driven by nonlinear effects. In the decoupling limit, we study the nonlinear evolution of finite-amplitude scalar perturbations and show that the inclusion of a sixth-order coupling term allows the scalar field to dynamically evolve toward nontrivial stationary configurations. This behavior can be understood in terms of the effective potential, which develops nontrivial local minima that provide a mechanism for nonlinear saturation. By numerically solving the fully coupled field equations, we construct asymptotically flat charged black hole solutions endowed with scalar hair. We classify these solutions according to the number of nodes in the scalar field profile, identifying multiple branches whose structure and multiplicity depend on the coupling parameters. We further show that the higher-order coupling progressively suppresses higher-node branches and characterize the scalar backreaction through deviations of the metric functions and the torsion scalar from the Reissner-Nordstr\"om background.

classification.title_zh: 标量-挠率-Maxwell平行引力中Reissner-Nordström黑洞的非线性标量化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究标量-挠率-Maxwell平行引力中Reissner-Nordström黑洞的非线性标量化，其中标量场与Weitzenböck不变量非最小耦合。我们考虑在线性层面避免快子不稳定的多项式耦合函数，从而探索由非线性效应驱动的标量化机制。在解耦极限下，我们研究有限振幅标量扰动的非线性演化，并表明引入六阶耦合项可使标量场动力学演化到非平凡稳态构型。该行为可用有效势理解，其发展出非平凡局域极小，提供非线性饱和机制。通过数值求解完全耦合场方程，我们构造带有标量毛的渐近平直带电黑洞解。我们根据标量场剖面的节点数分类这些解，识别出多支解，其结构和多重性依赖耦合参数。我们进一步表明高阶耦合逐渐抑制高节点支，并通过度规函数和挠率标量相对Reissner-Nordström背景的偏离刻画标量反作用。
classification.one_liner: 在标量-挠率-Maxwell平行引力中，六阶耦合驱动RN黑洞非线性标量化并生成多支带毛带电黑洞解。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文不属于AdS/CFT或全息研究，而是修改引力中的经典带电黑洞标量化与带毛解构造；仅与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关，不涉及全息超流、QNM、D3-D7等方向。

papers.title: Thermodynamic, Optical, and Wave Signatures of Charged Letelier AdS Black Holes with PFDM and Quintessence
papers.abstract: We study a four-dimensional charged Letelier--anti-de Sitter (AdS) black-hole metric containing a cloud of strings, a phenomenological perfect-fluid-dark-matter (PFDM) source, and a Kiselev-type quintessence term. We derive the curvature invariants, horizon temperature, entropy, electric potential, and horizon-based mass function, and analyze local thermal response and the associated extended-phase-space identities. A rectangular benchmark cycle gives $W=0.095000$ and $\eta\simeq15.39\%$ for the explicitly stated geometric-unit parameters; these values are model- and cycle-specific and are not presented as a universal efficiency enhancement. For geometric optics, we derive the photon-sphere condition, critical impact parameter, and finite-radius shadow angle. For a massless, minimally coupled scalar field, we obtain a radial-coordinate Helmholtz equation and identify frequency-dependent barriers, evanescent intervals, and candidate trapping regions; the eikonal barrier-top scale approaches the photon-sphere capture scale. Two qualifications delimit the interpretation. First, with the stated PFDM stress-tensor convention, $\rho_{\rm PFDM}=-\beta/(8\pi r^3)$, so positive $\beta$ describes a negative-density effective source. Second, the mass function follows from the horizon equation, but identifying it with a conserved asymptotic AdS mass requires a separate charge and boundary-normalization analysis. The potential-well analysis likewise does not determine complex quasinormal frequencies. We therefore present the results as a consistent, parameter-specific analysis of the adopted phenomenological geometry, while distinguishing algebraic thermodynamic identities from conclusions requiring asymptotic-charge or spectral calculations.

classification.title_zh: 含PFDM与精质项的带电Letelier AdS黑洞的热力学、光学与波动特征
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个四维带电Letelier--反德西特（AdS）黑洞度规，其中包含弦云、唯象完美流体暗物质（PFDM）源和Kiselev型精质项。我们推导曲率不变量、视界温度、熵、电势和基于视界的质量函数，并分析局域热响应及相关的扩展相空间恒等式。一个矩形基准循环在明确给出的几何单位参数下给出 W=0.095000 和 η≈15.39%；这些值特定于模型和循环，并不作为普适效率增强呈现。对于几何光学，我们推导光子球条件、临界碰撞参数和有限半径阴影角。对于无质量最小耦合标量场，我们得到径向坐标的Helmholtz方程，并识别频率依赖的势垒、倏逝区间和候选捕获区域；eikonal势垒顶部尺度接近光子球捕获尺度。两条限定界定解释。第一，在所述PFDM应力张量约定下，ρ_PFDM=-β/(8πr^3)，因此正β描述负密度的有效源。第二，质量函数由视界方程得出，但要将其等同于守恒的渐近AdS质量，需要单独的电荷和边界归一化分析。势阱分析同样不能确定复准正规模频率。因此，我们将其结果呈现为对所采用唯象几何的一个一致的、特定参数的分析，同时区分代数热力学恒等式与需要渐近电荷或谱计算的结论。
classification.one_liner: 系统分析含弦云、PFDM与精质项的带电Letelier AdS黑洞的热力学、阴影和标量场势垒特征，并明确限定其解释范围。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要属于经典引力/广义相对论中的AdS黑洞热力学、光学与标量场波动分析，匹配用户的经典引力支线；但未涉及全息对偶、量子信息或所列全息凝聚态等方向，且结论有明确的参数特定与解释限定。

papers.title: Variational Approach to the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon Equations of Motion for Extended Objects in General Relativity
papers.abstract: The exact motion of a finite size object in curved spacetime is captured by the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon equations. They associate a unique worldline, momentum, and spin to that object and determine the evolution of such in terms of its fully independent multipole moments. We provide a thorough review of this theory and show how to build it directly via a manifestly gauge invariant variational principle well-suited for effective descriptions of relativistic compact objects. We discuss conditions under which the covariant spin supplementary condition can be enforced and identify the natural basis of curvature tensors conjugate to the object's multipole moments.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论中扩展物体Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon运动方程的变分方法
classification.abstract_zh: 有限尺寸物体在弯曲时空中的精确运动由Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon方程描述。这些方程将唯一的世界线、动量和自旋赋予该物体，并依据其完全独立的多极矩决定这些量的演化。文章对该理论进行了系统综述，并展示如何通过显式规范不变的变分原理直接构造该理论，这一形式适用于相对论致密天体的有效描述。文章讨论了协变自旋补充条件可以被施加的条件，并识别出与物体多极矩共轭的曲率张量的自然基。
classification.one_liner: 综述并用规范不变变分原理构造广义相对论中扩展物体的Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon运动方程。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，讨论弯曲时空中扩展物体的运动方程与变分表述；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: The Energy-Momentum Tensor of a Compact Object in General Relativity to all Multipole Orders
papers.abstract: In effective field theory approaches to compact object motion in general relativity, spin and tidal effects are encoded by operators formed from the Riemann tensor and its derivatives. Many such operators contribute degenerately to observables, with a single one often affecting several multipole moments of the body. Using the Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon formalism, we construct a natural basis of independent tensors which are each canonically conjugate to precisely one multipole. We find the novel exact distributional formula for the energy-momentum tensor of a compact object in terms of its reduced multipole moments and these tensors.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论中致密天体至所有多极阶的能量-动量张量
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论中致密天体运动的有效场论方法里，自旋与潮汐效应由黎曼张量及其导数构成的算符编码。许多此类算符对可观测量的贡献是简并的，且单个算符常影响天体的多个多极矩。我们使用 Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon 形式，构造了一组独立张量的自然基，其中每个张量恰好与一个多极矩正则共轭。我们给出了致密天体能量-动量张量以其约化多极矩和这些张量表示的新的精确分布公式。
classification.one_liner: 用 Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon 形式构造与各多极矩正则共轭的张量基，并给出致密天体能量-动量张量的精确分布公式。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论中致密天体多极矩与能量-动量张量的形式研究，命中“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息、量子引力或量子信息。

papers.title: Black-hole ringdown at an exceptional point
papers.abstract: Black holes ring in damped oscillations. At an exceptional point, photon-sphere and near-horizon modes merge, and their response can acquire a linear time factor. We compute its amplitude from constrained Einstein-Maxwell data for a rotating, charged black hole in de Sitter space. With seven competing modes fixed, the late-time curvature error is 0.00383$\%$ for the pair and 0.01401$\%$ for a refitted exponential. We suppress the linear term by tuning the initial disturbance at fixed geometry. Hence, near coalescence, changing only the initial disturbance can shift the frequency inferred from a short ringdown fit.

classification.title_zh: 例外点处的黑洞铃宕
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞以阻尼振荡方式铃宕。在例外点，光子球模与近视界模合并，其响应可带有线性时间因子。我们针对 de Sitter 空间中旋转带电黑洞，由受约束的 Einstein-Maxwell 数据计算该振幅。固定七个竞争模式后，晚期曲率误差对模对为 0.00383%，对重新拟合的指数为 0.01401%。我们通过在固定几何下调节初始扰动来抑制线性项。因此，在并合附近，仅改变初始扰动就能改变从短铃宕拟合推断出的频率。
classification.one_liner: 该文在旋转带电 de Sitter 黑洞中计算例外点铃宕的线性时间项振幅，并表明初始扰动可改变短时铃宕拟合出的频率。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典黑洞时空中的准正模与铃宕，属于经典引力/广义相对论，并紧扣 QNM 与非线性演化重点标签；但不是全息研究。

papers.title: Scalar-tensor reconstruction of coherent quantum black holes
papers.abstract: We construct a scalar-tensor realisation of spherically symmetric black hole geometries that effectively arise from quantum coherent states characterised by a finite core and finite extension. We determine the non-minimal coupling to the Einstein-Hilbert Lagrangian, kinetic coupling, and scalar potential and show that the kinetic term is positive only in finite domains. For fixed black hole mass, the boundaries of these domains provide a natural mechanism that relates the core size and spatial extension to the dynamics of the scalar-tensor realisation. We further show that the same geometry can also be obtained from a Horndeski action with derivative coupling and determine its domain of validity. Neither reconstruction includes the event horizon nor can it simultaneously reproduce arbitrarily large portions of the interior and exterior of the black hole, whose quantum origin therefore appears to remain partially outside the regime of applicability of semiclassical theories of gravity.

classification.title_zh: 相干量子黑洞的标量-张量重构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一类标量-张量实现，用于描述由具有有限核心和有限延展的量子相干态有效产生的球对称黑洞几何。我们确定了与 Einstein-Hilbert 拉格朗日量的非最小耦合、动能耦合和标量势，并表明动能项仅在有限区域内为正。对于固定黑洞质量，这些区域的边界提供了一种自然机制，将核心尺寸和空间延展与标量-张量实现的动力学联系起来。我们进一步表明，同一几何也可由具有导数耦合的 Horndeski 作用量得到，并确定了其适用范围。两种重构都不包含事件视界，也不能同时再现黑洞内部和外部的任意大部分区域，因此其量子起源似乎仍部分处于半经典引力理论适用范围之外。
classification.one_liner: 用标量-张量与 Horndeski 作用重构有限核相干量子黑洞几何，并指出其难以同时覆盖视界内外。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于标量-张量/Horndeski 框架下的黑洞几何重构，主要关联经典引力/修改引力，而非全息或所列全息凝聚态等支线。

papers.title: Engineering a digital acoustic black hole
papers.abstract: We show how to design and build an analogue black hole as a synchronous digital circuit. We define the sound speed, the flow and the horizon of such a circuit in terms of its own logic, and realise one on a field-programmable gate array, where the black hole is probed electrically with a signal generator and an oscilloscope. We measure the stability of the horizon, its causal cone, the ringdown and rotational superradiance. A single flipped bit inside the horizon leaks out by an amount that falls exponentially with depth. Digital circuits thus form a reconfigurable class of gravitational analogues and realise an analogue black hole as a cellular automaton.

classification.title_zh: 工程化数字声学黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示如何将类比黑洞设计并构建为同步数字电路。我们用电路自身逻辑定义声速、流和视界，并在现场可编程门阵列上实现一个，用信号发生器和示波器电学探测黑洞。我们测量视界的稳定性、因果锥、铃宕和旋转超辐射。视界内单个翻转比特会泄漏出来，其泄漏量随深度指数衰减。因此数字电路构成一类可重构的引力类比，并将类比黑洞实现为元胞自动机。
classification.one_liner: 在FPGA上实现可重构的数字声学黑洞元胞自动机，并测量视界稳定性、因果锥、铃宕与旋转超辐射。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及黑洞视界、铃宕与旋转超辐射等经典黑洞类比现象，但不含AdS/CFT或全息方法；对经典引力/QNM类比支线有中等相关性。

papers.title: M-theory anomaly localization and holographic $c$-extremization
papers.abstract: We compute the cubic and $C_3\wedge X_8$ caracteristic class contributions to the trial anomaly polynomial of supersymmetric $AdS_3\times M_8$ backgrounds with $M_8=P(\mathcal O \oplus \mathcal L)\to B_6$. Including the Abelian currents descending from $C_3$, we identify the projective invariant $J$ as the denominator arising from their elimination by $c$-extremization and recover the central charge $c^{(0)}=-I_3+3I_+I_-/J$. The $X_8$ push-forward determines the pure R-symmetry, mixed R--Betti and gravitational anomalies. Evaluating it at the classical extremum gives the associated central-charge corrections, linear in the overall unshifted flux. The mixed term contributes equally to both central charges and is required in general. We evaluate these formulae for three flux-quantized backgrounds, including non-polynomial solutions. Direct projective fibre integration reproduces the mixed coefficient obtained by localization. On the wrapped-$M5$ $S^4$ bundle, the same couplings reproduce the independently known field-theory anomaly through orders $N^3$ and $N$. Their interpretation as full CFT central charges requires a unitary SCFT with a normalizable vacuum, suitable supersymmetric boundary conditions, a complete mixing sector of global currents and control of omitted anomaly sectors. A conditional Euclidean relative-equivariant interpretation is discussed separately.

classification.title_zh: M理论反常局域化与全息c-极值化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算超对称AdS3×M8背景（其中M8=P(O⊕L)→B6）试探反常多项式中三次项和C3∧X8特征类的贡献。纳入由C3降维得到的Abelian流后，我们将射影不变量J识别为c-极值化消去这些流时出现的分母，并恢复中心荷c^(0)=-I3+3I+I-/J。X8推前决定纯R对称、混合R-Betti和引力反常。在经典极值处取值给出相应的中心荷修正，其与整体未移动通量成线性关系。混合项对两个中心荷贡献相同，且一般必需。我们在三个通量量子化背景（包括非多项式解）上计算这些公式。直接射影纤维积分复现了由局域化得到的混合系数。在包裹M5的S4丛上，相同耦合在N^3和N阶复现独立已知的场论反常。将其解释为完整CFT中心荷需要具有可归一化真空的幺正SCFT、合适的超对称边界条件、完整的整体流混合扇区以及对省略反常扇区的控制。文末单独讨论一种条件性的欧几里得相对等变解释。
classification.one_liner: 论文用M理论反常局域化与X8推前计算AdS3×M8全息背景的中心荷及修正，并在通量量子化例与包裹M5的S4丛上检验。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为AdS/CFT中的反常多项式与c-极值化，未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜等。

papers.title: Boundary Formula for Volume Response of Entanglement Wedge Polygons
papers.abstract: The vacuum volume of an entanglement wedge polygon is topological. We determine its semiclassical quadratic response to time-symmetric coherent scalar matter in AdS$_3$. A contrast of six interval entropies measures a nonnegatively weighted energy integral, whereas volume depends on the unweighted integral. For negative mass squared above the stability bound, perturbations with the same quadratic coefficient of global energy can match all six vacuum entropies through second order yet have opposite volume responses. A continuum of narrowing quartets reconstructs the volume response with controlled noise. An independent CFT calculation for a dimension-$3/2$ primary reproduces an exact polygon edge formula.

classification.title_zh: 纠缠楔多边形体积响应的边界公式
classification.abstract_zh: 纠缠楔多边形的真空体积具有拓扑性。本文确定其在 AdS$_3$ 中对时间对称相干标量物质的半经典二次响应。六个区间熵的对比可测量一个非负加权的能量积分，而体积依赖于未加权积分。对于高于稳定性下界的负质量平方，具有相同全局能量二次系数的微扰可以在二阶以内匹配所有六个真空熵，却具有相反的体积响应。一个连续收缩的四元组族以受控噪声重构体积响应。对维数 $3/2$ 主算符的独立 CFT 计算复现了一个精确的多边形边公式。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3 中推导纠缠楔多边形体积对相干标量物质的一阶半经典响应，并给出与 CFT 计算对应的边界公式。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究纠缠楔体积响应的全息公式，属于量子信息与 AdS/CFT 基础方向；未直接涉及用户重点列出的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7 探针膜等支线。

papers.title: On Thermodynamic Role of the Gauss-Bonnet Topological Term
papers.abstract: We revisit the thermodynamic implications of the Gauss-Bonnet topological term in four spacetime dimensions. It has been previously claimed in the literature that this term, although it does not modify the equations of motion, shifts the black hole entropy by a contribution proportional to the Euler characteristic of the horizon. We argue that this conclusion is sensitive to the choice of the boundary action on the horizon. We then identify a choice for which the Wald entropy expression naturally reproduces the Jacobson-Myers entropy, even for non-stationary black holes. We also show that there are no further contributions to conserved quantities from smooth outer boundaries, regardless of the choice of boundary conditions there and of the asymptotic behaviour of the spacetime. Moreover, we demonstrate that the topological Gauss-Bonnet term changes the critical temperature of the Hawking-Page phase transition, opening, in principle, a way for detecting its presence in the gravitational action. In fact, for a positive Gauss-Bonnet coupling constant, we observe a zeroth-order Hawking phase transition at high temperatures and pressures. While our discussion focuses on the case of the Gauss-Bonnet term in 4D, the results are more general and qualitatively apply to other Lovelock Lagrangians in their respective critical dimensions.

classification.title_zh: 论Gauss-Bonnet拓扑项的热力学作用

papers.title: Deep Inelastic Scattering and Proton Structure Functions in AdS/QCD models
papers.abstract: In this work we study the holographical fermionic deep inelastic scattering in a deformed AdS model. Imposing that the potentials that emerge from the Schr\"odinger-like equations for the fermionic chiral left and right modes are SUSY partners to preserve isospectrality, we implement a systematical truncation of such potentials. Then, we show that in the quadratic approximation of the deformed AdS model, the fermionic DIS and the proton structure functions $F_{1,2}(q^2,x)$ are identical with the results obtained from the soft wall model. Further, we obtain and compare high-order approximations for the fermionic potentials with the full solution of the deformed AdS model and show, as expected, that as greater the order of approximation, the better are the results for $F_{1,2}(q^2,x)$ when compared with experimental data explicitly for the Bjorken parameter values $x=0.85, 0.75$ and $0.65$.

classification.title_zh: AdS/QCD 模型中的深度非弹性散射与质子结构函数

papers.title: Cubic Curvature Corrections to Taub-NUT-AdS Black Holes and Their Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: We investigate cubic curvature corrections to four-dimensional Taub-NUT-AdS black holes and their thermodynamics. We construct the complete analytic solution to the first order in the higher-derivative couplings, and derive the corrected Hawking temperature and Wald entropy. The NUT potential remains unchanged, while reconstructing the NUT charge and Gibbs free energy through the Maxwell relation leaves just one undetermined function of the NUT parameter. We then independently evaluate the Gibbs free energy using two improved Reall-Santos methods, based on either the field redefinition or the background subtraction. After matching the thermodynamic variables, both methods yield identical results and fix the undetermined function, providing a consistent determination of the mass and NUT charge. Our work therefore establishes that the thermodynamics of Taub-NUT-AdS black hole withstands the higher-derivative corrections.

papers.title: Einstein--Yang--Mills Plane Waves: Uniqueness and an Exact Curvature Double Copy
papers.abstract: Coleman found plane waves of Yang--Mills theory that are genuinely non-abelian in four dimensions and yet obey linear field equations, and G\"uven showed that they remain exact when gravity is included. We study these waves in $D$ dimensions. Coleman's profile, which is linear in the transverse coordinates, is singled out twice: up to gauge, it is the only profile with bounded energy density, and the only one for which the full Riemann tensor equals the color-contracted square of the Yang--Mills field strength that sources it. In anti-de Sitter space, we construct a closed-form family for every $D\geq4$; there, the full Riemann tensor cannot equal this color square. Waves whose transverse space is a sphere are always singular. In quadratic and Gauss--Bonnet gravity, a hyperbolic transverse space avoids this only if the waves defocus light or the higher-curvature terms become comparable to the Einstein term. All solutions extend, with changed coefficients, to generic gravity and gauge theories.

classification.title_zh: Einstein–Yang–Mills 平面波：唯一性与精确曲率双拷贝
classification.abstract_zh: Coleman 发现四维 Yang–Mills 理论中存在真正非阿贝尔却满足线性场方程的平面波，Güven 表明包含引力时这些波仍为精确解。本文研究 D 维情形。Coleman 的剖面（对横向坐标线性）被两次单独选出：在规范等价意义下，它是唯一具有有界能量密度的剖面，也是唯一使完整 Riemann 张量等于其源 Yang–Mills 场强的色收缩平方的剖面。在反 de Sitter 空间中，作者对所有 D≥4 构造了闭式解族；在那里完整 Riemann 张量不能等于该色平方。横向空间为球面的波总是奇异的。在二次与 Gauss–Bonnet 引力中，双曲横向空间只有在波使光线散焦或高阶曲率项与 Einstein 项可比时才能避免奇异。所有解都可改变系数后推广到一般引力与规范理论。

papers.title: Rotating the Replica: Twisted R\'enyi Coefficients from CFT Operator Counting
papers.abstract: We show that twisting vacuum R\'enyi entropies by a spatial rotation reveals conformal field theory data governing the asymptotic counting of spinning operators. For a ball in four dimensions, the logarithmic coefficients of these angular-momentum-twisted R\'enyi entropies are determined by rotating-sphere thermal data to all orders in the local derivative expansion, including the Weyl-anomaly contribution. We test this relation in free theories and in strongly coupled, large-$N$ $\mathcal N=4$ Yang--Mills theory using holography.

papers.title: Critical Slowing Down and the Crossover to Quantum Scrambling in Holographic CFTs
papers.abstract: We investigate critical relaxation dynamics and their connection to quantum information scrambling in the conformal field theory dual to a Reissner-Nordstr\"om anti-de Sitter (RN-AdS) black hole. Employing the holographic dictionary, we formulate the thermodynamics in terms of boundary CFT variables and study the stochastic evolution of the reduced horizon radius using Langevin and Fokker-Planck formalisms. We demonstrate pronounced critical slowing down in the dual CFT, characterized by an enhancement of the autocorrelation time and stochastic fluctuations, accompanied by a suppression of the lowest nonzero Fokker-Planck eigenvalue. The autocorrelation time exhibits a universal power-law divergence, $\tau\sim|\epsilon|^{-\Delta}$, with $\Delta\simeq 2/3$, consistent with the analytical prediction and previous bulk gravitational results. Going beyond the conventional single-parameter analysis, we incorporate variations of the CFT central charge and identify a combined scaling variable involving temperature and central charge, demonstrating that the leading relaxation dynamics retain the same critical exponent along different trajectories in the two-dimensional parameter space. Finally, we explore the interplay between thermodynamic relaxation and quantum information scrambling by comparing the relaxation timescale with the fast-scrambling timescale. The comparison reveals a crossover between thermodynamic relaxation and quantum scrambling for which we derive the corresponding crossover scale analytically and find that, in the large-central-charge limit, it behaves as $\hat{\epsilon}\sim(C\ln C)^{-3/2}$. We also verify this numerically using the full nonlinear free-energy landscape. Our results connect critical dynamical scaling, finite-central-charge effects, and quantum scrambling within the holographic CFT framework.

classification.title_zh: 全息共形场论中的临界减慢与量子置乱交叉
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了与 Reissner-Nordström 反德西特（RN-AdS）黑洞对偶的共形场论中的临界弛豫动力学及其与量子信息置乱的联系。利用全息字典，我们用边界 CFT 变量表述热力学，并使用 Langevin 和 Fokker-Planck 形式研究约化视界半径的随机演化。我们展示了对偶 CFT 中明显的临界减慢，其特征为自相关时间和随机涨落增强，同时最低非零 Fokker-Planck 本征值被抑制。自相关时间显示出普适幂律发散，τ∼|ε|^{-Δ}，其中 Δ≃2/3，与解析预言和先前的体引力结果一致。超越常规单参数分析，我们纳入 CFT 中心荷的变化，并识别出涉及温度和中心荷的组合标度变量，证明在二维参数空间的不同轨迹上，主导弛豫动力学保持相同的临界指数。最后，我们通过比较弛豫时间尺度与快速置乱时间尺度，探索了热力学弛豫与量子信息置乱之间的相互作用。该比较揭示了热力学弛豫与量子置乱之间的交叉，我们解析地导出了相应的交叉标度，并发现在大中心荷极限下其行为为 \hat{\epsilon}∼(C ln C)^{-3/2}。我们还使用完全非线性的自由能景观对其进行了数值验证。我们的结果在全息 CFT 框架内联系了临界动力学标度、有限中心荷效应和量子置乱。

papers.title: Landau-Ginzburg Theory of a Holographic Superconductor: A Horizon Perspective on the Zero-Temperature Ground State
papers.abstract: We investigate the effect of a quartic scalar self-interaction, $\lambda|\phi|^4$, on a holographic superconductor in which non-linear electrodynamic couplings generate a superconducting dome containing an extended Lifshitz regime. The quartic interaction leaves the linearized scalar dynamics around the normal phase unchanged while modifying the non-linear solutions where the scalar field is large. As $\lambda$ increases, the solutions within the dome pass through three stages. The Lifshitz region shrinks until its scaling solution disappears at $\lambda^*$, leaving a no-AdS region, beyond whose edge the flows end before reaching any asymptotic region, and above $\lambda_c$ the dome consists entirely of asymptotically AdS hairy black holes. At the bottom of the dome we identify the point where the horizon value of the scalar field is largest, which we refer to as the critical point. There this value lies at the deepest symmetry-breaking minimum that the horizon effective potential, of Landau-Ginzburg form, can have. Unlike a conventional Landau-Ginzburg description, this interpretation rests on the scalar field at the horizon rather than on the boundary order parameter. Below $\lambda^*$, the constant scalar of the Lifshitz fixed point sits instead at the minimum of the effective potential of its asymptotic scaling region.

classification.title_zh: 全息超导体的朗道-金兹堡理论：零温基态的视界视角
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究四次标量自相互作用 λ|φ|^4 对全息超导体的影响；该模型中非线性电动力学耦合产生一个包含扩展 Lifshitz 区域的超导穹顶。四次相互作用不改变正常相附近标量涨落的线性化动力学，但会修改标量场较大时的非线性解。随着 λ 增大，穹顶内的解经历三个阶段：Lifshitz 区域收缩，其标度解在 λ* 处消失，留下一个无 AdS 区域，其边缘之外的流在到达任何渐近区域前终止；在 λ_c 以上，穹顶完全由渐近 AdS 的带毛黑洞组成。在穹顶底部，我们确定视界标量场取值最大的点，称为临界点；该值位于视界有效势（具有 Landau-Ginzburg 形式）所能具有的最深对称破缺极小值处。与传统 Landau-Ginzburg 描述不同，这一解释基于视界处的标量场而非边界序参量。在 λ* 以下，Lifshitz 不动点的常标量则位于其渐近标度区域有效势的极小值处。

papers.title: Decoupling Across Dimensions
papers.abstract: We present a prescription for identifying decoupled sectors of 4d SCFTs obtained from compactifications of branes. Central to our analysis is the comparison of anomaly polynomials obtained via field-theoretic reduction versus anomaly inflow. Our flagship examples are the 4d $\mathcal{N}=1$ SCFTs obtained by compactifying the 6d $(1,0)$ theory from M5-branes probing a $\mathbb{C}^2/\mathbb{Z}_2$ orbifold singularity on a torus with flux. The anomaly polynomial of the interacting fixed point is known to decompose into the $T^2$ reduction of the 6d anomaly polynomial, plus a contribution from flip fields introduced to remove operators from the spectrum. Adopting the inflow perspective, the contribution from the flipped sector is obtained as the difference between inflow anomaly polynomials in the singular and resolved geometries, which we efficiently compute using equivariant localization. Helpfully, the 4d SCFTs admit two dual quiver gauge theory descriptions: $Y^{p,q}$ quiver gauge theories, and class $\mathcal{S}_2$ necklace quivers obtained from trinions. We study the interacting and decoupled sectors on both sides of the duality and construct an explicit map between their chiral rings, identifying a range of parameter space for which the quivers flow to apparently different interacting fixed points. Each chiral ring generator is furthermore matched to an M2-brane wrapping a 2-cycle in the resolved M-theory geometry.

classification.title_zh: 跨维度的解耦
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个方案，用于识别由膜紧致化得到的4d SCFT的退耦扇区。分析核心是比较场论约化与反常流入得到的反常多项式。旗舰例子是由M5膜探测C^2/Z_2 orbifold奇点上的6d (1,0)理论在带通量的环面紧致化得到的4d N=1 SCFT。已知相互作用不动点的反常多项式可分解为6d反常多项式的T^2约化，加上为从谱中移除算符而引入的flip场的贡献。采用流入视角，flipped扇区的贡献由奇异与分辨几何中流入反常多项式之差得到，我们利用等变局域化高效计算。有帮助的是，这些4d SCFT具有两种对偶的quiver规范理论描述：Y^{p,q} quiver规范理论和由trinion得到的class S_2项链quiver。我们在对偶两侧研究相互作用与退耦扇区，并构造其手征环之间的显式映射，识别出quivers流向看似不同相互作用不动点的参数空间范围。每个手征环生成元进一步匹配到分辨M理论几何中包裹2-cycle的M2膜。

papers.title: Liberation in the Heavy Limit
papers.abstract: We study CFT four-point functions of identical scalar primaries as their dimension $\Delta$ grows for fixed $0<z, \bar z<1$, and call them liberated if they grow at the same exponential rate as those of a generalized free field (GFF), as is the case for heavy free particles propagating along geodesics in AdS. We show that the correlator is liberated at the crossing symmetric point if and only if the light spectrum is sparse, and that liberation then holds wherever $z$ and $\bar z$ lie on the same side of $1/2$. If the low twist states are also sparse, liberation holds everywhere except in an explicit band around $z+\bar z=1$. In particular, if the primary twist gap lies above $\sqrt{2}\Delta$, then the correlator is liberated everywhere. For twist cutoffs below $\Delta$, composites of two spinning generalized free fields fail to be liberated in a region that fills the band near the double lightcone limit. In two dimensions, Virasoro primaries cannot be liberated unless the central charge grows faster than $\Delta$. The same framework sharpens the universality of large-$c$ torus partition functions of two-dimensional CFTs.

classification.title_zh: 重极限下的解放
classification.abstract_zh: 研究相同标量主算符的四点函数在固定 0<z,\bar z<1 且维度 Δ 增大时的行为；若其指数增长率与广义自由场相同，则称其被解放，正如沿 AdS 测地线传播的重自由粒子。证明在交叉对称点解放当且仅当轻谱稀疏，且此时只要 z 与 \bar z 位于 1/2 同侧便处处解放。若低 twist 态也稀疏，则除 z+\bar z=1 附近显式带外处处解放；若主算符 twist gap 高于 \sqrt{2}Δ，则处处解放。低于 Δ 的 twist 截断下，两个自旋广义自由场的复合在双光锥极限附近带内失效。二维中 Virasoro 主算符除非中心电荷增长快于 Δ 否则不能解放。该框架还锐化二维 CFT 大 c 环面配分函数的普适性。

papers.title: Kinematically Unrestricted Flat Space Scattering from AdS$_{d+1} \times$ S$^p$/CFT$_d$
papers.abstract: We construct scattering states for scalar fields with generic kinematics from CFT operators in the flat space limit of AdS/CFT. The states can have momentum along the compact $S^p$ directions of $AdS_{d+1}\times S^p$, which is achieved by scaling to large R-symmetry charge and choosing a particular parameterization for the R-symmetry polarization. These states allow for the construction of an unrestricted S-matrix from the flat space limit of CFT correlation functions, which we check for various tree level interactions. We also describe a generalization of the Mellin space formalism which incorporates the compact momentum, and we discuss some possible implications for flat space holography.

classification.title_zh: 从 AdS$_{d+1}\times$ S$^p$/CFT$_d$ 构造运动学无限制的平直空间散射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了在 AdS/CFT 平直空间极限下，从 CFT 算符出发、具有一般运动学的标量场散射态。这些态可以带有沿 AdS$_{d+1}\times S^p$ 中紧致 $S^p$ 方向的动量；这是通过将 R 对称性荷标度到大值，并选择 R 对称性极化的特定参数化来实现的。这些态使得能够从 CFT 关联函数的平直空间极限构造无限制的 S 矩阵，我们在若干树图级相互作用中进行了检验。我们还描述了包含紧致动量的 Mellin 空间形式推广，并讨论了其对平直空间全息的可能含义。
classification.one_liner: 利用大 R 荷标度从 CFT 关联函数构造带紧致球面动量的平直空间 S 矩阵，并推广 Mellin 空间形式。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文聚焦 AdS/CFT 平直空间极限下的散射态构造、S 矩阵与 Mellin 空间推广，不涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p 波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜等方向，也不是经典引力研究。

papers.title: Spectral function, OPE, and QNMs detect different singular points of black branes with unequal R-charges
papers.abstract: We consider black brane solutions in the STU model, with three R-charges labeled by the parameters $q_1,q_2,q_3$. For equal R-charges $q_1=q_2=q_3$, the solution becomes the Reissner-Nordstr\"om black brane. For unequal R-charges $q_1>q_2>q_3\geq0$, there are three curvature singular points at $R\equiv r^2=-q_i$. Only $R=-q_3$ is the physical singularity, and the other two lie beyond it. Their optical times $T_i$, the complex times of null rays from the boundary to these singular points and back, form a right triangle in the complex $T$-plane. We probe these singular points using three observables, all built from the retarded correlator of $T_{xy}$ at zero spatial momentum: spectral function, OPE coefficients, and QNMs. The exponentially small correction to the spectral function at large real frequency is dominated by $T_1$ and $T_2$, which have the smallest ${\rm Im}\,T_i$. The OPE convergence radius is determined by $T_1$, which has the smallest $|T_i|$. A line of QNMs lies along the direction of $1/T_2$, since $T_2$ has the smallest phase $\arg T_i$. Furthermore, there is a second line of QNMs along the negative imaginary axis, which carries information about $T_3$ corresponding to the physical singularity. We derive these results from a WKB analysis and check them numerically. The three observables are therefore sensitive to different singular points of the geometry.

classification.title_zh: 谱函数、OPE与QNM探测带不等R荷黑膜的不同奇异点
classification.abstract_zh: 考虑STU模型中带三个R荷q1,q2,q3的黑膜解。等R荷时退化为Reissner-Nordström黑膜；不等R荷q1>q2>q3≥0时，在R≡r^2=-q_i处有三个曲率奇异点，仅R=-q3为物理奇异点，另两个位于其外部。定义光学时间T_i为从边界到这些奇异点再返回的零射线复时间，它们在复T平面构成直角三角形。利用零空间动量下T_xy推迟关联函数构造的三个观测量——谱函数、OPE系数和QNM——探测这些奇异点。大实频率下谱函数的指数小修正由Im T_i最小的T1和T2主导；OPE收敛半径由|T_i|最小的T1决定；一条QNM线沿1/T2方向，因为T2的相位最小；另一条QNM线沿负虚轴，携带对应物理奇异点T3的信息。作者通过WKB分析推导并用数值验证这些结果，表明三个观测量对不同几何奇异点敏感。
classification.one_liner: 在STU黑膜中，谱函数、OPE收敛半径和QNM分别对不同曲率奇异点的光学时间敏感。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究全息黑膜中的QNM、谱函数与OPE收敛性，并涉及黑洞几何奇异点，与用户重点标签中的QNM方向和AdS/CFT关联较强。

papers.title: Configurational Information and Hadron Spectroscopy in Holographic QCD
papers.abstract: Based on the concepts of entropy and complexity, Configurational Information Measures (CIMs) are tools capable of extracting information regarding physical systems from their spatially localized energy density, determining properties such as stability limits and phase transitions. In this thesis, CIMs are employed to investigate hadron spectroscopy. By utilizing phenomenological AdS/QCD models in conjunction with CIMs, cataloged meson and baryon resonances are interpolated into structures analogous to Regge trajectories, from which analytical expressions are derived to estimate the masses of higher-order excited states. These estimates are compared with experimental data to search for possible correspondences that may elucidate the properties of particles that have been experimentally detected but remain unidentified. Using this CIM-based AdS/QCD hybrid method, this work analyzes light mesons within a dynamical model, strange vector kaons in a framework that accounts for constituent quark masses, and light-flavor baryons at finite temperature.

classification.title_zh: 全息QCD中的构型信息与强子谱
classification.abstract_zh: 基于熵和复杂度的概念，构型信息度量（CIMs）是一类能够从空间局域能量密度中提取物理系统信息的工具，可确定稳定性极限和相变等性质。本论文利用CIMs研究强子谱。通过将唯象AdS/QCD模型与CIMs结合，将已编目的介子和重子共振态插值为类似Regge轨迹的结构，并由此推导解析表达式以估计更高激发态的质量。这些估计与实验数据比较，以寻找可能阐明已实验探测但仍未识别粒子性质的对应关系。使用这种基于CIM的AdS/QCD混合方法，本工作分析了动力学模型中的轻介子、考虑组分夸克质量的框架中的奇异矢量K介子，以及有限温度下的轻味重子。
classification.one_liner: 用构型信息度量结合唯象AdS/QCD模型拟合强子共振态Regge轨迹并估计激发态质量。

papers.title: Large-D approach to nearly critical holographic matter and Yang-Mills deconfinement
papers.abstract: We study a systematic expansion of dynamical black hole solutions in a class of five-dimensional Einstein-dilaton theories that are holographically dual to nearly critical, strongly coupled four-dimensional field theories. The expansion is motivated, through dimensional reduction, by the large-D limit of pure gravity, where D is the number of spacetime dimensions. At leading nontrivial order, the Einstein equations reduce to a closed set of non-relativistic hydrodynamic equations in four dimensions, as first shown in our previous letter; these equations generalize the large-D effective theory of black branes. We derive the thermodynamics and hydrodynamics of the system from black hole thermodynamics and the holographic dictionary, and show that the energy-momentum tensor extracted from the near-boundary geometry is conserved precisely when the effective equations hold. We analyze planar, cylindrical, and spherical domain walls between coexisting phases, as well as non-equilibrium steady-state walls with nonzero momentum flux. We also show how the near-horizon geometry can be completed by a holographic flow to an asymptotically AdS5 region. Finally, as an application to the confinement-deconfinement transition of Yang-Mills theory, we construct the domain wall between the confined and deconfined phases in improved holographic QCD, compute its surface tension, and compare it with recent lattice results.
