papers.title: On the Role of Gravity in Supercooled Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: Theories with radiative mass generation and radiative symmetry breaking (RSB) lead to first-order phase transitions (FOPTs) and the production of gravitational waves (GWs) as well as primordial black holes if supercooling lasts long enough. Here we investigate the role of gravity in supercooled FOPTs that occur in the RSB scenario. We use a model-independent approach that is valid when a quantity (which we explicitly determine and is computable once the model is specified) is small enough. Eventually, the curvature of spacetime becomes relevant if the FOPT does not complete in the case in which gravity is ignored. We also include the effect on the FOPT of the non-minimal couplings with coefficients of zero mass dimension. Depending on such non-minimal couplings, gravity can enhance or reduce the region of parameter space where the phase transition completes. Observable consequences of the role of gravity on the FOPT that can be probed by current and future GW detectors are then worked out and we explore the possibility that the background of GWs detected by pulsar timing arrays is produced by FOPTs in the RSB scenario. We also estimate the number of e-folds that elapse when the field playing the role of the order parameter is trapped in the false vacuum, which provides important information for cosmology.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 论引力在过冷相变中的作用
classification.abstract_zh: 具有辐射质量产生和辐射对称破缺的理论会导致一阶相变，并在过冷持续足够久时产生引力波以及原初黑洞。本文研究在辐射对称破缺情景下发生的过冷一阶相变中引力的作用。我们采用模型无关方法，该方法在某个可显式确定、且给定模型后即可计算的量足够小时有效。若忽略引力时一阶相变无法完成，时空曲率最终会变得重要。我们还纳入具有零质量量纲系数的非最小耦合对一阶相变的影响；取决于这些非最小耦合，引力可以扩大或缩小相变得以完成的参数空间区域。随后我们给出引力的作用在一阶相变中可由当前和未来引力波探测器检验的可观测后果，并探讨脉冲星计时阵列探测到的引力波背景由辐射对称破缺情景下的一阶相变产生的可能性。我们还估计了当充当序参量的场被困在假真空中时所经过的e-folds数，这为宇宙学提供了重要信息。
classification.one_liner: 研究辐射对称破缺过冷一阶相变中引力的作用、非最小耦合影响及其引力波可观测性。

papers.title: Amplification of metric perturbations by extremal horizons
papers.abstract: Under normal circumstances, an observer falling into a black hole feels nothing special upon crossing the horizon. In this paper we find an intriguing exception: For most of the parameter range of the extremal Kerr-Newman (KN) spacetime, horizon co-rotating perturbations are enhanced near the horizon, such that an infalling observer experiences an anomalously large tidal deformation as they enter the black hole. Such perturbations arise when there is a persistent source outside the black hole that is either co-rotating itself or has discrete Fourier support at the associated frequencies $\omega=m\Omega_H$ (where $m$ is the azimuthal number and $\Omega_H$ is the horizon frequency). The enhancement is formally infinite at precise co-rotation, and we work with a nearly co-rotating mode to keep perturbation theory under control. The underlying physics is the emergence of discrete self-similarity in the extremal limit, with complex scaling weights of the form $-1/2\pm i\alpha$ for real $\alpha$. It is analogous to the black hole Meissner effect, except that the near-horizon field is enhanced rather than screened. We numerically calculate the scaling exponents for coupled gravitoelectromagnetic (GEM) perturbations of extremal KN black holes and show that the complex exponents arise in the parameter range $Q < Q_*$ with $Q_*\approx.93M$. These exponents also predict the decay and growth rates (Aretakis effect) of generic GEM perturbations of the KN spacetime, both on and off the horizon. The enhancement of co-rotating perturbations can be viewed as a driven Aretakis instability.

classification.title_zh: 极端视界对度规扰动的放大
classification.abstract_zh: 通常情况下，落入黑洞的观察者在穿过视界时不会感到任何特殊之处。本文发现一个有趣的例外：在极端 Kerr-Newman（KN）时空的大部分参数范围内，随视界共转的扰动在视界附近被增强，使得落入的观察者在进入黑洞时经历异常大的潮汐形变。当黑洞外部存在持续源，且该源本身共转或在相关频率 ω=mΩ_H（m 为方位角数，Ω_H 为视界频率）处具有离散 Fourier 支撑时，就会产生这类扰动。在精确共转时，增强在形式上为无穷大；我们使用近共转模式来保持微扰论可控。其物理本质是极端极限下离散自相似性的出现，复标度权重形式为 -1/2±iα（α 为实数）。这类似于黑洞 Meissner 效应，区别在于近视界场被增强而非屏蔽。我们数值计算了极端 KN 黑洞耦合 gravitoelectromagnetic（GEM）扰动的标度指数，并表明复指数出现在 Q<Q_*、Q_*≈.93M 的参数范围内。这些指数还预言了 KN 时空的一般 GEM 扰动在视界上和视界外的衰减与增长率（Aretakis 效应）。共转扰动的增强可视为一种驱动 Aretakis 不稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 极端 Kerr-Newman 黑洞近视界的共转度规扰动被放大，使落入观察者经历异常潮汐形变，并可由复标度指数与驱动 Aretakis 不稳定性描述。

papers.title: Far-Zone Gravitational Interactions at the Sixth Post-Newtonian Order
papers.abstract: We compute the nonlinear far-zone dynamics of compact binaries at the sixth post-Newtonian (6PN) order in the effective field theory of general relativity. We derive the complete $\mathcal{O}(G^2)$ far-zone action of a generic multipolar source in both the causal and the conservative prescriptions. Besides the known tails and failed tails, it contains five new sectors generated by the nonlinear memory of the emitted waves. On scattering orbits, they contain a boundary term, nonlocal in time, fixed by the balance of angular momentum. The same construction yields the emitted waveforms, whose energy and angular-momentum fluxes balance the losses of the action. For the binary, the 6PN dynamics also requires PN corrections to the lower-order sectors, the iterated radiation reaction, and a coupling quadratic in the curvature of the composite source, whose coefficient we fix by matching the gravitational Compton amplitude to that of the constituents. We compute the two-radiation contributions to the total scattering angle at fourth, fifth and sixth post-Minkowskian (PM) order and to the conservative angle at 4PM and 5PM, retaining the integer-PN terms through 6PN. For the conservative angle, we give both the local and $\gamma$-3 prescriptions. Combined with the tail and the known potential contributions, our results reproduce the conservative and total 4PM angles and the second-self-force part of the conservative 5PM angle. Including the dissipative tail, we recover the total 5PM angle through 5PN and determine its new 6PN coefficient. At 6PM, the two-radiation contribution to the total angle extends the known 5PN result to 6PN.

classification.title_zh: 六阶后牛顿阶的远区引力相互作用
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在广义相对论有效场论中计算致密双星在六阶后牛顿（6PN）阶的非线性远区动力学。我们推导了因果 prescription 与保守 prescription 下一般多极源完整的 O(G^2) 远区作用量。除已知的 tails 与 failed tails 外，它还包含由辐射波的非线性记忆产生的五个新扇区。在散射轨道上，它们含有一个由角动量平衡固定的、时间非局域的边界项。同一构造给出辐射波形，其能量与角动量通量平衡作用量的损失。对于双星，6PN 动力学还需要低阶扇区的 PN 修正、迭代辐射反作用，以及复合源曲率中的二次耦合；我们通过将引力 Compton 振幅与组成成分的相应振幅匹配来确定该耦合系数。我们计算了两辐射贡献对总散射角在第四、第五和第六 post-Minkowskian（PM）阶的贡献，以及对保守角在 4PM 和 5PM 阶的贡献，并保留到 6PN 的整数-PN 项。对于保守角，我们给出 local 与 gamma-3 两种 prescription。结合 tail 与已知势贡献，我们的结果重现了保守和总 4PM 角以及保守 5PM 角的第二自 force 部分。计入耗散 tail 后，我们重现了通过 5PN 的总 5PM 角，并确定了其新的 6PN 系数。在 6PM 阶，两辐射贡献对总角的贡献将已知的 5PN 结果推广到 6PN。
classification.one_liner: 在广义相对论有效场论中计算致密双星远区 6PN 非线性动力学及散射角。

papers.title: New Effects in Multifield Cosmology Coupled to the Gauss-Bonnet Term
papers.abstract: We study the rapid-turn regime of multifield cosmology coupled to the Gauss-Bonnet term. We derive the corresponding modified relations between the inflationary Hubble and potential slow-roll parameters, in the two-field case. These relations show that including the Gauss-Bonnet coupling broadens the possibilities for realizing rapid turn inflation and for satisfying the swampland conjectures. We also derive a consistency condition relating the scalar field-space metric to the scalar potential and the Gauss-Bonnet coupling, which two-field slow-roll and rapid-turn inflationary solutions have to satisfy. Finally, we find general conditions under which phantom-like behavior is possible in multifield dark energy models coupled to the Gauss-Bonnet term. Notably, although we do not consider a direct interaction between dark matter and dark energy, dark matter is crucial for the occurrence of a phantom regime.

classification.title_zh: 耦合Gauss-Bonnet项的多场宇宙学中的新效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了耦合Gauss-Bonnet项的多场宇宙学的快速转向机制。我们在双场情形下推导了暴胀Hubble慢滚参数与势慢滚参数之间相应的修改关系。这些关系表明，引入Gauss-Bonnet耦合拓宽了实现快速转向暴胀以及满足swampland猜想的可能性。我们还推导了一个将标量场空间度规与标量势及Gauss-Bonnet耦合联系起来的相容性条件，双场慢滚和快速转向暴胀解必须满足该条件。最后，我们找到了在耦合Gauss-Bonnet项的多场暗能量模型中可能出现类幻影行为的一般条件。值得注意的是，尽管我们没有考虑暗物质与暗能量之间的直接相互作用，暗物质对于幻影区域的出现仍是至关重要的。
classification.one_liner: 该文研究耦合Gauss-Bonnet项的多场宇宙学中快速转向暴胀、swampland相容性及类幻影暗能量的新条件。

papers.title: Gravitational Memory from AdS States in the Flat-Space Limit
papers.abstract: We study linearized gravitational reconstruction in global AdS$_4$ with dynamical scalar matter, building on vacuum Einstein perturbations with fixed boundary metric and nontrivial normalizable data. External scalar sources prepare an excited state and modify the holographic Ward identities, while subsequent evolution can proceed without boundary driving. Separating the bulk matter-sourced response from vacuum perturbations, we derive an electric quadrupole master equation with the matter-dependent corrections required by the Einstein constraints. We also verify that a cylindrical boundary integral reproduces the Regge--Wheeler master field mode by mode, without identifying it with the full global Fefferman--Graham reconstruction. For weakly interacting scalars that become massless in the flat-space limit, we extract the Bondi shear and news from retarded gravitational evolution. The resulting supertranslation memory agrees numerically with the outgoing energy redistribution and the quadrupole moment of the boundary work. In the ordered flat-space limit, later boundary controls leave the first event's waveform unchanged, despite cancelling residual gravitational modes at finite AdS radius.

classification.title_zh: 平直空间极限下 AdS 态的引力记忆
classification.abstract_zh: 研究全局 AdS4 中带动力学标量物质的线性化引力重构，基于固定边界度规和非平凡可归一化数据的真空 Einstein 扰动。外部标量源制备激发态并修正全息 Ward 恒等式，随后演化可在无边界驱动下进行。将体物质源响应与真空扰动分离，推导出含 Einstein 约束所要求物质修正的电四极主方程。还验证柱形边界积分逐模重现 Regge-Wheeler 主模场，但不将其等同于完整全局 Fefferman-Graham 重构。对弱相互作用标量（在平直空间极限下无质量），从推迟引力演化中提取 Bondi shear 和 news。所得超平移记忆与出射能量重分布及边界功的四极矩数值一致。在有序平直空间极限下，后续边界控制不改变首个事件波形，尽管在有限 AdS 半径下会抵消残余引力模式。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS4 线性化引力中由标量源制备激发态，并在平直空间极限下提取 Bondi shear/news 与超平移引力记忆。

papers.title: Hilbert space in the flat limit of AdS/CFT. II. Massless particles
papers.abstract: Building on Part I of this series, where we described the emergence of massive scattering states, we demonstrate how unitary lowest-weight representations $\mathcal D(\Delta,s)$ of the conformal group with fixed dimension $\Delta$ and arbitrary integer spin $s$ contract to massless Poincar\'e particle representations. This requires combining the In\"on\"u--Wigner contraction $\mathfrak{so}(2,3) \to \mathfrak{iso}(1,3)$ with an infinite boost, in which case massless scattering states naturally emerge in a carrollian basis. For $\Delta>s+1$, we find that $\mathcal D(\Delta,s)$ contracts to the direct sum of massless particles of all spins $s'\leq s$. At the unitarity bound, lower-spin states become null so that $\mathcal D(s+1,s)$ contracts to a single massless particle representation carrying the two maximal helicities $J=\pm s$. In both cases, the inner product converges to the Poincar\'e-invariant one after a single helicity-independent rescaling, so that unitarity is preserved throughout the contraction.

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT 平直极限中的希尔伯特空间 II. 无质量粒子
classification.abstract_zh: 承接本系列第一部分（其中描述了大质量散射态的出现），本文展示固定维度 Δ 和任意整数自旋 s 的共形群幺正最低权表示 D(Δ,s) 如何收缩为无质量 Poincaré 粒子表示。这需要将 Inönü–Wigner 收缩 so(2,3)→iso(1,3) 与无穷大 boost 结合，此时无质量散射态自然以 Carrollian 基出现。对于 Δ>s+1，D(Δ,s) 收缩为所有自旋 s'≤s 的无质量粒子的直和。在幺正界，低自旋态变为零范数态，因此 D(s+1,s) 收缩为携带两个最大螺旋度 J=±s 的单一无质量粒子表示。两种情形下，内积在一次与螺旋度无关的重标度后收敛到 Poincaré 不变内积，因此整个收缩过程保持幺正性。
classification.one_liner: 通过 so(2,3)→iso(1,3) 收缩与无穷 boost，证明共形群最低权表示在 AdS/CFT 平直极限中给出无质量 Poincaré 粒子并保持幺正性。

papers.title: Umbilic Observatories
papers.abstract: We study gravitational dynamics for the simplest example of an umbilic boundary in four-dimensional general relativity --- a three-dimensional de Sitter hypersurface embedded in a four-dimensional Minkowski world. Generally speaking, an umbilic surface has the property that its induced metric is proportional to its extrinsic curvature. We consider the case of both conformal boundary conditions, as well as Dirichlet boundary conditions imposed at the timelike hypersurface. For both cases, we find that there are no linearised modes whose imaginary frequency grows with angular momentum. The conformal boundary conditions allow for a dynamical boundary degree of freedom, in addition to the bulk excitations. The umbilic property linearly decouples the boundary Weyl mode from the bulk dynamics, yielding linearly stable dynamics. In contrast, the Dirichlet problem has no boundary mode. The umbilic hypersurfaces may thus constitute an improved starting point for defining gravitational dynamics in the presence of a timelike boundary. Throughout our analysis, we draw parallels to the structure of spatial infinity for asymptotically Minkowski spacetimes and a more finite realisation thereof.

classification.title_zh: 脐点观测站
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究四维广义相对论中最简单的脐点边界例子——嵌入四维 Minkowski 时空的三维 de Sitter 超曲面上的引力动力学。脐点面的诱导度规与外曲率成比例。我们考虑在类时超曲面上施加共形边界条件和 Dirichlet 边界条件两种情形。两种情形下均未发现虚频率随角动量增长的线性模式。共形边界条件除体激发外还允许一个动力学边界自由度；脐点性质使边界 Weyl 模式与体动力学线性解耦，从而得到线性稳定的动力学。相反，Dirichlet 问题没有边界模式。因此脐点超曲面可能为在存在类时边界时定义引力动力学提供更好的起点。分析中还将结构与渐近 Minkowski 时空的空间无穷及其更有限的实现进行类比。
classification.one_liner: 研究四维 Minkowski 中嵌入的三维 dS 脐点边界上的线性引力动力学与边界条件稳定性。

papers.title: Conformal boundaries and the photon sphere of AdS black holes
papers.abstract: We study linearized gravitational perturbations of four-dimensional Schwarzschild-AdS black holes with finite timelike boundaries subject to conformal boundary conditions. These fix the conformal class of the induced metric and the mean curvature, while allowing the boundary Weyl mode to fluctuate. The photon sphere plays a distinguished role in this problem: a static boundary at this radius is totally umbilic, and the scalar problem separates exactly into independent bulk and boundary sectors. We prove the absence of exponentially growing scalar and vector modes for spherical harmonics of degree two and higher. We determine how large angular momentum instabilities are suppressed as the boundary approaches umbilicity. Near the horizon, we recover the universal Rindler spectrum, including sound and shear excitations. We numerically follow these fluid modes as the boundary is moved outwards and find that they approach standard gravitational quasinormal modes at the asymptotic AdS$_4$ boundary. For large black holes, these asymptotic endpoints correspond to the sound and shear poles of the dual three-dimensional conformal field theory. We also study perturbations of the AdS$_4$ black brane, where we find an analogous continuation of the fluid modes in the absence of an intermediate umbilic boundary.

classification.title_zh: AdS黑洞的共形边界与光子球
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有有限类时边界、并满足共形边界条件的四维Schwarzschild-AdS黑洞的线性化引力扰动。这些边界条件固定诱导度规的共形类与平均曲率，同时允许边界Weyl模涨落。光子球在此问题中具有特殊地位：位于该半径的静态边界是全脐的，标量问题可精确分离为独立的体扇区与边界扇区。作者证明，对于二阶及更高阶球谐，不存在指数增长的标量与矢量模式；并确定当边界趋近全脐时，大角动量不稳定性如何被抑制。在视界附近，他们恢复了通用的Rindler谱，包括声学与剪切激发。随后数值追踪这些流体模式随边界向外移动的演化，发现它们趋近渐近AdS4边界处的标准引力拟正规模。对于大黑洞，这些渐近端点对应对偶三维共形场论中的声学与剪切极点。文章还研究了AdS4黑膜扰动，并在没有中间全脐边界的情况下发现流体模式的类似延拓。
classification.one_liner: 研究有限共形边界下Schwarzschild-AdS黑洞的线性引力扰动，揭示光子球全脐边界、稳定性、Rindler流体模式与对偶CFT声学/剪切极点之间的联系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及AdS黑洞线性引力扰动、拟正规模与流体/输运模式，并连接经典引力与全息对偶，匹配用户对QNM与经典引力支线的关注。

papers.title: Giant Gravitons in AdS$_5\times$SE$_5$ and the Superconformal Index of Toric Quiver Gauge Theories
papers.abstract: We derive giant-graviton contributions to superconformal indices by quantizing probe D3-branes in type IIB backgrounds $\mathrm{AdS}_{5}\times SE_{5}$. For $SE_{5}=T^{1,1}$ and $Y^{p,q}$, we determine the scalar, vector, and fermionic fluctuations of maximal giant gravitons and extract their BPS spectra. The resulting single-letter indices agree with those predicted by the giant-graviton expansions of the dual toric quiver gauge theories. These results show that the single-giant terms in finite-$N$ supersymmetric counting functions can be recovered directly from quantized D3-brane degrees of freedom and point toward a universal worldvolume origin of giant-graviton expansions directly on the supergravity side. We view the results as a step in an intrinsically gravitational framework, much like the open-closed-open triality, for addressing supersymmetric microstate-counting problems that are conventionally outsourced to the dual field theory.

classification.title_zh: AdS$_5\times$SE$_5$中的巨引力子与环面箭图规范理论的超共形指数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过在IIB型背景AdS$_5\times SE_5$中量子化探针D3膜，导出巨引力子对超共形指数的贡献。对于$SE_5=T^{1,1}$和$Y^{p,q}$，我们确定最大巨引力子的标量、矢量与费米子涨落，并提取其BPS谱。所得单字母指数与对偶环面箭图规范理论的巨引力子展开预言一致。这些结果表明，有限$N$超对称计数函数中的单巨引力子项可直接由量子化D3膜自由度恢复，并指向巨引力子展开在超引力侧具有普适的世界体起源。我们将结果视为一种内禀引力框架（类似开-闭-开三元性）的一步，用于处理通常外包给对偶场论的超对称微观态计数问题。

papers.title: Multi-Generational Black Hole Population Analysis with an Astrophysically Informed Mass Function
papers.abstract: We analyze the population statistics of black holes in the LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA GWTC-3 catalog using a parametric mass function derived from simulations of massive stars experiencing pulsational pair-instability supernovae (PPISN). Our formalism enables us to separate the black hole mass function into sub-populations corresponding to mergers between objects formed via different astrophysical pathways, allowing us to infer the properties of black holes formed from stellar collapse and black holes formed via prior mergers separately. Applying this formalism, we find that this model fits the data better than the powerlaw+peak model with Bayes factor $ 9.7\pm0.1$. We measure the location of the lower edge of the upper black hole mass gap to be $M_{\rm BHMG}=84.05_{-12.88}^{+17.19}{\rm M}_{\odot}$, providing evidence that the $35{\rm M}_{\odot}$ Gaussian peak detected in the data using other models is not associated with the PPISN pile-up predicted to precede this gap. Incorporating spin, we find that the normalized spins of stellar remnant black holes are close to zero while those of higher generation black holes tend to larger values. All of these results are in accordance with the predictions of stellar structure theory and black hole merger scenarios. Finally, we combine our mass function with the spectral siren method for measuring the Hubble constant to find $H_0=36.19_{-10.91}^{17.50}$ km/s/Mpc and discuss potential explanations of this low value. Our results demonstrate how astrophysically-informed mass functions can facilitate the interpretation of gravitational wave catalog data to provide information about black hole formation and cosmology. Future data releases will improve the precision of our measurements.

classification.title_zh: 基于天体物理启发质量函数的多代黑洞种群分析
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用由脉动对不稳定性超新星（PPISN）大质量恒星模拟得到的参数化质量函数，分析LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA GWTC-3目录中的黑洞种群统计。该形式可将黑洞质量函数分解为不同天体物理形成通道的并合子种群，从而分别推断恒星坍缩形成的黑洞和先前并合形成的黑洞性质。应用该形式，我们发现该模型以9.7±0.1的Bayes因子比powerlaw+peak模型更好地拟合数据；测得黑洞质量隙上边缘下界为M_BHMG=84.05_{-12.88}^{+17.19} M_sun，表明其他模型探测到的35 M_sun高斯峰并非与该质量隙前预期的PPISN堆积相关。结合自旋，我们发现恒星遗迹黑洞的归一化自旋接近零，而高代黑洞自旋趋于较大值。最后，我们将质量函数与谱警笛方法结合测量哈勃常数，得到H0=36.19_{-10.91}^{17.50} km/s/Mpc，并讨论该低值的可能解释。结果表明，天体物理启发的质量函数可促进对引力波目录数据的解释，以提供黑洞形成和宇宙学信息。
classification.one_liner: 用PPISN启发的参数化质量函数分解GWTC-3黑洞并合种群，并联合自旋与谱警笛约束形成通道和H0。

papers.title: Gravitational-Wave Signatures and Periodic Orbits of Charged Particles Around a Five-Dimensional Rotating Black Hole: Comparison with the Kerr Black Hole
papers.abstract: We study periodic orbits of charged particles in the equatorial plane of a five-dimensional ($D=5$) rotating Myers--Perry black hole (BH) immersed in a uniform magnetic field, and the gravitational waves emitted by these orbits in an extreme mass-ratio inspiral. All results are compared with the Kerr BH in the uniform magnetic field. We find that a charged particle is much more weakly bound to the $D=5$ dimensional BH, i.e. its energy at the innermost stable circular orbit is close to unity, $0.95$--$0.99$, compared with $0.78$--$0.94$ for the Kerr BH, and the depth of the potential well is several times smaller. As a result, the periodic orbits of the $D=5$ dimensional BH lie much closer to the separatrix. The magnetic field can make the azimuthal frequency of the orbit smaller than the radial one and produces loops in the orbits far from the BH. Using the numerical kludge method, we compute the gravitational waveforms for a compact object of $10M_\odot$ orbiting a BH of $10^6M_\odot$. At the same magnetic field, the $D=5$ dimensional signal has a longer period, lower frequencies, and an amplitude smaller by about $18\%$. We show that for the magnetic parameter $\beta M=0.02$ the strongest spectral line is at $7.9$\,mHz, compared with $9.9$\,mHz for the Kerr BH. An estimate of the radiation reaction shows that the periodic orbits survive from less than an hour to a few days in the presence of an external magnetic field. Over these lifetimes, the signal-to-noise ratio for LISA is $7$--$31$ for the rotating BH in $D=5$ dimensions, compared to the Kerr BH where it is about $15$--$54$.

classification.title_zh: 五维旋转黑洞周围带电粒子的引力波信号与周期轨道：与Kerr黑洞比较
classification.abstract_zh: 研究五维旋转Myers-Perry黑洞赤道面带电粒子在均匀磁场中的周期轨道，以及极端质量比旋进中发出的引力波，并与均匀磁场中的Kerr黑洞比较。发现带电粒子在五维黑洞中束缚更弱，ISCO能量接近1（0.95--0.99，Kerr为0.78--0.94），势井深度小几倍，周期轨道更靠近分界线。磁场可使方位频率小于径向频率，并在远离黑洞处产生环圈。用数值kludge方法计算10M⊙致密天体绕10^6M⊙黑洞的波形；同磁场下五维信号周期更长、频率更低、振幅小约18%。磁场参数βM=0.02时最强谱线为7.9 mHz，Kerr为9.9 mHz。辐射反作用估计表明周期轨道在外磁场下存活不到一小时到几天；LISA信噪比为7--31，Kerr约为15--54。
classification.one_liner: 比较五维Myers-Perry黑洞与Kerr黑洞中带电粒子周期轨道及EMRI引力波，磁场下五维信号频率更低、振幅更小、LISA信噪比更低。

papers.title: Regular magnetic black holes with anti-de Sitter cores in scalar-tensor gravity: axial stability and radial instability
papers.abstract: We construct static, asymptotically flat regular black holes in Einstein-frame scalar--tensor gravity, sourced by a canonical scalar coupled to magnetic nonlinear electrodynamics. Prescribing the density and scalar profiles, we reconstruct the metric, the scalar--photon coupling and the potential. Regularity requires the mass function to vanish at the centre, which fixes the ADM mass, and the central $r^2$ growth of the density to be compensated by the gradient energy of the scalar. The solutions have an anti-de Sitter core supported by a negative potential and a nearly Reissner--Nordstr\"om exterior; absence of ghosts restricts the magnetic charge to an interval that shrinks to zero at a finite core depth. Axial perturbations reduce to a symmetric two-channel master system whose positive-definite potential guarantees mode stability; spectral and time-domain quasinormal frequencies agree. Radial perturbations, by contrast, are unstable: the reconstructed potential behaves as $V\propto-\varphi^5$ near the asymptotic vacuum, the scalar becomes tachyonic outside the horizon, and every ghost-free black hole has a growing monopole mode with $\Gamma M\approx0.14$--$0.28$. An angular Laplacian instability develops near the centre; for black holes it may lie entirely within the inner horizon, while horizonless solutions leave it uncovered and are therefore excluded.

classification.title_zh: 标量-张量引力中具有反德西特核心的规则磁黑洞：轴向稳定性与径向不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在爱因斯坦框架的标量-张量引力中构造静态、渐近平坦的规则黑洞，源为与磁非线性电动力学耦合的正则标量场。通过给定密度与标量剖面，重构度规、标量-光子耦合和势。规则性要求质量函数在中心消失，从而固定ADM质量，并要求密度的中心 r^2 增长由标量梯度能补偿。解具有由负势支持的反德西特核心和近Reissner-Nordström外部；无鬼条件将磁荷限制在一个区间，该区间在有限核心深度处收缩为零。轴向扰动化为对称双通道主方程，其正定势保证模式稳定性；谱方法与时间域得到的准正规模频率一致。相反，径向扰动不稳定：重构势在渐近真空附近表现为 V∝-φ^5，标量在视界外变为快子，且每个无鬼黑洞都有一个增长的单极模，ΓM≈0.14–0.28。中心附近出现角拉普拉斯不稳定性；对黑洞它可能完全位于内视界内，而无视界解会将其暴露，因此被排除。
classification.one_liner: 构造标量-张量引力中的规则磁黑洞并发现轴向稳定但径向/单极不稳定。

papers.title: Dyonic Simpson Visser black-bounce spacetime surrounded by an exotic Einstein cluster in general relativity
papers.abstract: In this work, we present the Simpson-Visser black-bounce (SV-BB) spacetime with both electric and magnetic charges (the dyonic SV-BB) as an exact solution of general relativity coupled to Maxwell electrodynamics and an anisotropic fluid with vanishing radial pressure. We assume the anisotropic fluid represents an Einstein cluster, which consists of a dense system of particles moving in circular orbits that generate only tangential pressure and zero radial pressure. We show that the electromagnetic SV-BB metric, which provides a regular black hole spacetime, can be obtained as an exact solution to the Einstein field equations sourced by a combination of an Einstein cluster (which is responsible for providing the exotic matter required to keep a black-bounce throat open) and an electromagnetic field in the framework of Maxwell electrodynamics.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论中由奇异爱因斯坦星团包围的双荷 Simpson-Visser 黑洞反弹时空
classification.abstract_zh: 本文给出带电场和磁场电荷的双荷 Simpson-Visser 黑洞反弹时空，它是广义相对论与 Maxwell 电动力学以及径向压为零的各向异性流体耦合的精确解。作者假设该各向异性流体为爱因斯坦星团，由沿圆轨道运动的致密粒子系统构成，只产生切向压而径向压为零。结果表明，电磁 Simpson-Visser 度规（给出正则黑洞时空）可由爱因斯坦星团（提供维持黑洞反弹喉部张开所需的奇异物质）与 Maxwell 电磁场共同作为源，得到爱因斯坦场方程的精确解。
classification.one_liner: 构造了由奇异爱因斯坦星团和 Maxwell 场支撑的双荷 Simpson-Visser 黑洞反弹精确解。

papers.title: Teleparallel Renormalization of Gravitational Action
papers.abstract: We study the gravitational action in the teleparallel equivalent of general relativity, where the spin connection contributes to the action through a surface term and, when chosen appropriately, regularizes the action by effectively playing the role of a counterterm. We resolve several apparent ambiguities in this procedure using the Schwarzschild spacetime as an example. We show that the apparent discrepancy between bulk and quasilocal actions originates from contributions associated with spacetime singularities, and that the quasilocal action agrees with the standard results obtained in general relativity. We further clarify the role of the tetrad choice in determining the corresponding spin connection, showing that the proper diagonal and canonical frames give the same Euclidean action, while only the proper diagonal frame reproduces the expected Lorentzian action on the Wheeler--DeWitt patch. Finally, we establish the uniqueness of the regularization scheme and show that imposing an appropriate fall-off behavior of the torsion tensor removes the remaining ambiguity and fixes the Euclidean action uniquely.

classification.title_zh: 引力作用的远平行重正化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究广义相对论远平行等效中的引力作用量。在该形式中，自旋联络通过表面项对作用量作出贡献，并且当被适当选择时，它通过有效充当抵消项而使作用量正规化。我们以 Schwarzschild 时空为例，解决了这一程序中的若干表观歧义。我们表明，体作用量与准局域作用量之间的表观差异源于与时空奇点相关的贡献，并且准局域作用量与广义相对论中得到的标准结果一致。我们进一步澄清了标架选择在确定相应自旋联络中的作用，表明适当的对角标架与正则标架给出相同的欧氏作用量，而只有适当的对角标架在 Wheeler--DeWitt patch 上重现预期的 Lorentzian 作用量。最后，我们确立了该重整化方案的唯一性，并表明对挠率张量施加适当的衰减行为可以消除剩余的歧义并唯一地固定欧氏作用量。
classification.one_liner: 该文在远平行等效广义相对论中澄清引力作用量的重整化、自旋联络与标架选择及唯一性问题。

papers.title: Scalar perturbations and strong cosmic censorship for an asymptotically de Sitter regular black hole
papers.abstract: We investigate the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of scalar perturbations and strong cosmic censorship (SCC) in regular Ay\'on-Beato-Garc\'ia-Bronnikov-de Sitter (ABGB-dS) black hole spacetime. The main motivation of this work is to clarify whether the regularization of black hole core, which removes the central singularity, can also change the fate of SCC connected to the Cauchy horizon. We first study the dependence of the scalar QNM frequency (QNF) on the scalar mass and black hole parameters. For angular number $l=0$, a small scalar mass can give rise to a slowly decaying mode which is purely imaginary, while it will become complex for large enough scalar mass and we call it dS-like mode. We also find that the black hole charge and cosmological constant affect the QNM spectrum in qualitatively opposite ways. We then examine SCC under massless and massive scalar perturbations. For massless perturbations, the QNMs spectrum can be organized into photon sphere (PS), de Sitter (dS) and near-extremal (NE) families. Compared with the SCC in the Reissner-Nordstr\"om-de Sitter (RN-dS) case, SCC is generally more easily violated in the ABGB-dS spacetime, although this tendency is reversed for sufficiently large cosmological constant. For massive scalar perturbations, we find that the scalar mass does not restore SCC. Instead, it can enhance the violation by driving the system into the regime $\beta>1$. At last, we discuss what we may expect from the violation of SCC in a regular black hole spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 渐近de Sitter正则黑洞的标量扰动与强宇宙监督
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究正则ABGB-dS黑洞时空中标量扰动的准正规模（QNM）以及强宇宙监督（SCC）。主要动机是澄清消除中心奇点的黑洞核心正则化是否也会改变与柯西视界相关的SCC命运。首先研究标量QNM频率对标的量质量和黑洞参数的依赖。对于角量子数l=0，小标量质量可给出纯虚的慢衰减模式；质量足够大时变为复频率，称为dS-like模式。黑洞电荷和宇宙学常数对QNM谱的影响在定性上相反。随后考察无质量和有质量标量扰动下的SCC。无质量情形QNM谱可组织为光子球、dS和近极端族；与RN-dS相比，ABGB-dS中SCC一般更易被破坏，但足够大宇宙学常数会反转此趋势。有质量标量不恢复SCC，反而可通过使系统进入β>1区域增强破坏。最后讨论正则黑洞时空中SCC破坏的可能含义。
classification.one_liner: 研究ABGB-dS正则黑洞标量QNM及SCC，发现正则化通常使SCC更易破坏，有质量标量也不恢复SCC。

papers.title: Octupole moments and the non-universality of free-fall in general relativity
papers.abstract: Extended bodies in general relativity do not necessarily fall along geodesics. Instead, a body can experience accelerations that depend on its angular momentum, as well as on its quadrupole, octupole, and higher-order moments. Moreover, due to the fact that one object's multipole moments can evolve differently from those of another, different bodies can fall differently---even with identical initial data. This paper examines how octupole moments contribute to the non-universality of free-fall in general relativity. We begin by showing that in arbitrary vacuum spacetimes, only the trace-free component of an octupole moment can affect an object's motion. It follows that at least 16 out of 40 octupole components decouple from the laws of motion. We also obtain two decompositions for trace-free octupole moments, one in terms of a timelike frame vector and the other in terms of a null tetrad. These decompositions are applied to motion both in static Newtonian spacetimes and in fully-relativistic vacuum spacetimes that are of Petrov type D (such as Kerr). In Newtonian spacetimes, the mass moments are shown to have their ordinary Newtonian effects. The momentum moments instead determine a body's hidden momentum---the misalignment between its momentum and its velocity. In Petrov type D spacetimes, we show that some torques that are impossible with quadrupole moments are generically possible with octupole moments. Octupole moments can thus have qualitatively-different effects from quadrupole moments.

classification.title_zh: 八极矩与广义相对论中自由落体的非普适性
classification.abstract_zh: 广义相对论中的延展物体不一定沿测地线运动，而可能经历依赖于角动量、四极矩、八极矩及更高阶多极矩的加速度。由于不同物体的多极矩演化方式可能不同，即使初始数据相同，不同物体也可能下落不同。本文研究八极矩如何导致自由落体的非普适性。我们首先证明，在任意真空时空中，只有八极矩的无迹分量能影响物体运动，因此40个八极矩分量中至少有16个与运动定律解耦。我们还给出无迹八极矩的两种分解：一种用类时标架矢量，另一种用零标架。将这些分解应用于静态牛顿时空以及完全相对论性的Petrov D型真空时空（如Kerr时空）中的运动。在牛顿时空中，质量矩具有通常的牛顿效应；动量矩则决定物体的隐藏动量，即动量与速度之间的失准。在Petrov D型时空中，我们证明某些在四极矩下不可能的力矩在八极矩下通常是可能的。因此，八极矩可以产生与四极矩定性不同的效应。
classification.one_liner: 论文分析八极矩对广义相对论中延展物体自由落体非普适性的贡献，并给出无迹八极矩的分解及其在牛顿与Petrov D型时空中的应用。

papers.title: Eccentricity-Modulated Phase Degeneracy and Distinguishability between Dark Matter and Accretion Disk Environmental Effects in EMRIs
papers.abstract: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) are sensitive probes of weak environmental effects around massive black holes, since such effects can accumulate into observable gravitational-wave phase shifts. In this work, we study the phase degeneracy between dark matter halos and accretion disks in eccentric EMRI waveforms. We model the dark matter (DM) environment with NFW and Beta halo profiles, and describe the disk using a thin $\alpha$-disk model. Their distinguishability is quantified through eccentricity-dependent phase diagnostics and the residual signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in the LISA band. Our results show that DM-induced dephasing depends only weakly on the initial eccentricity $e_0$, whereas disk-induced dephasing is strongly suppressed as $e_0$ increases. The distinguishability time exhibits a smooth and weakly non-monotonic dependence on the initial eccentricity, while being more strongly controlled by the environmental strength. For the benchmark systems considered here, the DM--disk waveform difference can be detectable by LISA, and $e_0$ can serve as an auxiliary diagnostic in addition to the observation duration.

classification.title_zh: EMRIs中暗物质与吸积盘环境效应的偏心率调制相位简并及可区分性
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋近（EMRIs）是探测大质量黑洞周围弱环境效应的敏感探针，因为这些效应可累积为可观测的引力波相位偏移。本文研究偏心EMRI波形中暗物质晕与吸积盘之间的相位简并。我们用NFW和Beta晕模型描述暗物质环境，并用薄α盘模型描述吸积盘。其可区分性通过依赖偏心率的相位诊断量和LISA波段的残余信噪比来量化。结果表明，暗物质导致的退相位仅微弱依赖初始偏心率e0，而吸积盘导致的退相位随e0增大而受到强烈抑制。可区分时间对初始偏心率呈现平滑且弱非单调的依赖，但更强烈地受环境强度控制。对于本文考虑的基准系统，暗物质与吸积盘的波形差异可被LISA探测，且e0可作为观测时长之外的辅助诊断量。

papers.title: Wave Optics Effects from Gravitational Wave Propagation Through Dark Matter Halos
papers.abstract: Gravitational wave (GW) propagation is usually studied under the geometric optics approximation. However, when GWs propagate through structures of sizes similar to their wavelength, this approximation breaks down. To study this situation, we present a scheme for numerically evolving linearised plane GWs through stationary, spherical astrophysical structures in both weak and strong gravity regimes. Our simulations evolve the full Einstein equations (with all 10 components) for Gaussian, NFW and Burkert potentials. Our simulations show that the scattering of the GWs depends not only on the mass of the lens but also strongly on the gravitational potential distribution of the lens. Among our most important results, we find that the GWs do not propagate along null geodesics when propagating through the Gaussian density, neither in the strong nor weak gravity setting. Another significant finding is that in the strong gravity case of the Burkert potential, the convexity of the wave is flipped when leaving the structure. We compare our results with the linearized scalar wave predictions and find that the difference between these and the exact GW modes are of order one when the wave is inside the central potential. However, the difference reduces to only a few percent when the wave has passed through the structure. Although these effects are small, future GW detectors and Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs) could be sensitive to these signals which could thus potentially help in constraining the structure of dark matter spikes or halos.

classification.title_zh: 引力波穿过暗物质晕传播的波动光学效应
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波传播通常用几何光学近似研究，但当引力波穿过尺度与其波长相近的结构时该近似失效。本文提出一种数值演化方案，在弱场和强场情形下让线性化平面引力波穿过静态球对称天体物理结构，并针对高斯、NFW 和 Burkert 势演化包含全部 10 个分量的完整 Einstein 方程。模拟表明，引力波散射不仅依赖透镜质量，也强烈依赖透镜的引力势分布。重要结果包括：穿过高斯密度分布时，无论强场还是弱场，引力波都不沿零测地线传播；在 Burkert 势的强场情形中，波离开结构时其凸性发生翻转。作者还与线性标量波预言比较，发现波位于中心势内时精确引力波模式与标量波预言相差量级为一，而穿过结构后差异降至仅百分之几。尽管效应较小，未来引力波探测器和脉冲星计时阵列可能对其敏感，从而有助约束暗物质尖峰或晕的结构。
classification.one_liner: 数值演化完整线性化 Einstein 方程，研究引力波穿过球形暗物质晕势时偏离几何光学的波动光学效应。

papers.title: Non conservative conformal Killing gravity: coupling the dark sector with curvature and matter
papers.abstract: The so called Harada gravity with non conserved energy-momentum tensor is here taken into account. It includes Rastall gravity as a special case. The field equations are written as Einstein equations where the source is supplemented by a divergence-free conformal Killing tensor and a tensor proportional to the metric, linear in the scalar curvature and the trace of the energy-momentum tensor. These terms can be natural candidates for dark sector and give rise to a coupling of the dark sector with the matter content. The field equations are the conformal Killing extension of Rastall gravity, and include Unimodular gravity. In a Friedmann-Robertson-Walker background, the Cosmic Microwave Background restricts parameters so that the dark sector only couples with the trace of the energy-momentum tensor. The explicit form of the tensor for the dark sector is found, and the Friedmann and continuity equations are presented, with a standard cosmological analysis. The sum of energy-momentum tensors of dust matter and of dark fluid is conserved, and the dust energy density evolves with the scale function with exponent -3/(1+tau), modified by the coupling tau with the dark fluid.

classification.title_zh: 非保守共形Killing引力：暗扇区与曲率和物质的耦合
classification.abstract_zh: 本文考虑具有非保守能量动量张量的 Harada 引力，它是 Rastall 引力的推广。场方程写成 Einstein 方程形式，其源项除无散度的共形 Killing 张量外，还包含一个与度规成正比、线性依赖于标量曲率和能量动量张量迹的张量；这些项可作为暗扇区的自然候选，并导致暗扇区与物质内容耦合。该场方程是 Rastall 引力的共形 Killing 推广，并包含幺模引力。在 FRW 背景下，CMB 限制参数使暗扇区只与能量动量张量的迹耦合。文中给出暗扇区张量的显式形式，给出 Friedmann 方程和连续性方程，并进行标准宇宙学分析。尘埃物质与暗流体的能量动量张量之和守恒，尘埃能量密度随尺度因子按指数 -3/(1+tau) 演化，并受到与暗流体耦合 tau 的修正。

papers.title: Real Part Emergence in Purely Imaginary Quasinormal Modes in Perturbed de Sitter Braneworlds
papers.abstract: For braneworlds with infinite extra dimensions, an analysis of the stability of the characteristic spectrum is essential for understanding their dynamical properties; in this study, we investigate the stability of the gravitational quasinormal-mode (QNM) spectrum of a thick de Sitter braneworld with a noncompact extra dimension, where the unperturbed background supports a localized graviton zero mode and a tower of purely imaginary QNMs. We first reconstruct the response of the warp factor and tensor effective potential to a smooth double-kink deformation of the bulk scalar field, and then introduce a superpotential deformation that parametrizes the resulting double-barrier structure; the deformed frequency-domain spectrum develops QNM pairs with nonzero real parts, and for the representative family studied here, a weak deformation can already generate a complex branch, although the least-damped pole remains purely imaginary in part of the parameter range. In the time domain, the QNM-dominated channel exhibits a transient damped oscillatory stage, whereas the original-potential evolution becomes dominated by the zero-mode sector at late times over the simulated interval. These results identify the double-barrier geometry as the model-specific realization of a more general sensitivity of outgoing, non-self-adjoint spectra, establish a robust model-level mechanism for oscillatory QNM imprints, and provide a dimensionless benchmark for future source-to-detector analyses, while quantitative detector detectability and cosmological-parameter inference require source, response, and noise modeling beyond the present analysis.

classification.title_zh: 扰动 de Sitter 膜世界中纯虚准正规模中实部的涌现
classification.abstract_zh: 对于具有无穷额外维的膜世界，特征谱稳定性分析对理解其动力学性质至关重要；本文研究具有非紧致额外维的厚 de Sitter 膜世界的引力准正规模（QNM）谱稳定性，其未扰动背景支持局域化引力子零模和一列纯虚 QNM。我们首先重构翘曲因子和张量有效势对体标量场光滑双 kink 形变的响应，然后引入超势形变以参数化由此产生的双势垒结构；形变后的频域谱发展出具有非零实部的 QNM 对，并且对于所研究的代表性参数族，弱形变已能产生复分支，尽管在部分参数范围内最弱阻尼极点仍为纯虚。在时域中，QNM 主导通道显示瞬态阻尼振荡阶段，而原势演化在模拟区间的晚期由零模部分主导。这些结果将双势垒几何识别为出射、非自伴谱更普遍敏感性在特定模型中的实现，建立了振荡 QNM 印记的稳健模型级机制，并为未来源到探测器分析提供无量纲基准；定量探测器可探测性和宇宙学参数推断需要超出本文的源、响应和噪声建模。

papers.title: Gravitational wave polarization modes and stability analysis in Weyl geometry gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate the gravitational wave polarization modes and stability in Weyl geometry gravity within a Minkowski background. Our results indicate that the tensor sector consists of two standard modes propagating at the speed of light. Although the vector sector possesses a dynamical perturbation, it generates no polarization modes. The scalar sector, in contrast, features a mixture mode of breathing and longitudinal modes associated with a single scalar degree of freedom. The propagating solutions of this scalar mode exhibit superluminal propagation and can undergo intrinsic amplitude decay, both of which are driven by the background Weyl gauge field. We further discuss the observational detectability of this scalar mode. Our stability analysis reveals that, while the tensor and vector sectors are free from ghost and Laplacian instabilities, the scalar sector suffers from a ghost instability. These findings clarify the unique gravitational wave propagation characteristics in Weyl geometry gravity and provide theoretical foundations for testing the theory through future multi-messenger observations.

classification.title_zh: Weyl几何引力中的引力波偏振模式与稳定性分析
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在Minkowski背景下研究Weyl几何引力中的引力波偏振模式与稳定性。结果表明：张量扇区包含两个以光速传播的标准模式；矢量扇区虽有动力学扰动，但不产生偏振模式；标量扇区则表现为呼吸模式与纵向模式的混合，对应单一标量自由度。该标量模式的传播解会出现超光速传播和本征振幅衰减，二者均由背景Weyl规范场驱动。文章进一步讨论该标量模式的可探测性，并发现张量与矢量扇区无鬼模和Laplacian不稳定性，而标量扇区存在鬼不稳定性。

papers.title: Signatures of Quantum-Corrected Black Holes in Gravitational Waves from Periodic Orbits
papers.abstract: Focusing on a Schwarzschild spacetime modified by loop quantum gravity (LQG) holonomy corrections, this work explores the gravitational radiation produced by test masses in bound periodic configurations. The underlying geometry incorporates a quantum-correction parameter $q_c$ that alters the radial metric scaling while maintaining both asymptotic flatness and the classical horizon radius. The bound geodesics are systematically classified using the zoom--whirl representation labelled by three integers $(z,w,v)$. Gravitational waveforms are computed within a numerical framework that combines exact geodesic motion with the quadrupole approximation, which is suitable for extreme mass ratio inspirals. We demonstrate that the quantum corrections lead to distinct phase shifts, amplitude variations, and modifications to the harmonic structure of the waveforms, with increasingly complex features for orbits with larger zoom numbers. The corresponding frequency spectra and characteristic strain peak, which fall within the millihertz band, are within the sensitivity ranges of space-based detectors such as LISA, Taiji, and TianQin. For specific orbital configurations and values of the quantum-correction parameter, the characteristic strain exceeds the projected detector noise, indicating potential observability. Our results demonstrate that gravitational waves from periodic orbits provide a sensitive probe of quantum-corrected black hole spacetimes in the strong-field regime.

classification.title_zh: 周期轨道引力波中量子修正黑洞的印记
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究由圈量子引力 holonomy 修正的 Schwarzschild 时空中，试验质量在束缚周期轨道上产生的引力辐射。度规含量子修正参数 q_c，改变径向标度但保持渐近平直性和经典视界半径。束缚测地线用 (z,w,v) 三个整数标记的 zoom-whirl 表示系统分类。数值框架结合精确测地线运动与适用于极端质量比旋进的四极近似来计算引力波波形。结果表明，量子修正导致相位移动、振幅变化以及波形谐波结构的改变，且 zoom 数越大特征越复杂。相应频谱和特征应变峰值位于毫赫兹波段，落在 LISA、太极、天琴等空间探测器的灵敏度范围内；对特定轨道配置和 q_c 值，特征应变超过预期探测器噪声，表明可能可观测。结果说明周期轨道引力波可作为强场区量子修正黑洞时空的敏感探针。

papers.title: A Machian wave effect in conformal, scalar-tensor gravitational theory
papers.abstract: Woodward's simultaneous energy-density identities, imposed exactly with a constant physical speed of light and nonzero proper density, fix the potential and exclude the independent potential derivatives used in his derivation. A background interpretation instead requires the perturbation terms omitted by that derivation. In general relativity (GR), the second time derivative isolated from the exact Landau-Lifshitz equations belongs to the gravitational operator and supplies no additional material mass source. In the Hoyle-Narlikar (HN) derivation of Woodward and Fearn, the linear second time derivative cancels from the time-time component; the covariant trace cancels the squared-gradient terms retained in Fearn's diagonal sum. Their propulsion estimates contain further errors in mechanical power, momentum transfer and constitutive dimensions. The mechanical analysis retains damping, complex harmonic response and the dissipative energy and entropy balances. For a smooth strictly positive scalar, an admissible Weyl transformation, universal material coupling and consistently mapped matter, driving and boundary data, the complete continuum conformal HN action becomes the Einstein action. Under these hypotheses, the additional measured force relative to the corresponding Einstein result is identically zero for the same physical matter model. Compatible global source-integral and absorber conditions restrict the admitted solutions and preserve this equality. Woodward and Fearn's mass-fluctuation and propulsion formulas do not follow from the stated GR or continuum conformal HN equations. Their additional scalar propulsion force is excluded in the local continuum sector under the stated hypotheses.

classification.title_zh: 共形标量-张量引力理论中的马赫波效应
classification.abstract_zh: Woodward 的同时能量密度恒等式在物理光速恒定且固有密度非零时被精确施加，会固定势并排除其推导中使用的独立势导数；若作背景解释，则需要该推导省略的扰动项。在广义相对论中，从精确 Landau-Lifshitz 方程分离出的二阶时间导数属于引力算子，不提供额外的物质质量源。在 Woodward 与 Fearn 的 Hoyle-Narlikar 推导中，线性二阶时间导数从 time-time 分量中抵消；协变迹抵消了 Fearn 对角求和中保留的平方梯度项。其推进估计在机械功率、动量传递和本构量纲方面还有进一步错误。力学分析保留阻尼、复谐响应以及耗散能量与熵平衡。对于光滑且严格为正的标量，在可容许 Weyl 变换、普适物质耦合以及一致映射的物质、驱动和边界数据下，完整的连续共形 HN 作用量变为 Einstein 作用量。在这些假设下，对于同一物理物质模型，相对于相应 Einstein 结果的额外测量力恒为零。相容的全局源积分与吸收体条件会限制容许解并保持该等式。Woodward 与 Fearn 的质量涨落和推进公式不能由所述 GR 或连续共形 HN 方程推出；在所述假设下，其额外标量推进力在局部连续区中被排除。

papers.title: False Alarm Rates in Detecting Gravitational Wave Lensing from Astrophysical Coincidences: Insights with Model-Independent Technique GLANCE
papers.abstract: Lensing of gravitational waves (GWs) due to intervening massive astrophysical systems between the source and the observer is an inevitable consequence of the general theory of relativity, which can produce multiple GW events with overlapping sky localization error. However, the confirmed detection of such a unique astrophysical phenomenon is challenging due to several sources of contamination, ranging from detector noise to astrophysical uncertainties. Robust model-independent search techniques that can mitigate noise contamination have been developed in the past. In this study, we explore the astrophysical uncertainty associated with incorrectly classifying a pair of unlensed GW events as a lensed pair and the associated false alarm rate (FAR) depending on the GW source properties. To understand the effect of unlensed astrophysical GW sources in producing false lensing detections, we perform a model-independent test using the pipeline GLANCE on a simulated population of merging binary black holes (BBHs). We find that $\sim$ 0.01\% of the pair of events can be falsely classified as lensed with a lensing threshold signal-to-noise ratio of 1.5, appearing at a time delay between the pair of events of $\sim$ 1000 days or more. We show the FAR distribution for the parameter space of the GW source masses, delay time, and lensing magnification parameter over which the model-independent technique GLANCE can confidently detect lensed GW pair with the current LIGO detector sensitivity. In the future, this technique will be useful in understanding the lensing FAR for next-generation GW detectors, which can observe more GW sources.

classification.title_zh: 从天体物理符合事件探测引力波透镜的误报率：基于模型无关技术GLANCE的洞见
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波经过源与观测者之间的致密天体系统时会发生透镜效应，这是广义相对论的必然结果，可产生天区定位误差重叠的多个引力波事件。然而，探测器噪声和天体物理不确定性使确认此类现象具有挑战性。本文研究将一对未透镜引力波事件错误分类为透镜事件的天体物理不确定性及相应误报率，并使用模型无关 pipeline GLANCE 对模拟的双黑洞并合族群进行检验。结果显示，在透镜信噪比阈值为 1.5 时，约 0.01% 的事件对可被误分类为透镜事件，且出现在约 1000 天或更长的时间延迟处。文中给出了 GLANCE 在当前 LIGO 灵敏度下可置信探测透镜引力波对的质量、延迟时间和放大率参数空间中的误报率分布，并指出该技术未来可用于理解下一代引力波探测器的透镜误报率。

papers.title: Using Gauge Covariant Lie Derivatives in Poincar\'{e} Gauge and Metric Teleparallel Theories of Gravity
papers.abstract: A procedure to determine the initial ansatz for the co-frame and spin connection characterizing a Riemann-Cartan geometry respecting a given group of continuous symmetries is illustrated. Assuming invariance of the metric under a particular group of symmetries, this gauge covariant Lie derivative when applied to the metric and associated orthonormal co-frame determines the values of an antisymmetric compensating matrix. The gauge covariant Lie derivative of the spin connection depends on this matrix, which when solved yields the spin connection compatible with the chosen co-frame. The procedure is straightforward and can be employed for any Riemann-Cartan geometry having symmetries including those with a non-trivial isotropy subgroup. Here we illustrate the procedure with numerous examples, including, spherically symmetric, plane symmetric, locally rotationally symmetric Bianchi type III, G\"{o}del, de Sitter and anti-de Sitter geometries. Further, we have also solved the zero curvature constraint to obtain the resulting spin connection for the corresponding metric teleparallel geometry having this same symmetry group. We complete this investigation by including the Lorentz transformation that yields the proper frame for some of these metric teleparallel geometries. This investigation provides a kinematical framework useful for the further study of Poincar\'{e} Gauge and metric teleparallel theories of gravity.

classification.title_zh: 在庞加莱规范与度规远平行引力理论中使用规范协变李导数
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种确定Riemann-Cartan几何在给定连续对称群下协架和自旋联络初始拟设的方法。假设度规在特定对称群下不变，将规范协变李导数作用于度规及相应正交协架，可确定反对称补偿矩阵；再对自旋联络取该李导数并求解，得到与所选协架相容的自旋联络。该方法适用于包括非平凡迷向子群在内的任意Riemann-Cartan对称几何，并以球对称、平面对称、局部旋转对称Bianchi III型、Gödel、de Sitter和anti-de Sitter等几何为例说明；还求解零曲率约束以得到相应度规远平行几何的自旋联络，并给出部分情形下得到适当标架的Lorentz变换。该工作为庞加莱规范与度规远平行引力理论的进一步研究提供运动学框架。

papers.title: Quasinormal Ringing of de Sitter Braneworlds
papers.abstract: Compared with the Poincar\'e braneworld, the de Sitter (dS) braneworld aligns more closely with the present universe characterized by a small but finite cosmological constant; to explore the quasinormal ringing properties within the dS brane scenario, we investigate gravitational perturbations in both thin and thick dS brane configurations. Analysis of the perturbation equations reveals that the effective potential along the extra dimension exhibits the shape of a P\"oschl-Teller potential, asymptotically approaching a constant value (mass gap) at infinity, and in particular this mass gap can be reduced. Analytical calculations further indicate that the gravitational perturbations, apart from the zero mode, possess a series of discrete, purely imaginary quasinormal modes in the late stages, implying that these perturbations decay without oscillation over time; the analytical findings also demonstrate that the brane structure primarily determines the distribution of the quasinormal spectrum while preserving the purely imaginary nature of the quasinormal frequencies. Subsequently, we further simulate the gravitational wave signal by numerically evolving the perturbation equations, which yields late-stage results consistent with the analytical predictions. Interestingly, these quasinormal modes carry information about the cosmological constant on the brane, which provides a potential new pathway for the study of cosmology in the dS brane scenario.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 膜世界的准正规模铃宕
classification.abstract_zh: 与 Poincaré 膜世界相比，de Sitter（dS）膜世界更接近当前宇宙，其宇宙学常数很小但非零；为探索 dS 膜场景中的准正规模铃宕性质，我们研究薄和厚 dS 膜构型中的引力扰动。对扰动方程的分析表明，沿额外维的有效势呈 Pöschl-Teller 势形状，在无穷远处渐近趋于常数值（质量间隙），尤其该质量间隙可被降低。解析计算进一步表明，除零模外，引力扰动在晚期具有一系列离散的、纯虚的准正规模，意味着这些扰动随时间无振荡衰减；解析结果还表明，膜结构主要决定准正规模谱的分布，同时保持准正规模频率的纯虚性质。随后，我们通过数值演化扰动方程进一步模拟引力波信号，得到的晚期结果与解析预言一致。有趣的是，这些准正规模携带膜上宇宙学常数的信息，这为 dS 膜场景中的宇宙学研究提供了潜在新途径。
classification.one_liner: 该文解析和数值研究了薄/厚 dS 膜中引力扰动的准正规模，发现除零模外为纯虚频率并携带膜上宇宙学常数信息。

papers.title: Introduction to the ADM formalism
papers.abstract: The authors present concepts and mathematical developments which give rise to the Hamiltonian formulation of Einstein's general relativity, first introduced by Arnowitt, Deser, and Misner. All the geometrical quantities needed for the construction are explicitly obtained, and examples of some of the application of the formalism are given.

papers.title: Self-force in hyperbolic black hole encounters
papers.abstract: Self-force methods can be applied in calculations of the scatter angle in two-body hyperbolic encounters, working order by order in the mass ratio (assumed small) but with no recourse to a weak-field approximation. This, in turn, can inform ongoing efforts to construct an accurate description of the general-relativistic binary dynamics via an effective-one-body description or other approaches. Existing self-force methods are to a large extent specialised to bound, inspiral orbits. Here we derive the first-order conservative self-force correction to the scattering angle, show its agreement with recent post-Minkowsian results, and develop a technique for (numerical) self-force calculations that can efficiently tackle scatter orbits. In the method, the metric perturbation is reconstructed from a Hertz potential that satisfies (mode-by-mode) a certain inhomogeneous version of the Teukolsky equation. The crucial ingredient in this formulation are certain jump conditions that the (multipole modes of the) Hertz potential must satisfy along the worldline of the small body's orbit. We present a closed-form expression for these jumps, for an arbitrary geodesic orbit in Schwarzschild spacetime. To begin developing the numerical infrastructure, a scalar-field evolution code on a Schwarzschild background (in 1+1D) is developed. Following this, results for the conservative scalar self-force corrections to the scatter angle are calculated. We continue by constructing a Teukolsky evolution code on a Schwarzschild background. This produces numerically unstable solutions due to unphysical homogeneous solutions of the Teukolsky equation at the horizon and null infinity being seeded by numerical error. This can be resolved by a change of variables to a Regge-Wheeler-like field. We then present a full numerical implementation of this method for circular and scatter orbits in Schwarzschild.

classification.title_zh: 双曲黑洞交会中的自作用力
classification.abstract_zh: 自作用力方法可用于计算两体双曲交会的散射角，按质量比（假定很小）逐阶展开，而不依赖弱场近似。这反过来可帮助构建广义相对论双星动力学的精确描述，例如有效单体描述或其他方法。现有自作用力方法在很大程度上针对束缚的旋进轨道。这里我们导出对散射角的一阶保守自作用力修正，展示其与近期后闵可夫斯基结果一致，并发展一种可有效处理散射轨道的（数值）自作用力计算技术。在该方法中，度规扰动由满足（逐模式）某个非齐次 Teukolsky 方程的 Hertz 势重构。该表述的关键要素是 Hertz 势（的多极模式）沿小天体轨道世界线必须满足的跳跃条件。我们给出 Schwarzschild 时空中任意测地轨道这些跳跃的闭式表达式。为开始发展数值基础设施，开发了 Schwarzschild 背景上的标量场演化代码（1+1D）。随后计算了散射角的保守标量自作用力修正结果。我们继续构建 Schwarzschild 背景上的 Teukolsky 演化代码。由于 Teukolsky 方程在视界和零无穷处的非物理齐次解被数值误差激发，这会产生数值不稳定解。可通过变量变换到类 Regge-Wheeler 场来解决。然后我们给出该方法在 Schwarzschild 中圆轨道和散射轨道上的完整数值实现。
classification.one_liner: 本文给出 Schwarzschild 时空中双曲散射轨道的一阶保守自作用力修正，并发展基于 Hertz 势与 Teukolsky 演化的数值方法。

papers.title: Time-domain metric reconstruction for hyperbolic scattering
papers.abstract: Self-force methods can be applied in calculations of the scatter angle in two-body hyperbolic encounters, working order by order in the mass ratio (assumed small) but with no recourse to a weak-field approximation. This, in turn, can inform ongoing efforts to construct an accurate model of the general-relativistic binary dynamics via an effective-one-body description and other semi-analytical approaches. Existing self-force methods are to a large extent specialised to bound, inspiral orbits. Here we develop a technique for (numerical) self-force calculations that can efficiently tackle scatter orbits. The method is based on a time-domain reconstruction of the metric perturbation from a scalar-like Hertz potential that satisfies the Teukolsky equation, an idea pursued so far only for bound orbits. The crucial ingredient in this formulation are certain jump conditions that (each multipole mode of) the Hertz potential must satisfy along the orbit, in a 1+1-dimensional multipole reduction of the problem. We obtain a closed-form expression for these jumps, for an arbitrary geodesic orbit in Schwarzschild spacetime, and present a full numerical implementation for a scatter orbit. In this paper we focus on method development, and go only as far as calculating the Hertz potential; a calculation of the self-force and its physical effects on the scatter orbit will be the subject of forthcoming work.

classification.title_zh: 双曲散射的时域度规重构
classification.abstract_zh: 自力方法可用于计算两体双曲相遇中的散射角，按质量比（假定很小）逐阶展开，但不依赖弱场近似。这反过来可为通过有效单体描述及其他半解析方法构建广义相对论双体动力学的精确模型提供信息。现有自力方法在很大程度上专门针对束缚的旋进轨道。本文发展一种可高效处理散射轨道的（数值）自力计算技术。该方法基于从满足 Teukolsky 方程的类标量 Hertz 势进行度规微扰的时域重构，此前该思路仅用于束缚轨道。该表述的关键要素是 Hertz 势（的每个多极模式）沿轨道必须满足的若干跳跃条件，在问题的 1+1 维多极约化中。我们给出了 Schwarzschild 时空中任意测地轨道的这些跳跃的闭式表达式，并给出散射轨道的完整数值实现。本文侧重方法发展，仅计算到 Hertz 势；自力及其对散射轨道物理效应的计算将留待后续工作。
classification.one_liner: 发展 Schwarzschild 时空中双曲散射轨道的时域自力度规重构方法，给出 Hertz 势跳跃条件与数值实现。

papers.title: Twinor Theory: Field Equations from $(A)dS_4^{\mathbb C}$ Spin-Tractors: A Twin to Twistor Theory Modelled on $(A)dS_4^{\mathbb C}$
papers.abstract: Twinor theory is formulated as a spacetime-based counterpart to twistor theory using holomorphic reductive Cartan geometry modelled on complexified $(A)dS_4$. The fundamental spin-tractor bundle defines Dirac twinors, its symmetric powers define ladder twinors, and their extremal Lorentz components define chiral twinors. The general \textit{twinor field equation} is $D\mathbf Y=\mathbf J$. Its adjacent contractions and mixed divergence are constrained by source relations; no additional equation is imposed on its completely symmetric projection. On a flat torsion-free Lorentzian background, the adjacent equations with the mass-normalization source and vanishing additional contracted sources, together with vanishing mixed divergence, reproduce the massive \textit{Dirac--Fierz--Pauli system}; the massless chiral realization gives the zero-rest-mass equations. Within the fixed mass normalization, the reality condition yielding a positive real mass squared is the \textit{anti-de Sitter reality condition} on the particle scale, independently of the cosmological scale and background curvature. The mass-coupling phase is therefore present in the classical connection before quantization. Nonlinear gravity is formulated through the full adjoint curvature, with energy--momentum and spin currents specifying Einstein--Cartan dynamics without requiring an action. The adjoint Bianchi identity constrains source compatibility, while a BGG-type sequence organizes torsion-free infinitesimal deformations. Matter interactions enter through the coupled connection and contracted source relations, with curvature compatibility recorded by $D\mathbf J=\mathcal F_D\mathbf Y$. Both chiralities are retained, and the additional consistency requirements for interacting higher-spin fields are distinguished from the underlying bundle construction.

classification.title_zh: Twinor 理论：从 $(A)dS_4^{\mathbb C}$ 自旋-牵引子得到场方程——以 $(A)dS_4^{\mathbb C}$ 为模型、作为 Twistor 理论对应物的双胞胎理论
classification.abstract_zh: Twinor 理论被表述为 twistor 理论的一个基于时空的对应物，使用以复化 $(A)dS_4$ 为模型的全纯约化 Cartan 几何。基本自旋-牵引子丛定义 Dirac twinors，其对称幂定义 ladder twinors，其极端 Lorentz 分量定义手征 twinors。一般 twinor 场方程为 $D\mathbf Y=\mathbf J$。其相邻缩并和混合散度受源关系约束；对其完全对称投影不再施加额外方程。在平直无挠 Lorentz 背景上，带质量归一化源和消失的额外缩并源、以及消失的混合散度，相邻方程重现大质量 Dirac--Fierz--Pauli 系统；无质量手征实现给出零静止质量方程。在固定质量归一化下，给出正实质量平方的实在性条件是在粒子尺度上的反 de Sitter 实在性条件，与宇宙学尺度和背景曲率无关。因此质量耦合相位在量子化之前已存在于经典联络中。非线性引力通过完整伴随曲率表述，能动张量和自旋流指定 Einstein--Cartan 动力学而无需作用量。伴随 Bianchi 恒等式约束源相容性，而 BGG 型序列组织无挠无穷小形变。物质相互作用通过耦合联络和缩并源关系进入，曲率相容性由 $D\mathbf J=\mathcal F_D\mathbf Y$ 记录。两种手征性都保留，并且相互作用高自旋场的额外相容性要求与底层丛构造相区分。
classification.one_liner: 以复化 $(A)dS_4$ 上的 Cartan 几何构造 twinor 理论，导出场方程并给出与 Dirac--Fierz--Pauli、零质量场和 Einstein--Cartan 引力的对应。

papers.title: RAKI: High-Order Alternative Finite Differences for General Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamics
papers.abstract: Binary neutron star (BNS) and black hole--neutron star mergers are among the most important multimessenger sources. Observations of these events could provide valuable insights into several unresolved phenomena, ranging from the efficiency of magnetic field amplification during and after mergers to the formation of magnetars and jets. Understanding these phenomena requires accurate modelling of magnetic field evolution, which remains a challenge for state-of-the-art general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics (GRMHD) simulations. In this work, we present \texttt{RAKI} (Relativistic Astrophysics Code Implementation of the Alternative Finite Difference Approach for GRMHD), the first GRMHD code to simulate BNS mergers using high-order alternative finite-difference methods with adaptive-order WENO (AFD-WENO-AO) reconstruction and a fully non-staggered, node-centred vector-potential formulation. The code achieves up to ninth-order convergence in smooth test problems while accurately capturing discontinuities. In magnetised Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff (TOV) star tests, \texttt{RAKI} retains $99.2$ per cent of the initial maximum magnetic field strength over ${\sim}2$ ms, exhibiting an order of magnitude less magnetic field loss than a reference GRMHD code at the same resolution. In BNS merger simulations, fifth-order AFD-WENO-AO reconstruction yields approximately third-order convergence of the gravitational-wave phase in both magnetised and unmagnetised models. The discrete no-monopole constraint is preserved to machine precision without staggered grids, even during BNS mergers with moving refinement regions. These results establish \texttt{RAKI} as a high-order, non-staggered GRMHD framework for accurate modelling of magnetic field evolution in neutron star mergers and its implications for multimessenger astrophysics.

classification.title_zh: RAKI：用于广义相对论磁流体力学的高阶替代有限差分方法
classification.abstract_zh: 双中子星（BNS）与黑洞—中子星并合是最重要的多信使源之一。观测这些事件有助于理解并合期间及之后磁场放大的效率、磁星与喷流的形成等未解决问题。准确模拟磁场演化对当前广义相对论磁流体力学（GRMHD）模拟仍是挑战。本文提出 RAKI（Relativistic Astrophysics Code Implementation of the Alternative Finite Difference Approach for GRMHD），这是首个使用高阶替代有限差分方法、采用自适应阶 WENO（AFD-WENO-AO）重构以及完全非交错、节点中心矢量势形式来模拟 BNS 并合的 GRMHD 代码。该代码在光滑测试问题中达到最高九阶收敛，同时能准确捕捉间断。在磁化 Tolman—Oppenheimer—Volkoff（TOV）星测试中，RAKI 在约 2 ms 内保留了初始最大磁场强度的 99.2%，在相同分辨率下磁场损失比参考 GRMHD 代码低一个量级。在 BNS 并合模拟中，五阶 AFD-WENO-AO 重构使磁化和非磁化模型中的引力波相位均达到约三阶收敛。即使在使用移动细化区域的 BNS 并合过程中，离散无磁单极约束也在非交错网格上保持到机器精度。这些结果确立了 RAKI 作为高阶、非交错 GRMHD 框架的地位，可用于准确模拟中子星并合中的磁场演化及其对多信使天体物理的影响。
classification.one_liner: RAKI 是首个面向双中子星并合的高阶非交错 GRMHD 代码，采用 AFD-WENO-AO 重构并显著改善磁场保持与引力波相位收敛。

papers.title: Search for Eccentric Neutron Star-Black Hole Binaries in Advanced LIGO's Fourth Observing Run using Effective-One-Body Waveforms
papers.abstract: The observation of orbital eccentricity in compact binary coalescences would provide a direct signature of dynamical formation environments. Previous matched-filter searches for eccentric neutron star-black hole (NSBH) binaries have been severely limited by computational constraints, necessitating the use of simplified waveform models that capture secular dephasing but omit apsidal precession and inter-orbit harmonics. Including these physical features increases the sensitive search volume for systems with $0.2 \le e_{20} \le 0.28$ by $\sim 25\%$ to $30\%$. We present a rapid matched-filter search methodology that makes the direct use of time-domain effective-one-body waveforms computationally feasible. By multibanding and high-frequency ratio-filtering, our pipeline achieves a $\sim 20\times$ reduction in computational cost. This allows a bank of 88.6 million effective-one-body templates, fifteen times larger than prior eccentric analyses, to search O4a and O4b Advanced LIGO data. We recover the known low-mass mergers GW230518_125908 and GW230529_181500 with parameters consistent with zero eccentricity. Finding no new gravitational-wave events with orbital eccentricity ($e_{20} \ge 0.05$), we place $90\%$ credible upper limits on the local merger rate density of eccentric NSBH systems across the search space of $\mathcal{R}_{90\%} \le 7.5\text{-}57\ \mathrm{Gpc}^{-3}\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$, up to a factor of $\sim 4$ improvement over previous observational bounds. At the parameters of GW200105_162426, this non-detection establishes an upper limit of $\mathcal{R}_{90\%} \le 12.1\ \mathrm{Gpc}^{-3}\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$. Alternatively, if GW200105_162426 is treated as an eccentric detection, the lack of subsequent detections in O4 updates the inferred local merger rate density of this population to $\mathcal{R} = 6.6^{+6.3}_{-3.8}\ \mathrm{Gpc}^{-3}\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$.

classification.title_zh: 在Advanced LIGO第四次观测运行中使用有效单体波形搜寻偏心中子星-黑洞双星
classification.abstract_zh: 在紧凑双星并合中观测到轨道偏心率将为动力学形成环境提供直接特征。此前针对偏心中子星-黑洞（NSBH）双星的匹配滤波搜寻受计算限制，只能使用简化波形模型，这些模型包含长期退相位但忽略拱线进动和轨道间谐波。纳入这些物理特征可使对0.2≤e20≤0.28系统的敏感搜寻体积增加约25%至30%。我们提出一种快速匹配滤波搜寻方法，使直接使用时间域有效单体波形在计算上可行。通过多频带分解和高频比率滤波，我们的流程将计算成本降低约20倍。这允许使用包含8860万个有效单体模板的模板库搜寻O4a和O4b的Advanced LIGO数据，该模板库比此前的偏心分析大十五倍。我们回收了已知的低质量并合GW230518_125908和GW230529_181500，其参数与零偏心率一致。未发现新的具有轨道偏心率（e20≥0.05）的引力波事件，我们在搜寻空间内对偏心NSBH系统的本地并合率密度给出90%可信上限R90%≤7.5-57 Gpc^-3 yr^-1，比此前观测界限改善最多约4倍。在GW200105_162426的参数处，这一非探测给出上限R90%≤12.1 Gpc^-3 yr^-1。或者，若将GW200105_162426视为偏心探测，则O4中缺乏后续探测将该种群的推断本地并合率密度更新为R=6.6^{+6.3}_{-3.8} Gpc^-3 yr^-1。
classification.one_liner: 该工作开发快速有效单体匹配滤波流程，在Advanced LIGO O4数据中搜寻偏心NSBH双星，未发现新偏心事件并给出并合率上限。

papers.title: Considering Numerical Relativity Surrogate Models for AGN Channel Merger Dynamics
papers.abstract: Binary black hole mergers (BBH) are currently observed by the gravitational-wave detectors LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA (LVK). A fraction of these mergers are likely to originate in active galactic nuclei (AGN), but the details of the dynamical processes driving AGN channel mergers remain poorly understood. Monte Carlo For AGN Channel Testing and Simulation (McFACTS) is an open-source, public software used to simulate AGN channel BBH formation and evolution with configurable options for exploring various AGN and Nuclear Star Cluster (NSC) parameter options. Within McFACTS, BBH mergers evolve through gas drag and dynamical interactions, ignoring relativistic effects which can influence merger remnant properties. Here we demonstrate in McFACTS the effect of handing off inspiralling BBH to a numerical relativity (NR) surrogate model, which more accurately predicts the masses, spins, and kick velocities of merger remnants. Compared to a simple analytic approach to calculating merger and remnant properties the NR surrogate model is significantly more accurate at predicting remnant spins, which improve $\chi_{eff}$ and $\chi_{p}$ calculations, and recoil kicks, parameters especially important for higher generation BBH mergers. Our findings show the NR surrogate significantly changes distributions of remnant spins and kick velocities, as well as showing that alternative methods should be used cautiously in future studies. We also outline some simple models which are computationally efficient and can reproduce much of the NR surrogate model results.

classification.title_zh: 考虑将数值相对论代理模型用于活动星系核通道并合动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞并合目前由 LIGO、Virgo 和 KAGRA（LVK）引力波探测器观测到。其中一部分并合可能起源于活动星系核（AGN），但驱动 AGN 通道并合的动力学过程细节仍不清楚。McFACTS（Monte Carlo For AGN Channel Testing and Simulation）是一个开源公共软件，用于模拟 AGN 通道中双黑洞的形成与演化，并可配置 AGN 和核星团（NSC）参数。在 McFACTS 中，双黑洞并合通过气体阻力和动力学相互作用演化，忽略了可能影响并合遗迹性质的相对论效应。本文展示在 McFACTS 中将旋近中的双黑洞交给数值相对论（NR）代理模型处理的效果，该模型能更准确地预测并合遗迹的质量、自旋和反冲速度。与计算并合及遗迹性质的简单解析方法相比，NR 代理模型在预测遗迹自旋方面显著更准确，从而改进有效自旋 χ_eff 和进动自旋 χ_p 的计算以及反冲踢速度；这些参数对更高代双黑洞并合尤其重要。结果表明，NR 代理模型显著改变遗迹自旋和踢速度的分布，并表明未来研究中应谨慎使用替代方法。我们还概述了一些计算效率高且能再现许多 NR 代理模型结果的简单模型。
classification.one_liner: 该文在 AGN 通道双黑洞并合模拟中引入数值相对论代理模型，以更准确预测并合遗迹的质量、自旋和反冲速度。

papers.title: The Redshift-Space Cluster-Galaxy Cross-Correlation as a Probe of Gravity on Cosmic Scales
papers.abstract: Testing General Relativity (GR) on cosmological scales requires probes that are directly sensitive to gravitational dynamics. We present a Fisher matrix forecast of how well the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) Bright Galaxy Survey (BGS) can constrain departures from GR through the cluster infall velocity field, using the redshift-space cluster-galaxy cross-correlation function $\xi^{\rm s}_{\rm cg}(r_p, r_\pi)$ as the primary observable. We construct mock catalogs from the AbacusSummit N-body simulations, using a Halo Occupation Distribution (HOD) model for galaxies and a log-normal mass-observable relation for cluster selection. We parameterize departures from GR with a single multiplicative factor $F_{\rm G}$ that rescales halo infall velocities relative to the GR prediction. Marginalizing over the HOD, mass-observable, and cosmological parameters, we find that DESI BGS can constrain $F_{\rm G}$ to $\sigma(F_{\rm G}) = 0.033$ at $z \sim 0.3$. This precision is sufficient to distinguish representative $f(R)$ and Galileon gravity models from GR at $\gtrsim 4\sigma$. The strongest limitation is a degeneracy between $F_{\rm G}$ and the scatter in the cluster mass-observable relation, while the constraint shows no strong degeneracy with any individual HOD parameter. Perfect knowledge of the galaxy-halo connection would improve the constraint to $\sigma(F_{\rm G}) \approx 0.015$, and including the galaxy autocorrelation function in the data vector could recover part of this improvement. The same data vector yields tight constraints on the cosmological parameters, $\sigma(\Omega_m) = 0.010$ and $\sigma(\sigma_8) = 0.010$, only moderately correlated with $F_{\rm G}$. These results demonstrate the potential of DESI BGS cluster-galaxy correlations to test gravity on quasi-linear scales, complementary to existing modified gravity probes and to weak-lensing cluster mass profiles.

classification.title_zh: 红移空间星系团-星系互相关作为宇宙尺度引力探针
classification.abstract_zh: 在宇宙学尺度检验广义相对论需要直接敏感于引力动力学的探针。我们给出Fisher矩阵预报，评估DESI亮星系巡天（BGS）通过星系团下落速度场、以红移空间星系团-星系互相关函数ξ^s_cg(r_p,r_π)为主要观测量，能多好地限制对GR的偏离。我们基于AbacusSummit N体模拟构造模拟星表，星系采用HOD模型，星系团选择采用对数正态质量-可观测量关系。我们用单一乘性因子F_G参数化对GR的偏离，该因子相对于GR预言重新标度晕下落速度。在边缘化HOD、质量-可观测量和宇宙学参数后，发现DESI BGS在z~0.3可将F_G限制到σ(F_G)=0.033。该精度足以以≳4σ区分代表性f(R)和Galileon引力模型与GR。最强限制是F_G与星系团质量-可观测量关系散射之间的退化，而与任何单个HOD参数没有强退化。完全知道星系-晕连接可将限制改善到σ(F_G)≈0.015，将星系自相关函数加入数据向量可恢复部分改善。同一数据向量给出紧宇宙学参数限制σ(Ω_m)=0.010和σ(σ_8)=0.010，仅与F_G中等相关。这些结果表明DESI BGS星系团-星系相关在准线性尺度检验引力的潜力，补充现有修改引力探针和弱透镜星系团质量轮廓。
classification.one_liner: 利用DESI BGS红移空间星系团-星系互相关对GR偏离作Fisher预报，可高精度限制晕下落速度修正因子F_G。

papers.title: Seeing Unseen Gravitational Wave Inspirals at the Galactic Center
papers.abstract: The Galactic Center is expected to host a population of extremely large mass-ratio inspirals (X-MRIs) migrating toward the supermassive black hole. We propose an observational approach utilizing the secular gravitational torque exerted by X-MRIs on the highly eccentric S-star S301. This approach is intrinsically limited by the stochastic nature of the surrounding stellar-mass black hole cusp. As S301 propagates through this granular medium, it experiences discrete gravitational encounters. Standard orbital fitting procedures inherently assume a smooth background potential; applying them to stochastic trajectories averages these discrete velocity discontinuities into a continuous secular drift. This introduces a systematic bias that mimics the X-MRI precession signal, invalidating traditional mass estimation techniques. To resolve this degeneracy, we implement a methodology based on the Wavelet Transform Modulus Maxima method to characterize the local H\"older regularity of the orbital motion. This model isolates the singular discontinuities induced by stellar-mass black hole encounters from the continuous torque of the X-MRI distribution, allowing for detection even when instantaneous accelerations are below the instrumental noise threshold. We demonstrate analytically that S301 is highly sensitive to the interior X-MRI population while remaining dynamically decoupled from the secular influence of the exterior cusp. Combining precision astrometry and radial velocity projections, we establish that a minimal population of two X-MRIs is detectable within a five to nine-year timeframe, allowing us to constrain the presence of an unseen orbiter population prior to the launch of space-based gravitational wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 观测银河系中心未见的引力波旋近源
classification.abstract_zh: 银河系中心预计存在大量极大质量比旋近（X-MRI），并向超大质量黑洞迁移。作者提出利用X-MRI对高偏心率S星S301施加的长期引力矩进行观测。该方法本质上受周围恒星级黑洞 cusp 随机性的限制：S301穿过这种颗粒状介质时会经历离散引力遭遇。标准轨道拟合流程默认背景势平滑，会把随机轨迹中的离散速度不连续平均成连续长期漂移，从而引入模仿X-MRI进动信号系统偏差，使传统质量估计失效。为解决这一简并，作者采用小波变换模极大值方法刻画轨道运动的局部Hölder正则性，将恒星级黑洞遭遇造成的奇异不连续与X-MRI分布的连续力矩分离，从而即使在瞬时加速度低于仪器噪声阈值时也能探测。分析表明，S301对内部X-MRI族群高度敏感，同时对外部cusp的长期影响动力学退耦。结合精密天体测量与径向速度投影，作者确定最少两个X-MRI可在五到九年的时间尺度内被探测，从而能在空间引力波探测器发射前约束未见的轨道器族群。
classification.one_liner: 提出用小波模极大值分析S301轨道中的奇异加速度跳变，以在空间引力波探测器发射前探测银心X-MRI族群。

papers.title: Anisotropic overlap reduction functions for arbitrary equal-arm TDI channels: A fully analytic framework and efficient evaluation
papers.abstract: We establish a unified analytic framework for anisotropic overlap reduction functions (ORFs) of arbitrary finite-delay time-delay interferometry (TDI) channels in a static, reciprocal, equal-arm equilateral constellation. The construction combines the polynomial constraints for laser-noise cancellation, constellation symmetries, and directional-projection integration. A free basis of the admissible channel module separates channel generation from angular integration; two families of elementary angular kernels then generate all channel-pair intensity ORFs. The channel algebra is independent of gravitational-wave polarization, and the intensity-kernel reduction applies to tensor, vector, breathing, and longitudinal sectors. Tensor multipoles illustrate the framework here. Complete propagation effects are retained at arbitrary fixed finite angular order, with explicit examples through $\ell=5$. Prepared frequency batches, shared multiprecision expressions, and local expansions at removable delay points provide stable evaluation. In the prepared-batch benchmark, the analytic implementation is approximately 50 to 5000 times faster than optimized sky quadrature at matched error tolerances. Independent multiprecision sky integrations also validate prescribed mixed error targets down to $10^{-100}$ in the tested cases. The resulting kernels and generation rules supply reusable inputs for anisotropic multichannel background models.

classification.title_zh: 任意等臂TDI通道的各向异性重叠约化函数：全解析框架与高效计算
classification.abstract_zh: 本文针对静态、互易、等臂等边星座中的任意有限延迟时间延迟干涉（TDI）通道，建立各向异性重叠约化函数（ORF）的统一解析框架。构造结合激光噪声消除的多项式约束、星座对称性与方向投影积分。可容许通道模的自由基将通道生成与角度积分分离；两类基本角度核生成所有通道对强度ORF。通道代数与引力波极化无关，强度核约化适用于张量、矢量、呼吸和纵向扇区。文中以张量多极展开为例，并在任意固定有限角阶保留完整传播效应，给出至ℓ=5的显式例子。预准备频率批次、共享多精度表达式及可去延迟点处的局部展开提供稳定计算。基准测试中，解析实现在匹配误差容限下比优化天空积分快约50至5000倍；独立多精度天空积分也验证了测试情形下低至10^{-100}的混合误差目标。所得核与生成规则可为各向异性多通道背景模型提供可复用输入。
classification.one_liner: 为任意等臂TDI通道建立各向异性重叠约化函数的全解析生成与高效稳定计算方法。

papers.title: Curvature Blindness: Material Inference in Stars and Black Hole Candidates
papers.abstract: Gravitational observations can leave material properties undetermined in two different ways: distinct states can have the same total source, and distinct spacetime histories can have the same retained observations. We organize these inverse problems in general relativity through a property-level identifiability criterion, with applications to stars and black hole candidates. Two ideal massless gases illustrate equal-source ambiguity: their temperatures differ by a factor of $(8/29)^{1/4}$ and their entropies differ while their stress-energy tensors agree. A separate causal-fluid example starts with identical sources and geometric data but different constitutive responses; the two models' curvature histories separate at linear order in proper time and their scale factors at cubic order. For black hole candidates, the relevant distinction is between stationary exterior parameters, perturbing fluxes and constituent history. The framework provides a test for whether retained data identify a material property, separating instantaneous source equality, history-wide source equality and observational projection.

classification.title_zh: 曲率盲区：恒星与黑洞候选体中的物质推断
classification.abstract_zh: 引力观测会以两种方式使物质性质无法确定：不同状态可以有相同的总源，不同时空历史可以保留相同的观测。我们通过性质层面的可识别性判据在广义相对论中组织这些反问题，并应用于恒星和黑洞候选体。两个理想无质量气体说明等源模糊性：它们的温度相差因子 (8/29)^{1/4}，熵不同而应力-能量张量相同。另一个因果流体例子从相同源和几何数据出发但本构响应不同；两个模型的曲率历史在固有时线性阶分开，标度因子在三次阶分开。对于黑洞候选体，相关区分在于稳态外部参数、扰动通量和组分历史。该框架提供一个检验保留数据是否识别物质性质的方法，区分瞬时源相等、历史范围源相等和观测投影。
classification.one_liner: 提出广义相对论中的性质层面可识别性判据，用等源气体与因果流体例子说明恒星和黑洞候选体的物质推断盲区。

papers.title: Gravitational waves away from a Schwarzschild black hole: full spectrum analysis
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves as one approaches Schwarzschild null infinity are the core of our investigation, treated as the spin-weighted generalisation of a massless scalar field. In particular, we compute their full spectrum, consistent with observations coming from LIGO and VIRGO experiments. This paper continues recent work by the authors, where the Poincar\'e asymptotic expansion was exploited in black hole perturbation theory. The mathematical formalism we developed is now intimately connected with gravitational wave phenomenology, providing new mathematical tools to investigate their features.

classification.title_zh: 远离史瓦西黑洞的引力波：全谱分析
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了接近史瓦西零无穷时的引力波，将其视为无质量标量场的自旋加权推广。特别地，我们计算了它们的全谱，并与LIGO和VIRGO实验观测相一致。本文延续作者近期的工作，其中在黑洞微扰理论中利用了庞加莱渐近展开。我们发展的数学形式现在与引力波现象学紧密联系，为研究其特性提供了新的数学工具。
classification.one_liner: 在史瓦西零无穷附近用自旋加权无质量场与庞加莱渐近展开计算黑洞引力波全谱，并联系LIGO/VIRGO现象学。

papers.title: Disentangling Spin-induced Precession vs. Eccentricity in GW190521 and GW231123
papers.abstract: We use the more than 2000 full numerical-relativity simulations included in the fifth release of the RIT binary-black-hole waveform catalog to perform Bayesian parameter estimation, via the rapid iterative fitting algorithm (RIFT), for the gravitational-wave events GW190521 and GW231123. We revisit GW190521, which has previously been identified as potentially possessing large eccentricity upon entering the detector band at $20~\mathrm{Hz}$, and confirm this finding: the highest likelihood is obtained from waveforms that are simultaneously eccentric and spin-precessing, yielding $e_{20} =0.207_{-0.147}^{+0.192}$ and $\chi_{1,\perp}=0.717_{-0.406}^{+0.194}$. Applying the same simulation pool to GW231123, we likewise find a preference for spin precession where at 20 Hz $\chi_{1,\perp}=0.678_{-0.462}^{+0.218}$, but in this case with negligible eccentricity at both $10~\mathrm{Hz}$ and $20~\mathrm{Hz}$, with $e_{10}=0.097_{-0.073}^{+0.124}$ and $e_{20}=0.056_{-0.045}^{+0.059}$. For comparison, both events are also analyzed using exclusively non-precessing (eccentric and quasi-circular) simulations, which yield lower likelihoods in each case. These results indicate that our approach is capable of discriminating between the effects of eccentricity and spin precession in current gravitational-wave signals. The singled out top peak likelihood NR simulations give estimates of the recoil velocities of the merged final holes of 3965km/s for GW190521, and of 2059km/s for GW231123.

classification.title_zh: 区分 GW190521 和 GW231123 中自旋诱导的进动与偏心率
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用第五版 RIT 双黑洞波形目录中包含的 2000 多个完整数值相对论模拟，通过快速迭代拟合算法（RIFT）对引力波事件 GW190521 和 GW231123 进行贝叶斯参数估计。我们重新审视了此前被认为在进入 20 Hz 探测器频带时可能具有大偏心率的 GW190521，并确认了这一发现：最高似然来自同时具有偏心率和自旋进动的波形，给出 e20 = 0.207_{-0.147}^{+0.192} 和 χ1,⊥ = 0.717_{-0.406}^{+0.194}。将同一模拟池应用于 GW231123，我们同样发现偏好自旋进动，在 20 Hz 时 χ1,⊥ = 0.678_{-0.462}^{+0.218}，但此事件在 10 Hz 和 20 Hz 处偏心率可忽略，分别为 e10 = 0.097_{-0.073}^{+0.124} 和 e20 = 0.056_{-0.045}^{+0.059}。作为比较，两个事件也仅使用非进动（偏心与准圆）模拟进行分析，每种情况下似然都更低。这些结果表明，我们的方法能够区分当前引力波信号中偏心率与自旋进动的影响。被单独选出的最高峰值似然 NR 模拟给出并合后最终黑洞的反冲速度估计：GW190521 为 3965 km/s，GW231123 为 2059 km/s。
classification.one_liner: 利用 RIT 数值相对论波形库对 GW190521 和 GW231123 做贝叶斯参数估计，区分自旋进动与轨道偏心率并给出反冲速度估计。
