papers.title: Photon Rings and Mass-Independent Observables of a Five-Dimensional Charged AdS Black Hole
papers.abstract: We investigate the optical properties of a five-dimensional charged anti-de Sitter (AdS) black hole. Using the null geodesic equations, we determine the event horizon and photon sphere radii and the critical impact parameter, showing that all decrease with increasing charge, while the photon sphere radius remains independent of the AdS radius. To avoid dependence on the mass scale and the observer-dependent apparent size of the shadow in an AdS spacetime, we introduce two mass-independent geometric observables: the subring exponent $\gamma$ and the ratio of the critical impact parameter to that of the direct image of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). We derive $\gamma$ in closed form and show that it is independent of the AdS radius and satisfies $2\pi/\sqrt{3}<\gamma\leq\pi\sqrt{2}$, above the values for four-dimensional Schwarzschild and Reissner--Nordstr\"om black holes. Using a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) forecast based on noiseless mock data with illustrative fractional uncertainties of $5\%$, we find that the dimensionless AdS radius can be constrained with a relative uncertainty of $16$--$19\%$, whereas the charge can be distinguished from zero only for the near-extremal fiducial model considered. Under these assumptions, the subring exponent provides a Gaussian separation of $3.4$--$5.9\sigma$ from the four-dimensional Schwarzschild black hole.

classification.title_zh: 五维带电AdS黑洞的光子环与质量无关可观测量
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究五维带电AdS黑洞的光学性质。利用零测地线方程确定事件视界、光子球半径和临界碰撞参数，发现它们均随电荷增加而减小，而光子球半径不依赖AdS半径。为避免对质量标度和AdS时空中观察者依赖的阴影表观尺寸的依赖，作者引入两个质量无关的几何可观测量：子环指数γ以及临界碰撞参数与最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）直接像的临界碰撞参数之比。作者给出γ的闭式表达式，证明其与AdS半径无关且满足2π/√3<γ≤π√2，高于四维Schwarzschild和Reissner–Nordström黑洞的相应值。基于无噪声模拟数据和5%示例性分数不确定度的MCMC预测，无量纲AdS半径可被限制到16–19%的相对不确定度，而电荷仅在所考虑的近极端基准模型中可与零区分；在此假设下，子环指数与四维Schwarzschild黑洞有3.4–5.9σ的高斯分离。
classification.one_liner: 该文用零测地线研究五维带电AdS黑洞的光子球与光子环，并提出质量无关的子环指数等几何可观测量以检验黑洞时空。

papers.title: Inverse Gertsenshte\v{i}n-Zel'dovich Effect in Time-Independent Electromagnetic Field
papers.abstract: The inverse Gertsenshte\v{i}n-Zel'dovich effect describes the conversion of gravitational waves into electromagnetic waves in the presence of a background electromagnetic field. This effect has primarily been studied for constant background electromagnetic fields. In this work, we develop a general formalism for calculating the components of the electric and magnetic fields induced by the passage of a gravitational wave through a spatially varying, time-independent background electromagnetic field. The formalism accommodates all six possible polarization modes of gravitational waves. We illustrate its applicability through several examples, including gravitational waves propagating through constant and spatially varying electromagnetic fields. We further investigate the electromagnetic signals generated by the passage of gravitational waves through astrophysical magnetic fields, particularly those associated with neutron stars and magnetars. By connecting gravitational waves and electromagnetic waves--two essential messengers of multi-messenger astronomy--the inverse Gertsenshte\v{i}n-Zel'dovich effect offers a promising framework for both gravitational-wave detection and astrophysical observations. The formalism developed here may therefore find applications in the design of high-frequency gravitational-wave detectors and in the investigation of high-energy astrophysical electromagnetic signals.

classification.title_zh: 时不变电磁场中的逆Gertsenshtein-Zel'dovich效应
classification.abstract_zh: 逆Gertsenshtein-Zel'dovich效应描述引力波在背景电磁场中转化为电磁波。本文针对空间变化且不随时间变化的背景电磁场，建立计算引力波通过时感生电场和磁场分量的通用形式，并适用于引力波的全部六种偏振模式。作者用恒定与空间变化电磁场等例子说明其适用性，并研究引力波穿过中子星和磁星等天体磁场时产生的电磁信号。该效应连接引力波与电磁波这两种多信使天文学信使，可能用于高频引力波探测器设计和高能天体电磁信号研究。
classification.one_liner: 建立引力波在空间变化时不变电磁场中产生电磁信号的通用形式，并讨论中子星/磁星磁场与高频引力波探测应用。

papers.title: Diamonds in the sky: the shape of gravitational waves from cosmic string cusps
papers.abstract: We carry an in-depth analysis of the gravitational wave (GW) emission of cosmic string cusps, going beyond the seminal work of Damour and Vilenkin. We identify two features that, to the best of our knowledge, have not been described in the literature: first the GWs emission from a cusp, at any given frequency, is not concentrated inside a cone but instead draws a diamond-like shape in the sky. Second, the emission is not maximal in the direction of the cusp velocity, but in two slightly offset directions. We explain these effects in detail, and illustrate them with simplified examples. Then, we study two limiting cases for which the overall radiated power is enhanced: when the diamond is stretched in a particular direction, and when higher order derivatives vanish at the cusp. We statistically estimate the importance of these effects in a population of odd-harmonic loops.

classification.title_zh: 天空中的钻石：宇宙弦尖点引力波的形状
classification.abstract_zh: 我们对宇宙弦尖点的引力波（GW）发射进行了深入分析，超越了 Damour 和 Vilenkin 的开创性工作。我们识别出据我们所知文献中尚未描述的两个特征：第一，尖点在任意给定频率下的引力波发射并不集中在一个锥体内，而是在天空中描绘出钻石状形状。第二，发射在尖点速度方向上并非最大，而是在两个略微偏移的方向上最大。我们详细解释这些效应，并用简化例子说明。然后，我们研究两种总体辐射功率增强的极限情形：当钻石在某一特定方向上被拉伸时，以及当尖点处高阶导数消失时。我们统计估计这些效应在一族奇次谐波环中的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 该文重新分析宇宙弦尖点的经典引力波发射，发现其天空分布呈钻石状且最大发射方向偏离尖点速度方向，并估计相关效应在奇次谐波环群体中的重要性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究宇宙弦尖点的经典引力波发射与天空分布，不属于全息对偶或用户列出的全息研究支线；仅与经典引力/引力波标签相关。

papers.title: Self-Bound Anisotropic Stars in $\mathcal{R}+\alpha\mathcal{R}^2$ Gravity with a Hayward Exterior: Junction Conditions and NICER Constraints
papers.abstract: Analytic compact-star models in modified gravity usually borrow the junction conditions of general relativity and fix their constants with radii derived for a particular stellar model. Here we avoid both. We study $\mathcal{F}(\mathcal{R})=\mathcal{R}+\alpha\mathcal{R}^{2}$ gravity with a Durgapal-Bannerji interior of embedding class one (Karmarkar condition) and a Hayward exterior. Without Birkhoff's theorem, the exterior is an assumption, and we measure its effect with the Hayward metric, which deforms Schwarzschild by a length $\ell$. The junction conditions of quadratic $\mathcal{F}(\mathcal{R})$ gravity fix all constants in closed form in terms of $M$, $R$ and $\ell$. The condition $p_r(R)=0$ is replaced by continuity of the trace of the extrinsic curvature. The Ricci scalar jumps at the surface, so there is a thin shell with negative surface energy density for $\alpha>0$, a gravitational double layer, and a small radial stress. For this stress to be below 1% of the central pressure we need $\alpha\lesssim0.2$ km$^{2}$ and $\ell\lesssim0.3M$. The interior behaves as a self-bound star. A single surface energy density, $\rho_s=(1.37\pm0.16)\rho_0$, reproduces PSR J0740+6620, J0437-4715, J0030+0451 and J0614-3329, and for $\alpha=0.1$ km$^{2}$ the model predicts $R_{1.4}=11.5$ km and a maximum mass of $2.9 M_\odot$. Because $\ell$ enters surface observables only at order $(\ell/M)^{2}(M/R)^{3}$, the results carry over to a Schwarzschild exterior. Calibrating instead with strange-star radii of eclipsing X-ray pulsars gives $R_{1.4}\approx9$ km, which current data rule out.

classification.title_zh: R+αR^2 引力中带 Hayward 外部的自束缚各向异性星：连接条件与 NICER 限制
classification.abstract_zh: 修改引力中的解析致密星模型通常沿用广义相对论的连接条件，并用特定恒星模型导出的半径来固定常数。本文避免这两种做法。我们研究 F(R)=R+αR^2 引力，采用嵌入类一（Karmarkar 条件）的 Durgapal-Bannerji 内解和 Hayward 外部。由于没有 Birkhoff 定理，外部是一种假设；我们用 Hayward 度规（通过长度 ℓ 对 Schwarzschild 作形变）来衡量其影响。二次 F(R) 引力的连接条件以 M、R 和 ℓ 的闭合形式固定所有常数；压强条件 p_r(R)=0 被外曲率迹的连续性替代。Ricci 标量在表面发生跳变，因此存在负表面能密度的薄壳、引力双层以及小的径向应力。为使该应力低于中心压强的 1%，需要 α≲0.2 km^2 且 ℓ≲0.3M。内部表现为自束缚星。单一表面能密度 ρ_s=(1.37±0.16)ρ_0 可重现 PSR J0740+6620、J0437-4715、J0030+0451 和 J0614-3329；对于 α=0.1 km^2，模型预言的 R_1.4=11.5 km，最大质量为 2.9 M_⊙。由于 ℓ 仅以 (ℓ/M)^2(M/R)^3 阶进入表面观测量，结果可延续到 Schwarzschild 外部。若改用食 X 射线脉冲星的奇异星半径来校准，则给出 R_1.4≈9 km，而当前数据排除这一结果。
classification.one_liner: 在 R+αR^2 引力中用完整连接条件匹配 Durgapal-Bannerji 内解与 Hayward 外部，并给出致密星质量半径及 NICER 约束。

papers.title: Looking for gravitational waves with orbital dynamics: GUEST mission and the $\mu$Hz band of Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: `Adding colour'' to the gravitational-wave sky by probing unexplored frequency bands has the potential to unveil new and unexpected phenomena in the Universe. The microhertz band, between pulsar timing arrays and LISA, is a particularly attractive target: it should host the extension of the signal recently found by pulsar timing arrays (if it is generated by a family of sources of gravitational waves), and it may harbour signals from the early Universe, primordial black holes or dark matter. In these proceedings, we review how the orbits of gravitationally bound systems act as resonant detectors of microhertz gravitational waves and ultra-light dark matter. We then describe GUEST (Gravitational Universe Exploration with Satellite Tracking), a mission concept recently proposed to the ESA F-class call, consisting of two dense passive spheres covered with retroreflectors, placed in highly eccentric Earth orbits and tracked by a global laser-ranging network.

classification.title_zh: 利用轨道动力学寻找引力波：GUEST任务与微赫兹引力波波段
classification.abstract_zh: 通过探测尚未探索的频段为引力波天空“增添色彩”，有可能揭示宇宙中新奇且意想不到的现象。位于脉冲星计时阵列与LISA之间的微赫兹波段是特别有吸引力的目标：如果脉冲星计时阵列最近发现的信号由一类引力波源产生，那么该信号的延伸应存在于这一波段；该波段也可能包含来自早期宇宙、原初黑洞或暗物质的信号。在这些会议论文集中，我们回顾了引力束缚系统的轨道如何作为微赫兹引力波和超轻暗物质的共振探测器。随后我们介绍GUEST（Gravitational Universe Exploration with Satellite Tracking），这是最近向ESA F级征集提交的一项任务概念，由两个覆盖回反射器的密集无源球体组成，置于高偏心地球轨道，并由全球激光测距网络跟踪。
classification.one_liner: 综述利用引力束缚系统轨道作为微赫兹引力波与超轻暗物质共振探测器，并介绍GUEST卫星激光测距任务概念。

papers.title: Quasinormal Mode Excitation in the Horizon Shear of Near-Extremal Kerr Black Holes
papers.abstract: The horizon shear of a near-extremal Kerr black hole perturbed by an eccentric extreme mass ratio inspiral shows low amplitude, high frequency oscillations (''wiggles") after periapsis passage. Previous works are unable to tie the frequency of the wiggles to the orbit, and argue they cannot be quasinormal modes (QNMs). We show that they are Kerr QNMs belonging to the damped-mode branch --- that is, modes whose decay rate stays finite as the spin approaches extremality. For an equatorial prograde orbit with $p = 3M$ and $e = 0.85$ and spins ranging from $a/M = 0.999$ to $a/M = 0.99999$, fits to the time-domain shear identify the fundamental $(\ell,m) = (2,1)$ and $(3,2)$ modes as the dominant and first subdominant excitations. Fitting each multipole separately gives frequencies to within two standard deviations of the Kerr values and provides evidence for the excitation of the fundamental $(3,1)$, $(4,1)$ and $(4,2)$ modes, though these are not resolvable in the full signal. We further argue that the same wiggles must be present in the tidal field that drives the shear. For $\ell \leq 4$ we find no evidence of QNM excitation in the $m = 0$ or the $m = \ell$ multipoles.

classification.title_zh: 近极端 Kerr 黑洞视界剪切中的准正规模激发
classification.abstract_zh: 近极端 Kerr 黑洞受到偏心极端质量比旋进扰动后，其视界剪切在近星点通过后出现低振幅、高频振荡（wiggles）。此前工作无法将 wiggle 频率与轨道联系起来，并认为它们不可能是准正规模（QNM）。我们证明这些振荡属于阻尼模分支的 Kerr QNM，即当自旋趋于极端时衰减率仍保持有限的模式。对于 p=3M、e=0.85 的赤道顺行轨道以及 a/M=0.999 到 0.99999 的自旋范围，对时域剪切的拟合识别出基频 (ℓ,m)=(2,1) 和 (3,2) 模式分别为占主导和第一亚主导激发。分别拟合每个多极得到频率在 Kerr 值的两个标准差以内，并提供基频 (3,1)、(4,1) 和 (4,2) 模式被激发的证据，尽管这些模式在全信号中不可分辨。我们进一步论证，驱动剪切的潮汐场中也必然存在同样的 wiggles。对于 ℓ≤4，未发现 m=0 或 m=ℓ 多极中存在 QNM 激发的证据。
classification.one_liner: 证明近极端 Kerr 黑洞视界剪切中的高频 wiggles 是阻尼分支 Kerr 准正规模，并识别主导多极激发。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 Kerr 黑洞准正规模激发，与 QNM 和经典引力支线相关；但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力，因而对全息研究的相关性有限。

papers.title: Quasinormal Modes of Slowly Rotating Black Holes in Hernquist Halos: Redshift and Angular Momentum
papers.abstract: We investigate axial quasinormal modes of black holes embedded in Hernquist halos, using an established analytic static geometry with an inner vacuum cavity extending to $4M_{\mathrm{BH}}$ and solving for frame dragging to first order in rotation. We compute the fundamental and first overtone branches for mass ratios $\epsilon\equiv M_{\mathrm{BH}}/M_{\mathrm{halo}}$ of $0.1$ and $0.01$, and halo compactness $\mathcal C\equiv M_{\mathrm{halo}}/a_0$ in the range $10^{-4}\leq\mathcal C\leq0.3$. The cavity geometry gives a local Kerr estimate in which redshift rescales the vacuum frequencies, horizon angular momentum sets the rotational splitting, and uniform frame dragging adds a real frequency shift. At zero spin, the cavity redshift reproduces the complex $\ell=2$ frequencies with relative residuals below $0.04\%$ for the fundamental and $0.31\%$ for the first overtone. Its leading weak compactness behavior, $1-\mathcal C$, explains the weak mass ratio dependence in dilute halos; at larger compactness, the exact redshift accounts for most of the separation between the two mass ratio sequences. At fixed total angular momentum, halos with vanishing local angular momentum and those with vanishing coordinate angular velocity exhibit opposite compactness trends in the real spin coefficient. At $\mathcal C=0.3$, their real fundamental mode spin coefficients differ by approximately $38\%$ and $54\%$ for the two mass ratios. Fixing the horizon angular momentum reduces these differences below $1\%$ for both overtones, showing that angular momentum partition accounts for most of the configuration dependence.

classification.title_zh: Hernquist 晕中缓慢旋转黑洞的准正模：红移与角动量
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究嵌入 Hernquist 晕中的黑洞的轴向准正模。采用一个已有的解析静态几何，其内部真空腔延伸至 4M_BH，并在转动一阶下求解框架拖曳。对质量比 ε=M_BH/M_halo=0.1 和 0.01、晕致密度 C=M_halo/a0 在 10^-4 到 0.3 范围内，计算基频和一阶泛音分支。腔体几何给出局部 Kerr 估计：红移重标真空频率，视界角动量决定转动分裂，均匀框架拖曳给出实频移。零自旋时，腔体红移重现复的 ℓ=2 频率，基频与一阶泛音的相对残差分别低于 0.04% 和 0.31%；其弱致密度首项行为 1-C 解释了稀薄晕中弱质量比依赖，较大致密度下精确红移解释了两种质量比序列的大部分差异。固定总角动量时，局部角动量消失的晕与坐标角速度消失的晕在实自旋系数上呈现相反的致密度趋势；在 C=0.3 时，两者对两个质量比的实基频自旋系数分别相差约 38% 和 54%。固定视界角动量后，这些差异对两个泛音均降至 1% 以下，表明角动量分配解释了大部分构型依赖。
classification.one_liner: 在 Hernquist 晕和内部真空腔的静态几何中，一阶转动与框架拖曳分析表明红移和角动量分配主导准正模频率及自旋分裂。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典黑洞时空中的准正模、转动与框架拖曳，直接对应 QNM 与经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；不涉及全息。

papers.title: Scalar-induced gravitational waves in spatially covariant gravity with two tensorial degrees of freedom
papers.abstract: We study scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) in a spatially covariant gravity model with two tensorial degrees of freedom, minimally coupled to a $k$-essence scalar field. For the parameter choice considered during radiation domination, the quadratic tensor action coincides with that of general relativity (GR). We derive the scalar transfer functions at finite $\sigma\equiv C_2\bar N$ and in the large-$|\sigma|$ limit. We then construct the source function of SIGWs. We further examine a cubic extrinsic-curvature interaction that modifies the source function of SIGWs without affecting the background or quadratic actions. We calculate the fractional energy density of SIGWs for monochromatic and log-normal primordial curvature power spectra. We find that, for the positive values of $\sigma$ studied, finite-$\sigma$ effects suppress the spectrum over a broad range of scales relative to the result in the $\sigma \rightarrow \infty$ limit. In this limit, the cubic interaction suppresses the spectrum at small wavenumbers and enhances it at larger wavenumbers. These results show that modified scalar dynamics and non-linear interactions can alter the fractional energy density of SIGWs even when the quadratic tensor action is identical to that of GR.

classification.title_zh: 具有两个张量自由度的空间协变引力中的标量诱导引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究最小耦合到 k-essence 标量场的、具有两个张量自由度的空间协变引力模型中的标量诱导引力波（SIGWs）。在辐射主导时期所考虑的参数选择下，张量二次作用与广义相对论（GR）一致。我们推导了有限 σ≡C2 N̄ 以及大 |σ| 极限下的标量转移函数，并构造了 SIGWs 的源函数。进一步考察了一个立方外曲率相互作用，它修改 SIGWs 源函数而不影响背景或二次作用。我们针对单色和对数正态原初曲率功率谱计算了 SIGWs 的分数能量密度。发现在所研究的正 σ 值下，相对于 σ→∞ 极限的结果，有限 σ 效应会在较宽尺度范围内压低谱；在该极限下，立方相互作用会压低小波数处的谱并增强较大波数处的谱。这些结果表明，即使张量二次作用与 GR 相同，修改后的标量动力学和非线性相互作用也能改变 SIGWs 的分数能量密度。
classification.one_liner: 在张量二次作用与 GR 相同的空间协变引力中，标量动力学和立方非线性相互作用仍可改变标量诱导引力波的能量密度谱。

papers.title: Energy-flux noise induced by imperfections of the Gaussian beam in the Li-Baker HFGW detector
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the energy-flux noise induced by imperfections of the Gaussian beam (GB) in the Li-Baker high-frequency gravitational wave (HFGW) detector. Modeling these imperfections with higher-order Laguerre-Gaussian (LG) beams, we analytically derive the resulting noise-to-signal ratio for both co- and cross-polarized $\mathrm{LG}_{nl}$ modes. It is found that higher-order co-polarized LG beams generate no tangential energy-flux noise at the optimal detection plane ($\phi=\pi/2$ or $3\pi/2$), whereas higher-order cross-polarized LG beams introduce non-negligible noise. Specifically, for an individual higher-order cross-polarized $\mathrm{LG}_{nl}$ mode under our representative parameters, maintaining the noise-to-signal ratio below unity typically requires the power fraction to satisfy $\sigma_{nl}<10^{-46}$, with the $\mathrm{LG}_{01}$ mode imposing the most stringent constraint of $\sigma_{01}<6.0\times10^{-49}$. Monte Carlo simulations suggest that the total power fraction $\sigma_{\mathrm{total}}$ of multiple higher-order cross-polarized $\mathrm{LG}_{nl}$ modes needs to remain below $10^{-49}$. Consequently, we propose employing a polarization filter to retain only the co-polarized component of the GB adopted in the practical experiment, thereby suppressing the noise while preserving signal integrity. These results provide theoretical guidance for noise control in the Li-Baker HFGW detector.

classification.title_zh: Li-Baker 高频引力波探测器中高斯光束不完美引起的能量通量噪声
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究 Li-Baker 高频引力波探测器中由高斯光束不完美引起的能量通量噪声。作者用高阶拉盖尔-高斯光束对不完美建模，解析推导共极化和交叉极化 LG_nl 模的噪声信号比，发现高阶共极化 LG 光束在最佳探测平面上不产生切向能量通量噪声，而高阶交叉极化 LG 光束会引入不可忽略噪声；在代表性参数下，单个高阶交叉极化模通常需满足 σ_nl<10^-46，LG_01 模要求最严，为 σ_01<6.0×10^-49；蒙特卡洛模拟表明多个高阶交叉极化模的总功率分数需低于 10^-49。文章据此建议使用偏振滤波器仅保留共极化分量以抑制噪声并保持信号。
classification.one_liner: 分析 Li-Baker 高频引力波探测器中高阶 LG 光束不完美导致的能量通量噪声，并建议偏振滤波抑制交叉极化噪声。

papers.title: Gravitational lensing of gravitational waves by a Kerr black hole
papers.abstract: We simulate the gravitational lensing of gravitational waves (GWs) by a Kerr black hole using a $(1+1)$-dimensional time-domain mode-sum approach. To enable efficient explicit time evolution, we implement a localized hyperboloidal foliation combined with a static field redefinition, ensuring bounded characteristic speeds across an extended, uniform tortoise-coordinate grid. Incident GW initial data are constructed by projecting a plane-wave Weyl tensor onto the Kinnersley tetrad. Through local spin-dyad rotations and Wigner $D$-matrix transformations, our framework accommodates both idealized wave packets and realistic binary coalescence signals at arbitrary incidence and polarization angles. To accurately resolve the lensed waveforms, we evolve over $68,000$ coupled $(j,m)$ modes. Our results reveal that a Kerr black hole acts as a diffraction-limited thick lens, focusing GWs into a forward beam. For idealized wave packets, the primary prompt pulse exhibits a spin-independent transverse Gaussian profile, whereas the subsequent lensing coda is sensitive to the black hole's spin. For binary coalescence signals, strong-field lensing substantially modifies the post-merger ringdown. However, the lensed inspiral and merger phases in Kerr and Schwarzschild backgrounds are virtually identical, yielding waveform mismatches below $2.2\times10^{-5}$ across various inclinations and polarizations. These findings demonstrate that non-spinning Schwarzschild models provide an accurate and computationally economical surrogate to search for strong-field lensing signatures with current ground-based detectors.

classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞对引力波的引力透镜效应
classification.abstract_zh: 本文采用(1+1)维时域模式求和方法模拟Kerr黑洞对引力波的引力透镜效应。为实现高效显式时间演化，作者使用局部双曲层叶状化并结合静态场重定义，在扩展的均匀乌龟坐标网格上保证有界特征速度。入射引力波初值通过将平面波Weyl张量投影到Kinnersley四元组构造；借助局部自旋二价旋转和Wigner D矩阵变换，该框架可处理任意入射角与偏振角下的理想波包及真实双星并合信号。为准确解析透镜化波形，演化包含68,000个耦合(j,m)模式。结果表明，Kerr黑洞表现为衍射受限的厚透镜，将引力波聚焦成前向光束。对理想波包，主即时脉冲呈现与自旋无关的横向高斯分布，而随后的透镜化尾波对黑洞自旋敏感。对双星并合信号，强场透镜化显著改变并合后的铃宕；但Kerr与Schwarzschild背景下的透镜化旋进和并合阶段几乎相同，在不同倾角和偏振下波形失配低于2.2×10^-5。这些发现表明，无自旋Schwarzschild模型可作为准确且计算经济的替代模型，用于当前地面探测器搜寻强场透镜化特征。
classification.one_liner: 数值模拟表明Kerr黑洞对引力波的强场透镜化主要改变并合后铃宕，而旋进与并合阶段可用Schwarzschild背景高精度替代。

papers.title: Complete quasinormal modes of Type-D black holes. II. Extremal Kerr black holes
papers.abstract: We develop a double-confluent Heun (HeunD) method that extends our construction of complete quasinormal-mode (QNM) spectra to extremal Kerr black holes. Matching the horizon-ingoing and infinity-outgoing radial solutions together with angular regularity yields the frequencies directly at extremality, without extrapolation from nonextremal spins. For gravitational perturbations, we obtain an expanded spectrum on both conventional and unconventional Riemann sheets, including additional QNMs revealed by analytic continuation across frequency branch cuts. Continuation in spin connects the extremal modes to our complete Schwarzschild spectrum, including its unconventional branches. We show for the first time that unconventional Class I sequences with $m<0$, continued from unconventional Schwarzschild modes, approach negative superradiant bounds with vanishing damping in the extremal limit. We also identify finite-damping modes interspersed among sequences approaching zero damping, showing that a single overtone cutoff cannot describe the transition to extremality. Independent scattering-amplitude calculations verify representative frequencies and their sheet assignments, while a contour count establishes spectral completeness within a bounded frequency domain. Uniform matching near the superradiant bound further distinguishes critical accumulation from isolated extremal QNMs and resolves the associated Riemann-sheet structure. These results bring extremal Kerr into our unified treatment of black-hole QNM spectra and reveal how the Schwarzschild mode families reorganize in the extremal limit.

classification.title_zh: Type-D黑洞的完整准正规模。II. 极端Kerr黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 本文发展双合流Heun（HeunD）方法，将完整准正规模谱构造推广到极端Kerr黑洞。通过匹配视界入射与无穷远出射径向解并施加角向正则性，直接在极端情形获得频率，而非从非极端自旋外推。对引力扰动，在常规与非常规Riemann叶上得到扩展谱，包括跨频率分支割线解析延拓揭示的额外QNM。自旋延拓将极端模与完整Schwarzschild谱（含非常规分支）联系起来，并首次表明m<0的非常规Class I序列在极端极限下趋近负超辐射界且阻尼消失；同时识别出夹杂在零阻尼序列中的有限阻尼模，说明单一泛音截断无法描述向极端性的过渡。独立散射振幅计算验证代表性频率及叶指派，围道计数在有界频率域内确立谱完备性；超辐射界附近的均匀匹配进一步区分临界累积与孤立极端QNM并解析Riemann叶结构。结果将极端Kerr纳入黑洞QNM谱的统一处理，并揭示Schwarzschild模族在极端极限下如何重组。
classification.one_liner: 用HeunD方法直接构造极端Kerr黑洞完整QNM谱并揭示其与Schwarzschild模族的联系。

papers.title: Early-time tails in Kerr black hole ringdown
papers.abstract: Black hole ringdowns are modelled as a superposition of quasinormal modes (QNMs), although the branch cut of the Green's function produces a nonoscillatory tail that may contaminate early-time ringdown analyses. Within linear perturbation theory, we quantify this branch-cut contribution for the scattering of localised Gaussian wave packets by a Kerr black hole with mass $M$. Defining the onset of ringdown as the earliest time at which the QNM and branch-cut contributions reconstruct the waveform, we evaluate the branch-cut amplitude relative to the QNM amplitude. For wave packets with a characteristic frequency $\omega_0\sim 1/M$, the branch-cut amplitude is typically of order $10\%$ of the QNM amplitude at ringdown onset with only a mild dependence on spin. We further find that the tail waveform before convolving with a source is almost independent of spin. The spin dependence of the relative amplitude therefore resides primarily in the excitation of the QNMs. Our results suggest that the branch-cut contribution may affect the accuracy of black hole spectroscopy, particularly near the onset of ringdown.

classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞铃宕中的早期尾
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞铃宕通常被建模为QNM的叠加，但格林函数的分支割会产生非振荡尾巴，可能污染早期铃宕分析。本文在线性微扰理论下，量化局域高斯波包被质量为M的Kerr黑洞散射时的分支割贡献。将铃宕起始定义为QNM与分支割贡献共同重构波形的最早时刻，并评估分支割振幅相对于QNM振幅的大小。对于特征频率ω0~1/M的波包，在铃宕起始时分支割振幅通常约为QNM振幅的10%，对自旋仅呈弱依赖。进一步发现，在与源卷积之前的尾巴波形几乎与自旋无关；因此相对振幅的自旋依赖主要来自QNM的激发。结果表明，分支割贡献可能影响黑洞谱学的精度，尤其是在铃宕起始附近。
classification.one_liner: 量化Kerr黑洞铃宕中分支割早期尾相对QNM的贡献，指出其约为10%并可能影响黑洞谱学。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究Kerr黑洞铃宕的QNM与分支割早期尾，属于经典引力/黑洞扰动和QNM方向；不涉及AdS/CFT或全息对偶。

papers.title: Probing Scalar Polarization with Next-Generation Gravitational-Wave Detectors: The Roles of Detector Geometry and Source Inclination
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave observations of compact binaries offer a direct way to test whether gravity admits polarizations beyond the two tensor modes of general relativity. We perform a forecast to assess how well future multi-messenger events will constrain the presence of scalar polarizations in gravitational waves. Performing binary neutron star injections, we forecast next-generation constraints on three modified gravity parameters in the PPE formalism: $\alpha$ (tensor amplitude), $\alpha_B$ (scalar amplitude) and $\beta$ (tensor and scalar phase). Cosmic Explorer (CE) and Einstein Telescope (ET) each tighten every parameter by 1--2 orders of magnitude over an O5 LIGO-Virgo network, with ET's triangular geometry giving a persistent $\approx2\times$ improvement over 2$\times$CE on the scalar-mode amplitude $\alpha_B$ in both a GW170817-like and a second, representative BNS. We show that, if the sky position and luminosity distance are known from EM observations, adding an EM-based prior on the orbital inclination $\iota$ narrows the $\alpha_B$ constraint by $\approx56\times$ relative to an isotropic inclination prior, for a GW170817-like event. We also assess how EM inclination priors as well as assumptions on the neutron star equation of state may affect the inference on the scalar amplitude $\alpha_B$. Overall, these results indicate that detector geometry and the availability of well-placed EM external information are both important levers --- alongside raw network sensitivity --- for next decade scalar-polarization tests.

classification.title_zh: 用下一代引力波探测器探测标量极化：探测器几何与源倾角的作用
classification.abstract_zh: 致密双星的引力波观测可直接检验引力是否具有广义相对论两种张量模式之外的极化。我们开展预报，评估未来多信使事件对标量极化的约束能力。通过双中子星注入，我们在PPE形式下预报对三个修改引力参数的限制：α（张量振幅）、α_B（标量振幅）和β（张量与标量相位）。与O5 LIGO-Virgo网络相比，Cosmic Explorer（CE）和Einstein Telescope（ET）各自将每个参数收紧1–2个数量级；ET的三角形几何对GW170817类及另一个代表性双中子星的标量模式振幅α_B给出持续约2倍于2×CE的改进。我们表明，若天区位置和光度距离由电磁观测已知，对轨道倾角ι加入基于电磁的先验，相对于各向同性倾角先验，可将GW170817类事件的α_B约束收窄约56倍。我们还评估电磁倾角先验以及中子星状态方程假设如何影响对标量振幅α_B的推断。总体而言，这些结果表明，探测器几何和良好定位的电磁外部信息都是未来十年标量极化检验的重要杠杆，与网络原始灵敏度并列。
classification.one_liner: 预报表明下一代引力波网络可显著收紧标量极化参数，且探测器几何与电磁倾角先验是关键杠杆。

papers.title: The General-Relativistic Limit of f(R) Gravity
papers.abstract: We establish the general-relativistic limit of f(R) gravity coupled to a massless scalar field for small, asymptotically Euclidean, well-prepared Cauchy data near Minkowski spacetime. We prove global existence and future causal geodesic completeness, with uniform estimates for the metric, matter, and rescaled effective field as an admissible family of modified Lagrangians f(R) approaches the Einstein-Hilbert Lagrangian R. The physical and conformal metrics and the matter field converge to the limiting Einstein-massless-scalar development, uniformly on the entire future spacetime, together with finitely many space and time derivatives. The effective field, defined by a nonlinear reparametrization of the physical scalar curvature, converges to the scalar curvature of the limiting Einstein development. The main analytical difficulty is that the effective-field mass tends to infinity, while its evolution equation becomes an algebraic trace relation. Small field amplitudes may coexist with high-frequency oscillations and comparatively large derivatives, whose quadratic contributions must be controlled uniformly. Using the Euclidean-hyperboloidal foliation method and adapted wave coordinates, we analyze a quasilinear wave-Klein-Gordon system whose nonlinearities do not satisfy the classical null condition. We combine oscillatory estimates, weighted interior and exterior energies, and propagation estimates for the discrepancy from the Einstein trace relation. Quantitative convergence on compact regions and uniform spacetime decay yield global convergence.

classification.title_zh: f(R) 引力的广义相对论极限
classification.abstract_zh: 我们针对接近 Minkowski 时空的小的、渐近欧氏的、良准备的 Cauchy 数据，建立 f(R) 引力与无质量标量场耦合时的广义相对论极限。我们证明全局存在性与未来因果测地完备性，并证明当一族可容许的修正拉格朗日量 f(R) 趋近 Einstein-Hilbert 拉格朗日量 R 时，度规、物质场和重标度有效场具有一致估计。物理度规、共角度规和物质场在整个未来时空上一致收敛到极限的 Einstein-无质量标量场发展，并连同有限多个空间和时间导数一起收敛。有效场由物理标量曲率的非线性重参数化定义，它收敛到极限 Einstein 发展的标量曲率。主要分析困难在于有效场质量趋于无穷，而其演化方程变为代数迹关系。小场振幅可以与高频振荡和相对较大的导数共存，其二次贡献必须被一致控制。我们使用欧氏-双曲叶理方法和适配的波坐标，分析一个非线性项不满足经典零条件的拟线性波-Klein-Gordon系统。我们结合振荡估计、加权内部与外部能量，以及关于偏离 Einstein 迹关系的传播估计。紧致区域上的定量收敛与一致时空衰减给出全局收敛。
classification.one_liner: 该文严格证明 f(R) 引力在小渐近欧氏初值下收敛到 Einstein-无质量标量场系统，并给出全局存在性、测地完备性与一致收敛。

papers.title: Unifying stochastic and deterministic signals: a practical search for the intermittent binary black-hole background
papers.abstract: Over the past decade, the Advanced LIGO, Advanced Virgo, and KAGRA detectors have detected nearly 400 compact binary mergers, most of which are stellar-mass binary black-hole (BBH) mergers. Nevertheless, most mergers in the Universe are too weak to be individually detected at current sensitivity levels. Since a BBH merger in band is much shorter than the average time between successive mergers, the population of these subthreshold events gives rise to an intermittent background of gravitational waves (GWs). This GW background is guaranteed to exist, but it has not yet been detected with current stochastic or deterministic searches. Here we propose a fast and accurate likelihood-based search for this background, which unifies the standard model-agnostic cross-correlation search and a fully deterministic, template-based search in a single likelihood. Our search is based on a truncated likelihood ratio, which is fully marginalized over the extrinsic parameters of the individual mergers, and which represents the data in two detectors as an expansion in terms of approximate sufficient statistics. These statistics are higher-order cross-moments of the data, weighted by geometrical factors that generalize the standard overlap reduction function (ORF) used in cross-correlation searches. We show that almost all the Bayesian evidence and information on the BBH merger population comes from correlations between frequency bins induced by individual mergers and is captured in the higher-order generalized ORFs. Consequently, any likelihood function that does not take these inter-frequency correlations into account is necessarily suboptimal. We validate our search on one year of simulated Advanced LIGO data, and find that a catalog-informed analysis, which uses information from both the detected and unresolved mergers, can infer the peak of the redshift distribution of the population of BBH mergers.

classification.title_zh: 统一随机与确定性信号：间歇性双黑洞背景的实用搜索
classification.abstract_zh: 过去十年，Advanced LIGO、Advanced Virgo 和 KAGRA 已探测到近 400 个致密双星并合，其中大多数是恒星级双黑洞并合。然而，宇宙中大多数并合在当前灵敏度下太弱，无法被单独探测。由于双黑洞并合在频带内的时间远短于连续并合之间的平均时间，这些亚阈值事件形成了间歇性引力波背景。该背景必然存在，但当前的随机或确定性搜索尚未探测到它。本文提出一种快速且准确的基于似然的搜索，将标准的模型无关交叉相关搜索与完全确定性的模板搜索统一在单个似然中。该搜索基于截断似然比，对单个并合的外禀参数完全边缘化，并将两个探测器的数据表示为近似充分统计量的展开。这些统计量是数据的高阶交叉矩，由几何因子加权，这些因子推广了交叉相关搜索中使用的标准重叠约化函数。我们表明，关于双黑洞并合种群的几乎所有贝叶斯证据和信息都来自单个并合引起的频率 bin 之间的相关性，并体现在高阶广义重叠约化函数中。因此，任何不考虑这些频率间相关性的似然函数都必然次优。我们在一年模拟 Advanced LIGO 数据上验证了该搜索，发现结合已探测和未分辨并合信息的目录知情分析可以推断双黑洞并合种群红移分布的峰值。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种统一的基于似然的搜索方法，将随机交叉相关搜索与确定性模板搜索结合，用于探测亚阈值双黑洞并合形成的间歇性引力波背景。

papers.title: Constructing likelihoods for a non-Gaussian gravitational-wave background
papers.abstract: The stochastic gravitational-wave background from stellar-mass compact binaries is non-Gaussian since it is made up of a finite number of individual mergers. Over the years, several methods have been developed to search for this background beyond the standard cross-correlation statistic. We reformulate the data analysis problem for such astrophysical backgrounds in terms of the characteristic function of the data in multiple detectors, and show that the existing searches arise as different limiting cases. We also show that new searches can be constructed through different approximations of the characteristic function, which gives a concrete way to engineer suitable approximate sufficient statistics. To illustrate this framework in the context of a simple example, we use the formalism proposed here to analyze an exactly solvable toy model.

classification.title_zh: 为非高斯引力波背景构造似然函数
classification.abstract_zh: 恒星质量致密双星产生的随机引力波背景由有限个并合事件组成，因此是非高斯的。本文用多探测器数据的特征函数重新表述这类天体物理背景的数据分析问题，并表明现有搜索是该框架的不同极限情形；同时说明可通过特征函数的不同近似构造新的搜索，为设计合适的近似充分统计量提供具体途径。文章还用该形式分析一个可精确求解的玩具模型作为示例。
classification.one_liner: 用多探测器特征函数统一非高斯随机引力波背景的似然与搜索框架。

papers.title: Isospectrality breaking in the axial quasinormal modes of Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity
papers.abstract: We study odd-parity perturbations of Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity. The dCS action is parity invariant because $\vartheta\,{}^{*}RR$ is the product of two pseudoscalars; nevertheless, the pseudoscalar perturbation has odd parity and enters only the axial sector at linear order and so lifts the axial--polar isospectrality of general relativity. We derive the finite-charge couplings between the pseudoscalar and the axial gravitational and electromagnetic perturbations directly from the linearized field equations. Both directions are governed by the radial kernel $(Mr-Q^2)\Delta/r^8$, and at nonzero charge the pseudoscalar couples to $\Psi+\chi\Psi_e$, with $\chi=2Q/[r\sqrt{(l-1)(l+2)}]$. After diagonalizing the Einstein--Maxwell sector, we compute branch-resolved quasinormal-mode shifts with exterior complex scaling for the photon-sphere modes and Frobenius shooting for the near-extremal zero-damping modes. For the Schwarzschild $l=2$ fundamental mode we obtain $\beta\,\delta\omega=-0.7733-0.3946\,i$ (units $M=\alpha=1$). Off resonance, the gravitational-led shift scales as $\zeta\,l^3$ at $Q=0$ but as $\zeta\,l^2/Q$ at fixed nonzero charge and large $l$. The electromagnetic-led branch becomes exactly degenerate with the pseudoscalar mode at $Q_c=2M\sqrt{l(l+1)+1}/[l(l+1)+2]$, where the pseudoscalar potential coincides with the polar partner of the electromagnetic-led potential; there the breaking is $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt\zeta)$, $M|\Delta\omega|\simeq2.4\sqrt\zeta$ for $l=2$, and the shift reverses sign across $Q_c$. Near extremality the photon-sphere shifts remain finite, whereas the non-degenerate fundamental gravitational-led zero-damping mode is suppressed, $\delta\omega/\omega\simeq6.0\times10^{3}\,\zeta\,(1-Q^2/M^2)$ for $l=2$.

classification.title_zh: 动态Chern-Simons引力中Reissner-Nordström黑洞轴向准正规模的等谱性破缺
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究动态Chern-Simons（dCS）引力中Reissner-Nordström黑洞的奇宇称扰动。尽管dCS作用量因ϑ *RR是两个赝标量之积而具有宇称不变性，赝标量扰动具有奇宇称，在线性阶只进入轴向扇区，从而破除广义相对论中的轴向—极向等谱性。作者从线性化场方程直接导出有限电荷下赝标量与轴向引力、电磁扰动之间的耦合。两个方向都由径向核(Mr-Q^2)Δ/r^8支配；在非零电荷下，赝标量耦合到Ψ+χΨ_e，其中χ=2Q/[r√((l-1)(l+2))]。在对Einstein-Maxwell扇区对角化后，他们用外复标度法计算光子球模的分支分辨准正规模频移，用Frobenius打靶法计算近极值零阻尼模。对Schwarzschild l=2基模得到β δω=-0.7733-0.3946 i（单位M=α=1）。非共振时，引力主导频移在Q=0按ζ l^3标度，但在固定非零电荷和大l时按ζ l^2/Q标度。电磁主导分支在Q_c=2M√(l(l+1)+1)/[l(l+1)+2]处与赝标量模精确简并，此时破缺为O(√ζ)，l=2时M|Δω|≈2.4√ζ，且频移在Q_c两侧变号。近极值时，光子球频移保持有限，而非简并的引力主导基模零阻尼模受到抑制，l=2时δω/ω≈6.0×10^3 ζ(1-Q^2/M^2)。
classification.one_liner: 研究动态Chern-Simons引力中RN黑洞轴向扰动，推导赝标量与引力/电磁扰动耦合并计算准正规模频移与等谱性破缺。

papers.title: Gravitational field of spinors with torsion and matter$-$antimatter asymmetry
papers.abstract: The conservation law for the orbital plus spin angular momentum of a free Dirac particle in curved spacetime requires that the affine connection has the antisymmetric part: the torsion tensor, which extends general relativity to the Einstein$-$Cartan theory of gravity. In spacetime with torsion, the Dirac equation becomes a nonlinear, cubic equation in the spinor wave function. Under charge conjugation, the nonlinear term changes sign relative to the mass term. A Dirac spinor and its charge conjugate therefore satisfy different field equations. We use the spinor connection formalism to derive the Dirac equation for a spherical spinor in its centrally symmetric gravitational field with torsion. We determine the energy$-$momentum tensor for this spinor and show that the energy contribution from torsion is negative for matter particles and positive for antimatter particles. Consequently, the ground state of a fermion has a lower energy than the ground state of the corresponding antifermion. We also derive the Einstein$-$Cartan$-$Dirac equations for this spinor; they indicate the existence of particle-like soliton solutions exhibiting matter$-$antimatter energy asymmetry.

classification.title_zh: 带挠率的旋量引力场与物质-反物质不对称
classification.abstract_zh: 本文从弯曲时空中自由 Dirac 粒子的轨道角动量与自旋角动量守恒出发，要求仿射联络具有反对称部分，即挠率张量，从而把广义相对论推广为 Einstein-Cartan 引力。在带挠率时空中，Dirac 方程成为旋量波函数的非线性三次方程；在电荷共轭下，非线性项相对于质量项变号，因此 Dirac 旋量与其电荷共轭满足不同的场方程。作者用旋量联络形式推导了中心对称带挠率引力场中球对称旋量的 Dirac 方程，确定了该旋量的能量-动量张量，并表明挠率对物质粒子能量贡献为负、对反物质粒子为正；因此费米子基态能量低于相应反费米子基态。作者还导出了该旋量的 Einstein-Cartan-Dirac 方程，指出存在表现出物质-反物质能量不对称的类粒子孤子解。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-Cartan 挠率引力中，Dirac 旋量的非线性方程导致物质与反物质能量不对称，并给出类粒子孤子解。

papers.title: Resonance correction to time-dependent finite-size effects in Effective Field Theory of binary black hole inspiral
papers.abstract: General Relativity predicts that black holes lack an internal structure and that their tidal Love numbers vanish. However, if astrophysical black holes were instead ultra-compact objects (UCOs) with internal structure, their tidal Love numbers would no longer vanish. Then, during a binary inspiral, their tidal deformation could transfer orbital energy to the UCO, increasing the orbital period and leaving an observable imprint on the phase of the emitted gravitational waves. As we discussed previously, the effect is enhanced if one binary companion is resonantly excited. Here we use the point-particle effective field theory framework to calculate this enhancement. We consider circular orbits and focus on excitations of the internal electric quadrupole, modelling the UCO spectrum as a harmonic oscillator spectrum. However, our methods could be straightforwardly extended to more complicated situations. Integrating out the internal quadrupole induces a series of time-dependent finite-size operators with specific numerical coefficients, which we calculate. We find that the static electric quadrupole Love number $k_2$ is negative, and that all finite-size terms are proportional to $k_2$. We further show that resonant excitation induces a leading 2.5 Post-Newtonian term, compared with the 5 Post-Newtonian term in the time-independent case. Our results confirm the expectation that resonant excitation during a binary inspiral offers one of the best ways to detect whether astrophysical black holes can undergo tidal deformation and, if they do, learn about their internal excitation spectrum.

classification.title_zh: 双黑洞旋近有效场论中随时间变化有限尺度效应的共振修正
classification.abstract_zh: 广义相对论预言黑洞没有内部结构且潮汐Love数消失；若天体黑洞实为具有内部结构的超致密天体，其潮汐Love数不再为零，并在双星旋近中通过潮汐形变把轨道能量转移给伴星，从而改变轨道周期并在引力波相位留下可观测印记。本文在点粒子有效场论框架下计算共振激发对时间相关有限尺度效应的增强，考虑圆轨道并聚焦内部电四极激发，将超致密天体谱建模为谐振子谱。积掉内部四极后得到一系列具有特定数值系数的时间相关有限尺度算符，并发现静态电四极Love数k2为负，所有有限尺度项均正比于k2；共振激发给出领头2.5后牛顿阶项，而时间无关情形为5后牛顿阶项。结果支持双星旋近中的共振激发是探测天体黑洞是否发生潮汐形变并了解其内部激发谱的最佳途径之一。
classification.one_liner: 用点粒子有效场论计算双星旋近中共振激发的时变有限尺度修正，发现其使潮汐形变效应在2.5后牛顿阶出现。

papers.title: Quasinormal Modes of a Rotating Ho\v{r}ava Black Hole: Two Perturbative Approaches to Nonseparability
papers.abstract: Quasinormal modes (QNMs) provide a powerful probe of strong-field gravity. We study fundamental scalar quasinormal modes of an asymptotically flat rotating black hole in the low-energy sector of Ho\v{r}ava gravity, whose exact scalar equation is nonseparable due to rotation-induced Lorentz violation. We develop two complementary approximations that both preserve the exact Kerr sector: Method I applies a slow-rotation approximation only to the nonseparable Lorentz-violating part, whereas Method II employs a small-$\eta$ biorthogonal spheroidal projection, with $\eta$ the Lorentz-violating parameter. Using residual-controlled continuation and symmetric finite differences, validated by a Kerr continued-fraction benchmark and an independent radial spectral method, we compute the linear frequency response. Axisymmetric modes provide an exact Kerr null test. For the corotating modes studied, the real-frequency response is positive and increases with spin. At $a/M=0.9$, the two methods reveal a roughly $2\%$ angular correction to the real response, while the imaginary response is nonmonotonic and highly sensitive to angular projection due to internal cancellation. These results highlight the distinct rotational signatures of Lorentz violation in black-hole ringdown.

classification.title_zh: 旋转 Hořava 黑洞的准正规模：处理不可分离性的两种微扰方法
classification.abstract_zh: 准正规模（QNMs）是探测强场引力的有力工具。我们研究 Hořava 引力低能区中一个渐近平直旋转黑洞的基本标量准正规模；由于旋转诱导的洛伦兹破坏，其精确标量方程不可分离。我们发展两种互补近似，二者都保留精确的 Kerr 部分：方法 I 仅对不可分离的洛伦兹破坏部分施加慢旋转近似；方法 II 采用小 η 双正交球状投影，其中 η 为洛伦兹破坏参数。利用残差控制的延拓和对称有限差分，并以 Kerr 连分式基准和独立的径向谱方法验证，我们计算线性频率响应。轴对称模给出精确的 Kerr 零检验。对于所研究的同转模，实频响应为正且随自旋增加。在 a/M=0.9 时，两种方法揭示实响应约有 2% 的角度修正，而虚响应由于内部抵消呈非单调且对角度投影高度敏感。这些结果凸显了洛伦兹破坏在黑洞铃宕中的独特旋转特征。
classification.one_liner: 用两种保留 Kerr 基准的微扰方法计算旋转 Hořava 黑洞标量准正规模，并分析洛伦兹破坏的旋转特征。

papers.title: Hamiltonian Analysis of the Newer General Relativity
papers.abstract: We present a systematic Hamiltonian analysis of the five-parameter class of theories known as Newer General Relativity. Quadratic nonmetricity theories of this type can be divided into nine types according to the structure of their primary constraints. After reviewing the framework of symmetric teleparallel gravity, we derive the ADM formulation of Newer General Relativity, discuss the existing classification and perform the Hamiltonian formulation of the theory. For each type, we compute the conjugate momenta, identify the primary constraints, and construct both the canonical and primary Hamiltonians. We then determine the constraint structure and analyze the resulting physical degrees of freedom in each type.

classification.title_zh: Newer General Relativity 的哈密顿分析
classification.abstract_zh: 我们对称为 Newer General Relativity 的五参数理论类进行系统的哈密顿分析。此类二次非度规性理论可根据其初级约束结构分为九类。在回顾对称远平行引力框架后，我们推导 Newer General Relativity 的 ADM 表述，讨论现有分类并对该理论作哈密顿表述。对每一类，我们计算共轭动量、识别初级约束，并构造正则哈密顿量与初级哈密顿量。随后确定约束结构并分析各类所得的物理自由度。
classification.one_liner: 对五参数 Newer General Relativity 的九类二次非度规性理论进行 ADM 与哈密顿约束分析，确定各类物理自由度。

papers.title: Axion-angle dependence of the rotational and tidal properties of PNJL quark stars
papers.abstract: We investigate how a fixed, spatially uniform axion angle modifies the rotational and static tidal properties of self-bound quark stars in general relativity, using an axion-extended Polyakov-loop Nambu--Jona-Lasinio equation of state. We vary $\theta$ from $0$ to $\pi$ while holding the remaining model parameters fixed, and compute the leading-order moment of inertia and the second-order spin-induced quadrupole moment and mass shift. The calculation includes finite-surface-density contributions to the rotational mass shift and static tidal response. Across this range, the static maximum mass increases from $1.68$ to $1.95\,M_\odot$, remaining below the lower edge of the quoted $1\sigma$ timing interval for PSR~J0740+6620. At $M=1.338\,M_\odot$, the moment of inertia increases by $13\%$ and the dimensionless tidal deformability rises from $342$ to $547$. Over the common mass range examined, the differences in the moment of inertia between adjacent sampled angles exceed the tested interpolation and table-resolution sensitivities. Despite these changes, joint fits to the five sequences describe the $\bar I$--$C$ and I-Love-Q relations with maximum departures of $2.7\%$ and $0.4\%$, respectively, over the fitted domains. The predicted binary tidal-deformability curves lie within the estimated 90\% credible region of the adopted GW170817 posterior over the mass-ratio ranges examined. Within this EOS family, stellar properties vary appreciably with $\theta$, while the normalized quantities admit accurate joint fits across the five sequences.

classification.title_zh: PNJL夸克星转动与潮汐性质的轴子角依赖
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究在广义相对论中，固定且空间均匀的轴子角如何修改自束缚夸克星的转动与静态潮汐性质，采用轴子扩展的Polyakov-loop Nambu--Jona-Lasinio物态方程。作者在固定其余模型参数下将θ从0变到π，计算领头阶转动惯量、二阶自旋诱导四极矩和质量移动，并包含有限表面密度对转动质量移动和静态潮汐响应的贡献。在此范围内，静态最大质量从1.68 M⊙增至1.95 M⊙，仍低于PSR J0740+6620所给1σ计时区间下边缘。在M=1.338 M⊙处，转动惯量增加13%，无量纲潮汐形变度从342升至547。在所考察的共同质量范围内，相邻采样角之间的转动惯量差异超过所测试的插值与表分辨率敏感度。尽管如此，对五个序列的联合拟合在拟合区域内描述Ibar-C和I-Love-Q关系的最大偏离分别为2.7%和0.4%。预测的双星潮汐形变曲线在所考察质量比范围内位于所采用GW170817后验的90%可信区域内。在该物态方程族内，恒星性质随θ显著变化，而归一化量可在五个序列间获得准确联合拟合。
classification.one_liner: 轴子扩展PNJL物态方程下，轴子角θ显著改变夸克星转动惯量与潮汐形变，但归一化I-Love-Q关系仍可联合拟合。

papers.title: Physical Effects in the Vicinity of Black Holes
papers.abstract: General relativity, a theory that is already over a century old, is still the best theory that we have to describe the universe at energy scales where only the gravitational force is important. It has stood tall to any observational tests thrown at it since its inception, and it has remarkable predictive power when it is utilized to study and model astrophysical problems. It also continues to surprise us with its ability to generate new problems and insights that render themselves useful in the study of modern physics. This is especially highlighted by the transition of modern observational astronomy away from an electromagnetic radiation epoch, and into a new gravitational wave epoch. This thesis devotes its study to phenomena that can be analyzed within the framework of classical general relativity, but whose results may contain interesting implications for cosmological and black hole observations. (Full abstract can be found in document).

classification.title_zh: 黑洞附近的物理效应
classification.abstract_zh: 广义相对论已有一个多世纪的历史，但在只有引力重要的能标下仍是描述宇宙的最佳理论。它自提出以来通过了所有观测检验，并在天体物理问题的建模中展现出很强的预测能力。该理论也持续带来新的问题和洞见，对现代物理研究有帮助；现代观测天文学从电磁辐射时代向引力波时代的转变尤其凸显了这一点。本论文研究可在经典广义相对论框架内分析的现象，其结果可能对宇宙学和黑洞观测有意义。

papers.title: Apparent horizon mergers in analytic intial data
papers.abstract: Five years ago Pook-Kolb, Hennigar and Booth published a series of three papers exploring the evolution of apparent horizons and other marginally outer trapped surfaces during a black hole merger. This was seen to be much more intricate than the well-known "pair-of-pants" merger associated with event horizons. In this paper we show that parameter evolutions of Brill-Lindquist-deSitter initial data mimic many of the features of that evolution. Hence, this analytic intial data is a useful testing ground for ideas about marginally outer trapped surface evolution and spacetime geometry during mergers.

classification.title_zh: 解析初始数据中的表观视界并合
classification.abstract_zh: 五年前 Pook-Kolb、Hennigar 和 Booth 发表了三篇论文，探讨黑洞并合过程中表观视界和其他类光外陷面的演化；这比事件视界著名的“裤衩”并合更复杂。本文表明 Brill-Lindquist-deSitter 初始数据的参数演化可以模拟该演化的许多特征，因此该解析初始数据是研究并合期间类光外陷面演化和时空几何的有用试验场。

papers.title: Classical traversability of a carbon BTZ wormhole
papers.abstract: We investigate the classical traversability of an analogue spatial wormhole geometry realized on a two-dimensional curved carbon membrane. The background is obtained by implementing a reflection-symmetric doubling technique on the exterior spatial sector of a non-rotating Ba\~nados-Teitelboim-Zanelli black hole, effectively replacing the event horizon with a smooth traversable throat. Within this framework, massless Dirac quasiparticles propagate as spinorial light rays whose kinematics are governed exclusively by the metric curvature, forcing them to track the null geodesics of the ultrastatic spacetime. By evaluating the exact geodesic equations, we demonstrate that classical traversability is dictated by a sharp binary threshold in the conserved angular momentum, where the minimum throat radius acts as a centrifugal potential barrier that separates traversing paths from reflecting ones. We show that near-critical trajectories experience a logarithmic divergence in their angular evolution, causing the quasiparticles to execute multiple spatial windings around the throat before escaping. These classical ray-tracing configurations establish the necessary geometric backbones for future mesoscopic investigations.

classification.title_zh: 碳膜BTZ虫洞的经典可穿越性
classification.abstract_zh: 研究在二维弯曲碳膜上实现的模拟空间虫洞几何的经典可穿越性。背景通过对非旋转Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli黑洞外部空间扇区进行反射对称加倍得到，将事件视界替换为光滑可穿越喉部。无质量Dirac准粒子作为旋量光线传播，其运动学仅由度规曲率决定，并沿超静态时空的零测地线运动。通过精确测地线方程表明，经典可穿越性由守恒角动量的尖锐二值阈值决定，最小喉部半径作为离心势垒区分穿越与反射路径。近临界轨迹的角演化出现对数发散，使准粒子在逃逸前绕喉部多次空间缠绕。这些经典光线追踪构型为未来介观研究提供几何骨架。

papers.title: Finite temperature effects on g-modes of inviscid neutron stars
papers.abstract: We study the effect of temperature on secular, compositional $g$-modes in the core of inviscid neutron stars. Using a chiral $SU(2)_f$ sigma model, we construct isentropic temperature profiles for hot and dense matter and find that the frequency of the global core $g$-mode's dependence on temperature is governed by the nuclear symmetry energy slope parameter $L$. As a result, the $g$-mode frequency of a warm neutron star can be either higher or lower than that of its cold counterpart, depending on $L$. Our results highlight the interplay of thermal effects and composition gradients, and demonstrate the potential of neutron star $g$-mode observations to constrain the density dependence of the symmetry energy.

classification.title_zh: 有限温度效应对无粘中子星g模的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究温度对无粘中子星核心长期成分g模的影响。使用手征SU(2)_f sigma模型，我们为热致密物质构造等熵温度剖面，发现全局核心g模频率对温度的依赖由核对称能斜率参数L控制。因此，暖中子星的g模频率可能高于或低于冷中子星，取决于L。结果凸显热效应与成分梯度的相互作用，并展示中子星g模观测约束对称能密度依赖的潜力。
classification.one_liner: 用SU(2)_f sigma模型研究温度对无粘中子星核心g模频率的影响，发现其温度依赖由对称能斜率L决定。

papers.title: A Zoo of Fermionic Relative R\'enyi Negativities in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Models
papers.abstract: Quantum entanglement is a fundamental resource that gives rise to correlations with no classical counterpart in strongly correlated fermionic systems. However, its characterization in mixed quantum states remains challenging. Established entanglement diagnostics, such as logarithmic negativity, are computationally demanding in interacting systems, and their evaluation by exact diagonalization is restricted to small system sizes. Meanwhile, conventional R\'enyi proxies, including twisted and untwisted R\'enyi negativities, can be positive even for separable states. In this work, we introduce a family of \textit{relative R\'enyi negativities} that serve as entanglement witnesses. By relating fermionic partial time reversal to the size superoperator, we establish a path-integral representation for these R\'enyi negativities, enabling their evaluation in thermal states of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model and its generalizations via a large-$N$ expansion. Applying this method, we investigate entanglement in both the original SYK model and the Maldacena-Qi coupled SYK model. We identify a special class of relative R\'enyi negativities which serve as plausible proxies for logarithmic negativity and uncover first-order entanglement transitions that are invisible to simple observables. These results highlight the utility of relative R\'enyi negativities as probes of mixed-state entanglement in strongly correlated fermionic systems and suggest the existence of a new class of transitions where these negativities serve as free energies.

classification.title_zh: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型中的费米子相对 Rényi 负性集合
classification.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠是强关联费米子系统中非经典关联的基础资源，但混合态纠缠刻画仍具挑战。对数负性等已有诊断在相互作用系统中计算昂贵，精确对角化受限于小系统；而传统 Rényi 负性代理量对可分态也可能为正。本文引入一类相对 Rényi 负性作为纠缠见证者。通过将费米子部分时间反演与 size 超算符联系起来，作者给出这些 Rényi 负性的路径积分表示，从而可在 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SYK）模型及其推广的热态中通过大 N 展开计算。应用该方法，他们研究原始 SYK 模型和 Maldacena-Qi 耦合 SYK 模型中的纠缠，识别出一类可作为对数负性合理代理量的特殊相对 Rényi 负性，并发现简单观测量看不到的一阶纠缠转变。结果表明相对 Rényi 负性是强关联费米子系统中混合态纠缠的探针，并暗示存在以这些负性为自由能的新型转变。
classification.one_liner: 引入相对 Rényi 负性并在 SYK/耦合 SYK 的大 N 热态中计算，揭示一阶纠缠转变。

papers.title: Ricci-flat Seeds, Trombone Rescaling and Magnetizing Kerr Black Holes
papers.abstract: We present a new family of Ricci-flat rotating metrics, which we refer to as Solution II, obtained by demagnetizing the genuine Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (G-KBR) black hole. Together with Solution I, which was previously obtained by demagnetizing the Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (KBR) black hole, this gives two families of Ricci-flat deformations of the Kerr black hole, each labeled by $B$. We study the global structures, thermodynamics, various limits, and the local connections among these limits. We also study the remagnetizations in both Einstein-Maxwell and Kaluza-Klein theories, and find that, to yield a physically acceptable solution, the Ernst transformation should be augmented by an appropriate trombone rescaling.

classification.title_zh: Ricci 平坦种子、Trombone 重标度与磁化 Kerr 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一族新的 Ricci 平坦转动度规，称为 Solution II，它通过将真正的 Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (G-KBR) 黑洞去磁化得到。它与此前由 Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (KBR) 黑洞去磁化得到的 Solution I 一起，给出两族以 B 标记的 Kerr 黑洞 Ricci 平坦形变。我们研究其整体结构、热力学、各种极限以及这些极限之间的局域联系。我们还研究 Einstein-Maxwell 与 Kaluza-Klein 理论中的重磁化，发现为得到物理上可接受的解，Ernst 变换需辅以适当的 trombone 重标度。

papers.title: Magnetically Charged Black Holes from Grand Unified Theory
papers.abstract: Grand Unified models of particle physics inevitably give rise to magnetic monopoles. Often the model will also contain a weakly broken discrete symmetry that leads to the formation of biased domain walls that survive for a limited period in cosmology. For a range of the discrete symmetry breaking parameter, domain walls can collapse to form magnetically charged extremal black holes lighter than $\simeq 1\, {\rm kg}$ but these are not expected to survive until the present epoch due to Hawking evaporation and Schwinger pair production of monopoles. If the parameter is smaller still, the black holes may be astrophysical, with mass greater than $10^{15}\, {\rm g}$ and with sub-extremal magnetic charge: $Q \simeq 10^8$ (for our canonical choice of parameters). The cosmological energy density in residual magnetic monopoles depends on the discrete symmetry breaking parameter and for sufficiently small values of the parameter, the magnetic monopole density can satisfy all observational constraints.

classification.title_zh: 来自大统一理论的磁荷黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 粒子物理的大统一模型不可避免地产生磁单极子。通常模型还会包含一个弱破缺的离散对称性，导致形成偏置畴壁，这些畴壁在宇宙学中只存活有限时期。对于离散对称性破缺参数的一定范围，畴壁可以坍缩形成质量轻于约1 kg的磁荷极端黑洞，但由于霍金蒸发和单极子的Schwinger对产生，预计它们不会存活到今天。如果该参数更小，黑洞可能是天体物理尺度的，质量大于10^15 g，并具有亚极端磁荷：Q约10^8（对于我们的典型参数选择）。残余磁单极子的宇宙学能量密度取决于离散对称性破缺参数；对于足够小的参数值，磁单极子密度可以满足所有观测约束。
classification.one_liner: 大统一理论中的偏置畴壁坍缩可产生磁荷黑洞，并给出残余磁单极子密度与观测约束的关系。

papers.title: Two-horizon sector thermodynamics and NUT bi-hair in Kerr-Newman-NUT spacetimes
papers.abstract: First law consistency alone does not determine the black hole state space of NUT-charged spacetimes, because several inequivalent macroscopic formulations can yield consistent thermodynamics. We develop a two-horizon sector diagnostic for the electrically charged Kerr-Newman-NUT family by organizing the inner- and outer-horizon entropies and inverse temperatures into sum ($\Sigma$) and difference ($\Delta$) sectors. The charged rotating geometry gives a more stringent test of the uncharged Taub-NUT sector result, since the mass $M$, ordinary electric charge $Q$, ordinary angular momentum $J$, NUT charge $N$, and the NUT secondary hair $J_N=MN$ all enter the same two-horizon thermodynamics. For the physically anchored minimal homogeneous state spaces defined and tested here, we find a clear sector separation: the $\Sigma$ sector closes with the charge-like variables $Q$ and $N$, whereas the $\Delta$ sector additionally requires the rotation-like variables $J$ and $J_N$. Natural reductions that eliminate either $J_N$ or $N$ fail to reproduce the first law coefficient fixed by the sector temperature, and their associated Bekenstein-Smarr relations do not close with the assigned scaling weights. Within this class, electric charge and ordinary rotation therefore do not absorb the NUT secondary response, and the charged rotating family supports the NUT bi-hair organization: $N$ has a charge-like sector role, while $J_N=MN$ is a rotation-like thermodynamic secondary hair. The latter is defined off shell in the homogeneous equation of state, not as a new metric parameter or asymptotic conserved charge.

classification.title_zh: Kerr-Newman-NUT 时空中的双视界扇区热力学与 NUT 双毛
classification.abstract_zh: 仅靠第一定律一致性不能确定 NUT 带电时空的黑洞状态空间，因为若干不等价的宏观表述都可给出一致的热力学。我们通过将内、外视界熵和逆温度组织为和（Σ）与差（Δ）扇区，为带电 Kerr-Newman-NUT 族建立双视界扇区诊断。带电转动几何对无电荷 Taub-NUT 扇区结果给出更严格检验，因为质量 M、普通电荷 Q、普通角动量 J、NUT 荷 N 以及 NUT 次级毛 J_N=MN 都进入同一双视界热力学。对于本文定义并检验的物理锚定最小齐次状态空间，我们发现清晰的扇区分隔：Σ 扇区由类荷变量 Q 和 N 闭合，而 Δ 扇区还需类转动变量 J 和 J_N。消除 J_N 或 N 的自然约化无法再现由扇区温度固定的第一定律系数，其 Bekenstein-Smarr 关系也不能按指定标度权重闭合。在该类中，电荷与普通转动不能吸收 NUT 次级响应，带电转动族支持 NUT 双毛组织：N 具有类荷扇区角色，而 J_N=MN 是类转动的热力学次级毛。后者在齐次状态方程中离壳定义，不是新度规参数或渐近守恒荷。
classification.one_liner: 通过双视界 Σ/Δ 扇区诊断表明 Kerr-Newman-NUT 黑洞热力学支持 N 与 J_N=MN 的 NUT 双毛结构。

papers.title: Theoretical Aspects of Direct Waves in Kerr Black Holes: Pole-Splitting Method for Ringdown Analysis
papers.abstract: We develop a theoretical description of direct waves (DWs) from a particle plunging into a Kerr black hole in the extreme-mass-ratio regime. A DW is characterized by a source-driven complex frequency $\omega_{\rm G}$ that reflects the particle's orbital motion, including motion inside the ergoregion. Hence, it is expected to be a probe of rich structures of Kerr black holes. We show that the contribution of the quasinormal-mode (QNM) pole sector to the DW is part of dynamical QNM excitation. We also show that the apparent horizon-mode poles cancel at every order of a consistent near-horizon expansion of the trajectory, homogeneous radial solution, and complete point-particle source. This result assumes that the point particle follows a geodesic near the horizon and leaves open the possibility of a transient DW while the particle passes near the ergosurface or the vicinity of the potential barrier. To investigate this possibility in simulated plunge waveforms, we develop a pole-splitting method that decomposes the transfer function into QNM-pole and non-pole parts. The resulting waveform decomposition avoids the frequency-dependent time shift (group delay) introduced by the QNM filtering. For quasi-circular plunges into moderately and rapidly rotating Kerr black holes, the frequency and decay rate of the non-pole waveform show qualitative agreement with our theoretical prediction over finite time intervals. These results support the potential use of DWs as probes of the ergoregion and gravitational redshift effect around black holes.

classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞中直接波的理论研究：面向铃宕分析的极点劈裂方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了极端质量比情形下粒子坠入Kerr黑洞所产生直接波（DW）的理论描述。DW由反映粒子轨道运动（包括在能层内运动）的源驱动复频率ω_G刻画，因此有望成为探测Kerr黑洞丰富结构的探针。我们表明，准正模（QNM）极点部分对DW的贡献是动力学QNM激发的一部分。我们还表明，在轨迹、齐次径向解和完整点粒子源的相容近视界展开的每一阶，表观视界模极点都会相消。该结果假设点粒子在视界附近沿测地线运动，并保留了粒子经过能层表面或势垒附近时出现瞬态DW的可能性。为在模拟坠入波形中研究这一可能性，我们发展了一种极点劈裂方法，将传递函数分解为QNM极点部分和非极点部分。所得的波形分解避免了QNM滤波引入的依赖频率的时间平移（群延迟）。对于坠入中等和快速旋转Kerr黑洞的准圆轨道情形，非极点波形的频率和衰减率在有限时间区间内与我们的理论预言定性一致。这些结果支持将DW用作探测黑洞周围能层和引力红移效应的潜在工具。
classification.one_liner: 该文建立Kerr黑洞极端质量比坠入直接波的理论框架，并提出极点劈裂方法分离QNM极点与非极点波形，用于铃宕分析。

papers.title: Static multipolar Einstein-vector-Gauss-Bonnet black holes
papers.abstract: We construct and analyze static multipolar black holes in Einstein-vector-Gauss-Bonnet theory with a quadratic coupling function. The vectorized solutions bifurcate from the Schwarzschild black hole at discrete values of the Gauss-Bonnet coupling, obtained from a perturbative eigenvalue problem on the Schwarzschild background and labelled by the angular multipole number $\ell$. We restrict to the fundamental radial branches. The electric sector contains the known spherically symmetric $\ell=0$ branch as well as axisymmetric branches with $\ell>0$. These electric branches extend to larger values of the coupling. The magnetic sector features a sequence of axisymmetric branches, including the previously found magnetic dipole branch at $\ell=0$. The magnetic branches instead exist only on finite intervals of the coupling, ending at critical solutions. Away from the bifurcation point, nonlinearities generate additional multipoles, but even-$\ell$ and odd-$\ell$ moments remain separated.

classification.title_zh: 静态多极 Einstein-vector-Gauss-Bonnet 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在带二次耦合函数的 Einstein-vector-Gauss-Bonnet 理论中构造并分析静态多极黑洞。矢量化解在离散的 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合值处从 Schwarzschild 黑洞分岔，这些值由 Schwarzschild 背景上的微扰本征值问题得到，并以角多极数 ℓ 标记。我们限于基本径向分支。电 sector 包含已知的球对称 ℓ=0 分支以及 ℓ>0 的轴对称分支，这些电分支延伸到更大的耦合值。磁 sector 具有一系列轴对称分支，包括此前发现的 ℓ=0 磁偶极分支；磁分支只存在于有限的耦合区间内，并终止于临界解。远离分岔点时，非线性会生成额外多极，但偶 ℓ 与奇 ℓ 矩仍然分离。
classification.one_liner: 该文在 Einstein-vector-Gauss-Bonnet 理论中构造静态多极黑洞，并刻画电、磁矢量化解的分岔结构及其有限耦合区间行为。

papers.title: Harmonic oscillation and orbital morphology for spinning charged quantum corrected black hole
papers.abstract: This study investigates the dynamical behavior of particle's test around a spinning charged Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton (EMd) quantum corrected black hole (QCBH) by examining the effects of spinning parameter $a$, quantum correction parameter $b$, and charge parameter $Q$. Using EMd spacetime geometry, we analyze the effective potential and effective force to determine the stability and structure of the circular orbits in a strong gravitational field. Furthermore, we calculate the oscillation frequencies radial $(\Omega_r)$, vertical $(\Omega_\theta)$, and angular $(\Omega_\phi)$, as well as the corresponding Periapsis and Lense-Thirring precession frequencies. The spin parameter primarily determines the spinning properties of spacetime, while the quantum correction and charge particle introduce additional biases to Kerr-Newman geometry, particularly near the event horizon. These corrections alter the position and stability of the circular orbits, and the spectrum effectively associates with particle's motion. The results provide a comprehensive description of the orbital dynamics of spinning EMd QCBH through future high-precision astrophysical observations.

classification.title_zh: 旋转带电量子修正黑洞的谐振荡与轨道形态
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在旋转带电 Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton 量子修正黑洞时空中研究测试粒子的动力学，分析自旋参数 a、量子修正参数 b 和电荷参数 Q 对有效势与有效力的影响，以确定强引力场中圆轨道的稳定性和结构。文章计算径向、垂直和角向振荡频率以及近星点进动和 Lense-Thirring 进动频率，并讨论这些修正对圆轨道位置、稳定性及粒子运动频谱的影响。

papers.title: Mass-Varying Dark Matter Induced Scalarization and Scalar Clouds around Black Holes
papers.abstract: We consider a black hole solution embedded in a mass-varying dark matter (DM) halo and study scalarization induced by DM. We derive the required conditions on the scalar DM coupling that allow for a regular bound-state scalar cloud. We find that such configurations exist only for quantized coupling values in terms of the halo's intrinsic parameters (for Hernquist, this reduces to the inverse of the compactness). This study provides a novel connection between DM phenomenology and scalarization around a black hole.

classification.title_zh: 变质量暗物质诱导的黑洞标量化与标量云
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑嵌入变质量暗物质晕中的黑洞解，并研究由暗物质诱导的标量化。我们推导了标量暗物质耦合所需的条件，使正则束缚态标量云能够存在。我们发现这类位形仅当耦合取量子化值时存在，该量子化值由晕的内禀参数决定（对 Hernquist 晕，约化为紧致度的倒数）。该工作为暗物质现象学与黑洞周围标量化之间提供了新联系。

papers.title: Shadow, Emission, and Strong-Field Lensing of Dilatonic Black Holes
papers.abstract: We study the shadow and strong-field optical properties of a static, spherically symmetric dyon-like dilatonic black hole. The photon sphere radius, critical impact parameter, and shadow radius are obtained and analyzed in terms of the charge $Q$ and the dilatonic coupling parameter $a$. We show that increasing these parameters decreases the photon sphere and shadow radii, leading to a smaller apparent shadow. The predicted angular diameter is compared with the observational data for M87$^{*}$ and SgrA$^{*}$. We explicitly show that the Sgr A* data do not constrain the model parameters, whereas the results for M87* depend on the adopted mass estimates from stellar and gas dynamics. We also estimate the high-frequency energy emission rate in the geometric-optics approximation and derive the leading Bozza coefficient $\bar{a}$, which characterizes the logarithmic behavior of the deflection angle in the strong-field regime. Astrophysical implication of the obtained outcomes are discussed.

classification.title_zh: 膨胀子黑洞的阴影、辐射与强场透镜效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究静态球对称、类双荷膨胀子黑洞的阴影与强场光学性质。我们得到光子球半径、临界碰撞参数和阴影半径，并分析它们随电荷 Q 与膨胀子耦合参数 a 的变化。结果表明，增大这些参数会减小光子球半径和阴影半径，从而导致更小的视阴影。我们将预测的角直径与 M87* 和 Sgr A* 的观测数据进行比较。我们明确显示 Sgr A* 数据不能约束模型参数，而 M87* 的结果依赖于所采用的恒星动力学与气体动力学质量估计。我们还用几何光学近似估计高频能量发射率，并推导出主导的 Bozza 系数  ar{a}，该系数刻画强场区域偏折角的对数行为。最后讨论所得结果的 astrophysical implications。
classification.one_liner: 研究膨胀子黑洞的阴影、强场透镜与高频辐射，并用 M87* 和 Sgr A* 数据讨论参数约束。

papers.title: Pole Skipping, Avoided Crossing, and Resonant Excitation in Kerr Quasinormal Modes near Algebraically Special Frequencies
papers.abstract: Kerr quasinormal modes near algebraically special frequencies exhibit anomalous behavior, including apparent bifurcation, disappearance, and a nonsmooth connection to the Schwarzschild limit, which has remained puzzling for decades. Tracking poles and zeros of Green-function building blocks across different Riemann sheets, we show that the bifurcation is due to an avoided crossing accompanied by resonant excitation, while the disappearance is due to pole skipping caused by cancellation of a quasinormal-mode pole by a Matsubara-mode zero. This resolves the physical origin of these long-standing anomalies.

classification.title_zh: 代数特殊频率附近Kerr准正规模中的极点跳过、避免交叉与共振激发
classification.abstract_zh: Kerr准正规模在代数特殊频率附近表现出异常行为，包括表观分叉、消失以及与Schwarzschild极限的非光滑连接，这数十年来一直令人困惑。通过追踪格林函数构建块在不同黎曼面上的极点与零点，我们表明分叉是由伴随共振激发的避免交叉引起的，而消失则是由松原模零点抵消准正规模极点导致的极点跳过引起的。这解决了这些长期异常现象的物理起源。
classification.one_liner: 通过追踪格林函数极零点，解释Kerr准正规模在代数特殊频率附近的分叉与消失分别源于避免交叉/共振激发和极点跳过。

papers.title: Beyond quasinormal modes: a complete mode decomposition of black hole perturbations
papers.abstract: We show that retarded Green's functions of black hole spacetimes can be expressed as a convergent mode sum everywhere in spacetime. At late times a quasinormal mode sum converges, while at early times a Matsubara (or, Euclidean) mode sum converges. The two regions are separated by a lightcone which scatters from the black hole potential. The Matsubara sum is a Fourier series on the Euclidean thermal circle associated to the early time region. We illustrate our results for P\"oschl-Teller, BTZ, and Schwarzschild. In the case of Schwarzschild, we express the branch cut contribution as a convergent sum of de Sitter quasinormal modes as $\Lambda\to 0^+$, and exploit recent exact solutions to the Heun connection problem. In each case we analytically show convergence by studying the asymptotics of residue sums and also provide numerical demonstrations.

classification.title_zh: 超越准正规模：黑洞扰动的完整模式分解
classification.abstract_zh: 作者证明黑洞时空的推迟格林函数可以在全时空写成收敛的模式和。晚期由准正规模求和收敛，早期由 Matsubara（欧几里得）模式求和收敛；两个区域由一个从黑洞势散射出的光锥分隔。Matsubara 求和是早期区域对应欧几里得热圆周上的傅里叶级数。文章以 Pöschl-Teller、BTZ 和 Schwarzschild 为例展示结果。对 Schwarzschild，作者在 Λ→0+ 时把分支割贡献写成 de Sitter 准正规模的收敛求和，并利用近期关于 Heun 连接问题的精确解。每种情形都通过研究留数求和的渐近行为解析证明收敛，并给出数值演示。
classification.one_liner: 论文证明黑洞时空推迟格林函数可用全时空收敛的模式和表示：晚期由准正规模主导，早期由 Matsubara 模式主导，并在 BTZ 与 Schwarzschild 等例子中验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接讨论黑洞扰动、准正规模与推迟格林函数的模式分解，属于 QNM 与经典引力支线；摘要未涉及全息对偶、量子信息或凝聚态应用。

papers.title: Reconstruction of Black Hole Islands from Hawking Radiation via the Algebraic Petz Map
papers.abstract: The island proposal guarantees a unitary Page curve for evaporating black holes, implying that operators deep behind the horizon must be fully reconstructable from asymptotic Hawking radiation. However, because the interior is causally disconnected and highly dynamical, standard entanglement wedge reconstruction methods, relying on global isometries or continuous modular flow, fail to provide this mapping. We resolve this by constructing a protocol for island reconstruction using the algebraic Petz map. By using modular theory, we reflect island operators into the accessible complement, transport them to the boundary, and map them into the radiation algebra. Furthermore, we demonstrate that this purely algebraic derivation naturally yields the structure of Papadodimas-Raju mirror operators. This framework provides a rigorous operational dictionary for the island formula, proving that information trapped inside a black hole can be decoded.

classification.title_zh: 通过代数 Petz 映射从霍金辐射重构黑洞岛
classification.abstract_zh: 岛提议保证蒸发黑洞具有幺正的 Page 曲线，意味着视界深处算符必须能从渐近霍金辐射中完全重构。但由于内部因果不连通且高度动力学化，依赖全局等距或连续模流的纠缠楔重构方法无法给出该映射。我们通过代数 Petz 映射构建岛重构协议：利用模理论将岛算符反射到可访问补集，输运到边界并映射进辐射代数；并证明这一纯代数推导自然给出 Papadodimas-Raju 镜像算符结构。该框架为岛公式提供严格的操作性字典，证明黑洞内部信息可被解码。
classification.one_liner: 用代数 Petz 映射给出从霍金辐射重构黑洞岛算符的严格协议，并导出镜像算符结构。

papers.title: Wald entropy and Wen-Zee type gauge-curvature coupling in 2+1-dimensional gravity
papers.abstract: The Wen-Zee term is a mixed gauge-curvature coupling in the topological Chern-Simons description of a quantum Hall fluid, encoding the electric charge bound to spatial curvature. We investigate a Lorentz-covariant generalization of this coupling, expanding its scope to black-hole spacetimes and determine its contribution to horizon entropy. Such a coupling arises naturally in three-dimensional Chern-Simons gravity based on the Maxwell algebra. We show that its Wald entropy contribution is a horizon boost charge, given by a loop integral of the additional gauge field projected along the tangent to the bifurcation circle. This contribution can be nonzero even when the mixed term vanishes on shell. We show that the integral admits an Abelian holonomy interpretation when the projection direction is covariantly constant. We evaluate the charge on a flat cosmological solution and, using smooth horizon fields and a specified thermal ensemble, on an AdS-Lorentz black hole. These results connect the geometric response familiar from quantum Hall physics to gravitational horizon thermodynamics.

classification.title_zh: 2+1维引力中的Wald熵与Wen-Zee型规范-曲率耦合
classification.abstract_zh: Wen-Zee项是量子霍尔流体拓扑Chern-Simons描述中的混合规范-曲率耦合，编码束缚于空间曲率的电荷。我们研究该耦合的Lorentz协变推广，将其适用范围扩展到黑洞时空，并确定其对视界熵的贡献。此类耦合自然出现在基于Maxwell代数的三维Chern-Simons引力中。我们证明其Wald熵贡献是一个视界boost charge，由附加规范场沿分叉圆切向投影的环路积分给出。即使混合项在壳上为零，该贡献也可非零。当投影方向协变常时，该积分具有Abelian holonomy解释。我们在平坦宇宙学解上计算该电荷，并在AdS-Lorentz黑洞上使用光滑视界场和指定热系综进行计算。这些结果将量子霍尔物理中熟悉的几何响应与引力视界热力学联系起来。

papers.title: Quantum Love and ringdown near extremality
papers.abstract: In this paper we discuss the quasinormal modes and the tidal responses of a four-dimensional asymptotically flat Reissner-Nordstr\"{o}m black hole near extremality and investigate the nontrivial near-horizon quantum corrections of these observables. The near-horizon dynamics of near extremal black holes are generally governed by an effective Schwarzian action coupled to boundary gauge modes. We use this description and couple this effective theory with a massless scalar field outside. Using this setup we compute $2 \to 2$ scattering process of a black hole and a scalar particle. The poles of the scattering amplitude at complex frequencies give us the quasinormal mode spectrum and we recover the predicted zero damped modes near extremality at leading order. Next we evaluate the static Love numbers from the elastic limit of the scattering amplitude. We show that the static Love numbers are non-zero in contrast to the classical expectations. Very close to extremality, the behaviour is analytic, but as the near-extremal energy becomes sufficiently large, we find logarithmic dependence on the energy. This cannot be removed by the choice of renormalisation scheme. Thus near-horizon quantum effects non-trivially change the tidal response of near-extremal black holes.

classification.title_zh: 近极端性附近的量子 Love 数与铃宕
classification.abstract_zh: 本文讨论四维渐近平直 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞在近极端极限下的准正规模与潮汐响应，并研究这些观测量的非平凡近视界量子修正。近极端黑洞的近视界动力学通常由与边界规范模耦合的有效 Schwarzian 作用量描述；作者将该有效理论与外部无质量标量场耦合，计算黑洞与标量粒子的 2→2 散射。散射振幅在复频率处的极点给出准正规模谱，并在领头阶恢复近极端下预言的零阻尼模。随后从散射振幅的弹性极限提取静态 Love 数，表明其相对于经典预期非零；在非常接近极端时行为解析，但当近极端能量足够大时出现无法通过重整化方案消除的对能量对数依赖。因此近视界量子效应非平凡地改变近极端黑洞的潮汐响应。
classification.one_liner: 利用耦合边界规范模的 Schwarzian 有效理论计算近极端 RN 黑洞的 QNM 与量子修正 Love 数，发现静态 Love 数非零并出现对数能量依赖。

papers.title: Emergent Scaling Symmetry and Universal Interior Criticality of Scalarized Black Holes
papers.abstract: The interiors of spontaneously scalarized charged black holes exhibit a tower of universality classes, including the previously reported $1/2$ scaling. We show that their near-critical collapse is governed by an emergent scaling symmetry at the would-be Cauchy horizon. This symmetry renders the interior dynamics autonomous, model-independent, and exactly integrable, realizing first-kind self-similarity rather than Choptuik-type second-kind criticality. It also yields a ``seesaw amplification'': an arbitrarily small exterior hair produces an arbitrarily large interior response. The amplification obeys an amplitude identity relating three independently measurable quantities. The singularity exponent equals the critical exponent of the exterior scalar charge. These relations connect the exterior phase transition to the approach to the interior singularity through the scaling dynamics near the would-be Cauchy horizon.

classification.title_zh: 标量化黑洞的涌现标度对称性与普适内部临界性

papers.title: Maximal $D=5$ trombone supergravity from M5-branes and $\mathrm{SU}(2)$-flavoured $\mathcal{N}=1$ class $\mathcal{S}$ operator spectra
papers.abstract: We recently presented a new $D=5$ $\mathcal{N}=8$ gauged supergravity involving the local trombone scaling symmetry. It arises by consistent truncation of M-theory on the internal space of the Maldacena-N\'u\~nez AdS$_5$ solution dual to the $\mathcal{N}=2$ four-dimensional superconformal field theory (SCFT) of class $\mathcal{S}$ associated to M5-branes wrapped on an unpunctured Riemann surface. Using exceptional generalised geometry/field theory, we extend that construction to show that the same $D=5$ $\mathcal{N}=8$ supergravity also arises by consistent truncation of $D=11$ supergravity on the family of $\mathcal{N}=1$ M5-brane-wrapped solutions of Bah-Beem-Bobev-Wecht, including the $\mathcal{N}=1$ Maldacena-N\'u\~nez (MN1) configuration. Then, using recently derived mass matrices, we compute universal sectors of the Kaluza-Klein spectrum on the MN1 solution. In general, this universal spectrum is only locally defined, and we give a prescription for extracting globally defined subsectors thereof. This globally defined universal Kaluza-Klein spectrum is dual to a universal sector of the light operator spectrum of the SU(2)-flavoured $\mathcal{N}=1$ class $\mathcal{S}$ SCFT dual to MN1.

classification.title_zh: 来自 M5-膜的极大 D=5 trombone 超引力与 SU(2)-味 N=1 class S 算符谱
classification.abstract_zh: 我们最近提出了一个包含局部 trombone 标度对称性的新 D=5 N=8 规范超引力。它来自 M-theory 在 Maldacena-Núñez AdS5 解内部空间上的一致截断，该解对偶于 M5-膜包裹无穿孔黎曼面所对应的四维 N=2 class S 超共形场论。利用例外广义几何/场论，我们扩展该构造，证明同一个 D=5 N=8 超引力也可由 D=11 超引力在 Bah-Beem-Bobev-Wecht 的 N=1 M5-膜包裹解族上的一致截断得到，其中包括 N=1 Maldacena-Núñez（MN1）位形。随后，利用最近导出的质量矩阵，我们计算了 MN1 解上 Kaluza-Klein 谱的普遍扇区。一般而言，该普遍谱只在局部定义，我们给出了提取其整体定义子扇区的方案。这个整体定义的普遍 Kaluza-Klein 谱对偶于 MN1 所对偶的 SU(2)-味 N=1 class S SCFT 的轻算符谱中的一个普遍扇区。

papers.title: Ten-dimensional localization
papers.abstract: We construct equivariantly closed polyforms for the fluxes and the action of (massive) type IIA and type IIB supergravity directly in ten dimensions. We illustrate applications of our formalism to two distinct classes of solutions in massive type IIA. Our analysis straightforwardly reproduces and vastly generalizes all known results for on-shell actions in these classes, with no need for a consistent truncation. Where known, we match the corresponding field theory partition functions at leading order, and our results extend easily to other solutions of type II supergravity.

classification.title_zh: 十维局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们直接在十维中为（大质量）IIA 型和 IIB 型超引力的通量及作用量构造等变闭多形式。我们展示该形式体系在大质量 IIA 型的两类不同解中的应用。我们的分析直接重现并大幅推广了这些类别中关于在壳作用量的所有已知结果，且无需一致截断。在已知情形下，我们在领头阶匹配相应的场论配分函数，且结果可容易推广到 II 型超引力的其他解。

papers.title: Walking Sudakov: From Cusp to Octagon
papers.abstract: We study the Sudakov form factor and the four-point scattering amplitude on the Coulomb branch of planar $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM as functions of the Coulomb-branch parameters and kinematic invariants. This setup provides a controlled probe of the interpolation between on- and off-shell regimes of infrared-sensitive quantities in gauge theories. We identify a novel scaling limit in which both observables exhibit double-logarithmic behavior governed by a walking anomalous dimension. As the mass scales are varied, this walking anomalous dimension interpolates between the cusp anomalous dimension of the on-shell regime and the octagon anomalous dimension of the off-shell regime. Based on the explicit two-loop result and the expected all-order structure, we propose an all-loop form for the walking anomalous dimension both for the form factor and for the four-point scattering amplitude. These all-loop expressions depend on new, presently unknown functions of the 't Hooft coupling.

classification.title_zh: Walking Sudakov：从尖点到八边形
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究平面 N=4 SYM Coulomb 分支上的 Sudakov 形状因子和四点散射振幅，将其表示为 Coulomb 分支参数和运动学不变量的函数。该设置提供了对规范理论中红外敏感量在壳与离壳区域之间插值的受控探针。我们识别出一个新的标度极限，在该极限下两个观测量都表现出由 walking 反常维数支配的双对数行为。随着质量标度变化，该 walking 反常维数在在壳区域的尖点反常维数与离壳区域的八边形反常维数之间插值。基于显式两圈结果和预期的全圈结构，我们为形状因子和四点散射振幅的 walking 反常维数提出全圈形式。这些全圈表达式依赖于 't Hooft 耦合的新的、目前未知的函数。

papers.title: Black-hole formation and thermalization in open JT gravity
papers.abstract: Black-hole formation is expected, via holography, to correspond to thermalization in the boundary theory. For open quantum systems, an initial pure state generically evolves into a mixed state irreversibly, suggesting that horizon formation in the bulk should arise. In this paper, we extend the holographic Lindblad prescription to a non-Markovian setting and apply it to JT gravity coupled to a scalar field. Using numerical simulations in the semiclassical and high-temperature regime, we demonstrate the dynamical formation of black holes.
