papers.title: Molien--Weyl Singlet Counting and BFSS$_2$--Factorization in Gaussian Matrix Quantum Mechanics
papers.abstract: We study the singlet-sector structure of mass-deformed BFSS$_{d+1}$ matrix quantum mechanics by combining the large--\(d\) Gaussian reduction with the Molien--Weyl projection. The Gaussian reduction captures the bulk matrix dynamics through a gauged harmonic oscillator, while the Molien--Weyl integral imposes the Gauss law and reorganizes the physical Hilbert space into holonomy-projected singlet excitations. We show that the very-low-temperature bosonic singlet spectrum is universally controlled by the quadratic Gram operators \(\Tr(X_aX_b)\), whose number is \(d(d+1)/2\). For \(N=2\), this result is established by explicit residue computations and character methods; for \(N>2\), it is supported by the character analysis. Thus the infrared spectrum begins as a collection of BFSS$_2$--like Gram towers, although higher invariant structures generally modify the full partition function. We also give a Hamiltonian derivation of the exceptional exact factorization at \((d,N)=(2,2)\), where the BFSS$_3$ singlet partition function equals the cube of the BFSS$_2$ one for all temperatures. This rigidity is special to the \(SU(2)\) invariant tensor structure and distinguishes exact singlet factorization from the possibility of smooth deconfinement--like holonomy crossovers at finite $N$. Finally, we extend the Gram-counting picture to supersymmetric BFSS/BMN models and indicate how the Molien--Weyl formulation can benchmark Monte Carlo simulations in both \(X_a\)-space and holonomy space.

classification.title_zh: Molien–Weyl 单态计数与高斯矩阵量子力学中的 BFSS_2 因子化
classification.abstract_zh: 本文结合大 d 高斯约化与 Molien–Weyl 投影，研究质量形变 BFSS_{d+1} 矩阵量子力学的单态扇区结构。高斯约化通过规范谐振子描述体矩阵动力学，而 Molien–Weyl 积分施加高斯律，并将物理希尔伯特空间重组为经 holonomy 投影的单态激发。我们表明，极低温玻色单态谱普遍由二次 Gram 算符 Tr(X_aX_b) 控制，其数目为 d(d+1)/2；N=2 时由显式留数计算与特征标方法建立，N>2 时由特征标分析支持。因此红外谱起始为 BFSS_2 型 Gram 塔，尽管更高不变量结构一般会修正完整配分函数。我们还给出 (d,N)=(2,2) 例外精确因子化的哈密顿量推导，其中 BFSS_3 单态配分函数在所有温度下等于 BFSS_2 单态配分函数的三次方。该刚性是 SU(2) 不变张量结构特有的，并将精确单态因子化与有限 N 下平滑去禁闭式 holonomy 交叉的可能性区分开。最后，我们将 Gram 计数推广到超对称 BFSS/BMN 模型，并说明 Molien–Weyl 表述可用于基准测试 X_a 空间与 holonomy 空间中的 Monte Carlo 模拟。
classification.one_liner: 用 Molien–Weyl 投影统计 BFSS 矩阵量子力学单态谱，发现低温由 Gram 算符塔控制，并证明 (d,N)=(2,2) 的精确单态因子化。

papers.title: Towards a Carrollian Description of Yang-Mills
papers.abstract: We provide a theory defined purely on null infinity that describes Yang-Mills in the Minkowski space bulk. The dynamical field of our model is the characteristic data of the bulk gauge field, and the action combines an electric branch Carrollian kinetic term with non-local interactions of MHV type that link different points on the celestial sphere. We explicitly show how this theory recovers all MHV and NMHV tree amplitudes in Yang-Mills, and outline how arbitrary tree amplitudes may be obtained from its Feynman diagram expansion. The detailed expression we find for the NMHV amplitude appears to be new.

classification.title_zh: 迈向杨-米尔斯的卡罗尔描述
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个完全定义在零无穷上的理论，用于描述闵可夫斯基体时空中的杨-米尔斯理论。该模型的动力学场是体规范场的特征数据，其作用量将电支卡罗尔动能项与天体球上连接不同点的MHV型非局域相互作用结合起来。我们明确展示该理论如何恢复杨-米尔斯的所有MHV和NMHV树级振幅，并概述如何通过其费曼图展开得到任意树级振幅。我们得到的NMHV振幅详细表达式似乎是新的。

papers.title: Regge trajectories from the adjoint sector of Matrix Quantum Mechanics
papers.abstract: We reexamine the large $N$ limit of SU$(N)$ symmetric quantum mechanics of a Hermitian matrix whose singlet sector is well known to be exactly solvable via free fermions. When the Fermi level approaches a maximum of the potential, there is critical behavior corresponding to string theory in two dimensions. We uncover new phenomena in the adjoint sector by solving the Marchesini-Onofri equation both numerically and analytically using semiclassical approximations: at criticality, the spectrum is governed by Regge trajectories with energy eigenvalues growing according to $\Delta^2 \sim n/ \alpha'$. In the dual 2D string theory, we interpret these states as oscillatory excitations of a ``short'' folded open string. Up to sub-leading corrections, this Regge behavior is essentially universal and is insensitive to the particular potential we choose to approach criticality. Slightly away from criticality, the highly excited states transition into ``long strings'' that extend far into the Liouville direction.

classification.title_zh: 矩阵量子力学伴随扇区的Regge轨迹
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视一个厄米矩阵的SU(N)对称量子力学的大N极限；其单态扇区可通过自由费米子精确求解。当费米能级接近势的极大值时，出现对应于二维弦理论的临界行为。通过数值和半经典近似求解Marchesini-Onofri方程，我们在伴随扇区发现新现象：在临界点，谱由Regge轨迹支配，能量本征值按 Δ^2 ∼ n/α' 增长。在对偶二维弦理论中，我们将这些态解释为“短”折叠开弦的振荡激发。至次领头修正，这种Regge行为基本是普适的，且不依赖于趋近临界时所选的具体势。稍微偏离临界点，高激发态转变为延伸至Liouville方向的“长弦”。
classification.one_liner: 在矩阵量子力学伴随扇区发现临界Regge轨迹，并用二维弦的短/长折叠开弦解释。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于矩阵模型与二维弦/全息对偶方向，和JT/SYK/AdS2/矩阵模型主题相关；但未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM或经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Positive Celestial Geometry
papers.abstract: Celestial amplitudes are multiple Mellin transforms w.r.t. conformal dimensions. For arbitrary multiplicity $n$ of massless states in sufficiently high space--time dimension $D$ we perform all Mellin integrations and find an associahedron description in celestial space. The latter expresses celestial tree--level $\phi^3$ amplitudes as the canonical forms associated with this positive geometry. This yields a geometric interpretation of celestial amplitudes in terms of the underlying boundary geometry. Our universal treatment of Mellin integrals in $D$ dimensions also provides a unified description of celestial amplitudes arising from different bulk theories.

classification.title_zh: 正天球几何
classification.abstract_zh: 天球振幅是相对于共形维数的多重 Mellin 变换。对于足够高维时空 D 中任意多重数 n 的无质量态，我们完成所有 Mellin 积分，并在天球空间中得到一个 associahedron 描述。该描述将树级天球 φ^3 振幅表示为与此正几何相联系的典范形式。这给出了天球振幅基于底层边界几何的几何解释。我们对 D 维 Mellin 积分的统一处理也为来自不同体理论的天球振幅提供了统一描述。
classification.one_liner: 完成任意多重数天球振幅的 Mellin 积分，并用 associahedron 正几何统一描述树级 φ^3 天球振幅。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦平直时空天球振幅的 Mellin 积分与正几何结构，不属于用户列出的全息超流/超导、p波/多分量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7 探针膜或经典引力等主要关注支线。

papers.title: Reconstructing the Gravitational Waveform from Its Probe Limit
papers.abstract: Gravitational observables for binary systems exhibit a simple polynomial dependence on the masses $m_1$, $m_2$ of the two scattering objects when they are written in terms of the appropriate kinematic variables in the post-Minkowskian (PM) regime. We point out that this property, combined with particle interchange symmetry, allows one to reconstruct the leading and subleading PM waveforms from their probe limit, $m_1 \gg m_2$. As an application, focusing on their re-expansion in the small-velocity or post-Newtonian (PN) regime, we calculate the probe-limit waveforms up to 10PN, and then exploit this observation to deduce from them the waveforms for generic masses in the center-of-mass frame up to 5PN. To this end, we employ both the amplitude-based waveform integrands and the tail formula. This combined approach simplifies substantially the PN expansion of the full subleading PM waveform.

classification.title_zh: 从探针极限重构引力波形
classification.abstract_zh: 本文指出，在 post-Minkowskian (PM) 区域用合适运动学变量表示时，双体系统的引力可观测量对两个散射物体质量 m1、m2 呈简单多项式依赖；结合粒子交换对称性，可由探针极限 m1≫m2 重构领头和次领头 PM 波形。作为应用，作者计算了探针极限波形至 10PN，并据此推导质心系中一般质量波形至 5PN，使用了基于振幅的波形被积函数与 tail 公式。
classification.one_liner: 利用质量多项式依赖和交换对称性，从探针极限重构双体 PM 波形并简化 PN 展开。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的引力波与双体动力学计算，符合用户经典引力支线；但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: The Baby Universe is Fine and the CFT Knows It: On Holography for Closed Universes
papers.abstract: Big bang/big crunch closed universes can be realized in AdS/CFT, even though they lack asymptotically AdS boundaries. With enough bulk entanglement, the bulk Hilbert space of a closed universe can be holographically encoded in the CFT. We clarify the relation of this encoding to observer-clone proposals and refute recent arguments about the breakdown of semiclassical physics in such spaces. In the limit of no bulk entanglement, the holographic encoding breaks down. The oft-cited one-dimensional nature of the closed universe Hilbert space represents the limitation of the external (CFT) Hilbert space to access the quantum information in the closed universe, similar to the limitations imposed on observers outside a perfectly isolated quantum lab. We advocate that the CFT nevertheless continues to determine the physical properties of the closed universe in this regime, showing how to interpret this relationship in terms of a final state projection in the closed universe. We provide a dictionary between the final state wavefunction and CFT data. We propose a model of the emergence of an arrow of time in the universe with a given initial or final state projection. Finally, we show that the conventional EFT in the closed universe, without any projection, can be recovered as a maximally ignorant description of the final state. This conventional EFT is encoded in CFT data, and it can be probed by computing coarse-grained observables. We provide an example of one such observable. Taken together, these results amount to a clean bill of health for baby universes born of AdS/CFT.

classification.title_zh: 婴儿宇宙安然无恙，且 CFT 知晓此事：论闭合宇宙的全息描述
classification.abstract_zh: 大爆炸/大挤压型闭合宇宙可以在 AdS/CFT 中实现，尽管它们没有渐近 AdS 边界。当体纠缠足够多时，闭合宇宙的体希尔伯特空间可由 CFT 全息编码。本文澄清这种编码与观察者克隆提议的关系，并反驳近期关于此类空间中半经典物理失效的论证。在无体纠缠极限下，全息编码失效。常被提及的闭合宇宙希尔伯特空间的一维性，反映了外部 CFT 希尔伯特空间访问闭合宇宙量子信息的局限，类似于完全孤立量子实验室外观察者所受的限制。作者主张，CFT 在该情形下仍决定闭合宇宙的物理性质，并说明如何用闭合宇宙中的末态投影解释这一关系；给出了末态波函数与 CFT 数据之间的字典；提出了在给定初始或末态投影下宇宙时间箭头出现的模型；最后表明，无投影的闭合宇宙中传统 EFT 可作为末态的最大无知描述被恢复，该 EFT 编码于 CFT 数据中并可通过粗粒化可观测量探测，且给出一个此类可观测量的例子。
classification.one_liner: 论文论证 AdS/CFT 可全息描述具有足够体纠缠的闭合婴儿宇宙，并在无纠缠极限下用末态投影和 CFT 字典解释其半经典 EFT。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与字典研究，但未涉及用户重点标签所列的超流超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、探针膜或经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Gravitational-Wave Echoes and Greybody Cutoff from Logarithmic Throats at a Marginal-Trapping Threshold
papers.abstract: When a static, spherically symmetric configuration is brought close to a marginal-trapping threshold, it develops a long throat. As the nondegenerate minimum of $F=1-2m/r$ approaches zero, $F\simeq\Delta+\beta(r-R_M)^2$, the proper length across the throat grows as $-\ln\Delta/\sqrt\beta$, even though the local curvature stays finite. We study how axial gravitational waves propagate in an effective model of this throat, in which the lapse is parametrized as $N\propto F^{s/2}$. For $s>0$ the throat acts as a cavity behind the angular-momentum barrier, and waves come back out as echoes spaced by $T_{\rm echo}\simeq2\Lambda+\delta\propto\Delta^{-s/2}$, where $\Lambda$ is the optical length of the throat and $\delta$ does not depend on $\Delta$. We study four-dimensional, matter-supported quasi-black holes in which a regular centre caps the near-AdS$_2$ throat. These configurations provide a simplified model for investigating capped throats in horizonless microstate geometries. The echo delay in this model is controlled by the inverse redshift near the bottom of the throat, as in capped microstate geometries. This differs from thin-shell gravastars and wormholes, where the delay grows only logarithmically with the distance to the would-be horizon. Time-domain evolutions confirm the $\Delta^{-s/2}$ scaling over three decades in $\Delta$; for $s=0$ the throat becomes part of the barrier and no distinct echo appears. The barrier also imposes a greybody cutoff on the reflected spectrum, $1-\Gamma\simeq e^{-(\omega-f)/T}$, where $T$ is fixed by the curvature of the barrier and does not depend on the surface gravity of any horizon behind it. In this model, the prompt signal is the same whether the interior contains a horizon or a reflecting throat. In the horizonless case, however, the transmitted wave returns as echoes, restoring the high-frequency part of the full reflected spectrum.

classification.title_zh: 边缘捕获阈值处对数喉的引力波回声与灰体截断
classification.abstract_zh: 当静态球对称位形接近边缘捕获阈值时，会形成长喉。当 F=1-2m/r 的非退化极小值趋近于零，F≃Δ+β(r-R_M)^2 时，喉的固有长度按 -lnΔ/√β 增长，而局部曲率保持有限。我们研究轴向引力波在该喉的有效模型中的传播，其中 lapse 参数化为 N∝F^{s/2}。对于 s>0，喉充当角动量势垒后的腔，波以回声形式返回，回声间隔为 T_echo≃2Λ+δ∝Δ^{-s/2}，其中 Λ 是喉的光学长度，δ 不依赖 Δ。我们研究四维、物质支撑的准黑洞，其中正则中心封顶近 AdS2 喉；这些位形为带帽微态几何中的封顶喉提供了简化模型。该模型中的回声延迟由喉底附近红移的倒数控制，类似带帽微态几何；这不同于薄壳 gravastar 和 wormhole，后者的延迟仅随到拟视界距离对数增长。时域演化在 Δ 的三个数量级范围内确认了 Δ^{-s/2} 标度；对于 s=0，喉成为势垒的一部分，不出现独立回声。势垒还对反射谱施加灰体截断 1-Γ≃e^{-(ω-f)/T}，其中 T 由势垒曲率固定，不依赖其背后任何视界的表面引力。在该模型中，无论内部包含视界还是反射喉，初始信号相同；但在无视界情形下，透射波会作为回声返回，恢复全反射谱的高频部分。
classification.one_liner: 在边缘捕获阈值附近的长喉模型中，轴向引力波产生间隔按 Δ^{-s/2} 增长的回声，并受与势垒曲率相关的灰体截断。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/黑洞替代几何中的引力波散射与回声研究，涉及时间域演化和灰体谱；与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论较相关，但不涉及全息超流、p波、multi-trace等全息凝聚态支线。

papers.title: Quasinormal-mode encounters: Pseudospectra near Kerr--Newman exceptional points
papers.abstract: Exceptional points (EPs), at which two quasinormal frequencies and their eigenvectors coalesce, can strongly enhance the spectral instability of black hole quasinormal modes. We investigate this behavior in Kerr--Newman spacetimes through pseudospectra and condition numbers for neutral massless scalar fields and coupled gravitoelectromagnetic (GE) perturbations. For the scalar field, we follow the $(\ell,m)=(1,1)$ spheroidal branch and derive the energy norm from the stress-energy tensor. For GE perturbations, we use a coupled four-field system equipped with a positive radiative energy. At the selected near-EP backgrounds, the condition numbers of both modes in the close pair exceed those of the two more-damped modes shown for comparison at the same background. Along a matched GE parameter path, the frequency splitting follows a square-root law and the condition numbers grow as the inverse square root of the distance to the EP. The pseudospectral contours resolve the transition from individual-mode sensitivity to the collective response of the pair. Within the discretized problems and energy norms considered here, these results quantify the amplification of spectral instability near EPs and provide a basis for studying their contribution to black-hole ringdown.

classification.title_zh: 准正规模相遇：Kerr–Newman 例外点附近的赝谱
classification.abstract_zh: 例外点（EPs）是准正规模频率及其本征矢合并的点，可显著增强黑洞准正规模的谱不稳定性。本文利用赝谱和条件数研究 Kerr–Newman 时空中中性无质量标量场及耦合引力电磁（GE）扰动的这一行为。对标量场，沿 (ℓ,m)=(1,1) 椭球分支并由应力能量张量导出能量范数；对 GE 扰动，采用具有正辐射能的四场耦合系统。在选定的近 EP 背景上，紧邻模式对中两个模式的条件数超过同一背景下作为对比的另外两个更阻尼模式。沿匹配的 GE 参数路径，频率劈裂遵循平方根律，条件数随到 EP 距离的平方根倒数增长。赝谱等高线分辨了从单模式敏感性到模式对集体响应的转变。在本文考虑的离散化问题和能量范数内，这些结果量化了 EP 附近谱不稳定性的放大，并为研究其对黑洞铃宕的贡献提供基础。
classification.one_liner: 用赝谱与条件数量化 Kerr–Newman 黑洞近例外点处准正规模的谱不稳定性放大。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接涉及 QNM、谱不稳定性与经典黑洞时空扰动，匹配“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；摘要未涉及全息方法。

papers.title: Heavy-Particle Effective Theory: from On-Shell Formalism to Gravitational Compton Amplitudes
papers.abstract: We formulate on-shell heavy-particle effective theory (HPET) amplitudes by projecting the spinor-helicity variables onto the $SU(2)$ little group of a timelike reference velocity $v^{\mu}$. Retaining both large and small components of the velocity-projected spinors gives an intermediate velocity-projected amplitudes in which reparameterization invariance can be imposed before expanding in the inverse heavy-particle mass. Integrating out the small component then yields HPET amplitudes organized by heavy-particle power counting, with a direct correspondence to local operators at fixed order. We determine the three-point velocity-projected amplitudes for two equal-mass particles of arbitrary spin $S$ coupled to a soft massless boson of helicity $h$. Four-point gravitational Compton amplitudes can be constructively obtained using velocity-projected three-point amplitudes, and expanded into HPET amplitudes which is free of spurious poles up to sub-leading order. As a gravitational application, we show that the projected gravitational minimal coupling reproduces the Kerr spin-induced multipoles up to order $2S$, and find the classical limits of the tree-level elastic gravitational scattering and gravitational Compton amplitudes agreed with the literature up to contact terms undetermined by factorization.

classification.title_zh: 重粒子有效理论：从在壳形式到引力康普顿振幅
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过在时间类参考速度 v^μ 的 SU(2) 小群上投影旋量-螺旋度变量，构造在壳重粒子有效理论（HPET）振幅。保留速度投影旋量的大分量和小分量可得到中间的速度投影振幅，并可在按重粒子质量倒数展开前施加重参数化不变性。积掉小分量后，得到按重粒子幂次计数组织的 HPET 振幅，并与固定阶的局域算符直接对应。作者确定了任意自旋 S 的两个等质量粒子与螺旋度 h 的软无质量玻色子耦合的三点速度投影振幅。四点引力康普顿振幅可由速度投影三点振幅构造性获得，并展开为 HPET 振幅；在次领头阶之前没有伪极点。作为引力应用，文中表明投影的引力最小耦合可复现直至 2S 阶的 Kerr 自旋诱导多极，并发现树级弹性引力散射和引力康普顿振幅的经典极限与文献一致，差别仅在因子化无法确定的接触项。
classification.one_liner: 建立速度投影的在壳重粒子有效理论，并用于生成无伪极点的引力康普顿振幅及复现 Kerr 多极与经典散射极限。
classification.relevance_reason: 非 AdS/CFT/全息研究；但涉及引力康普顿振幅、Kerr 多极与经典引力散射极限，对经典引力/振幅支线有中等相关性。

papers.title: Rotation overcharges vectorized black holes
papers.abstract: A charged black hole has a ceiling: extremality bounds the charge that a given mass and spin can support. Vector hair has so far only lowered it. In the Einstein--Maxwell--Vector (EMV) model, where a massless vector field couples nonminimally to the electromagnetic invariant, the spherically symmetric vectorized Reissner--Nordstr\"om black holes are strictly undercharged: vector hair is paid for in charge. Whether this ceiling is a property of the vector field or merely of spherical symmetry has remained open, because spherical symmetry hides the hair's mass as well: its Komar mass vanishes identically and the exact identity $M_V=2\Omega_HJ_V$ degenerates to $0=0$. Rotation lifts both degeneracies at once. We construct the rotating solutions of the model, the first in this setting, and find that the hair's mass is not a free parameter but a second-order invariant of the rotational response, fixed by $M_V=2\Omega_HJ_V$. Above a coupling threshold the ceiling gives way: the domain of existence crosses the extremal Kerr--Newman bound, reaching $q=Q/M>1$ with $q^2+\chi^2$ up to $1.84$, while at $\alpha=5$ the maximum charge stays below it. The shadow is where the hair becomes visible. At $(q,\chi)=(0.9947,0.10)$, near the extremal bound, the hair contributes an ellipticity of $8.30\%$, against $0.44\%$ from the charge and $0.06\%$ from rotation --- a factor of $19$ that charging a Kerr black hole cannot mimic; at the overcharged solution $(q,\chi)=(1.2527,0.10)$ the total ellipticity reaches $25.6\%$. Whether the branch is ghost-free remains open, but the existing no-go criteria do not settle it: they assume a background and a dispersion relation that do not hold here.

classification.title_zh: 旋转使矢量毛发型黑洞过充电
classification.abstract_zh: 带电黑洞存在上限：极端性界限制约了给定质量和自旋所能承载的电荷。矢量毛发迄今只会降低这一上限。在 Einstein-Maxwell-Vector（EMV）模型中，无质量矢量场与电磁不变量非最小耦合，球对称的矢量化 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞严格处于欠充电状态：矢量毛发以电荷为代价。球对称是否掩盖了毛发质量的问题一直悬而未决，因为其 Komar 质量恒为零，恒等式 M_V=2Ω_HJ_V 退化为 0=0。旋转同时解除这两个简并。我们构造了该模型的旋转解（这是此设定下的首次），发现毛发质量并非自由参数，而是旋转响应的二阶不变量，由 M_V=2Ω_HJ_V 固定。超过耦合阈值后上限被突破：存在域越过极端 Kerr-Newman 边界，达到 q=Q/M>1，且 q²+χ² 最高可达 1.84；而在 α=5 时最大电荷仍低于该边界。阴影是毛发变得可见之处。在接近极端边界的 (q,χ)=(0.9947,0.10) 处，毛发贡献 8.30% 的椭率，电荷贡献 0.44%、旋转贡献 0.06%——因子 19 的差异无法通过给 Kerr 黑洞充电来模仿；在过充电解 (q,χ)=(1.2527,0.10) 处总椭率达到 25.6%。该分支是否无鬼仍然开放，但现有 no-go 判据无法定论：它们假设的背景和色散关系在此并不成立。
classification.one_liner: 在 EMV 模型中构造首个旋转矢量毛发型黑洞解，发现超过耦合阈值时矢量毛发可使电荷越过极端 Kerr-Newman 上限，并显著改变黑洞阴影椭率。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力中旋转黑洞解与阴影研究，直接匹配用户关注的“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；但不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息量子信息。

papers.title: Phenomenological implications of cosmic (super)strings with time-varying tension
papers.abstract: Cosmic strings and cosmic superstrings could have formed in the early universe. In a particular class of models, the tension associated with these defects is time dependent, either because the strings themselves are composed of evolving moduli fields, or because they are directly coupled to evolving scalar fields leading to an effective time dependence in the string tension. Here we take seriously the possibility of this time dependence and investigate the phenomenological consequences of such an evolution, comparing the results to the more traditional case of a fixed time independent tension. In particular, for five different time varying models, motivated by different possible forms of evolution of the string tension, we evaluate their Gravitational Wave (GW) contributions as well as their impact on the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB). Performing an MCMC analysis of the models we find there are indeed interesting spectral signatures in the GW emission at frequencies between the current PTA and interferometer data, but the signatures are not unique to these strings, making them hard to pin down using current data. However, we do find cosmic strings with evolving tension fit the GW data as well as other favoured models.

classification.title_zh: 具有时变张力的宇宙（超）弦的现象学意义
classification.abstract_zh: 宇宙弦和宇宙超弦可能形成于早期宇宙。在一类特定模型中，这些缺陷的张力随时间变化：或者弦本身由演化的模量场构成，或者它们直接与演化的标量场耦合，从而产生有效的时变弦张力。本文认真对待这种时间依赖的可能性，研究其演化的现象学后果，并与传统的固定张力情形比较。具体地，针对五种由不同可能张力演化形式所激发的时变模型，我们评估它们的引力波贡献以及对宇宙微波背景的影响。通过对这些模型进行MCMC分析，我们发现当前脉冲星计时阵列与干涉仪数据之间的频率范围内确实存在有趣的引力波谱特征，但这些特征并非这些弦所独有，因此用当前数据很难确定下来。不过，我们确实发现具有演化张力的宇宙弦与其他受青睐的模型一样能很好地拟合引力波数据。
classification.one_liner: 研究时变张力宇宙弦/超弦的引力波与CMB现象学，并用MCMC比较五类模型。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为宇宙弦/超弦的宇宙学与引力波现象学，不属于全息或AdS/CFT；仅与经典引力/引力波分支有间接关联。

papers.title: Covariant phase space analysis of static spherical vacua in power-law $f(R)$ gravity
papers.abstract: We formulate the static, spherically symmetric vacuum equations of power-law metric $f(R)$ gravity as a covariant autonomous system using the $(1+1+2)$ formalism. The finite critical sets include the scale-invariant Clifton--Barrow solution, a Minkowski endpoint shared by the Schwarzschild family, and degenerate boundaries of the normalized chart. The Clifton--Barrow equilibrium is an outward-radial attractor over a positive interval of the power-law parameter, whereas the Schwarzschild endpoint is a saddle of the polynomially extended system. Poincar\'e compactification, supplemented by secondary and weighted charts, resolves several asymptotic regimes. In particular, normally attracting sheets at large normalized curvature occur in the positive-curvature sector and are separated from the negative-curvature Clifton--Barrow equilibrium. Metric reconstruction also identifies a selected scalar-flat family with a regular throat, one asymptotically flat end, and a curvature-singular end. These results organize the regular reduced chart and the boundary regimes resolved here; they do not constitute a complete classification of static spherical vacua. All stability statements concern the static radial flow.

classification.title_zh: 幂律 f(R) 引力中静态球对称真空的协变相空间分析
classification.abstract_zh: 本文使用 (1+1+2) 形式，将幂律度规 f(R) 引力的静态球对称真空方程表述为协变自治系统。有限临界集包括尺度不变的 Clifton--Barrow 解、Schwarzschild 族共享的 Minkowski 端点，以及归一化图的退化边界。Clifton--Barrow 平衡在幂律参数的正区间内是外向径向吸引子，而 Schwarzschild 端点是多项式扩展系统的鞍点。Poincaré 紧化辅以次级和加权图，解决了若干渐近区域；特别地，正曲率扇区出现大归一化曲率处的法向吸引叶，并与负曲率的 Clifton--Barrow 平衡分离。度规重构还识别出一个选定的标量平坦族，具有规则喉、一个渐近平坦端和一个曲率奇异端。这些结果组织了规则约化图及本文解决的边界区域；它们不构成静态球对称真空的完整分类，所有稳定性陈述均针对静态径向流。
classification.one_liner: 用 (1+1+2) 协变自治系统分析幂律 f(R) 静态球对称真空的临界集、渐近结构与径向流稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究 f(R) 引力的经典静态球对称真空与广义相对论式时空结构，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不属于 AdS/CFT 或其他全息研究。

papers.title: Odds Estimation for Supermassive Black Hole Binaries in Local Core Galaxies
papers.abstract: Supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) are expected products of massive galaxy mergers, but identifying binaries in nearby galaxies remains challenging. We combine simulated massive-galaxy assembly histories from IllustrisTNG with a semi-analytic core-scouring model to connect observable core galaxy properties to the probability of hosting a bound SMBHB at z=0. We (i) construct a core galaxy population using an observationally motivated galaxy stellar mass function, (ii) model binary evolution through dynamical friction, stellar hardening, and gravitational-wave emission, and (iii) perform logistic regressions with five observable predictors: stellar mass deficit, stellar mass, central density, central velocity dispersion, and effective radius. The resulting models perform well on simulated systems, achieving a pseudo-$R^2$ of $0.51\pm0.03$, accuracy $0.95\pm0.01$, precision $0.92\pm0.03$, and recall $0.82\pm0.04$. Uncoalesced binaries are typically compact, with separations peaking near 0.3 pc, though only $\sim0.3\%$ emit in the pulsar timing array band. Applying the model to observed core galaxies, we identify eight nearby galaxies more likely than not to host SMBHBs. Of those eight host candidates, we note Messier 86 (NGC 4406) as a particularly likely example that was similarly identified using independent means and therefore warrants future follow-up.

classification.title_zh: 本地核心星系中超大质量黑洞双星的概率估计
classification.abstract_zh: 超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHBs）被认为是大质量星系并合的预期产物，但在近邻星系中识别双星仍然困难。我们将 IllustrisTNG 模拟的大质量星系组装历史与半解析核心挖空模型结合，把可观测的核心星系性质与 z=0 时宿主一个束缚 SMBHB 的概率联系起来。我们 (i) 使用观测驱动的星系恒星质量函数构建核心星系族群，(ii) 通过动力学摩擦、恒星硬化与引力波辐射模拟双星演化，(iii) 用五个可观测预测量进行逻辑回归：恒星质量亏损、恒星质量、中心密度、中心速度弥散和有效半径。所得模型在模拟系统上表现良好，达到 pseudo-R^2=0.51±0.03、准确率 0.95±0.01、精确率 0.92±0.03、召回率 0.82±0.04。未并合双星通常很致密，分离度峰值约 0.3 pc，但只有约 0.3% 在脉冲星计时阵列波段辐射。将模型应用于观测到的核心星系，我们识别出八个近邻星系比不更可能宿主 SMBHB。在这八个宿主候选者中，我们指出 Messier 86 (NGC 4406) 是一个特别可能的例子，它也曾通过独立方法被类似识别，因此值得未来跟进。
classification.one_liner: 结合 IllustrisTNG 与半解析双星演化模型，用核心星系可观测性质估计近邻星系宿主超大质量黑洞双星的概率，并给出八个候选星系。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究星系中超大质量黑洞双星的人口统计、演化与观测候选，属于天体物理/经典黑洞与引力波现象，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力理论。

papers.title: Systematic High Overtone Expansion of Kerr Quasinormal Modes
papers.abstract: We develop a systematic method to compute the high overtone expansion of Kerr quasinormal modes on normal angular branches to arbitrary order. We first obtain the expansion of the angular eigenvalue at large frequencies by a simple polynomial recursion. Using this result in an alternative form of the radial Teukolsky equation, we find that all the WKB corrections are defined on a fixed genus-one spectral curve, and that the quantum periods at the second and higher orders are expressed in terms of only two elliptic periods. This allows us to determine the expansion coefficients order by order. We confirm that the truncated expansions reproduce quasinormal frequencies obtained by solving the angular and radial equations directly, for scalar, electromagnetic and gravitational fields. We also compare the scalar results with the exact WKB analysis of extremal Kerr black holes.

classification.title_zh: Kerr准正规模高泛音展开的系统方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种系统方法，可在常规角分支上把Kerr准正规模的高泛音展开计算到任意阶。首先用简单的多项式递推得到大频率下角本征值的展开；再将其代入径向Teukolsky方程的另一种形式，发现所有WKB修正都定义在一个固定的亏格一谱曲线上，并且二阶及更高阶的量子周期仅由两个椭圆周期表示。由此可以逐阶确定展开系数。我们验证了截断展开能重现直接求解角方程和径向方程得到的标量、电磁和引力场的准正规模频率，并将标量结果与极端Kerr黑洞的精确WKB分析进行了比较。
classification.one_liner: 用固定亏格一谱曲线上的WKB量子周期，系统计算Kerr黑洞准正规模的高泛音展开至任意阶。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究Kerr黑洞准正规模的高泛音WKB展开，匹配“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Inverse design of scalar-tensor EFT from odd-parity effective potentials
papers.abstract: We develop an inverse-design approach to the effective field theory (EFT) of perturbations in scalar-tensor gravity around static and spherically symmetric backgrounds with a timelike scalar-field gradient, taking the odd-parity effective potential as input and reconstructing compatible background and EFT data. As analytically tractable examples, we construct explicit realizations of the P\"oschl-Teller potential, for which the quasinormal-mode spectrum can be obtained in closed form. We then study the Regge-Wheeler potential of general relativity and its parametrized deformations, showing how both can be realized within the scalar-tensor EFT. In particular, the latter realizations provide a route to interpreting phenomenological constraints on potential deformations from black hole ringdown observations in terms of the underlying EFT data.

classification.title_zh: 从奇宇称有效势逆设计标量-张量 EFT
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种逆设计方法，用于研究具有类时标量场梯度的静态球对称背景下标量-张量引力的微扰 EFT：以奇宇称有效势为输入，重构相容的背景与 EFT 数据。作为可解析示例，构造 Pöschl-Teller 势的显式实现，其准正规模谱可闭式求得；随后研究广义相对论的 Regge-Wheeler 势及其参数化形变，并展示二者均可在该标量-张量 EFT 中实现，从而为用底层 EFT 数据解释黑洞铃宕观测对势形变的唯象约束提供途径。
classification.one_liner: 以奇宇称有效势为输入逆设计标量-张量 EFT，并用 QNM 示例连接黑洞铃宕约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题属于经典引力/修改引力与黑洞 QNM，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”标签；但不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶，因此对全息主线相关性中等。

papers.title: Draining Without Emptying a Stringy Black Hole: Repetitive Electric Penrose Process
papers.abstract: This paper studies the repetitive electric Penrose process in the Gibbons-Maeda-Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger (GMGHS) black hole under the optimal condition for maximum energy extraction. Unlike the Reissner-Nordstr\"om (RN) black hole, the effective potential curve of the incident particle in the GMGHS black hole remains unchanged during the iterations. The iteration termination conditions are determined by two aspects: the escape condition requires that particle 0 can overcome the effective potential peak and escape to infinity, and this condition is independent of the black hole charge; the existence condition for negative-energy particle 1 requires the black hole charge to be sufficiently large, indicating that the repetitive process cannot completely consume the charge of the GMGHS black hole to zero. Numerical simulations show that the return on investment of energy extraction can exceed $100\%$, but the energy utilization efficiency does not exceed $50\%$, and most of the extractable energy is converted into an increase in the irreducible mass of the black hole. In addition, a smaller decay radius and a larger absolute value of the charge-to-mass ratio of particle 1 can improve the return on investment and energy utilization efficiency of energy extraction; the larger the specific energy of the incident particle, the smaller the return on investment of energy extraction, while the energy utilization efficiency remains unchanged; for an initially non-extremal black hole, as the initial charge increases, the return on investment of energy extraction increases monotonically, while the energy utilization efficiency first increases and then decreases. After the iterations end, the black hole still retains extractable energy, and neither the charge nor the mass vanishes.

classification.title_zh: 抽干而不耗尽弦黑洞：重复电性彭罗斯过程
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在最大能量提取最优条件下，Gibbons-Maeda-Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger（GMGHS）黑洞中的重复电性彭罗斯过程。与 Reissner-Nordström（RN）黑洞不同，GMGHS 黑洞中入射粒子的有效势曲线在迭代过程中保持不变。迭代终止条件由两方面决定：逃逸条件要求粒子 0 能够克服有效势峰并逃逸至无穷远，且该条件与黑洞电荷无关；负能粒子 1 的存在条件要求黑洞电荷足够大，这表明重复过程不能将 GMGHS 黑洞的电荷完全消耗至零。数值模拟显示，能量提取的投资回报率可以超过 100%，但能量利用效率不超过 50%，且大部分可提取能量转化为黑洞不可约质量的增加。此外，较小的衰变半径和粒子 1 电荷-质量比绝对值较大可以提高能量提取的投资回报率和能量利用效率；入射粒子的比能越大，能量提取的投资回报率越小，而能量利用效率保持不变；对于初始非极端黑洞，随着初始电荷增加，能量提取的投资回报率单调增加，而能量利用效率先增加后减小。迭代结束后，黑洞仍保留可提取能量，电荷和质量均未消失。
classification.one_liner: 在 GMGHS 弦黑洞中，重复电性 Penrose 过程可循环提取能量，但受负能粒子存在条件限制，无法将黑洞电荷和质量完全耗尽。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 GMGHS 弦黑洞中的经典重复电性 Penrose 过程与能量提取，属于经典引力/黑洞物理，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息字典或量子信息；与用户标注的经典引力支线相关，但与全息凝聚态等他类主线关联较弱。

papers.title: Generalized Dirac Equation in Metric-Affine Spacetimes: Consistency, Effective Mass, and Spinor Curvature
papers.abstract: We formulate a generalized Dirac equation in four-dimensional metric-affine spacetimes with curvature, torsion, and non-metricity. The spinor connection is expanded over the complete basis of the Clifford algebra $cl(1,3)$ and contains eight complex coupling constants. Requiring agreement between direct covariantization of the Dirac equation and variation of the corresponding symmetrized Lagrangian imposes eight real consistency conditions, reducing the number of independent real parameters from sixteen to eight. In the static isotropic symmetric teleparallel sector, formal Hermiticity of the Hamiltonian with respect to the curved-space Dirac inner product reproduces the corresponding restrictions on the non-metricity and coframe couplings. The coframe-dependent terms introduce scalar and pseudoscalar mass contributions that persist in Minkowski spacetime. For a single free Dirac field with constant coefficients, they yield one effective mass, $m_{\mathrm{eff}}=\sqrt{(m-4b_3)^2+16b_4^2}$, and a chiral phase removable by a constant chiral field redefinition. A nonzero effective mass is therefore possible even when the original mass parameter vanishes. We also derive the Clifford decomposition of the generalized spinor curvature and show that it can remain nonzero when affine curvature, torsion, and non-metricity all vanish. When $m=0$, the combination $b_3^2+b_4^2$ determines both the effective mass squared and the surviving spinor curvature, establishing an algebraic link between these contributions.

classification.title_zh: 度规-仿射时空中的广义狄拉克方程：一致性、有效质量与旋量曲率
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在具有曲率、挠率和非度规性的四维度规-仿射时空中建立广义狄拉克方程。旋量联络在Clifford代数cl(1,3)的完整基上展开，包含八个复耦合常数；要求狄拉克方程的直接协变化与相应对称化拉格朗日量变分一致，会给出八个实一致性条件，将独立实参数由十六个减少到八个。在静态各向同性对称远平行扇区中，哈密顿量相对于弯曲空间狄拉克内积的形式厄米性再现了对非度规性和标架耦合的限制。标架相关项引入标量和赝标量质量贡献，即使在Minkowski时空中也存在。对于具有常数系数的单个自由狄拉克场，这些贡献给出一个有效质量 m_eff=sqrt((m-4b_3)^2+16b_4^2)，以及可由常数手征场重定义消除的手征相位；因此即使原始质量参数为零，也可能存在非零有效质量。文中还推导了广义旋量曲率的Clifford分解，并表明当仿射曲率、挠率和非度规性全为零时该旋量曲率仍可非零。当m=0时，组合b_3^2+b_4^2同时决定有效质量平方和残余旋量曲率，从而在这些贡献之间建立代数联系。
classification.one_liner: 在度规-仿射时空中构造广义狄拉克方程，并用一致性条件、厄米性及Clifford分解分析有效质量与旋量曲率。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究度规-仿射时空中的广义狄拉克方程与旋量曲率，不涉及AdS/CFT全息字典、全息凝聚态、全息QCD或用户列出的全息重点标签；仅与经典/扩展引力中的弯曲时空场论有边缘关联。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of Swirling Black Holes and Kerr-Taub-NUT
papers.abstract: We establish the first law of black hole thermodynamics for the recently discovered Kerr swirling (KS) and accelerated Kerr swirling (AKS) black hole solutions. We also revisit the first law for the Kerr-Taub-NUT (KTN) spacetime. Guided by Noether's original insight that global symmetries give rise to conservation laws, we employ and adapt the surface charge method for computing the associated charges (mass and angular momentum) in the presence of spacetime string-like defects (conical singularities) along the axes of both KS and KTN black holes. We obtain finite integrated charges in a quasi-local manner, without relying on the non-flat asymptotic regions characteristic of these spacetimes. We then establish a first law without introducing independent stringy terms unrelated to symmetries. For both KS and KTN, the quantities that play the role of the black hole entropy differ from the simple geometrical rule of one-fourth of the horizon area. This mismatch arises because we keep first-law charges associated with conservation laws. It indicates that standard formulas may not be naively used for black holes with string-like defects; they have a different topology and suggest the need for a new geometrical framework. In stark contrast, for the AKS spacetime, which can be regularized outside the singularity and lacks string-like defects, we find that the charges are consistent with a first law having the usual one-fourth of the area entropy. We first determine the mass using the Christodoulou-Ruffini formula and then check its agreement with the result obtained from the surface charge method.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 涡旋黑洞与 Kerr-Taub-NUT 的热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为最近发现的 Kerr 涡旋（KS）黑洞和加速 Kerr 涡旋（AKS）黑洞解建立了黑洞热力学第一定律。我们也重新审视了 Kerr-Taub-NUT（KTN）时空的第一定律。受 Noether 关于整体对称性产生守恒律的原始洞见引导，我们采用并调整表面电荷方法，在 KS 和 KTN 黑洞轴线上存在类弦缺陷（锥形奇点）的情况下计算相关荷（质量和角动量）。我们以准局域方式获得有限积分荷，而不依赖这些时空特有的非平坦渐近区域。随后，我们在不引入与对称性无关的独立弦项的情况下建立第一定律。对于 KS 和 KTN，起到黑洞熵作用的量不同于简单的四分之一视界面积几何规则。这种不匹配出现的原因是我们保留了与守恒律相关的第一定律荷。这表明标准公式可能不能被天真地用于具有类弦缺陷的黑洞；它们具有不同的拓扑，并提示需要新的几何框架。与之形成鲜明对比的是，对于 AKS 时空——它可以在奇点外被正则化且没有类弦缺陷——我们发现其荷与具有通常四分之一面积熵的第一定律一致。我们先使用 Christodoulou-Ruffini 公式确定质量，然后检验其与表面电荷方法所得结果的一致性。
classification.one_liner: 用表面电荷法为 KS、AKS 与 KTN 黑洞建立热力学第一定律，并指出类弦缺陷导致熵偏离面积四分之一规则。
keywords: 加速 Kerr 涡旋黑洞
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典黑洞时空的热力学第一定律、表面电荷与广义相对论解，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线。

papers.title: Localization in Seven-Dimensional Supergravity
papers.abstract: Seven-dimensional supergravity provides holographic access to strongly coupled six-dimensional superconformal theories through its highest-dimensional supersymmetric AdS vacua. Its unique spinor-bilinear geometry and massive higher-form dynamics make systematic analysis and solution-finding distinctively challenging. Relative equivariant localization can obtain supersymmetric observables in odd dimensions from fixed-point data on an auxiliary even-dimensional filling, without an explicit solution. We extend this approach to seven dimensions in maximal Cartan-gauged supergravity with all gauge fields active. We formulate the Euclidean action and Killing-spinor equations in terms of field strengths, and construct a bilinear system adapted to the change in spinor reality conditions from symplectic-Majorana to Majorana. On the non-null gauged active spinor branch, independent, oppositely R-charged spinors are paired by Majorana conjugation on the same complex background. One algebraic gauging correction and two algebraic bilinear projections suffice to extend the equal-charge sector to independent Cartan charges, and the underlying efficient reorganization also applies in the Lorentzian theory. Massive 3-form self-duality fixes the quartic anomaly class and determines the higher-form fixed-point datum from Abelian moment maps. Localization at the single fixed point of the filling recovers the general supersymmetric AdS$_7$ black-hole action, without extending the solution. We prove gauge-covariant Killing-spinor invariance under the combined supersymmetric Killing flow and R-symmetry action, deriving the linear chemical-potential constraint. Extremizing the constrained entropy functional and requiring real positive stationary entropy yields the nonlinear charge relation within the Euclidean analysis, equivalent to Lorentzian horizon extremality for the known spherical black-hole family.

classification.title_zh: 七维超引力中的局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 七维超引力通过其最高维超对称 AdS 真空为强耦合六维超共形理论提供全息描述。本文把相对等变局域化推广到七维最大 Cartan 规范超引力（所有规范场均活跃），用场强表述欧氏作用量和 Killing 旋量方程，并构造适应旋量实条件从辛-Majorana 到 Majorana 变化的双线性系统。在非零规范活跃旋量分支上，同一复背景上的 Majorana 共轭将独立且 R 荷相反的旋量配对；一个代数规范修正和两个代数双线性投影足以把等荷扇区推广到独立 Cartan 荷，且该重组也适用于 Lorentz 理论。大质量 3-形式自对偶固定四阶反常类，并由 Abel 矩映射确定高形式不动点数据。在填充的单一不动点处局域化无需延拓解即可恢复一般超对称 AdS7 黑洞作用量；作者证明联合超对称 Killing 流与 R 对称作用下的规范协变 Killing 旋量不变性，导出线性化学势约束；对约束熵泛函取极值并要求实正静止熵，可在欧氏分析中得到非线性电荷关系，等价于已知球对称黑洞族的 Lorentz 视界极端性。
classification.one_liner: 将相对等变局域化推广到七维最大 Cartan 规范超引力，并由不动点数据恢复 AdS7 黑洞作用量与熵/极端性约束。

papers.title: Gravity between two masses beyond Newton's law
papers.abstract: Newton's law of universal gravitation describes the attraction between two masses through an inverse-distance potential. In Einstein's theory gravity gravitates: each mass reshapes the spacetime geometry through which the other acts. More than a century later, extracting the two-body interaction from this coupled geometry remains a fundamental analytical challenge. Even without motion or radiation, the static sector of the interaction harbours an infinite hierarchy of field couplings: the purest laboratory for gravitational non-linearity. Here we determine the static interaction from ninth to twelfth order in Newton's constant for arbitrary mass ratios, and derive a closed expression for the first backreaction beyond the Schwarzschild test-body limit to all orders in the gravitational coupling. We achieve both advances by formulating the problem around the stationary interaction energy. An exact one-body background resums one source's self-interaction, stationarity reduces the fields required from the other, and integrated response identities reveal cancellations across the coupled modes. Complementary expansions then resolve the complete mass dependence at finite order. Together, these results bridge the gap between an infinitesimal probe and comparable masses, exposing hidden analytical simplicity within Einstein's theory and providing essential building blocks for modelling orbital dynamics and gravitational-wave generation.

classification.title_zh: 超越牛顿定律的两质量间引力
classification.abstract_zh: 牛顿万有引力定律用反距离势描述两质量间的吸引。在爱因斯坦理论中引力本身也产生引力：每个质量通过重塑时空几何来影响另一个质量。一个多世纪后，从这种耦合几何中提取两体相互作用仍是基础性的解析难题。即使没有运动或辐射，相互作用的静态部分也包含无穷层次的场耦合，是研究引力非线性的最纯粹实验室。本文对任意质量比确定了牛顿常数九阶至十二阶的静态相互作用，并给出了超越 Schwarzschild 试探体极限的首个背反作用在引力耦合所有阶上的闭合表达式。两项进展均通过围绕静态相互作用能表述问题实现：精确的单体背景重求和了一个源的自相互作用，驻定性减少了另一个源所需的场，积分响应恒等式揭示了耦合模式间的抵消；互补展开则在有限阶上解析完整的质量依赖。这些结果弥合了无穷小试探体与可比质量之间的差距，揭示了爱因斯坦理论中隐藏的解析简洁性，并为轨道动力学建模和引力波产生提供了基本构件。
classification.one_liner: 该文在经典广义相对论框架下解析计算任意质量比两体静态引力相互作用的高阶项，并给出超越试探体极限的首个背反作用闭合表达式。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究广义相对论中的经典两体引力与高阶非线性相互作用，属于用户重点关注的经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Holographic duals of JT gravity at finite cutoff: the classical case
papers.abstract: We formulate JT gravity with finite-cutoff boundaries and end-of-the-world branes in the first-order BF formulation. We dynamically reduce the BF model into a one-dimensional system living at the boundaries, generalizing earlier constructions. We obtain in particular a geometrical understanding of the phase space degrees of freedom associated to each of these boundaries. We leverage these results to probe bulk locality and the underlying structure of spacetime. Within our framework, we are able to derive a closed-form expression for the holographic Schwarzian description of JT gravity at finite-cutoff in phase space. The resulting degrees of freedom describe the embedding of the finite-cutoff curve in AdS$_2$. A quantization of these systems is presented in a companion paper.

classification.title_zh: 有限截断下JT引力的全息对偶：经典情形
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在一阶BF表述中构造具有有限截断边界和世界尽头膜的JT引力。我们将BF模型动力学地约化为生活在边界上的一维系统，推广了此前的构造。特别是，我们获得了对每个此类边界相关相空间自由度的几何理解。我们利用这些结果探测体局域性和时空的底层结构。在该框架内，我们能够推导出有限截断下JT引力的全息Schwarzian描述在相空间中的闭合表达式。所得自由度描述有限截断曲线在AdS$_2$中的嵌入。这些系统的量子化将在配套论文中给出。
classification.one_liner: 在BF表述中构造有限截断JT引力及其边界相空间全息Schwarzian描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于JT/AdS2有限截断全息的基础构造，与全息对偶和低维引力相关，但不直接对应所列全息凝聚态、超流超导、探针膜等具体重点支线。

papers.title: Breaking of integrability in elliptic deformations of AdS3 strings with mixed flux
papers.abstract: We construct elliptic deformations of the $AdS_3 \times S^3 \times T^4$ superstring supported by mixed NSNS and RR fluxes in type IIB supergravity and investigate their integrability. The NSNS sector includes a Wess-Zumino term, and imposing that the theory preserves 8 supersymmetries also requires the presence of a B-field coupling the deformed $AdS_3$ and $S^3$ factors. We explore integrability from two different perspectives: through the construction of a flat Lax connection and the computation of the tree-level worldsheet S-matrix. For generic elliptic parameters and NSNS flux, we find inelastic $2 \rightarrow 2$ amplitudes, violating the elasticity required by integrability. In the integrable cases as identified by the Lax analysis, these inelastic amplitudes vanish and the tree-level S-matrix satisfies the classical Yang-Baxter equation. In particular, the addition of a Wess-Zumino term, which preserves integrability in the rational and trigonometric models, breaks integrability for elliptic deformations.

classification.title_zh: 混合通量下AdS3弦椭圆形变中可积性的破坏
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在IIB型超引力中构造由NSNS与RR混合通量支撑的AdS3×S3×T4超弦的椭圆形变，并研究其可积性。NSNS部分包含Wess-Zumino项；要求理论保持8个超对称还需要一个耦合形变后AdS3与S3因子的B场。我们从两个角度探讨可积性：构造平坦Lax联络和计算树级世界面S矩阵。对一般椭圆参数和NSNS通量，我们发现非弹性2→2散射振幅，违反可积性所需的弹性。在Lax分析所确认的可积情形中，这些非弹性振幅消失，且树级S矩阵满足经典Yang-Baxter方程。特别地，添加Wess-Zumino项在有理与三角模型中保持可积性，但在椭圆形变中破坏可积性。
classification.one_liner: 构造混合通量支撑的AdS3×S3×T4弦椭圆形变，并用Lax联络与树级S矩阵表明Wess-Zumino项在椭圆情形破坏可积性。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于AdS/CFT中的AdS3弦可积性研究，与用户列出的凝聚态、超流超导、探针膜等专题无直接重合。

papers.title: Exact holographic superfluid at the Bogomolny point: transport, large charge, and R\'enyi entropies
papers.abstract: The Abelian Higgs model in AdS$_5$, in the probe limit, is a standard holographic model of a strongly coupled superfluid, usually solved numerically. When the scalar mass saturates the Breitenlohner-Freedman bound and the quartic coupling takes the Bogomolny value, its condensed phase can be found in closed form on every static, uncharged AdS$_5$ background with maximally symmetric spatial sections. We prove that it is linearly stable, as is any nodeless probe-limit condensate in the standard quantization with a nonnegative quartic coupling and no superflow. On each slicing it answers a different question about the dual conformal field theory. On the planar black brane it is the superfluid at all temperatures below $T_c$: the superfluid fraction follows the Gorter-Casimir two-fluid law exactly, and the speed and the attenuation of sound are found in closed form. In global AdS$_5$ it describes a state of charge $Q$ on $\mathbb{R}\times S^3$, arguably the lowest-energy one, and gives its scaling dimension in closed form at all $Q$, classically in the bulk. Its excitations include towers that the superfluid effective theory does not describe; they come from an infrared fixed point of the probe sector. The hyperbolic slicing gives in closed form a homogeneous hairy phase of the black holes that compute the charged R\'enyi entropies of a ball. Its condensate does not vanish at the entangling surface. When sourced by operators inserted there, the phase sets in at R\'enyi index exactly one at zero chemical potential, as found for a neutral scalar.

classification.primary_topic: 全息凝聚态/超流超导/强关联
classification.title_zh: Bogomolny 点上的精确全息超流：输运、大电荷与 Rényi 熵
classification.abstract_zh: 在探针极限下，AdS5 中的 Abelian Higgs 模型是强耦合超流的标准全息模型，通常需数值求解。当标量质量饱和 Breitenlohner-Freedman 界且四次耦合取 Bogomolny 值时，其凝聚相可在每个具有最大对称空间截面的静态、不带电 AdS5 背景上以闭式给出。我们证明它是线性稳定的，正如标准量子化、非负四次耦合且无超流时任何无节点探针极限凝聚一样。在不同切片上，它回答对偶共形场论的不同问题：在平面黑膜上，它是所有 T<Tc 下的超流，超流分数严格遵循 Gorter-Casimir 双流体定律，声速和声衰减以闭式给出；在整体 AdS5 中，它描述 R×S^3 上电荷 Q 的态（可说是最低能态），并在所有 Q 下以闭式给出其标度维度（体内部为经典）；其激发包括超流有效理论不描述的塔，来自探针扇区的红外不动点；双曲切片以闭式给出计算球带电 Rényi 熵的黑洞的均匀毛发相，其凝聚在纠缠面上不消失；当由插入该处的算符源驱动时，该相在零化学势下恰好于 Rényi 指数一出现，如同中性标量情形。
classification.one_liner: 该文给出 Bogomolny 点 AdS5 Abelian Higgs 模型的闭式全息超流解，并解析研究输运、大电荷谱与带电 Rényi 熵。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接匹配全息超流超导支线，涉及精确解、输运、大电荷与 Rényi 熵等核心问题。

papers.title: Competition and coexistence of baryonic condensates in AdS hardwall model
papers.abstract: Cold dense QCD admits several order parameters for baryon-number breaking, among them diquark and dibaryon condensates. We ask whether they exclude one another or coexist, using a five-dimensional AdS hardwall model with full backreaction in which two charged scalars, dual to operators of charges $q_i$ and dimensions $\Delta_i$, couple to a common $U(1)_B$ gauge field. With the diquark-like operator fixed at $q_1=2$, $\Delta_1=3$, both operators condense only within a narrow window of $\Delta_2$, which widens with $q_2$ and closes when the operators coincide. Outside the window, only a single condensate forms. The structure persists in both confined and deconfined phases. In the $\mu_B$-$T$ plane, confined matter with both condensates is preferred at low temperature, below a narrow band of deconfined matter with one condensate.

classification.title_zh: AdS硬壁模型中重子凝聚的竞争与共存
classification.abstract_zh: 冷致密QCD允许多个重子数破缺序参量，其中包括双夸克和双重子凝聚。我们使用五维AdS硬壁模型并包含完全背反作用，其中两个荷电标量（对偶于电荷q_i、维度Δ_i的算符）与共同的U(1)_B规范场耦合，来考察它们是否互相排斥还是共存。固定类双夸克算符为q_1=2、Δ_1=3时，两个算符只在Δ_2的窄窗口内同时凝聚；该窗口随q_2增大而变宽，并在两算符重合时关闭。窗口外只形成单一凝聚。该结构在禁闭与解禁闭相中都存在。在μ_B-T平面中，具有双凝聚的禁闭物质在低温下更受偏好，位于具有单凝聚的解禁闭物质的窄带之下。
classification.one_liner: 在带完全背反作用的AdS硬壁模型中，两个与共同U(1)_B耦合的荷电标量只在参数窗口内共存凝聚，并给出μ_B-T平面中的相结构。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究多分量重子凝聚的竞争与共存及相结构，与多分量序参量和相变支线相关；但它属于全息QCD硬壁模型，并非超流超导、经典引力或非线性演化支线。

papers.title: $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills Flux Tube in AdS
papers.abstract: We study a supersymmetric Wilson line on the boundary of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory in AdS$_4$, or equivalently on a half-space, as a model for exploring the connection between holographic strings and confining flux tubes. The boundary breaks four-dimensional conformal symmetry and is expected to remove integrability, bringing this system closer to a confining string while preserving enough supersymmetry to constrain its dynamics. Working in the planar limit, we analyze the defect spectrum at weak and strong coupling and compute the superconformal index, thereby relating the perturbative gauge-theory description to the worldsheet excitations of a long holographic string. These complementary perspectives allow us to propose a map between operators in the two regimes, under which the worldsheet axion, in particular, becomes a two-particle state at strong coupling. The resulting picture supports a smooth interpolation from an exponentially growing gauge-theory spectrum to the Cardy-like spectrum of a string worldsheet, providing a non-integrable supersymmetric model for investigating the spectral reorganization expected in confining gauge theories.

classification.title_zh: AdS 中的 N=4 超对称杨-米尔斯通量管
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究 AdS4 边界（或半空间）上 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中的超对称 Wilson 线，作为探讨全息弦与禁闭通量管之间联系的模型。边界破坏四维共形对称性并预计消除可积性，使系统更接近禁闭弦，同时保留足够超对称约束动力学。在平面极限下，我们分析弱耦合与强耦合下的缺陷谱并计算超共形指标，从而将微扰规范理论描述与长全息弦的世界面激发联系起来。这些互补视角使我们提出两区域算符之间的映射；特别地，世界面轴子在强耦合下成为两粒子态。所得图像支持从指数增长的规范理论谱到弦世界面的 Cardy 型谱的平滑插值，为研究禁闭规范理论中预期谱重组提供一个非可积超对称模型。
classification.one_liner: 用 AdS4 边界上的超对称 Wilson 线缺陷研究全息弦与禁闭通量管谱的对应与插值。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于 AdS/CFT 与全息弦/缺陷谱研究，但未涉及用户列出的超流超导、p波、QNM、经典引力等具体重点支线；对全息字典和禁闭弦谱有一般相关性。

papers.title: The Effective Kerr-Compton Tree Amplitude from Black Hole Perturbation Theory
papers.abstract: We develop a new method to construct the tree-level Compton amplitude for gravitational-wave scattering off a Kerr black hole in post-Minkowskian effective field theory. Building on previous computations that required physical consistency of the amplitude, the method uses wave scattering functions from black hole perturbation theory to uniquely determine additional contact terms. We illustrate the iterative procedure by deriving explicit expressions up to sixth order in spin, including previously unknown sectors at the fifth and sixth orders in spin. The amplitude features complex transcendental structures and a leading dissipative contact term at sixth order in spin. We verify our result against known results in the literature and reproduce the one-loop tail result from black hole perturbation theory.

classification.title_zh: 来自黑洞微扰理论的有效 Kerr-Compton 树级振幅
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新方法，用于在后 Minkowski 有效场论中构造引力波被 Kerr 黑洞散射的树级 Compton 振幅。该方法建立在先前需要振幅满足物理一致性的计算之上，利用黑洞微扰理论中的波散射函数来唯一确定额外的接触项。我们通过推导到自旋六阶的显式表达式来说明这一迭代过程，其中包括自旋五阶和六阶此前未知的部分。该振幅具有复杂的超越结构，并在自旋六阶出现一个领头耗散接触项。我们将结果与文献中已知结果进行核对，并从黑洞微扰理论重现了单圈尾项结果。
classification.one_liner: 利用黑洞微扰理论的波散射函数，逐步确定后 Minkowski EFT 中 Kerr 黑洞树级 Compton 振幅的接触项，并给出自旋六阶结果。

papers.title: On functional classes in higher-spin theory
papers.abstract: The factorization over the ideal in the $d$-dimensional Vasiliev theory requires an accurate description of the higher-spin algebra $\mathcal{A}$ and its twisted adjoint module $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ as certain functional spaces. It is shown that the conditions of $\mathcal{A}$ to be closed under action of the Moyal star product, and of $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ to be a star-product $\mathcal{A}$-module along with some auxiliary conditions lead to properly defined free-level factorization procedure. The conditions on admissible functions have simple algebraic form; in the case of $\mathcal{A}$ the analogous functional space has been considered by Soloviev \cite{Soloviev:2013iba}. The relation of the obtained functional classes to the locality problem in the Vasiliev theory is discussed. In particular it is observed that certain non-local expressions diverge due to properties of $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ while the spin-local expressions are well-defined.

classification.title_zh: 论高自旋理论中的函数类
classification.abstract_zh: d维Vasiliev理论中关于理想的因子化，需要把高自旋代数 A 及其扭曲伴随模 A^{tw} 准确描述为特定函数空间。文章表明，若 A 在 Moyal 星积作用下封闭，且 A^{tw} 是星积 A-模并满足若干辅助条件，则可得到良定义的自由层因子化程序。可容许函数所需条件具有简单代数形式；对 A 而言，Soloviev 曾考虑过类似的函数空间。文章还讨论了所得函数类与 Vasiliev 理论中局域性问题的关系，特别指出某些非局域表达式会因 A^{tw} 的性质而发散，而自旋局域表达式则良定义。
classification.one_liner: 该文用星积封闭性与模条件刻画Vasiliev高自旋理论中的函数空间，并讨论其与自由层因子化和局域性问题的关系。

papers.title: Large-$N$ limit of chiral quiver theories: free energy, supersymmetric indices and operator counting
papers.abstract: We find the first analytic solution to the large-$N$ saddle point equations for the $S^3$ free energy of a chiral $\mathcal N=2$ Chern-Simons-matter theory with an M-theory dual. Focusing on the chiral quiver dual to AdS$_4\times Q^{1,1,1}/\mathbb Z_{\rm k}$, we show how the long-range forces of the matrix model cancel at large $N$, resolving a long-standing tension with the expected $N^{3/2}$ scaling. The resulting free energy precisely matches the holographic prediction for all assignments of trial R-charges. Our results extend to the superconformal and topologically twisted indices on $S^2\times S^1$, whose large-$N$ and Cardy limit is determined by the same saddle. The solution agrees with the predictions of the operator counting method, giving strong evidence for this conjecture beyond non-chiral quivers. We support the analytic solution with a finite-$N$ numerical analysis for multiple assignments of R-charges, extending recent numerical results obtained for this quiver.

classification.title_zh: 手性箭图理论的大N极限：自由能、超对称指标与算符计数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们首次给出具有M理论对偶的手性N=2 Chern-Simons-物质理论在S^3自由能的大N鞍点方程的解析解。针对对偶于AdS4×Q^{1,1,1}/Z_k的手性箭图，我们展示矩阵模型的长程力在大N下相消，解决了与预期N^{3/2}标度之间长期存在的矛盾。所得自由能对所有试探R荷分配均与全息预言精确一致。结果可推广到S^2×S^1上的超共形指标和拓扑扭曲指标，其大N与Cardy极限由同一鞍点决定。该解与算符计数方法的预言一致，为非手性箭图之外的该猜想提供了有力证据。我们用有限N数值分析对多个R荷分配支持解析解，扩展了近期对该箭图的数值结果。
classification.one_liner: 首次解析求解 AdS4×Q^{1,1,1}/Z_k 手性箭图 Chern-Simons-物质理论的大N自由能鞍点，并验证全息标度与指标/算符计数预言。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 全息对偶与矩阵模型计算，验证自由能标度及指标/算符计数，但不直接涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁、QNM、探针膜等具体支线。

papers.title: Carrollian CFTs and the Light Front
papers.abstract: Carrollian symmetries play an important role in building holographic duals to asymptotically flat spacetimes (AFS). This construction hinges on the isomorphism between the (asymptotic) isometries of AFS and the conformal Carroll algebra. Carroll symmetries also naturally arise on the lightfront, as co-dimension one subalgebras in the Poincare algebra written in lightcone coordinates. In this paper, building on the isomorphism between four dimensional (4d) Poincare and 3d conformal Carroll algebras, we make a connection between physics on the lightfront and Carrollian CFTs. Using insights from the lightfront literature, we construct new representations of Carroll CFTs that connect to massive bulk scattering. We compute two-point functions and build a map between 3d Carroll CFTs and 4d lightfront theories living in AFS.

classification.title_zh: Carrollian CFT 与光前
classification.abstract_zh: Carrollian 对称性在构建渐近平直时空的全息对偶中起重要作用。该构造依赖于渐近平直时空的（渐近）等距与共形 Carroll 代数之间的同构。Carroll 对称性也自然出现在光前上，作为光锥坐标下 Poincaré 代数的余维一子代数。本文基于四维 Poincaré 与三维共形 Carroll 代数之间的同构，将光前物理与 Carrollian CFT 联系起来。利用光前文献的洞见，我们构造了与有质量体散射相关联的 Carroll CFT 新表示。我们计算两点函数，并建立三维 Carroll CFT 与生活在渐近平直时空中的四维光前理论之间的映射。
classification.one_liner: 基于 Poincaré 与共形 Carroll 代数同构，建立三维 Carroll CFT 与四维渐近平直时空光前理论及有质量体散射的对应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 Carrollian/平直时空光前全息的形式研究，虽与全息理论相关，但与用户重点列出的全息超流超导、探针膜、QNM、相变气泡成核、经典引力等具体支线无直接交集。

papers.title: Does SO(2,2) symmetry lead to an additional U(1) symmetry in 5-dimensional Einstein-scalar theories?
papers.abstract: Solving Einstein equations including the matter fields in dimensions higher than four is computationally challenging. However, the existence of symmetries facilitates these calculations. Among these symmetries, we can mention the SO(2,2) symmetry that arises in the near-horizon geometries of extremal black holes with vanishing horizon area in four dimensions \cite{EVH/CFT} and higher dimensions \cite{Sadeghian:2015}. Solutions of Einstein theories including scalar and Maxwell fields with SO(2,2) symmetry have been classified in four, five, and higher dimensions \cite{Sadeghian:2014}. For the Einstein-Maxwell-Lambda theory, a theorem states that SO(2,2) symmetry leads to an additional U(1) symmetry and therefore unique axisymmetric solutions. Nevertheless, in the presence of a scalar field, this symmetry group is not large enough in five dimensions to guarantee solution uniqueness, and the additional U(1) symmetry remains a conjecture in \cite{Sadeghian:2014}. Here, we study the Einstein equations of theories with a five-dimensional scalar field using the Lie symmetry method for solving partial differential equations. We challenge the conjecture in \cite{Sadeghian:2014} and find a solution that depends on both $\theta$ and $\psi$ coordinates as a counterexample to that conjecture.

classification.title_zh: SO(2,2) 对称性是否会在五维 Einstein-scalar 理论中导致额外的 U(1) 对称性？
classification.abstract_zh: 在高于四维时，求解包含物质场的 Einstein 方程在计算上具有挑战性，而对称性的存在可简化计算。SO(2,2) 对称性出现在四维零视界面积极端黑洞的近视界几何中，也出现在更高维情形。含标量场和 Maxwell 场的 Einstein 理论中具有 SO(2,2) 对称性的解已在四维、五维及更高维被分类。对于 Einstein-Maxwell-Lambda 理论，有定理指出 SO(2,2) 对称性会导致额外的 U(1) 对称性，从而给出唯一的轴对称解。然而，存在标量场时，该对称群在五维中不足以保证解的唯一性，额外 U(1) 对称性在此前工作中仍是猜想。本文用 Lie 对称方法研究含五维标量场理论的 Einstein 方程，挑战该猜想，并找到一个同时依赖 θ 和 ψ 坐标的解作为反例。
classification.one_liner: 用 Lie 对称方法研究五维 Einstein-scalar 方程，构造依赖 θ 和 ψ 的解，作为 SO(2,2) 导致额外 U(1) 猜想的反例。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文核心是五维 Einstein-scalar 方程的经典解与 SO(2,2)/U(1) 对称性，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；摘要虽提及极端黑洞近视界与 EVH/CFT 背景，但未展开全息应用。

papers.title: Ortho-symplectic interface line operators in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM theories
papers.abstract: We study the line operators at the half-BPS interfaces in 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills (SYM) theories of orthogonal and symplectic gauge groups. For the NS5-type interfaces, line operators are labeled by pairs of electric or magnetic charges under the gauge groups on either side of the interface, whereas for the D5-type interfaces they are labeled by electric or magnetic charges under the single gauge group preserved by the interface. We propose dualities between the Wilson lines and vortex lines at the interfaces under the action of S-duality. As highly non-trivial evidence of the dualities on the junctions of the line operators and the interfaces, we find matching of the line defect half-indices for the dual pairs.

classification.title_zh: 正交-辛规范群 N=4 SYM 理论中的界面线算子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了四维 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中正交和辛规范群的半 BPS 界面上的线算子。对于 NS5 型界面，线算子由界面两侧规范群下的电或磁荷对标记；而对于 D5 型界面，它们由界面保持的单一规范群下的电或磁荷标记。我们提出了在 S 对偶作用下界面上的威尔逊线与涡旋线之间的对偶。作为线算子与界面结点上对偶的高度非平凡证据，我们发现对偶对的线缺陷半指数相匹配。
classification.one_liner: 研究 N=4 SYM 中正交/辛规范群半 BPS 界面上的线算子及其 S 对偶，通过线缺陷半指数匹配给出非平凡证据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 N=4 SYM 的缺陷/线算子及 S 对偶，属于 AdS/CFT 字典中边界算子/缺陷的范畴，但不直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息凝聚态、经典引力或非平衡物理。

papers.title: Deformed Amplituhedra and Interpolating Anomalous Dimensions on the Coulomb Branch
papers.abstract: We study planar four-point scattering amplitudes on the Coulomb branch of $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory, focusing on multi-parameter families of massive kinematics. We extend the deformed Amplituhedron construction of \cite{Arkani-Hamed:2023epq,Flieger:2025ekn} to general external kinematics characterized by a six-parameter embedding-space Gram matrix. We show that copositivity constraints on the inverse Gram matrix control the real geometry and restrict the numerator of the two-loop canonical form to the span of the two planar double-box structures expected for the scattering amplitude. We then specialize to a three-parameter massive configuration and evaluate the relevant one- and two-loop integrals using differential equations directly in four dimensions, obtaining analytic expressions in terms of multiple polylogarithms. We investigate multiscale infrared limits of the proposed two-loop amplitude and find exponentiation through two loops. The kinematic family contains the limits governed by the cusp and octagon anomalous dimensions and interpolates between them through the walking anomalous dimension introduced in~\cite{Alday:2026cpk}. Our result reproduces the one-loop interpolation and fixes the two-loop coefficients in their proposed all-loop ansatz. Interestingly, our results suggest that the walking anomalous dimension may be entirely determined through all loop orders by the cusp and octagon anomalous dimensions.

classification.title_zh: 形变振幅体与库仑分支上的插值反常维数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论库仑分支上的平面四点散射振幅，关注多参数的大质量运动学族。我们将 Arkani-Hamed:2023epq、Flieger:2025ekn 的形变 Amplituhedron 构造推广到由六参数嵌入空间 Gram 矩阵描述的一般外运动学。我们证明，逆 Gram 矩阵上的余正性约束控制实几何，并将两圈正则形式的分子限制在散射振幅所预期的两个平面双箱结构的张成空间内。随后我们专门研究一个三参数大质量构型，并直接在四维中用微分方程计算相关的一圈和两圈积分，得到用多重多对数表示的解析表达式。我们研究所提出的两圈振幅的多尺度红外极限，并发现直到两圈的指数化。该运动学族包含由尖点（cusp）和八边形（octagon）反常维数支配的极限，并通过 Alday:2026cpk 引入的行走（walking）反常维数在二者之间插值。我们的结果复现一圈插值，并确定了其提出的全圈拟设中的两圈系数。有趣的是，我们的结果表明，行走反常维数可能完全由尖点和八边形反常维数在所有圈阶确定。
classification.one_liner: 推广 N=4 SYM 库仑分支上的形变 Amplituhedron，计算两圈振幅并研究 cusp、octagon 与 walking 反常维数之间的插值。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 N=4 SYM 的散射振幅与反常维数，属于 AdS/CFT 场论侧的振幅研究，但未涉及引力、全息字典或用户重点标签（全息超流超导、相变与气泡成核、QNM 与非线性演化、探针膜、冷原子等），与用户关注的具体全息凝聚态及经典引力问题关联很小。

papers.title: Gravitational Reconstruction in $AdS_{4}$
papers.abstract: We reconstruct linearized gravitational perturbations in $AdS_{4}$ from a conserved, traceless stress tensor on a fixed conformally flat boundary metric, extending our earlier real Lorentzian construction. For admissible data with no spacelike Fourier support in a flat conformal frame, the physical response reduces to an integral over boundary light-cone cuts. Boundary improvements restore Fefferman--Graham (FG) gauge while preserving normalizability and the linearized Weyl tensor. We then reconstruct perturbations with general spacelike boundary momentum, including nonzero frequency and its zero-frequency limit, using explicit position-space generalized functions on real stress data. Boundary kernels are constructed for normalizable perturbations and sufficient conditions are derived for the reconstruction to converge. The results motivate controlled flat-space limits relevant to Bondi--Metzner--Sachs symmetries and celestial holography.

classification.title_zh: AdS_4 中的引力重构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在固定共形平坦边界度规上，从守恒无迹应力张量重构 AdS4 中的线性化引力扰动，扩展了此前实洛伦兹构造。对于在平坦共形标架中没有类空傅里叶支撑的容许数据，物理响应化为边界光锥截割上的积分。边界改进可恢复 Fefferman–Graham (FG) 规范，同时保持可归一化性和线性化 Weyl 张量。随后，我们利用实应力数据上的显式位置空间广义函数，重构具有一般类空边界动量的扰动，包括非零频率及其零频率极限。我们为可归一化扰动构造边界核，并给出重构收敛的充分条件。结果有助于研究受控平直空间极限，这些极限与 Bondi–Metzner–Sachs 对称性和天球全息相关。
classification.one_liner: 从边界守恒无迹应力张量重构 AdS4 线性化引力扰动，并给出 FG 规范、边界核与收敛条件。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 字典与线性化引力重构，涉及经典引力/广义相对论标签；但与全息凝聚态、超流超导、QNM 等具体研究支线不直接重合。

papers.title: Holography and localization in fractional field theory
papers.abstract: Fractional field theory is a promising framework wherein to quantize the gravitational interaction but the presence of nonlocal operators can make its handling difficult. With the purpose of easing this problem, we recast the theory as a local dual in two ways. First, we generalize the Caffarelli--Silvestre extension theorem to self-adjoint fractional field theories with multi-scale kinetic terms and nonlocal interactions, taking the example of a scalar field. The latter is reinterpreted as a nonlocal boundary degree of freedom holographically dual to a local theory of two scalars living in a higher-dimensional bulk. However, inclusion of a local non-linear potential is not straightforward. We therefore propose an alternative picture where the nonlocal theory is not extended to a higher-dimensional space but is localized at the price of introducing a continuum of masses. This \emph{spectral localization} allows for a natural implementation of the fakeon prescription and the related classicization procedure, already employed in local theories with higher-derivative and complex ghosts. Applications to fractional quantum gravity and its comparison with quadratic quantum gravity are discussed.

classification.title_zh: 分数字段论中的全息与局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 分数字段论是量子化引力相互作用的一个有前景框架，但非局域算符的存在使其处理困难。为缓解该问题，我们以两种方式将理论重写为局域对偶。首先，我们将 Caffarelli--Silvestre 延拓定理推广到具有多尺度动能项和非局域相互作用的自伴分数字段论，以标量场为例。后者被重新解释为非局域边界自由度，全息对偶于高维体内两个标量场的局域理论。然而，加入局域非线性势并不直接。因此我们提出另一种图像：非局域理论不延拓到高维空间，而是以引入连续质量谱为代价实现局域化。这种谱局域化可自然实现 fakeon 规定及相关的经典化程序，这些程序已用于带高阶导数和复鬼的局域理论。文中讨论了分数量子引力及其与二次量子引力的比较。
classification.one_liner: 将非局域分数字段论通过 Caffarelli--Silvestre 延拓或谱局域化重写为局域对偶，并讨论分数量子引力与 fakeon/经典化。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于形式化全息/非局域场论与分数量子引力，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜或经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: The Non-Relativistic Limit of Five-Dimensional Boson Stars and Scale Invariance Violation
papers.abstract: We investigate the non-relativistic limit of spherically symmetric boson stars in (4+1)-dimensional general relativity (GR). In this limit, the resulting Newtonian theory exhibits an exact scale invariance, leading to a critical boson star configuration with a fixed global U(1) charge and vanishing binding energy. We identify the origin of these properties in the restored scale symmetry and analyze how relativistic and gravitational corrections break this symmetry. By comparing the full (4+1)-dimensional Einstein-Klein-Gordon system with the Wick-Cutkosky model, we quantify the effects of these corrections on the energy-charge relation and the kinematic stability of the configurations. Our results demonstrate how weak violation of scale invariance lifts the degeneracy of the non-relativistic solutions and determines the behavior of boson stars away from the critical limit.

classification.title_zh: 五维玻色星的非相对论极限与标度不变性破缺
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究(4+1)维广义相对论中球对称玻色星的非相对论极限。在该极限下，所得牛顿理论具有精确标度不变性，导致具有固定全局U(1)电荷和零结合能的临界玻色星构型。作者指出这些性质源于恢复的标度对称性，并分析相对论与引力修正如何破坏该对称性。通过比较完整的(4+1)维Einstein-Klein-Gordon系统与Wick-Cutkosky模型，量化这些修正对能量-电荷关系和构型运动学稳定性的影响。结果表明，标度不变性的弱破缺如何解除非相对论解的简并，并决定玻色星远离临界极限时的行为。
classification.one_liner: 研究五维玻色星非相对论极限中的精确标度不变性、临界构型及相对论/引力修正导致的标度对称性破缺。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的玻色星研究，涉及非相对论极限与标度不变性，与用户经典引力支线相关；但摘要未涉及全息对偶、AdS/CFT或用户列出的全息重点标签，因此相关性中等。

papers.title: Entropically favored scalar hair on AdS black branes
papers.abstract: We construct neutral AdS$_5$ black branes with source-free scalar hair that is entropically favored over the symmetric phase. A quadratic scalar--Gauss--Bonnet coupling destabilizes the thermal state while leaving the ultraviolet operator dimension fixed at $\Delta=3$. The fully backreacted solutions require only a quadratic scalar potential. We describe how a neural-network search led to this simple model.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: AdS 黑膜上熵占优的标量毛发
classification.abstract_zh: 本文构造了带无源标量毛发的中性 AdS5 黑膜，该毛发在熵上优于对称相。二次标量–Gauss–Bonnet 耦合使热态失稳，同时将紫外算符维度固定在 Δ=3。完全反作用解只需二次标量势。文中还说明了神经网络搜索如何导向这一简单模型。
classification.one_liner: 构造熵占优的 AdS5 黑膜标量毛发，并给出固定 Δ=3 的二次标量–Gauss–Bonnet 反作用模型。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及全息黑膜相变与经典引力反作用解，与相变/引力热力学和经典引力支线相关；但未涉及超流超导、p波、探针膜或QNM等具体重点方向。

papers.title: Covering Surfaces, Conical-Defect Continuation, and Multi-Entropy at Arbitrary Genus
papers.abstract: We derive normalized geometric factors for permutation-twist correlators at arbitrary genus. For three uniformly ramified branch values, hypergeometric uniformization shows that the real part of the continued conical-defect exponent equals the covering-space anomaly factor. Its imaginary part is an Euler-characteristic Weyl phase. We extend the normalization to additional branch values, derive higher replica-index corrections to the geometric multi-entropy, and state the extra condition required for a holographic limit. A reducible conformal/topological example demonstrates why large central charge alone does not fix the complete entanglement result.

classification.title_zh: 任意亏格下的覆盖曲面、锥形缺陷延拓与多熵
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在任意亏格下推导置换-twist关联子的归一化几何因子。对于三个均匀分支值，超几何单值化表明延拓锥形缺陷指数的实部等于覆盖空间反常因子；其虚部为欧拉示性数Weyl相位。我们将归一化推广到额外分支值，推导几何多熵的高阶复制指标修正，并陈述全息极限所需的额外条件。一个可约共形/拓扑例子说明仅大中心荷并不能固定完整纠缠结果。
classification.one_liner: 推导任意亏格下置换-twist关联子的归一化与锥形缺陷延拓，给出多熵的高阶复制修正及全息极限条件。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文讨论多熵、覆盖曲面与全息极限，属于全息纠缠/量子信息方向；但不直接对应列出的全息超导、探针膜、QNM等具体重点支线。

papers.title: Near-horizon BF bounds for the $t^+$ KK tower on extremal AdS$_5$ black holes
papers.abstract: We study the charged Breitenlohner--Freedman (BF) bound for all horizon harmonics of the type IIB $t^+$ Kaluza--Klein tower on extremal charged AdS$_5$ black holes with equal rotations. The scalar equation follows from maximal five-dimensional gauged supergravity at level zero and the linearized exceptional-field-theory equations at higher levels. For aligned charge and rotation, a quadratic form in charge and spin changes signature on the curve of supersymmetric (BPS) black holes, where every mode satisfies the bound. Above the curve, where $\Omega_H>1$, every black hole has a violating mode, although no finite truncation in level or spin detects violation at every such black hole. Below the curve, where $\Phi_H>1$, the BF-passing set is confined to a thin strip and controlled by charge and spin discreteness. At large radius and fixed rotation, a level-four mode with spin proportional to the radius violates the bound even where all U(2) singlets satisfy it. These results concern the near-horizon BF bound of one tower in two-derivative supergravity; full radial stability remains open.

classification.title_zh: 极值 AdS5 黑洞上 t^+ Kaluza-Klein 塔的近视界 BF 界
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有相等转动的带电极值 AdS5 黑洞上，IIB 型 t^+ Kaluza-Klein 塔所有视界谐波的带电 Breitenlohner-Freedman (BF) 界。标量方程在零级来自五维最大规范超引力，在更高级来自线性化例外场论方程。对于电荷与转动对齐的情形，电荷和自旋的二次型在超对称 (BPS) 黑洞曲线上改变符号，此时每个模式都满足该界。在曲线上方，即 Ω_H>1 时，每个黑洞都有一个违反该界的模式，尽管任何有限层级或自旋截断都不能在每个这样的黑洞处检测到违反。在曲线下方，即 Φ_H>1 时，通过 BF 界的集合被限制在一条薄带内，并受电荷和自旋离散性控制。在大半径和固定转动下，自旋与半径成正比的第四级模式违反该界，即使所有 U(2) 单态都满足它。这些结果涉及两导数超引力中一个塔的近视界 BF 界；完整的径向稳定性仍待解决。
classification.one_liner: 研究极值 AdS5 黑洞上 t^+ KK 塔所有视界谐波的近视界 BF 界，并刻画 BPS 曲线两侧及大半径下的违反模式结构。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于 AdS5 黑洞与超引力 KK 塔的线性稳定性/BF 界研究，与全息和经典引力相邻；但未直接涉及所列全息凝聚态、超流超导、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace 或 QNM 等具体支线。

papers.title: Go with the flow(s): radial de Sitter holography and $T^2 (+ \Lambda_2)$
papers.abstract: What can we learn about a putative dual to de Sitter spacetime from the bulk? Conversely, what can a candidate dual theory teach us about the bulk? In this work, we construct midisuperspace Wheeler-DeWitt states that are localised on the Schwarzschild-de Sitter spacetime. Using these states, we construct a slice-independent worldtube holographic framework in the static patch. We then construct a dictionary between this worldtube proposal and both the $T^2$ and $T^2 + \Lambda_2$ frameworks for cut-off holography. In doing so, we provide a bulk realisation of $T^2+ \Lambda_2$ for dS$_4$ black holes. We identify the average Hamiltonian of our worldtube proposal as the seed energy of the $T^2 (+ \Lambda_2)$ theories. To recover the $T^2 (+ \Lambda_2)$ energy spectrum as the average Hamiltonian of a worldtube theory, one must make the bulk framework slice-dependent, and we discuss the consequences of this trade-off.

classification.title_zh: 随流而行：径向 de Sitter 全息与 T^2 (+ Λ2)
classification.abstract_zh: 我们能从体时空中学到什么关于 de Sitter 时空的推测对偶？反过来，一个候选对偶理论能教给我们关于体时空的什么？在这项工作中，我们构造了局域在 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 时空上的 midisuperspace Wheeler-DeWitt 态。利用这些态，我们在静态 patch 中构造了一个切片无关的 worldtube 全息框架。然后我们构造了该 worldtube 提议与用于截断全息的 T^2 和 T^2+Λ2 框架之间的字典。借此，我们为 dS4 黑洞提供了 T^2+Λ2 的体实现。我们将 worldtube 提议的平均哈密顿量认定为 T^2(+Λ2) 理论的种子能量。为了将 T^2(+Λ2) 能谱恢复为某个 worldtube 理论的平均哈密顿量，必须使体框架变为切片依赖的，并且我们讨论了这种取舍的后果。
classification.one_liner: 构造基于 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 的 worldtube 全息框架，并建立其与 T^2(+Λ2) 截断全息及 dS4 黑洞的字典。

papers.title: Creation of the Universe in Lorentzian Classical Gravity
papers.abstract: The singularity theorems and the past incompleteness of inflationary spacetimes suggest that the beginning of the Universe lies beyond the domain of semiclassical gravity. We show that the creation of the Universe can nevertheless be understood within Lorentzian gravity by allowing gravitational junctions, so that the full spacetime need not be a smooth manifold. We construct rotationally invariant cosmic creation gates joining any finite number $n\geq2$ of locally de Sitter regions in $D\geq3$ spacetime dimensions at a timelike perfect-fluid junction with $P=w\rho$. For $w>-(D-3)/(D-2)$, they are geodesically complete in both temporal directions. The total spatial volume approaches finite, positive limits in the infinite past and future on the global-time foliation adapted to the junction fluid. We also construct exact deformed cosmic creation gates through nonlinear homogeneous backreaction that retain the initial volume while the future volume grows without bound. In these solutions, the junction fluid always expands, cooling for $w>0$ and heating for allowed $w<0$. Keeping the bulk regions locally de Sitter, we determine the linearized perturbations: in three dimensions, the generic inhomogeneous sector contains one hybrid sound mode and $n-1$ relative transverse modes; in four and higher dimensions, only the homogeneous hybrid sound mode survives. A finite-volume beginning requires fine-tuned homogeneous and inhomogeneous initial data, while causal response generically leads to unbounded future spatial volume. We also discuss a broader creation criterion allowing bounded past-volume oscillations. The gravitational equations determine conditioned admissible histories. We discuss implications for cosmology.

classification.title_zh: 洛伦兹经典引力中的宇宙创生
classification.abstract_zh: 奇点定理和暴胀时空的过去不完备性表明，宇宙的开端超出半经典引力的适用范围。我们表明，通过允许引力结（gravitational junctions），使整个时空不必是光滑流形，宇宙创生仍可在洛伦兹引力中理解。我们构造旋转不变的宇宙创生门，在D≥3维时空中以P=wρ的类时完美流体结连接任意有限n≥2个局部de Sitter区域。对于w>-(D-3)/(D-2)，它们在两个时间方向测地完备。在适配结流体的全局时间叶层上，总空间体积在无限过去和未来趋于有限正极限。我们还通过非线性均匀反作用构造精确的变形宇宙创生门，保持初始体积而未来体积无界增长。在这些解中，结流体总是膨胀，w>0时冷却，允许的w<0时加热。保持体区域局部de Sitter，我们确定线性化扰动：三维中一般非均匀扇区包含一个混合声模和n-1个相对横向模；四维及以上仅均匀混合声模存活。有限体积开端需要微调均匀和非均匀初始数据，而因果响应一般导致未来空间体积无界。我们还讨论更广泛的创生判据，允许有界过去体积振荡。引力方程决定条件可允许历史。我们讨论对宇宙学的含义。
classification.one_liner: 该文在洛伦兹经典引力中利用引力结连接多个局部de Sitter区域，构造宇宙创生门并分析其测地完备性、体积演化和线性扰动。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论与宇宙学，涉及de Sitter区域、引力结和扰动；不涉及全息或AdS/CFT，但与用户关注的经典引力支线相关。

papers.title: Holographic spectral functions of exotic spin-1 mesons
papers.abstract: We develop a general holographic framework for computing thermal spectral functions of exotic spin-1 mesons. A bulk Proca mass encodes the canonical ultraviolet dimension of the interpolating operator, allowing channels with different ultraviolet scaling to be treated within a unified membrane-flow formalism in the zero-spatial-momentum limit. We test this framework in a soft-wall model with a gluon-condensate background for the hybrid $\pi_1$ and tetraquark-like $Z_c$ channels. The results show that dissociation temperatures of both channels lie below the phase transition temperatures. Increasing the gluon-condensate parameter $c$ delays dissociation in both channels, but through different effects: both the vacuum-mass shift and thermal spectral deformation contribute in the $\pi_1$ channel, whereas the latter dominates in the $Z_c$ channel. Nevertheless, for the same environment, the $Z_c$ resonance dissociates at a lower temperature than the $\pi_1$ resonance.

classification.title_zh: 奇异自旋-1介子的全息谱函数
classification.abstract_zh: 本文建立一个计算奇异自旋-1介子热谱函数的一般全息框架。通过在体引入Proca质量编码插值算符的紫外维度，在零空间动量极限下用统一的膜流形式处理不同紫外标度通道。作者在带胶子凝聚背景的软墙模型中检验该框架，研究hybrid π1和类四夸克Zc通道。结果表明两通道的解离温度均低于相变温度；增大胶子凝聚参数c会推迟两通道的解离，但机制不同：π1通道中真空质量移动和热谱形变都有贡献，而Zc通道中后者主导；同一环境下Zc共振比π1共振在更低温度解离。
classification.one_liner: 建立软墙全息框架计算奇异自旋-1介子热谱函数，并比较π1与Zc通道的解离行为。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息QCD中的介子热谱函数研究，与用户重点标签所列的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM非线性演化、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜及经典引力等方向不直接对应。

papers.title: Gravitational form factors of the pion in light-front holographic QCD
papers.abstract: Understanding the internal structure of the pion-particularly the energy-momentum distributions of quarks and gluons and the internal mechanical properties encoded in its gravitational form factors-is a fundamental challenge in quantum chromodynamics (QCD). In this work, we study the gravitational form factors using light-front QCD (LFQCD), combined with the holographic QCD. Our main innovation is the introduction of an effective light-front wave function, with its five-dimensional component obtained from holographic QCD, which is then employed, within the light-front QCD framework, to calculate the pion's gravitational form factors $A(Q^2)$ and $D(Q^2)$ as well as its radius. Our computed pion gravitational form factors show agreement with lattice QCD results, providing nontrivial support for the viability of our phenomenological model.

classification.title_zh: 光前全息QCD中π介子的引力形状因子
classification.abstract_zh: 理解π介子的内部结构，尤其是夸克和胶子的能量-动量分布以及由其引力形状因子编码的内部力学性质，是量子色动力学（QCD）中的基本挑战。本文利用光前QCD并结合全息QCD研究引力形状因子。我们的主要创新是引入一个有效光前波函数，其五维分量由全息QCD给出，然后在光前QCD框架中用于计算π介子的引力形状因子 A(Q^2)、D(Q^2) 及其半径。计算得到的π介子引力形状因子与格点QCD结果一致，这为我们的现象学模型的可行性提供了非平凡支持。
classification.one_liner: 用全息QCD给出的五维分量构造有效光前波函数，计算π介子引力形状因子并与格点QCD比较。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题为全息QCD框架下π介子引力形状因子的现象学计算，不属于用户列出的重点支线（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/凝聚态实验启发、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力等）。

papers.title: Insight on confinement from the QCD effective charge
papers.abstract: Like the Gell-Mann--Low coupling $\alpha$ of QED, the effective charge $\alpha_{g_1}$ is a physical, observable-defined running coupling that can serve as the QCD coupling $\alpha_s$. It can be represented by an analytic form consistent with renormalization-group evolution, holographic light-front QCD (HLFQCD), and the world data on $\alpha_s$. As an observable, $\alpha_{g_1}$ has a physically relevant analytic structure that reflects the underlying partonic dynamics. It displays, in the long-distance regime, two imaginary conjugate singularities at $Q^2 = \pm i\Lambda_s^2$, with $\Lambda_s$ the QCD scale. To connect this structure to confinement, we combine known general relations between $\alpha_{g_1}$ and the parton dressed propagators and vertices with a recent phenomenological representation of $\alpha_{g_1}$ within HLFQCD. Since, unlike vertices, propagators characterize a field variation between separate locations, the two singularities are assigned to the propagators. This results in the parton propagators displaying a long-distance behavior $e^{-\Lambda_s |x|/\sqrt{2}} |x|^{-5/2 + d_a}$ where propagation is suppressed beyond distances of order $1/\Lambda_s$, as expected from confinement. This offers an intuitive interpretation of confinement as the suppression of QCD Green's functions at long distance.

classification.title_zh: 从QCD有效荷洞察禁闭
classification.abstract_zh: 类似QED的Gell-Mann–Low耦合α，有效荷α_{g1}是一个物理的、由可观测量定义的跑动耦合，可作为QCD耦合α_s。它可由与重整化群演化、全息光前QCD（HLFQCD）以及α_s世界数据一致的解析形式表示。作为可观测量，α_{g1}具有反映底层部分子动力学的物理相关解析结构。在长距离区域，它在Q^2=±iΛ_s^2处显示两个共轭虚奇点，其中Λ_s为QCD标度。为将该结构与禁闭联系起来，作者将α_{g1}与部分子修饰传播子和顶点之间的已知一般关系，与HLFQCD中α_{g1}的近期唯象表示相结合。由于传播子而非顶点描述分离位置间的场变化，两个奇点被归于传播子。这导致部分子传播子在长距离呈现 e^{-Λ_s |x|/√2}|x|^{-5/2+d_a} 行为，传播在1/Λ_s量级之外被抑制，符合禁闭预期。这为禁闭提供了直观解释：QCD格林函数在长距离被压低。
classification.one_liner: 利用HLFQCD中QCD有效荷的解析结构，将长距离虚奇点归于部分子传播子，从而直观解释禁闭为格林函数长程压低。
