papers.title: Influence of $\Delta$ resonances in hyperonic neutron stars on gravitational-wave inspiral signatures
papers.abstract: The composition of dense matter in neutron star interiors remains uncertain, with the possible appearance of the non-strange $\Delta$ resonances providing an important source of theoretical uncertainty. In this work, we investigate the gravitational wave signatures of hyperonic neutron stars containing $\Delta$ baryons within a density-dependent relativistic mean-field framework based on the DDME2 parametrization. Within this framework, the baryons interact among themselves via mesons. For $\Delta$ baryons, the interaction is uncertain to date. We investigate how variations of the scalar and vector $\Delta-$meson couplings, subject to \(x_{\sigma\Delta}-x_{\omega\Delta}=0.2\), modify the tidal properties and inspiral gravitational-wave signals. We find that the allowed variation in the $\Delta-\sigma$ coupling leads to substantial changes in the tidal properties of the neutron stars, which in turn leave distinct imprints on the gravitational-wave waveforms, particularly in their frequency evolution, accumulated phase, and strain amplitude. These waveform differences arise through changes in tidal deformability and are not unique signatures of $\Delta$ resonances. Future gravitational-wave observations may therefore constrain the $\Delta-$meson couplings within the adopted dense-matter framework, subject to degeneracies with alternative EOS models.

classification.title_zh: Δ共振态对超子中子星引力波旋进信号的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星内部致密物质的组成仍不确定，非奇异Δ共振态的可能出现是重要的理论不确定性来源。本文在基于DDME2参数化的密度依赖相对论平均场框架内，研究中子星含有Δ重子时超子中子星的引力波特征。在该框架中，重子之间通过介子相互作用。对于Δ重子，其相互作用至今仍不确定。我们在满足x_{σΔ}-x_{ωΔ}=0.2的条件下，研究标量和矢量Δ-介子耦合的变化如何改变潮汐性质和旋进引力波信号。我们发现，Δ-σ耦合的允许变化会导致中子星潮汐性质发生显著改变，进而对引力波波形留下明显印记，尤其是在频率演化、累积相位和应变振幅方面。这些波形差异通过潮汐形变的变化产生，并不是Δ共振态的独有特征。因此，未来引力波观测或可在所采用的致密物质框架内限制Δ-介子耦合，但仍会与替代状态方程模型存在简并。
classification.one_liner: 在相对论平均场框架下研究含Δ重子的超子中子星潮汐形变及其对旋进引力波波形的影响。

papers.title: Two-peak gravitational wave spectra from supercooled two-field phase transitions
papers.abstract: We study the gravitational wave (GW) spectrum generated by supercooled first-order phase transitions in two-field conformal models. We construct three representative toy models that capture the essential features of these models, derive analytical criteria for the existence of two-step transitions, and show how the two-field dynamics generate a genuine two-peak GW spectrum. We identify regions of parameter space in which two-peak GW spectra are observable at LISA and the Einstein Telescope. By way of illustration, we apply our analysis to a realistic conformal dark SU(3) model.

classification.title_zh: 超冷双场相变产生的双峰引力波谱
classification.abstract_zh: 研究了双场共形模型中超冷一级相变产生的引力波谱。构造三个代表性玩具模型以刻画这类模型的关键特征，给出两步相变存在的解析判据，并展示双场动力学如何产生真正的双峰引力波谱。识别了可在 LISA 和爱因斯坦望远镜观测到双峰引力波谱的参数空间区域，并作为一个示例将分析应用于一个现实的共形暗 SU(3) 模型。
classification.one_liner: 双场共形模型的超冷一级相变可通过两步过渡产生可在 LISA/ET 观测的双峰引力波谱。

papers.title: Planckian dissipation per unit critical entropy as a coupling-free probe of the strange-metal bath
papers.abstract: Strange metals pair a resistivity linear in temperature with a specific heat $C/T$ rising logarithmically on cooling. We find that, if electrons scatter off a local critical bath, the coupling cancels in the ratio $Q$ of their coefficients, leaving two measurable numbers: how slowly the bath relaxes, seen in photoemission or optics, and the share of critical entropy that relaxes current. Baths form classes: $Q\le4.91$ for a conformal bath, as SYK models confirm; 9--15 for the Yukawa--SYK field; and far less for Kondo lattices. LSCO, at $Q\approx9$, exceeds the conformal bound, pointing to the Yukawa--SYK field.

classification.title_zh: 以单位临界熵的普朗克耗散作为奇异金属浴的无耦合探针
classification.abstract_zh: 奇异金属将电阻率随温度线性变化与比热 C/T 在冷却时对数上升结合在一起。我们发现，如果电子受到局域临界浴的散射，耦合会在其系数的比值 Q 中抵消，留下两个可测量数：浴弛豫有多慢（见光电子能谱或光学测量），以及临界熵中参与弛豫电流的份额。浴形成若干类别：共形浴的 Q≤4.91，正如 SYK 模型所确认；Yukawa-SYK 场为 9--15；Kondo 晶格则小得多。LSCO 在 Q≈9 处超过共形界限，指向 Yukawa-SYK 场。
classification.one_liner: 提出奇异金属临界浴的无耦合比值 Q，并用共形/SYK、Yukawa-SYK 与 Kondo 晶格分类解释 LSCO 的 Q≈9。

papers.title: Exceptional points and hysteresis in Kerr-Newman quasi-normal modes
papers.abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) and eigenstate hysteresis, previously found in Kerr only with an auxiliary scalar field, arise intrinsically in the quasinormal-mode spectrum of Kerr-Newman black holes. Using a hyperboloidal formulation of the coupled gravito-electromagnetic Teukolsky equations and a Chebyshev pseudospectral method, we compute the $\ell=m=2$ spectrum and locate four EPs at up to $99.974\%$ of extremality, one from a new repulsion. The gaps close as a square root branch point, and quasistatic loops around one or more EPs exchange the coalescing modes, confirming hysteresis.
authors: Mario Misas Arcos (Departamento de Electr\'onica y Electromagnetismo)
Alberto T. P\'erez (Departamento de Electr\'onica y Electromagnetismo)
Carlos F. Sopuerta (Institute of Space Sciences
Institute of Space Studies of Catalonia)

classification.title_zh: Kerr-Newman 准正规模中的例外点与滞回
classification.abstract_zh: 例外点（EPs）和本征态滞回此前仅在带辅助标量场的 Kerr 黑洞中发现；本文表明它们内在地出现在 Kerr-Newman 黑洞的准正规模谱中。利用耦合引力-电磁 Teukolsky 方程的双曲形式化和 Chebyshev 伪谱方法，我们计算了 ℓ=m=2 谱，并在高达 99.974% 极端性处定位了四个 EP，其中一个来自新的排斥。间隙以平方根分支点闭合，绕一个或多个 EP 的准静态回路交换合并的模式，确认了滞回。
classification.one_liner: Kerr-Newman 黑洞准正规模谱中内在地出现例外点与本征态滞回，并由耦合 Teukolsky 方程谱计算加以确认。

papers.title: A Bound on the Dynamical Love Number
papers.abstract: The tidal deformability of a compact object is encoded in a single function of frequency, the retarded Green's function relating the induced multipole to the applied tide. Causality, reality, passivity, and the high-frequency conditions required for a positive-measure dispersion representation allow this response to be rescaled into a holomorphic self-map of the upper complex frequency half-plane. Using the Schwarz-Pick theorem, already employed to derive the quantum chaos bound in black hole physics, we provide a bound on the rate of the tidal response with respect to the frequency. For a neutron star with a positive tidal spectral threshold, the dynamical Love number is bounded in terms of the static response and the lowest frequency carrying nonzero tidal spectral weight, with the ideal single-mode model saturating the bound. For a black hole, whose tidal spectrum is gapless, the dynamical Love number is a finite-part moment of the horizon absorption spectrum. Under a growth hypothesis on the complete response the theorem constrains the full Euclidean response, but it does not bound the dynamical Love number.

classification.title_zh: 动力学 Love 数的界
classification.abstract_zh: 致密天体的潮汐可变形性由单一频率函数——联系诱导多极矩与外加强潮的推迟格林函数——编码。因果性、实性、被动性以及正测度色散表示所需的高频条件，使该响应可重标度为上半复频率平面的全纯自映射。利用曾用于黑洞物理量子混沌界的 Schwarz-Pick 定理，我们给出潮汐响应对频率变化率的界。对于具有正潮汐谱阈值的中子星，动力学 Love 数由静态响应和携带非零潮汐谱权重的最低频率界定，理想单模模型饱和该界。对潮汐谱无隙的黑洞，动力学 Love 数是视界吸收谱的有限部分矩。在完整响应的增长假设下，该定理约束完整欧几里得响应，但不界定动力学 Love 数。
classification.one_liner: 利用因果性与 Schwarz-Pick 定理给出致密天体动力学 Love 数随频率变化的界，并区分中子星与黑洞的潮汐谱情形。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究致密天体潮汐响应与动力学 Love 数的经典引力/广义相对论现象，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息字典；与经典引力支线直接相关，但与全息研究主线关联有限。

papers.title: Ringdown and echoes from compact objects: Debye series and Debye quasinormal modes
papers.abstract: We introduce a new series decomposition of the waveform constructed in the spirit of Debye expansions in scattering theory, and we use this to analyse the time-domain response of compact, horizonless bodies to scalar-field perturbations on curved spacetimes. The Debye decomposition separates out direct exterior propagation, surface reflection, and successive transmissions through the interior of a compact body, and it provides an intuitive interpretation of the waveform in terms of geodesic trajectories. By analysing the quasinormal-mode (QNM) content of individual Debye terms, we set out a Debye-QNM description that is complementary to the standard QNM description. With this framework, we examine a scalar field propagating on two illustrative `Schwarzschild star' compact-body spacetimes: a neutron-star-like model $R>3M$ and an ultracompact object $R<3M$. We show that the closed-form Debye reconstruction matches well with the exact waveform, and that it converges even at early times, giving an accurate description of all waveform features including the prompt response. In the neutron-star case, the low-order Debye terms mainly describe the ringdown and a non-modal component associated with the sub-threshold branch cut. In the ultracompact case, the Debye series organizes the waveform into a prompt/ringdown contribution followed by a succession of echo-like wavepackets. The new Debye-QNM expansion and the standard QNM expansion have complementary spectral interpretations: the former identifies modes in individual propagation channels, whereas the latter describes collective resonances that are resummations of the former. This distinction clarifies how echo-like structures emerge from repeated interior propagation, and how pole and branch-cut contributions enter the time-domain signal.

classification.title_zh: 紧致天体的环衰减与回声：Debye 级数与 Debye 准正模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文引入一种按散射理论中 Debye 展开精神构造的波形新级数分解，并用它分析弯曲时空中紧致、无视界天体对标量场扰动的时域响应。该 Debye 分解分离出外部直接传播、表面反射以及穿过紧致天体内部的连续透射，并以测地线轨迹给出波形的直观解释。通过分析各 Debye 项的准正模（QNM）内容，作者提出与标准 QNM 描述互补的 Debye-QNM 描述。利用该框架，作者研究标量场在两个示例性“Schwarzschild 星”紧致天体时空中的传播：类中子星模型 R>3M 与超紧致天体 R<3M。结果表明，闭式 Debye 重构与精确波形吻合良好，且即使在早期也能收敛，可准确描述包括瞬发响应在内的所有波形特征。在中子星情形，低阶 Debye 项主要描述环衰减以及与亚阈值支割线相关的非模成分；在超紧致情形，Debye 级数将波形组织为瞬发/环衰减贡献及随后一系列类回声波包。新的 Debye-QNM 展开与标准 QNM 展开具有互补的谱解释：前者识别单个传播通道中的模，后者描述作为前者重求和的集体共振。这一区别阐明了类回声结构如何由反复内部传播产生，以及极点与支割线贡献如何进入时域信号。
classification.one_liner: 提出 Debye 级数/Debye-QNM 框架，用传播通道分解紧致天体标量扰动波形并解释环衰减与回声。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及 QNM、环衰减与回声以及经典引力时空扰动，与重点标签中的“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”相关；但不涉及全息、超流超导或多分量序参量等方向。

papers.title: A geometric--analytic proof of the reverse isoperimetric inequality in Einstein gravity
papers.abstract: We develop a geometric--analytic proof of the reverse isoperimetric inequality for compact AdS black hole horizons in Einstein gravity. At fixed thermodynamic volume, a York slice/Jacobi variation of the gravitational action shows that the spherical Schwarzschild--AdS solution is a strict local entropy maximum against generic non-spherical deformations. The finite global extension is formulated within the hypotheses of the Sherif--Dunsby (SD) rigidity theorem: compactness and spherical topology, the required intrinsic Ricci decomposition $\mathrm{Ric}_h=\alpha\,\mathbf e\!\otimes\!\mathbf e+\beta N$ with $\alpha\neq\beta$, a proper conformal transformation of the hypersurface metric given by $\widetilde h_{ab}=e^{2\varphi}h_{ab}$ that preserves its intrinsic scalar curvature, $\widetilde R\equiv R[\widetilde h]=R[h]\equiv R>0$, and negative sheet expansion. Compactness and $S^3$ topology are built into the class considered here. In the static spherical sector such as Schwarzschild--AdS and RN--AdS, the SD Ricci form is naturally realized while it is an additional restriction for Kerr--AdS case. For the $S^3$ topology, a positive Yamabe type conformal class exists for which the Yamabe theorem provides a representative of positive and constant scalar-curvature. We further restrict to the scalar-curvature preserving conformal transformation required by the SD theorem. The negative sheet expansion is obtained using gravitational focusing. Within this admissible class, a non-round Kerr--AdS horizon cannot maximize the entropy, while fixed thermodynamic volume selects the corresponding round Schwarzschild--AdS comparator. The analysis thus establishes a generic local entropy maximum and a finite global result within the stated geometric rigidity class, identifying the role of gravity in reversing the ordinary isoperimetric problem.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: Einstein引力中反向等周不等式的几何-分析证明
classification.abstract_zh: 我们针对Einstein引力中紧致AdS黑洞视界，发展反向等周不等式的几何-分析证明。在固定热力学体积下，对引力作用量作York切片/雅可比变分表明，球形Schwarzschild–AdS解在一般非球形形变下是严格的局域熵最大。全局有限扩展在Sherif–Dunsby（SD）刚性定理假设内表述：紧致性与球面拓扑、所需的内禀Ricci分解 Ric_h=α e⊗e+βN 且 α≠β、由 \tilde h_{ab}=e^{2φ}h_{ab} 给出的保持内禀标量曲率的超曲面度规的恰当共形变换 \tilde R≡R[\tilde h]=R[h]≡R>0，以及负的叶层膨胀。紧致性和 S^3 拓扑已内置于所考虑的类中。在静态球对称扇区如Schwarzschild–AdS和RN–AdS中，SD Ricci形式自然实现，而对Kerr–AdS情形则是附加限制。对于 S^3 拓扑，存在正的Yamabe型共形类，Yamabe定理为其提供具有正且常标量曲率的代表。我们进一步限制到SD定理所需的保标量曲率共形变换。负叶层膨胀由引力聚焦得到。在此容许类中，非圆的Kerr–AdS视界不能使熵最大化，而固定热力学体积选择相应的圆Schwarzschild–AdS比较对象。该分析因此建立了在所声明的几何刚性类中的一般局域熵最大和有限全局结果，并识别出引力在反转通常等周问题中的作用。
classification.one_liner: 在Einstein引力中，对紧致AdS黑洞视界给出反向等周不等式的几何-分析证明：固定热力学体积下，球形Schwarzschild–AdS在给定刚性类中是熵最大者。

papers.title: Classical and Semiclassical Stability of Emergent Universes in Jordan-Brans-Dicke Theory
papers.abstract: The Emergent Universe scenario is based on the assumption that the universe originates from a past-eternal Einstein static (ES) state, subsequently evolving toward an inflationary phase and a hot Big Bang era. Such models are appealing as they provide nonsingular and geodesically complete cosmological histories. However, it has been argued by Mithani and Vilenkin that, even when the ES state is classically stable, certain models can admit semiclassical tunneling channels leading to quantum decay toward configurations of vanishing scale factor. In this work, we investigate the classical and semiclassical stability of the ES regime in the context of Jordan-Brans-Dicke (JBD) theory. We analyze the structure of the Wheeler-DeWitt potential in minisuperspace and study representative semiclassical tunneling channels compatible with the Hamiltonian constraint. We show that, for suitable choices of the JBD potential and model parameters, the ES configuration can be robust against both classical perturbations and the specific semiclassical tunneling channels analyzed in this work. Our results indicate that the quantum instability discussed by Mithani and Vilenkin may be avoided within certain regions of parameter space, while leaving open the possibility of more general tunneling processes beyond the scope of the present analysis.

classification.title_zh: Jordan-Brans-Dicke 理论中涌现宇宙的经典与半经典稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 涌现宇宙方案基于宇宙起源于过去永恒的 Einstein 静态（ES）态、随后演化至暴胀相和热大爆炸时期的假设。此类模型因给出非奇异且测地完备的宇宙历史而具有吸引力。然而，Mithani 和 Vilenkin 曾论证，即使 ES 态经典稳定，某些模型仍可存在半经典隧穿通道，导致向标度因子消失的构型发生量子衰变。本文在 Jordan-Brans-Dicke（JBD）理论背景下研究 ES 区域的经典与半经典稳定性。我们分析 minisuperspace 中 Wheeler-DeWitt 势的结构，并研究与 Hamiltonian 约束相容的代表性半经典隧穿通道。我们表明，对于 JBD 势和模型参数的适当选择，ES 构型可同时抵抗经典微扰和本文分析的特有半经典隧穿通道。结果表明，Mithani 和 Vilenkin 讨论的量子不稳定性可在参数空间的某些区域内被避免，同时保留超出本文分析范围的更一般隧穿过程的可能性。
classification.one_liner: 在 Jordan-Brans-Dicke 理论中，适当参数下涌现宇宙的 Einstein 静态态可经典稳定并避免特定半经典隧穿衰变。
classification.relevance_reason: 不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶；主题为修改引力宇宙学中 Einstein 静态态的经典与半经典稳定性，仅与经典引力/宇宙学支线间接相关。

papers.title: Orientifold and Integrability: $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super-Yang-Mills on $\mathbb{RP}^4$
papers.abstract: We study planar $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory (SYM) on the real projective space $\mathbb{RP}^4$ using integrability, holography and supersymmetric localization, and discuss its relation to orientifolds in string theory. We show that the integrability of $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM is preserved when combining the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ involution defining $\mathbb{RP}^4$ with the action of the charge conjugation of the SU$(N)$ gauge group. We demonstrate this by calculating one-point functions of non-BPS single-trace operators in various subsectors at weak coupling, which can be mapped to overlaps between energy eigenstates and crosscap states in integrable spin chains. The results exhibit a parity selection rule, a hallmark of integrability, and are given in terms of a ratio of determinants. Building on these results, we conjecture a closed formula for general single-trace operators. We further provide evidence that this construction is holographically dual to a probe orientifold O1-plane in $\text{AdS}_5\times \text{S}^5$ by constructing the corresponding worldsheet crosscap states in the pp-wave limit. Finally, we use supersymmetric localization to compute one-point functions of half-BPS operators exactly at finite $g_{\rm YM}$ and $N$. The computation reduces to two-dimensional Yang-Mills theory on $\mathbb{RP}^2$ twisted by charge conjugation and leads to a matrix integral of a Wishart-Laguerre type. In the planar limit, the exact result interpolates between the weak-coupling gauge-theory result, the strong-coupling supergravity prediction for the orientifold, and the worldsheet crosscap in the pp-wave limit.

classification.title_zh: Orientifold 与可积性：$\mathbb{RP}^4$ 上的 $\mathcal{N}=4$ 超杨-米尔斯理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用可积性、全息和超对称局域化研究平面极限下实射影空间 $\mathbb{RP}^4$ 上的 $\mathcal{N}=4$ 超杨-米尔斯理论，并讨论其与弦论中 orientifold 的关系。我们证明，将定义 $\mathbb{RP}^4$ 的 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 对合与 SU$(N)$ 规范群的电荷共轭作用结合时，$\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM 的可积性仍然保持。我们通过在弱耦合下计算各子扇区中非 BPS 单迹算符的单点函数来展示这一点；这些单点函数可映射为可积自旋链中能量本征态与 crosscap 态之间的重叠。结果表现出宇称选择规则，这是可积性的标志，并以行列式之比的形式给出。基于这些结果，我们猜测一般单迹算符的闭合公式。我们进一步通过在 pp-wave 极限下构造相应的世界面 crosscap 态，提供证据表明该构造在全息上对偶于 $\text{AdS}_5\times \text{S}^5$ 中的探针 orientifold O1-平面。最后，我们使用超对称局域化，在有限 $g_{\rm YM}$ 和 $N$ 下精确计算半 BPS 算符的单点函数。该计算归结为 $\mathbb{RP}^2$ 上被电荷共轭扭曲的二维杨-米尔斯理论，并导致 Wishart-Laguerre 型矩阵积分。在平面极限下，精确结果在弱耦合规范理论结果、orientifold 的强耦合超引力预言以及 pp-wave 极限下的世界面 crosscap 之间插值。
classification.one_liner: 利用可积性、全息与局域化研究 $\mathbb{RP}^4$ 上 $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM 的 orientifold 对偶及单点函数。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与可积性/局域化，未直接涉及用户重点标签中的具体支线（如全息超导、p波、畴壁/涡旋、QNM、经典引力、D3-D7 探针膜等）。

papers.title: Geometry and holography of $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times\mathrm{S}^2$: towards the field theory dual
papers.abstract: We take a first step in identifying the superconformal quantum mechanics dual to supersymmetric AdS$_2\times$S$^2$ solutions. We focus on the Type IIB solutions of the form AdS$_2\times$S$^2\times$CY$_2\times\Sigma$ that preserve eight supercharges, with $\Sigma$ a two-dimensional space parametrised by $(x_1,x_2)$, and read off their brane content, a D1-D5-NS5 intersection with D3 and D7 flavour branes. We propose that their dual $\mathcal{N}=4$ quantum mechanics is organised over a two-dimensional lattice of cells in $\Sigma$. Namely, it consists of copies of the linear quiver along $x_1$ dual to the U(1)-invariant solutions of the class, one for each interval along $x_2$, with ranks given by the D1 and D5 charges of the corresponding cell. Its central charge agrees with the holographic one at leading order. We show that the family of SL$(2,\mathbb{R})$ non-Abelian T-duals of the AdS$_3\times$S$^2\times$CY$_2$ solutions of massive Type IIA supergravity, constructed in previous work, belongs to this class, as does the SL$(2,\mathbb{R})\times$SU$(2)$ non-Abelian T-dual of AdS$_3\times$S$^3\times$CY$_2$, and work both out in detail. For both we propose global completions that introduce additional D3 and D7 branes. Along $x_2$ we interpret the fundamental strings stretched between the colour branes and the additional D3 and D7 branes as baryon vertices. Finally, we extend this proposal from the non-Abelian T-duals to the solutions of the class whose defining functions factorise in $x_1$ and $x_2$, including those in which the AdS$_2$ and S$^2$ factors have the same warp factor.

classification.title_zh: AdS2×S2 的几何与全息：朝向场论对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 本文迈出识别超对称 AdS2×S2 解的超共形量子力学对偶的第一步。聚焦保持八个超荷的 Type IIB AdS2×S2×CY2×Σ 解（Σ 由 (x1,x2) 参数化），读出其膜内容：D1-D5-NS5 交叠并含 D3 与 D7 味道膜。我们提出其对偶 N=4 量子力学由 Σ 上二维格点胞元组织：沿 x2 每个区间对应一份沿 x1 的线性 quiver（对偶于该类的 U(1) 不变解），其秩由相应胞元的 D1、D5 电荷给出；中心电荷在领头阶与全息结果一致。我们证明先前构造的 massive Type IIA AdS3×S2×CY2 解的 SL(2,R) 非阿贝尔 T-对偶族属于此类，AdS3×S3×CY2 的 SL(2,R)×SU(2) 非阿贝尔 T-对偶亦属此类，并详细计算。对二者提出引入额外 D3 和 D7 膜的全局完备化。沿 x2，将色膜与额外 D3、D7 膜之间拉伸的基本弦解释为重子顶点。最后，将该提议推广到定义函数在 x1 和 x2 中可分离的解（包括 AdS2 与 S2 翘曲因子相同的解）。
classification.one_liner: 提出超对称 AdS2×S2 Type IIB 解的对偶 N=4 量子力学格点 quiver 构造，并用非阿贝尔 T-对偶解检验。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息对偶字典与 AdS2 量子力学构造，并涉及 D3/D7 味道膜；但不直接对应全息超流、multi-trace、QNM 等具体重点支线。

papers.title: M2 brane $S^3/\mathbb Z_k$ instanton partition function in ${\rm AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction
papers.abstract: As was shown in arXiv:2609.14497, the 2-loop $ {\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction to the partition function of M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ vanishes. This is in agreement with the localization prediction for $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory interpreted in the grand-canonical ensemble according to the conjecture of arXiv:2505.21633. Here we study the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction for the M2 brane instanton wrapping $S^3/\mathbb Z_k\subset S^7/\mathbb Z_k$ dual to the leading non-perturbative large $N$ contribution to the ABJM free energy on 3-sphere. The 1-loop instanton M2 brane partition function was shown in arXiv:2307.14112 to match the localization prediction. The 2-loop computation is complicated by the presence of bosonic and fermionic zero modes, which requires to integrate over the collective coordinates. The collective-coordinate Jacobian provides a non-trivial ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ contribution in addition to the one of the quartic interaction vertex in the M2 brane action. We find that for $k>2$ the the quartic vertex contribution is cancelled by the Jacobian contribution for the choice of the separation of the fermionic zero modes from the quantum fields under which these form separate supermultiplets. Assuming the supersymmetric prescription for the paired zero modes we show that the cancellation persists after integration over the collective coordinates. Thus the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction vanishes, in agreement with the grand-canonical ensemble prediction. For $k=1$ the quartic vertex contribution reduces to equation-of-motion terms as in the case of ${\rm AdS}_3 \subset { \rm AdS}_7 \times S^4$ in arXiv:2511.22306 which is related to $S^3 \subset {\rm AdS}_4 \times S^7$ case by a formal analytic continuation.

classification.title_zh: AdS4×S7/Z_k 中 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数：两圈修正
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究在 AdS4×S7/Z_k 中包裹 S^3/Z_k 的 M2 膜瞬子配分函数的两圈 T_2^{-1} 修正；该瞬子对偶于 ABJM 理论在三维球面上自由能的主导非微扰大 N 贡献。先前一圈结果与局域化预言一致。两圈计算因存在玻色和费米零模而需对集体坐标积分；集体坐标雅可比给出非平凡的 T_2^{-1} 贡献。作者发现 k>2 时，在使费米零模与量子场分离并形成独立超多重态的选取下，四阶相互作用顶点贡献被雅可比贡献抵消；在配对零模的超对称处方下，积分后抵消仍成立，故 T_2^{-1} 修正为零，与巨正则系综预言一致。k=1 时四阶顶点贡献约化为运动方程项，与 AdS3⊂AdS7×S4 情形通过形式解析延拓相关。
classification.one_liner: 计算 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数的两圈修正，发现其 T_2^{-1} 项在 k>2 时因四阶顶点与集体坐标雅可比抵消而消失，支持 ABJM 巨正则系综局域化预言。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于 M2 膜瞬子与 ABJM 局域化的精确全息检验，不涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流/超导、p波、畴壁/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜等方向。

papers.title: Wilson Towers as Local Bulk Fields
papers.abstract: Multi-winding Wilson loops (Wilson spools) in 2+1-dimensional gravity can reproduce one-loop partition functions of local free fields in the bulk. Bulk free fields have a second-quantized Fock space, and the AdS/CFT correspondence suggests that the associated multi-particle sectors are dual to multi-trace primaries in the CFT. In this note, we use standard symmetric-function methods to show that the Wilson spool in thermal AdS$_3$ can be recast as a sum over $single$-winding Wilson loops -- one for each multi-trace primary. In a companion paper to appear, we will view Wilson networks and TQFTs as the natural language of non-perturbative bulk quantum gravity. The present note illustrates how this can apply to $local$ bulk fields, and not just defects: a bulk (generalized free) field is to be viewed as a full tower of multi-trace Wilson lines. We further show that the $SL(2)$ descendants of each multi-trace primary, together with the boundary gravitons of the AdS$_3$ background, correctly reproduce the full Virasoro character of each module. In this language, the role of a light insertion on a heavy primary is played by a topological Verlinde line. This allows us to obtain a "microscopic" description of one-loop determinants on the smooth BTZ handlebody. A spatially wound probe Wilson line on a torus with a contractible $thermal$ cycle can be traded for a Verlinde line inserted on a dense family of heavy Polyakov loops -- with the roles of the two cycles exchanged, so that the $spatial$ cycle is now contractible. The vacuum row of the modular $S$-kernel acts as the (approximate) density of the heavy primaries. This reinforces the case made in arXiv:2601.18775 that a smooth horizon is a stand-in for an ensemble of quantum states, each produced by a heavy Wilson line that appears as a singular horizon in the semi-classical limit.

classification.title_zh: Wilson 塔作为体局部场
classification.abstract_zh: 2+1 维引力中的多绕数 Wilson 圈（Wilson spools）可以重现体内局部自由场的一圈配分函数。体自由场具有二次量子化 Fock 空间，AdS/CFT 对偶暗示相关联的多粒子扇区对偶于 CFT 中的 multi-trace 原初算符。本文用标准对称函数方法证明，热 AdS3 中的 Wilson spool 可改写为单绕数 Wilson 圈的求和——每个 multi-trace 原初算符对应一个。作者还表明，每个 multi-trace 原初算符的 SL(2) 后代与 AdS3 背景的边界引力子一起正确重现每个模的完整 Virasoro 特征标。在此语言中，轻插入作用于重原初算符的角色由拓扑 Verlinde 线扮演，从而给出光滑 BTZ handlebody 上一圈行列式的“微观”描述。具有可收缩热圈的环面上的空间绕数探针 Wilson 线可替换为插入在密集重 Polyakov 圈族上的 Verlinde 线，两个圈的角色交换，使空间圈变为可收缩；模 S-核的真空行充当重原初算符的（近似）密度。这加强了 arXiv:2601.18775 的论点：光滑视界代表量子态系综，每个态由一条在半经典极限下表现为奇异视界的重 Wilson 线产生。
classification.one_liner: 将 AdS3 中的 Wilson spool 重写为对应 multi-trace 原初算符的单绕数 Wilson 圈塔，并连接 BTZ 一圈行列式与视界微观态系综。

papers.title: Fortuity beyond counting: an explicit construction
papers.abstract: We reconsider the "fortuity'' mechanism in the D1D5 CFT focusing on the K3 symmetric orbifold. Going beyond the counting of BPS states, we investigate perturbatively how the explicit form of the BPS cohomologies is modified by the twist-two deformations. We calculate the action of the supercharges in the sector $(h,j)=(1,0)$ for different values of the central charge and derive explicit expressions for the primary states. Equipped with this information, we compare some protected three-point couplings in the free and the gravity regime. We show that agreement between the two descriptions imposes non-trivial constraints on the identification of monotone and fortuitous states. In particular, we argue that the map relating theories with different values of the central charge must and can be defined so as to commute with the supercharges that define the cochain complex. We then study the three-point correlators between the fortuitous and monotone states identified in our analysis to assess whether the two sectors are dynamically decoupled. We find an explicit example of a non-vanishing coupling between two monotone and a fortuitous state, providing evidence that the two sectors are dynamically connected.

classification.title_zh: 超越计数的偶然性：一个显式构造
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新考虑 D1D5 CFT 中的“fortuity”机制，重点关注 K3 对称 orbifold。超越 BPS 态计数，我们微扰地研究 BPS 上同调的显式形式如何被 twist-two 形变修改。我们计算中心荷取不同值时 sector (h,j)=(1,0) 中超荷的作用，并推导 primary 态的显式表达式。利用这些信息，我们比较自由 regime 与引力 regime 中某些受保护的三点耦合。我们表明两种描述之间的一致性对 monotone 态与 fortuitous 态的识别施加了非平凡约束。特别地，我们论证，联系不同中心荷理论的映射必须且可以被定义得与定义上链复形的超荷对易。然后我们研究分析中识别的 fortuitous 态与 monotone 态之间的三点关联函数，以评估两个 sector 是否动力学解耦。我们发现两个 monotone 态与一个 fortuitous 态之间存在非零耦合的显式例子，这提供了两个 sector 动力学相连的证据。
classification.one_liner: 在 K3 对称 orbifold 的 D1D5 CFT 中显式研究 BPS 上同调在 twist-two 形变下的变化，并发现 monotone 与 fortuitous 态之间存在非零三点耦合。

papers.title: Mixed-state extension of the holographic signal inequality
papers.abstract: A novel inequality involving the residual information and genuine multi-entropy was proposed in \cite{Balasubramanian:2025hxg} for tripartite holographic pure states, using which it was argued, that purely GHZ-like tripartite entanglement is not allowed in holography. In this work, we generalize this holographic signal inequality to mixed states. In a minimal extension, we compute the reflected genuine multi-entropy following \cite{Yuan:2024yfg} and find a class of holographic geometries that violate this minimally extended inequality due to a vanishing Markov gap. We can symmetrize this prescription, where instead of computing the residual information on the given mixed state $\rho_{ABC}$, we compute it on its canonical purification. The inequality is restored on the canonically purified state. Finally, we conjecture a new inequality for tripartite holographic states and give supporting evidence.

classification.title_zh: 全息信号不等式的混合态推广
classification.abstract_zh: 本文把此前针对三分全息纯态提出的全息信号不等式推广到混合态。采用最小推广时，按已有方案计算反射的 genuine multi-entropy，发现一类全息几何因 Markov gap 消失而违反该不等式；若在正则纯化态上计算残余信息，则可恢复不等式。最后提出一个三分全息态的新不等式猜想并给出支持证据。
classification.one_liner: 将三分全息纯态的信号不等式推广到混合态，并讨论最小推广的违反与正则纯化修复。

papers.title: Holographic pressure and volume for black holes
papers.abstract: We advocate for a holographic definition of thermodynamic pressure and volume for black holes based on quasi-local gravitational thermodynamics. When a black hole is enclosed by a finite timelike boundary, York's quasi-local first law includes a surface pressure conjugate to the boundary area. Assuming the existence of a holographically dual theory living on this boundary, these geometric quantities correspond to the pressure and volume of the dual thermal system. In this work we focus on static, spherically symmetric black holes, for which these quantities reduce to global thermodynamic variables. The holographic volume provides a notion of system size, allowing extensivity to be defined in standard thermodynamic terms, and it yields a definition of the large-system limit. For the asymptotically flat case, we show that, in the canonical thermodynamic representation, small Schwarzschild black holes are non-extensive, whereas large black holes become extensive in the large-system limit. A similar conclusion applies to Anti-de-Sitter Schwarzschild black holes, with the difference that the quasi-local energy of the large black hole also becomes extensive in the large-system limit. Before this limit, the energy decomposes into subextensive and extensive contributions, and we derive an explicit expression for the extensive part as a function of the finite volume and entropy.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞的全息压强与体积
classification.abstract_zh: 本文主张基于准局域引力热力学，为黑洞定义全息的热力学压强和体积。当黑洞被有限类时边界包围时，York 准局域第一定律包含一个与边界面积共轭的表面压力。假设该边界上存在全息对偶理论，这些几何量对应对偶热系统的压强和体积。本文聚焦静态球对称黑洞，此时这些量退化为全局热力学变量。全息体积提供了系统尺度的概念，使广延性可按标准热力学定义，并给出大系统极限。对于渐近平直情形，在正则热力学表示中，小的 Schwarzschild 黑洞是非广延的，而大黑洞在大系统极限下变为广延。类似结论适用于 Anti-de Sitter Schwarzschild 黑洞，区别在于大黑洞的准局域能量在大系统极限下也变为广延；在此极限之前，能量分解为亚广延和广延贡献，并给出广延部分作为有限体积和熵函数的显式表达。

papers.title: Gravitational form factors of the proton in the improved holographic QCD model
papers.abstract: We compute the gluonic contribution to the gravitational form factors of the proton using the improved holographic QCD model, in which the proton is described in terms of bulk Dirac fermions. Model parameters are constrained using lattice and phenomenological input, allowing us to obtain estimates for the gravitational form factors and to compare them with results from other approaches. Using the extracted form factors, we analyze mechanical properties of the proton, including pressure and shear distributions. We obtain estimates for the mechanical and mass radii of the proton, $\rho_{\text{mech}} \approx 0.63$ fm, $\rho_{\text{mass}} \approx 0.65$ fm, and compare these values with radius estimates from other nonperturbative studies.

classification.title_zh: 改进全息QCD模型中质子的引力形状因子
classification.abstract_zh: 本文使用改进全息QCD模型计算质子引力形状因子的胶子贡献，其中质子在体时空中由Dirac费米子描述。模型参数通过格点与现象学输入约束，从而给出引力形状因子的估计并与其他方法结果比较。利用得到的形状因子，作者分析质子的力学性质，包括压强与剪切分布，并估计质子的力学半径约0.63 fm、质量半径约0.65 fm，与其他非微扰研究结果进行比较。
classification.one_liner: 在改进全息QCD模型中用体Dirac费米子计算质子引力形状因子及其力学半径与压强/剪切分布。

papers.title: One Method to Find Them All: Analytic Black Holes beyond Einstein
papers.abstract: Rotating black holes offer powerful probes of gravity, but constructing their geometries beyond vacuum general relativity remains challenging. Here we develop a unified framework for constructing stationary, axisymmetric deformations of Kerr from their tidal curvature and physical sources. As a demonstration, we obtain closed-form solutions for six higher-curvature interactions at leading order in the couplings and for generic subextremal spin, without slow-rotation expansions, numerical fitting, or mode decomposition. The solutions pass stringent checks against the field equations, previous mode-by-mode constructions, and known analytic predictions for horizon quantities. We find that the chirality of the interactions organizes the analytic structure of these solutions, a pattern that likely extends to a large class of purely metric higher-curvature theories. Our framework opens a systematic route to black-hole geometries in beyond-Einstein theories and perturbative astrophysical environments. These geometries provide a foundation for strong-field tests with gravitational waves and other observational channels, such as black-hole images and X-ray spectroscopy, as well as theoretical studies of near-extremal black holes.

classification.title_zh: 一种方法找到全部：超越爱因斯坦的解析黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 旋转黑洞为检验引力提供了强有力的探针，但在真空广义相对论之外构造其几何仍然具有挑战性。我们发展了一个统一框架，从潮汐曲率和物理源出发构造Kerr的稳态、轴对称形变。作为演示，我们在耦合的领头阶、对一般亚极端自旋得到了六种高曲率相互作用的闭式解，无需慢旋转展开、数值拟合或模式分解。这些解通过了与场方程、此前逐模式构造以及视界量已知解析预言的严格检验。我们发现，相互作用的手征性组织了这些解的解析结构，这一模式很可能推广到一大类纯度规高曲率理论。我们的框架为超越爱因斯坦理论以及微扰天体物理环境中的黑洞几何开辟了一条系统途径。这些几何为利用引力波和其他观测通道（如黑洞图像和X射线光谱）进行强场检验，以及近极端黑洞的理论研究提供了基础。

papers.title: Can One Hear the Absence of a Singularity?
papers.abstract: One of the central expectations of quantum gravity is the resolution of the curvature singularities predicted by General Relativity, potentially giving rise to effective black-hole geometries that are regular inside the horizon. We show that, for a very broad class of regular black holes including several known solutions, the quasinormal-mode spectrum in the large-overtone limit differs discontinuously from that of a Schwarzschild black hole, even when the regularization parameter is arbitrarily small. The real part of the quasinormal frequencies vanishes asymptotically, rather than approaching a nonzero constant, as generically occurs in General Relativity and other theories predicting black holes with curvature singularities. The asymptotic black-hole spectrum thus retains a distinctive imprint of singularity resolution. We establish these results analytically through a systematic formulation of the monodromy method and confirm them numerically. We interpret this phenomenon as a manifestation of black-hole spectral instability, whereby arbitrarily small deviations from vacuum General Relativity produce nonperturbative changes in the large-overtone spectrum.

classification.title_zh: 能听到奇点的缺失吗？
classification.abstract_zh: 量子引力的一个核心预期是消除广义相对论所预言的曲率奇点，并可能在视界内产生正则的有效黑洞几何。我们证明，对于一大类包含若干已知解的正则黑洞，其准正规模谱在大泛音极限下与 Schwarzschild 黑洞存在不连续差异，哪怕正则化参数任意小也是如此。准正则频率的实部渐近趋于零，而不是像广义相对论以及其他预言曲率奇点黑洞的理论中通常那样趋于非零常数。因此，渐近黑洞谱保留了奇点消除的独特印记。我们通过系统建立单值性方法解析地得到这些结果，并进行了数值验证。我们将该现象解释为黑洞谱不稳定性的一种表现：对真空广义相对论的任意微小偏离会在高泛音谱中产生非微扰变化。
classification.one_liner: 一大类正则黑洞在高泛音准正则模谱中留下奇点消除的非微扰印记，表现为谱的不连续性。

papers.title: Self-gravitating Schr\"odinger--Poisson Solitons in Curved Spacetime
papers.abstract: We formulate a description of self-gravitating Schr\"odinger--Poisson (SP) solitons in curved spacetime using a local inertial frame centered on the soliton. In the weak-field and non-relativistic regime, the effect of the background spacetime is incorporated into the SP equations through an effective tidal potential determined by the spacetime curvature. We apply this framework to a soliton moving along a circular equatorial geodesic around a Kerr black hole. The tidal field contains stationary and time-dependent quadrupolar components, which induce a deformation of the soliton and an associated mass quadrupole moment. We formulate the quadrupolar response in terms of the tidal deformability and the dimensionless Love number. We then estimate the gravitational radiation associated with the rotating deformed soliton and evaluate the corresponding characteristic strain for representative soliton sizes and orbital radii. A comparison with representative sensitivity curves of planned space-based gravitational-wave detectors identifies parameter regimes in which the estimated characteristic strain may lie within their sensitivity ranges. Our framework provides a systematic basis for investigating the tidal response of self-gravitating bosonic solitons in black-hole spacetimes and their potential gravitational-wave signatures.

classification.title_zh: 弯曲时空中的自引力薛定谔-泊松孤子

papers.title: Semi-agnostic inspiral modeling: the massless scalar case at leading post-Newtonian order
papers.abstract: We introduce a semi-agnostic modeling framework for black hole binary inspirals beyond general relativity that fixes the field content without selecting a particular theory. We expand in the post-Newtonian order and in powers of $l/L$, where $l$ is the characteristic length-scale that controls deviations from General Relativity and $L$ is the characteristic length-scale of the system. We focus on the case of a massless scalar field coupled with the metric, at leading post-Newtonian order. Taking into account the scaling with $l/L$ of both the interaction terms and the quantities that characterise the sources, we find that the inspiral can be described in terms of a small number of universal parameters. Such a parametrisation is suitable for obtaining combined bounds from multiple sources and performing searches for specific fields.

classification.title_zh: 半不可知旋进建模：领头后牛顿阶的无质量标量情形
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个超越广义相对论的半不可知黑洞双星旋进建模框架，它固定场内容而不选择特定理论。我们按后牛顿阶和 l/L 的幂展开，其中 l 是控制偏离广义相对论的特征长度尺度，L 是系统的特征长度尺度。我们关注无质量标量场与度规耦合、领头后牛顿阶的情形。考虑相互作用项和源特征量随 l/L 的标度，我们发现旋进可用少量普适参数描述。这种参数化适合从多源获得联合限制并搜寻特定场。

papers.title: Attractors and initial-condition sensitivity in Horndeski cosmologies
papers.abstract: We study whether nearby homogeneous cosmological histories approach or move away from the Genesis and contracting solutions. We also determine how an uncertainty in the scalar velocity at a later stage affects the inferred initial velocity. In the Genesis models, including the gravitational dynamics can substantially change this relation. We find that convergence of homogeneous solutions can occur even around backgrounds with unstable perturbations, and therefore attraction of the background is not sufficient to establish that a cosmological solution is physically viable. In the contracting model, one power-law solution attracts nearby trajectories, whereas another repels them. The strength of these effects depends on how the cosmological state is parametrized. Their evolution through the subsequent bounce is not considered here.

classification.title_zh: Horndeski 宇宙学中的吸引子与初值敏感性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究邻近的均匀宇宙历史是否会趋近或远离 Genesis 与收缩解。我们还确定较晚阶段标量速度的不确定性如何影响推断出的初始速度。在 Genesis 模型中，包含引力动力学可显著改变这一关系。我们发现，即使背景的微扰不稳定，均匀解也可能收敛，因此背景吸引性不足以证明宇宙解物理可行。在收缩模型中，一个幂律解吸引邻近轨迹，而另一个排斥它们。这些效应的强度取决于宇宙学状态的参数化方式。本文不考虑它们随后穿过反弹的演化。

papers.title: Closure of Traceful Radiation-Gauge Reconstruction with Matter: General Kerr Conditions, a Thin-Shell Benchmark, and a Conserved Torus
papers.abstract: We formulate the closure problem for first-order, traceful radiation-gauge metric reconstruction on a Kerr background with matter. The reconstruction is decomposed into Weyl-curvature, Ricci-trace, and mass--angular-momentum completion sectors. For compatible initial, gauge, and completion data, we establish local existence and uniqueness of the resulting triangular transport system on a regular Kerr domain, and identify the additional conditions needed for a closed global formulation. This is not a global existence theorem. We test the framework using two conserved matter sources. For a thin shell around a Schwarzschild black hole, Israel matching, regularity, asymptotic flatness, a barotropic equation of state, and fixed rest mass determine the static, axial, and leading rotational sectors. The ADM-mass shift is $\sqrt{1-2M/R}$ times the shell rest mass, while the axial sector determines the angular momentum, moment of inertia, and interior frame dragging. We also construct a stationary constant-angular-momentum fluid torus on Kerr and compute its Newman--Penrose Ricci projections, showing that nonspherical sources generally excite coupled Ricci sectors. The shell provides a closed benchmark, while the torus illustrates the additional structure required for general Kerr sources.

classification.title_zh: 含物质的有迹辐射规范重构闭包：一般Kerr条件、薄壳基准与守恒环面
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为Kerr背景下含物质的一阶有迹辐射规范度规重构建立闭包问题。重构被分解为Weyl曲率、Ricci迹以及质量-角动量补全扇区。对于相容的初始、规范与补全数据，我们在正则Kerr区域上建立所得三角输运系统的局部存在性与唯一性，并识别闭合全局表述所需的附加条件；这不是全局存在定理。我们用两个守恒物质源检验该框架。对于围绕Schwarzschild黑洞的薄壳，Israel匹配、正则性、渐近平直性、正压物态方程和固定静质量确定了静态、轴向及领头转动扇区。ADM质量偏移为壳静质量的 √(1-2M/R) 倍，而轴向扇区确定角动量、转动惯量与内部参考系拖曳。我们还在Kerr上构造了一个常角动量的稳态流体环面，并计算其Newman--Penrose Ricci投影，表明非球对称源一般会激发耦合的Ricci扇区。薄壳提供了闭合基准，环面则说明一般Kerr源所需的额外结构。
classification.one_liner: 在Kerr背景上建立含物质的一阶有迹辐射规范度规重构闭包，给出局部存在唯一性、Schwarzschild薄壳基准和Kerr流体环面算例。

papers.title: Foldy--Wouthuysen Transformation of the Generalized Dirac Equation in Symmetric Teleparallel Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate the non-relativistic limit of the generalized Dirac equation in a weak, static, and spherically symmetric background of symmetric teleparallel gravity. The underlying generalized spinor connection incorporates the complete Clifford-algebra basis and introduces additional couplings to the non-metricity sector beyond those of the conventional Dirac theory. Working in the coincident gauge and adopting the weak-field Schwarzschild geometry in isotropic coordinates, we derive the corresponding generalized Dirac Hamiltonian and perform successive Foldy--Wouthuysen transformations up to order $1/m^2$, retaining terms to first order in the gravitational potential and its spatial derivatives. The resulting block-diagonal Hamiltonian contains not only the expected gravitational counterparts of the kinetic, spin--orbit, and Darwin interactions, but also additional operator structures generated by the generalized spinor connection. In particular, direct spin--gravity, anisotropic spin--momentum--gravity, and tidal spin--momentum couplings arise naturally from the generalized metric-affine interaction. We further perform an order-of-magnitude analysis for an electron in the Earth's weak gravitational field to justify the adopted truncation of the inverse-mass expansion. These results demonstrate that the generalized Dirac equation in a symmetric teleparallel background gives rise to new low-energy interaction channels involving the fermion spin, momentum, and spatial derivatives of the gravitational field. The resulting effective Hamiltonian provides a framework for exploring phenomenological constraints on the additional couplings entering the generalized spinor connection.

classification.title_zh: 对称远平行引力中广义狄拉克方程的Foldy--Wouthuysen变换
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究了广义狄拉克方程在对称远平行引力的弱、静态、球对称背景下的非相对论极限。广义旋量联络包含完整的Clifford代数基，并引入超出常规Dirac理论的非度规性耦合。作者在重合规范下采用各向同性坐标中的弱场Schwarzschild几何，推导广义Dirac哈密顿量，并连续进行Foldy--Wouthuysen变换至1/m^2阶，保留引力势及其空间导数的一阶项。所得块对角哈密顿量除动能、自旋-轨道和Darwin相互作用的预期引力对应项外，还包含由广义旋量联络产生的额外算符结构，特别是直接自旋-引力、各向异性自旋-动量-引力以及潮汐自旋-动量耦合。文章还对地球弱引力场中的电子进行量级分析以论证截断。结果表明，对称远平行背景中的广义Dirac方程会产生涉及费米子自旋、动量和引力场空间导数的新低能相互作用通道，并为唯象限制广义旋量联络中的额外耦合提供框架。
classification.one_liner: 在对称远平行引力的弱场球对称背景中，通过Foldy--Wouthuysen变换导出广义Dirac方程的非相对论哈密顿量，并发现新的自旋-引力耦合。

papers.title: The 't Hooft model on (A)dS$_2$
papers.abstract: We solve large-$N$ two-dimensional QCD with fundamental quarks---the 't Hooft model---on rigid AdS$_2$ and dS$_2$. Their isometries preserve the null gauge $A_-=0$ and in affine coordinates the curvature enters the light-front Hamiltonian only through the special-conformal generator of the null line. The $SL(2,\mathbb{R)}$ Casimir then results in an exact meson equation: 't Hooft's equation plus a Legendre operator whose sign is determined by the curvature. On AdS$_2$ it is related to equations proposed in the context of folded/segmented strings and light-front holography. The pion is massless in the chiral limit and obeys a Gell-Mann--Oakes--Renner relation that fixes the chiral condensate, the dimensions cross over from Regge to logarithmic growth once the flux tube exceeds the curvature radius, and the flat-space integrable structure survives. We also solve the problem of a quark interacting with an antiquark placed at the boundary: beyond a critical coupling the string pulls it back to the boundary, resulting in a scattering phase. On dS$_2$ and due to the expansion of space, the mesons are unstable resonances even at $N=\infty$ and eventually dissociate. Their widths are given by Boltzmann factors at the de Sitter temperature.

classification.title_zh: (A)dS₂ 上的 't Hooft 模型
classification.abstract_zh: 我们求解了带基本夸克的大 N 二维 QCD——'t Hooft 模型——在刚性 AdS₂ 和 dS₂ 上的版本。其等距群保持零规范 A_-=0；在仿射坐标中，曲率仅通过零线上的特殊共形生成元进入光前哈密顿量。SL(2,R) Casimir 因此给出精确的介子方程：'t Hooft 方程加上一个 Legendre 算符，其符号由曲率决定。在 AdS₂ 上，它与折叠/分段弦及光前全息背景下提出的方程相关。在手征极限下 π 介子无质量，并满足确定手征凝聚的 Gell-Mann–Oakes–Renner 关系；一旦通量管超过曲率半径，维度从 Regge 增长过渡到对数增长，而平空间可积结构仍然保留。我们还求解了一个夸克与放置在边界上的反夸克相互作用的问题：超过临界耦合后，弦将其拉回边界，产生散射相移。在 dS₂ 上，由于空间膨胀，即使 N=∞ 介子也是不稳定共振并最终解离；其宽度由 de Sitter 温度下的 Boltzmann 因子给出。
classification.one_liner: 在刚性 AdS₂/dS₂ 中求解大 N 二维 QCD，得到曲率修正的 't Hooft 介子谱与 dS₂ 中介子共振衰变。

papers.title: Resurgence of Black Holes in Thermal OPE
papers.abstract: The momentum-space thermal OPE generically gives an asymptotic high-energy expansion of thermal two-point functions. We study the resurgent structure of this expansion in holographic CFTs at infinite and finite volume, whose dual bulk geometries are planar and spherical AdS black holes, respectively. The perturbative expansion is fixed to all orders by the stress-tensor sector of the thermal OPE and can be computed from a near-boundary analysis of the bulk wave equation. Non-perturbative effects, on the other hand, encode information about the bulk geometry away from the boundary. Using exact WKB analysis, we identify the locations of the associated Borel singularities as WKB actions between the AdS boundary and distinguished points in the complex radial plane, which include the black hole singularity in certain regimes. Furthermore, we identify a complex-frequency chamber in the timelike momentum regime where Borel resummation of the high-energy expansion reconstructs the full thermal two-point function. We further derive Stokes jumps that determine the non-perturbative contributions required upon crossing the boundary of this chamber.

classification.title_zh: 热 OPE 中黑洞的复兴
classification.abstract_zh: 动量空间热 OPE 通常给出热两点函数的高能渐近展开。本文研究全息 CFT 中该展开在无限和有限体积下的复苏结构，其对偶体几何分别为平面和球形 AdS 黑洞。微扰展开由热 OPE 的应力张量部分固定到所有阶，并可由体波方程的近边界分析计算。非微扰效应则编码远离边界的体几何信息。利用精确 WKB 分析，作者将相关 Borel 奇点的位置识别为 AdS 边界与复径向平面中若干特殊点之间的 WKB 作用量，其中在特定区域包括黑洞奇点。此外，他们识别出类时动量区域中的一个复频率腔室，在其中对高能展开做 Borel 重求和可重构完整热两点函数。进一步导出 Stokes 跳跃，以确定穿过该腔室边界时所需的非微扰贡献。
classification.one_liner: 利用精确 WKB 研究全息 CFT 热 OPE 高能展开的复兴结构，将 Borel 奇点与 AdS 黑洞几何及黑洞奇点联系起来。

papers.title: Entanglement Bounds on Cardy Growth in Higher Dimensions
papers.abstract: We propose bounds relating thermal entropy to entanglement in unitary conformal field theories: $f\le4\pi^2a$ in four dimensions and $f\le2.99830949\ldots\,F$ in three dimensions. Here $f$ is the dimensionless coefficient of the cosmological constant term in the thermal effective action, $a$ is the Euler anomaly coefficient, and $F$ is the sphere free energy. Spherical R\'enyi entropy relates the four-dimensional bound to the conformal collider bounds. We formulate a stronger conjectural inequality involving the stress-tensor three-point function, saturated by every free theory, and establish it in controlled regimes of weakly coupled gauge theories, large-$N$ vector models, and holographic CFTs. Finite-$N$ numerical results provide additional tests. The bounds constrain the Cardy growth of the density of states at high energy.

classification.title_zh: 高维 Cardy 增长的纠缠界
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出将热熵与纠缠联系起来的界，适用于幺正共形场论：四维中 f≤4π²a，三维中 f≤2.99830949… F。这里 f 是热有效作用中宇宙学常数项的无量纲系数，a 是 Euler 异常系数，F 是球面自由能。球面 Rényi 熵将四维界与共形对撞机界联系起来。我们提出一个涉及应力张量三点函数的更强猜想不等式，所有自由理论都饱和该不等式，并在弱耦合规范理论、大 N 矢量模型和全息 CFT 的可控区域建立该不等式。有限 N 数值结果提供了额外检验。这些界约束高能下态密度的 Cardy 增长。
classification.one_liner: 提出并用多种 CFT 方法检验热熵—纠缠不等式，约束高能 Cardy 态密度增长。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究 CFT 中热熵与纠缠的普适界，并在全息 CFT 等区域检验；与全息和纠缠相关，但不直接匹配给定的重点支线。

papers.title: On the geometric origin of central charges in gravity
papers.abstract: Central extensions of asymptotic symmetry algebras are traditionally determined through an explicit computation of the algebra of conserved charges. We show that, within an ambiguity-free covariant phase space formalism based on the Noetherian split, they instead arise as intrinsic quantities completely determined by the Lagrangian through the geometry of the associated covariant phase space. We prove two general Charge Representation Theorems describing the canonical realization of diffeomorphism symmetries in the presence of field-dependent vector fields and Lagrangian anomalies, corresponding respectively to vanishing and integrable Noetherian flux. In both cases, we derive explicit expressions for the associated central extensions and establish the corresponding cocycle identities. This provides a constructive algorithm for determining central charges directly from the Lagrangian formulation of the theory, without requiring an explicit computation of the charge algebra. As a non-trivial application, we consider asymptotically locally AdS$_3$ spacetimes with Penrose--Brown--Henneaux boundary conditions. We recover the corresponding centrally extended asymptotic symmetry algebra, providing an explicit realization of the Charge Representation Theorems.

classification.title_zh: 论引力中中心荷的几何起源
classification.abstract_zh: 传统上，渐近对称代数的中心扩张通过显式计算守恒荷代数来确定。我们表明，在基于 Noether 分裂的无歧义协变相空间形式中，它们反而作为内禀量出现，完全由拉格朗日量通过相关协变相空间的几何决定。我们证明两个一般的荷表示定理（Charge Representation Theorems），描述在场依赖矢量场和拉格朗日异常存在时微分同胚对称性的正则实现，分别对应 Noether 通量消失与可积的情形。两种情形下，我们导出相关中心扩张的显式表达式并建立相应的余圈恒等式。这提供了直接从理论拉格朗日表述确定中心荷的构造性算法，而无需显式计算荷代数。作为一个非平凡应用，我们考虑具有 Penrose--Brown--Henneaux 边界条件的渐近局域 AdS$_3$ 时空，恢复相应的中心扩张渐近对称代数，从而显式实现荷表示定理。
classification.one_liner: 用协变相空间几何从拉格朗日量直接构造引力中心荷，并在 AdS$_3$ 上恢复中心扩张渐近对称代数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究引力中渐近对称代数的中心扩张及 AdS$_3$ 应用，属于经典引力与渐近对称/全息基础相关的形式方法；不涉及用户列出的超流超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM 等具体支线。

papers.title: Two types of hairy black holes in the (3+1)-dimensional $O(3)$ sigma-model
papers.abstract: We construct stationary axially symmetric black holes with scalar hair in the gravitating nonlinear $O(3)$ sigma model with a partly negative symmetry-breaking potential. Our results show that it supports two qualitatively different types of asymptotically flat hairy black holes, distinguished by their connection to the corresponding solitonic branches and by the structure of their scalar hair; the type I black holes are connected to the vacuum branch and type II black holes are connected to regular scalaron-supported spinning solitons. The type II black holes have a strongly deformed scalar field structure, with the scalar field taking its vacuum value on the symmetry axis and approaching the anti-vacuum in the near-horizon equatorial region. We analyze their global charges, horizon properties, and dependence on the model parameters, comparing the solutions with Kerr black holes. For sufficiently weak gravitational coupling, the branch connectivity changes: the fundamental branches of types I and II reconnect to form one continuous family, while their corresponding second branches form another. We find that, in contrast to the vacuum-connected type I family, the scalaron-supported type II black holes extend to substantially larger horizon radii while preserving a nontrivial scalar configuration outside the horizon.

classification.title_zh: (3+1)维 O(3) sigma 模型中的两类毛发黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在具有部分负对称破缺势的引力非线性 O(3) sigma 模型中构造稳态轴对称带标量毛黑洞。结果表明，该模型支持两类定性不同的渐近平直毛发黑洞，其区别在于与相应孤子分支的联系以及标量毛的结构：I 型黑洞连接真空分支，II 型黑洞连接规则的、由 scalaron 支撑的旋转孤子。II 型黑洞的标量场结构强烈变形，标量场在对称轴上取真空值，并在近视界赤道区域趋于反真空。我们分析其全局荷、视界性质和对模型参数的依赖，并与 Kerr 黑洞比较。对于足够弱的引力耦合，分支连通性发生变化：I 型和 II 型的基本分支重连为一个连续族，而它们对应的第二分支形成另一族。与连接真空的 I 型族不同，由 scalaron 支撑的 II 型黑洞可延伸到显著更大的视界半径，同时在视界外保持非平庸的标量构型。
classification.one_liner: 在引力 O(3) sigma 模型中构造并比较两类渐近平直毛发黑洞，揭示其与孤子分支的连通性及弱耦合下的分支重连。

papers.title: On 2-loop AdS$_2$ superstring partition function in AdS$_5 \times S^5$ and AdS$_4\times CP^3$
papers.abstract: We revisit the 2-loop computation of the partition function of the GS superstring expanded near the AdS$_2$ surface in AdS$_5\times S^5$ and AdS$_4\times {\rm CP}^3$, dual to $\frac{1}{2}$ BPS circular Wilson loop in ${\cal N}=4$ SYM and ABJM theories. In arXiv:2601.08809 it was done in AdS$_5\times S^5$ using dimensional regularization and a UV pole was found. Since dimensional regularization is problematic for the GS string, here we use a heat-kernel cutoff instead. Then the contribution of the local path integral measure, proportional to $\delta(0)$, can no longer be ignored. We show that it cancels the $\delta(0)$ terms coming from the quartic interactions in the action, leaving the square of the difference ${\rm Str}\,E$ between the regularized numbers of bosonic and fermionic modes. The result is thus UV finite, the pole of arXiv:2601.08809 being an artefact of dimensional regularization. If all fields are regularized with the same smearing kernel, ${\rm Str}\,E=0$ and the 2-loop coefficient $f_2$ vanishes, in tension with $f_2=\frac{3}{32\pi^2}$ in SYM theory. In the AdS$_4\times{\rm CP}^3$ case the same cancellation leaves a finite term proportional to the square of the coincident value of the massless 2d fermion Green's function, giving, ironically, $f_2=\frac{3}{32\pi^2}$ instead of $f_2=0$ required by localization. This term is the level-zero (string) part of the result of arXiv:2609.14497 for the AdS$_2\times S^1$ M2 brane in AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$, where it is cancelled by the higher $S^1$ modes, which also remove a finite mass shift of the massless fermion in conflict with the AdS$_2$ supersymmetry. This suggests that the type II string path integral measure should contain an extra contribution, supplied in the IIA case by the parent M2 brane; in the AdS$_5\times S^5$ case it is still to be identified and may resolve the remaining 2-loop mismatch with localization.

classification.title_zh: AdS5×S5 与 AdS4×CP3 中 AdS2 超弦配分函数的两圈计算
classification.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视 AdS5×S5 与 AdS4×CP3 中展开在 AdS2 面附近的 GS 超弦配分函数的两圈计算，该配分函数对偶于 N=4 SYM 与 ABJM 理论中的 1/2 BPS 圆形 Wilson 圈。此前 arXiv:2601.08809 在 AdS5×S5 中使用维数正规化并发现一个紫外极点；由于维数正规化对 GS 弦存在问题，本文改用热核截断。此时局域路径积分测度的贡献（正比于 δ(0)）不能再被忽略。作者表明，它抵消了作用量中四次相互作用带来的 δ(0) 项，只留下玻色与费米模式正规化数目之差 Str E 的平方。因此结果是紫外有限的，arXiv:2601.08809 中的极点只是维数正规化的产物。若所有场都用同一抹平核正规化，则 Str E=0，两圈系数 f2 消失，这与 SYM 理论要求的 f2=3/(32π^2) 相矛盾。在 AdS4×CP3 情形中，同样的抵消留下一个正比于无质量二维费米子格林函数重合值平方的有限项，讽刺地给出 f2=3/(32π^2)，而不是局域化要求的 f2=0。该项是 arXiv:2609.14497 中 AdS4×S7/Z_k 内 AdS2×S1 M2 膜结果的能级零（弦）部分；在那里它被更高的 S1 模式抵消，而这些模式也移除了与 AdS2 超对称相冲突的无质量费米子有限质量移动。这表明 II 型弦路径积分测度应包含额外贡献，在 IIA 情形由母 M2 膜提供；在 AdS5×S5 情形中该贡献仍待确定，并可能解决与局域化之间剩余的两圈不匹配。
classification.one_liner: 用热核截断重算 AdS2 超弦两圈配分函数，指出维数正规化极点系假象，并讨论与局域化结果的剩余不匹配及可能缺失的路径积分测度贡献。

papers.title: Another Brick in the Wall: Spectral Form Factor of Normal Modes in Horizonless Geometries
papers.abstract: We compute the normal mode spectrum and its spectral form factor for a probe scalar wave in smooth horizonless backgrounds. We first consider the BTZ black hole with a brickwall that hides the near-horizon region, which has recently been proposed as a toy model for a finite-temperature semiclassical black hole microstate. In this setup, the spectral form factor may or may not have a linear ramp, depending on the details of the brickwall construction. However, we argue that even in cases that do show a ramp, this ramp does not originate from level correlations associated with quantum chaos. Then we calculate the normal mode spectrum for a genuine microstate geometry (superstratum) and find evidence of chaos, both with a ramp and level repulsion. We conclude that the eigenvalue spectrum of normal modes can indeed serve as a tool for investigating the quantum dynamics of fuzzballs; however, the brickwall models are incapable of capturing this phenomenon.

classification.title_zh: 墙上的又一块砖：无视界几何中简正模的谱形状因子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了光滑无视界背景中探针标量波的简正模谱及其谱形状因子。首先考虑带有砖墙的 BTZ 黑洞，砖墙遮蔽近视界区域；该设置最近被提出作为有限温度半经典黑洞微态的玩具模型。在此设置中，谱形状因子是否有线性斜坡取决于砖墙构造的细节。然而我们论证，即使出现斜坡，该斜坡也不来源于与量子混沌相关的能级关联。然后我们计算一个真正微态几何（superstratum）的简正模谱，发现混沌证据，既有斜坡也有能级排斥。我们得出结论：简正模的本征值谱确实可以作为研究 fuzzball 量子动力学的工具；但砖墙模型无法捕捉这一现象。
classification.one_liner: 在无视界背景中计算简正模谱形状因子，发现超层微态几何显示量子混沌，而砖墙模型不能。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文讨论黑洞微态/无视界几何中的简正模谱与量子混沌，与“QNM与非线性演化”支线相关；但不涉及用户列出的全息超流、多分量序参量、探针膜等方向。

papers.title: The Disordered Universe 2025: Statistical Systems Out of Equilibrium
papers.abstract: These lecture notes provide an introduction to quantum spin glasses, with a particular emphasis on their application to open problems in cosmology and holography. Focusing on the spherical $p$-spin model, we develop a complete and self-contained analysis of its thermodynamic and dynamical properties. We introduce the replica method, discuss both replica-symmetric and one-step replica symmetry-broken solutions, and characterise the resulting glassy phase. The framework is then extended to the quantum model, where we study the emergence of slow dynamics and the role of quantum correlations through Euclidean and real-time correlation functions. Finally, we explore how concepts such as replica symmetry breaking and disorder naturally arise in cosmological and holographic systems related to black hole fragmentation, highlighting spin glass models as useful theoretical laboratories for these phenomena. These notes are based on a series of lectures held during the La Ricotta Summer School: The Disordered Universe 2025 from 21 July to 1 August 2025.

classification.title_zh: 无序宇宙 2025：非平衡统计系统
classification.abstract_zh: 这些讲义介绍量子自旋玻璃，特别强调其在宇宙学与全息中未解问题上的应用。围绕球面 p-spin 模型，我们对其热力学与动力学性质给出完整且自洽的分析。我们介绍复本方法，讨论复本对称解与一步复本对称破缺解，并刻画由此产生的玻璃相。随后将框架推广到量子模型，通过欧氏与实时关联函数研究慢动力学的出现以及量子关联的作用。最后，我们探讨复本对称破缺与无序等概念如何自然出现在与黑洞碎裂相关的宇宙学和全息系统中，强调自旋玻璃模型可作为研究这些现象的有用理论实验室。这些讲义基于 2025 年 7 月 21 日至 8 月 1 日 La Ricotta 暑期学校“The Disordered Universe 2025”的一系列讲座。

papers.title: Wilson loops of Chern-Simons-matter Theories with one parameter and Picard-Fuchs equations
papers.abstract: Extending our previous work, we investigate Wilson loops of flavored Chern-Simons theory and ABJ theory by the use of Picard-Fuchs equations. The singularity structure of the equations is analyzed in detail, and local solutions around the singularities are determined. Each theory has one parameter, and the parameter dependence of the Wilson loops is also determined. In flavored Chern-Simons theory, we find an interesting phase transition. For $n$-times-wound Wilson loops, we determine their $n$-dependence by using a recursion relation obtained in our previous work.

classification.title_zh: 单参数 Chern-Simons-物质理论 Wilson 圈的 Picard-Fuchs 方程研究
classification.abstract_zh: 作为此前工作的推广，我们利用 Picard-Fuchs 方程研究带味 Chern-Simons 理论与 ABJ 理论的 Wilson 圈。我们详细分析了方程的奇点结构，并确定了奇点附近的局部解。每种理论含有一个参数，我们也确定了 Wilson 圈对参数的依赖。在带味 Chern-Simons 理论中，我们发现了一个有趣的相变。对于 n 次缠绕的 Wilson 圈，我们利用此前工作得到的递推关系确定了其 n 依赖性。
classification.one_liner: 利用 Picard-Fuchs 方程研究带味 Chern-Simons 理论与 ABJ 理论 Wilson 圈的奇点结构、参数依赖与缠绕数依赖，并发现一个有趣相变。

papers.title: Trace Relations and Partition Functions
papers.abstract: In general trace relations appear in finite $N$ matrix models and collective field theories. They lead, as was established previously, to reductions of large $N$ Hilbert spaces. Even more importantly they induce the appearance of a whole class of new (miraculous) states whose number grows exponentially in $N^2$. In this work we discuss their relevance to finite $N$ thermodynamics and the role they play in constraining the partition functions of finite $N$ theories.

classification.title_zh: 迹关系与配分函数
classification.abstract_zh: 在一般的有限 N 矩阵模型和集体场论中会出现迹关系。正如先前所确立的，这些关系会导致大 N Hilbert 空间的约化。更重要的是，它们会诱导出一类全新的（奇迹）态，其数目随 N^2 指数增长。本文讨论这些态与有限 N 热力学的相关性，以及它们在约束有限 N 理论配分函数中所起的作用。
classification.one_liner: 研究有限 N 矩阵模型中的迹关系如何约化大 N Hilbert 空间、产生指数多新态并约束配分函数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及有限 N 矩阵模型中的迹关系与配分函数约束，与用户关注的 multi-trace 约束相关；但摘要未明确给出 AdS/CFT 对偶或全息应用，因此定级为 medium。

papers.title: Landau singularity of the K3 maximal cut in black-hole scattering at fifth post-Minkowskian order
papers.abstract: Modeling the gravitational waves from merging black holes requires precise calculations of the two-body problem. The post-Minkowskian expansion of black-hole scattering, in powers of Newton's constant, now stands at fifth order, four loops. At this order one part of the deflection diverges when the black holes pass at about 94 percent of the speed of light. The divergence is known to come from periods of a K3 surface, which has a node at this speed. We show that the node lies on the integration contour of the K3 maximal cut, which makes this speed a Landau singularity of the cut. Requiring the divergence to cancel, without introducing new infinities, has been shown to fix the memory contribution, named for the permanent displacement that the waves leave in test masses, up to one constant. We derive the leading coefficients of its boundary integrals in closed form. We obtain both results from maximal cuts and boundary limits, without an integration-by-parts reduction of the full four-loop integrand. We also continue the K3 and Calabi--Yau periods of these integrals to the energies of bound orbits, as in the inspiral before a merger.

classification.title_zh: 五阶后闵可夫斯基黑洞散射中K3最大割的Landau奇点
classification.abstract_zh: 模拟双黑洞并合产生的引力波需要对两体问题做精确计算。黑洞散射的后闵可夫斯基展开以牛顿常数幂次展开，目前已到五阶、四圈。在此阶，当黑洞以约光速94%的速度掠过时，偏折的一部分发散。已知该发散来自K3曲面的周期，而该曲面在此速度处有一个节点。我们证明该节点位于K3最大割的积分围道上，使该速度成为该割的Landau奇点。已有工作表明，要求发散在不引入新无穷大的情况下抵消，可将记忆贡献（因波在检验质量中留下的永久位移而得名）固定到一个常数。我们以闭式推导其边界积分的主导系数。我们直接从最大割和边界极限得到这两个结果，而无需对完整四圈被积函数做分部积分约化。我们还将这些积分的K3和Calabi-Yau周期延拓到束缚轨道的能量，如同并合前的旋近阶段。
classification.one_liner: 证明五阶后闵可夫斯基黑洞散射中约94%光速处的发散对应K3最大割的Landau奇点，并闭式给出记忆项边界积分主导系数及向束缚轨道能量的周期延拓。

papers.title: Hironaka decompositions in supersymmetric theories: an exploration
papers.abstract: We ask when tree-level supersymmetric cohomology admits a Hironaka decomposition: a unique expansion in finitely many secondary operators with polynomial coefficients in algebraically independent bosonic primaries. Such a decomposition organizes the cohomology into towers with a common set of unrestricted dressings. For diagonal models with $N$ labels, $d\geq1$ bosonic species and $f$ fermionic species, we construct this decomposition and obtain $(N!)^{d-1}2^{fN}$ secondaries. We also prove that the scalar-branch ring of ABJM theory admits a Hironaka decomposition at every rank and positive integer Chern--Simons level, and construct explicit bases for the $SU(2)\times SU(2)$ Klebanov--Witten scalar ring. We also do the same for the Higgs branches of two class-S theories. However, not all supersymmetric cohomologies admit a Hironaka decomposition. In the Wess--Zumino model with $W=x^2y^2$, every positive-degree scalar annihilates the nonzero class $xy$, while $x^n$ is in cohomology for every $n\geq 1$. These two properties rule out a Hironaka decomposition over scalar primaries.

classification.title_zh: 超对称理论中的 Hironaka 分解：一项探索
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究树级超对称上同调何时允许 Hironaka 分解：即用有限多个次级算符、以代数独立的玻色原初算符的多项式系数进行唯一展开。此类分解将上同调组织成具有共同无限制 dressing 的塔。对于具有 N 个标签、d≥1 种玻色子和 f 种费米子的对角模型，我们构造该分解并得到 (N!)^{d-1}2^{fN} 个次级算符。我们还证明 ABJM 理论的标量分支环在任意秩和正整数 Chern–Simons 能级下都允许 Hironaka 分解，并为 SU(2)×SU(2) Klebanov–Witten 标量环构造显式基。我们对两个 class-S 理论的 Higgs 分支也做了同样的事。然而并非所有超对称上同调都允许 Hironaka 分解。在 W=x^2y^2 的 Wess–Zumino 模型中，每个正次数标量都湮灭非零类 xy，而 x^n 对每个 n≥1 都属于上同调。这两条性质排除了以标量原初算符为基础的 Hironaka 分解。
classification.one_liner: 研究超对称上同调/手征环的 Hironaka 分解，并在 ABJM、Klebanov-Witten 与 class-S 模型中构造显式分解，同时给出 Wess-Zumino 反例。

papers.title: The Fate of 1/4-BPS States in the D1-D5 CFT
papers.abstract: We consider the 1/4-BPS operators in the D1-D5 system on AdS$_3\times S^3\times T^4$. We evaluate the anomalous dimensions of low-lying sectors in conformal perturbation theory around Sym$^N(T^4)$ exactly in $N$. All anomalous dimensions are consistent with recombination of the short multiplets into long ones and take a particularly simple form. We show that at finite $N$ and at first nontrivial order in the deformation, for the sectors we consider, the BPS density of states agrees with that of the supergravity point. To the order in conformal perturbation theory we consider, this confirms that not all states that can get lifted do get lifted.

classification.title_zh: D1-D5 CFT 中 1/4-BPS 态的归宿
classification.abstract_zh: 本文考虑 AdS$_3\times S^3\times T^4$ 上 D1-D5 系统中的 1/4-BPS 算符。作者在 Sym$^N(T^4)$ 附近的共形微扰论中，对低 lying 扇区的反常维度给出了精确到 $N$ 的结果。所有反常维度都与短多重态复合成长多重态相一致，并具有特别简单的形式。作者进一步表明，在有限 $N$ 且微扰展开第一非平凡阶时，对于所考虑的扇区，BPS 态密度与超引力点的一致。就所考虑的共形微扰论阶数而言，这证实了并非所有能够被提升的态都会实际被提升。
classification.one_liner: 在 D1-D5 CFT 中共形微扰论精确到 N 计算低阶 1/4-BPS 算符的反常维度，并检验其与超引力 BPS 态密度的一致性。

papers.title: Cosmology of the Baby Universe in Coupled SYK
papers.abstract: We analyze the structure of the baby universe which arises in the coupled SYK realization of the AS$^2$ geometry. To do this, we develop and leverage combinatorial arguments about traces of many Majoranas which remain valid at finite $N$ and $p$ and thus furnish the finite $\lambda$ completion of the chord rules found in [1]. We find that there is a first order phase transition which persists in the $\beta\rightarrow\infty$ limit between the thermal AdS and AS$^2$ phases parameterized by the mass of the heavy particle insertion and the ratio between the SYK and Maldacena-Qi coupling constants. We then explore Lorentzian time evolution in the baby universe and find a cosine scale factor confirming the big bang / big crunch nature of the bulk cosmology.

classification.title_zh: 耦合SYK中婴儿宇宙的宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 本文分析耦合SYK实现AS^2几何时出现的婴儿宇宙结构。作者发展并利用关于多个Majorana算符迹的组合论证，这些论证在有限N和p下仍成立，从而给出[1]中弦规则的有限λ补全。研究发现，在β→∞极限下，热AdS相与AS^2相之间存在一阶相变，该相变由重粒子插入的质量以及SYK耦合与Maldacena-Qi耦合之比参数化。随后作者探索婴儿宇宙中的洛伦兹时间演化，发现余弦标度因子，证实了体宇宙学的大爆炸/大挤压性质。
classification.one_liner: 在耦合SYK模型中研究AS^2几何的婴儿宇宙，给出有限N,p弦规则补全，发现热AdS与AS^2相之间的一阶相变及余弦标度因子的大爆炸/大挤压演化。

papers.title: Cusp regularization with spin structures and gravitational anomalies
papers.abstract: The family of $SL(2,\mathbb Z)$ black holes has an accumulation point corresponding to a cusped geometry, which causes the sum over black holes to diverge. We extend cusp regularization to the sum over geometries compatible with a fixed boundary spin structure. For $c_L=c_R$, including the cusp as a counterterm cancels the leading divergence for each of the three even boundary spin structures. The required subtraction is the same in all three sectors and is two thirds of the bosonic one. We further show that gravitational anomalies cause cancellations between black hole contributions, removing the leading cusp divergence except at $c_L-c_R=0,\pm24$ in pure gravity and $c_L-c_R=0,\pm12$ in $\mathcal N=(1,1)$ supergravity. We also derive the spin structure dependent anomaly phases responsible for these cancellations.

classification.title_zh: 带自旋结构的尖点正则化与引力反常
classification.abstract_zh: SL(2,Z) 黑洞族具有对应尖点几何的聚点，导致对黑洞求和发散。本文将尖点正则化推广到与固定边界自旋结构相容的几何求和。当 c_L=c_R 时，引入尖点作为抵消项可消除三种偶边界自旋结构各自的首项发散；三种扇区所需减除相同，为玻色情形的三分之二。进一步证明引力反常会导致黑洞贡献之间的相消，从而消除领头尖点发散，除非纯引力中 c_L-c_R=0,±24，以及 N=(1,1) 超引力中 c_L-c_R=0,±12。本文还导出了与自旋结构相关的、造成这些相消的反常相位。
classification.one_liner: 将尖点正则化推广到固定边界自旋结构，并证明引力反常可使 SL(2,Z) 黑洞求和中的领头尖点发散发生相消。

papers.title: An autoencoder-based surrogate waveform model for quasi-circular binary-black-hole mergers
papers.abstract: The generation of accurate waveforms from binary black hole (BBH) mergers is a major effort in Gravitational-Wave Astronomy. In recent years, machine-learning-based surrogate models for BBH waveforms have been proposed. Those offer the potential to dramatically accelerate waveform generation while maintaining accuracy competitive with that of traditional waveform approximants. In this work, we investigate the viability of autoencoders as generative models for gravitational-wave signals from quasi-circular BBH mergers. We introduce AESur3dq8, a novel surrogate waveform model based on autoencoders that enables the rapid and accurate construction of large template banks, producing millions of waveforms in under a second using modest computational resources. The model is trained on the numerical-relativity-informed surrogate NRHybSur3dq8 and subsequently fine-tuned using the SXS catalog of BBH simulations. We demonstrate that waveforms generated by AESur3dq8 achieve mismatches of order $10^{-4}$ with respect to Numerical Relativity waveforms, and that parameter estimation performed with these templates yields results fully consistent with those reported by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration for observed gravitational-wave events.

classification.title_zh: 基于自编码器的准圆双黑洞并合替代波形模型
classification.abstract_zh: 从双黑洞并合产生精确波形是引力波天文学的主要工作。近年来，基于机器学习的双黑洞波形替代模型被提出，可显著加速波形生成并保持与传统波形近似模型相当的精度。本文研究自编码器作为准圆双黑洞并合引力波信号生成模型的可行性。我们提出 AESur3dq8，一种基于自编码器的新型替代波形模型，可利用适度计算资源在不到一秒内生成数百万个波形，从而快速准确地构建大型模板库。该模型在数值相对论信息驱动的替代模型 NRHybSur3dq8 上训练，并使用 SXS 双黑洞模拟目录进行微调。我们证明 AESur3dq8 生成的波形相对于数值相对论波形的失配约为 10^{-4}，并且使用这些模板进行的参数估计结果与 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 合作组对已观测引力波事件的报告完全一致。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于自编码器的双黑洞并合替代波形模型，可快速生成高精度模板并用于参数估计。

papers.title: Heavy Black-Holes Also Matter in Standard Siren Cosmology
papers.abstract: With the release of the Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog GWTC-4.0 by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) collaboration, 218 candidate detections of gravitational waves (GWs) from compact binary coalescences (CBCs) have been reported. This milestone represents a major advancement for GW cosmology, as many methods, particularly those employing the spectral siren approach, critically depend on the number of available sources. We investigate the impact of a novel parametric model describing the full population mass spectrum of CBCs on the estimation of the Hubble constant. This model is designed to test the impact of heavy black holes in GW cosmology. We perform a joint inference of cosmological and population parameters using 142 CBCs from GWTC-4.0 with a false alarm rate smaller than 0.25 per year, using both spectral and dark siren approaches. With spectral sirens, we estimate the Hubble constant to be $H_0 = 78.8^{+19.0}_{-15.3}\,{\rm km s^{-1} Mpc^{-1}}$ (68% CL), while the dark siren method yields $H_0 = 82.5^{+16.8}_{-14.3}\,{\rm km s^{-1} Mpc^{-1}}$ (68% CL). These results improve the uncertainty by approximately 30.4% and 36.2%, respectively. We show that this improvement is linked to the presence of a new mass scale in the binary black hole mass spectrum at $63.3^{+4.8}_{-4.8}\,M_{\odot}$, which provides additional constraints on the Hubble constant. Besides providing the tightest standard-siren constraints on $H_0$, this highlights the importance of a heavy-mass feature in the black hole spectrum.

classification.title_zh: 重黑洞在标准汽笛宇宙学中也很重要
classification.abstract_zh: 随着 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 合作组发布 GWTC-4.0，已报告 218 个致密双星并合引力波候选事件。本文研究一个描述致密双星并合全体质量谱的新参数模型对哈勃常数估计的影响，该模型旨在检验重黑洞在引力波宇宙学中的作用。作者使用 GWTC-4.0 中虚警率低于每年 0.25 的 142 个事件，联合推断宇宙学与种群参数，并同时采用谱汽笛和暗汽笛方法。谱汽笛给出 H0 = 78.8^{+19.0}_{-15.3} km/s/Mpc（68% CL），暗汽笛给出 H0 = 82.5^{+16.8}_{-14.3} km/s/Mpc（68% CL），不确定度分别改善约 30.4% 和 36.2%。文章表明这一改善与双黑洞质量谱中约 63.3 Msun 的新质量尺度有关，该尺度为哈勃常数提供了额外约束。
classification.one_liner: 利用 GWTC-4.0 的 142 个致密双星并合事件联合推断宇宙学与种群参数，发现约 63 Msun 的重黑洞质量尺度可改进哈勃常数约束。

papers.title: Charging up regular black holes
papers.abstract: We present a general construction of charged regular black holes as solutions of a generalization of the Einstein--Maxwell field equations in spherical symmetry in which the Einstein tensor is deformed into an identically conserved tensor containing up to second derivatives of the gravitational field. The generality of the construction allows us to define the field equations satisfied by generic regular black holes when becoming charged. The conditions that guarantee regularity of charged solutions are evaluated and shown to be more stringent than the regularity conditions for uncharged solutions. This implies, in particular, that the charged versions of the Bardeen and Hayward black holes become singular. Improved versions of the Bardeen and Hayward metrics that remain regular when charged are proposed. Our results indicate that regularizing the vacuum solutions of general relativity is, in general, not enough to yield regular solutions in other situations of physical interest. The implications that follow for the construction of realistic regular black holes, in which aspects such as rotation and the presence of matter fields are taken into account, are discussed.

classification.title_zh: 带电正则黑洞的构造
classification.abstract_zh: 本文给出带电正则黑洞的一般构造，将其作为球对称下 Einstein--Maxwell 场方程推广形式的解；其中 Einstein 张量被变形为一个恒等守恒、且含引力场最高二阶导数的张量。该构造的普适性使我们能定义一般正则黑洞在带电后所满足的场方程。我们评估保证带电解正则性的条件，并表明这些条件比无电荷解的正则性条件更严格。这尤其意味着 Bardeen 黑洞和 Hayward 黑洞的带电版本会变成奇异。我们提出改进的 Bardeen 和 Hayward 度规，使其在带电时仍保持正则。结果表明，一般而言，仅将广义相对论的真空解正则化，并不足以在其他物理情形中给出正则解。我们还讨论了这些结果对构造现实正则黑洞（需考虑旋转与物质场等）的影响。
classification.one_liner: 提出带电正则黑洞的一般构造，指出Bardeen/Hayward黑洞带电后变奇异，并给出保持正则的改进度规。

papers.title: Metric--affine gravity with dynamical chronology protection
papers.abstract: Modified theories of gravity often introduce geometric structure beyond general relativity to address unresolved problems in the gravitational sector without invoking ad hoc matter fields. Mimetic gravity, for example, generates an effective cosmological dark sector by isolating the conformal mode of the metric, while Ho\v{r}ava--Lifshitz gravity attains power-counting renormalizability by endowing spacetime with a preferred dynamical foliation. Although chronology protection was not the original motivation for either theory, both can realize it classically through stable causality. This suggests that chronology protection itself may be elevated from a derived property to a guiding principle for constructing modified gravitational theories, especially if its implementation at the quantum-gravitational level leaves infrared imprints in the effective action. Motivated by this possibility, we introduce a toy metric--affine gravity model whose chronology-protecting sector is purely geometric. The model breaks projective invariance and selects a timelike, closed non-metricity one-form. In the globally exact sector, this one-form defines a time function, realizing stable causality through affine geometry. On the matter-free, spatially flat FLRW branch with non-compact slices, $\Lambda=0$, and positive chronology-sector density, the local quadratic gravitational spectrum contains the two tensor modes of GR and a single scalar mode. The scalar has positive kinetic energy but a gradient instability, $c_s^2=-2$, requiring stabilization before a viable cosmological application can be established. We investigate the classical cosmological effects and scalar-mode dynamics of this purely geometric chronology-protecting extension of general relativity.

classification.title_zh: 具有动力学时序保护的度规-仿射引力
classification.abstract_zh: 修改引力理论常通过引入超出广义相对论的几何结构来处理引力 sector 的未解决问题，而不诉诸额外物质场。本文受 mimetic gravity 与 Hořava–Lifshitz 引力可在经典层面实现时序保护的启发，提出一个玩具度规-仿射引力模型，其时序保护部分纯为几何。该模型破坏射影不变性，并选取一个类时、闭合的非度规性一形式；在全局精确 sector 中，该一形式定义时间函数，从而通过仿射几何实现稳定因果性。在无物质、空间平坦 FLRW 分支上（非紧切片、Λ=0、正时序 sector 密度），局部二次引力谱包含广义相对论的两个张量模式和一个标量模式；该标量具有正动能但有梯度不稳定性 c_s^2=-2，需在可行宇宙学应用前被稳定化。本文研究这一纯几何时序保护型广义相对论扩展的经典宇宙学效应与标量模式动力学。
classification.one_liner: 提出一个用非度规性一形式实现经典稳定因果性的度规-仿射玩具模型，并发现其FLRW标量模式存在梯度不稳定性。

papers.title: A Quiet Night in the Millihertz Sky? LISA Forecasts from LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA Populations
papers.abstract: The high-mass black hole population inferred from ground-based observations can substantially affect the number of binaries detectable by the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). We use population constraints based on data from the latest LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog (GWTC-5.0), as well as constraints from the O3 search for intermediate-mass black hole binaries, to forecast the number and masses of binary black holes detectable by LISA. Using the released GWTC-5.0 population posterior, we obtain $6.6^{+5.5}_{-2.2}$ expected detections with signal-to-noise ratio $>8$ in 4 years (median and $90\%$ credible interval). The alternative population models we consider use a broken power law with two or three Gaussian peaks for either the primary-mass distribution or a common mass distribution for both black holes. For the three-peak model with the common mass distribution, extrapolating from $300$ to $1000M_\odot$ roughly doubles the median expected number of LISA detections to $\sim14$. The upper end of its $90\%$ credible interval rises from tens to thousands of expected detections, although approximations may limit the reliability of the most extreme counts. For the reference GWTC-5.0 population, $39^{+22}_{-11}\%$ of the binaries detectable by LISA merge during the mission or within $10$ years after its end and are potential multiband sources. Essentially all of these mergers would be detectable by a reference Cosmic Explorer configuration if it is operating at merger. Ground-based measurements of the high-mass population can therefore inform both LISA forecasts and the prospects for observing the same binaries through inspiral and merger.

classification.title_zh: 毫赫兹天空的宁静夜晚？来自 LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA 族群的 LISA 预测
classification.abstract_zh: 地面观测推断的大质量黑洞族群可显著影响激光干涉空间天线（LISA）可探测的双星数量。我们使用基于最新 LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA 引力波暂现源表（GWTC-5.0）的数据族群约束，以及 O3 对中等质量黑洞双星搜寻的约束，预测 LISA 可探测的双黑洞数量和质量。利用已发布的 GWTC-5.0 族群后验，我们得到 4 年内信噪比 >8 的预期探测数为 6.6^{+5.5}_{-2.2}（中位数和 90% 可信区间）。替代族群模型使用断裂幂律并在主质量或共同质量分布上带有两个或三个高斯峰。对于共同质量分布的三峰模型，从 300 外推到 1000 太阳质量使 LISA 预期探测中位数大致翻倍至约 14 个，其 90% 可信区间上限从数十升至数千，但近似可能限制极端计数的可靠性。对于参考 GWTC-5.0 族群，LISA 可探测的双星中有 39^{+22}_{-11}% 在任务期间或结束后 10 年内并合，为潜在多波段源；若宇宙探索者在并合时运行，这些并合基本都能被探测到。因此地面观测的大质量族群可同时为 LISA 预测及通过旋近和并合观测同一双星提供信息。
classification.one_liner: 基于地面引力波观测约束预测 LISA 可探测的大质量黑洞双星数量，并讨论多波段观测前景。
