papers.title: Probing the inner disk edge of rotating neutron stars with dipole excitations in finite nuclei
papers.abstract: The nuclear equation of state shapes both the structure of rapidly rotating neutron stars and the orbital motion in their surrounding spacetime. Its uncertainty affects the mass and radius at which the innermost stable circular orbit reaches the stellar surface, a condition that defines the transition between disks whose inner edge is set by the surface and those truncated by orbital instability. We quantify how measurements of the electric dipole polarizability of neutron-rich nuclei reduce the uncertainty in this transition and in the orbital properties at the disk inner edge. We compute uniformly rotating neutron stars in general relativity for a family of equations of state that systematically vary the symmetry energy, derived from relativistic energy density functionals with density-dependent point-coupling interactions. We compare the results for the full family with those for the subset consistent with the measured dipole polarizabilities of finite nuclei. The dipole polarizability constraint reduces the spread in transition mass and equatorial radius by factors of about seven to ten across the spin frequencies considered. Along this transition, it also confines the orbital frequency at the disk inner edge to a band narrower than $20$~Hz at each spin. Combined with a measured neutron-star spin, a kilohertz quasi-periodic oscillation interpreted as disk orbital motion further restricts the mass--radius region, allowing an independent mass estimate to probe the symmetry-energy constraint. The dipole response of finite nuclei thus informs both the structure of rotating neutron stars and the orbital properties of their inner accretion disks.

classification.title_zh: 利用有限原子核中的偶极激发探测旋转中子星的内盘边缘
classification.abstract_zh: 核物质状态方程同时决定快速旋转中子星的结构及其周围时空中的轨道运动。其不确定性影响最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）到达星体表面时所对应的质量和半径，这一条件定义了盘内边缘由星体表面决定还是由轨道不稳定性截断的转变。我们量化富中子核的电偶极极化率测量如何减小该转变及盘内边缘轨道性质的不确定性。我们在广义相对论下计算均匀旋转中子星，采用一族系统改变对称能的状态方程，这些方程来自密度依赖点耦合相互作用的相对论能量密度泛函。我们将全族结果与符合有限核偶极极化率测量子集的结果进行比较。偶极极化率约束将转变质量和赤道半径的散布在所考虑自转频率范围内缩小约七到十倍，并在该转变上把盘内边缘轨道频率限制在每个自转下窄于20 Hz的带内。结合测得的中子星自转，若将千赫兹准周期振荡解释为盘轨道运动，还可进一步限制质量—半径区域，从而给出独立质量估计以检验对称能约束。因此，有限核的偶极响应对旋转中子星结构及其内吸积盘轨道性质均有启示。
classification.one_liner: 有限核偶极极化率通过约束对称能，把旋转中子星ISCO触及表面转变的质量、半径和内盘轨道频率不确定性显著收窄。

papers.title: Nonradial oscillation modes of axion condensed neutron stars in the Cowling approximation
papers.abstract: In light QCD axion models, finite-density corrections to the axion potential can source a nonvanishing axion field inside neutron stars. Extending our previous analysis of radial oscillations, we study the nonradial ($l=2$) oscillation spectrum of such axion condensed neutron stars in the relativistic Cowling approximation, keeping the fluid and axion perturbations fully coupled and dynamical. The condensate modifies the fluid spectrum in two ways: the altered equilibrium structure raises the $f$- and $p$-mode frequencies by up to $\sim20\%$, while the dynamical coupling to the axion field partially compensates this shift, almost entirely for the $f$-mode. Fluid modes with frequencies above the axion mass acquire a new damping channel through axion emission. The $f$-mode remains below this threshold for all configurations supporting a condensate, whereas the $p$-modes are damped on timescales that can be as short as $\sim10$ ms, shorter than their gravitational-wave damping times, except for certain axion masses where the outgoing axion amplitude nearly vanishes. The spectrum also contains a family of strongly damped axion-dominated quasinormal modes, with imaginary parts of order kHz, and a sequence of gravitationally bound axion states analogous to gravitational atom levels. Below the propagation threshold, the bound $p$-modes undergo avoided crossings with these levels, exchanging their fluid- and axion-dominated character.

classification.title_zh: Cowling 近似下轴子凝聚中子星的非径向振荡模式
classification.abstract_zh: 在轻 QCD 轴子模型中，轴子势的有限密度修正可在中子星内部产生非零轴子场。本文延续此前对径向振荡的分析，在相对论 Cowling 近似下研究此类轴子凝聚中子星的非径向（l=2）振荡谱，并保持流体扰动与轴子扰动完全耦合且动力学演化。凝聚体以两种方式修改流体谱：改变的平衡结构使 f 模和 p 模频率最多升高约 20%，而与轴子场的动力学耦合会部分补偿这一移动，对 f 模几乎完全补偿。频率高于轴子质量的流体模式会通过轴子发射获得新的阻尼通道。对于所有支持凝聚体的位形，f 模均低于该阈值；p 模则可在短至约 10 ms 的时间尺度上被阻尼，短于其引力波阻尼时间，但在某些轴子质量下出射轴子振幅几乎消失。谱中还包含一族强阻尼的轴子主导准正规模，其虚部量级为 kHz，以及一系列类似引力原子能级的引力束缚轴子态。在传播阈值以下，束缚 p 模会与这些能级发生避免交叉，交换其流体主导与轴子主导的特征。
classification.one_liner: 研究轴子凝聚中子星在 Cowling 近似下的 l=2 非径向振荡谱，分析 f/p 模频移、轴子发射阻尼、轴子主导准正规模及避免交叉。

papers.title: All Dark Matter as Primordial Black Holes: a Gravitational-Wave Test
papers.abstract: We propose a novel test for the hypothesis that the dark matter of the Universe is composed entirely by asteroidal-mass primordial black holes. It relies on detecting the stochastic gravitational-wave background generated by the coalescence onto rapidly spinning supermassive astrophysical black holes of the light primordial black holes accumulated in spherically symmetric spikes. We discuss the scenarios in which the signal can be observed by the future space-based gravitational-wave observatories LISA and DECIGO.

classification.title_zh: 全部暗物质为原初黑洞：一个引力波检验
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种检验宇宙暗物质完全由小行星质量原初黑洞组成这一假设的新方法。该方法依赖于探测球对称尖峰中积累的轻原初黑洞并合到快速旋转的超大质量天体物理黑洞上所产生的随机引力波背景。我们讨论了未来天基引力波天文台 LISA 和 DECIGO 可观测该信号的情景。
classification.one_liner: 提出利用轻原初黑洞并合到快速旋转超大质量黑洞产生的随机引力波背景，检验全部暗物质为小行星质量原初黑洞的假设。

papers.title: Weighing dark matter particles with gravitational waves
papers.abstract: It is commonly assumed that the mass of dark matter particles cannot be determined from their gravitational effects when dark matter behaves as collisionless matter. Here we show that extreme-mass-ratio inspirals observable by millihertz gravitational-wave observatories such as the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) could measure the mass of ultralight dark matter particles in sufficiently dense dark matter spikes. The separation of scales between the two black holes allows ultralight dark matter to form a collisionless density spike around the massive primary while retaining wave effects in its interaction with the stellar-mass companion. We incorporate wave-dependent accretion and dynamical friction into relativistic inspiral waveforms and jointly infer the dark matter particle mass, spike normalisation and binary parameters from simulated LISA signals. For massive black holes at the low-mass end of the LISA population ($M\sim 10^5 M_\odot$), our forecasts show that particle masses spanning $10^{-14}-10^{-11}\,\mathrm{eV}$ could be measured to within an order of magnitude.

classification.title_zh: 用引力波称量暗物质粒子
classification.abstract_zh: 通常认为，当暗物质表现为无碰撞物质时，无法从其引力效应确定暗物质粒子质量。本文表明，LISA 等毫赫兹引力波天文台可观测的极端质量比旋近，在足够致密的暗物质尖峰中，能够测量超轻暗物质粒子的质量。两个黑洞之间的尺度分离使超轻暗物质能在大质量主黑洞周围形成无碰撞密度尖峰，同时在与恒星级伴星的相互作用中保留波动效应。作者将依赖波动的吸积和动力学摩擦纳入相对论旋近波形，并从模拟的 LISA 信号中联合推断暗物质粒子质量、尖峰归一化和双星参数。对于处于 LISA 族群低质量端的大质量黑洞（M∼10^5 M⊙），预测显示 10^-14–10^-11 eV 范围内的粒子质量可被测量到一个数量级以内。
classification.one_liner: 利用 LISA 可观测的极端质量比旋近波形，结合超轻暗物质尖峰中的波动吸积与动力学摩擦，可对暗物质粒子质量给出量级约束。

papers.title: Gravitational wave signatures of periodic orbits around a Schwarzschild-like black hole
papers.abstract: We investigate how deviations from the Schwarzschild geometry affect the motion of massive test particles and the gravitational radiation associated with their periodic trajectories around a new improved Schwarzschild black hole. Periodic configurations are determined by examining the commensurability of the radial and azimuthal orbital frequencies. For representative trajectories, we numerically reconstruct the particle motion and calculate corresponding gravitational wave polarizations using the symmetric trace-free mass-quadrupole approach. By comparing these signals with their Schwarzschild counterparts, we assess how the modified spacetime geometry is encoded in the radiation. Our analysis shows that the parameters $\xi$ and $\gamma$ produce modest changes in the orbital configurations and their associated waveforms, providing a means of investigating the dynamical signatures of this BH model.

classification.title_zh: 类 Schwarzschild 黑洞周围周期轨道的引力波特征
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究偏离 Schwarzschild 几何如何影响大质量试验粒子的运动，以及围绕一种新改进 Schwarzschild 黑洞的周期轨迹所伴随的引力辐射。通过考察径向与方位角轨道频率的可公度性确定周期构型。对代表性轨迹，我们数值重构粒子运动，并用对称无迹质量四极矩方法计算相应的引力波偏振。通过将这些信号与 Schwarzschild 对应情形比较，我们评估修改后的时空几何如何编码在辐射中。分析表明，参数 ξ 和 γ 会对轨道构型及其相关波形产生适度改变，从而为研究该黑洞模型的动力学特征提供途径。

papers.title: Geodesic dynamics and tidal forces in a quantum-regularized black hole from string T-duality
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the geodesic dynamics and tidal force effects in neutral and electrically charged regular spacetimes inspired by T-duality. We first analyze the geometric properties of these solutions, including their regular central structure and horizon configurations, and show how the interplay between the T-duality scale $\ell_0$ and the electric charge $Q$ determines the transition between black hole and horizonless geometries. We then study the motion of massive and massless particles through the corresponding effective potentials, examining the existence and stability of circular orbits and the behavior of their characteristic radii. We further investigate the tidal forces experienced by observers in radial free fall, focusing on the behavior of the radial and angular components, their extrema and sign changes, and the location of these characteristic points relative to the horizon structure of the geometry. We show that the T-duality regularization renders the tidal forces finite in the central region and gives rise to different stretching and compression regimes, including a region of simultaneous compression in both the radial and angular directions, while the electric charge modifies the strength and location of these tidal features. Finally, we analyze the evolution of the geodesic deviation vector for two sets of initial conditions. We find that both the T-duality scale and the electric charge tend to suppress the accumulated radial stretching, whereas the angular deformation is considerably less sensitive to the charge. These results show how the quantum regularization induced by T-duality and the presence of electric charge modify the orbital dynamics and tidal response of these geometries in the strong-field regime. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the corresponding classical limits are recovered appropriately.

classification.title_zh: 弦T对偶诱导的量子正则化黑洞中的测地线动力学与潮汐力
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究由T对偶启发的中性和带电正则时空中的测地线动力学与潮汐力效应。作者分析这些解的几何性质，包括正则中心结构和视界构型，并说明T对偶标度ℓ0与电荷Q如何决定黑洞与无视界几何之间的转变。随后通过有效势研究有质量和无质量粒子运动，考察圆轨道的存在性、稳定性及其特征半径。文章进一步研究径向自由下落观测者感受到的潮汐力，关注径向和角向分量的行为、极值与符号变化，以及这些特征点相对于视界结构的位置。结果表明，T对偶正则化使中心区域潮汐力有限，并产生不同的拉伸和压缩区域，包括径向和角向同时压缩的区域，而电荷会改变这些潮汐特征的强度和位置。最后分析两组初始条件下测地线偏离矢量的演化，发现T对偶标度和电荷倾向于抑制累积的径向拉伸，而角向形变对电荷较不敏感；同时验证了相应的经典极限。

papers.title: Genesis in Minimally Modified Gravity
papers.abstract: We construct a Genesis scenario within the framework of a type-II minimally modified gravity. The background solution is past geodesically complete and approaches Minkowski spacetime in the asymptotic past. While the Hubble expansion rate grows, the matter sector satisfies the null-energy condition. Scalar perturbations are ghost-free and have no ultraviolet gradient instability, although the squared sound speed $c_\mathcal{R}^2$ becomes negative within a finite infrared region in the Fourier space for a finite time interval. Numerical evolution, including superhorizon growth, yields a nearly scale-invariant, slightly red-tilted scalar spectrum over a broad region of parameter space. The tensor spectrum is blue, with a strongly suppressed tensor-to-scalar ratio. Finally, using the matter fluctuation $\delta\chi$, whose asymptotic normalization is regular, we find that the background-dependent cubic couplings vanish in the far past at fixed nonzero momenta. The surviving matter--graviton and graviton self-interactions are Planck suppressed.

classification.title_zh: 最小修改引力中的 Genesis 场景
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在 type-II 最小修改引力框架内构造 Genesis 场景。背景解在过去测地完备，并在渐近过去趋近 Minkowski；Hubble 膨胀率增长，而物质部门满足零能条件。标量扰动无鬼且无紫外梯度不稳定性，尽管声速平方 c_R^2 在有限时间段的有限红外傅里叶区域为负。数值演化（含超视界增长）在较宽参数空间给出近尺度不变、略红倾的标量谱；张量谱为蓝谱且张标比受强抑制。最后，利用渐近归一化正规的物质涨落 δχ，发现远过去固定非零动量下依赖背景的三次耦合消失，剩余的物质-引力子与引力子自相互作用受 Planck 压低。
classification.one_liner: 构建过去测地完备的最小修改引力 Genesis，并显示标量谱近尺度不变、张量谱蓝且张标比受抑制。

papers.title: Realistic neutron stars in the constant-Q branch of f(Q) gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate the hydrostatic equilibrium and global structure of neutron stars within symmetric teleparallel gravity, where gravitational interactions are mediated by the non-metricity scalar $Q$. Working within the metric-affine formulation, we adopt the regular, constant-$Q$ branch ($Q = Q_*$) of $f(Q)$ gravity, which preserves regularity at the stellar centre while maintaining explicit dependence on the non-linear functional form through $f(Q_*)$ and its derivatives. We propose three novel non-linear $f(Q)$ extensions: (i) a Born-Infeld-inspired model, (ii) a Hu--Sawicki analogue, and (iii) a Tsujikawa-inspired model. Incorporating state-of-the-art realistic unified equations of state, namely GPPVA(DD2) and SLy4, we numerically solve the modified Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations and evaluate stellar stability via the Harrison-Zel'dovich-Novikov criterion. The Born-Infeld and Hu-Sawicki analogues smoothly recover the general relativistic limit as their control parameters increase, predicting stellar radii for low-mass objects ($M < 2.0\,M_\odot$) that match observational constraints from X-ray binaries and GW170817; however, their maximum masses remain capped below $2.43\,M_\odot$ (DD2) and $2.06\,M_\odot$ (SLy4). Conversely, the Tsujikawa-inspired model significantly stiffens the effective gravitational coupling, accommodating massive compact objects up to $\sim 3.36\,M_\odot$ and offering a viable physical origin for the $2.59_{-0.09}^{+0.08}\,M_\odot$ secondary object in GW190814, albeit at the expense of overpredicting radii for typical low-mass neutron stars. These contrasting behaviours demonstrate a key phenomenological complementarity between maximum mass and radius bounds within the constant-$Q$ framework, highlighting the utility of multimessenger observations in constraining non-linear non-metricity gravity.

classification.title_zh: f(Q)引力常Q分支中的真实中子星
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究对称远平行引力中由非度规标量Q中介的中子星流体静力学平衡与整体结构。作者在度规-仿射表述下采用f(Q)引力的正则常Q分支（Q=Q_*），该分支在星体中心保持正则性，同时通过f(Q_*)及其导数保留非线性函数形式的显式依赖。文章提出三种新的非线性f(Q)扩展：(i) Born-Infeld启发模型，(ii) Hu-Sawicki类比模型，(iii) Tsujikawa启发模型。结合GPPVA(DD2)和SLy4等现实统一物态方程，数值求解修正的Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff方程，并用Harrison-Zel'dovich-Novikov判据评估恒星稳定性。Born-Infeld和Hu-Sawicki类比模型随控制参数增大平滑恢复广义相对论极限，对低质量天体（M<2.0 M_太阳）给出的半径与X射线双星和GW170817观测约束相符；但其最大质量仍低于2.43 M_太阳（DD2）和2.06 M_太阳（SLy4）。相反，Tsujikawa启发模型显著硬化有效引力耦合，可容纳高达约3.36 M_太阳的大质量致密天体，并为GW190814中2.59_{-0.09}^{+0.08} M_太阳的次级天体提供可行物理起源，但代价是高估典型低质量中子星的半径。这些对比行为展示了常Q框架内最大质量与半径约束之间的现象学互补性，并凸显多信使观测在约束非线性非度规引力中的作用。
classification.one_liner: 在f(Q)引力常Q分支中，用真实物态方程求解修正TOV方程，比较三种非线性模型对中子星质量、半径和稳定性的预言。

papers.title: Improved constraints on higher-derivative effective field theory extensions of general relativity with GW230627_015337
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave (GW) observations of binary black holes provide a powerful probe of general relativity (GR) in the strong-field regime. In effective field theory (EFT) extensions of GR, higher-curvature operators modify the binary dynamics and introduce corrections to the inspiral phase. In this work, we consider two parity-even cubic-curvature couplings and one quartic-curvature coupling, whose leading phase corrections enter at 5PN, 6PN, and 8PN order, respectively. We incorporate these corrections into the individual multipoles of the \texttt{SEOBNRv5HM\_ROM} waveform using the flexible theory-independent framework, allowing higher-order modes and the full inspiral-merger-ringdown signal to be used in the analysis. We first perform a Fisher-matrix analysis of 92 binary-black-hole events selected from a parent sample of 273 events in the public LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA catalogs. GW230627\_015337 provides the tightest forecast constraints on all three EFT couplings and is therefore selected for a full Bayesian analysis. The posterior distributions are consistent with GR, with all three couplings consistent with zero at 90\% credibility. The corresponding one-sided 90\% upper limits on the characteristic length scales are \(17.1\), \(11.1\), and \(18.3\,\mathrm{km}\). The log Bayes factors of the three EFT models relative to GR range from \(-5.49\) to \(-2.51\), favoring GR under the adopted priors. These bounds probe higher-curvature length scales at the level of \(10\)--\(20\,\mathrm{km}\) and are numerically tighter than representative previous inspiral and ringdown constraints, although differences in the models and analysis assumptions should be taken into account.

classification.title_zh: 利用 GW230627_015337 改进对广义相对论高阶导数有效场论扩展的约束
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞引力波观测是强场区检验广义相对论（GR）的有力手段。在 GR 的有效场论（EFT）扩展中，高阶曲率算符会修改双星动力学，并对旋近相位引入修正。本文考虑两个宇称偶的三次曲率耦合和一个四次曲率耦合，其领头相位修正分别进入 5PN、6PN 和 8PN 阶。我们利用灵活的理论无关框架，将这些修正纳入 SEOBNRv5HM_ROM 波形的各个多极中，从而在分析中可使用高阶模和完整的旋近-并合-铃宕信号。我们首先对公共 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 目录中从 273 个母样本选出的 92 个双黑洞事件进行 Fisher 矩阵分析。GW230627_015337 对三个 EFT 耦合给出最紧的预报约束，因此被选作完整贝叶斯分析。后验分布与 GR 一致，三个耦合在 90% 可信度下均与零一致。相应特征长度尺度的单侧 90% 上限为 17.1、11.1 和 18.3 km。三个 EFT 模型相对 GR 的对数贝叶斯因子范围为 -5.49 到 -2.51，在所采用先验下支持 GR。这些界限在 10–20 km 量级探测高阶曲率长度尺度，数值上比代表性先前旋近和铃宕约束更紧，但应考虑模型和分析假设的差异。
classification.one_liner: 用 GW230627_015337 对 GR 的高阶曲率 EFT 耦合做全贝叶斯分析，结果与 GR 一致并给出 10–20 km 级长度尺度上限。

papers.title: On the Interpretation of Tests of the Horizon Area Law
papers.abstract: This Letter investigates gravitational-wave tests of the horizon area law. Although they provide a striking consistency check of general relativity (GR), these tests rely on models that assume GR, making their interpretation inherently model dependent. We show with a specific example---simulations of merging boson stars---that exotic compact objects can mimic merging black holes and pass an area-law test at a confidence as high as $\sim 92\%$ despite not even having event horizons.

classification.title_zh: 论视界面积定律检验的解释
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究引力波对视界面积定律的检验。尽管这些检验为广义相对论提供了显著的一致性检验，但它们依赖假设广义相对论的模型，因此其解释本质上依赖于模型。我们通过合并玻色星的模拟给出一个具体例子，表明奇异致密天体可以模仿合并黑洞，并在没有事件视界的情况下以高达约92%的置信度通过面积定律检验。
classification.one_liner: 合并玻色星模拟表明，无事件视界的奇异致密天体可模仿黑洞并以高置信度通过视界面积定律引力波检验，揭示此类检验的模型依赖性。

papers.title: A gaussian-process reconstruction of gravitational-wave friction from dark standard sirens
papers.abstract: Standard sirens provide a direct probe of the cosmic distance-redshift relation and therefore a powerful test of whether gravitational waves (GWs) propagate as predicted by general relativity on cosmological scales. In many extensions of general relativity, GW propagation is modified by an anomalous friction term, which alters the amplitude evolution and leads to a GW luminosity distance that differs from its electromagnetic counterpart. In this work, we develop a non-parametric reconstruction of this anomalous friction from dark standard sirens. We reconstruct its redshift dependence, encoded in the friction function $\alpha_M(z)$, with a Gaussian process (GP) and derive the corresponding GW-to-EM luminosity-distance ratio $\Xi(z)$ by integration, explicitly retaining the relation between the local friction modification and its accumulated effect on the observed distance, while enforcing a monotonic and invertible GW luminosity distance. We apply the method to the GWTC-5.0 catalog, jointly inferring the source population, modified propagation, and background cosmological parameters. We find no evidence for departures from GR, with $\alpha_M=0$ and $\Xi=1$ consistent with the posterior over the redshift range probed by the catalog. The result is stable under variations of the GP kernel, smoothness and amplitude priors, resolution prescription, and likelihood treatment. We further introduce function-space diagnostics for comparing flexible and parametric reconstructions, including prior calibration, prior-to-posterior contraction, common summaries of propagation-population degeneracies, and principal-component analysis. These tools make explicit which features are informed by the data and which are imposed by the function-space prior, providing a framework for interpretable non-parametric tests of gravitational-wave propagation.

classification.title_zh: 利用暗标准汽笛对引力波摩擦的高斯过程重构
classification.abstract_zh: 标准汽笛提供了宇宙距离-红移关系的直接探针，因而可强有力地检验引力波在宇宙学尺度上是否按广义相对论预言传播。在广义相对论的许多扩展中，引力波传播被反常摩擦项修正，改变振幅演化，并导致引力波光度距离不同于电磁对应体。本文从暗标准汽笛出发，对反常摩擦进行非参数重构。我们用高斯过程重构编码在摩擦函数 α_M(z) 中的红移依赖，并通过积分得到相应的引力波与电磁光度距离比 Ξ(z)，显式保留局域摩擦修正与其对观测距离累积效应之间的关系，同时强制引力波光度距离单调且可逆。我们将方法应用于 GWTC-5.0 目录，联合推断源族群、修改传播和背景宇宙学参数。未发现偏离广义相对论的证据，在所探测红移范围内 α_M=0 和 Ξ=1 与后验一致。结果在 GP 核、平滑度和振幅先验、分辨率方案及似然处理变化下稳定。我们进一步引入函数空间诊断，用于比较灵活重构与参数化重构，包括先验校准、先验到后验收缩、传播-族群简并的常见汇总以及主成分分析。这些工具明确了哪些特征由数据约束、哪些由函数空间先验施加，为可解释的引力波传播非参数检验提供框架。
classification.one_liner: 用高斯过程从暗标准汽笛重构引力波传播摩擦函数，并在 GWTC-5.0 中未发现偏离广义相对论的证据。

papers.title: Taub-NUT as gravitational dyon with torsion
papers.abstract: We show that the Levi-Civita connection for the Taub-NUT metric is singular on Misner strings and generates an Einstein tensor containing the squares of the delta function. This can be improved by introducing torsion, in which case the Einstein tensor may be interpreted as that of a cosmic string with negative variable tension. Komar flows in Misner strings are generated by torsion, which is therefore responsible for the asymptotic Komar charges. The Taub-NUT metric then appears as a soliton supported by two spin-fluid beams.

classification.title_zh: Taub-NUT 作为带挠率的引力双荷子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明 Taub-NUT 度规的 Levi-Civita 联络在 Misner 弦上奇异，并产生含 delta 函数平方的 Einstein 张量。引入挠率可改进这一点，使 Einstein 张量可解释为具有负可变张力的宇宙弦；Misner 弦中的 Komar 流由挠率产生，因此挠率决定渐近 Komar 荷。于是 Taub-NUT 度规表现为由两束自旋流体支撑的孤子。

papers.title: On the existence of toric ALE and ALF gravitational instantons
papers.abstract: We establish existence and uniqueness results for asymptotically locally Euclidean (ALE) and asymptotically locally flat (ALF) gravitational instantons. In particular, we prove the existence of a unique, Ricci-flat, toric ALE and ALF gravitational instanton, for every admissible rod structure, that is smooth up to possible conical singularites. We also give an elementary proof that any toric ALE or ALF self-dual instanton is a multi-Eguchi-Hanson or multi-Taub-NUT solution.

classification.title_zh: 关于环面 ALE 与 ALF 引力瞬子的存在性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了渐近局部欧氏（ALE）和渐近局部平坦（ALF）引力瞬子的存在性与唯一性结果。特别地，我们证明对每一个容许的杆结构，存在唯一的、Ricci 平坦的、环面 ALE 和 ALF 引力瞬子，其光滑至多可能有锥奇点。我们还给出一个初等证明：任何环面 ALE 或 ALF 自对偶瞬子都是多 Eguchi-Hanson 或多 Taub-NUT 解。

papers.title: Impact of a third body on binary neutron star tidal interactions
papers.abstract: To model a compact binary coalescence, it is commonly assumed that the binary evolves in isolation. In the present work, we relax this assumption by introducing a distant third body and investigate how the third body would affect the binary evolution. We treat this problem perturbatively and study tidal interaction in the binary due to the third body's presence. We introduce appropriate modifications to the equations governing the orbital motions and the evolution equations of the binary component's quadrupole moment. We compute the radiated energy and accumulated dephasing for the binary. Our findings indicate that for extreme-mass-ratio inspirals, these effects would not be significant. However, for binaries such as intermediate-mass-ratio inspirals, these effects are more relevant, and in some scenarios the accumulated dephasing can reach up to $\mathcal{O}(1)$ radians.

classification.title_zh: 第三体对双中子星潮汐相互作用的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 为模拟致密双星并合，通常假设双星在孤立环境中演化。本文放宽这一假设，引入一个遥远的第三体，并研究第三体如何影响双星演化。作者以微扰方式处理该问题，研究第三体存在时双星中的潮汐相互作用；对控制轨道运动的方程以及双星分量四极矩的演化方程引入适当修正，并计算辐射能量与累积相位亏损。结果表明，对于极端质量比旋近，这些效应不显著；但对于中等质量比旋近等双星，这些效应更为相关，在某些情形下累积相位亏损可达 O(1) 弧度。
classification.one_liner: 研究遥远第三体对双中子星潮汐相互作用、轨道演化与累积相位亏损的微扰影响。

papers.title: Cosmological and High Energy Physics implications from gravitational-wave background searches in LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA's O1-O4a runs
papers.abstract: We search for gravitational-wave background signals produced by various early Universe processes in the Advanced LIGO O4a dataset, combined with the data from the earlier O1, O2, and O3 (LIGO-Virgo) runs. The absence of detectable signals enables powerful constraints on fundamental physics. We derive gravitational-wave background energy density upper limits from the O1-O4a data to constrain parameters associated with various possible processes in the early Universe: first-order phase transitions, cosmic strings, domain walls, stiff equation of state, axion inflation, second-order scalar perturbations, primordial black hole binaries, and parity violation. In our analyses, the presence of an astrophysical background produced by compact (black hole and neutron star) binary coalescences throughout the Universe is also considered. We address the implications for various cosmological and high energy physics models based on the obtained parameter constraints. We conclude that LIGO-Virgo data already yield significant constraints on numerous early Universe scenarios.

classification.title_zh: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O1-O4a运行引力波背景搜索的宇宙学与高能物理启示
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用Advanced LIGO O4a数据集并结合此前的O1、O2和O3（LIGO-Virgo）数据，搜索早期宇宙各种过程产生的引力波背景信号。未探测到信号使我们可以对基础物理给出强约束。我们由O1-O4a数据得到引力波背景能量密度上限，用以约束早期宇宙中多种可能过程的参数：一阶相变、宇宙弦、畴壁、硬状态方程、轴子暴胀、二阶标量扰动、原初黑洞双星和宇称破坏。分析中还考虑了宇宙中致密（黑洞和中子星）双星并合产生的天体物理背景。我们讨论所获参数约束对各类宇宙学和高能物理模型的意义，并结论LIGO-Virgo数据已对众多早期宇宙情景给出显著约束。

papers.abstract: The goal of this note is to show that the standard BV formulation of gravity in the Palatini-Cartan formalism is equivalent, using a BV pushforward, to an AKSZ-like version compatible with BFV data on the boundary.

papers.title: Inverse KLT kernel of AdS string integrals from the intersection matrix
papers.abstract: We develop a topological and combinatorial interpretation of the Kawai--Lewellen--Tye (KLT) relations for $n$-point AdS string-amplitude building blocks, which are disk integrals with multivariable multiple polylogarithm insertions and sphere integrals with their single-valued counterparts. Building on the framework of twisted de Rham theory over a noncommutative ring, we reformulate the problem in terms of associahedral chambers of the moduli space loaded with solutions of the Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov equation. We construct regularized twisted cycles and express their intersection pairings through local monodromies and Drinfeld associators, which control transport between fusion-tree normalizations. Organizing the intersection contributions by common boundary faces yields the intersection matrix, which is identified with the inverse KLT kernel by the twisted period relation. The field-theory limit of the inverse KLT kernel is also given.

classification.title_zh: 从相交矩阵构造 AdS 弦积分的逆 KLT 核
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为 n 点 AdS 弦振幅构建块的 Kawai--Lewellen--Tye（KLT）关系发展拓扑与组合解释；这些构建块是带多变量多重多对数插入的圆盘积分，以及其单值对应物的球面积分。基于非交换环上的扭曲 de Rham 理论框架，我们把问题重述为模空间上的 associahedral chambers 并载有 Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov 方程的解。我们构造正则化扭曲循环，并通过局部单值性和 Drinfeld associator 表示其相交配对，这些控制融合树归一化之间的传输。按共同边界面组织相交贡献得到相交矩阵，并由扭曲周期关系将其认定为逆 KLT 核。还给出了逆 KLT 核的场论极限。

papers.title: Random Euclidean CFT$_2$ from Triangulated dS$_3$ Gravity
papers.abstract: We propose a random Euclidean CFT description of three-dimensional de Sitter gravity with fixed central charge and primary spectrum but fluctuating OPE coefficients. A normalized four-point coefficient extracted from the complex Liouville cosmological wavefunction matches the analytically continued tetrahedral Virasoro graph amplitude. Its two-copy form gives a non-Gaussian OPE correlation, with a modular $S$ transform relating the corresponding amplitude to fixed-angle Conformal Turaev--Viro theory. The $K_4$ graph also determines a compact hyperbolic core assembled from two generalized tetrahedra, with a pleated genus-three boundary. We reconstruct this core directly from a marked family of real Lorentzian de Sitter spacetimes expanding from a tetrahedral initial graph. Inverse normal flow collapses six future-boundary collars into geodesic cuffs. Initial spacelike arc lengths fix the exterior dihedral angles, while boost holonomies and marked seams determine the edge lengths and face pairings. Semiclassically, the OPE correlation acquires an oscillatory phase governed by hyperbolic volume, whose angle derivatives measure Lorentzian holonomies. As four necks of the future boundary pinch and the remaining bends vanish, its genus-three surface degenerates into two four-punctured spheres joined at four nodes. Sphere-tree sewing extends this relation between geometry and wavefunction coefficients to higher-point channels.

classification.title_zh: 由三角化 dS$_3$ 引力得到的随机欧几里得 CFT$_2$
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种随机欧几里得 CFT 描述，用于中心荷和主场谱固定但 OPE 系数涨落的三维 de Sitter 引力。由复 Liouville 宇宙学波函数提取的归一化四点系数，与解析延拓后的四面体 Virasoro 图振幅相匹配。它的双拷贝形式给出非高斯 OPE 关联，而一个模 $S$ 变换将相应振幅与固定角度的共形 Turaev--Viro 理论联系起来。$K_4$ 图还确定了一个由两个广义四面体拼成的紧致双曲核心，其边界为褶皱的亏格三曲面。我们直接从一族有标记的、由四面体初始图膨胀而来的实 Lorentzian de Sitter 时空重建该核心。逆法向流将六个未来边界领口收缩为测地袖口。初始类空弧长固定外部二面角，而 boost holonomies 与标记缝确定边长和面配对。半经典地，OPE 关联获得由双曲体积支配的振荡相位，其角度导数测量 Lorentzian holonomies。当未来边界的四个颈收缩且其余弯折消失时，其亏格三曲面退化为两个四穿孔球面在四个节点处相连。球树缝合将这种几何与波函数系数之间的关系推广到更高点通道。

papers.title: Finite-cutoff geometry in double-scaled SYK: SYK deformations, branes and CMC-Krylov complexity
papers.abstract: We develop a finite-cutoff holographic description of the double-scaled SYK (DSSYK) model. We construct microscopic deformations of Kourkoulou-Maldacena and thermofield-double SYK states whose double-scaling limits reproduce a lower-dimensional analogue of $\text{T}\overline{\text{T}}$ and $\text{T}\overline{\text{T}}+\Lambda_2$ deformations, which we denote $T^2$ and $T^2+\Lambda_1$, respectively. The ensemble-averaged theory describes wormhole states in finite-cutoff sine dilaton gravity, and finite-cutoff anti-de Sitter and de Sitter geometries in the low- and high-energy regimes, respectively. The analysis includes both perturbative and non-perturbative solutions to the energy spectrum flow equation, and the regions behind and beyond the respective horizons. Only the perturbative branch admits physical quantum states. We study how to incorporate end-of-the-world (ETW) branes in the finite cutoff holographic dictionary. The ETW brane leads to an additional boundary theory deformation, which leads to black hole or eternal traversable wormhole geometries depending on the existence of normalizable bound states. We extend the finite cutoff length evaluations for constant mean curvature (CMC) slices, which we interpret as complexity in the boundary theory. We discuss possible extensions with matter. Our results provide a microscopic framework for studying the finite-cutoff boundaries, CMC slices and branes in the holographic dictionary of DSSYK.

classification.title_zh: 双标度 SYK 中的有限截断几何：SYK 形变、膜与 CMC-Krylov 复杂度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为双标度 SYK（DSSYK）模型建立有限截断全息描述。构造 Kourkoulou-Maldacena 态与热场双态 SYK 态的微观形变，其双标度极限重现 T Tbar 及 T Tbar+Lambda2 形变的低维类似物，分别记为 T^2 与 T^2+Lambda1。系综平均理论描述有限截断 sine dilaton gravity 中的虫洞态，并在低能区与高能区分别对应有限截断 AdS 与 dS 几何。分析包含能谱流方程的微扰与非微扰解，以及视界后与视界外区域；只有微扰支允许物理量子态。我们研究如何在有限截断全息字典中纳入 end-of-the-world（ETW）膜。ETW 膜导致额外的边界理论形变，并根据是否存在可归一化束缚态给出黑洞或永恒可穿越虫洞几何。我们将常平均曲率（CMC）切片的有限截断长度计算进行推广，并将其解释为边界理论中的复杂度。最后讨论与物质耦合的可能扩展。我们的结果为在 DSSYK 全息字典中研究有限截断边界、CMC 切片与膜提供了微观框架。

papers.title: Thermodynamics and mechanical laws of causal-diamond horizons
papers.abstract: We develop a unified thermodynamic and mechanical framework for causal-diamond horizons in Minkowski spacetime. Euclidean regularity fixes the temperature $T_D=1/(\pi\alpha)$, where $2\alpha$ is the temporal extent of the diamond. The regulated Gibbons-Hawking-York contribution gives $I_D^E=-A_0/(4G)$, with $A_0$ the area of the horizon bifurcation surface, and the vanishing equilibrium geometric energy then yields the entropy-area relation $S_D=A_0/(4G)$. For weak matter perturbations crossing a localized portion of the future horizon, a Raychaudhuri analysis relates the associated Killing-energy flux to the area response, yielding a local physical-process first law at leading order near the bifurcation surface and, for classical matter satisfying the null energy condition, a local second law. Uniform conformal surface gravity establishes the zeroth law, while zero temperature is approached only in the limit $\alpha\to\infty$, in which the finite causal horizon disappears. These results show that a coherent horizon-law structure can arise within a causal diamond, a fundamental building block of the causal structure of Minkowski spacetime. The derivation is explicit in $(2+1)$ dimensions, while the physical results retain the same form for spherical causal diamonds in $d\geq3$.

classification.title_zh: 因果菱形视界的热力学与力学定律
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在Minkowski时空中为因果菱形视界建立统一的热力学与力学框架。欧几里得正则性固定温度为 T_D=1/(π α)，其中 2α 是因果菱形的时间延展。经过正则化的 Gibbons-Hawking-York 贡献给出 I_D^E=-A_0/(4G)，A_0 为视界分叉面的面积；平衡几何能量为零则导出熵-面积关系 S_D=A_0/(4G)。对于穿过未来视界局域部分的弱物质扰动，Raychaudhuri 分析将相应的 Killing 能量通量与面积响应联系起来，在分叉面附近领头阶给出局域物理过程的第一定律；对满足零能量条件的经典物质还给出局域第二定律。均匀共形表面引力确立第零定律，而零温仅在 α→∞ 的极限下趋近，此时有限因果视界消失。这些结果表明，在Minkowski时空因果结构的基本构件——因果菱形——中可以出现自洽的视界定律结构。推导在 (2+1) 维中显式给出，而物理结果对 d≥3 的球形因果菱形保持相同形式。

papers.title: A local second law for black hole dynamics in the charged large $D$ membrane paradigm
papers.abstract: The large $D$ membrane paradigm provides a perturbative, non-gravitational description of black hole dynamics. While the local second law of thermodynamics has been established for neutral membranes, the explicit determination of the local entropy production in the charged large $D$ membrane paradigm remains an open problem. In this paper, we compute the subleading-order correction to the divergence of the membrane velocity for a charged black hole in a flat background. Using the non-affine null Raychaudhuri equation and the Einstein-Maxwell equation at the physical event horizon, we relate the horizon expansion to the auxiliary membrane kinematics. We demonstrate that the membrane velocity produces a non-negative divergence at the first non-vanishing order in the membrane worldvolume, which is driven by two quadratic forms: the membrane shear and an additional term arising from the Maxwell field. Using this result, we subsequently construct the corresponding membrane entropy current and establish the non-negativity of its divergence through this order, thereby establishing the local second law for the charged large $D$ membrane paradigm.

classification.title_zh: 带电大D膜范式下黑洞动力学的局域第二定律
classification.abstract_zh: 大D膜范式为黑洞动力学提供了微扰的、非引力的描述。中性膜的局域热力学第二定律已经建立，但带电大D膜范式中局域熵产生的显式确定仍是未决问题。本文计算平直背景下带电黑洞膜速度散度的次领头阶修正，利用非仿射零Raychaudhuri方程与物理事件视界处的Einstein-Maxwell方程，将视界膨胀与辅助膜运动学联系起来。结果表明，膜速度在膜世界体第一个非零阶产生非负散度，由膜剪切和Maxwell场额外项两个二次型驱动。由此构造相应的膜熵流，并证明其散度到该阶非负，从而建立带电大D膜范式的局域第二定律。

papers.title: M2 brane in AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction to $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS Wilson loop vs localization in ABJM theory
papers.abstract: We study the quantization of an M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$, dual to the $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory. The classical action and the one-loop contribution were previously shown to reproduce the gauge-theory localization result. Here we extend the analysis to the two-loop order. In an adapted static and $\kappa$-symmetry gauge the world-volume action contains no cubic interaction vertices, so that the two-loop correction is determined entirely by quartic interactions and is manifestly free of logarithmic UV divergences. We find that the bosonic and fermionic contributions combine into a perfect square $ {\mathscr X}^2$ where ${\mathscr X}$ is a linear combination of the bosonic and fermionic 3d Green's functions and their derivatives. The evaluation of $\mathscr X$ requires fixing the $\mathrm{AdS}_2$ boundary quantization of the massless fermionic modes. With the boundary conditions selected by the preserved supersymmetry, $\mathscr X$ vanishes and hence the complete two-loop correction is found to be zero. This result would not be consistent with identifying the M2-brane loop expansion directly with the large-$N$ expansion of the canonical, fixed-$(N,k)$ localization prediction. Instead, it agrees precisely with the recent proposal that the semiclassical M2-brane partition function should be matched to the gauge-theory grand-canonical ensemble, in which the Wilson loop expectation value is perturbatively one-loop exact. The vanishing of the two-loop correction thus provides a non-trivial test of this grand-canonical identification.

classification.title_zh: AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$ 中的 M2 膜：$\frac{1}{2}$-BPS Wilson 圈的两圈修正与 ABJM 理论局域化比较
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究包裹 $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ 的 M2 膜在 $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ 中的量子化，该构型对偶于 ABJM 理论中的 $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS 圆形 Wilson 圈。此前经典作用量与单圈贡献已被证明可重现规范理论局域化结果；本文将分析推广到两圈阶。在适配的静态与 $\kappa$-对称规范下，世界体作用量不含三阶相互作用顶点，因此两圈修正完全由四阶相互作用决定，并且明显不存在对数紫外发散。作者发现玻色子与费米子贡献组合成一个完全平方 ${\mathscr X}^2$，其中 ${\mathscr X}$ 是玻色子与费米子三维格林函数及其导数的线性组合。计算 $\mathscr X$ 需要固定无质量费米子模的 $\mathrm{AdS}_2$ 边界量子化；在保持超对称所选择的边界条件下，$\mathscr X$ 消失，因此完整两圈修正为零。该结果与将 M2 膜圈展开直接等同于固定 $(N,k)$ 局域化预言的 large-$N$ 展开不相容；相反，它与近期提出的将半经典 M2 膜配分函数匹配到规范理论巨正则系综的提案精确一致，在该系综中 Wilson 圈期望值在微扰意义上单圈精确。两圈修正的消失因此为这一巨正则识别提供了非平凡检验。

papers.title: Quantum Effects in Supersymmetric Galilean Yang-Mills
papers.abstract: We study the quantum dynamics of supersymmetric Galilean Yang-Mills (SGYM), with a focus on three dimensions where there is a classical scale symmetry. This is believed to be the worldvolume theory describing D2-branes within type IIA non-relativistic string theory and arises as a non-relativistic limit of maximally supersymmetric (relativistic) Yang-Mills. Unlike the relativistic case, we find that SGYM only admits perturbative dynamical excitations on the Coulomb branch. We show that in three dimensions the classical scale symmetry is broken at one-loop due to logarithmic divergences which cannot be absorbed by renormalization of existing couplings. As such we find that SGYM is non-renormalizable. However, we argue that by including additional marginal deformations the original coupling can be renormalized and rendered asymptotically free. Finally, we propose that three-dimensional SGYM flows to a strongly coupled non-relativistic M2-brane theory.

classification.title_zh: 超对称伽利略杨-米尔斯中的量子效应
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究超对称伽利略杨-米尔斯（SGYM）的量子动力学，重点考察具有经典标度对称性的三维情形。该理论被认为描述 IIA 型非相对论弦理论中 D2 膜的世界体积理论，并可作为最大超对称（相对论）杨-米尔斯理论的非相对论极限得到。与相对论情形不同，我们发现 SGYM 只在库仑分支上具有微扰动力学激发。我们证明，在三维情形中，经典标度对称性在一圈层次由于对数发散而被破坏，且这些发散无法通过现有耦合的重整化吸收；因此 SGYM 是不可重整化的。然而，我们论证，通过引入额外的边缘形变，原耦合可以被重整化并使理论成为渐近自由的。最后，我们提出三维 SGYM 流向一个强耦合的非相对论 M2 膜理论。

papers.title: A discrete series gauge field at the late-time boundary of $dS_4$
papers.abstract: We study the free Maxwell field on the planar patch of four-dimensional de Sitter spacetime ($dS_4$). We review its bulk canonical quantization in the Bunch-Davies vacuum, and we give a representation-theoretic viewpoint by studying the transformation properties of single-particle states under infinitesimal dS transformations. By taking the late-time limit, we identify two late-time operators with scaling dimensions $\Delta=1$ (leading) and $\Delta=2$ (subleading). We introduce CFT-inspired inner products invariant under the dS group ($SO(4,1)$) for states created by late-time operators acting on the Bunch-Davies vacuum. We explain how the unitary discrete series representations of $SO(4,1)$ associated with the photon are furnished by both operators, in contrast with the Maxwell field on $AdS$ where the $\Delta=1$ operator corresponds to a non-normalizable mode. We also explain how the corresponding discrete series representations of $SO(4,1)$ split into a direct sum of representations corresponding to two helicities $+1$ and $-1$. This is achieved by taking advantage of the dS invariance of the self-dual and anti-self-dual sectors of the photon field strength. In our outlook, we draw inspiration from a recent proposal for the microscopic description of $dS_4$ higher-spin gravity where conformal gauge fields in 3 dimensions play a central role, and we investigate a possible connection of the $\Delta=1$ late-time operator with a conformal spin-1 gauge field in 3 dimensions.

classification.title_zh: dS_4 晚期边界上的离散系列规范场
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究四维 de Sitter 时空平面片上的自由 Maxwell 场。作者回顾了 Bunch-Davies 真空中的体正则量子化，并通过单粒子态在无穷小 dS 变换下的变换性质给出表示论视角。取晚期极限后，识别出标度维 Δ=1（领头）和 Δ=2（次领头）的两个晚期算符。作者引入在 dS 群 SO(4,1) 下不变、受 CFT 启发的内积，用于晚期算符作用于 Bunch-Davies 真空所产生的态。文中说明与光子相关的 SO(4,1) 酉离散系列表示如何由这两个算符共同提供，并与 AdS 上 Δ=1 算符对应非归一化模式的情形相对照。作者还说明 SO(4,1) 的相应离散系列表示如何分解为螺旋度 +1 和 -1 两个表示的直和，这是利用光子场强自对偶与反自对偶部分的 dS 不变性实现的。展望中，作者受近期关于 dS_4 高自旋引力微观描述（三维共形规范场起核心作用）的提议启发，探讨 Δ=1 晚期算符与三维共形自旋-1 规范场之间可能联系。
classification.one_liner: 研究 dS_4 中自由 Maxwell 场的晚期边界算符及其 SO(4,1) 离散系列表示，并探讨与三维共形规范场的可能联系。

papers.title: Gravitational Compton scattering at the fourth post-Minkowskian order
papers.abstract: We compute the classical gravitational Compton amplitude at the fourth post-Minkowskian order, $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$, within the Worldline Quantum Field Theory framework. We derive the associated $N$-matrix element, which provides the gravitational-wave scattering phase shift at the same order. As a nontrivial check, we show that our result agrees with black-hole perturbation theory.

classification.title_zh: 第四后闵可夫斯基阶的引力康普顿散射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在世界线量子场论框架下计算了四阶后闵可夫斯基（O(G^4)）的经典引力康普顿振幅，并导出相应的 N-矩阵元，从而给出同阶的引力波散射相移；作为非平凡检验，结果与黑洞微扰理论一致。
classification.one_liner: 在世界线量子场论中计算 O(G^4) 经典引力康普顿振幅并给出引力波散射相移，与黑洞微扰理论相符。

papers.title: Black hole thermodynamics and KK photon quantum corrections in 2D effective dilaton gravity
papers.abstract: We study black hole thermodynamics using a two-dimensional effective theory obtained by dimensional reduction of four-dimensional Einstein--Maxwell theory. For spherically symmetric charged black holes, the resulting dilaton gravity has a nonlinear potential that reproduces the semiclassical phase structure of four-dimensional AdS black holes, including the Hawking--Page transition and the small/large Reissner--Nordstr\"{o}m--AdS black hole transition. This shows that the two-dimensional theory before taking the near-horizon and near-extremal limits captures non-extremal thermodynamics beyond the Jackiw--Teitelboim gravity regime. We also include electromagnetic Kaluza--Klein modes on the internal sphere and integrate them out to derive the one-loop effective dilaton gravity. At leading order in the derivative expansion, these corrections appear as constant shifts in the black hole entropy and in the effective charge parameter of the dilaton potential. Therefore, the semiclassical phase structure is not qualitatively modified within this leading local approximation.

classification.title_zh: 二维有效膨胀引力中的黑洞热力学与KK光子量子修正
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用四维Einstein-Maxwell理论维数约化得到的二维有效理论研究黑洞热力学。对于球对称带电黑洞，所得膨胀引力具有非线性势，能够重现四维AdS黑洞的半经典相结构，包括Hawking-Page相变以及小/大Reissner-Nordström-AdS黑洞相变。这表明，在取近视界和近极端极限之前，该二维理论捕捉到了超出Jackiw-Teitelboim引力范围的非极端热力学。我们还把内部球面上的电磁Kaluza-Klein模式纳入，并将其积掉以推导单圈有效膨胀引力。在导数展开的领头阶，这些修正表现为黑洞熵和膨胀势中有效电荷参数的常数移动。因此，在此领头局域近似内，半经典相结构不会被定性改变。
classification.one_liner: 将四维Einstein-Maxwell球对称黑洞约化为二维膨胀引力，并计算KK光子单圈修正对黑洞热力学与相结构的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究黑洞热力学、Hawking-Page相变与RN-AdS相变，属于引力热力学和经典/半经典引力支线，但不涉及全息超流、探针膜、QNM或非均匀态等其它重点方向。

papers.title: Twirled Perfect Tensor Networks: Computationally covariant holographic tensor networks
papers.abstract: We define a novel class of tensor networks motivated by the Python's Lunch Conjecture (PLC) in local tensor network models of the black hole interior. We start from the observation that, for extended black brane states with short-range correlations, the PLC predicts a complexity that is smaller than the upper bound for generic short-range correlated states. We argue that the PLC makes implicit assumptions about the fine structure of the relevant tensor networks modeling gravity that render them non-generic. We demonstrate this explicitly in random tensor network models of the python's lunch, where the exponential complexity is not generally controlled by the PLC exponent. We trace the difference with the PLC to a lack of "computational covariance" in random tensor networks: while the PLC is motivated by an ability to arbitrarily decompose space into low-complexity units provided certain basic rules are followed, we show that random tensor networks do not generically have this property. We propose another class of tensor networks built from what we call "twirled perfect tensors" that do satisfy the computational covariance property and have a complexity bounded by the PLC value. We still find a discrete limitation from local postselection that appears to be absent in gravity. Moreover, we show that this class of tensor networks combines desirable holographic features of perfect tensor networks and random tensor networks, for example, it obeys a lattice Ryu-Takayanagi formula for arbitrary boundary subregions. Though motivated by holography, these tensor networks provide a flexible framework with potential applications beyond quantum gravity.

classification.title_zh: Twirled 完美张量网络：计算协变的全息张量网络
classification.abstract_zh: 我们定义了一类新的张量网络，其动机来自黑洞内部局域张量网络模型中的 Python's Lunch 猜想（PLC）。我们从以下观察出发：对于具有短程关联的扩展黑膜态，PLC 预言的复杂度低于一般短程关联态的上界。我们认为 PLC 对建模引力的相关张量网络的精细结构作了隐含假设，使其成为非一般的。我们在 python's lunch 的随机张量网络模型中明确展示了这一点：指数复杂度通常并不由 PLC 指数控制。我们将与 PLC 的差异追溯到随机张量网络缺乏“计算协变性”：虽然 PLC 的动机是在遵循某些基本规则时能够将空间任意分解为低复杂度单元，但我们表明随机张量网络一般不具有这一性质。我们提出另一类由我们称为“twirled perfect tensors”构建的张量网络，它确实满足计算协变性，并且复杂度被 PLC 值所界定。我们仍然发现来自局域后选择的离散限制，而这在引力中似乎不存在。此外，我们表明这类张量网络结合了完美张量网络和随机张量网络的可取全息特征，例如，它对任意边界子区域服从格点 Ryu-Takayanagi 公式。尽管受全息启发，这些张量网络提供了一个灵活的框架，可能在量子引力之外也有应用。
classification.one_liner: 提出 twirled perfect tensor networks，以满足计算协变性并给出受 Python's Lunch 猜想界定的复杂度，同时具有格点 RT 公式等全息特征。

papers.title: Bulk Phase Shift and Singularity
papers.abstract: High-energy scattering of a light particle off a black hole at fixed impact parameter is described by an eikonal phase, which encodes the resulting time delay and angular deflection. This bulk phase shift admits a holographic interpretation as of the thermal momentum-space two-point function of a scalar operator in the CFT in the Regge limit. At small impact parameter, the phase shift acquires an imaginary part signaling inelastic scattering, obscuring the interpretation of time delay and deflection which become complex-valued. However, in a holographic CFT these quantities can also be extracted from the so called bulk-cone singularities of the position space thermal correlator. Extending this analysis to small impact parameters, we find that the position-space correlator develops a singularity precisely when a null geodesic reflects off the black hole singularity and reaches the opposite boundary. This provides a more robust identification of bulk time delay and angular deflection through singularities of position-space correlators.

classification.title_zh: 体相移与奇点
classification.abstract_zh: 固定碰撞参数下，轻粒子被黑洞高能散射由 eikonal 相位描述，该相位编码相应的时间延迟与角偏转。这种体相移可全息解释为 CFT 中标量算符在 Regge 极限下的热动量空间两点函数。在小碰撞参数处，相移获得虚部，表示非弹性散射，使时间延迟与偏转成为复值并模糊其解释。然而在全息 CFT 中，这些量也可从位置空间热关联子的所谓 bulk-cone 奇点中提取。将这一分析推广到小碰撞参数，我们发现位置空间关联子恰在一条零测地线从黑洞奇点反射并到达对侧边界时出现奇点。这通过位置空间关联子的奇点，为体时间延迟与角偏转提供了更稳健的识别。
classification.one_liner: 通过位置空间热关联子的 bulk-cone 奇点，在小碰撞参数下更稳健地提取黑洞散射的体时间延迟与角偏转。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文讨论 eikonal 相移与 CFT 热两点函数之间的全息字典，并涉及黑洞散射与 bulk-cone 奇点，属于 AdS/CFT 基础字典及黑洞信息方向；但与所列超流超导、探针膜、QNM 等具体重点支线不直接重合。

papers.title: Timelike Entanglement Entropy and Renormalization Group Flow Irreversibility
papers.abstract: We study holographic $c$-theorems based on timelike entanglement entropy and show that timelike $c$-functions capture irreversible renormalization group (RG) flow. We demonstrate that timelike $c$-functions are applicable to both relativistic and nonrelativistic quantum matter in nematic phases with broken rotational symmetry, and that they remain monotonic along holographic anisotropic RG flows under explicit geometric conditions, thereby passing some of the most stringent consistency tests. We derive the exact flow of the composite timelike $c$-function in general homogeneous anisotropic geometries and establish the $c$-theorem for adiabatic flows. Across all classes of scaling backgrounds examined, consistent with the null energy condition and thermodynamic stability, the monotonicity condition universally reduces to a constraint on a running geometric effective dimension. We further construct a second $c$-function purely from the imaginary part of the timelike entanglement entropy and prove its monotonicity under the local effective-dimension condition, without requiring adiabaticity. For Poincar\'e-invariant flows, this condition follows directly from the null energy condition. Moreover, we identify a geometric upper bound on the rate of change of the timelike $c$-functions, which constrains how rapidly effective degrees of freedom can be coarse-grained. Our results suggest that capturing RG irreversibility in nonrelativistic flows requires observables that are intrinsically sensitive to the temporal direction. The applicability of holographic $c$-theorems is thus extended to highly nontrivial RG flows and points toward a new information-theoretic diagnostic of holographic RG dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 类时纠缠熵与重整化群流不可逆性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究基于类时纠缠熵的全息 c-定理，并表明类时 c-函数能够刻画不可逆的重整化群（RG）流。我们证明类时 c-函数适用于相对论与非相对论量子物质，包括破缺旋转对称性的向列相，并且在明确的几何条件下沿全息各向异性 RG 流保持单调，从而通过了一些最严格的一致性检验。我们推导了一般均匀各向异性几何中复合类时 c-函数的精确流动，并建立绝热流的 c-定理。在考察的所有标度背景类别中，与零能条件及热力学稳定性一致，单调性条件普遍约化为对跑动几何有效维度的约束。我们进一步仅由类时纠缠熵的虚部构造第二个 c-函数，并在局部有效维度条件下证明其单调性，而不要求绝热性。对于庞加莱不变流，该条件直接由零能条件推出。此外，我们给出类时 c-函数变化率的几何上界，它限制了有效自由度被粗粒化的速度。我们的结果表明，刻画非相对论流中的 RG 不可逆性需要本质上对时间方向敏感的观测量。因此，全息 c-定理的适用范围被推广到高度非平凡的 RG 流，并指向一种新的全息 RG 动力学信息论诊断。
classification.one_liner: 基于类时纠缠熵构造全息 c-函数，证明其沿各向异性 RG 流单调，并把不可逆性归结为对跑动有效维度的约束。

papers.title: Charged Black-Hole Binary Evolution at Second Post-Newtonian Order
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of electrically charged black-hole binaries and their gravitational-wave emission during the inspiral phase. Within the post-Newtonian framework, we derive the conservative and dissipative dynamics up to second order (2PN), combining Effective Field Theory and classical methods. We compute the NNLO conservative Lagrangian, LO dissipative effects in harmonic and Lorenz gauges, and provide the equations of motion, center-of-mass transformations, and the Lagrangian/Hamiltonian in ADM-type coordinates. We also obtain gauge-invariant expressions for the binding energy, periastron advance in quasi-circular orbits, and the scattering angle in unbound orbits. Our results extend previous analyses and are fully consistent with recent post-Minkowskian findings.

classification.title_zh: 后牛顿二阶带电黑洞双星演化
classification.abstract_zh: 研究带电黑洞双星在旋近阶段的动力学及其引力波辐射。在后牛顿框架内，结合有效场论与经典方法，推导至二阶（2PN）的保守与耗散动力学。计算NNLO保守拉格朗日量、谐和规范与Lorenz规范下的领头阶耗散效应，并给出运动方程、质心变换以及ADM型坐标中的拉格朗日量与哈密顿量。还得到束缚能、准圆轨道近星点进动和无束缚轨道散射角的规范不变表达式。结果扩展了先前分析，并与近期后闵可夫斯基结果完全一致。
classification.one_liner: 在后牛顿二阶精度下系统推导带电黑洞双星的保守与耗散动力学及引力波观测量。

papers.title: Holographic Timelike c-function
papers.abstract: The integration of high-energy degrees of freedom along the renormalization group (RG) flow in Poincar\'e-invariant theories is captured by a monotonic c-function. For such theories, holographic c-functions have been constructed using entanglement entropy. However, in theories with broken Lorentz invariance, these constructions generally fail, reflecting both the violation of entanglement RG monotonicity and its limitations in capturing essential features of nonrelativistic RG flows. Since many quantum many-body systems lack Lorentz invariance, it is important to identify a quantity that captures the decrease of effective degrees of freedom along such flows. We show that the recently introduced holographic timelike entanglement entropy naturally gives rise to a new c-function applicable to all such theories, which moreover obeys a geometric upper bound on its rate of change. We further demonstrate the existence of this c-function in theories with Lifshitz and hyperscaling-violating fixed points, showing that, provided the null energy condition, thermodynamic stability and explicit geometric conditions on the flow are satisfied, it obeys the expected RG monotonicity.

classification.title_zh: 全息类时c函数
classification.abstract_zh: 在庞加莱不变理论中，沿重整化群（RG）流积分掉高能自由度由单调c函数刻画，全息c函数已利用纠缠熵构造。然而，在洛伦兹不变性破缺的理论中，这些构造通常失效，既反映纠缠RG单调性的破坏，也反映其在刻画非相对论RG流本质特征方面的局限性。由于许多量子多体系统缺乏洛伦兹不变性，找到一个能刻画这些流中有效自由度减少的量很重要。本文证明，最近引入的全息类时纠缠熵自然给出一个适用于所有这些理论的新c函数，且其变化率满足几何上界。作者进一步在具有Lifshitz和hyperscaling破坏不动点的理论中证明该c函数的存在，并表明在满足零能条件、热力学稳定性以及流的显式几何条件时，它满足预期的RG单调性。
classification.one_liner: 利用全息类时纠缠熵为破坏洛伦兹不变性的理论构造满足几何上界和RG单调性的c函数，并在Lifshitz与hyperscaling破坏不动点中得到验证。

papers.title: Decoupled asymmetric thin-shell wormholes
papers.abstract: We construct reflection-asymmetric thin-shell wormholes by joining a Schwarzschild exterior to its minimal geometric deformation, which shares the same mass and redshift function, so that the asymmetry is carried entirely by the gravitational-decoupling sector. The deformed side is a black hole sourced by a scalar field coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics, in its branch with a real scalar. We show that the total radial null energy of shell and bulk obeys an exact identity and becomes positive for a sufficiently strong deformation. The momentum flux across the shell equals the radial null-energy density of the bulk, and retaining it yields the linear stability condition in closed form. We prove that stability with a conventional shell response requires the bulk to violate the radial null energy condition at the throat; the deformation instead enlarges the stable domain and moves the transition radius inside the photon sphere. For a stationary extension built on Kerr, the junction is solved exactly in the spin, which fixes how the angular momentum is shared between shell and bulk and where the shell behaves as a rotating fluid. A free-precession model provides an estimate of the gravitational-wave signal of the throat.

classification.title_zh: 解耦的非对称薄壳虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过将Schwarzschild外部与它的最小几何变形解拼接，构造反射不对称薄壳虫洞；两者共享相同质量和红移函数，因此不对称性完全由引力解耦部分承载。变形侧是由标量场耦合非线性电动力学所源的黑洞，取实标量分支。我们证明壳与体的总径向零能量满足精确恒等式，并在变形足够强时变为正。跨壳动量通量等于体的径向零能量密度，保留它可得到闭式线性稳定性条件。我们证明，采用常规壳响应时稳定性要求喉部体违反径向零能量条件；而变形扩大了稳定域，并将转变半径移入光子球内。对于基于Kerr的稳态延拓，结条件可在自旋中精确求解，从而确定角动量如何在壳与体之间分配，以及壳在何处表现为旋转流体。自由进动模型给出了喉部引力波信号的估计。
classification.one_liner: 构造反射不对称薄壳虫洞，并分析其稳定性、Kerr稳态延拓与喉部引力波信号。

papers.title: From Specific Heat Bounds to Penrose-like Inequalities: A Unified Thermodynamic Perspective
papers.abstract: Under explicit and physically motivated assumptions, we identify a local-to-global thermodynamic mechanism that organizes several previously disconnected inequalities on black holes. We first focus on asymptotically flat, static, and spherically-symmetric black holes, and provide a unified thermodynamic perspective on various Penrose-like inequalities. We also discuss the generalizations in asymptotically Schwarzschild anti-de Sitter black holes/branes. In holographic settings, these bounds imply monotonic behavior of normalized thermodynamic quantities in the dual field theory. Notably, one central integrated inequality can be established directly under the NEC in general static planar symmetric asymptotically Schwarzschild anti-de Sitter black branes. Our purpose is not to claim a fully general proof of the proposed local bounds, but to expose a unified structural perspective connecting local thermodynamic constraints to global geometric inequalities. Establishing the local bounds beyond the classes considered here remains an open problem.

classification.title_zh: 从比热界到类 Penrose 不等式：统一的热力学视角
classification.abstract_zh: 在明确且具有物理动机的假设下，我们识别出一种从局域到全局的热力学机制，用以组织若干此前互不关联的黑洞不等式。我们首先聚焦渐近平直、静态、球对称黑洞，为多种类 Penrose 不等式提供统一的热力学视角。我们还讨论在渐近 Schwarzschild anti-de Sitter 黑洞/膜中的推广。在全息背景下，这些界意味着对偶场论中归一化热力学量的单调行为。值得注意的是，一个核心的积分不等式可在一般静态平面对称渐近 Schwarzschild AdS 黑洞膜的零能量条件（NEC）下直接建立。我们的目的不是声称对所提出的局域界给出完全一般的证明，而是揭示连接局域热力学约束与全局几何不等式的统一结构视角。在本文考虑的类型之外建立局域界仍是开放问题。
classification.one_liner: 该文提出从局域热力学约束到全局几何不等式的统一框架，并在全息 AdS 黑洞/膜背景下讨论对偶热力学量的单调性。
classification.relevance_reason: 主要属于经典黑洞热力学与几何不等式；虽涉及全息对偶热力学量的单调性，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超流/多分量序参量/探针膜等主线，因此相关度为中等。

papers.title: Exact spinning wormholes in five dimensions from Toda integrability
papers.abstract: We construct a new exact solution to the five-dimensional Einstein-phantom-scalar system that describes a rotating wormhole connecting two asymptotically flat regions. The solution represents a rotating generalization of the Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole with equal angular momenta. Under the cohomogeneity-one ansatz, we demonstrate that the radial equations reduce to an integrable $A_1\oplus A_2$ Toda system, from which the general local solution can be obtained in closed form. This integrable structure enables us to implement the regularity and asymptotic-flatness conditions analytically, thereby singling out a three-parameter family of solutions characterized by the mass, the equal angular momenta, and the scalar charge. The resulting spacetimes are geodesically complete, horizonless and stably causal, and contain no curvature singularities. The Toda structure further allows us to prove the uniqueness of the wormhole throat and to derive a sharp upper bound on the angular momentum for a fixed throat area. We also establish the existence and uniqueness of an ergosurface with respect to the stationary frame that is nonrotating at one asymptotic end, while the opposite end rotates relative to this frame. In a suitable scaling limit, the scalar field vanishes and the solution approaches the exterior region of the extremal Myers-Perry black hole with equal angular momenta.

classification.title_zh: 来自 Toda 可积性的五维精确旋转虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: 本文构造了五维 Einstein-phantom-scalar 系统的一个新精确解，描述连接两个渐近平直区域的旋转虫洞，是等角动量 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞的旋转推广。在 cohomogeneity-one 拟设下，径向方程化为可积的 A1⊕A2 Toda 系统，并可得到闭式一般局部解。利用该可积结构可解析施加正则性与渐近平直条件，从而选出由质量、等角动量和标量荷刻画的 3 参数解族。所得时空测地完备、无视界、稳定因果且无曲率奇点。Toda 结构还用于证明虫洞喉的唯一性，并给出固定喉面积下角动量的尖锐上界。文章还证明存在唯一一个相对于在一个渐近端不旋转的静止参考系的能层，而另一端相对于该参考系旋转。在适当标度极限下，标量场消失，解趋近于等角动量极端 Myers-Perry 黑洞的外部区域。
classification.one_liner: 利用 Toda 可积结构构造并解析刻画了五维等角动量旋转虫洞精确解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究五维 Einstein-phantom-scalar 精确旋转虫洞、正则性与渐近平直条件、能层及极端 Myers-Perry 极限，属于经典引力/广义相对论精确解方向，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；摘要未涉及全息。

papers.title: Massive Scalar Quasinormal Modes and Quasibound States of Charged Black Holes with Logarithmic corrections
papers.abstract: We study how long-range deformations in a black-hole metric affect the oscillation, trapping, and decay of a neutral, minimally coupled massive scalar field. We choose a logarithmic deformation of Reissner-Nordstr\"om (RN) sourced by nonlinear electrodynamics. It provides an exact solution of Einstein gravity and admits a finite completion. The same geometry also arises in a phenomenological perfect-fluid dark-matter model. In this setup, we analyze both quasinormal modes (QNMs), which describe relaxation, and quasibound states (QBSs), which describe trapped modes with small horizon absorption. We first show that a small scalar mass moves the potential barrier outward, raises it, and reduces its curvature. First-order WKB then predicts weaker damping at every fixed finite multipole and overtone. We then compare several approaches, namely sixth-order WKB, global matching, a generalized Leaver method (adapted to the logarithmic geometry) and time-domain evolution. All methods yield consistent QNM estimates within their ranges of validity. Global matching and Leaver also agree closely for QBSs. Further analytic estimates with a reference trapped state show that a local Pad\'e approximation gives a binding-energy error of about $0.04\%$, while leading Gamow tunnelling underestimates damping by about $25\%$. Across the sampled QBSs, increasing the scalar mass or nonlinear coupling strengthens binding but shortens the lifetime through greater horizon absorption. Finally, using an appropriate horizon regularization and a common complex radial contour, we demonstrate orthogonality of an independently computed QNM-QBS pair using a suitable relativistic bilinear framework.

classification.title_zh: 带对数修正的带电黑洞的大质量标量拟正规模与准束缚态
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究黑洞度规中的长程变形如何影响中性最小耦合大质量标量场的振荡、囚禁与衰减。所考虑的模型是非线性电动力学产生的 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞的对数变形，它是 Einstein 引力的精确解并具有有限完成；同一几何也出现在唯象完美流体暗物质模型中。作者分析描述弛豫的拟正规模（QNM）和描述带小视界吸收的囚禁模式的准束缚态（QBS）。结果表明，小标量质量使势垒外移、升高并降低其曲率，一阶 WKB 预言在固定有限多极子和泛音下阻尼减弱。随后用六阶 WKB、全局匹配、适配对数几何的广义 Leaver 方法以及时域演化进行比较，各方法在其有效范围内给出一致的 QNM 估计；全局匹配与 Leaver 对 QBS 也高度一致。进一步的解析估计显示，局部 Padé 近似给出的束缚能误差约 0.04%，而领头 Gamow 隧穿把阻尼低估约 25%。在所采样的 QBS 中，增大标量质量或非线性耦合会增强束缚，但因更强的视界吸收而缩短寿命。最后，通过适当的视界正则化和共同的复径向围道，作者用合适的相对论双线性框架证明了一对独立计算的 QNM-QBS 的正交性。
classification.one_liner: 研究对数修正带电黑洞中大质量标量场的 QNM 与准束缚态，并比较多种计算方法及验证正交性。
classification.relevance_reason: 与用户关注的 QNM 和经典引力/黑洞扰动支线直接相关；不涉及全息、量子信息或量子引力。

papers.title: Acoustic Schwarzschild-like black hole and analogous Hawking radiation in Einstein-bumblebee gravity
papers.abstract: We derive an acoustic Schwarzschild-like black hole and study its analogous Hawking radiation in Einstein-bumblebee theory by using Gross-Pitaevskii theory in the background of Schwarzschild-like spacetime. This black hole have two kinds of event horizons: one is the gravitational horizon $r_h=2M$(black hole horizon), the others are the internal and external acoustic horizons $2M<r_{ac-}\leq4M,\;r_{ac}\geq4M$(dumb hole horizon) which depend on the tuning parameter $\xi$ and Lorentz violation coupling constant $\ell$. The corresponding Hawking temperature $T_h$ depends only on $\ell$, however $T_{ac}$ depends on $\ell$ and $\xi$. The dumb hole temperature $T_{ac}$ has a maximum $T_{acm}=T_h/8$. When considering the scalar particles radiating from the dumb hole, we find that in low frequency, the grey-body factor increases with the tuning parameter $\xi$, but decreases with $\ell$. In the high frequency, it approaches to $1$. Its energy emission rate is similar to the Planck's black spectrum where there has a maximum at a given peak frequency $\omega_m$. The energy emission rate also increases with the tuning parameter $\xi$, but decreases with $\ell$. This opposite dependence relationship is the most experimentally valuable feature and can directly benchmark against observations of real astrophysical black holes.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-bumblebee 引力中的声学 Schwarzschild 类黑洞及类比霍金辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用 Schwarzschild 类时空背景下的 Gross-Pitaevskii 理论，在 Einstein-bumblebee 理论中导出声学 Schwarzschild 类黑洞，并研究其类比霍金辐射。该黑洞具有两类事件视界：一类是引力视界 r_h=2M（黑洞视界），另一类是由调节参数 ξ 和洛伦兹破坏耦合常数 ℓ 决定的内、外声学视界 2M<r_ac-≤4M、r_ac≥4M（dumb hole 视界）。相应的霍金温度 T_h 只依赖于 ℓ，而 T_ac 依赖于 ℓ 和 ξ。dumb hole 温度 T_ac 有最大值 T_acm=T_h/8。考虑从 dumb hole 辐射的标量粒子时，我们发现低频下灰体因子随调节参数 ξ 增大，但随 ℓ 减小；高频下其趋于 1。其能量发射率类似于普朗克黑体谱，并在给定峰值频率 ω_m 处有最大值。能量发射率也随 ξ 增大，但随 ℓ 减小。这种相反的依赖关系是最具实验价值的特点，可直接与真实天体物理黑洞的观测进行比对。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-bumblebee 时空中用 Gross-Pitaevskii 理论构造声学 Schwarzschild 类黑洞，并研究其视界、霍金温度、灰体因子与能量发射率。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/黑洞与类比霍金辐射，涉及修改引力时空和声学视界，与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论相关；但不是全息研究，也未涉及全息超流超导、多分量序参量、multi-trace 等全息重点方向。

papers.title: Theory and Cosmology of Biverse Volume-Normalized Gravity
papers.abstract: This dissertation expounds the biverse volume-normalized gravity, a novel theoretical framework of classical and quantum gravity that provides an unusual solution to the cosmological constant problem, the 60-degree-of-magnitude discrepancy between the value of the vacuum energy density in our universe predicted by particle physics and that implied by cosmological data. In the literature, there exist two interesting ideas: 1) to use the "volume-normalized" action functional, the usual action of the particle Standard Model and general relativity but divided by the spacetime volume, first proposed by Tseytlin; 2) to generate the vacuum energy density dynamically by assigning a ghost-free massive potential to the graviton. However, each has a problem: Tseytlin's attempt suffers from diverging quantum loops and the massive gravity theory has a second metric tensor with questionable origin and the quantum strong coupling problem. Inspired by these two ideas, as well as the AdS/CFT correspondence in string theory, the biverse volume-normalized gravity extends Tseytlin's idea by placing our (3+1)-dimensional universe on the boundary of a (4+1)-dimensional bulk space. This new adaptation controls the large quantum gravity loops in the limit of vanishing ratio of the spacetime volume of our universe to that of the other universe. The ghost-free massive gravity can then be seamlessly incorporated, not only that its otherwise nebulous second metric tensor appears naturally as the pullback of the bulk metric on the boundary, but its strong coupling problem also solved. The biverse volume-normalized gravity is also consistent with all tested models of particle cosmology and the evolution of the universe, and nontrivially predicts that the tensor-to-scalar ratio of our universe is exactly zero.

classification.title_zh: 双宇宙体积归一化引力的理论与宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 本论文阐述双宇宙体积归一化引力，这是一种新的经典与量子引力理论框架，为宇宙学常数问题（粒子物理预言的真空能量密度与宇宙学数据暗示值之间约60个数量级的差异）提供了不同寻常的解决方案。文献中存在两个有趣想法：1）使用“体积归一化”作用量泛函，即粒子标准模型与广义相对论的通常作用量除以时空体积，由 Tseytlin 首先提出；2）通过给引力子赋予无鬼大质量势来动态产生真空能量密度。然而二者各有问题：Tseytlin 的尝试受量子圈发散困扰，而大质量引力理论有来源可疑的第二度规张量以及量子强耦合问题。受这两个想法以及弦论中的 AdS/CFT 对应启发，双宇宙体积归一化引力扩展 Tseytlin 的想法，将我们的 (3+1) 维宇宙置于 (4+1) 维体空间的边界上。这一新改编在我们宇宙与另一宇宙时空体积比趋于零的极限下控制大的量子引力圈。无鬼大质量引力随后可无缝纳入：其原本模糊的第二度规张量自然表现为体度规在边界上的拉回，其强耦合问题也得到解决。双宇宙体积归一化引力还与所有已检验的粒子宇宙学模型和宇宙演化一致，并非平凡地预言我们宇宙的张量标量比恰好为零。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种受 AdS/CFT 启发的双宇宙体积归一化引力框架，以边界/体配置处理宇宙学常数并预言张量标量比为零。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文使用 AdS/CFT 启发的边界/体结构并讨论量子引力与宇宙学常数，但与用户列出的全息凝聚态、全息超导、QNM、探针膜等具体重点支线不直接对应；相关性主要来自全息启发和引力理论。

papers.title: Graph-Based Algorithms for Worldline EFT Integrands
papers.abstract: We present novel graph-centered algorithms for the construction and representation of worldline effective field theory (WEFT) integrands that separate the topological and algebraic structure of loop integrands into independent graph-numerator pairs. In this representation, the graph encodes all propagators, worldline source and sink vertices, momentum routing, i0 prescriptions, and proper-time dependence, while the numerator carries only the minimal algebraic, tensorial content. To construct integrands at fixed post-Minkowskian order we propose a generalized Berends-Giele construction that minimizes the number of expensive tensor contraction operations. We also discuss simplification and canonicalization strategies through "serialization" of worldline propagators and the application of "selfie"-subdiagram partial-fraction identities, yielding a minimal canonical topology basis. We further show that the graph-numerator representation naturally generalizes the notion of an integral family and its sectors, relevant for integration-by-parts (IBP) reduction: propagators are not constrained to a single master labeling, and each sector carries its own minimal set of independent scalar products, completing into an overcomplete global family. This setup minimizes the total number of required integral sectors through an optimal use of sector symmetries and enables independent optimization of propagator labeling for IBP reductions. The algorithms are implemented in the Rust crate FeynRIR, which is currently able to efficiently compute integrands for the variation of the effective WEFT action, the equations of motion for the worldlines and the (radiation-reacted) impulse.

classification.title_zh: 世界线 EFT 被积函数的图算法
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出以图为中心的算法，用于构造和表示世界线有效场论（WEFT）被积函数，将圈图被积函数的拓扑结构与代数结构分离为图-分子对。图编码传播子、世界线源/汇顶点、动量路由、i0  prescription 和固有时依赖，分子只携带最小代数与张量内容。为在固定 post-Minkowskian 阶构造被积函数，作者提出广义 Berends-Giele 构造以减少昂贵的张量收缩；并讨论通过世界线传播子“序列化”和“selfie”子图部分分式恒等式进行化简与规范化，得到最小规范拓扑基。文章还表明图-分子表示自然推广积分族及扇区概念，适用于 IBP 约化：传播子不限于单一主标号，每个扇区有自身最小独立标量积，构成过完备全局族；这可利用扇区对称性减少所需积分扇区并独立优化传播子标号。算法实现在 Rust crate FeynRIR 中，目前可高效计算 WEFT 有效作用量变分、世界线运动方程及（含辐射反作用的）冲量的被积函数。
classification.one_liner: 提出图-分子表示与算法，用于高效构造世界线 EFT 被积函数并服务 post-Minkowskian 经典引力计算。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文面向世界线 EFT 与 post-Minkowskian 被积函数算法，属于经典引力/引力波解析计算的方法学工作；不涉及全息或量子引力，故与全息重点支线不直接相关，但与经典引力支线相关。

papers.title: Exact lattice bosonization of the double-scaled $c=1$ matrix model
papers.abstract: In a recent paper by two of us, it has been shown that entanglement entropy (EE) of matrix quantum mechanics (or, equivalently, of a non-relativistic fermion model) has a natural interpretation in terms of an exact bosonization of the fermion theory in terms of a lattice boson with lattice spacing $\sim 1/N$ (where $N$ is the rank of the matrix, equal to the number of fermions). The theory of this lattice boson is distinct from a latticized version of the "collective variable'' theory which is formulated in terms of the fermion density $\rho(\lambda)$ ("collective variable''); it is, in fact, more closely related to the Wigner distribution of the fermions. In this paper, we develop this connection further for the $c=1$ double scaled matrix model. Even though $N$ becomes infinite, the double scaled theory is described by a boson on a finite and non-uniform lattice spacing, of order $\sim g_s(x) l_s$ (where $g_s(x) \equiv g_s {\rm cosech}^2(x/l_s)$ is a position dependent string coupling). We explicitly derive the $c=1$ EE, as well as the one and two-point functions of fermion density from the lattice boson. The results are explicitly finite, unlike the collective variable theory which is shown to yield divergent answers. Our results suggest that while local observables such as the EE and $\langle \rho(\lambda) \rangle$, are characterized by a unique short distance scale $g_s(x) l_s$, the asymptotic observables such as the S-matrix at every genus are characterized by a short distance scale $l_s$. We show how this arises and discuss a possible interpretation in terms of D0 brane physics.

classification.title_zh: 双标度 c=1 矩阵模型的精确格点玻色化
classification.abstract_zh: 在最近由我们中两人发表的一篇论文中已经表明，矩阵量子力学（等价于非相对论费米子模型）的纠缠熵可以自然地解释为用格距约为 1/N 的格点玻色子对费米子理论进行精确玻色化（N 为矩阵秩，等于费米子数）。这种格点玻色子理论与以费米子密度 ρ(λ) 表述的“集体变量”理论的格点化版本不同；事实上，它更接近费米子的 Wigner 分布。本文针对 c=1 双标度矩阵模型进一步发展这一联系。尽管 N 变为无穷，双标度理论由一个位于有限且非均匀格距（量级约为 g_s(x) l_s，其中 g_s(x)=g_s cosech^2(x/l_s) 是位置依赖的弦耦合）上的玻色子描述。我们显式从格点玻色子导出 c=1 纠缠熵以及费米子密度的一点和两点函数。结果是显式有限的，而集体变量理论被表明给出发散答案。我们的结果提示：虽然诸如纠缠熵和 ⟨ρ(λ)⟩ 这样的局域可观测量由唯一的短距离尺度 g_s(x) l_s 刻画，但诸如每个亏格上的 S 矩阵这样的渐近可观测量由短距离尺度 l_s 刻画。我们展示这是如何产生的，并讨论其与 D0 膜物理的可能解释。
classification.one_liner: 在 c=1 双标度矩阵模型中构造精确格点玻色化，得到有限纠缠熵与密度关联函数。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于 c=1 矩阵模型、纠缠熵与 D0 膜/弦论方向，未直接涉及用户重点列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Holographic entropy inequalities & typical states
papers.abstract: As a consequence of the Ryu-Takayanagi formula, static semiclassical states in AdS quantum gravity share a set of special properties expressible as linear inequalities on their entanglement entropies. How general are these properties? Do they still hold when we move away from the regime of validity of RT, i.e. static states in classical Einstein gravity? Do they perhaps hold even for some class of non-holographic states? We will motivate these questions and review what's known about the answers.

classification.title_zh: 全息熵不等式与典型态
classification.abstract_zh: 作为Ryu-Takayanagi公式的结果，AdS量子引力中的静态半经典态共享一组可表述为纠缠熵线性不等式的特殊性质。这些性质有多普遍？当我们离开RT的适用区域，即经典Einstein引力中的静态态时，它们是否仍然成立？它们是否甚至对某些非全息态也成立？我们将引出这些问题并综述已知答案。
classification.one_liner: 综述RT公式引出的全息纠缠熵线性不等式及其在典型态、超越半经典极限和非全息态中的普适性问题。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接讨论全息纠缠熵不等式与RT公式，属于AdS/CFT量子信息方向，但不涉及用户列出的超流超导、探针膜、QNM或经典引力等具体重点支线。

papers.title: The Free Scalar as a Thermal Envelope for Three-Dimensional CFTs
papers.abstract: We conjecture that every unitary three-dimensional conformal field theory obeys $c_S/C_T\leq16\pi\zeta(3)$, where $s=c_ST^2$ is the thermal entropy density and $C_T$ the stress-tensor two-point coefficient, with equality for free scalars. We embed this in a stronger conjecture: on $S^1\times H^2$, the $C_T$-normalized hyperbolic heat capacity is bounded above by that of the free scalar for all $T\geq(2\pi R)^{-1}$. Near the conformal temperature, for theories smooth from the high-temperature side and without boundary terms in the modular Hamiltonian, the heat-capacity bound follows from conformal-collider positivity. We test the conjectures in free, interacting large-$N$, and holographic theories. Monte Carlo data for the three-dimensional Ising and $O(N)$ models also obey the flat-space bound.

classification.title_zh: 自由标量作为三维共形场论的热包络
classification.abstract_zh: 作者猜想每个幺正三维共形场论都满足 c_S/C_T ≤ 16πζ(3)，其中 s = c_S T^2 是热熵密度，C_T 是应力张量两点系数，自由标量取等号。并进一步猜想：在 S^1×H^2 上，经 C_T 归一化的双曲热容对所有 T≥(2πR)^{-1} 都被自由标量的值从上界约束。在共形温度附近，对于从高温侧光滑且模哈密顿量没有边界项的理论，热容界可由共形对撞机正定性推出。作者在自由理论、相互作用大 N 理论以及全息理论中检验了这些猜想，并指出三维 Ising 与 O(N) 模型的蒙特卡洛数据也满足平直空间中的界。
classification.one_liner: 提出自由标量饱和的三维CFT热熵与双曲热容上界猜想，并在自由、大N、全息及Ising/O(N)数据中检验。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究三维CFT热力学普适不等式并在全息理论中检验，与用户重点关注的超流超导、p波、畴壁/涡旋、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7探针膜、气泡成核及经典引力等支线无直接重叠。

papers.title: A Four-Dimensional Gaussian Random Field Generator for Modeling Spatiotemporal Variability in Astrophysical Sources
papers.abstract: Semi-analytic models of black-hole movies require both an emitting flow prescription and a time-dependent source variability. Existing prescriptions are often limited to either equatorial emission or time-independent sources. In this work we present a unified model for these two ingredients. First, we prescribe an off-equatorial, nongeodesic Kerr fluid rotation law by lifting an equatorial specific-angular-momentum profile to cylindrical surfaces, setting the polar component of the four-velocity to zero, normalizing the flow with the full Kerr metric at the spacetime point, and retaining the option to recover a geodesic-like plunging prescription when needed. Second, we use this velocity as the disk advection field in a four-dimensional inhomogeneous, anisotropic Mat\'ern-like Gaussian random field. We provide a parametrized model for a torus-like disk and a central jet through a single composite correlation tensor. The resulting effective model is an implementation-ready prescription for time-dependent thick-disk and disk-jet emission for relativistic studies.

classification.title_zh: 用于模拟天体物理源时空变异的四维高斯随机场生成器
classification.abstract_zh: 半解析黑洞电影模型需要发射流处方与时间依赖的源变异性。现有方案常局限于赤道发射或定常源。本文提出统一模型：首先将赤道比角动量剖面提升到柱面，令四速度极向分量为零，用时空点处完整 Kerr 度规归一化，构造离赤道、非测地的 Kerr 流体旋转律，并保留恢复类测地 plunging 处方的选项；其次将该速度作为四维非均匀、各向异性 Matérn-like 高斯随机场的吸积盘平流场，并通过单一复合相关张量参数化环面状盘与中心喷流。结果为相对论研究提供可直接实现的时变厚盘与盘-喷流发射方案。
classification.one_liner: 用 Kerr 流体旋转律驱动四维非均匀各向异性高斯随机场，为黑洞电影中的时变厚盘与盘-喷流发射提供可实现的半解析处方。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文使用 Kerr 时空和相对论流体处方，属于经典黑洞时空/相对论天体物理建模；不涉及全息、量子引力、纠缠或量子信息，因此与全息研究主线相关性低，仅与经典引力支线边缘相关。

papers.title: Probing Graviton Mass with MeerKAT PTA and SKA-PTA Forecasts
papers.abstract: In this study, we derive constraints on the graviton mass using the 4.5-year data release from the MeerKAT Pulsar Timing Array (MPTA) and provide forecasts for the upcoming Square Kilometre Array PTA (SKA-PTA). By modeling the modified dispersion relation and the corresponding tensor correlation function for massive gravitons, we perform Bayesian inference on the angular-correlation measurements under three noise configurations. Our 90\% credible upper limits on the graviton mass span $m_g < (2.10$-$2.58) \times 10^{-23}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^{2}$. Including monopolar and dipolar contributions does not significantly alter these bounds, confirming that the constraints are driven by the quadrupolar tensor correlation. All results remain fully consistent with general relativity. For SKA-PTA, we forecast sensitivities down to $m_g \sim 10^{-24}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^{2}$ with a 10-year observing baseline and $m_g \sim 10^{-25}\,\mathrm{eV}/c^{2}$ with a 50-year observing baseline, representing order-of-magnitude improvements over current limits. This work demonstrates the power of current and future PTA observations to test fundamental aspects of gravity in the nanohertz band.

classification.title_zh: 利用MeerKAT PTA和SKA-PTA预测探测引力子质量
classification.abstract_zh: 本研究利用MeerKAT脉冲星计时阵列（MPTA）4.5年数据发布给出引力子质量限制，并对即将到来的平方公里阵列PTA（SKA-PTA）进行预测。通过建模大质量引力子的修正色散关系及相应张量关联函数，我们在三种噪声配置下对角关联测量进行贝叶斯推断。引力子质量的90%可信上限为 m_g < (2.10–2.58)×10^{-23} eV/c^2。纳入单极和偶极贡献不会显著改变这些界限，表明限制由四极张量关联驱动。所有结果与广义相对论完全一致。对于SKA-PTA，我们预测在10年观测基线下达 m_g ~ 10^{-24} eV/c^2，在50年基线下达 m_g ~ 10^{-25} eV/c^2，相比当前限制有数量级改进。本工作展示了当前和未来PTA观测在纳赫兹频段检验引力基本方面的能力。
classification.one_liner: 用MeerKAT PTA数据限制引力子质量并预测SKA-PTA可达灵敏度，结果与广义相对论一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题是脉冲星计时阵列对引力子质量的限制与SKA-PTA预测，属于经典引力/引力波检验，不涉及全息或AdS/CFT；但与用户列出的“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签相关。

papers.title: Numerical calculations of neutron star mountains supported by crustal lattice pressure
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves may set the spin frequencies of neutron stars in low-mass X-ray binaries (LMXBs). One mechanism for facilitating such emission is the formation of a mass asymmetry - or `mountain' - supported by elastic strains driven by thermal gradients. Most studies have focused either on the origin of the elastic strains or the temperature asymmetry in isolation, and have not considered the entire formation process. In previous work, we showed that anisotropic heat transport in magnetised accreting neutron stars can source a significant temperature asymmetry, and made rough estimates that suggested temperature-induced perturbations in the pressure supplied by the crustal lattice may be competitive with the widely known model of temperature-induced capture-layer shifts. In this paper we carry out detailed calculations to properly explore this scenario. We self-consistently calculate the temperature asymmetries, the perturbations in crustal lattice pressure, and the mass asymmetries within a single framework. For the first time, we make use of the set of realistic equations of state from the Brussels-Montreal nuclear energy-density functionals BSk19, BSk20, and BSk21 which describe all regions of accreting neutron stars in a thermodynamically consistent, unified way. We find these mountains are too small to dictate the spin-equilibrium of LMXBs, and estimate the level of gravitational wave emission they produce.

classification.title_zh: 由地壳晶格压力支撑的中子星“山”的数值计算
classification.abstract_zh: 低质量X射线双星中的中子星可能通过引力波辐射设定自转频率，其机制之一是热梯度驱动弹性应变形成质量不对称，即“山”。本文在一个统一框架内自洽计算温度不对称、地壳晶格压力扰动和质量不对称，并首次采用Brussels-Montreal核能量密度泛函BSk19、BSk20、BSk21给出的真实状态方程，以热力学一致的方式描述吸积中子星各区域。结果表明这些“山”太小，不足以决定LMXB的自转平衡，并估计了其产生的引力波辐射水平。
classification.one_liner: 用统一框架和BSk真实状态方程数值计算地壳晶格压力支撑的中子星“山”，发现其不足以主导LMXB自转平衡。
