papers.title: Strong-Field Gravitational-Wave Lensing from Ray-Traced Arrival-Time Surfaces
papers.abstract: The diffraction integral formalism has been greatly successful in describing gravitational wave lensing effects in scenarios where the wavelength of the signal is comparable to the characteristic length scale of the lens, known as the wave optics regime. However, the assumptions required to construct its integrand break down as the source approaches the strong gravity region of a black hole lens. In particular, we are interested in the lensed signal from a binary (the source) near a massive black hole (the lens). We present a new formalism for obtaining low frequency corrections to sources being lensed in the strong field regime of gravity by leveraging the fact that null geodesics obey the Hamilton--Jacobi equations. In doing so, we are able to construct a time delay surface without relying on the thin lens approximation, and solve the diffraction integral for the resulting surface directly. For a stationary source at $10M$, deep in the strong field regime, when comparing the results with a relativistic wave scattering model, we find $6.5\%$ and $0.3\%$ agreement in the peak amplification and first diffractive fringe, respectively. Furthermore, we find a $< 1\%$ agreement with the amplitude of the point mass lens with a source at $10^4 M$ in the weak field, but noticeable dephasing between the peaks of the amplification function at higher frequencies. This work allows for clean interpolation between otherwise separate regimes, valid for sources from $\sim 6M \to \infty$. It provides a transparent, physically motivated framework for computing beyond-geometric optics lensing effects in the strong field regime.

classification.title_zh: 强场引力波透镜效应：基于光线追踪到达时间面
classification.abstract_zh: 摘要讨论引力波透镜的衍射积分形式在源接近黑洞强引力区时失效。作者利用零测地线满足 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程，提出一种不依赖薄透镜近似构造时间延迟面并直接求解衍射积分的新形式，用于获得强场低频修正。对位于 10M 的静止源，与相对论波散射模型比较，峰值放大率和第一衍射条纹分别达到 6.5% 和 0.3% 的一致性；在弱场 10^4M 源下与点质量透镜振幅一致性小于 1%，但高频峰值间出现明显退相位。该框架可在约 6M 到无穷远的源之间进行插值，用于计算超越几何光学的强场透镜效应。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于零测地线 Hamilton-Jacobi 的光线追踪到达时间面方法，直接求解衍射积分以描述强场引力波透镜效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文核心属于经典引力/广义相对论中的强场黑洞透镜与引力波传播问题，直接对应用户的“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Strong Field Gravitational Lensing in Full Wave Optics
papers.abstract: Compact binaries evolving in the vicinity of massive black holes may be commonplace in the Universe, and their gravitational waves carry signatures of their environment. We study the strong lensing of these signals by the massive companion, a configuration that violates the standard assumptions of the lensing literature: geometric optics and thin lenses. Using a perturbative framework, we compute the full wave optics amplification factors for face-on and edge-on binaries, including spinning lenses. In the edge-on configuration, peak amplification does not occur at perfect source--lens--observer alignment, even for a non-spinning lens. This is a consequence of the anisotropic, coherent quadrupolar emission of the stellar-mass binary breaking the axisymmetry of the system. Restricting to the equatorial plane near the optical axis, we then find that the frequency dependence of the amplification factor is universal across every configuration studied, persisting deep into the wave optics regime. Comparing against a strong-field ray tracing calculation, we find agreement at the $\sim10\%$ level for a face-on binary lensed by a Schwarzschild black hole. In the less symmetric edge-on case only the angular peak shift and fringe spacing is reproduced to this accuracy. For a Kerr lens, the face-on amplification factor is described by its Schwarzschild counterpart to the same $\sim 10 \%$ accuracy once the effect of frame dragging is corrected for. A point mass lens, by contrast, fails to reproduce the features of the system, which may have strong implications for forecasts that adopt it for lensing by massive black holes in the strong field.

classification.title_zh: 全波光学中的强场引力透镜
classification.abstract_zh: 致密双星可能在大质量黑洞附近演化，其引力波携带环境特征。我们研究大质量伴星对这些信号的强透镜效应，该情形违背几何光学和薄透镜的标准假设。利用微扰框架，我们计算正面和侧面双星（包括自旋透镜）的全波光学放大因子。在侧面配置中，即使透镜不自旋，峰值放大也不发生在源—透镜—观测者完美对齐时；这是恒星级双星各向异性相干四极辐射破坏系统轴对称性的结果。限制在光轴附近的赤道面后，我们发现放大因子的频率依赖性在所有研究配置中具有普适性，并深入波光学区域。与强场光线追踪计算比较，Schwarzschild黑洞透镜正面双星在约10%水平一致；在对称性较低的侧面情形，仅角峰移和条纹间距达到该精度。对于Kerr透镜，在修正参考系拖曳效应后，正面放大因子可由其Schwarzschild对应物以约10%精度描述。点质量透镜则无法重现这些特征，这可能对采用点质量透镜进行强场大质量黑洞透镜预测产生重要影响。
classification.one_liner: 论文用全波光学微扰框架研究致密双星引力波被大质量黑洞强透镜的放大因子，并比较Schwarzschild/Kerr透镜与光线追踪及点质量透镜近似。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究强场引力透镜与波光学；但不涉及全息、AdS/CFT或量子信息。

papers.title: Binary Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes in 3+1 numerical relativity: mergers, fly-bys and gravitational waves
papers.abstract: We present what are, to our knowledge, the first three-dimensional numerical-relativity evolutions of wormhole binaries: pairs of massive Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes held open by a phantom scalar field, whose energy density is nowhere positive. We construct constraint-satisfying initial data for single throats and for pairs, at rest and with orbital momentum, and evolve them with adaptive mesh refinement. An isolated throat is unstable: depending on the sign of a small perturbation, it collapses to a black hole or inflates, at the rate that linear perturbation theory predicts to within 1.9%. Two throats at rest repel when their scalar charges have the same sign and attract when the signs are opposite, with a strength ratio close to the scalar force law's prediction, so only opposite-signed pairs merge. A head-on collision forms a common horizon around both throats while they are still open. The horizon then loses 28% of its area as it absorbs the scalar field, and approaches the Schwarzschild radius of the pair's mass. Pairs that fly past each other form no horizon, and both throats inflate. Every encounter emits a short burst of gravitational waves and a scalar dipole wave of comparable, negative energy. An isolated collapsing throat rings at the quasinormal frequency of the black hole it becomes. No throat survives more than a few orbital periods, even when its initial perturbation is tiny, so these binaries do not inspiral. The results hold for one phantom-scalar model, equal masses, a single throat compactness and no spin.

classification.title_zh: 3+1维数值相对论中的双Ellis-Bronnikov虫洞：并合、飞掠与引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们给出据我们所知首个虫洞双星的三维数值相对论演化：由幻影标量场支撑、能量密度处处非正的大质量Ellis-Bronnikov虫洞对。我们构造单喉和双喉、静止及带轨道角动量的约束满足初始数据，并用自适应网格加密演化。孤立喉不稳定：依小扰动符号坍缩为黑洞或膨胀，速率与线性扰动理论预言在1.9%内相符。两个静止喉在标量荷同号时相斥、反号时相吸，强度比接近标量力律预言，因此只有反号对并合。正面碰撞在两个喉仍张开时于二者周围形成共同视界；视界吸收标量场后面积损失28%，并趋近该对质量的Schwarzschild半径。飞掠对不形成视界，两个喉均膨胀。每次相遇发射短引力波暴和能量相当且为负的标量偶极波。孤立坍缩喉以所形成黑洞的准正规频率振铃。即使初始扰动很小，没有喉能存活超过几个轨道周期，因此这些双星不会旋近。结果限于一个幻影标量模型、等质量、单一喉致密度和无自旋。
classification.one_liner: 首次三维数值相对论模拟双Ellis-Bronnikov虫洞，揭示其并合、飞掠、引力波与不稳定坍缩行为。

papers.title: NRHJSur3dq8: a spectral numerical-relativity surrogate family for non-eccentric aligned-spin binary-black-hole waveforms
papers.abstract: We present NRHJSur3dq8, a family of numerical-relativity surrogates for non-eccentric aligned-spin binary-black-hole waveforms inspired by an action-angle parameterization. The model provides both the dynamics: the Hamiltonian values, azimuthal action $J_\phi(\Phi)$, the orbital clock $\tau(\Phi)$ as functions of its phasing, and the radiative pieces: the waveforms, their near-analytic derivatives, and modeling errors associated with each. The surrogated variables are conditioned into pieces that vary slowly on the radiation-reaction timescale, represented on shared $h$-adaptive Chebyshev elements, and regressed across the intrinsic parameters with a Gaussian-process model. A time-parameterized merger-ringdown set of elements is attached where the adiabatic description breaks down. Fixed-hyperparameter leave-one-out validation of the central NRHJSur3dq8_AA model variant against numerical relativity gives a $(2,2)$ unweighted mismatch of $1.6^{+62}_{-1.5}\times10^{-6}$ and an all-mode mismatch of $2.8^{+84}_{-2.7}\times10^{-6}$ over the full inspiral-merger-ringdown span. Sky-averaged and signal-to-noise-ratio-weighted over $32$ orientations per simulation, the model's full inspiral-merger-ringdown in-sample mismatch against the SXS numerical-relativity simulations used for training is $8.9\times10^{-7}$ to $2.8\times10^{-5}$ across total masses $40$-$120 M_\odot$. Waveforms are hybridized using post-Newtonian waveforms. Beyond accuracy, NRHJSur3dq8 provides two capabilities uncommon in numerical-relativity surrogates: nearly analytic derivatives of the strain with respect to the physical parameters, and a calibrated Gaussian-process predictive uncertainty of the model. A full non-hybridized inspiral-merger-ringdown waveform evaluates in $12.5$ ms on a single CPU call. Batched evaluation takes $0.43$ ms per waveform at a batch of $4096$, measured at a starting frequency of $25$ Hz.

classification.title_zh: NRHJSur3dq8：面向非偏心对齐自旋双黑洞波形的谱数值相对论代理模型族
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出 NRHJSur3dq8，这是一族受作用量-角变量参数化启发的数值相对论代理模型，用于非偏心、对齐自旋的双黑洞波形。该模型同时提供动力学量（哈密顿量值、方位角作用量 J_phi(Phi)、轨道时钟 tau(Phi) 作为其相位演化的函数）以及辐射部分（波形、其近解析导数及相应的建模误差）。代理变量被条件化为在辐射反作用时标上缓慢变化的分量，用共享的 h 自适应 Chebyshev 单元表示，并通过高斯过程模型跨内禀参数回归。在绝热描述失效处，附加一组时间参数化的并合-铃宕单元。对核心 NRHJSur3dq8_AA 模型变体进行固定超参数的留一法验证，与数值相对论比较，在全 inspiral-merger-ringdown 范围内得到 (2,2) 未加权失配 1.6^{+62}_{-1.5}×10^{-6}，全模式失配 2.8^{+84}_{-2.7}×10^{-6}。对每次模拟按 32 个方向做天区平均和信噪比加权后，模型全 inspiral-merger-ringdown 对训练所用 SXS 数值相对论模拟的样本内失配在总质量 40–120 M_sun 范围内为 8.9×10^{-7} 至 2.8×10^{-5}。波形使用后牛顿波形进行混合。除精度外，NRHJSur3dq8 还提供数值相对论代理模型中不常见的两项能力：应变对物理参数的近解析导数，以及经校准的高斯过程预测不确定度。完整的非混合 inspiral-merger-ringdown 波形在单次 CPU 调用中耗时 12.5 ms；在 4096 批次下，以 25 Hz 起始频率测得每波形批处理评估耗时 0.43 ms。
classification.one_liner: 该工作构建并验证了一族高精度、带预测不确定度和近解析导数的双黑洞数值相对论波形代理模型。

papers.title: The Bondi dipole in full numerical relativity: a self-accelerating positive-negative mass binary
papers.abstract: Bondi showed in 1957 that a body of negative active gravitational mass and a positive one should accelerate together without limit while their total momentum stays zero. We test this prediction in full 3+1 numerical relativity, from constraint-satisfying initial data. The matter is two complex scalar fields with identical self-interactions, one of which enters the Einstein equations with the opposite sign; its stars have positive inertial and passive masses but negative active and Arnowitt-Deser-Misner (ADM) masses. To our knowledge, they are the first asymptotically flat bodies of negative ADM mass evolved in numerical relativity. A pair of stars with equal and opposite ADM masses accelerates as a single object at constant separation, and its total momentum stays zero to within 0.5%. The acceleration follows Newton's law of gravitation in both mass and separation, reverses when the stars are exchanged, and is absent in same-sign pairs and isolated stars. We detect no gravitational radiation. The results hold for head-on pairs released from rest, up to a few percent of the speed of light, and in the longest run the pair reaches a tenth of it with both stars intact.

classification.title_zh: 全数值相对论中的邦迪偶极子：一个自加速的正负质量双星
classification.abstract_zh: 邦迪在1957年指出，一个具有负主动引力质量的物体和一个正主动引力质量的物体应无限制地共同加速，而总动量保持为零。我们在完整的3+1数值相对论中，从满足约束的初始数据出发检验这一预言。物质由两个具有相同自相互作用的复标量场组成，其中一个场以相反符号进入爱因斯坦方程；其星体具有正惯性质量和正被动质量，但具有负主动质量和负ADM质量。据我们所知，这是数值相对论中首次演化渐近平坦的负ADM质量天体。一对ADM质量等值反号的星体以恒定间距作为单一物体加速，其总动量在0.5%以内保持为零。加速度在质量和间距两方面都遵循牛顿引力定律，交换两星后方向反转，而在同号对和孤立星体中不存在。我们未探测到引力辐射。结果适用于从静止释放的迎头对，速度达到光速的百分之几，在最长运行中该对达到光速的十分之一且两星保持完整。
classification.one_liner: 首次在完整数值相对论中演化渐近平坦的负ADM质量星体，并验证邦迪预言的正负主动质量双星自加速偶极子。

papers.title: Global hyperbolicity meets order completeness
papers.abstract: Recently, an order completeness property has attracted attention in some low regularity spacetime geometry literature, where it was named `chronocompleteness'. In this work we prove that, in the framework of standard Lorentzian geometry, this property is equivalent to global hyperbolicity. The equivalence of global hyperbolicity with other more traditional forms of order completeness is also established.

classification.title_zh: 全局双曲性与序完备性相遇
classification.abstract_zh: 最近，一种序完备性质在低正则性时空几何文献中受到关注，并被命名为“chronocompleteness”。本文证明，在标准洛伦兹几何框架下，该性质等价于全局双曲性；同时建立了全局双曲性与若干更传统的序完备性形式之间的等价关系。
classification.one_liner: 在标准洛伦兹几何中证明 chronocompleteness 与全局双曲性等价，并联系其他传统序完备性形式。

papers.title: Discrete symmetries of modified Teukolsky equations
papers.abstract: The Teukolsky equation possesses discrete symmetries that constrain the properties of black hole perturbations and their quasinormal mode spectrum. In this study, we explore how a class of modifications of the Teukolsky potential can alter the symmetry structure of the equation and break the m = 0 degeneracy of quasinormal modes. We prove this result in frequency domain using the master Teukolsky equation and in time domain via (2+1)-dimensional simulations. We also show that the discrete symmetries can be leveraged for a more efficient characterization of the m = 0 quasinormal modes from time-domain evolutions. As a theory-specific application, we consider the case of higher-derivative theories of gravity, highlighting that time-domain implementations of frequency-domain potentials can give rise to additional non-physical branches of modes.

classification.title_zh: 修改后 Teukolsky 方程的离散对称性
classification.abstract_zh: Teukolsky 方程具有离散对称性，这些对称性约束黑洞扰动及其准正规模谱的性质。本文研究一类 Teukolsky 势的修改如何改变方程的对称结构，并破坏准正规模的 m=0 简并。我们分别在频域用主 Teukolsky 方程、在时域用 (2+1) 维模拟证明该结果；并展示可利用离散对称性从时域演化中更高效地表征 m=0 准正规模。作为特定理论应用，考虑高阶导数引力，指出频域势的时域实现可能产生额外的非物理模式分支。
classification.one_liner: 研究修改 Teukolsky 势对离散对称性和 m=0 准正规模简并的影响，并用于高阶导数引力中的时域 QNM 分析。

papers.title: Exact solutions for static spherically symmetric spacetime with a perfect fluid in Rastall theory
papers.abstract: In general relativity, exact Liouvillian solutions for a static and spherically symmetric spacetime with a perfect fluid and the equation of state $p(r)=w\rho (r)$ are known only for $w=0,-\frac{1}{6}, -\frac{1}{5}, -\frac{1}{3}$, and $-1$. We extend this setup to Rastall theory, presenting the relation between the Rastall parameter and the constant $w$, and deriving exact solutions that correspond to their known counterparts in general relativity, except for $w=-\frac{1}{6}$. Furthermore, we find that, when $w\neq \frac{1}{3}, -1$, there exist several types of solutions whose behaviors change depending on the choice of constants.

classification.title_zh: Rastall理论中具有完美流体的静态球对称时空的精确解
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论中，对于具有完美流体且状态方程为 p(r)=wρ(r) 的静态球对称时空，精确的Liouvillian解仅已知对应于 w=0、-1/6、-1/5、-1/3 和 -1。我们将此设定推广到Rastall理论，给出Rastall参数与常数 w 之间的关系，并导出与广义相对论中已知对应解相对应的精确解，但 w=-1/6 除外。此外，我们发现当 w≠1/3、-1 时，存在若干类解，其行为会随常数选择而变化。
classification.one_liner: 将广义相对论中完美流体静态球对称时空的已知精确解推广到Rastall理论，并分析Rastall参数与状态方程参数的关系及解的行为。

papers.title: Massive boson stars: Waveform-based branch diagnosis with neural reconstruction
papers.abstract: We investigate whether the dynamical merger branch of massive boson-star collisions can be inferred from the gravitational waveform without supplying the intrinsic source parameters. Using an existing equal-mass, head-on numerical-relativity catalogue, we construct branch-conditioned reduced-basis surrogates for the real $(2,0)$ and $(4,0)$ modes and perform parameter-blind waveform inference. On a frozen test set of 60 held-out samples, the correct branch is recovered for all samples using either mode, showing that the branch information is not confined to the dominant $(2,0)$ channel. The inference also recovers $|\phi_c|$ with a mean relative error of $4.30\%$ and selects the correct $\lambda$ from $\{10,50,100,300\}$ in $68.3\%$ of the test samples. These results demonstrate waveform-based branch and source-parameter inference within the present noiseless numerical-relativity catalogue.

classification.title_zh: 大质量玻色星：基于波形的分支诊断与神经重建
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究能否在不提供内禀源参数的情况下，从引力波形推断大质量玻色星碰撞的动力学并合分支。基于已有的等质量、迎面碰撞数值相对论目录，我们为实 (2,0) 和 (4,0) 模式构建以分支为条件的约化基代理模型，并执行参数盲的波形推断。在由60个留出样本组成的冻结测试集上，使用任一模式均能对所有样本恢复正确分支，表明分支信息并不局限于主导的 (2,0) 通道。该推断还以4.30%的平均相对误差恢复 |\phi_c|，并在68.3%的测试样本中从 {10,50,100,300} 中选出正确的 \lambda。这些结果在当前无噪声数值相对论目录范围内展示了基于波形的分支与源参数推断。
classification.one_liner: 利用引力波波形在无源参数条件下推断大质量玻色星碰撞的并合分支与源参数。

papers.title: Time-domain framework for the Teukolsky equation with a particle source using comoving hyperboloidal coordinates
papers.abstract: We present a scheme and implementation code for time-domain integration of the Teukolsky equation in 1+1 dimensions with a point-particle source, based on comoving, spatially compactified hyperboloidal coordinates. We demonstrate that the scheme evades the problem of nonphysical growing modes that plague some numerical evolution schemes without compactification. Our use of comoving coordinates greatly simplifies the application of jump conditions on the particle's worldline. We develop our method and test its performance for a scalar field on a Schwarzschild background, first for a circular geodesic orbit source and then for a scattering geodesic orbit. We then present a test implementation of the method for the $s = -2$ Teukolsky equation, illustrating its long-term stability and absence of growing-mode behavior through comparison with similar results using noncompactified characteristic coordinates. Our method paves the way to calculations of the full gravitational self-force in extreme-mass-ratio scattering.

classification.title_zh: 使用共动双曲超曲面坐标的带粒子源Teukolsky方程时域框架
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方案和实现代码，用于在1+1维中基于共动、空间紧致化的双曲超曲面坐标，对带点粒子源的Teukolsky方程进行时域积分。我们证明该方案避免了一些未紧致化数值演化方案中出现的非物理增长模问题。使用共动坐标大大简化了粒子世界线上跳跃条件的应用。我们在Schwarzschild背景上以标量场发展和测试该方法，先用于圆测地轨道源，再用于散射测地轨道。随后给出s=-2 Teukolsky方程的测试实现，通过与未紧致化特征坐标下的类似结果比较，说明其长期稳定性和无增长模行为。该方法为极端质量比散射中完整引力自力计算铺路。
classification.one_liner: 提出并实现带点粒子源的Teukolsky方程共动紧致化双曲超曲面时域积分方案，用于黑洞扰动与极端质量比自力计算。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究黑洞背景下Teukolsky方程的经典时域演化与粒子源/自力计算，属于经典引力与广义相对论支线。

papers.title: Frenet--Serret invariants of timelike worldlines in Kerr spacetime: chart independence, horizon crossing and null-endpoint limits
papers.abstract: We examine the Frenet-Serret (FS) curvature kappa and first torsion tau_1 of timelike worldlines in Kerr spacetime, focusing mainly on non-Killing equatorial trajectories. Since these quantities are scalars associated with a worldline, a coordinate transformation cannot remove a divergence for the same curve. We demonstrate this by transforming a single worldline between five coordinate charts and verifying agreement of its invariants, including in an off-equatorial test. We also show why reusing the same coordinate components of the tangent vector in two charts generally describes different curves. For a non-unit tangent v with norm S = g(v,v), we derive the identity kappa squared = Q squared / S cubed - (q dot q) / S squared, where q = nabla_v v and Q = q dot v. When Q approaches a nonzero limit and q dot q remains finite, the curvature scales as |Q_0| S to the power -3/2 as the curve approaches a null endpoint. Under the additional condition that S' is nonzero, we obtain a closed expression for the limiting value of tau_1. We verify these results using exact symbolic calculations for two Kerr-Schild spirals, including one with spin parameter a greater than the mass M, for which no event horizon exists. For Killing observers, we derive closed-form expressions for kappa and tau_1 and show that both become singular at light surfaces. Finally, we distinguish FS torsion, which measures rotation relative to the acceleration direction, from gyroscope rotation rates defined using regular reference frames. For a geodesic plunge, the rotation rate relative to the principal-null frame remains finite across the horizon, while the rate relative to the Carter-plane axis agrees with Marck's precession rate. Our analysis focuses mainly on equatorial examples; a numerical comparison in double-null coordinates is left for future work.

classification.title_zh: Kerr时空中类时世界线的Frenet--Serret不变量：坐标图独立性、穿越视界与零端点极限
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考察Kerr时空中类时世界线的Frenet-Serret (FS)曲率κ和第一挠率τ1，主要关注非Killing赤道轨迹。由于这些量是世界线标量，同一曲线的坐标变换不能消除发散。我们通过将单条世界线在五个坐标图之间变换并验证其不变量一致（包括一个离赤道测试）来证明这一点，并说明在两个坐标图中重复使用切矢相同的坐标分量通常描述不同曲线。对于非单位切矢v且S=g(v,v)，我们导出恒等式 κ^2 = Q^2/S^3 - (q·q)/S^2，其中q=∇_v v、Q=q·v。当Q趋于非零极限且q·q保持有限时，曲线趋近零端点时曲率按|Q0| S^{-3/2}标度。在S'非零的附加条件下，我们得到τ1极限值的闭合表达式。我们用两个Kerr-Schild螺旋的精确符号计算验证这些结果，其中一个自旋参数a大于质量M、不存在事件视界。对于Killing观察者，我们导出κ和τ1的闭合表达式，并表明二者在光面上奇异。最后，我们区分FS挠率（度量相对于加速度方向的转动）与用正则参考系定义的陀螺仪转动率。对于测地线坠落，相对于主零标架的转动率在穿越视界时保持有限，而相对于Carter平面轴的转动率与Marck进动率一致。我们的分析主要集中于赤道例子；双零坐标中的数值比较留待未来工作。
classification.one_liner: 研究Kerr时空中类时世界线的Frenet-Serret曲率和挠率，证明其坐标图独立，给出零端点标度及Killing观察者与测地线坠落的转动比较。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究Kerr时空世界线几何与视界穿越；但未涉及全息、量子信息或用户其他重点标签。

papers.title: Radiation properties of a regular black hole embedded in a Dehnen-type dark matter halo with a thin accretion disk
papers.abstract: We study the shadow, timelike geodesic structure, and thin accretion disk radiation properties of a static spherically symmetric regular black hole embedded in a Dehnen-type dark matter halo. Using the EHT observations of M87* and Sgr A*, we constrain the halo scale parameter $a$ at $1\sigma$ and $2\sigma$ levels. Based on the Page--Thorne model and a backward ray-tracing method, we compute the local radiative flux, redshift factor distribution, and observed flux images for different viewing angles. We further compare the Dehnen regular black hole with the Einasto and Hayward regular black holes by evaluating their ISCO radii and disk flux profiles. The results show that increasing $a$ reduces the ISCO radius, enlarges the effective radiation area, and amplifies the Doppler asymmetry of both direct and secondary images. Compared with the Einasto and Hayward models, the Dehnen black hole exhibits the strongest ISCO contraction and the most pronounced left-right brightness asymmetry, while the Einasto model is nearly insensitive to its scale parameter and the Hayward black hole shows only a mild dependence. These findings demonstrate that regular black holes with different regularisation mechanisms can be distinguished by their accretion disk images, providing a potential tool for testing dark-matter halo models with future high-resolution observations.

classification.title_zh: 嵌入Dehnen型暗物质晕并带有薄吸积盘的正则黑洞的辐射性质
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了嵌入Dehnen型暗物质晕中的静态球对称正则黑洞的阴影、类时测地线结构以及薄吸积盘辐射性质。利用EHT对M87*和Sgr A*的观测，在1σ和2σ置信水平约束晕尺度参数a。基于Page--Thorne模型和反向光线追踪方法，计算不同视角下的局部辐射通量、红移因子分布和观测通量图像。我们进一步通过评估ISCO半径和盘通量分布，将Dehnen正则黑洞与Einasto和Hayward正则黑洞进行比较。结果表明，增大a会减小ISCO半径、扩大有效辐射面积，并放大直接像和次级像的多普勒不对称性。与Einasto和Hayward模型相比，Dehnen黑洞表现出最强的ISCO收缩和最明显的左右亮度不对称性，而Einasto模型对其尺度参数几乎不敏感，Hayward黑洞仅表现出轻微依赖。这些发现表明，具有不同正则化机制的正则黑洞可通过其吸积盘图像加以区分，为未来高分辨率观测检验暗物质晕模型提供了潜在工具。
classification.one_liner: 用EHT约束和薄盘光线追踪研究Dehnen暗物质晕中正则黑洞的阴影与吸积盘辐射，并比较不同正则化模型。

papers.title: Gravitational Light Deflection: Geometrical Methods and Nonlinear Electrodynamics
papers.abstract: Gravitational lensing constitutes one of the most direct observational manifestations of spacetime curvature and provides a powerful probe of compact astrophysical objects. In this work, we present a comprehensive analysis of the bending of light in curved spacetime, beginning with the fundamental aspects of gravitational lensing and the Newtonian approximation to light deflection. The relativistic formulation of lensing is then developed through the lens equation, lensing potential, and a geometrical interpretation of Fermat's principle using an effective refractive index in curved spacetime. Photon trajectories and light deflection are subsequently investigated in static, spherically symmetric geometries, followed by a detailed study of photon motion in the equatorial plane of the Kerr spacetime. Analytical expressions for the closest approach distance and critical parameters governing photon orbits are derived. Furthermore, the bending angle is examined using the Rindler-Ishak method and the Gauss-Bonnet theorem within the optical geometry. Finally, the analysis is extended to axisymmetric spacetimes using the OIA and GW-OIA formalisms, providing a unified geometrical framework for computing light deflection in both static and rotating gravitational fields. The review also examines nonlinear electrodynamics (NED), distinguishing changes in the gravitational background from changes in the characteristic propagation of electromagnetic waves. Representative models are used to relate these effects to finite-distance deflection, polarization-dependent optical observables, and comparisons between weak bending and strong-field capture.

classification.title_zh: 引力光偏折：几何方法与非线性电动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 引力透镜是时空曲率最直接的观测表现之一，也是探测致密天体的一种有力手段。本文对弯曲时空中的光线偏折进行了综合分析，首先介绍引力透镜的基本方面以及光偏折的牛顿近似。随后通过透镜方程、透镜势以及利用弯曲时空中有效折射率对费马原理的几何解释，发展相对论性的透镜表述。接着研究静态球对称几何中的光子轨迹与光偏折，并详细讨论 Kerr 时空赤道面内的光子运动，导出最近接近距离和控制光子轨道的临界参数的解析表达式。此外，利用 Rindler-Ishak 方法以及光学几何中的 Gauss-Bonnet 定理考察偏折角。最后，将分析推广到轴对称时空，使用 OIA 与 GW-OIA 形式体系，为计算静态与旋转引力场中的光偏折提供统一的几何框架。该综述还考察非线性电动力学（NED），区分引力背景的变化与电磁波特征传播的变化。文中用代表性模型将这些效应与有限距离偏折、偏振依赖的光学可观测量以及弱偏折与强场捕获之间的比较联系起来。
classification.one_liner: 综述弯曲时空中引力光偏折的几何方法，并讨论非线性电动力学对光传播的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题为经典广义相对论中的引力光偏折、Kerr 时空光子轨道与光学几何方法，直接匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

papers.title: The point-particle-limit effective-source approach for computing gravitational self-force in the Lorenz gauge
papers.abstract: The traditional effective-source method is hampered by complex analytical expressions and the inherent smoothness limit, which incur high computational costs and complicate implementation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce the point-particle-limit effective source method, which analytically takes the size of the effective source to zero, thereby transforming the problem into a well-defined jump condition of retarded metric field at the particle position governed by the local singular field. This formulation naturally pairs with a discontinuous Galerkin scheme, whose inherent capacity for accommodating solution discontinuities enables highly accurate enforcement of the jump conditions. We apply both the traditional and point-particle-limit effective source method to calculate the time-domain gravitational metric perturbation and gravitational self-force in the Lorenz gauge on a point particle in a circular orbit around a Schwarzschild black hole. The comparison of numerical results shows the excellent advantage of the point-particle-limit effective source method, which validates the correctness and efficiency of the point-particle-limit effective source method and thereby establishes a numerical foundation for computing generic geodesic orbits or long-time self-consistent orbital evolution.

classification.title_zh: 计算Lorenz规范下引力自力时的点粒子极限有效源方法
classification.abstract_zh: 传统有效源方法受复杂解析表达式和固有的光滑性限制，导致高计算成本和实现复杂。为克服这些限制，我们引入点粒子极限有效源方法，将有效源尺寸解析地取为零，从而把问题转化为由局部奇异场支配的、在粒子位置处推迟度规场的良定义跳跃条件。该表述自然适配间断Galerkin格式，其容纳解间断的固有能力使得跳跃条件可被高精度施加。我们将传统有效源方法和点粒子极限有效源方法应用于计算围绕Schwarzschild黑洞圆轨道运动点粒子的时域引力度规扰动和Lorenz规范下的引力自力。数值结果比较显示点粒子极限有效源方法的显著优势，验证了其正确性和效率，从而为计算一般测地轨道或长时间自洽轨道演化建立了数值基础。
classification.one_liner: 提出点粒子极限有效源方法并结合间断Galerkin格式，高效计算Lorenz规范下Schwarzschild时域引力自力。

papers.title: Cosmological Inflation in $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_{m})$ Gravity
papers.abstract: Cosmological inflation provides the standard description of the early accelerated expansion of the Universe, but the shortcomings of General Relativity (GR) motivate the search for alternative gravitational frameworks. In this paper, we study inflation in $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)$ gravity, constructed in the symmetric teleparallel formulation, where the non-metricity scalar $Q$ couples non-minimally to the matter Lagrangian $\mathcal{L}_m$. We consider an inflaton scalar field with a power-law potential and show that, in this framework, the inflationary dynamics is governed by the interplay between the scalar field and the effective geometric sector generated by the matter-geometry coupling. Thus, the scalar field supplies the matter source, while the modified $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)$ structure alters the background evolution and the inflationary observables. Within the slow-roll approximation, we derive the expressions of the scalar spectral index $n_s$ and the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$ for both linear and nonlinear coupling models. The linear model, $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)=-\alpha Q+2\mathcal{L}_m+\beta$, is treated as a benchmark GR-like limit, whereas the nonlinear model, $f(Q,\mathcal{L}_m)=-\alpha Q+(2\mathcal{L}_m)^2+\beta$, captures the genuinely modified effects of the theory. We find that the linear model remains consistent with the latest joint Planck 2018 and BICEP/Keck (BK18) constraints ($r < 0.036$ at $95\%$ CL) for positive $\alpha$ and $\beta$, while the nonlinear model is favored for negative values of these parameters and yields predictions largely concentrated within the $68\%$ confidence level. These results indicate that the nonlinear matter-geometry coupling can lead to distinct inflationary behavior and may improve the observational compatibility of the quadratic potential $(n=2)$, which is strongly disfavored in the standard GR-based inflationary scenario.

classification.title_zh: f(Q,L_m) 引力中的宇宙学暴胀
classification.abstract_zh: 宇宙学暴胀提供了宇宙早期加速膨胀的标准描述，但广义相对论（GR）的不足促使人们寻找替代引力框架。本文研究对称远平行表述下构造的 f(Q,L_m) 引力中的暴胀，其中非度规标量 Q 与物质拉格朗日量 L_m 非最小耦合。我们考虑具有幂律势的暴胀子标量场，并表明在该框架中，暴胀动力学由标量场与物质-几何耦合产生的有效几何部分之间的相互作用决定。标量场提供物质源，而修改后的 f(Q,L_m) 结构改变背景演化和暴胀观测量。在慢滚近似下，我们推导线性与非线性耦合模型的标量谱指数 n_s 和张量-标量比 r 的表达式。线性模型 f(Q,L_m)=-αQ+2L_m+β 被视为类 GR 的基准极限，而非线性模型 f(Q,L_m)=-αQ+(2L_m)^2+β 捕捉该理论真正修改的效应。我们发现，对于正 α 和 β，线性模型与最新的 Planck 2018 和 BICEP/Keck（BK18）联合限制一致（95% CL 下 r<0.036），而非线性模型在参数为负时更受青睐，其预言大多集中在 68% 置信水平内。这些结果表明，非线性物质-几何耦合可导致不同的暴胀行为，并可能改善二次势（n=2）与观测的兼容性，而该势在标准 GR 暴胀情景中受到强烈不利。

papers.title: Tidal contributions to neutron star orbital precession around Sgr $A^*$
papers.abstract: We investigate tidal contributions to the orbital precession of neutron stars around the supermassive black hole Sgr A*, using stellar configurations described by the Tolman - Oppenheimer - Volkoff equations. We examine the dependence of tidal precession on stellar compactness, pericentre distance, and the quadrupolar tidal Love number $k_2$, and compare its magnitude with general relativistic orbital precession. The calculated tidal angular shift decreases strongly with increasing pericentre distance and, for the stellar configurations considered, with increasing compactness. Larger Love numbers enhance the tidal contribution. This behaviour reflects the strong dependence of tidal precession on the stellar-radius-to-pericentre-distance ratio, $(R/r_p)^5$. Despite the enhancement during closer encounters, the predicted tidal shifts remain extremely small, reaching approximately $3.5 \times 10^{-18},\mu as$ within the displayed parameter range. The ratio of tidal to general relativistic precession spans approximately $10^{-33}$ - $10^{-28}$, indicating that relativistic precession overwhelmingly dominates. Our results suggest that direct detection of the neutron-star tidal contribution through orbital precession around Sgr A* would be exceptionally challenging under the assumptions of the adopted model.

classification.title_zh: Sgr A* 周围中子星轨道进动的潮汐贡献
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Sgr A* 超大质量黑洞周围中子星轨道进动的潮汐贡献，并用 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程描述恒星位形。我们考察潮汐进动对恒星致密度、近星点距离和四极潮汐 Love 数 k2 的依赖，并将其量级与广义相对论轨道进动进行比较。计算得到的潮汐角偏移随近星点距离增大而显著减小，并且在所考虑的恒星位形中随致密度增大而减小；较大的 Love 数会增强潮汐贡献。这种行为反映了潮汐进动对恒星半径与近星点距离之比 (R/rp)^5 的强依赖。尽管在更近距离交会时潮汐效应会增强，但预测的潮汐偏移仍然极小，在所示参数范围内约为 3.5×10^-18 μas。潮汐进动与广义相对论进动之比约为 10^-33 至 10^-28，表明相对论进动占绝对主导。我们的结果表明，在所采用模型的假设下，通过 Sgr A* 周围的轨道进动直接探测中子星潮汐贡献将异常困难。

papers.title: Torque lags from magnetic unlocking in neutron stars and gravitational-wave smearing
papers.abstract: In canonical twisted-torus models of hydromagnetic equilibrium in neutron stars, the toroidal field is confined to regions where the poloidal field lines are closed. As spindown torques applied at the stellar surface need not be communicated efficiently to such magnetically-unlocked regions, toroidal zones or magnetic voids may rotate faster than the electromagnetically braked part of the star. Continuous gravitational radiation from the associated non-corotating quadrupole may therefore be emitted at higher frequencies than poloidal ones to a degree that depends on the diffusive microphysics controlling angular momentum transport. Dissipative processes can suppress long-lived lags, and we estimate the relevant timescales and their sensitivity to microphysics. Nevertheless, we show that a quadrupole component whose pattern speed differs from the observed spin is shifted, or smeared, over a finite frequency band. Single-template or narrowband upper limits therefore constrain only the quadrupole contribution lying inside the searched frequency window, not necessarily the full frequency-integrated quadrupole. Using simple models, we quantify this spectral redistribution over finite observation windows and discuss its implications for continuous-wave searches.

classification.title_zh: 中子星磁解锁产生的力矩滞后与引力波抹散
classification.abstract_zh: 在典型的中子星磁流体平衡扭曲环面模型中，环向场局限于极向场线闭合的区域。由于恒星表面施加的自转减慢力矩未必能有效传递到这些磁解锁区域，环向区或磁空腔可能比电磁制动部分转得更快。因此，由相关非共转四极矩产生的连续引力辐射可能以高于极向区的频率发出，程度取决于控制角动量输运的扩散微观物理。耗散过程可抑制长寿命滞后，我们估计相关时标及其对微观物理的敏感性。我们表明，图案速度不同于观测自转的四极矩分量会在有限频带内被移动或抹散。单模板或窄带上限因此只约束落在搜索频率窗内的四极矩贡献，而不一定是全频积分的四极矩。用简单模型，我们量化有限观测窗内的这种谱再分布，并讨论其对连续波搜索的意义。

papers.title: Dark Matter phase space distribution under a fully relativistic treatment. Eddington inversion according to general relativity
papers.abstract: We develop a fully relativistic extension of Eddington inversion to reconstruct the phase-space distribution function of dark matter from its density profile. Treating dark matter as an effective perfect fluid in a static, spherically symmetric spacetime, we use the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations to determine the gravitational background and derive an Abel-type inversion that yields the distribution function in terms of the conserved particle energy measured at infinity. We show that the resulting expression recovers the classical Eddington inversion in the weak-field, nonrelativistic limit. We also investigate the finite-boundary contribution, which can introduce an unphysical divergence, and present a regularization procedure that removes it. We apply our method to a Milky Way model consisting of a generalized Navarro-Frenk-White halo and a Gondolo-Silk dark-matter spike around Sagittarius A$^*$, neglecting baryonic contributions. The relativistic and Newtonian velocity distributions agree at radii far from the Galactic center but begin to differ at distances of order $10^{-5}\,\mathrm{pc}$. Closer to the black hole, the relativistic peak speed can reach approximately twice the Newtonian prediction. Finally, we derive a general expression for dark-matter capture by neutron stars that accommodates arbitrary ambient velocity distributions. Near Sagittarius A$^*$, the relativistic capture factor is nearly an order of magnitude smaller than the Maxwell-Boltzmann prediction, while the Newtonian Eddington result can overestimate it by a factor of approximately two. These results demonstrate the importance of relativistic phase-space reconstruction for dark-matter phenomenology in strong gravitational fields.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论处理下的暗物质相空间分布：基于广义相对论的 Eddington 反演
classification.abstract_zh: 本文将 Eddington 反演推广为完全相对论版本，用以从暗物质密度剖面重建其相空间分布函数。作者把暗物质视为静态球对称时空中的有效完美流体，利用 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程确定引力背景，并推导出以无穷远处守恒粒子能量为变量的 Abel 型反演。结果表明，该表达式在弱场非相对论极限下回到经典 Eddington 反演；作者还研究有限边界贡献可能引入的非物理发散，并给出正则化方案。将该方法应用于由广义 Navarro-Frenk-White 晕和 Sagittarius A* 周围 Gondolo-Silk 暗物质尖峰组成的银河系模型（忽略重子贡献）时，相对论与非相对论速度分布在远离银心处一致，但在约 10^{-5} pc 量级开始不同；更靠近黑洞处，相对论峰值速度可达牛顿预测的约两倍。最后，作者导出适用于任意环境速度分布的中子星暗物质捕获一般表达式；在 Sagittarius A* 附近，相对论捕获因子比 Maxwell-Boltzmann 预测小近一个量级，而牛顿 Eddington 结果可高估约两倍。这些结果说明强引力场中相对论相空间重建对暗物质现象学很重要。

papers.title: Nonlinear Tides of Binary Neutron Stars
papers.abstract: Nonlinear tides couple stellar oscillations and reshape the gravitational wave (GW) signal from inspiralling binaries. We present hydrodynamic simulations of nonlinear tides in inspiralling neutron-star binaries and, within a mode-coupling model, derive a semi-analytic quadrupolar fundamental mode-frequency shift through second order in the tidal strength. The two approaches agree in the perturbative regime, but diverge at stronger tidal fields, where perturbation theory breaks down. In the late inspiral, nonlinear tides reduce the fundamental-mode frequency by ${\sim}10\%$ for equal-mass binaries and add a GW phase shift of $\mathcal{O}(1)$ radian beyond the linear tidal response. These effects make nonlinear tides a promising target for next-generation GW detectors.

classification.title_zh: 双中子星的非线性潮汐
classification.abstract_zh: 非线性潮汐会耦合恒星振荡，并改变旋近双星产生的引力波信号。我们给出旋近中子星双星中非线性潮汐的流体力学模拟，并在模式耦合模型内推导出潮汐强度二阶的准解析四极基模频率移动。两种方法在微扰区域一致，但在更强潮汐场下出现分歧，此时微扰论失效。在旋近后期，等质量双星的非线性潮汐使基模频率降低约10%，并在线性潮汐响应之外增加量级为O(1)弧度的引力波相位移动。这些效应使非线性潮汐成为下一代引力波探测器的有希望目标。

papers.title: Gravitationally Induced Polarization-Angle Rotation in Pulsar-Black Hole Binaries
papers.abstract: Radio pulsars emit highly polarized radiation whose polarization properties are commonly described by the Rotating Vector Model (RVM). In this work, we investigate the effects of gravitational light bending and parallel transport on the polarization profile of a pulsar in a hypothetical binary system with a black hole (BH) companion. We combine the RVM with numerical integration of null geodesics to calculate the polarization direction along the photon trajectory and model the orbital-phase-dependent variation of the observed polarization position angle (PPA). We consider both non-spinning and spinning black hole companions and include the evolution of the orbital geometry due to relativistic spin-orbit coupling. For a non-spinning black hole, the change in the observed polarization direction arises from the geometric shift associated with gravitational light bending. For a spinning black hole, frame dragging introduces an additional geometric shift, while parallel transport produces an additional polarization rotation measured relative to our chosen reference construction. We investigate the dependence of these polarization changes on the binary parameters and the orientation of the pulsar spin. We find that gravitational light bending can significantly distort the characteristic S-shaped PPA profile, particularly near superior conjunction, and can reverse its overall sense of variation for the supermassive black hole system considered here. Relativistic spin-orbit evolution also affects the orbital-phase dependence of the polarization profile, particularly in the supermassive black hole system. These results show that relativistic photon propagation can modify both the shape and the phase dependence of pulsar polarization profiles and may provide a useful probe of the geometry of pulsar-BH binaries when such systems are discovered.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星-黑洞双星中引力诱导的偏振角旋转
classification.abstract_zh: 射电脉冲星发出高度偏振辐射，其偏振性质常用旋转矢量模型（RVM）描述。本文研究在假想的脉冲星-黑洞双星中，引力光线偏折与平行移动对脉冲星偏振剖面的影响。我们将RVM与零测地线数值积分结合，计算光子轨迹上的偏振方向，并建模观测偏振位置角（PPA）随轨道相位的变化。我们考虑非旋转与旋转黑洞伴星，并纳入相对论自旋-轨道耦合引起的轨道几何演化。对非旋转黑洞，观测偏振方向的变化来自引力光线偏折导致的几何位移；对旋转黑洞，参考系拖曳引入额外几何位移，而平行移动产生相对于所选参考构造测量的额外偏振旋转。我们研究这些偏振变化对双星参数和脉冲星自旋取向的依赖。发现引力光线偏折可显著扭曲特征S形PPA剖面，尤其在上合附近，并可使所考虑的超大质量黑洞系统的整体变化方向反转。相对论自旋-轨道演化也影响偏振剖面的轨道相位依赖，尤其在超大质量黑洞系统中。结果表明，相对论光子传播可同时改变脉冲星偏振剖面的形状和相位依赖，并可能在此类系统被发现时用于探测脉冲星-黑洞双星的几何。

papers.title: Gravitational-Wave Signatures and Periodic Orbits of Charged Particles Around a Five-Dimensional Rotating Black Hole: Comparison with the Kerr Black Hole
papers.abstract: We study periodic orbits of charged particles in the equatorial plane of a five-dimensional ($D=5$) rotating Myers--Perry black hole (BH) immersed in a uniform magnetic field, and the gravitational waves emitted by these orbits in an extreme mass-ratio inspiral. All results are compared with the Kerr BH in the uniform magnetic field. We find that a charged particle is much more weakly bound to the $D=5$ dimensional BH, i.e. its energy at the innermost stable circular orbit is close to unity, $0.95$--$0.99$, compared with $0.78$--$0.94$ for the Kerr BH, and the depth of the potential well is several times smaller. As a result, the periodic orbits of the $D=5$ dimensional BH lie much closer to the separatrix. The magnetic field can make the azimuthal frequency of the orbit smaller than the radial one and produces loops in the orbits far from the BH. Using the numerical kludge method, we compute the gravitational waveforms for a compact object of $10M_\odot$ orbiting a BH of $10^6M_\odot$. At the same magnetic field, the $D=5$ dimensional signal has a longer period, lower frequencies, and an amplitude smaller by about $18\%$. We show that for the magnetic parameter $\beta M=0.02$ the strongest spectral line is at $7.9$\,mHz, compared with $9.9$\,mHz for the Kerr BH. An estimate of the radiation reaction shows that the periodic orbits survive from less than an hour to a few days in the presence of an external magnetic field. Over these lifetimes, the signal-to-noise ratio for LISA is $7$--$31$ for the rotating BH in $D=5$ dimensions, compared to the Kerr BH where it is about $15$--$54$.

classification.title_zh: 五维旋转黑洞周围带电粒子的引力波信号与周期轨道：与Kerr黑洞的比较
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究浸没在均匀磁场中的五维旋转Myers-Perry黑洞赤道面上带电粒子的周期轨道，并计算这些轨道在极端质量比旋进中发出的引力波，所有结果均与均匀磁场中的Kerr黑洞比较。研究发现，带电粒子在五维黑洞中束缚得弱得多：其最内稳定圆轨道能量接近1，为0.95--0.99，而Kerr黑洞为0.78--0.94，势阱深度也小数倍；因此五维黑洞的周期轨道更靠近分界线。磁场可使轨道方位角频率小于径向频率，并在远离黑洞处产生回环。作者使用数值kludge方法计算了10倍太阳质量致密天体绕10^6倍太阳质量黑洞运行时的引力波形。在相同磁场下，五维信号周期更长、频率更低，振幅约小18%。当磁参数βM=0.02时，最强谱线位于7.9 mHz，而Kerr黑洞为9.9 mHz。辐射反作用估计表明，在外部磁场存在时周期轨道可存活不到一小时至数天；在此期间，LISA对五维旋转黑洞的信噪比为7--31，而Kerr黑洞约为15--54。

papers.title: Quasinormal modes of thick branes in $f(R,T)$ gravity
papers.abstract: We study tensor perturbations and quasinormal modes (QNMs) of thick branes in $f(R,T)=R+\alpha T$ gravity. Starting from the background thick brane solutions, we derive the Schr\"odinger-like equation for gravitational perturbations and construct the corresponding effective potential. The effective potential exhibits a double-barrier structure whose properties depend on the model parameters. We analyze transmission spectra and find good agreement between resonance peaks and the real parts of the quasinormal frequencies. The parameters $b$ and $\alpha$ mainly control the width and height of the potential barriers, respectively. QNMs are extracted using both time-domain evolution and direct integration methods, showing consistent results for low-lying modes. Higher overtones become increasingly difficult to extract due to stronger damping and numerical contamination. Our results indicate that $f(R,T)$ corrections significantly affect both the effective potential and the quasinormal spectrum, providing a possible imprint of modified gravity in braneworld perturbations.

classification.title_zh: f(R,T)引力中厚膜的准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 f(R,T)=R+αT 引力中厚膜的张量扰动与准正规模（QNMs）。从背景厚膜解出发，我们推导了引力扰动的类薛定谔方程并构造相应的有效势。该有效势呈现双势垒结构，其性质依赖于模型参数。我们分析了透射谱，发现共振峰与准正规模实部吻合良好。参数 b 和 α 主要分别控制势垒的宽度和高度。我们使用时域演化和直接积分方法提取 QNMs，低阶模式结果一致。由于更强的阻尼和数值污染，高阶泛音越来越难以提取。我们的结果表明，f(R,T) 修正会显著影响有效势和准正规模谱，为修改引力在膜世界扰动中留下可能印记。
classification.one_liner: 该文在 f(R,T)=R+αT 引力中研究厚膜张量扰动的有效势与准正规模，发现修改引力参数显著改变双势垒结构和 QNM 谱。

papers.title: The $C^0$-inextendibility of Kerr spacetimes
papers.abstract: We prove the $C^0$-inextendibility of the full Kerr realizations considered in this paper and all their connected covering spacetimes. The result holds for positive mass and nonzero rotation in the subextremal, extremal, and overextremal regimes. The obstruction at the singular ring is expressed by unbounded proper time in a fixed-endpoint causal homotopy class. It persists under every positive continuous conformal rescaling and under continuous widening of the Kerr causal cones, without any global causality assumption. We give sharp bounds in a fixed coordinate norm for stationary and axisymmetric perturbations and describe complete timelike geodesics that encounter arbitrarily large curvature near the ring.

classification.title_zh: Kerr时空的C^0-不可延拓性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明了本文所考虑的全Kerr实现及其所有连通覆盖时空的C^0-不可延拓性。该结果在正质量且非零转动下成立，涵盖亚极端、极端和超极端情形。奇异环处的阻碍由固定端点因果同伦类中无界的固有时表述。它在每个正连续共形重标度下以及Kerr因果锥的连续加宽下持续存在，且无需任何全局因果性假设。我们给出了固定坐标范数下对稳态和轴对称扰动的尖锐界，并描述了在环附近遇到任意大曲率的完整类时测地线。
classification.one_liner: 证明Kerr时空及其连通覆盖时空在C^0意义下不可延拓，阻碍来自奇异环处固有时无界。

papers.title: Existence of static axisymmetric solutions to the Einstein equations
papers.abstract: We construct smooth Riemannian metrics and scalar potentials that are invariant under a circle action and satisfy the static Einstein equations with positive cosmological constant. The underlying compact three-manifold is a ball with two disjoint open balls removed. The potential (or lapse function) is positive in the interior and vanishes at the boundary, consisting of three non-degenerate horizons. The areas of the two inner boundary components are controlled by two arbitrary parameters, namely the masses of the black holes, which are taken to be sufficiently small and comparable. Each inner horizon radius scales linearly with the individual mass parameters, while the separation of their reference centers scales as the cube root of the total mass. These two scales are assumed to be sufficiently small at different rates, whereas the cosmological length remains fixed. The main analytical challenge is to control the linearized equation and the nonlinear remainder simultaneously near the shrinking horizons, between the centers and in the outer region. Weighted H\"older estimates quantify the growth of the inverse and show that the error of an approximation joining Kottler collars to de Sitter space is small enough to close a contraction argument. Namely, we solve a reduced elliptic Einstein equation that is endowed with two obstruction tensors; varying the two axial positions removes their coefficients. The contracted Bianchi identity and an energy estimate for an auxiliary vector field (Killing field) introduced by the projection to vanish. Finally, for a fixed cosmological constant, the intrinsic metric of one of the two boundary components is sufficient to determine a static solution with simply connected interior and non-vanishing boundary gradient, up to isometry and multiplication of the potential by a positive constant.

classification.title_zh: 爱因斯坦方程静态轴对称解的存在性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文构造在圆作用下不变、并满足带正宇宙学常数的静态爱因斯坦方程的平滑黎曼度规与标量势。底流形是一个球体挖去两个不相交开球所得的区域；势（失效函数）在内部为正、在边界为零，形成三个非退化视界。两个内边界的面积由两个黑洞质量参数控制。两个内视界半径分别随各自质量参数线性缩放，参考中心间距按总质量的立方根缩放；这些尺度以不同速率足够小，而宇宙学尺度固定。主要分析难点是在收缩视界附近、中心之间以及外部区域同时控制线性化方程与非线性余项。作者用加权 Hölder 估计控制逆的增长，并证明将 Kottler 环套与 de Sitter 空间拼接的近似误差足以闭合压缩论证。具体而言，作者求解一个带两个障碍张量的约化椭圆爱因斯坦方程，通过改变两个轴向位置消除其系数，并利用收缩 Bianchi 恒等式及辅助 Killing 向量的能量估计使投影消失。最后，对固定宇宙学常数，两个边界分量之一的內禀度规足以确定一个内部单连通、边界梯度非零的静态解，直至等距和势乘以正常数。
classification.one_liner: 证明在带正宇宙学常数、挖去两个球体的球状区域上存在具有三个非退化视界的静态轴对称爱因斯坦方程解。

papers.title: Geometric criticality and regular quasibound spectra of axial Proca fields in Schwarzschild spacetime
papers.abstract: We investigate how a local geometric critical point of the odd-parity Proca potential relates to the global quasibound spectrum in Schwarzschild spacetime. After normalization by $\mu^2$, the axial potential $V_{\rm ax}=(1-2M/r)[\ell(\ell+1)/r^2+\mu^2]$ has the same radial form as the timelike-geodesic effective potential. Its outer minimum and inner maximum merge at $r=6M$, the Schwarzschild innermost stable circular orbit, when $(M\mu_c)^2=\ell(\ell+1)/12$. With $\delta=1-(M\mu)^2/(M\mu_c)^2$, we derive exact fold scalings: stationary-point separation $\propto\delta^{1/2}$, barrier--well depth $\propto\delta^{3/2}$, and curvature magnitudes $\propto\delta^{1/2}$. Continued-fraction calculations for the first three axial quasibound branches with $\ell=1,2,3$, cross-checked for selected modes by independent Riccati shooting, show regular frequency continuation across the threshold and approximately linear near-critical behavior. At fixed radius the radial operator is affine in $\delta$, supporting a conditional simple-root analytic interpretation. The main result is the explicit distinction between geometric potential criticality and spectral degeneracy for the branches examined.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild时空中轴向Proca场的几何临界性与规则准束缚谱
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究奇宇称Proca势的局部几何临界点与Schwarzschild时空中整体准束缚谱之间的关系。归一化后，轴向势与类时测地线有效势具有相同的径向形式；当 (Mμ_c)^2=ℓ(ℓ+1)/12 时，其外极小与内极大在 r=6M（即Schwarzschild最内稳定圆轨道）处合并。以 δ=1-(Mμ)^2/(Mμ_c)^2 定义偏离量，作者导出精确的折叠标度：驻点间距正比于 δ^{1/2}，势垒-势阱深度正比于 δ^{3/2}，曲率大小正比于 δ^{1/2}。对 ℓ=1,2,3 的前三个轴向准束缚支，连分数计算并用Riccati打靶对部分模式交叉检验，显示频率跨阈值规则延续且近临界行为近似线性。固定半径下径向算符对 δ 仿射，支持一种条件性的简单根解析解释。主要结果是明确区分所考察分支中的几何势临界性与谱简并。
classification.one_liner: 在Schwarzschild背景中，轴向Proca势的几何临界点（r=6M）与准束缚频谱并不等价，谱在阈值附近规则延续。

papers.title: Relativistic diffusing particles, entropy and varying cosmological constants
papers.abstract:
We discuss Einstein equations with a non-conserved energy-momentum $T^{\mu
u}$. The energy-momentum tensor $	ilde{T}^{\mu
u}$ on the right hand side of Einstein equations is expressed in the form $8\pi GT^{\mu
u}-g^{\mu
u}\Lambda+\Sigma^{\mu
u}$ where $G$ is the Newton constant, $\Lambda$ is the cosmological term and $T^{\mu
u}$ is the energy-momentum of an ideal fluid. The remaining part $\Sigma^{\mu
u}$ describes the viscosity and a heat flow. We discuss space-time-dependent Newton ``constant" $G$ and the cosmological term $\Lambda$. The covariant conservation law for $	ilde{T}^{\mu
u}$ imposes a relation between the energy-momentum (non)conservation and the variation of $G$ and $\Lambda$. The covariant derivative $
abla_{\mu}T^{\mu
u}$ can be related to the first law of thermodynamics and expressed by the temperature $T$ and the entropy $S$. The energy-momentum non-conservation in our models is a consequence of a diffusion of its constituting particles. We describe a gas of diffusing massive particles in a homogeneous isotropic space-time as a system with a time-dependent linear barotropic equation of state $P_{t}=w_{t}ho_{t}$ with $0<w_{t}\leq  rac{1}{3}$. The gas of massive diffusing particles in an expanding universe tends in a limit of infinite time to the gas of diffusing massless particles. We obtain results on the energy density, entropy and phase space dstribution in a soluble model of massless relativistic particles in a spatially flat expanding universe.

classification.title_zh: 相对论性扩散粒子、熵与变化的宇宙学常数
classification.abstract_zh: 本文讨论能量动量张量不守恒时的爱因斯坦方程。方程右侧的等效能量动量张量写成理想流体项、宇宙学项以及描述粘性与热流的额外项之和，并允许牛顿常数G与宇宙学项Λ随时空变化。等效能量动量张量的协变守恒给出能量动量非守恒与G、Λ变化之间的关系；协变导数∇_μT^{μν}可与热力学第一定律联系，并用温度和熵表示。模型中的能量动量非守恒源于组成粒子的扩散。文章在均匀各向同性时空中描述大质量扩散粒子气体，采用随时间变化的线性正压物态方程P_t=w_tρ_t（0<w_t≤1/3），并指出在膨胀宇宙中该气体在无穷长时间极限下趋于无质量扩散粒子气体；最后给出空间平直膨胀宇宙中无质量相对论粒子可解模型的能量密度、熵与相空间分布结果。

papers.title: Topological analysis of novel charged-AdS black hole solutions embedded in dark matter halos with quintessence field
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the properties of a charged anti-de Sitter (AdS) black hole in the presence of a NGC 4649-type dark matter halo and a surrounding quintessence field. Starting from the modified Einstein field equations (EFEs), we construct the corresponding black hole solutions by incorporating the effects of electric charge, cosmological constant, dark matter distribution, and quintessence characterized by a variable equation of state. We analyze the resulting spacetime geometry through the metric function and horizon structure, showing that the dark matter halo strengthens the gravitational attraction, whereas the quintessence field provides a repulsive contribution that substantially alters the asymptotic behavior of the spacetime. Furthermore, the thermodynamic properties are investigated by applying the Duan-\(\phi\)-mapping topological theory together with the generalized free energy method. This framework allows us to examine the topological structure, critical behavior, and stability conditions of the black hole system in a consistent manner. We further study the fractional shifts relative to the reference value of \(\omega_q\) and observe that variations in \(\omega_q\) produce systematic changes which highlight the important role of the quintessence field in determining the phase structure and critical behavior of the black hole system.

classification.title_zh: 嵌入具有精质场的暗物质晕中的新型带电AdS黑洞解的拓扑分析
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究在存在NGC 4649型暗物质晕及周围精质场时，带电反德西特（AdS）黑洞的性质。我们从修改的Einstein场方程出发，纳入电荷、宇宙学常数、暗物质分布以及由变状态方程描述的精质场效应，构造相应的黑洞解。我们通过度规函数和视界结构分析所得时空几何，表明暗物质晕增强引力吸引，而精质场提供排斥贡献并显著改变时空的渐近行为。此外，我们结合Duan-φ映射拓扑理论与广义自由能方法研究热力学性质，从而一致地考察黑洞系统的拓扑结构、临界行为和稳定性条件。我们还研究相对于ω_q参考值的分数偏移，并观察到ω_q的变化会产生系统性变化，这突显了精质场在决定黑洞系统相结构和临界行为中的重要作用。

papers.title: Forecasting Strongly Lensed Binary Black Hole Rates from the Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background with TianQin
papers.abstract: The millihertz stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) provides a population-level probe of stellar-mass binary black holes (BBHs) and their cosmic merger history. We develop a framework using TianQin alone to propagate SGWB-informed BBH population constraints into forecasts of strongly lensed BBH mergers detectable by ground-based gravitational-wave detectors. The framework distinguishes between lensed events with at least one detected image and lens systems in which both images are detected and successfully associated. Using a one-year mock observation, we infer the BBH population and propagate the resulting posterior through a galaxy-scale lensing model with image-level selection. For the adopted system-magnification threshold, \(\mu_{\rm sys}\ge 2\), the median predicted rate of lensed events with at least one detected image is \(R_{\rm event}^{\rm det}=5.50\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}\), while the median rate of associated two-image lens systems is \(R_{\rm sys}^{\rm det}=2.54\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}\); the median detectable system fraction is \(\mathcal{F}_{\rm sys}^{\rm det}=3.35\times10^{-4}\). Compared with the prior-only propagation, the pooled 16th--84th percentile widths decrease by 6.5\% for the event rate, 6.4\% for the system rate, and 4.0\% for the system fraction. Our work establishes a quantitative link between millihertz SGWB inference and forecasts of strongly lensed BBH mergers for ground-based gravitational-wave observations.

classification.title_zh: 利用天琴从随机引力波背景预报强透镜双黑洞事件率
classification.abstract_zh: 毫赫兹随机引力波背景（SGWB）为恒星质量双黑洞（BBH）及其宇宙学并合历史提供了族群层面的探针。我们建立了一个仅使用天琴的框架，将SGWB给出的BBH族群约束传播到地面引力波探测器可探测的强透镜BBH并合预报中。该框架区分至少探测到一个像的透镜事件与两个像均被探测并成功关联的透镜系统。利用一年的模拟观测，我们推断BBH族群，并将所得后验通过带有像级选择的星系尺度透镜模型传播。对于所采用的系统放大率阈值 μ_sys ≥ 2，至少探测到一个像的透镜事件率中位数为 R_event^det=5.50×10^-4 yr^-1，而成功关联的双像透镜系统率中位数为 R_sys^det=2.54×10^-4 yr^-1；可探测系统比例中位数为 F_sys^det=3.35×10^-4。与仅先验传播相比，合并的16--84百分位宽度在事件率上减少6.5%，在系统率上减少6.4%，在系统比例上减少4.0%。我们的工作建立了毫赫兹SGWB推断与地面引力波观测的强透镜BBH并合预报之间的定量联系。
classification.one_liner: 用天琴的SGWB族群推断预报地面探测器可探测的强透镜双黑洞事件率。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves from Ringing Dyonic Black Holes and Estimation of Parameters in Einstein-Bumblebee-Maxwell Gravity
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the quasinormal mode (QNM) frequencies of dyonic Reissner-Nordstr\"om (RN)-like black holes associated with scalar and gravitational perturbations in the framework of Einstein-bumblebee-Maxwell gravity theory. The QNMs are calculated using the 6th-order Pad\'e averaged WKB approximation method. We analyse the dependence of oscillation frequencies and damping rate of the BHs for the free model parameters. To further verify the QNM spectrum, we study the time evolution of both the scalar and gravitational perturbations around the BHs and extract the dominant QNM from the resulting ringdown signal. Moreover, we try to estimate the BH parameters using Fisher analysis method for the future gravitational wave detector named Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). We found that for supermassive BHs with mass around $10^6$ -- $10^8 M_\odot$ and at lower redshifts, the signal-to-noise ratio for the detection of a QNM signal by the LISA is high. Further, for a representative source at a luminosity distance of $3$ Gpc, the BH mass at the detector reference frame and the Lorentz violating parameter are well constrained for supermassive BHs with mass $\ge 10^6.$

classification.title_zh: 振铃双荷黑洞的引力波与 Einstein-Bumblebee-Maxwell 引力中的参数估计
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在 Einstein-bumblebee-Maxwell 引力理论框架下，研究双荷 Reissner-Nordström 型黑洞在标量和引力扰动下的准正规模频率，采用六阶 Padé 平均 WKB 近似方法计算。作者分析了振荡频率和阻尼率对自由模型参数的依赖，并通过标量与引力扰动的时间演化验证 QNM 谱、从铃宕信号中提取主导 QNM。进一步使用 Fisher 分析方法，针对未来引力波探测器 LISA 估计黑洞参数；结果表明，对于质量约 10^6–10^8 倍太阳质量且红移较低的超大质量黑洞，QNM 信号信噪比较高；对于光度距离 3 Gpc 的代表性源，质量不小于 10^6 倍太阳质量时，探测器参考系中的黑洞质量和洛伦兹破坏参数可得到较好限制。

papers.title: Accurate pulsar timing array likelihoods: better low-rank covariance for gravitational wave background
papers.abstract: In pulsar timing array analyses, the stochastic process describing the gravitational wave background is typically modeled using a Fourier basis at discrete frequencies with an interval $\sim 0.1~\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$, with a diagonal Fourier-domain covariance determined by the power spectral density at the corresponding frequencies. Although this rank-reduced modeling significantly accelerates likelihood evaluation and provides a good approximation in many scenarios, it can lead to biased parameter inference because it is insensitive to spectral features on scales smaller than $\sim 0.1~\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$. We introduce a better construction of the low-rank covariance for low-frequency processes by maximizing the log-likelihood averaged over an ensemble of realizations drawn from the true model likelihood. In this approach, the basis-domain covariance matrix is sensitive to the entire model spectrum and is generally non-diagonal. Using two mock datasets, we demonstrate improved likelihood accuracy and more faithful recovery of spectral features compared to the conventional Fourier-diagonal model. Benchmark tests show that this new model requires a computational cost comparable to that of the conventional approach.

classification.title_zh: 精确的脉冲星计时阵列似然：用于引力波背景的更好低秩协方差
classification.abstract_zh: 在脉冲星计时阵列分析中，描述引力波背景的随机过程通常用离散频率、间隔约0.1 yr^{-1}的傅里叶基建模，其傅里叶域协方差为对角，并由相应频率的功率谱密度决定。尽管这种降秩建模显著加速似然评估并在许多情形下提供良好近似，但它对小于约0.1 yr^{-1}尺度的谱特征不敏感，可能导致参数推断有偏。我们通过最大化在从真实模型似然抽取的实现集合上平均的对数似然，引入一种更好的低频过程低秩协方差构造。在该方法中，基域协方差矩阵对整个模型谱敏感，且通常非对角。使用两个模拟数据集，我们证明相比传统傅里叶对角模型，似然精度提高且谱特征恢复更忠实。基准测试表明新模型计算成本与传统方法相当。

papers.title: Neutron Star--Primordial Black Hole Binaries: Dynamical Tides, Resonance Locking, and Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: The orbital evolution of a neutron star and a much lower-mass primordial black hole can differ strikingly from that of typical compact binaries. Dynamical tides, analogous to those in the Solar System's giant planet-moon systems, can accelerate inspiral or induce outspiral, depending on the orbital configuration. We show how gravitational-wave emission mediates this evolution when neutron star modes remain locked in resonance with the orbit. These effects may leave observable signatures in pulsar timing or gravitational waves.

classification.title_zh: 中子星—原初黑洞双星：动力学潮汐、共振锁定与引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星与质量低得多的原初黑洞的轨道演化，可能与典型致密双星显著不同。类似于太阳系巨行星—卫星系统中的动力学潮汐，可根据轨道构型加速旋近或诱导向外旋出。我们展示当中子星模式与轨道保持共振锁定时，引力波辐射如何介导这一演化。这些效应可能在脉冲星计时或引力波中留下可观测印记。

papers.title: Impact of nonlinear electrodynamics on quasinormal modes of rotating black strings
papers.abstract: We study massless scalar perturbations of rotating anti-de Sitter black strings sourced by a power-Maxwell field with negative exponent $s$. The charge enters the metric function as $-Qr^{p}$ with $p=2/(1-2s)$, and the case $s=-1/2$ gives a linear term with an algebraic horizon. Since rotation is a local boost of the static string, the rotating spectrum follows exactly from the static one evaluated at a frequency-dependent momentum. We compute the spectrum with the Horowitz-Hubeny series, Chebyshev collocation and time-domain evolution, each implemented in two independent codes and checked against the planar Schwarzschild-AdS limit. The charge acts in two ways. At the reduced charge $\hat q_c=0.72626$ the least damped pair of modes meets on the imaginary axis, so more strongly charged strings ring down without oscillation, and at the endpoint of the branch the spectrum is exactly hypergeometric. At large transverse momentum the distance of the modes from the light cone grows as $k^{1/(1-4s)}$, replacing the $k^{-1/5}$ law of the neutral brane. Rotation continues the exceptional point into a line in the plane of charge and rotation, adds a purely damped axisymmetric tower, and never produces superradiant growth. A near-horizon estimate used earlier for this geometry misses all of these effects.

classification.title_zh: 非线性电动力学对旋转黑洞弦准正规模式的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 研究由负指数幂-Maxwell场产生的旋转反de Sitter黑洞弦的无质量标量扰动。电荷以 -Q r^p 进入度规函数，其中 p=2/(1-2s)；s=-1/2 时给出线性项和代数视界。由于旋转可视为静态弦的局域助推，旋转谱可由静态谱在频率依赖动量下精确得到。用Horowitz-Hubeny级数、Chebyshev配置和时间演化计算谱，每种方法在两套独立代码中实现，并与平面Schwarzschild-AdS极限核对。电荷有两种作用：在约化电荷 \hat q_c=0.72626 处，最弱阻尼的一对模式在虚轴上相遇，因此更强带电的弦无振荡衰减；在分支端点谱为精确超几何形式。大横向动量下，模式到光锥的距离按 k^{1/(1-4s)} 增长，替代中性膜的 k^{-1/5} 规律。旋转将例外点延续为电荷-旋转平面中的一条线，增加纯阻尼轴对称模式塔，且从不产生超辐射增长。此前用于该几何的近视界估计遗漏了所有这些效应。

papers.title: Black holes from a nonlocal equation of state: horizon geometry, singularity structure and thermodynamics
papers.abstract: We show that a nonlocal equation of state for an anisotropic fluid reduces to a linear equation for the enclosed matter and uniquely selects a Yukawa-type density profile in a static, spherically symmetric Kerr--Schild geometry. The resulting neutral solution has finite-range hair, exponentially screened at large distances, with the asymptotic mass as its only conserved charge, and admits an exact horizon classification: horizonless configurations, Schwarzschild-like black holes, two-horizon geometries with a Cauchy horizon, and an extremal configuration whose mass and radius are obtained in closed form. We prove that the magnitude of the inner surface gravity exceeds that of the outer horizon throughout the two-horizon regime. When the central mass vanishes, the geometry approaches a global monopole in the static branch and a Kantowski--Sachs-type region in the nonstatic branch. The singularity satisfies Kr\'olak's strong-curvature criterion and is Tipler-strong along non-radial geodesics in the spacelike branch. For vanishing central mass, the Ricci scalar and the square root of the Kretschmann scalar are locally integrable with respect to the invariant spacetime volume, despite diverging at the origin. A power-law generalization of the nonlocal closure yields solutions expressed through incomplete gamma functions, interpolating between the singular core and a regular black hole with a de~Sitter core, without invoking nonlinear electrodynamics. We obtain closed-form surface gravities, an extended first-law identity and a Smarr relation, and locate the heat-capacity divergence using the lower branch of the Lambert function. Finally, thermodynamic topology distinguishes a Schwarzschild-like regime with one defect from an extremal regime with two opposite-winding defects that merge at the maximum Hawking temperature.

classification.title_zh: 来自非局域状态方程的黑洞：视界几何、奇点结构与热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，各向异性流体的非局域状态方程可化为关于包围物质的线性方程，并在静态球对称 Kerr-Schild 几何中唯一选出 Yukawa 型密度分布。所得中性解具有有限程毛，在远距离被指数屏蔽，渐近质量是其唯一守恒荷，并给出精确的视界分类：无视界构型、类 Schwarzschild 黑洞、含 Cauchy 视界的双视界几何，以及质量和半径可闭式给出的极端构型。我们证明在整个双视界区间内，内表面重力的量值超过外视界。中心质量消失时，几何在静态支逼近整体单极子，在非静态支逼近 Kantowski-Sachs 型区域。奇点满足 Králak 强曲率判据，并在类空支沿非径向测地线为 Tipler 强奇点。中心质量消失时，尽管 Ricci 标量和 Kretschmann 标量平方根在原点发散，它们关于不变时空体积局部可积。非局域闭合关系的幂律推广给出用不完全 gamma 函数表示的解，在奇异核心与具有 de Sitter 核心的正规黑洞之间插值，且无需引入非线性电动力学。我们得到闭式表面重力、扩展第一定律恒等式和 Smarr 关系，并利用 Lambert 函数下支定位热容发散。最后，热力学拓扑区分出含一个缺陷的类 Schwarzschild 区间与含两个相反绕数缺陷的极端区间，这些缺陷在最大 Hawking 温度处合并。

papers.title: Ultra-compact twin stars with hybrid equations of state from bosonic dark matter
papers.abstract: The properties of compact stars with a strong first-order phase transition to quark matter and with an additional fluid of self-interacting bosonic dark matter (DM) are studied. We find that the inclusion of DM changes the stability of mass-radius configurations relative to the naive one-fluid criterion. For compact star configurations with similar masses and different radii, so-called twin stars, the presence of DM removes the unstable segment between the hadronic and the hybrid branch, so that the stable mass-radius sequence becomes continuous after the onset of the phase transition to quark matter. We furthermore find stable ultra-compact objects (UCOs), defined by a total compactness $C = M_\text{tot}/R_\text{grav} \ge 1/3$. We observe two distinct classes of UCOs: a DM-halo class with $f_\text{DM} \gtrsim 0.9$, and a DM-core class at $f_\text{DM} \lesssim 0.02$. The two classes can be separated by the surface redshift of the normal matter, which reaches $z = 0.734 - 0.808$ for the DM-core and extreme values of $z = 2 - 3.468$ for the DM-halo class, allowing us to use their redshift as a way to disentangle the two classes. Furthermore, the high redshift of the DM-halo UCOs could serve as a signal of DM since their redshift exceeds the Buchdahl limit of $z = 2$. Finally, we find hybrid star solutions of ``ultimate twins" with similar masses and visible radii, but different dark matter content, leading to different tidal deformabilities and surface redshifts. Future X-ray and gravitational measurements of ultra-compact neutron stars with radii and masses outside the allowed neutron star range can thereby probe the presence and the properties of DM in addition to a first-order phase transition to quark matter.

classification.title_zh: 含玻色暗物质混合态方程的超致密孪生星
classification.abstract_zh: 研究了具有强一阶相变到夸克物质、并额外包含自相互作用玻色暗物质流体的致密星性质。我们发现，引入暗物质相对于朴素单流体判据改变了质量-半径构型的稳定性。对于质量相近而半径不同的致密星构型，即所谓孪生星，暗物质的存在消除了强子分支与混合分支之间的不稳定段，使向夸克物质相变开始后的稳定质量-半径序列变得连续。我们还发现稳定的超致密天体，定义为总致密度 C=M_tot/R_grav ≥ 1/3。观察到两类不同的超致密天体：暗物质晕类 f_DM ≳ 0.9，以及暗物质核类 f_DM ≲ 0.02。两类可由正常物质的表面红移区分：暗物质核类达到 z=0.734–0.808，暗物质晕类极端值为 z=2–3.468，从而可用红移区分两类。此外，暗物质晕类超致密天体的高红移可作为暗物质信号，因为其红移超过 Buchdahl 极限 z=2。最后，我们发现“终极孪生星”的混合星解：质量相近且可见半径相似，但暗物质含量不同，导致不同的潮汐形变和表面红移。未来对半径和质量超出允许中子星范围的超致密中子星进行 X 射线和引力测量，可借此探测暗物质的存在与性质，以及到夸克物质的一阶相变。

papers.title: Holographic Approaches to Hadron Structure
papers.abstract: We give an introduction to and an overview of holographic approaches to QCD and hadron structure. After an introduction to the string-theoretic foundations of holographic QCD, we review the predictions of top-down and bottom-up models for the phenomenology of mesons, baryons, and glueballs. We focus on the top-down model following from probe flavor branes in the Witten model of low-energy Yang-Mills theory and, in the more phenomenological approach of bottom-up models, on minimal models based on five-dimensional anti-de Sitter space.

classification.title_zh: 强子结构的全息方法

papers.title: High-order temperature fluctuations in hot and dense QCD matter from multi-charge holography
papers.abstract: We investigate temperature cumulants from second to sixth order across the QCD phase diagram using a lattice-calibrated multi-charge Einstein--Maxwells--dilaton model under heavy-ion charge constraints. Near the model's critical end point at $(\mu_B,T)\simeq(547,112)$~MeV, the enhanced heat capacity produces a local suppression of the temperature variance. The higher-order cumulants develop sign reversals on the high-temperature side of the transition, with the onset moving to lower baryon chemical potentials as the order increases. Ratios of different cumulant orders provide a consistency check of the expected mean-field critical behavior. At fixed chemical potentials, their limits on both sides of the critical point agree with the predictions for the critical-isotherm exponent $\delta=3$. The freeze-out analysis reveals nonmonotonic collision-energy dependence that need not be accompanied by sign reversals. On a representative trajectory, the variance reaches a local minimum near $\sqrt{s_{NN}}\simeq6$~GeV, with its position and depth depending on the freeze-out path. Temperature cumulants probe the thermal response and its critical scaling, providing information complementary to conserved-charge fluctuations for exploring the QCD phase diagram.

papers.title: General Relativity for Mathematicians - Part I
papers.abstract: These notes cover the first part of a course of the same title taught by Filippo Fila-Robattino and Manuel Tecchiolli at the University of Zurich in the Winter Semester of 2025. Topics include variational principles in classical mechanics, special relativity, smooth manifolds and tensor calculus, connections and curvature, geodesic motion, and the derivation of Einstein's equations from the Einstein-Hilbert action. The treatment is aimed at a mathematical audience, combining physical motivation with precise definitions, detailed proofs, and explicit calculations.

papers.title: The Loud Tail of the Supermassive Black Hole Binary Population: Multimessenger Candidates and Prospects for SKAO
papers.abstract: We assess whether electromagnetically identified supermassive black hole (SMBH) binary candidates populate the rare, high-amplitude tail of the gravitational wave (GW) amplitude distribution. Using an SMBH binary population model fitted to the NANOGrav 15-year data, we find that 3C~66B and Mrk~501 are likely to stand out from the GW background, making them promising targets for individual-source searches. Furthermore, we show that individual detections can probe the binary hardening mechanism, as models with strong environmental hardening predict a higher abundance of individually resolvable binaries than purely GW-driven models. Applying the same population fits and accounting for the confusion noise from the unresolved population, we forecast that the Square Kilometre Array Observatory (SKAO) will resolve tens of individual binaries, with 3C~66B robustly detectable.

papers.title: Tracing the evolution of eccentric precessing binary black holes: a hybrid approach
papers.abstract: To describe a general bound binary black hole system, we need to consider orbital eccentricity and the misalignment of black holes' spin vectors with respect to the orbital angular momentum. Binary black holes often have a non-negligible eccentricity at formation, and dynamical interactions could produce binaries with non-negligible eccentricity in the bands of gravitational-wave (GW) detectors. The angle between each black hole's spin vector and the binary's orbital angular momentum (referred to as the spin tilt) at formation also carries information about the formation channel. The spin tilts inferred in GW astronomy are usually those when the binary is in the band of a GW detector. Therefore, it is necessary to evolve the binary back in time to compute the tilts at formation. For certain binaries, the tilts in the formal limit of infinite orbital angular momentum, also known as tilts at infinity, could be a useful approximation to those at formation. Additionally, full orbit-averaged evolution to formation could be computationally infeasible in many situations, while the hybrid evolution we use to compute the tilts at infinity would be feasible. We thus generalize the publicly available tilts_at_infinity code to compute the tilts at infinity for eccentric, spin-precessing binaries. This code employs hybrid post-Newtonian evolution, starting with orbit-averaged evolution for higher frequencies and then transitioning to precession-averaged evolution to compute the tilts at infinity. We find that the transition frequency used in the quasicircular case still gives acceptably small errors in the eccentric case, and show that eccentricity and hybrid evolution both have a significant effect on the tilts at infinity for many binaries. We also give examples of cases where the tilts at infinity are and are not a good approximation to the tilts at formation in the eccentric case. (Abridged)

classification.title_zh: 追踪偏心进动双黑洞的演化：一种混合方法
classification.abstract_zh: 为了描述一般的束缚双黑洞系统，需要考虑轨道偏心率和黑洞自旋矢量与轨道角动量的错位。双黑洞在形成时往往具有不可忽略的偏心率，动力学相互作用也可能在引力波探测器频段内产生具有不可忽略偏心率的双星。每个黑洞自旋矢量与双星轨道角动量之间的夹角（自旋倾角）在形成时也携带形成通道的信息。引力波天文学中推断的自旋倾角通常是双星处于引力波探测器频段时的倾角，因此需要将双星反向演化以计算形成时的倾角。对于某些双星，无限轨道角动量形式极限下的倾角（无穷远倾角）可作为形成时倾角的近似。此外，完全轨道平均演化到形成时在许多情况下计算上不可行，而用于计算无穷远倾角的混合演化则可行。我们因此将公开的 tilts_at_infinity 代码推广到偏心、自旋进动双星，以计算无穷远倾角。该代码采用混合后牛顿演化：先对较高频率进行轨道平均演化，再过渡到进动平均演化以计算无穷远倾角。我们发现准圆情形使用的过渡频率在偏心情形下仍给出可接受的小误差，并表明偏心率和混合演化对许多双星的无穷远倾角都有显著影响。我们还给出了在偏心情形下无穷远倾角是否是形成时倾角良好近似的例子。
classification.one_liner: 该文将 tilts_at_infinity 代码推广到偏心进动双黑洞，用混合后牛顿演化计算无穷远自旋倾角并评估其作为形成时倾角近似的适用性。

papers.title: Post-adiabatic effective-one-body waveforms for coalescing compact binaries
papers.abstract: I apply and extend the formalism of osculating orbits of Damour et al. (2004) and Lynch et al. (2026) to eccentric effective one body (EOB) models, in order to obtain an efficient yet accurate description of the inspiral-to-plunge dynamics of tidal, spinning compact binaries, including precessing ones by twisting the otherwise planar motion. The method is recast in terms of equinoctial orbital elements, to circumvent singularities associated with the zero-eccentricity limit. While the formalism is general and can be applied to any EOB model, I focus here on the TEOBResumS-Dal\'i family and demonstrate how this technique speeds up waveform generation without significantly compromising the accuracy of the model. Over $10^4$ binary neutron stars (BNSs) and as many binary black holes (BBHs) with initial eccentricities up to $0.6$ at $20$ Hz, the median speedup against an optimized version of the model is $\sim 2.6$ for BNSs and $\sim 1.5$ for BBHs, with mismatches against the full numerical solution always below $5 \times 10^{-7}$. The largest speedups, up to $\sim 7$ for individual systems, are obtained for light BBHs ($M \lesssim 8 M_\odot$) with low eccentricities $(e_0 \lesssim 0.1)$. In absolute terms, the median time needed to generate a BNS waveform is $\sim 0.5$ s, with $99.7\%$ of the systems below one second, and for long signals the model is up to $\sim 26$ times faster than a previous version. Applied to the calculation of initial conditions in the $e \rightarrow 0$ limit, the inclusion of radiation-reaction effects allows the model's input eccentricity to agree with the gauge-invariant waveform eccentricity down to initial values of $\sim 7 \times 10^{-8}$. Beyond time-domain applications, the same construction also gives frequency-domain EOB waveforms for eccentric compact binaries via a multi-harmonic stationary phase approximation.

classification.title_zh: 合并致密双星的后绝热有效单体波形
classification.abstract_zh: 本文将 Damour 等（2004）与 Lynch 等（2026）的密切轨道形式推广到偏心有效单体（EOB）模型，以高效且准确地描述含潮汐、自旋以及进动的致密双星从旋近到 plunge 的动力学，并用分点轨道根数避免零偏心率奇点。作者以 TEOBResumS-Dalí 族为例，对大量双中子星与双黑洞系统表明波形生成可提速且失配低于 5×10^{-7}；该方法还可通过多谐波驻相近似给出频域 EOB 波形。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于分点轨道根数的后绝热 EOB 波形方法，在保持高精度下加速偏心、含潮汐与自旋的致密双星波形生成。
