papers.title: Searching for lensed gravitational waves with unlensed templates
papers.abstract: Gravitational lensing can split the signal of a binary merger into two images, which either overlap and interfere or arrive as separate events. We show that the matched-filter output of every two-image template can be straightforwardly constructed from the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) time series that searches already compute with unlensed templates. This enables a marginalized detection statistic that increases search sensitivity without additional matched filtering and is more than 150 times faster than an explicit lensed template bank. For overlapping images in the geometric-optics regime, our two-image method recovers $\gtrsim97\%$ of the optimal SNR from point-mass and singular isothermal lenses, compared with as little as $67\%$ captured by unlensed templates, with substantial gains also for Chang-Refsdal and cored isothermal lenses. Overlapping lensed signals moreover fail the signal-consistency test that is used to down-rank noise transients. Our two-image method restores the consistency and increases the sensitive volume by roughly $2$-$4\times$ for the strongly down-ranked signals. For separated images, our method enables an efficient coherent search for pairs in which neither image is significant alone. Near fold caustics, this increases the sensitive volume by factors of 1.8-2.6 over requiring two independent detections, and up to 1.6 over a targeted counterpart search. Our method is applicable to any matched-filtering search.

classification.title_zh: 用未透镜模板搜寻透镜化引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 引力透镜可把双星并合的引力波信号分成两个像，这两个像可能重叠并干涉，也可能作为分离事件到达。作者表明，每个双像模板的匹配滤波输出都可以直接由现有未透镜模板搜索已经计算的信噪比时间序列构造出来。由此得到一个边缘化检测统计量，无需额外匹配滤波即可提高搜索灵敏度，且比显式透镜模板库快150倍以上。在几何光学区间的重叠像情形下，该双像方法可从点质量透镜和奇异等温透镜中恢复约97%以上的最优信噪比，而未透镜模板最多只捕获约67%；对Chang-Refsdal透镜和带核等温透镜也有显著增益。重叠的透镜化信号还会无法通过用于降低噪声瞬变排序的信号一致性检验，而双像方法可恢复一致性，并使被强烈降序信号的敏感体积增大约2至4倍。对于分离像，该方法可对两个像单独都不显著的成对信号进行高效相干搜索；在折叠焦散附近，相比要求两次独立探测，敏感体积提高1.8至2.6倍，相比针对性对应体搜索最高提高1.6倍。该方法适用于任何匹配滤波搜索。
classification.one_liner: 利用现有未透镜匹配滤波的信噪比时间序列构造双像透镜模板检测统计量，从而高效提升引力波透镜搜索的灵敏度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的引力波透镜搜索与数据分析方法，不属于全息或量子引力研究；与用户所列经典引力支线直接相关。

papers.title: Scattering of scalar waves by scalarized black holes in Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity
papers.abstract: We systematically investigate the scattering and absorption of a massive scalar field by scalarized black holes in Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity with quartic coupling $f(\phi)=\alpha(\phi^{2}+\beta\phi^{4})$ and exponential coupling $f(\phi)=\alpha(1-\operatorname{e}^{-\beta\phi^{2}})$. The background solutions are obtained numerically via a Chebyshev pseudospectral method, enabling a partial-wave analysis on purely numerical black hole backgrounds. The partial-wave results are cross-validated against geodesic and glory approximations and the Schwarzschild limit with excellent agreements. We find that scalarization suppresses the total absorption cross section relative to the Schwarzschild case, and produces distinctive signatures in the differential scattering cross section. A qualitative difference between the two coupling models is identified: for the quartic coupling model, deviations from Schwarzschild are concentrated in the intermediate-angle region $\sim(70^{\circ},140^{\circ})$, with comparatively small changes at forward angles and near the glory peak; for the exponential coupling model, deviations appear across the full angular range and substantially modify the glory peak, which in some parameter regimes can even exceed the Schwarzschild value. This distinctive angular pattern provides a potential diagnostic for distinguishing EsGB coupling functions from scattering observables.

classification.title_zh: 爱因斯坦-标量-Gauss-Bonnet引力中标量化黑洞对标量波的散射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们系统研究了在具有四次耦合 f(φ)=α(φ^2+βφ^4) 和指数耦合 f(φ)=α(1−e^{−βφ^2}) 的爱因斯坦-标量-Gauss-Bonnet引力中，大质量标量场被标量化黑洞散射和吸收的问题。背景解通过切比雪夫赝谱法数值获得，使得可以在纯数值黑洞背景上进行分波分析。分波结果与测地线近似、glory近似以及史瓦西极限交叉验证，符合得很好。我们发现标量化相对于史瓦西情形抑制了总吸收截面，并在微分散射截面中产生独特特征。两种耦合模型之间存在定性差异：对于四次耦合模型，偏离史瓦西的结果集中在约(70°,140°)的中间角区域，前向角和glory峰附近变化相对较小；对于指数耦合模型，偏离出现在整个角范围，并显著修改glory峰，在某些参数区间甚至可超过史瓦西值。这种独特的角分布为从散射可观测量区分EsGB耦合函数提供了潜在诊断。
classification.one_liner: 数值分波分析显示EsGB标量化黑洞抑制标量波总吸收截面，且不同耦合函数在微分散射角分布上留下可区分的诊断特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究EsGB修正引力中标量化黑洞的经典标量波散射与吸收，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；未涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Probing parity-breaking black-hole geometry with extreme-mass-ratio inspirals
papers.abstract: We investigate the gravitational-wave signatures of equatorial reflection symmetry breaking in extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) around a parity-violating conformal Kerr black hole. For the circular-orbit branch connected to equatorial Kerr orbits, we derive the dynamics through second order in the dimensionless deformation parameter $\varepsilon$ and construct adiabatic inspirals and gravitational-wave signals using a mass-quadrupole prescription. Equatorial reflection maps $\varepsilon$ to $-\varepsilon$, making the polar displacement odd and the orbital frequency and energy even in the deformation. The induced first harmonic has a small direct contribution for the configurations studied, while second-order dynamical corrections accumulate over many cycles to produce appreciable dephasing. We find that rapid black-hole rotation enhances these phase effects and the associated noise-weighted waveform mismatch. For a one-year inspiral of a $10M_\odot$ object into a $10^6M_\odot$ black hole with $a/M=0.9$ and viewing inclination $\iota=2\pi/3$, the fixed-parameter mismatch reaches the comparison benchmark $\mathcal M=0.01$ at approximately $\varepsilon=10^{-3}$, without optimization over time, phase, or Kerr parameters. A single-parameter Fisher analysis also indicates improved local sensitivity to $\varepsilon$ at high spin. These results connect the reflection properties of the circular branch to accumulated source-phase effects and complement tests of propagation birefringence. The sensitivity estimates remain conditional on the adiabatic quadrupole model and the adopted comparison procedure; robust observational constraints require more accurate radiation modeling and a full parameter-estimation analysis.

classification.title_zh: 用极端质量比旋近探测宇称破坏黑洞几何
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究围绕宇称破坏共形 Kerr 黑洞的极端质量比旋近（EMRI）中，赤道反射对称性破缺的引力波信号。针对与赤道 Kerr 轨道相连的圆轨道分支，作者在无量纲形变参数 ε 的二阶展开下导出动力学，并用质量四极矩方案构造绝热旋近和引力波信号。赤道反射将 ε 映射为 -ε，使极向位移为奇、轨道频率和能量为偶。诱导的一阶谐波在所研究构型中直接贡献较小，而二阶动力学修正会在多周期累积后产生可观的退相位。研究发现黑洞快速旋转会增强这些相位效应及相应的噪声加权波形失配。对于 10 M⊙ 天体旋近至 10^6 M⊙、a/M=0.9、观测倾角 ι=2π/3 的一年旋近，固定参数失配在不优化时间、相位或 Kerr 参数时约在 ε=10^-3 达到比较基准 M=0.01；单参数 Fisher 分析也表明高自旋下对 ε 的局域灵敏度有所提高。结果将圆轨道分支的反射性质与累积源相位效应联系起来，并补充传播双折射检验。灵敏度估计仍依赖于绝热四极矩模型和所采用的比较流程；稳健的观测约束需要更精确的辐射建模和完整参数估计分析。
classification.one_liner: 在宇称破坏共形 Kerr 黑洞的 EMRI 中，二阶形变修正可累积成可观测的引力波退相位，高自旋增强灵敏度。

papers.title: Moving Beyond Quasinormal Modes and Reinterpreting Direct Waves in Binary Black Hole Merger-Ringdowns
papers.abstract: Based on black-hole perturbation-theory calculations and an effective-one-body picture of binary black hole mergers, it has been suggested that a direct wave may be present and measurable in the ringdown. Furthermore, it has been suggested that this signal might originate from substantially inside the light ring (or photon sphere) of the remnant black hole, perhaps even from close to the event horizon. In this paper, we present three independent strands of evidence against such claims. In the process, we show that there is indeed an early-time part of the ringdown signal that cannot be directly modeled by quasinormal modes. However, there is no evidence that this is a direct wave as it has previously been defined, and we show that the properties of this component are related to the remnant's light ring rather than its horizon.

classification.title_zh: 超越准正规模并重新解释双黑洞并合-铃宕中的直接波
classification.abstract_zh: 基于黑洞微扰论和双黑洞并合的有效单体图像，已有工作提出铃宕中可能存在可测量的直接波，并认为其可能来自残余黑洞光球层内部甚至视界附近。本文给出三条独立证据反对这些主张；同时表明铃宕早期确有一部分信号不能直接用准正规模建模，但没有证据表明这就是此前定义的直接波，且该成分的性质与残余黑洞的光球层而非视界相关。
classification.one_liner: 论文用黑洞微扰论证据反驳双黑洞铃宕中“直接波来自视界附近”的解释，并将早期铃宕成分关联到光球层。

papers.title: Optical constraints on rotating logarithmic- and exponential-entropy wormholes from strong-field lensing
papers.abstract: The longstanding issue of whether horizonless compact objects can mimic black holes at horizon scales is addressed, a problem that persists because the shadow diameter alone is degenerate across a wide class of geometries. For slowly rotating traversable wormholes, we precisely formulate the optical appearance as a set of observables derived from equatorial null geodesics, yielding necessary and sufficient conditions for a multi-parameter fingerprint. Using a new lapse function that interpolates between exponential and rational redshift profiles, we obtain the photon-sphere condition, the strong-deflection lensing coefficients, and the Lyapunov exponent in closed form. The equations yield two families of wormhole solutions dependent on logarithmic and exponential entropy parameters. We compare the resulting quantum-modified spacetimes with Kerr and four regular black holes. The shadow diameter is shown to be tunable to within $5\%$ to $11\%$ of Kerr for all models considered, so that $|R_{\rm sh}^{\rm WH}/R_{\rm sh}^{\rm Kerr}-1| \lesssim 0.11$ and the shadow alone cannot separate the models. The degeneracy is lifted when the rotational asymmetry, lensing coefficients, Lyapunov exponent, and orbital frequency are combined: for the $5$-component fingerprint $\mathbf{F}=(\Arot,\abar,\bbar, \Lya,\Oph)$, the fractional deviation $\Delta_i=(F_i^{\rm WH}-F_i^{\rm Kerr})/ F_i^{\rm Kerr}$ satisfies $|\Delta_i|\gtrsim 0.05$ for every component, with the largest departures in the second lensing coefficient and the Lyapunov exponent. The combined discrimination signal reaches a signal-to-noise ratio of about $3.8$ to $3.9$ against Kerr and about $3.7$ against the Kazakov--Solodukhin benchmark, which is sufficient to break the shadow-diameter degeneracy at the $10\%$ measurement level.

classification.title_zh: 强场透镜对旋转对数熵与指数熵虫洞的光学约束
classification.abstract_zh: 针对无地平线致密天体能否在视界尺度模仿黑洞的问题，本文把慢旋转可穿越虫洞的光学外观表述为赤道零测地线导出的可观测量，并给出多参数指纹的必要充分条件。采用在对数/指数红移 profile 间插值的 lapse function，得到光子球条件、强偏折透镜系数和 Lyapunov 指数的闭式表达式，得到依赖对数熵和指数熵参数的两族虫洞解，并与 Kerr 及四个正则黑洞比较。阴影直径可调到 Kerr 的 5%–11% 内，因此仅靠阴影无法区分；结合旋转不对称性、透镜系数、Lyapunov 指数和轨道频率的五分量指纹可打破退化，各分量相对 Kerr 偏差 |Δ_i| ≳ 0.05，最大偏差在第二透镜系数与 Lyapunov 指数，联合判别信噪比约 3.8–3.9 对 Kerr、约 3.7 对 Kazakov–Solodukhin 基准，足以在 10% 测量水平打破阴影直径退化。
classification.one_liner: 旋转对数/指数熵虫洞的强场透镜多参数指纹可打破其与 Kerr 黑洞的阴影直径退化。

papers.title: Destinies of Plasmoids Formed from the Magnetic Reconnection Occurring within the Ergo Region of a Rotating Black Hole
papers.abstract: It is widely accepted that magnetic reconnections occur successively in black hole accretion flows, especially on the equatorial plane, owing to the formation of the equatorial current sheet. When magnetic reconnection takes place within the ergosphere of a rotating black hole, one of the ejected plasmoids (denoted as $p_-$) may acquire negative energy-at-infinity density, while the companion plasmoid (denoted as $p_+$) correspondingly carries the energy extracted from the black hole. This mechanism, known as the Comisso-Asenjo process, provides a viable astrophysical pathway for extracting energy from a rotating black hole. Generally speaking, two conditions have to be satisfied for successful energy extraction. First, $p_-$ is generated via magnetic reconnection with negative energy-at-infinity density. Second, the associated $p_+$, which carries the extracted energy, must escape to infinity. Though a number of studies have promoted the theory of the Comisso-Asenjo process, the escape of $p_+$ lacks consideration. In this work, we adopt geodesic approach to systematically examine the destinies of $p_+$ after ejection, thereby establishing the complete conditions for energy extraction from a rotating black hole via magnetic reconnection. We redefine the covering factor, for which only escaping $p_+$ are counted. This quantity reflects how probable the successful energy extraction occurs in an accretion system. Through analysis of this revised covering factor, we identify a lower bound on the black hole spin, $a=0.8005$, below which energy extraction via magnetic reconnection can never succeed, no matter how high the magnetization of the bulk plasma is. This limit suggests that the spin-down of a black hole caused by successive magnetic reconnections would terminate once the spin decreases to approximately 0.8005.

classification.title_zh: 旋转黑洞能层内磁重联形成的等离子体团的命运
classification.abstract_zh: 广泛认为，黑洞吸积流中会连续发生磁重联，尤其是在赤道面上，这是由于赤道电流片的形成。当磁重联发生在旋转黑洞的能层内时，一个被抛射的等离子体团（记为 p_-）可能获得负的无穷远能量密度，而伴随的等离子体团（记为 p_+）相应地携带从黑洞提取的能量。该机制被称为 Comisso-Asenjo 过程，为从旋转黑洞提取能量提供了可行的天体物理途径。一般来说，成功提取能量需满足两个条件：第一，p_- 通过磁重联产生且具有负的无穷远能量密度；第二，携带被提取能量的 p_+ 必须逃逸到无穷远。尽管已有许多研究推进了 Comisso-Asenjo 过程理论，但对 p_+ 的逃逸缺乏考虑。在本工作中，我们采用测地线方法系统考察 p_+ 被抛射后的命运，从而建立通过磁重联从旋转黑洞提取能量的完整条件。我们重新定义覆盖因子，其中只计入逃逸的 p_+。该量反映吸积系统中成功能量提取发生的概率。通过分析这一修正覆盖因子，我们确定了黑洞自旋的下界 a=0.8005；低于该值时，无论体等离子体磁化程度多高，通过磁重联提取能量都永远无法成功。这一极限表明，由连续磁重联引起的黑洞自旋减慢将在自旋降至约 0.8005 时终止。
classification.one_liner: 用测地线追踪 p_+ 逃逸，完善 Comisso-Asenjo 能量提取条件并给出自旋下界 a=0.8005。

papers.title: Gravitational lensing effects on neutrino oscillations around a Schwarzschild black hole immersed in perfect fluid dark matter
papers.abstract: We investigate neutrino flavor oscillations in the weak gravitational-lensing regime of a static, spherically symmetric black hole surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter (PFDM). Within a covariant quantum-mechanical framework, we derive the oscillation phases for radial and non-radial propagation of ultrarelativistic neutrinos. While the leading radial phase is independent of the metric function, non-radial trajectories acquire impact-parameter-dependent corrections governed by the PFDM parameter $\lambda$. We construct the flavor-transition probability for two coherent lensed paths and analyze the resulting interference in two and three flavor scenarios. Varying $\lambda$ shifts the oscillation extrema and modifies their amplitudes and contrast, with a non-monotonic dependence on the neutrino mass scale, lens mass, flavor channel, and mass ordering. The $P_{\mu\tau}$ channel shows particularly strong sensitivity to the PFDM contribution for the considered configurations. Moreover, the path-interference terms retain information about the absolute neutrino mass scale. These results characterize PFDM-induced modifications of lensed neutrino oscillations and provide a basis for more realistic treatments including decoherence, averaging, detector resolution, and corrections to lens trajectories and magnifications.

classification.title_zh: 完美流体暗物质包围的史瓦西黑洞周围引力透镜效应对中微子振荡的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究静态球对称黑洞在完美流体暗物质（PFDM）包围下弱引力透镜区域的中微子味振荡。在协变量子力学框架内，推导超相对论中微子径向和非径向传播的振荡相位。径向领先相位与度规函数无关，而非径向轨迹获得由PFDM参数λ控制的依赖碰撞参数的修正。针对两条相干透镜路径构造味跃迁概率，并分析二味和三味情形下的干涉。改变λ会移动振荡极值并改变振幅和对比度，且对中微子质量标度、透镜质量、味通道和质量顺序呈非单调依赖。在所考虑构型中，P_{μτ}通道对PFDM贡献尤为敏感。此外，路径干涉项保留绝对中微子质量标度的信息。这些结果刻画了PFDM引起的透镜中微子振荡修正，并为更真实的处理（包括退相干、平均化、探测器分辨率以及透镜轨迹和放大率修正）提供基础。
classification.one_liner: 研究PFDM包围的史瓦西黑洞弱透镜区中微子味振荡，给出径向/非径向相位及双路径干涉对暗物质参数的依赖。

papers.title: Weak Cosmic Censorship in Einstein-Born-Infeld Black Hole: A Parameter-Space Analysis
papers.abstract: Einstein-Born-Infeld is a charged black hole solution of general relativity with Born-Infeld nonlinear electrodynamics, which has interesting physical features. It violates Bekenstein's entropy upper bound, and it can overcharge with respect to the Reissner-Nordstr\"om black hole. It presents an optimum situation to test the cosmic censorship conjecture, which is another important conjecture in black hole physics. In principle, this analysis requires the calculation of the self-energy of a test particle in the vicinity of the black hole, which, in general, is not feasible because of the electromagnetic nonlinearities. In this work, we propose an alternative approach that allows us to explore the whole parameter space of the Einstein-Born-Infeld black hole and test the validity of the cosmic censorship conjecture.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Born-Infeld 黑洞中的弱宇宙监督：参数空间分析
classification.abstract_zh: Einstein-Born-Infeld 是广义相对论中带 Born-Infeld 非线性电动力学的带电黑洞解，具有违反 Bekenstein 熵上界、相对 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞可过充电等特征，是检验宇宙监督猜想的理想对象。通常该分析需要计算黑洞附近检验粒子的自能，但由于电磁非线性一般不可行。本文提出一种替代方法，可探索 Einstein-Born-Infeld 黑洞的整个参数空间并检验宇宙监督猜想的有效性。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-Born-Infeld 黑洞全参数空间中检验弱宇宙监督猜想，并提出规避非线性电动力学自能计算困难的替代方法。

papers.title: Radius of the innermost stable circular orbit of black-holes with localized Astrophysical Dark Matter halo
papers.abstract: We investigate the geodesic structure of a static, spherically symmetric black-hole in the background of a localized Astrophysical Dark Matter (ADM)-halo. The halo is modeled by a core-radius ($r_0$), regularized density profile that vanishes at the event horizon and exponential factor ensures the finite total halo mass. We solved the Einstein field equations numerically with equation of state with $p=w\rho$ for stiff matter $w=1$ scenario. By analyzing the effective potential and its first and second derivatives, we evaluated the characteristic radius of the time-like innermost stable circular orbit ($r_{\text{ISCO}}$) of massive particle in the vicinity of hairy black-hole. Our numerical analysis is consistent with the recently proposed theoretical upper bound $r_{\text{ISCO}} \le 6$ normalized to unit mass black-hole. We showed that the ADM-halo shifts $r_{\text{ISCO}}$ inward with respect to the Schwarzschild (bald) scenario and the shifts are larger for larger halo core-radius. In particular our numerical finding enumerate $r_{\text{ISCO}}$ are approximately $5.97$, $5.61$, $5.53$ for $r_0=2.0,10.0,20.0$ respectively. We believe that our analysis with ADM-halo model shed light on probing black-hole hair through high-energy astrophysical observables.

classification.title_zh: 带有局域天体物理暗物质晕的黑洞最内稳定圆轨道半径
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究静态球对称黑洞在局域天体物理暗物质晕背景下的测地线结构。暗物质晕采用含核心半径 r0 的正则化密度剖面，在视界处为零，指数因子保证总晕质量有限；作者在刚性物质 w=1 状态方程下数值求解 Einstein 场方程，并通过有效势及其一、二阶导数计算有毛发黑洞附近大质量粒子的类时 ISCO 半径。数值结果与近期提出的归一化上界 r_ISCO≤6 一致，并表明暗物质晕使 ISCO 相对 Schwarzschild 情形内移，且核心半径越大移动越明显；对 r0=2.0、10.0、20.0 分别得到约 5.97、5.61、5.53。
classification.one_liner: 该文用数值方法研究暗物质晕背景下黑洞的类时测地线与 ISCO，发现暗物质晕使 ISCO 相对 Schwarzschild 黑洞内移。

papers.title: How accurate is Spectral Einstein Code (SpEC)? And what limits its accuracy?
papers.abstract: The improved sensitivity of upcoming gravitational-wave detectors will require correspondingly more accurate binary black hole (BBH) simulations. Given the high cost of such simulations, it is essential to understand their sources of error and use computational resources efficiently. We study sources of error in BBH simulations performed with the Spectral Einstein Code (SpEC) and seek to understand what limits their accuracy. In particular, we focus on the inspiral phase because it is the longest-running part of the simulation and accounts for the majority of the waveform error. We find that targeted changes to simulation parameters and resolution in different parts of the computational domain reduce constraint violations and gravitational waveform differences. We also discuss more fundamental limitations on our accuracy that become important at higher resolutions: floating-point errors and large differences in the scales of the fundamental variables. Addressing these limitations will require substantial changes to both the SpEC code and the formulation it uses to evolve Einstein's equations. Many of the improvements and changes discussed in this paper are likely to be relevant to other numerical relativity codes.

classification.title_zh: 谱爱因斯坦代码（SpEC）有多准确？是什么限制了其准确性？
classification.abstract_zh: 即将升级的引力波探测器灵敏度将要求相应更准确的双黑洞（BBH）模拟。鉴于此类模拟成本很高，理解其误差来源并高效利用计算资源至关重要。我们研究使用谱爱因斯坦代码（SpEC）进行的BBH模拟中的误差来源，并试图理解是什么限制了其准确性。特别地，我们关注旋近阶段，因为它是模拟中运行时间最长的部分，并占波形误差的大部分。我们发现，对计算域不同部分的模拟参数和分辨率进行有针对性的调整，可以减少约束违反和引力波形差异。我们还讨论了在更高分辨率下变得重要的更根本的准确性限制：浮点误差以及基本变量尺度上的巨大差异。解决这些限制将需要对SpEC代码及其用于演化爱因斯坦方程的表述进行重大修改。本文讨论的许多改进和修改很可能与其他数值相对论代码相关。
classification.one_liner: 该文分析SpEC双黑洞数值相对论模拟的误差来源与精度极限，指出旋近阶段主导波形误差，并讨论浮点误差和变量尺度差异等根本限制。

papers.title: Dressing a naked singularity with zero-point length
papers.abstract: We regularize the central density cusp of the Joshi--Malafarina--Narayan spacetime using a normalized kernel motivated by a zero-point length. For an unbounded cusp, the convolution and enclosed mass are obtained analytically; truncating this density gives a regular, horizonless tangential-pressure interior matched to Schwarzschild. Convolving the finite cloud instead preserves its total mass and yields a smooth matter tail. A compactness bound establishes horizon avoidance for this second prescription. We determine the central lapse, establish causal geodesic completeness despite extreme optical delays, derive a uniform optical-delay formula across the critical compactness, and identify the stable interior light ring of ultracompact configurations. The massless scalar probe operator is nonnegative, while semiclassical trapped modes exhibit strongly suppressed leakage. An explicit pressure-closure comparison separates robust geometric properties from closure-dependent delay exponents. Planck-scale examples illustrate extreme redshifts and delays, but their photon interpretation requires physics beyond classical propagation in the core. The construction specifies an effective static source, rather than a microscopic matter theory or a dynamical resolution of collapse.

classification.title_zh: 用零点长度修饰裸奇点
classification.abstract_zh: 我们用受零点长度启发的归一化核正则化 Joshi–Malafarina–Narayan 时空的中心密度尖峰。对无界尖峰，卷积与包围质量可解析得到；截断该密度得到正则、无视界、切向压强的内部，并与 Schwarzschild 匹配。对有限云做卷积则保持总质量并给出光滑物质尾。紧致度上界证明第二种方案避免视界。我们确定中心 lapse，证明尽管存在极端光学延迟仍测地完备，导出跨临界紧致度的统一光学延迟公式，并识别超紧致位形的稳定内部光环。无质量标量探针算符非负，半经典束缚模泄漏被强烈抑制。显式压力闭合比较将稳健几何性质与依赖闭合的延迟指数分开。普朗克尺度例子展示极端红移和延迟，但其光子解释需要核心中超出经典传播的物理。该构造给出有效静态源，而非微观物质理论或坍缩的动力学解决。
classification.one_liner: 用零点长度核正则化 JMS 裸奇点，构造无视界致密内部并分析测地完备性、光延迟与光环。

papers.title: Onset of Chaos and Orbital Instabilities around Rotating Weyl Black Holes
papers.abstract: We investigate nonlinear photon motion in the vicinity of a rotating black hole (BH) within Weyl conformal gravity (WCG) by employing Poincare sections, Lyapunov exponents, Fast Lyapunov Indicators (FLI), Kolmogorov-Sinai (KS) entropy, and Discrete Indicator of Chaos (DIG) maps. The joint influence of BH spin and higher order curvature corrections, governed by the parameters $\xi$ and $\gamma$, induces a transition from nearly integrable trajectories to markedly chaotic dynamics in the strong field domain. As $\xi$ and $\gamma$ increase, the invariant tori are increasingly deformed and eventually break up. Resonance islands and stochastic layers then form, producing large chaotic regions in phase space, especially near the extremal spin regime. Increasing Lyapunov exponents, faster FLI growth, and higher KS entropy provide quantitative measures of the enhanced dynamical instability, the increased sensitivity to initial conditions, and the corresponding rate of information production. DIG maps show shrinking regular regions and expanding chaotic domains around the photon sphere, indicating that conformal gravity corrections destabilize null circular orbits. Taken together, these findings clarify how relativistic frame dragging and higher order curvature terms jointly control photon chaos and point to nonlinear photon dynamics as a potential probe of departures from General Relativity in the strong-gravity regime.

classification.title_zh: 旋转 Weyl 黑洞周围的混沌起始与轨道不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用 Poincare 截面、Lyapunov 指数、快速 Lyapunov 指标（FLI）、Kolmogorov-Sinai（KS）熵和离散混沌指标（DIG）图，研究 Weyl 共形引力（WCG）中旋转黑洞附近的非线性光子运动。黑洞自旋与由参数 ξ 和 γ 控制的高阶曲率修正的联合影响，导致强场区域从近可积轨迹向明显混沌动力学转变。随着 ξ 和 γ 增大，不变环面越来越变形并最终破裂。随后形成共振岛和随机层，在相空间中产生大范围混沌区域，尤其在接近极端自旋的区域。增大的 Lyapunov 指数、更快的 FLI 增长和更高的 KS 熵，为增强的动力学不稳定性、对初始条件敏感性的增加以及相应的信息产生率提供了定量度量。DIG 图显示光子球周围的规则区域缩小、混沌区域扩大，表明共形引力修正使零测地圆轨道失稳。总体而言，这些发现阐明了相对论参考系拖曳和高阶曲率项如何共同控制光子混沌，并指出非线性光子动力学可作为强引力区偏离广义相对论的潜在探针。
classification.one_liner: 在旋转 Weyl 共形引力黑洞中，自旋与高阶曲率修正共同驱动光子轨道从近可积走向混沌。

papers.title: Semiclassical Cosmological Constant in Anti-de Sitter and de Sitter Spacetimes
papers.abstract: We investigate the semiclassical Einstein equation for a quantized scalar field in four-dimensional anti-de Sitter (AdS) and de Sitter (dS) spacetimes. We first determine self-consistent configurations by fixing the bare cosmological constant to its geometric value, requiring the renormalized vacuum stress-energy tensor to vanish. In AdS, the resulting mass-curvature relations depend on the curvature coupling and boundary conditions; one formal Neumann root for minimal coupling is excluded by the admissible parameter range, whereas both Dirichlet and Neumann solutions are allowed for conformal coupling. In dS, we recover the known self-consistent solution for a minimally coupled massive field. We then evaluate the effective cosmological constant on prescribed backgrounds in four massless configurations. In each case, it takes the form \(\Lambda_{\mathrm{eff}}=A/\ell^2+B/\ell^4\). The competition between classical curvature and vacuum polarization produces a minimum and a zero in the minimally coupled AdS case, while the other configurations are monotonic. Finally, the formal continuation \(\ell\rightarrow i\ell\) fails to reproduce the directly calculated quantum coefficients: their AdS-to-dS ratios are \(29/61\) for minimal coupling and \(-1\) for conformal coupling. These results show that continuation of the curvature scale alone does not establish equivalence between the semiclassical vacuum contributions in AdS and dS.

classification.title_zh: 反德西特与德西特时空中的半经典宇宙学常数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究四维反德西特（AdS）和德西特（dS）时空中量子化标量场的半经典爱因斯坦方程。首先，将裸宇宙学常数固定为其几何值，并要求重整化真空应力-能量张量为零，以确定自洽位形。在AdS中，所得质量-曲率关系依赖于曲率耦合和边界条件；最小耦合下的一个形式Neumann根因可允许参数范围而被排除，而共形耦合下Dirichlet和Neumann解均被允许。在dS中，我们重现了已知的最小耦合大质量场自洽解。随后，我们在四个无质量位形中计算给定背景上的有效宇宙学常数，每种情形均呈 Λ_eff=A/ℓ^2+B/ℓ^4 形式。经典曲率与真空极化之间的竞争在最小耦合AdS情形产生一个极小值和一个零点，而其他位形是单调的。最后，形式延拓 ℓ→iℓ 无法重现直接计算的量子系数：其AdS到dS的比值在最小耦合下为29/61，在共形耦合下为-1。这些结果表明，仅对曲率尺度作延拓并不能建立AdS与dS半经典真空贡献之间的等价性。
classification.one_liner: 研究AdS/dS时空中量子标量场对半经典爱因斯坦方程的自洽解与有效宇宙学常数，并指出ℓ→iℓ延拓不能联系两种时空的量子真空贡献。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于半经典爱因斯坦方程和弯曲时空量子场论，匹配经典引力/广义相对论支线，但不涉及AdS/CFT全息字典或量子引力，与用户主要全息研究线关联有限。

papers.title: A computer assisted existence proof for a non-Schwarzschild black hole in Einstein--Weyl gravity
papers.abstract: Static, asymptotically flat, non-Schwarzschild black holes in four-dimensional Einstein--Weyl gravity have previously been constructed by numerical shooting, while the local field equations admit horizon and asymptotic expansions to all orders. We give a computer assisted existence proof for a non-Schwarzschild solution whose dimensionless horizon radius is one in units of the massive spin-two scale, with parameters close to the previously reported numerical branch. The exterior is divided into a convergent horizon series domain, a compact core enclosed by a parameter dependent Taylor model with directed rounding, and an infinite asymptotic domain treated as a centered stable manifold fixed point problem. The resulting five-dimensional matching map between the core and tail is continuous on a rigorously specified box. After exact rational preconditioning, the signs on opposite faces satisfy the hypotheses of the Poincar\'e--Miranda theorem and therefore certify a matching zero. The solution has a regular nondegenerate horizon, no additional exterior horizon, vanishing Ricci scalar, and nonvanishing Ricci tensor. The strict bounds also imply existence at every sufficiently nearby horizon radius and a local continuous family at fixed coupling. The proof establishes existence, but not uniqueness of the matching zero.

classification.title_zh: Einstein–Weyl 引力中非 Schwarzschild 黑洞的计算机辅助存在性证明
classification.abstract_zh: 四维 Einstein–Weyl 引力中静态、渐近平坦的非 Schwarzschild 黑洞此前已通过数值打靶构造，而局部场方程在视界和渐近区域具有全阶展开。本文给出一个计算机辅助存在性证明：证明一个无量纲视界半径（以有质量自旋二标度为单位）为 1、参数接近既有数值分支的非 Schwarzschild 解存在。外部区域被分为收敛的视界级数域、由带定向舍入的参数依赖 Taylor 模型包围的紧致核心，以及作为中心稳定流形不动点问题处理的无穷渐近域。核心与尾部之间的五维匹配映射在严格给定的盒子上连续；经精确有理预条件后，相对面上的符号满足 Poincaré–Miranda 定理假设，从而证明匹配零点存在。该解具有正则非退化视界、无额外外部视界、Ricci 标量为零且 Ricci 张量非零。严格界还蕴涵在充分接近的每个视界半径处解存在，并在固定耦合下存在局部连续族。该证明确立存在性，但不证明匹配零点的唯一性。
classification.one_liner: 用计算机辅助 Poincaré–Miranda 论证证明 Einstein–Weyl 引力中存在非 Schwarzschild 黑洞解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典/修改引力中的黑洞解存在性证明，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息。

papers.title: Spin-mediated modulation of chaos bound violation in Lorentz-violating black hole spacetimes
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate how the particle spin modulates chaos bound violations in Lorentz-violating black hole spacetimes within the framework of Bumblebee gravity. Using the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon formalism, we analyze the effects of spin-curvature coupling, Lorentz symmetry breaking, and the cosmological constant on the orbital instability in static spherically symmetric (A)dS black holes. We find that the particle spin provides an additional mechanism for modulating the critical angular momentum associated with the onset of violation. The Lorentz-violating parameter suppresses the violations by reducing the accessible parameter space and the critical charge. Meanwhile, a negative cosmological constant decreases the violation region but enhances the violation magnitude for allowed configurations. Our results demonstrate that the spin and Lorentz symmetry breaking jointly regulate the interplay between orbital instability and black hole horizon properties.

classification.title_zh: 洛伦兹破缺黑洞时空中自旋对混沌界限破坏的调制
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在Bumblebee引力框架下研究粒子自旋如何调制洛伦兹破缺黑洞时空中的混沌界限破坏。利用Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon形式，分析自旋-曲率耦合、洛伦兹对称性破缺和宇宙学常数对静态球对称(A)dS黑洞轨道不稳定性的影响。发现粒子自旋提供了调制与破坏起始相关的临界角动量的额外机制；洛伦兹破缺参数通过减少可及参数空间和临界电荷来抑制破坏；负宇宙学常数减小破坏区域，但对允许位形增强破坏幅度。结果表明自旋与洛伦兹对称性破缺共同调控轨道不稳定性与黑洞视界性质之间的相互作用。
classification.one_liner: 在Bumblebee引力下，自旋-曲率耦合与洛伦兹破缺共同调制(A)dS黑洞轨道不稳定性及混沌界限破坏。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论与黑洞轨道动力学，涉及混沌界限破坏，但与用户重点的全息超流、multi-trace、探针膜等方向无直接关联；仅经典引力支线相关。

papers.title: Regular Black Holes from Anisotropic Source with Hydrodynamic Equation of State
papers.abstract: We study regular black hole solutions sourced by an anisotropic energy momentum tensor. It is well known that the geometry of the interior of a spherically symmetric regular black hole approaches the dS metric. Having decomposed the energy momentum tensor into its isotropic and anisotropic components, we assume a hydrodynamic equation of state, $P= P(\rho)$, for the pressure, and look for spherically symmetric, regular black hole solutions. We consider different forms of $ P(\rho)$ which yield the previously known regular black hole solutions, as well as various new metrics. We show that the profile of $ P(\rho)$ has a root and a maximum as it approaches $0^+$ at large distances. Consequently, the square of the sound speed of perturbations, $c_s^2$, changes sign at the point where $P$ reaches its maximum, indicating a potential hydrodynamic instability. In addition, imposing the subluminal bound on $c_s$ puts strong constraints on the model parameters, excluding models in which the energy density has an exponential fall off. We establish a universal hierarchy among the relative positions at which the strong energy condition is violated, at which $P$ has its root, and at which $P$ attains its maximum.

classification.title_zh: 由各向异性源与流体动力学状态方程得到的正则黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究由各向异性能量动量张量作为源的正则黑洞解。球对称正则黑洞内部几何通常趋近 de Sitter 度规；作者将能量动量张量分解为各向同性和各向异性部分，并对压强采用流体动力学状态方程 P=P(ρ)，寻找球对称正则黑洞解。文中考虑多种 P(ρ) 形式，既能重现已知正则黑洞解，也给出新度规。结果表明 P(ρ) 在远距离趋于 0^+ 时具有一个根和一个极大值，因此微扰声速平方 c_s^2 在 P 达到极大值处变号，暗示可能存在流体动力学不稳定性。此外，对 c_s 施加速度上限会强烈限制模型参数，并排除能量密度指数衰减的模型。作者还建立了强能量条件被破坏的位置、P 的根以及 P 取极大值位置之间的相对位置等级关系。
classification.one_liner: 用各向异性源和流体动力学状态方程构造正则黑洞解，并分析声速、能量条件与参数约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力与黑洞解研究，契合“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但未涉及全息、AdS/CFT 或所列全息凝聚态/超流超导等支线。

papers.title: Demagnetizing KBR and New Ricci-flat Rotating Metric
papers.abstract: We construct a new Ricci-flat metric by demagnetizing the recently reported Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (KBR) solution. The metric is a deformation of the Kerr metric characterized by a parameter $B$, so that the asymptotic Kerr becomes a regular dome of spindle shape with north and south poles. Despite lacking an asymptotically-flat region, we find that the first law of black hole thermodynamics can be established. Some thermodynamic relations are identical to those of the Kerr black hole, as if the constant $B$ is absent. Our Ricci-flat rotating metric serves a neutral seed for a variety of inequivalent schemes of magnetizing the Schwarzschild and Kerr black holes.

classification.title_zh: 去磁化 KBR 与新的 Ricci 平坦旋转度规
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过对近期报道的 Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson（KBR）解进行去磁化，构造了一个新的 Ricci 平坦度规。该度规是以参数 B 标记的 Kerr 度规的变形，使渐近 Kerr 区域变为具有南北极的规则纺锤形穹顶。尽管不存在渐近平坦区域，作者仍建立了黑洞热力学第一定律，并发现部分热力学关系与 Kerr 黑洞相同，仿佛常数 B 不存在。该 Ricci 平坦旋转度规可作为多种对 Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 黑洞磁化方案的中性种子。
classification.one_liner: 通过去磁化 KBR 构造了一个无渐近平坦区但满足黑洞热力学第一定律的新 Ricci 平坦旋转度规。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论中的精确解与黑洞热力学研究，并可作为磁化 Schwarzschild/Kerr 的中性种子；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Gravitational waves from cosmic superstrings and gauge strings
papers.abstract: We perform a phenomenological comparison of the gravitational wave (GW) spectrum expected from cosmic gauge string networks and superstring networks comprised of multiple string types. We show how violations of scaling behavior and the evolution of the number of relativistic degrees of freedom in the early Universe affect the GW spectrum. We derive simple analytical expressions for the GW spectrum from superstrings and gauge strings that are valid for all frequencies relevant to pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and laser interferometers. We analyze the latest data from PTAs and show that superstring networks are consistent with 32 nHz data from NANOGrav, but are excluded by 3.2 nHz data at $3\sigma$ unless the string coupling $g_s<0.2$ or the strings evolve in only about 10% of the volume of the higher-dimensional space. We also point out that while gauge string networks are excluded by NANOGrav-15 data at $3\sigma$, they are completely compatible with EPTA and PPTA data. Finally, we study correlations between GW signals at PTAs and laser interferometers.

classification.title_zh: 宇宙超弦与规范弦产生的引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们对宇宙规范弦网络与由多种弦类型组成的超弦网络所预期的引力波谱进行唯象比较。我们展示标度行为的破坏以及早期宇宙相对论自由度数目的演化如何影响引力波谱。我们给出适用于脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）和激光干涉仪所有相关频率的简析表达式。我们分析PTA最新数据并表明：超弦网络与NANOGrav的32 nHz数据一致，但除非弦耦合 g_s<0.2 或弦仅在高维空间约10%的体积中演化，否则在3σ水平上被3.2 nHz数据排除。我们还指出，规范弦网络虽被NANOGrav-15数据在3σ水平排除，却与EPTA和PPTA数据完全兼容。最后，我们研究PTA与激光干涉仪引力波信号之间的关联。
classification.one_liner: 比较宇宙规范弦与多类型超弦网络的引力波谱，并用脉冲星计时阵列数据约束弦耦合与高维空间演化体积。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦宇宙弦/超弦网络的随机引力波背景与PTA数据约束，不属于AdS/CFT全息或用户列出的全息凝聚态、纠缠、QNM等支线；仅与经典引力/引力波标签有边缘关联。

papers.title: Probability measures for de Sitter JT gravity
papers.abstract: Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity with positive cosmological constant is a toy model to study the emergence of expanding de Sitter universes from a quantum state. Its density matrix is a superposition of double-trumpet amplitudes which are solutions of a Wheeler-DeWitt equation. We compare predictions of such mixed states for classical expanding universes with the corresponding predictions of no-boundary wavefunctions. Double-trumpet amplitudes consistent with holography, whose semiclassical limit matches the result from Schwarzian boundary fluctuations, lead to a flat probability distribution for the size of the universe, consistent with models of inflation. This is in contrast to the suppression of large universes predicted by no-boundary wave functions.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter JT 引力的概率测度
classification.abstract_zh: 正宇宙学常数的 Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力是研究膨胀 de Sitter 宇宙如何从量子态涌现的玩具模型。其密度矩阵是满足 Wheeler-DeWitt 方程的双喇叭振幅的叠加。我们比较此类混合态对经典膨胀宇宙的预言与无边界波函数的相应预言。与全息一致、且半经典极限匹配 Schwarzian 边界涨落的双喇叭振幅，给出宇宙大小的平坦概率分布，与暴胀模型一致；这与无边界波函数预言的大宇宙被压低形成对比。
classification.one_liner: 比较 de Sitter JT 引力中双喇叭混合态与无边界波函数给出的宇宙大小概率分布，发现全息一致的双喇叭振幅导致平坦分布。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及 de Sitter JT 引力、双喇叭振幅、全息一致性与无边界波函数，属于量子引力/全息宇宙学；但不对应用户列出的全息超流、探针膜、QNM 等具体研究支线。

papers.title: Multipartite Entanglement Geometry in AdS/BCFT
papers.abstract: Multipartite entanglement measures probe how quantum correlations are organized beyond what can be inferred from pairwise entropies. We study how this structure is reshaped by a physical boundary in a holographic BCFT. The end-of-the-world brane opens new relative-homology channels for multipartite entanglement, allowing connected bulk webs to reorganize and factorize at scales that need not coincide with any ordinary Ryu--Takayanagi transition. In static AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$, this produces a characteristic hierarchy of multipartite phases and a nontrivial dependence of genuine multi-entropy on the boundary. In the thermofield-double state, genuinely connected webs can instead be supported through the Einstein--Rosen bridge, leading to growth, reconnection and saturation scales distinct from the usual Hartman--Maldacena transitions. These results show that multipartite entanglement is sensitive not only to extremal-surface areas but also to how bulk entanglement structures are allowed to join, split and terminate in the presence of a boundary.

classification.title_zh: AdS/BCFT 中的多分纠缠几何
classification.abstract_zh: 多分纠缠度量探测的是无法仅由成对熵推断出的量子关联组织方式。我们研究在全息 BCFT 中物理边界如何重塑这种结构。世界尽头膜为多分纠缠打开新的相对同调通道，使连通的体纠缠网络可在不一定与普通 Ryu--Takayanagi 转变重合的尺度上重组和因子化。在静态 AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$ 中，这产生特征性的多分相层级，以及真正多熵对边界的非平凡依赖。在热场双态中，真正连通的网络反而可通过 Einstein--Rosen 桥支撑，导致不同于通常 Hartman--Maldacena 转变的增长、重连和饱和尺度。这些结果表明，多分纠缠不仅敏感于极值面面积，也敏感于有边界时体纠缠结构被允许如何连接、分裂和终止。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS/BCFT 中，世界尽头膜与 ER 桥改变多分纠缠连通网的连接、分裂与终止，产生新的多分相和标度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于全息纠缠与 AdS/BCFT 理论，涉及多分纠缠和 TFD/ER 桥；但与用户列出的全息超流、p波、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7 探针膜或经典引力等具体重点支线没有直接重合。

papers.title: Surface defects in $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills: exact results and holographic bootstrap
papers.abstract: We study two-point functions of chiral primary operators in $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills in the presence of a half-BPS surface defect. Such a defect preserves only the diagonal combination of transverse rotations and of a global U(1) R-symmetry, so that the correlator depends on one additional cross-ratio and splits into sectors of definite angular charge. We solve the superconformal Ward identities and construct the bulk and defect superconformal blocks in all sectors, including the charged ones, which have no analogue for defects preserving transverse rotations. The solution contains a holomorphic sector, which we fix non-perturbatively by mapping it to a chiral algebra correlator. We extend this map to defects breaking transverse rotations, where it requires a redefinition of the modes of the two-dimensional current algebra, and use it to fix the charged sectors as well. We then use the defect dispersion relation to reconstruct the full correlator of the dimension-two chiral primary at leading order at large N and strong coupling. In the charged sectors long multiplets are absent and the answer is conjecturally exact in both N and the coupling; expanding it at weak coupling, we find perfect agreement with known results. From these correlators we extract infinitely many new pieces of defect CFT data. Finally, we reproduce the strong-coupling answer by an independent Witten diagram bootstrap on the rotation-invariant locus.

classification.title_zh: N=4 超对称杨-米尔斯中的表面缺陷：精确结果与全息 bootstrap
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在存在半BPS表面缺陷时，N=4 超对称杨-米尔斯理论中手征主算符的两点函数。该缺陷仅保持横向旋转与整体 U(1) R-对称性的对角组合，因此关联函数多依赖一个交比，并分解为具有确定角电荷的扇区。我们求解超共形 Ward 恒等式，并在所有扇区（包括对保持横向旋转的缺陷没有对应的带电扇区）构造体与缺陷超共形块。该解包含一个全纯扇区，我们通过将其映射到手征代数关联函数来非微扰地固定它。我们将此映射推广到破坏横向旋转的缺陷，其中需要对二维流代数的模式重新定义，并用它来固定带电扇区。随后我们利用缺陷色散关系，在大 N 强耦合领头阶重构维度二手征主算符的完整关联函数。在带电扇区中长多重态不存在，答案在 N 和耦合常数上被猜想为精确；将其在弱耦合展开，我们发现与已知结果完全一致。从这些关联函数中我们提取了无穷多新的缺陷 CFT 数据。最后，我们通过在旋转不变轨迹上的独立 Witten 图 bootstrap 复现了强耦合答案。
classification.one_liner: 利用超共形 Ward 恒等式、手征代数与缺陷色散关系，研究 N=4 SYM 半BPS表面缺陷中手征主算符两点函数的精确与全息 bootstrap 结果。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 N=4 SYM 表面缺陷 CFT 与 AdS/CFT 基础/字典方向，研究超共形块、手征代数和 Witten 图 bootstrap；未直接涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜、冷原子或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: DSSYK, open ASEP/TASEP and 2d dilaton gravity at strong coupling
papers.abstract: We discuss the triality between stochastic growth models in the KPZ universality class, the DSSYK model, and low dimensional dilaton gravity. The TASEP model, which will be our primary focus, is identified with the strong-coupling limit of two-dimensional quantum gravity. The Hamiltonian of DSSYK and the transfer matrix of ASEP coincide up to an additive constant, and we derive the exact expression for the resolvent of the corresponding transfer matrix in ASEP on a finite interval. We also mention the relation of cumulants with the Tutte polynomial $T(1,q)$ of the crossing graph dual to the chord diagram, which implies the relationship of the models considered with the $Q=0$ Potts model coupled with gravity. We further exploit the realization of all these models in terms of different versions of discrete and continuous random walks on two-dimensional manifolds, which parameterize the Hilbert spaces of the respective theories. The representation of TASEP as the growth model of heaps provides new insight into strong-coupling gravity, suggesting its interpretation as an emerging phenomenon. The new dualities between ASEP and q-TASEP models and heap models providing a useful growth interpretation have been developed.

classification.title_zh: 强耦合下的DSSYK、开放ASEP/TASEP与二维膨胀引力
classification.abstract_zh: 我们讨论KPZ普适类中的随机生长模型、DSSYK模型与低维膨胀引力之间的三重对偶。以TASEP为主要对象，将其识别为二维量子引力的强耦合极限。DSSYK哈密顿量与ASEP转移矩阵在相差一个加性常数下相同，并给出有限区间ASEP对应转移矩阵预解式的精确表达式。我们还提到累积量与交叉图（弦图对偶）的Tutte多项式T(1,q)的关系，从而表明所考虑模型与耦合引力的Q=0 Potts模型相关。进一步利用二维流形上离散和连续随机行走的不同版本来实现这些模型，这些随机行走参数化各理论的希尔伯特空间。将TASEP表示为堆的生长模型为强耦合引力提供新见解，暗示其可解释为涌现现象。发展了ASEP与q-TASEP模型及提供有用生长解释的堆模型之间的新对偶。
classification.one_liner: 揭示DSSYK、开放ASEP/TASEP与强耦合二维膨胀引力之间的精确对偶与可解结构。

papers.title: 3d Lovelock gravity and the holographic c-theorem: Proof at all orders and resummation
papers.abstract: We prove that 3d Lovelock gravity, the Horndeski theory obtained from the regularized Lovelock invariants in three dimensions, admits a holographic c-theorem at all orders and for arbitrary values of the couplings. In the minisuperspace of domain wall solutions, the equation of the Horndeski scalar is a total derivative at every order, which locks the derivative of the scalar to that of the warp factor along the flows we consider and allows the null energy condition to be integrated into a monotonic c-function. The linear scalar profile of the resulting vacuum breaks the special conformal transformations, so the dual theory is scale-invariant but not conformal, and the central charge is defined as the coefficient of the logarithmic divergence of the on-shell action on the sphere. We compute it exactly for the Gauss-Bonnet case and asymptotically for the full tower, and find that it is linear in the couplings and matches the UV value of the c-function. Since all results depend on the couplings only through two generating functions, we give the resummed Lagrangians, c-functions and central charges in closed form for the choices of couplings that lead to regular black holes, and classify the resummed theories by the positivity of the effective Newton constant on the vacuum and the uniqueness of the vacuum with a non-trivial scalar.

classification.title_zh: 三维Lovelock引力与全息c定理：全阶证明与重求和
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，三维Lovelock引力——由三维正则化Lovelock不变量得到的Horndeski理论——在任意耦合取值下、在所有阶数上都满足全息c定理。在畴壁解的minisuperspace中，Horndeski标量方程在每一阶都是全导数，这使我们考虑的流中标量导数被锁定为warp因子的导数，并允许将零能条件积分成单调c函数。所得真空的线性标量剖面破坏特殊共形变换，因此对偶理论是尺度不变但非共形的，中心荷定义为球面上在壳作用量对数发散项的系数。我们对Gauss-Bonnet情形精确计算，对完整塔渐近计算，发现它线性依赖于耦合，并与c函数的UV值匹配。由于所有结果仅通过两个生成函数依赖耦合，我们针对导致正则黑洞的耦合选择，以闭式形式给出重求和后的Lagrangian、c函数和中心荷，并根据真空上有效Newton常数的正性以及具有非平凡标量真空的唯一性对重求和理论分类。
classification.one_liner: 证明三维Lovelock/Horndeski引力在任意耦合与全阶下存在全息c定理，并给出c函数、中心荷及重求和形式的闭式结果。

papers.title: Cohomological Aspects of Entanglement Entropy: From Information Theory to Noncommutative Geometry
papers.abstract: We develop a cohomological framework for entanglement entropy that unifies information theory, operator algebras, and noncommutative geometry. Entropy is a 1-cocycle in information cohomology; we generalize this to the quantum setting via Hochschild and cyclic cohomology. For an inclusion of von Neumann algebras N contained in M with a faithful normal state w admitting a cyclic and separating vector, and a conditional expectation E: M -> N (whose existence is equivalent to modular invariance of N by Takesaki's theorem), we construct the entanglement complex as the image of the transgression map tau_w on the relative cyclic complex, where A is a dense *-subalgebra of M and B = A intersect N. Our main result identifies entanglement cohomology with the kernel of the restriction map HC*(A) -> HC*(B), up to the connecting homomorphism d of the long exact sequence of the pair (A,B); when d = 0, the identification is exact. The relative modular cocycle u_t = (Dw : D(w|_N) o E)_t generates explicit entanglement classes when E is not w-invariant, with the Araki relative entropy as its infinitesimal generator. The framework accommodates Type III von Neumann algebras, where no local density matrix exists, and leads to a holographic proposal: a subspace of H^1_ent is conjecturally dual to linearized modular Hamiltonian perturbations of the bulk entanglement wedge. We verify the construction in finite-dimensional, type II_1, and type III_1 examples.

classification.title_zh: 纠缠熵的上同调方面：从信息论到非交换几何
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了一个纠缠熵的上同调框架，统一信息论、算子代数和非交换几何。熵是信息上同调中的1-余循环；我们通过Hochschild和循环上同调将其推广到量子情形。对于von Neumann代数包含 N⊂M，具有忠实正规态w，允许循环分离向量，以及条件期望 E:M→N（其存在性由Takesaki定理等价于N的模不变性），我们在相对循环复形上构造纠缠复形作为transgression映射τ_w的像，其中A是M的稠密*-子代数，B=A∩N。主要结果将纠缠上同调识别为限制映射HC*(A)→HC*(B)的核，模去配对(A,B)长正合序列的连接同态d；当d=0时，识别是精确的。相对模余循环 u_t=(Dw:D(w|_N)∘E)_t 在E非w不变时生成显式纠缠类，Araki相对熵作为其无穷小生成元。该框架适用于不存在局域密度矩阵的III型von Neumann代数，并导出一个全息提议：H^1_ent的一个子空间猜想对偶于体纠缠楔的线性化模Hamiltonian扰动。我们在有限维、II_1型和III_1型例子中验证了构造。
classification.one_liner: 用Hochschild/循环上同调刻画von Neumann代数包含的纠缠熵，并提出其与体纠缠楔模哈密顿量扰动的全息对应猜想。

papers.title: MacDowell-Mansouri $\sigma$-model
papers.abstract: Standard pre-geometric mechanisms reproduce the $\Lambda$CDM model but lack a natural source for inflation. We propose a mechanism for the emergence of scalar-coupled topological terms by extending the Lie algebra of a MacDowell-Mansouri model to a Lie algebroid. These terms are commonly regarded as a source for cosmological inflation in effective string actions. With an additional constraint on torsion imposed, the theory reduces to a scalar-tensor theory belonging to the Horndeski class, and reproduces inflationary dynamics that meet existing constraints (Planck/BICEP/Keck and GW170817).

classification.title_zh: MacDowell-Mansouri σ-模型
classification.abstract_zh: 标准的前几何机制可以重现 ΛCDM 模型，但缺乏暴胀的自然来源。我们提出一种机制，通过将 MacDowell-Mansouri 模型的李代数扩展为李代数胚，使标量耦合的拓扑项得以出现。这些项在有效弦作用量中通常被视为宇宙学暴胀的来源。在额外施加挠率约束后，该理论约化为属于 Horndeski 类的标量-张量理论，并重现满足现有约束（Planck/BICEP/Keck 和 GW170817）的暴胀动力学。
classification.one_liner: 将 MacDowell-Mansouri 模型扩展为李代数胚以产生标量耦合拓扑项，并在挠率约束下得到可满足观测约束的 Horndeski 暴胀。

papers.title: Decoupling Limit of Quiver Theories and the Angular Spectra of Extreme C-metrics
papers.abstract: We investigate the angular eigenvalue problem of the extreme charged C-metric. Starting from a constrained five-point Fuchsian description of the non-extremal angular equation, we obtain its extreme limit by decoupling a hypermultiplet in the dual four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$, $\mathrm{SU(2)}\times \mathrm{SU(2)}$ linear quiver gauge theory. We derive the parameter dictionary and renormalized Matone relations, and connect the physical limit $Q\to M$ to the quiver decoupling by an explicit coordinate transformation. Regular endpoint conditions give an algebraic quantization condition. Eigenvalues obtained from the truncated instanton prepotential are tested against independent angular spectra near extremality and at larger acceleration. The axisymmetric sector recovers the known exact spectrum.

classification.title_zh: Quiver 理论的解耦极限与极端 C-度规的角谱
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究极端带电 C-度规的角向本征值问题。从非极端角向方程的受约束五点 Fuchsian 描述出发，通过对偶四维 N=2、SU(2)×SU(2) 线性 quiver 规范理论中一个 hypermultiplet 的解耦，得到其极端极限。我们导出参数字典和重整化 Matone 关系，并通过显式坐标变换将物理极限 Q→M 与 quiver 解耦联系起来。正则端点条件给出代数量子化条件。由截断瞬子预势得到的本征值在近极端和较大加速度下与独立角谱进行检验。轴对称扇区恢复已知精确谱。
classification.one_liner: 研究极端带电 C-度规的角向本征值问题，并将其与 N=2 线性 quiver 规范理论的解耦极限及参数字典相对应。

papers.title: Holograms and Standard Models
papers.abstract: Despite riddles, mysteries, and enigmas the theory of elementary particles has not changed for 50 years. We argue that the current paradigm -- Wilsonian quantum field theory -- is inadequate for resolving the puzzles, and should be replaced by a new paradigm based on the Holographic Principle. We show how a simplified but still very rich standard model emerges from de Sitter holography in the flat-space limit and explain why the puzzle of huge quantum corrections to the cosmological constant simply does not occur in the holographic paradigm.

classification.title_zh: 全息与标准模型
classification.abstract_zh: 尽管存在种种谜题、奥秘和疑团，基本粒子理论50年来没有改变。我们论证当前范式——Wilsonian量子场论——不足以解决这些难题，应被基于全息原理的新范式取代。我们展示一个简化但仍非常丰富的标准模型如何从平直空间极限下的de Sitter全息中涌现，并解释为什么宇宙学常数巨大量子修正的难题在全息范式中根本不会出现。
classification.one_liner: 文章主张用de Sitter全息原理取代Wilsonian量子场论，并说明标准模型可在平直空间极限下从全息中涌现。

papers.title: Learning Effective Bulk Fields from Fermionic Spectra: Application to an Extended Power-Law Liquid Model for Cuprate Strange Metals
papers.abstract: We develop a Neural-ODE framework to infer effective bulk metric functions and the charge-weighted gauge potential from boundary fermionic spectra within a static, planar black-hole ansatz. Controlled benchmarks recover the known bulk profiles of the Einstein--Maxwell and Gubser--Rocha models. We then use normalized interaction self-energy targets generated from an extended power-law liquid model with parameters calibrated by angle-resolved photoemission measurements to test the proposed geometric explanation of cuprate strange-metal spectra in a semi-holographic setting. For this application, we use a massless probe in backgrounds with conformal-to-$\mathrm{AdS}_2\times\mathbb{R}^2$ asymptotics and derive a spectral extraction formula from the conserved radial Dirac flux. We identify coordinate/Weyl redundancy and a degeneracy in the scaled Hawking temperature of the normalized inverse problem. The conformal factor remains undetermined, so bulk entropy and the associated contribution to electronic specific heat require independent input. Low-temperature targets are fitted accurately across the studied doping range. In the high-temperature test, however, the present ansatz and optimization search have not yielded a refined geometry that accurately reproduces the thermal spectral shape while preserving frequency symmetry. These results may guide the further development of semi-holographic models for cuprates, and the framework may also find applications in other strongly correlated electron systems.

classification.title_zh: 从费米子谱学习有效体场：应用于铜氧化物奇异金属的扩展幂律液体模型
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一个 Neural-ODE 框架，在静态平面黑洞拟设下，从边界费米子谱推断有效体度规函数和带电荷权重的规范势。受控基准测试可恢复 Einstein--Maxwell 与 Gubser--Rocha 模型的已知体轮廓。随后，我们使用由扩展幂律液体模型生成、并用角分辨光电子能谱测量校准参数的归一化相互作用自能目标，在半全息设定下检验所提出的铜氧化物奇异金属谱的几何解释。对于该应用，我们使用具有共形到 AdS2×R2 渐近背景中的无质量探针，并从守恒的径向 Dirac 流推导谱提取公式。我们识别出坐标/Weyl 冗余以及归一化逆问题中标度 Hawking 温度的退化。共形因子仍未被确定，因此体熵及相应的电子比热贡献需要独立输入。低温目标在所研究掺杂范围内拟合准确。然而，在高温测试中，当前拟设与优化搜索尚未给出一个精炼几何，能在保持频率对称性的同时准确复现热谱形状。这些结果可能指导铜氧化物半全息模型的进一步发展，该框架也可能应用于其他强关联电子系统。

papers.title: Eight-dimensional Manin triples, Yang-Baxter deformations and solutions of Supergravity Equations
papers.abstract: Extensive list of 4+4-dimensional Manin triples that was presented recently can be used to find new solutions of supergravity equations via Poisson-Lie T-plurality. To get the solutions we start with 1+3-dimensional flat backgrounds on Poisson-Lie groups corresponding to semi-Abelian Manin triples. For application of the Poisson-Lie T-plurality we identify Manin triples that form various decompositions of the same Drinfeld double. Beside flat backgrounds and plane-parallel waves solving supergravity equations, plurality transformation also produces curved backgrounds with torsion satisfying (generalized) supergravity equations. Many of the Poisson-Lie transformations can be understood as homogeneous Yang-Baxter deformations. Of special interest are the non-unimodular deformations leading to solutions of generalized supergravity equations.

classification.title_zh: 八维Manin三元组、Yang-Baxter形变与超引力方程的解
classification.abstract_zh: 最近给出的广泛4+4维Manin三元组列表可通过Poisson-Lie T-对偶性用于寻找超引力方程的新解。为获得这些解，我们从对应于半阿贝尔Manin三元组的Poisson-Lie群上的1+3维平坦背景出发。为应用Poisson-Lie T-对偶性，我们识别出构成同一Drinfeld double各种分解的Manin三元组。除了满足超引力方程的平坦背景和平面平行波外，对偶变换还产生带挠率、满足（广义）超引力方程的弯曲背景。许多Poisson-Lie变换可理解为齐次Yang-Baxter形变。特别值得关注的是导致广义超引力方程解的非幺模形变。
classification.one_liner: 利用八维Manin三元组和Poisson-Lie T-对偶性生成超引力方程的新背景，并联系Yang-Baxter形变。

papers.title: Finite-$N$ BMN index across all vacuum sectors
papers.abstract: We compute the finite-$N$ Witten index of BMN matrix quantum mechanics after summing over all partition-labeled supersymmetric vacuum sectors. Starting from the unitary-matrix integral for each sector, we adapt two complementary evaluation methods to the BMN index: a symmetric-group character expansion, which reduces each fixed fugacity order to a finite combinatorial sum, and a residue expansion in which the contributing poles are organized by rooted trees, with a colored-tree generalization for multi-partition sectors. Where practical, direct integration and extraction of the constant term in the expanded integrand give independent coefficient-by-coefficient checks. We evaluate every vacuum sector for $N\leq 9$. In the equal-fugacity expansion, the coefficients near charges $j\sim N^2$ exhibit substantial cancellations between vacuum sectors, which tend to reduce the effective $N^2$ coefficient of the total index entropy. The finite-$N$ data also reveal a nontrivial sectoral organization: near $j=N^2$, the sector giving the largest contribution changes with $N$, from single-partition sectors at small rank to double-partition sectors starting at $N=6$. We call this phenomenon dominance switching. These results provide quantitative finite-$N$ input for using the BMN index as a diagnostic of protected plane-wave black-hole sectors and suggest in the controlled type-IIA regime a possible D2 dressed black-hole interpretation in which D0 black-hole sectors are accompanied by macroscopic spherical D2-brane degrees of freedom, analogous to dual dressed black holes in $AdS_5\times S^5$.

classification.title_zh: 跨所有真空扇区的有限-N BMN 指数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算 BMN 矩阵量子力学在求和所有以配分标记的超对称真空扇区之后的有限-N Witten 指数。从每个扇区的幺正矩阵积分出发，我们将两种互补的求值方法用于 BMN 指数：其一是对称群特征标展开，它把每个固定逸度阶约化为有限组合和；其二是留数展开，其中贡献极点按有根树组织，并对多配分扇区作有色树推广。在可行时，直接积分以及从展开被积函数中提取常数项给出逐系数的独立检验。我们对 N≤9 的每个真空扇区进行了计算。在等逸度展开中，电荷 j∼N^2 附近的系数在真空扇区之间表现出显著抵消，这倾向于降低总指数熵的有效 N^2 系数。有限-N 数据还揭示出非平凡的扇区组织：在 j=N^2 附近，给出最大贡献的扇区随 N 改变，从小阶数的单配分扇区变为从 N=6 开始的双配分扇区。我们称这一现象为主导扇区切换。这些结果为把 BMN 指数用作受保护平面波黑洞扇区的诊断提供了定量有限-N 输入，并提示在受控的 type-IIA 区域可能存在一种 D2 修饰黑洞解释：其中 D0 黑洞扇区伴随宏观球面 D2 膜自由度，类似于 AdS_5×S^5 中的对偶修饰黑洞。
classification.one_liner: 计算 BMN 矩阵量子力学有限-N Witten 指数并汇总所有真空扇区，发现高电荷区强抵消与主导扇区切换，为平面波黑洞扇区诊断提供定量输入。

papers.title: Quantum spacetime and quantum fluctuations in the IKKT model at weak coupling
papers.abstract: This paper aims to clarify conceptual aspects of emergent structure in IKKT-type matrix models. Even without any adjustable parameters in the action, non-trivial matrix vacua do acquire a meaningful coupling constant, as well as two distinct uncertainty scales: a) the scale of noncommutativity of the matrix background, and b) the scale of quantum fluctuations of the matrices under the path integral. These scales are estimated for two prototypes of matrix backgrounds, known as Moyal-Weyl quantum plane and covariant quantum spacetime. Their relative importance separates two regimes: 1) the semi-classical regime interpreted in terms of semi-classical noncommutative geometry, and 2) the deep quantum regime usually interpreted in terms of holography. The quantum fluctuations around the background are shown to be negligible in the weak coupling regime. This justifies a basic assumption in previous work on the emergent 3+1-dimensional semi-classical geometry and (quantum) gravity in suitable vacua.

classification.title_zh: 弱耦合下 IKKT 模型中的量子时空与量子涨落
classification.abstract_zh: 本文旨在澄清 IKKT 型矩阵模型中涌现结构的概念性问题。即使作用量不含可调参数，非平凡矩阵真空仍可获得有意义的耦合常数，以及两个不同的不确定度尺度：a) 矩阵背景的非对易尺度；b) 路径积分下矩阵量子涨落的尺度。针对 Moyal-Weyl 量子平面和协变量子时空两类原型矩阵背景估计了这些尺度。它们的相对重要性区分两个区域：1) 以半经典非对易几何解释的半经典区域；2) 通常以全息解释的深度量子区域。结果表明，在弱耦合区域，背景周围的量子涨落可忽略。这为先前关于合适真空中涌现 3+1 维半经典几何和（量子）引力的工作中的一个基本假设提供了依据。
classification.one_liner: IKKT 矩阵模型中弱耦合下背景非对易尺度与量子涨落尺度分离，为涌现半经典几何/量子引力假设提供支撑。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及 IKKT 矩阵模型、全息与涌现量子引力，但与用户重点标签（全息超流超导、探针膜、QNM、经典引力等）均无直接匹配。

papers.title: The indivisibility of a quantum-corrected AdS black hole with phantom global monopoles
papers.abstract: We study the indivisibility of a quantum-corrected AdS black hole involving two kinds of global monopoles, regular or phantom ones to declare the effects from the quantum fluctuation, monopole factors and the negative cosmological constant on the evolution of black holes. We focus our attention on the possibility that this kind of black holes break into their own two parts because of the second law of thermodynamics. We derive and calculate the entropies of the initial black hole and the broken parts respectively and the entropy difference relates to the black holes structure including the quantum-gravity oscillation, global monopoles and the influence from AdS environment. It is found that the two kinds of global monopoles both keep the black holes intact instead of splitting because the entropy difference is negative. The considerable quantum fluctuation compels the defference to be positive and the fragmentation of the black holes may happen in the case that the mass of one fragmented black hole is tiny and the other one's mass is huge. The AdS radius can increase the whole value of change in entropy and the difference near the midpoint of mass ratio will become positive, so the large enough radius may lead the isolated black hole to become two parts nearly equal in the mass.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 含正则或幻影整体单极子的量子修正 AdS 黑洞的不可分性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究含两类整体单极子（正则或幻影）的量子修正 AdS 黑洞的不可分性，以揭示量子涨落、单极子因子和负宇宙学常数对黑洞演化的影响。我们重点关注这种黑洞是否会因热力学第二定律而分裂为两部分。我们分别推导并计算初始黑洞与分裂后各部分的熵，熵差与黑洞结构相关，包括量子引力振荡、整体单极子以及 AdS 环境的影响。结果发现，两类整体单极子都使黑洞保持完整而不分裂，因为熵差为负。显著的量子涨落会迫使熵差为正，因此当一个分裂后黑洞质量很小、另一个质量很大时，黑洞可能发生碎裂。AdS 半径会增大熵变化的总值，并使质量比中点附近的熵差变为正值，因此足够大的半径可能使孤立黑洞分裂成质量近似相等的两部分。
classification.one_liner: 该文通过比较熵差研究含正则或幻影整体单极子的量子修正 AdS 黑洞能否热力学分裂，发现单极子抑制分裂，而量子涨落和足够大的 AdS 半径可促成碎裂。
keywords: 量子修正 AdS 黑洞
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS 黑洞热力学与引力热力学范畴，涉及整体单极子和熵差稳定性，与经典引力及相变/热力学支线有一定关联；但未使用 AdS/CFT 字典或全息方法，也未直接涉及全息超导、QNM 或探针膜等用户重点支线。

papers.title: Combinatorial properties of holographic entropy inequalities
papers.abstract: A holographic entropy inequality (HEI) is a linear inequality obeyed by Ryu-Takayanagi holographic entanglement entropies, or equivalently by the minimum cut function on weighted graphs. We establish a new combinatorial framework for studying HEIs, and use it to prove several properties they share, including two majorization-related properties as well as a necessary and sufficient condition for an inequality to be an HEI. We thereby resolve all the conjectures presented in [arXiv:2508.21823], proving two of them and disproving the other two. In particular, we show that the null reduction of any superbalanced HEI passes the majorization test defined in [arXiv:2508.21823], thereby providing strong new evidence that all HEIs are obeyed in time-dependent holographic states.

classification.title_zh: 全息熵不等式的组合性质
classification.abstract_zh: 全息熵不等式（HEI）是Ryu-Takayanagi全息纠缠熵满足的线性不等式，等价于加权图上的最小割函数满足的不等式。我们建立一个研究HEI的新组合框架，并用它证明若干共同性质，包括两个与majorization相关的性质，以及一个不等式成为HEI的充要条件。由此解决arXiv:2508.21823中的全部猜想，证明其中两个并反驳另外两个。特别地，我们证明任意superbalanced HEI的null reduction通过该文定义的majorization检验，从而为所有HEI在含时全息态中成立提供强有力的新证据。
classification.one_liner: 建立全息熵不等式的组合框架，解决相关猜想并给出含时全息态中HEI成立的新证据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦全息纠缠熵不等式的组合与majorization性质，属于形式化全息量子信息研究；未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或D3-D7探针膜等方向。

papers.title: Differential Equations for Wilson Loops in ABJM Theory
papers.abstract: We derive a system of differential equations which are satisfied by the vevs of BPS Wilson loops and 't Hooft coupling of ABJM theory. They are Picard-Fuchs equations of an algebraic curve defined by the derivative of the planar resolvent of the corresponding matrix model. The weak and strong coupling behaviors can be reproduced by their local solutions around regular singularities. We also obtain a recursion relation which can be used to determine the planar vevs of BPS Wilson loops in arbitrary representations.

classification.title_zh: ABJM 理论中 Wilson 环的微分方程
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导出 ABJM 理论中 BPS Wilson 环的真空期望值与 't Hooft 耦合所满足的一组微分方程。它们是相应矩阵模型平面预解式的导数所定义代数曲线的 Picard-Fuchs 方程。通过其在正则奇点附近的局部解，可以重现弱耦合与强耦合行为。我们还得到一个递推关系，可用于确定任意表示下 BPS Wilson 环的平面真空期望值。
classification.one_liner: 用矩阵模型预解式导出的 Picard-Fuchs 方程刻画 ABJM 理论 BPS Wilson 环真空期望值随 't Hooft 耦合的演化，并给出任意表示的递推关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于 AdS/CFT 背景下 ABJM 理论 Wilson 环与矩阵模型精确计算，但不直接涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、探针膜、QNM 或经典引力等重点支线。

papers.title: Cosmological pole-skipping, shock waves and quantum chaotic dynamics of de Sitter horizons
papers.abstract: We present a systematic analysis of pole-skipping for scalar, Maxwell, and gravitational waves in cosmological spacetimes. Specifically, working in empty de Sitter space and in Schwarzschild-de Sitter black hole geometries, we locate the tower of pole-skipping points of such fields and show that they impose nontrivial constraints on the corresponding bulk two-point functions. Focusing on the gravitational sound channel, we then extract the Lyapunov exponent and butterfly velocities that characterize hypothetical dual many-body quantum chaos at each horizon. These chaotic data precisely match the outcome of a gravitational shock wave calculation, confirming that the relevant pole-skipping points encode high-energy scattering of horizon quanta. Interestingly, the butterfly velocities can become superluminal or imaginary, with the latter signaling a spatially modulated propagation of chaos. Assuming that a holographic dual exists, we translate our results into field theory language and propose that the dual theory can be divided into two entangled sectors that capture the black hole and cosmological horizon degrees of freedom. Our results suggest that the black hole sector becomes increasingly nonlocal as the black hole shrinks and that the cosmological horizon sector exhibits behavior compatible with violations of Hermiticity. Finally, we outline simple microscopic toy models, built from long-range and non-Hermitian deformations of the Double Scaled Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (DSSYK)-type chains, that realize these features, providing a concrete arena for future exploration.

classification.title_zh: 宇宙学 pole-skipping、冲击波与 de Sitter 视界的量子混沌动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们对宇宙学时空中的标量、Maxwell 和引力波的 pole-skipping 进行了系统分析。具体而言，在空 de Sitter 空间和 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 黑洞几何中，我们定位了这些场的 pole-skipping 点塔，并表明它们对相应的体两点函数施加非平凡约束。聚焦引力声学通道，我们提取了刻画每个视界处假设的对偶多体量子混沌的 Lyapunov 指数和蝴蝶速度。这些混沌数据与引力冲击波计算的结果精确匹配，确认相关 pole-skipping 点编码了视界量子的高能散射。有趣的是，蝴蝶速度可能变为超光速或虚数，后者标志着混沌的空间调制传播。假设存在全息对偶，我们将结果翻译为场论语言，并提出对偶理论可分为两个纠缠扇区，分别捕捉黑洞和宇宙学视界自由度。我们的结果表明，黑洞扇区随着黑洞收缩而变得越来越非局域，而宇宙学视界扇区表现出与厄米性破缺相容的行为。最后，我们勾勒了由双标度 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (DSSYK) 型链的长程和非厄米形变构建的简单微观玩具模型，以实现这些特征，为未来探索提供具体平台。
classification.one_liner: 系统分析 de Sitter 与 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 视界的 pole-skipping，并用冲击波和 DSSYK 型玩具模型刻画视界量子混沌。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息量子混沌与 de Sitter 视界 pole-skipping 方向，未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM非线性演化、冷原子或 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜等具体支线。

papers.title: Holographic free energy and integrated correlators of ${\cal N}=1^*$ theory
papers.abstract: We consider the 2nd integrated correlators of ${\cal N}=4$, $D=4$ super Yang-Mills theory, especially those which can be associated with ${\cal N}=1^*$ mass-deformed theories. We provide an analytic derivation of the integrals at supergravity tree level, which has not been available so far. Our result agrees with the previous results from the study of BPS solutions in the dual supergravity models.

classification.title_zh: ${\cal N}=1^*$ 理论的全息自由能与积分关联函数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑 ${\cal N}=4$、$D=4$ 超杨-米尔斯理论的第二积分关联函数，特别是那些可与 ${\cal N}=1^*$ 质量形变理论相联系的关联函数。我们给出超引力树图层面这些积分的解析推导，此前尚不可得。我们的结果与对偶超引力模型中 BPS 解研究得到的先前结果一致。
classification.one_liner: 在超引力树图层面解析计算 ${\cal N}=4$ SYM 的第二积分关联函数，并与 ${\cal N}=1^*$ 质量形变及对偶 BPS 解结果吻合。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 字典与超引力树图计算，涉及 N=1* 质量形变和积分关联函数；未直接涉及用户列出的具体研究支线标签。

papers.title: Brane expansions for anti-symmetric line operator index
papers.abstract: Based on the D5-brane realization of Wilson line operators in anti-symmetric representations, we propose brane expansion formulas for $I_{N,k}$, the Schur index of ${\cal N}=4$ $U(N)$ SYM decorated by line operators in the anti-symmetric representation of rank $k$. For the large $N$ index $I_{\infty,k}$ we propose a double-sum expansion, and for finite $N$ index $I_{N,k}$ we propose a quadruple-sum expansion. Objects causing finite $k$ and finite $N$ corrections are disk D3-branes ending on the D5-brane.

classification.title_zh: 反对称线算符指标的膜展开
classification.abstract_zh: 基于反称表示中 Wilson 线算符的 D5-膜实现，我们为 I_{N,k} 提出膜展开公式；I_{N,k} 是由秩 k 反称表示线算符修饰的 N=4 U(N) SYM 的 Schur 指标。对于大 N 指标 I_{\infty,k}，我们提出双求和展开；对于有限 N 指标 I_{N,k}，我们提出四重求和展开。导致有限 k 和有限 N 修正的对象是终止于 D5-膜上的盘状 D3-膜。
classification.one_liner: 用 D5-膜及端点在其上的 D3-膜给出反称表示线算符修饰的 N=4 U(N) SYM Schur 指标的膜展开公式。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接涉及 D5-膜实现、D3-膜端点修正和 N=4 SYM 线算符指标，属于 D3-D5 探针膜/膜展开支线；但不涉及 Floquet 驱动或经典引力。

papers.title: Axion RG flows and the holographic dynamics of instanton densities
papers.abstract: Axionic holographic RG flow solutions are studied in the context of general Einstein-Axion-Dilaton theories. A non-trivial axion profile is dual to the (non-perturbative) running of the $\theta$-term for the corresponding instanton density operator. It is shown that a non-trivial axion solution is incompatible with a non-trivial (holographic) IR conformal fixed point. Imposing a suitable axion regularity condition allows to select the IR geometry in a unique way. The solutions are found analytically in the asymptotic UV and IR regimes, and it is shown that in those regimes the axion backreaction is always negligible. The axion backreaction may become important in the intermediate region of the bulk. To make contact with the axion probe limit solutions, a systematic expansion of the solution is developed. Several concrete examples are worked out numerically. It is shown that the regularity condition always implies a finite allowed range for the axion source parameter in the UV. This translates into the existence of a finite (but large) number of saddle-points in the large $N_c$ limit. This ties in well with axion-swampland conjectures.

classification.title_zh: 轴子 RG 流与瞬子密度的全息动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在一般 Einstein-Axion-Dilaton 理论中研究轴子全息 RG 流解。非平凡的轴子剖面与相应瞬子密度算符的 θ 项非微扰跑动对偶。文章表明，非平凡轴子解与不平凡的全息红外共形不动点不相容；施加合适的轴子正则条件可唯一地选择红外几何。作者在渐近 UV 和 IR 区域解析求解，并说明这些区域中轴子反作用总是可忽略；轴子反作用可能在体时空中等区域变得重要。为联系轴子探针极限解，文章发展了系统的展开，并给出若干数值例子。结果表明，正则条件总意味着 UV 中轴子源参数有一个有限允许范围，这对应于大 N_c 极限下存在有限但很大数目的鞍点，并与轴子 swampland 猜想相吻合。
classification.one_liner: 研究 Einstein-Axion-Dilaton 中轴子全息 RG 流，表明非平凡轴子剖面与红外 CFT 不相容，正则条件唯一选择红外几何并限制 UV 轴子源。

papers.title: Gravitational fingerprints of a black hole solution in Palatini Kalb-Ramond gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate particle motion, optical observables, and linear wave propagation around a static black hole in Palatini Kalb Ramond gravity with a vanishing cosmological constant. The analysis distinguishes the conserved mass $M$ from the orbital mass $\bar{M}=M/\rho$ and isolates the radial deformation $\sigma^2=1-q/2$, where $q=\ell_2/(1-\ell_1)$. At fixed $\bar{M}$, the photon sphere, critical impact parameter, and innermost stable circular orbit retain their Schwarzschild values. Radial frequency ratios also preserve their Schwarzschild profiles for the same areal release and particle radii, while proper distances, infall times, and accumulated orbital angles depend on $\sigma$. For radial fall, the tidal eigenvalues acquire a factor $\sigma^{-2}$, and the instability exponent of the photon orbit scales as $\sigma^{-1}$. In addition, we examine light deflection in the weak and strong regimes with an explicit account of the conical asymptotics. The shadow comparison with Sgr A* and M87* exhibits a coupling degeneracy when the orbital mass and areal distance are set. Scalar, electromagnetic, and massless Dirac perturbations probe the physical metric, whereas a homogeneous axial gravitational sector with $\delta B_{\mu\nu}=0$ admits an exact Schwarzschild spectral map. In this sector, both oscillation and attenuation rates scale as $\sigma^{-1}$ at fixed $\bar{M}$. Third order WKB estimates agree with frequencies extracted from time evolution to within $0.7\%$ for the reported fundamental modes.

classification.title_zh: Palatini Kalb-Ramond 引力中一个黑洞解的引力指纹
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究宇宙学常数为零的 Palatini Kalb-Ramond 引力中静态黑洞周围的粒子运动、光学可观测量和线性波传播。分析区分守恒质量 M 与轨道质量 \bar{M}=M/\rho，并分离出径向形变 \sigma^2=1-q/2，其中 q=\ell_2/(1-\ell_1)。在固定 \bar{M} 时，光子球、临界碰撞参数和最内稳定圆轨道保持 Schwarzschild 值。对于相同的面积释放和粒子半径，径向频率比也保持 Schwarzschild 轮廓，而固有距离、下落时间和累积轨道角依赖 \sigma。对于径向下落，潮汐本征值获得 \sigma^{-2} 因子，光子轨道的不稳定指数按 \sigma^{-1} 缩放。此外，我们考察弱场和强场区域的光偏折，并显式考虑锥形渐近。与 Sgr A* 和 M87* 的阴影比较显示，在固定轨道质量和面积距离时存在耦合简并。标量、电磁和无质量 Dirac 扰动探测物理度规，而具有 \delta B_{\mu\nu}=0 的均匀轴向引力扇区允许精确的 Schwarzschild 谱映射。在该扇区中，固定 \bar{M} 时振荡率和衰减率均按 \sigma^{-1} 缩放。对于所报告的基本模，三阶 WKB 估计与从时间演化提取的频率在 0.7% 以内一致。
classification.one_liner: 研究 Palatini Kalb-Ramond 黑洞的粒子运动、光学观测量与线性扰动/QNM，并分析径向形变参数的影响。

papers.title: A new class of rotating black hole solutions endowed with a scalar hair
papers.abstract: We present new hairy stationary and axisymmetric black hole solutions. These solutions belong to a subclass of Horndeski scalar-tensor theories, in which there is no non-minimal coupling to curvature. The full rotating solutions are obtained numerically using the Kadath library based on spectral methods. The metric does not rely on an explicit ansatz but rather on the use of a set of numerical coordinates. Black holes obtained differ from Kerr in general, and depend on a new independent parameter, a primary hair, coming from a linear time dependence in the scalar field. These solutions admit a Killing horizon like the Kerr black hole, but are non-circular, and break the zeroth law of black hole thermodynamics.

classification.title_zh: 一类具有标量毛发的新型旋转黑洞解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们给出新的带毛稳态轴对称黑洞解。这些解属于 Horndeski 标量-张量理论的一个子类，其中没有与曲率的非最小耦合。完整的旋转解利用基于谱方法的 Kadath 库数值获得。度规不依赖显式拟设，而是使用一组数值坐标。所得黑洞一般不同于 Kerr 黑洞，并依赖于一个来自标量场线性时间依赖的新独立参数，即初级毛发。这些解与 Kerr 黑洞一样具有 Killing 视界，但不是圆对称的，并且破坏黑洞热力学的第零定律。
classification.one_liner: 在无曲率非最小耦合的 Horndeski 理论中数值构造出非圆对称、破坏黑洞热力学第零定律的带毛旋转黑洞解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究 Horndeski 标量-张量理论中的带毛旋转黑洞解及其热力学性质；不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息。

papers.title: Cosmological perturbations from localized sources: a gauge-invariant multipolar theory
papers.abstract: We develop a first-principles description of the linearized gravitational field of localized sources in spatially flat Friedmann-Lema\^{\i}tre-Robertson-Walker universes with arbitrary smooth expansion histories. The construction determines the complete retarded metric and the induced perturbation of the surrounding cosmic fluid from prescribed source stresses and a cosmologically stationary past field. It includes all multipole orders and accounts for curvature tails, through which the field depends on the source's past history inside the light cone. Generalizing the Blanchet-Damour multipolar formalism, we identify gauge-invariant mass and current moments together with a canonical cosmic fluid moment that determines an independent scalar response. This response vanishes in Minkowski and pure de Sitter spacetime, although curvature tails persist in de Sitter. The gauge-invariant multipoles are obtained directly in position space. This gives an exterior description without the nonlocal spatial projection through the source interior required by the usual scalar-vector-tensor decomposition. We also relate the canonical multipole metric to the standard variables of cosmological perturbation theory. The retarded construction requires neither a slow-motion nor a geometric-optics approximation. We define effective multipolar sources by truncating the moments of slowly varying sub-Hubble extended sources at a prescribed Cartesian multipole order, recovering the earlier quadrupolar and octupolar models in de Sitter spacetime. We recover the known Minkowski and de Sitter multipolar fields and obtain an analytical representation for gravitational propagation in the $\Lambda$CDM model including radiation.

classification.title_zh: 局域源产生的宇宙学扰动：规范不变多极理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在空间平坦、具有任意光滑膨胀历史的Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker宇宙中，从第一性原理出发描述局域源的线性化引力场。该构造由给定的源应力和宇宙学平稳的过去场确定完整的推迟度规以及周围宇宙流体的诱导扰动。它包含所有多极阶，并计入曲率尾效应，使场依赖于源在光锥内的过去历史。我们推广Blanchet-Damour多极形式，识别出规范不变的质量多极和电流多极，以及一个决定独立标量响应的正则宇宙流体多极。该响应在Minkowski时空和纯de Sitter时空中消失，尽管de Sitter中曲率尾仍然存在。规范不变多极直接在位置空间中求得，从而给出外部描述，而无需通常标量-矢量-张量分解所要求的穿过源内部的非局域空间投影。我们还将正则多极度规与宇宙学扰动理论的标准变量联系起来。该推迟构造既不需要慢速近似，也不需要几何光学近似。我们通过将缓慢变化的亚哈勃尺度延展源的矩截断到指定笛卡尔多极阶来定义有效多极源，并恢复de Sitter时空中先前的四极和八极模型。我们恢复已知的Minkowski和de Sitter多极场，并给出包含辐射的LambdaCDM模型中引力传播的解析表示。

papers.title: Geodesics of the five-dimensional Kerr-(A)dS black hole in closed form
papers.abstract: The Hamilton-Jacobi equation for geodesic motion in the five-dimensional Kerr-(A)dS black hole separates in Boyer-Lindquist coordinates, but the resulting first-order system has so far been integrated case by case, according to the real roots of the radial and the polar polynomial. We give the general solution in closed form. In dimensionless variables both polynomials are quartic, and a theorem of Biermann and Weierstrass then yields the radial and the polar coordinate as one pair of manifestly real formulas, parametrized by an arbitrary point of the orbit rather than by a turning point, and valid for timelike and null geodesics alike whatever the root structure. The time coordinate and the two azimuthal angles follow by quadratures that reduce to elliptic integrals of the third kind alone, and the affine parameter by one more of the same type. Along the way we correct the inverse metric and the radial potential as published.

classification.title_zh: 五维Kerr-(A)dS黑洞测地线的闭式解
classification.abstract_zh: 五维Kerr-(A)dS黑洞中测地线运动的Hamilton-Jacobi方程在Boyer-Lindquist坐标下可分离，但由此得到的一阶系统此前只能依据径向和极角多项式的实根情形逐例积分。我们给出闭式通解。在无量纲变量下两个多项式均为四次，Biermann-Weierstrass定理由此将径向和极角坐标写成一对显式实公式，以轨道上任意点而非转向点为参数，且对类时和类光测地线以及任意根结构均适用。时间坐标和两个方位角由求积给出，且仅化为第三类椭圆积分，仿射参数再需一个同类积分。文中还修正了已发表的逆度规和径向势。
classification.one_liner: 给出五维Kerr-(A)dS黑洞测地线的闭式通解，并修正逆度规与径向势。

papers.title: Black hole free energy landscapes from constrained instantons
papers.abstract: We apply gravitational path integral factorization to provide a semiclassical interpretation of generalized black hole free energy landscapes at fixed external temperature and angular velocities. Boundary integral transforms express the formal partition function as an integral over constrained sectors labeled by complete local partial-Neumann data on an auxiliary hypersurface. Independent variation establishes paired regular subregion solutions as constrained instantons, with Lagrange multipliers supporting lapse and tangential shift jumps that accommodate thermal and rotational mismatches. For selected nonextremal stationary families with an asymptotic boundary, the constrained saddle action takes the form $I_{\rm constr}=\beta\mathcal F_{\rm gen}=\beta(E_{\mathcal B}-\Omega_{\mathcal B}^{I}J_{\mathcal B,I})-S$, with $\beta=T^{-1}$. Here $E_{\mathcal B}$ and $J_{\mathcal B,I}$ are renormalized Hamiltonian charges and $S$ is the black hole entropy, whose contribution to the action comes from the regular horizon cap. Interior stationary points of the landscape correspond to smooth equilibrium saddles when the retained variations independently span the entropy and angular momentum directions. We extend the construction to local, parity-even $f(\mathrm{Riemann})$ theories without curvature derivatives by retaining the complete auxiliary interface data. The same thermodynamic form follows with Wald entropy, without a small-deficit expansion. Schwarzschild and Kerr black holes illustrate the Einstein construction, while five-dimensional static AdS black holes in Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity and the rotating BTZ branch of new massive gravity provide explicit checks of the higher-curvature extension.

classification.title_zh: 来自约束瞬子的黑洞自由能景观
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将引力路径积分因子化用于给出固定外部温度和角速度下广义黑洞自由能景观的半经典解释。边界积分变换把形式配分函数表示为约束扇区上的积分，这些扇区由辅助超曲面上的完整局域 partial-Neumann 数据标记。独立变分表明，成对的正则子区域解是约束瞬子，拉格朗日乘子支持 lapse 与切向 shift 的跳变，以容纳热失配和转动失配。对于具有渐近边界的若干非极端稳态族，约束鞍点作用量为 I_constr=βF_gen=β(E_B−Ω_B^I J_{B,I})−S，其中 β=T^{-1}；E_B 与 J_{B,I} 是重整化哈密顿荷，S 是黑洞熵，其对作用量的贡献来自正则视界帽。当保留的变分独立张成熵和角动量方向时，景观的内部驻点对应光滑平衡鞍点。我们将该构造推广到无曲率导数的局域宇称偶 f(Riemann) 理论，并保留完整辅助界面数据。同一热力学形式以 Wald 熵成立，无需小亏缺展开。Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 黑洞说明 Einstein 构造，而 Einstein–Gauss–Bonnet 引力中的五维静态 AdS 黑洞和 new massive gravity 的转动 BTZ 分支给出高曲率推广的显式检验。

papers.title: Gravitational Instability of Cold Axion Dark Matter Beyond Minimal Coupling
papers.abstract: Following recent observations of unexpectedly massive galaxies at high redshift by the James Webb Space Telescope, the revision of Dark Matter (DM) models --specifically regarding how DM couples to gravity-- has become a central topic in Cosmology. In this paper, we develop an axion model for Cold Dark Matter (CDM) with a non-minimal coupling to gravity. From this framework, we evaluate the gravitational instability in the hydrodynamic limit. Our results demonstrate how gravitational instabilities depend on the non-minimal coupling parameter, providing a novel tool for aligning with the high-redshift observations from the James Webb Space Telescope.

classification.title_zh: 超越最小耦合的冷轴子暗物质引力不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 继詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜近期发现高红移处意外大质量星系之后，修正暗物质模型——特别是暗物质如何与引力耦合——已成为宇宙学的核心课题。本文构建了一个具有非最小引力耦合的冷暗物质轴子模型。在此框架下，我们在流体动力学极限下评估引力不稳定性。结果表明，引力不稳定性如何依赖于非最小耦合参数，为与詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜的高红移观测相符提供了一种新工具。
