papers.title: Complexification of the Kerr-AdS black hole thermodynamic phase transition
papers.abstract: In this paper, we establish a systematic complex-analytical framework for investigating the thermodynamics of high-dimensional singly spinning Kerr-AdS black holes. By performing an analytical continuation of the black hole horizon radius into the complex plane, we map the thermodynamic behavior for the black hole to the zeros distribution of the corresponding analytical function. In the region below the critical point, this approach provides the criterion for identifying phase transitions and reveals that the zeroth-order phase transition does not alter the underlying thermodynamic topological structure of the black hole. In the supercritical region, based on the Lee-Yang theory of phase transition, we construct the Widom line to characterize the supercritical crossover behavior for the Kerr-AdS black holes. This study provides a new perspective on the thermodynamic analysis of black holes.

classification.title_zh: Kerr-AdS 黑洞热力学相变的复化

papers.title: Grey-body factors of black holes
papers.abstract: Grey-body factors describe the frequency-dependent transmission of fields through the effective potential generated by a black hole or another compact object. They convert the idealized thermal spectrum of Hawking radiation into the spectrum measured by an observer, determine absorption and scattering cross sections, and provide real-frequency observables complementary to quasinormal modes. In this review, we present a unified account of grey-body factors in black-hole physics and related systems. We formulate the scattering problem for asymptotically flat, de Sitter, and anti-de Sitter spacetimes, and discuss the connections between transmission coefficients, absorption cross sections, Hawking radiation, and ringdown. We also review methods for their computation and survey recent developments, including the correspondence between grey-body factors and quasinormal modes, their stability under deformations of the effective potential, wormhole transmission and superradiance, and their behavior in modified theories of gravity. Finally, we discuss the appearance of grey-body factors in gauge/gravity duality, where absorption probabilities in the bulk are related to correlation functions and transport coefficients in the boundary theory.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞的灰体因子
classification.abstract_zh: 本文综述黑洞及相关系统中的灰体因子：它们描述场通过黑洞或致密天体有效势的频率依赖透射，将理想霍金热谱转换为观测谱，并联系吸收/散射截面与准正规模。文章统一讨论渐近平直、de Sitter 和 anti-de Sitter 时空中的散射问题，梳理透射系数、吸收截面、霍金辐射与 ringdown 的关系，评述计算方法及近期进展，包括灰体因子与准正规模的对应、有效势形变下的稳定性、虫洞透射与超辐射、修改引力中的行为，以及规范/引力对偶中体吸收概率与边界关联函数和输运系数的联系。

papers.title: Linearised gravitational radiation in de Sitter spacetime at all multipole orders
papers.abstract: We derive the linearised gravitational waves generated by a localised matter source in the Poincare patch of de Sitter spacetime at arbitrary multipole order. The linearised de Sitter problem is mapped exactly to an auxiliary flat-space problem in harmonic gauge, with a conserved source built from the physical stress tensor. This allows us to use the multipole expansion of Damour and Iyer verbatim, and yields the exterior metric at all orders in terms of two families of radiative multipole moments given as explicit integrals of the physical stress tensor. The de Sitter tail is absorbed entirely into the auxiliary stress tensor, so that neither the moments nor the canonical exterior metric carry an integral over the past history of the source. As a check, we recover the known quadrupolar metric: in the quadrupolar truncation it is our canonical field up to a residual gauge transformation, which we construct explicitly.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 时空中任意多极阶的线性引力辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 de Sitter 时空的 Poincare patch 中，推导由局域物质源产生的线性引力波，并给出任意多极阶的结果。通过将线性化 dS 问题精确映射为谐和规范下的辅助平直空间问题，其中守恒源由物理应力张量构造，我们可以直接使用 Damour-Iyer 多极展开，并以物理应力张量的显式积分给出两组辐射多极矩，从而得到所有阶的外围度规。dS tail 被完全吸收进辅助应力张量，因此多极矩和正则外围度规都不包含对源过去历史的积分。作为检验，我们恢复了已知的四极度规：在四极截断下，它至多差一个显式构造的残余规范变换。

papers.title: Mechanical angular momentum loss at $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ from static and radiative gravitons
papers.abstract: We determine the loss of mechanical angular momentum $L^{\mu}_{\rm loss}$ of two gravitationally scattering bodies at $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ using worldline quantum field theory (WQFT). The gravitational memory effect, a phenomenon of the early- and late-time behaviour of the gravitational field, leads to static contributions to $L^{\mu}_{\rm loss}$. We illuminate how these arise: the linear memory contributes through so-called static correlators, while the nonlinear memory vanishes at this order due to symmetry considerations. The computation of the remaining, dynamical part resembles that of the $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ impulse. We generate its integrand using a reformulation of the WQFT Feynman rules that conserves four-momentum at every vertex and plainly exhibits the classical loops. The three-loop integrals are reduced to master integrals, whose differential equations and boundary matching in the post-Newtonian limit we describe in some detail. In contrast to conservative effects at this order, only polylogarithms appear. While individual contributions to the dynamical part are divergent, these cancel in $L^{\mu}_{\rm loss}$. The quadratic-in-radiation part of our result reproduces earlier results, while the complete result agrees with existing post-Newtonian results.

classification.title_zh: 静态与辐射引力子导致的 O(G^4) 机械角动量损失

papers.title: An explicit product for the on-shell higher-spin algebra in $AdS_d$-space
papers.abstract: For $d>3$ we construct the product of the bosonic on-shell higher-spin algebra directly on the AdS-traceless representatives. We find the traceless projector in closed form, determine all linear relations among the trace-producing operators, and prove that every class modulo the $\mathfrak{sp}(2)$ ideal has a unique traceless representative. The resulting product is an explicit differential operator, which we test on the $\mathfrak{so}(d-1,2)$ generators. A toy model shows how the factorisation lifts from bilinear products to trilinear ones in minimal $A_\infty$-algebras.

papers.title: U(1) Current Diffusion in Gauss-Bonnet Holography
papers.abstract: We study holographic $U(1)$ charge transport using a probe Maxwell field in a five-dimensional Gauss-Bonnet-AdS black-brane background. Within the all-order linearised fluid/gravity framework, we derive the off-shell constitutive relation and determine the diffusion function and electric and magnetic conductivities analytically in the hydrodynamic regime and numerically at generic frequency and momentum. To first order in the Gauss-Bonnet coupling, the leading diffusion constant remains unchanged in our normalization, while its frequency dependence and the electric conductivity receive nontrivial corrections. The deformation also generates a nonvanishing leading magnetic conductivity. Beyond the hydrodynamic regime, it modifies the transport profiles while preserving the damped behaviour of the diffusion function. The corresponding memory kernel vanishes at negative times, supporting a retarded constitutive response.

papers.title: Boundary preparation of strong Mpemba states in holography
papers.abstract: Finite boundary drives ending at the same charge density can select different relaxation channels. We demonstrate this in a probe Abelian--Higgs model on a fixed AdS black brane with a stable normal endpoint. Charge exchange during preparation modifies scalar propagation and source coupling. Density history and radial Maxwell feedback during and after the drive leave a cubic slow amplitude even after linear slow-mode cancellation. For the tested protocols at $\rho_f=3$, the density-history term interferes constructively with the net radial feedback; its modulus is 85--89\% of that of the total cubic coefficient. Calculated from the low-order equations alone, this total coefficient predicts the compensating pulse. Full nonlinear evolution confirms the reduction from $O(\epsilon^3)$ to $O(\epsilon^5)$ in the source amplitude $\epsilon$, with approximately 600-fold suppression for the representative protocol at $\epsilon=0.05$. Compensation extends the window of fast-channel relaxation without changing the final quasinormal-mode spectrum; early distance crossing already arises from linear interference. Fully tuned two- and three-pulse preparations suppress one and two slow modes, respectively, within numerical resolution. Local analysis establishes finite-pulse reachability of strong Mpemba states with vanishing selected asymptotic slow-mode coefficients. Charge-neutral controls retain a total-time advantage from a common input when the full subsequent control duration is included.

classification.title_zh: 全息中强 Mpemba 态的边界制备
classification.abstract_zh: 终止于相同电荷密度的有限边界驱动可以选择不同的弛豫通道。我们在固定 AdS 黑膜上的探针阿贝尔-希格斯模型中展示了这一点，该模型具有稳定的正常端点。制备过程中的电荷交换会改变标量传播和源耦合。驱动期间及之后的密度历史和径向麦克斯韦反馈，即使在线性慢模抵消之后，仍会留下一个三次慢振幅。对于 rho_f=3 的测试协议，密度历史项与净径向反馈发生相长干涉；其模量为总三次系数的 85–89%。仅根据低阶方程计算，该总系数就能预测补偿脉冲。完整的非线性演化证实，源振幅 epsilon 从 O(epsilon^3) 降至 O(epsilon^5)，在 epsilon=0.05 的代表性协议中约抑制 600 倍。补偿扩展了快通道弛豫窗口，但不改变最终的准正规模谱；早期距离交叉已由线性干涉产生。完全调谐的两脉冲和三脉冲制备在数值分辨率内分别抑制一个和两个慢模。局部分析确立了具有消失的选定渐近慢模系数的强 Mpemba 态的有限脉冲可达性。当计入完整的后续控制持续时间时，电荷中性对照从共同输入保留了总时间优势。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS 黑膜探针阿贝尔-希格斯模型中，边界驱动可通过密度历史与径向麦克斯韦反馈制备强 Mpemba 态并抑制慢模。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文使用 AdS 黑膜上的探针阿贝尔-希格斯模型研究非平衡弛豫、准正规模与非线性演化，直接匹配“全息超流超导”和“QNM与非线性演化”重点标签。

papers.title: Higher-Dimensional Test of the Holographic Dual of Entanglement Cohomology
papers.abstract: We extend the holographic test of entanglement cohomology from $d=2$ to higher-dimensional conformal field theories. For a $d$-dimensional CFT with a spherical entangling region $A$, the vacuum modular Hamiltonian is known explicitly, and the boundary relative entropy of a primary-operator perturbation can be computed via conformal Ward identities. On the bulk side, the perturbation is dual to a scalar field in AdS$_{d+1}$, and the bulk canonical energy is computed using the JLMS relation. We carry out the computation explicitly for $d=3$ and $d=4$ and find that the boundary and bulk results agree at first order in the perturbation, with identical coefficients $\kappa_d \Delta^2 / C_T$, where $\kappa_3 = \pi^2/12$ and $\kappa_4 = 3\pi^3/16$. The result extends the quantitative verification of the holographic dual of entanglement cohomology beyond the $d=2$ case treated in the companion paper and confirms that the modular Hamiltonian perturbation is the correct holographic image of the first entanglement cohomology class. We discuss the role of the conformal anomaly, the shape of the entanglement wedge, and an outlook on TsT-deformed backgrounds. \keywords{Entanglement entropy \and Cyclic cohomology \and von Neumann algebras \and Holography \and Modular Hamiltonian}

classification.title_zh: 纠缠上同调全息对偶的高维检验
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将纠缠上同调的全息检验从 d=2 推广到更高维共形场论。对于具有球对称纠缠区域 A 的 d 维 CFT，真空模哈密顿量已知显式形式，且可通过共形 Ward 恒等式计算主算符扰动的边界相对熵。在体侧，该扰动对偶于 AdS_{d+1} 中的标量场，并用 JLMS 关系计算体正则能量。我们显式计算 d=3 和 d=4，发现边界与体结果在一阶扰动下一致，系数均为 κ_d Δ^2/C_T，其中 κ_3=π^2/12，κ_4=3π^3/16。该结果将纠缠上同调全息对偶的定量验证推广到伴随论文处理的 d=2 情形之外，并确认模哈密顿量扰动是第一纠缠上同调类的正确全息像。我们讨论共形反常、纠缠楔形状以及 TsT 形变背景的展望。
classification.one_liner: 把纠缠上同调的全息检验从二维推广到三维和四维 CFT，并在一阶扰动下验证边界与体结果一致。

papers.title: Subsystem quantum R\'enyi-Bhattacharyya distance in 2D CFTs and its holographic applications
papers.abstract: We develop a systematic method to compute the subsystem fidelity and R\'enyi fidelity in two-dimensional conformal field theories (CFTs) from the operator product expansion of twist operators, and apply it to the subsystem quantum Bhattacharyya distance (BD) and R\'enyi-Bhattacharyya distance (RBD). We validate the method against exact results in the free massless fermion and boson theories, and then use it to compute the BD and RBD in holographic CFTs between two heavy primary states, between two thermal states, and between a heavy primary state and a thermal state. When the two states differ in their classical, order-$c$ data, the distances are of order $c$, and the states are distinguishable already at the level of classical gravity; when the leading data coincide, the distances are of order $1/c$ at every order of the short interval expansion, so that the distinguishability becomes a perturbative quantum gravity effect. For a heavy primary state and its thermal counterpart, the leading contribution to the BD appears at order $\ell^8$ and is of order $c^0$, whereas the RBD is generically of order $c$, in line with the earlier finding that a heavy primary state and a thermal state share the same order-$c$ entanglement entropy but have different order-$c$ R\'enyi entropies in the short interval expansion.

classification.title_zh: 二维CFT中的子系统量子Rényi-Bhattacharyya距离及其全息应用
classification.abstract_zh: 本文发展了一种利用twist算符算符乘积展开系统计算二维共形场论中子系统保真度和Rényi保真度的方法，并将其应用于子系统量子Bhattacharyya距离（BD）和Rényi-Bhattacharyya距离（RBD）。作者在自由无质量费米子和玻色子理论中与精确结果对照验证该方法，随后在全息CFT中计算两个重primary态之间、两个热态之间以及重primary态与热态之间的BD和RBD。当两个态的经典order-c数据不同时，距离为order c，可在经典引力层面区分；当leading数据相同时，距离在短区间展开的每一阶均为order 1/c，区分性成为微扰量子引力效应。对于重primary态与其热对应态，BD的leading贡献出现在order ell^8且为order c^0，而RBD一般为order c，这与重primary态和热态具有相同order-c纠缠熵但短区间展开中Rényi熵不同的已有结果一致。
classification.one_liner: 用twist算符OPE计算二维CFT子系统Rényi-Bhattacharyya距离，并给出全息CFT中重态与热态可区分性的经典/量子引力层次。

papers.title: Non-Riemannian Holography: Long Strings and Soft Hair
papers.abstract: We propose an $\mathbf{O}(D,D)$-covariant holographic dictionary for two bulk completions of the Gomis--Ooguri boundary data: Riemannian $AdS_3$ supported by pure NS--NS flux and an everywhere non-Riemannian string Newton--Cartan geometry. An $\mathbf{O}(D,D)$-covariant Codazzi identity yields the boundary conservation law. Both branches share diagonal generalized-metric one-point functions, but only the non-Riemannian branch carries independent normalizable soft hair that couples to long strings without contributing to surface charges or the renormalized on-shell action. Supersymmetric non-Riemannian saddles admit arbitrary chiral Killing-spinor profiles, realizing "supersupersymmetry."

classification.title_zh: 非黎曼全息：长弦与软毛发
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个 O(D,D)-协变的全息字典，用于 Gomis–Ooguri 边界数据的两个体完成：由纯 NS–NS 通量支撑的黎曼 AdS3，以及处处非黎曼的弦 Newton–Cartan 几何。一个 O(D,D)-协变的 Codazzi 恒等式给出边界守恒律。两支共享对角广义度规的单点函数，但只有非黎曼支携带独立的、可归一化的软毛发；该软毛发与长弦耦合，但不贡献表面荷或重整化在壳作用量。超对称非黎曼鞍点允许任意手征 Killing 旋量分布，实现“supersupersymmetry”。
classification.one_liner: 提出 O(D,D) 协变非黎曼全息字典，区分黎曼 AdS3 与非黎曼弦 Newton–Cartan 两支，并揭示非黎曼支的软毛发与长弦耦合。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 AdS/CFT 全息字典与非黎曼弦几何，属于全息基础与字典方向；但不涉及用户重点列出的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM 或探针膜等具体支线。

papers.title: Complex spinodals and supercritical crossovers in Kerr-Newman-AdS$_4$ black holes
papers.abstract: We study supercritical crossovers in four-dimensional Kerr-Newman-AdS black holes at fixed angular momentum and charge. From the exact enthalpy, we prove uniqueness of the physical critical point and positivity of the quartic Landau coefficient throughout the charge-rotation family, treating the uncharged Kerr-AdS endpoint in separate scaling variables. An exact quartic reduction determines the coexistence entropies and latent heat throughout the subcritical regime. Above criticality, the two physical spinodals continue as a complex conjugate pair. Their real temperature projection defines a Widom-type line, and varying the charge-rotation ratio assembles these lines into a crossover surface. The Landau cusp fixes the imaginary entropy and temperature to scale with the square root and three-halves powers of the pressure displacement from criticality. The projected fold and the local heat capacity ridge share a critical tangent. We derive their leading quadratic temperature separation and prove that the ridge lies at a higher temperature near criticality. Exact endpoint solutions and numerical continuation check these predictions. The cusp exponents are common to the family, while the crossover temperature depends on the thermodynamic criterion used to define it.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: Kerr-Newman-AdS$_4$ 黑洞中的复旋节线与超临界交叉
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在固定角动量和电荷下研究四维 Kerr-Newman-AdS 黑洞的超临界交叉。由精确焓出发，我们证明在整个电荷-旋转族中物理临界点的唯一性以及四阶 Landau 系数为正，并将无电荷 Kerr-AdS 端点置于单独的标度变量中处理。精确的四次约化确定了整个亚临界区域内的共存熵与潜热。在临界之上，两个物理旋节线继续以复共轭对形式存在；其实温度投影定义了一条 Widom 型线，改变电荷-旋转比可将这些线组装成一张交叉面。Landau 尖点将虚熵和温度固定为随偏离临界压力的平方根与三二分之三次方标度。投影折叠与局域热容脊共享一条临界切线；我们导出它们领先的二次温度分离，并证明在临界附近该脊位于更高温度。精确端点解与数值延拓检验了这些预言。尖点指数对该族是共同的，而交叉温度依赖于用来定义它的热力学判据。
classification.one_liner: 该文证明 Kerr-Newman-AdS$_4$ 黑洞临界点唯一，并用复旋节线与 Landau 理论刻画超临界交叉面及热容脊。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及黑洞热力学相变、临界性与经典引力，与“相变与气泡成核”和“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关；但摘要未涉及全息 CFT 字典、超流超导、探针膜或量子信息等其它重点方向。

papers.title: Holomorphic extremal surfaces for pseudoentropy in dS/CFT
papers.abstract: We formulate the extremization problem for codimension-two hypersurfaces in de Sitter space in holomorphic coordinates, with real anchoring conditions at future infinity. The resulting equation ($K^I=0$) describes complex bulk realizations extending the usual piecewise Hartle--Hawking construction. We compute holographic pseudoentropy for harmonic deformations of spherical regions of arbitrary size and dimension, confirming its universal expansion through second order in the deformation parameter. The result is independent of the integration contour within each homology class on the complexified extremal surface. Inequivalent classes, labeled by an integer associated with a discrete global-coordinate isometry, differ by a sign of the universal term in odd boundary dimensions and by real finite shifts in even dimensions. For conical defects in dS$_3$ parametrized by a Schwarzschild-dS mass, we also verify the first law of pseudoentropy and the persistence of contour degeneracy within each homology class.

classification.title_zh: dS/CFT中用于赝熵的全纯极值面
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在全纯坐标中表述de Sitter空间中余维二超曲面的极值化问题，并在未来无穷远采用实锚定条件。所得方程（K^I=0）描述了复体实现，扩展了通常的分段Hartle-Hawking构造。我们计算了任意大小和维度的球形区域在调和形变下的全息赝熵，并确认其普适展开在形变参数二阶成立。该结果在复化极值面上同一同调类内与积分围道无关。由与离散整体坐标等距对应的整数标记的不等价同调类，在奇数边界维度中相差一个普适项的符号，在偶数维度中相差实有限平移。对于由Schwarzschild-dS质量参数化的dS3锥形缺陷，我们还验证了赝熵第一定律以及每个同调类内围道简并的持续性。
classification.one_liner: 在dS/CFT中建立全纯极值面方程，并计算球形区域形变下的全息赝熵及dS3锥形缺陷中的赝熵第一定律。

papers.title: Strong generation of the chiral algebra of $\mathcal N=4$~$SU(N)$ super Yang--Mills theory
papers.abstract: The Schur sector of four-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory contains infinitely many protected operators, while the invariant polynomials of a single adjoint scalar are organized by finitely many Casimir degrees. I prove that the small $\mathcal N=4$ short multiplets built from these invariants strongly generate the associated chiral algebra, thereby establishing the $SU(N)$ case of the strong-generation conjecture of Beem et al. For every $N\ge2$, all field components associated with degrees $2,\ldots,N$ suffice, in every conformal weight and every degree of the standard relative quantum BRST cohomology. The proof brings together cyclic trace cohomology, quantum lifting, and an arbitrary-degree quartic--odd transport identity. Exact field relations and a finite-rank Newton obstruction exclude every additional lowest space, including non-scalar flavor representations; the required normal-ordering corrections and BRST primitives are derived explicitly. The resulting completeness theorem explains how a finite family of supersymmetric multiplets organizes an unbounded quantum spectrum. Every Schur class is a normal polynomial in their components and derivatives, even when its gauge-theory representative involves fermions and arbitrarily many derivatives. This supplies a uniform set of local inputs for meromorphic operator products, bounds protected state multiplicities before cancellations in an index, and gives an algebraic account of the finite-rank reorganization of protected trace operators.

classification.title_zh: N=4 SU(N) 超杨-米尔斯理论手性代数的强生成
classification.abstract_zh: 四维 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论的 Schur 扇区包含无穷多保护算符，而单个伴随标量的不变多项式由有限个 Casimir 次数组织。本文证明由这些不变量构造的小 N=4 短多重态强生成相伴手性代数，从而建立了 Beem 等人强生成猜想的 SU(N) 情形。对每个 N≥2，所有与次数 2,...,N 相关的场分量在标准相对量子 BRST 上同调的每个共形权和每个次数中都足够。证明结合了循环迹上同调、量子提升和任意次数的四次-奇输运恒等式。精确场关系和有限秩 Newton 障碍排除了所有额外最低空间，包括非标量味表示；所需正规序修正和 BRST 原语被显式导出。所得完备性定理说明有限族超对称多重态如何组织无界量子谱。每个 Schur 类都是其分量与导数的正规多项式，即使规范理论代表涉及费米子和任意多导数。这为亚纯算符乘积提供统一的局部输入，在指标中抵消前约束保护态多重数，并给出保护迹算符有限秩重组的代数描述。
classification.one_liner: 证明 N=4 SU(N) SYM 的 Schur 短多重态强生成其手性代数，确立 Beem 等人强生成猜想的 SU(N) 情形。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究 N=4 SYM 的保护算符与手性代数强生成，属于 AdS/CFT 字典中 CFT 侧的基础性结果；与用户关注的全息超流、畴壁、QNM 演化、冷原子等支线无直接重叠，仅在 multi-trace 算符结构上部分相关。

papers.title: Gravity as Large Scale Structure: Families of CFTs and the Higher-Spin Gap
papers.abstract: We observe an apparently universal behavior in large $N$ conformal field theory (CFT) in $d\geq 2$ dimensions: the single-trace, higher-spin gap obeys the parametric bound $\Delta_{\rm gap} \lesssim (\delta c)^{1/d}$, where $\delta c$ is the central charge increment between successive theories. The origin of this bound is explained heuristically, using a generalized notion of branes that interpolate between conformal points in theory space. Seeking a more precise framework for this picture leads to the central concept of families of CFTs, which tacitly underlies various features and puzzles of AdS/CFT. We develop a working definition of families, with inspiration from families of $L$-functions in number theory, and formulate a family-level version of the gap bound. Interpreted holographically for families of AdS$_{d+1}$ vacua, this bound, when applicable, rules out Planckian scale separation, constrains the size and number of extra dimensions, and explains simple scaling patterns in string/M-theory. It also accounts for why all known large $N$ vector models have a bounded gap.

classification.title_zh: 引力作为大尺度结构：CFT族与高自旋能隙
classification.abstract_zh: 我们观察到 d≥2 维大 N 共形场论中一个看似普适的行为：单迹高自旋能隙满足参数化上界 Δ_gap ≲ (δc)^{1/d}，其中 δc 是相邻理论之间的中心荷增量。该上界的起源通过一种推广的膜图像启发式解释，这些膜在理论空间中连接不同共形点。为寻求更精确的框架，作者提出“CFT 族”这一核心概念，并借鉴数论中 L-函数族的思路给出工作定义，进而表述族层面的能隙上界。在全息解释下，该上界适用于 AdS_{d+1} 真空族时，可排除 Planck 尺度分离、约束额外维的大小与数目，并解释弦/M 理论中的简单标度模式；它也说明了为何所有已知的大 N 矢量模型都具有有界能隙。
classification.one_liner: 文章提出 CFT 族与单迹高自旋能隙上界，并利用全息对偶约束 Planck 尺度分离、额外维及弦/M 理论标度模式。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息高自旋/CFT族与弦论紧致化的基础性讨论，与用户列出的全息超流、p波序参量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变、QNM、探针膜及经典引力等具体支线无直接交叉。

papers.title: Gravitational Cheshire effect from Yang-Mills instantons
papers.abstract: We show that the dimensional reduction of four-dimensional Yang-Mills instantons naturally gives rise to nontrivial matter configurations in three dimensions exhibiting an unusual mechanism of gravitational screening. Starting from Euclidean Yang-Mills theory, we reduce (anti-)self-dual gauge configurations along a compact direction generated by a $U(1)$ isometry of the instanton background. Under this reduction, the gauge connection decomposes into a three-dimensional Yang-Mills field and an adjoint Higgs field, while the metric gives rise, as usual, to a dilaton and an Abelian gauge connection. For instantons on the Taub-NUT background, the reduced fields organize themselves into two mutually screening pairs: the backreaction of the Abelian sector cancels internally, and the same occurs independently in the non-Abelian sector. As a result, the full matter content supports a composite stealth configuration on flat three-dimensional space. By contrast, the dimensional reduction of instantons on the Eguchi-Hanson background yields a non-Abelian matter sector whose gravitational backreaction cancels, while the Abelian sector remains gravitationally active and therefore deforms the three-dimensional background geometry. These examples reveal a direct connection between four-dimensional (anti-)self-duality and three-dimensional BPS-type relations, and illustrate how instantonic sectors that are gravitationally invisible in four dimensions can descend into either fully composite stealth configurations or partially stealth matter configurations after dimensional reduction.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 来自杨-米尔斯瞬子的引力柴郡效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，四维杨-米尔斯瞬子的维数约化会自然产生三维中的非平凡物质位形，并表现出一种不寻常的引力屏蔽机制。从欧几里得杨-米尔斯理论出发，我们沿由瞬子背景的 U(1) 等距所生成的紧致方向约化（反）自对偶规范位形。在此约化下，规范联络分解为三维杨-米尔斯场与伴随希格斯场，而度规照常给出伸缩子与阿贝尔规范联络。对于 Taub-NUT 背景上的瞬子，约化后的场组织成两对相互屏蔽的配对：阿贝尔部分的背反作用在内部抵消，非阿贝尔部分也独立发生同样情况。因此，全部物质内容在平直三维空间上支持一个复合 stealth 位形。相比之下，Eguchi-Hanson 背景上瞬子的维数约化给出一个非阿贝尔物质部分，其引力背反作用抵消，而阿贝尔部分仍具有引力活性，因而使三维背景几何发生形变。这些例子揭示了四维（反）自对偶性与三维 BPS 型关系之间的直接联系，并说明在四维中引力不可见的瞬子部分如何在维数约化后降为完全复合的 stealth 位形或部分 stealth 的物质位形。
classification.one_liner: 四维杨-米尔斯瞬子经维数约化可在三维产生完全或部分引力 stealth 的物质位形，展示引力柴郡效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息，但研究经典引力背反作用、瞬子维数约化与 stealth/屏蔽物质位形，与经典引力及孤子型非平凡位形支线相关。

papers.title: Wrapping M5-branes on a non-spin manifold: Spin$^h$ structures and AdS$_7$ black holes
papers.abstract: We construct a solution of seven-dimensional maximal gauged supergravity of the form AdS$_2\times M_5$, where $M_5$ is the five-dimensional Wu manifold $SU(3)/SO(3)$. The solution is supersymmetric, despite the fact that the Wu manifold admits neither a spin structure nor a spin$^c$ structure. Rather, it admits a spin$^h$ structure, wherein the ill-definedness of ordinary spinors due to a minus sign in their holonomy is compensated by a further minus sign arising through the spinors carrying $SO(3)$ Yang-Mills charge, in a half-integer isospin representation of the $SU(2)$ double cover of the $SO(3)$. We show how the configuration can be lifted to a solution of $D=11$ supergravity of the form AdS$_2\times M_9$, where $M_9$ is the unit tangent bundle of the Wu manifold. We discuss the geometry and topology of $M_9$, and study the supersymmetry from the eleven-dimensional standpoint. We extend the seven-dimensional solution to a black hole, and discuss some aspects of its holographic interpretation and the UV to IR flow. We revisit a previously-known AdS$_2\times H^3\times H^2$ solution, and its UV to IR flow, showing that the flow equations in fact admit of an exact solution. Additionally, we give a detailed discussion of the lift of the AdS$_2\times S^5$ solution to $D=11$, exhibiting similarities and differences between the properties of its internal space $M_9$ (the unit tangent bundle of $S^5$) and the Wu manifold example of our main discussion. We also construct the non-compact dual of the Wu manifold solution, where $M_5$ is taken to be $SL(3,\mathbb R)/SO(3)$.

classification.title_zh: 在非自旋流形上包裹 M5 膜：Spin^h 结构与 AdS7 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了七维最大规范超引力中形式为 AdS2×M5 的解，其中 M5 是五维 Wu 流形 SU(3)/SO(3)。该解是超对称的，尽管 Wu 流形既不允许 spin 结构也不允许 spin^c 结构；它允许的是 spin^h 结构：普通旋量因和乐中的负号而定义不良，但该负号由旋量携带 SO(3) Yang-Mills 荷、处于 SO(3) 的 SU(2) 双覆盖的半整数同位旋表示所产生的另一个负号补偿。我们展示如何将该位形提升为 D=11 超引力中 AdS2×M9 的解，其中 M9 是 Wu 流形的单位切丛；讨论 M9 的几何与拓扑，并从十一维角度研究超对称。我们将七维解扩展为黑洞，并讨论其全息解释及 UV 到 IR 流的一些方面。我们还重新审视此前已知的 AdS2×H3×H2 解及其 UV 到 IR 流，表明该流方程事实上允许精确解。此外，我们详细讨论 AdS2×S5 解到 D=11 的提升，展示其内部空间 M9（S^5 的单位切丛）的性质与本文主要讨论的 Wu 流形例子之间的异同。我们还构造 Wu 流形解的非紧对偶，其中 M5 取为 SL(3,R)/SO(3)。
classification.one_liner: 构造了七维规范超引力中 AdS2×Wu 流形的超对称解并提升到 D=11，讨论其黑洞扩展与全息解释。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息超引力解构造与自旋结构/拓扑问题，虽涉及 AdS/CFT 与黑洞，但不直接匹配用户列出的具体研究支线（如全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、D3-D7 探针膜等）。

papers.title: Angular Momentum Loss at Fourth Post-Minkowskian Order
papers.abstract: We calculate the total loss of angular momentum for a gravitational scattering of two non-spinning point-like objects at $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$. Our methodology combines use of both amplitudes and worldline-based methods. We derive the integrand from two copies of the gravitational waveform with cuts on massive lines arising naturally from the worldline. We then glue these two copies and evaluate the resulting phase-space integrals using reverse unitarity, in the amplitudes spirit. We obtain separately the radiated angular momentum and the static contribution that, at this order, is entirely determined by the initial shear and the linear memory. Combining these two terms, we derive relativistic expressions for the angular momentum loss and for the infrared-finite component of the mass dipole loss, which in the low-velocity limit match results available in the literature. We also use this result to derive the conservative deflection angle at $\mathcal{O}(G^5)$ and first self-force order.

classification.title_zh: 四阶后闵可夫斯基阶的角动量损失
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了两个非自旋点状物体引力散射在 O(G^4) 阶的总角动量损失。方法结合了振幅方法与世界线方法：从两份引力波形的乘积导出被积函数，其中大质量线上的割来自世界线；再将两份拷贝粘合，并用逆向幺正性以振幅思路计算相空间积分。我们分别得到辐射角动量与静态贡献；在该阶，静态贡献完全由初始剪切和线性记忆决定。合并两项后，我们给出角动量损失以及质量偶极损失红外有限部分的相对论表达式，并在低速极限下与文献结果一致。我们还利用该结果导出 O(G^5) 且含一阶自力修正的保守偏转角。
classification.one_liner: 用振幅与世界线方法计算 O(G^4) 引力散射角动量损失，并导出 O(G^5) 保守偏转角。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与后闵可夫斯基引力波辐射的高阶计算，直接对应重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”，不涉及全息。

papers.title: Resistive alignment of a black-hole magnetosphere
papers.abstract: Recent numerical simulations have shown that black-hole magnetospheres evolve rapidly toward alignment between the magnetic axis and spin axis but the physical origin of this process has remained unclear. We develop an analytic theory of this alignment within resistive relativistic magnetohydrodynamics. Taking the slow-spin Blandford-Znajek monopole solution as the exterior magnetic field, we reduce the induction equation to a relaxation equation for the current-sheet inclination angle. Our analysis shows that alignment results from second-order spin effects in the Blandford-Znajek solution combined with explicit resistive dissipation. We test this prediction using resistive-GRMHD simulations at several spins and resistivities and compare the measured late-time secular decay with the analytic prediction. This alignment timescale hence carries a unique signature which combines plasma dissipation with spacetime rotation.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞磁层的电阻性对齐
classification.abstract_zh: 近期数值模拟显示，黑洞磁层会迅速演化至磁轴与自旋轴对齐，但其物理起源仍不清楚。我们在电阻性相对论磁流体力学框架下建立该对齐的解析理论。以慢旋转的 Blandford-Znajek 单极子解作为外部磁场，将感应方程约化为电流片倾角的弛豫方程。分析表明，对齐源于 Blandford-Znajek 解中的二阶自旋效应与显式电阻耗散的共同作用。我们用多个自旋和电阻率的电阻性 GRMHD 模拟检验该预言，并将测得的晚期长期衰减与解析预言比较。因此，该对齐时标携带了结合等离子体耗散与时空旋转的独特特征。
classification.one_liner: 建立电阻性相对论 MHD 中黑洞磁层磁轴-自旋轴对齐的解析理论，并用 GRMHD 模拟验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究黑洞磁层的经典 GRMHD 解析理论与数值模拟，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Vacuum stability in Geometric Trinity of Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate whether the classical equivalence of general relativity, its teleparallel equivalent, and its symmetric teleparallel equivalent extends to false-vacuum decay at leading semiclassical order. For a real scalar field minimally coupled to gravity, we compare the tunnelling exponent $B=S_{\rm b}-S_{\rm fv}$, which determines the exponential suppression of the decay rate, $\Gamma\sim e^{-B}$, with the Euclidean bounce, $S_{\rm b}$, and false-vacuum actions, $S_{\rm fv}$. The three formulations admit the same $O(4)$-symmetric Coleman-De Luccia bounce, but the boundary terms relating their actions can contribute to $B$. We explicitly evaluate the torsion and non-metricity boundary contributions at the regular origin, $r=0$, and at the asymptotic endpoint, $r\to\infty$. For regular configurations with consistently matched bounce and false-vacuum boundary data, these contributions vanish in both TEGR and STEGR. We therefore obtain $B_{\rm GR}=B_{\rm TEGR}=B_{\rm STEGR}$, establishing that the three formulations predict the same leading semiclassical suppression of false-vacuum decay within the class of configurations and boundary conditions considered.

classification.title_zh: 引力几何三位一体中的真空稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究广义相对论、其远平行等价表述和对称远平行等价表述之间的经典等价性是否在半经典领头阶延伸到假真空衰变。对于最小耦合引力的实标量场，我们比较决定衰变率指数抑制的隧穿指数 B=S_b-S_fv 与欧几里得反弹作用量 S_b 和假真空作用量 S_fv。三种表述给出相同的 O(4) 对称 Coleman-De Luccia 反弹，但联系它们作用量的边界项可能对 B 有贡献。我们显式计算了正则原点 r=0 和渐近端点 r→∞ 处的挠率与非度规性边界贡献。对于反弹与假真空边界数据一致匹配的正则位形，这些贡献在 TEGR 和 STEGR 中均消失。因此得到 B_GR=B_TEGR=B_STEGR，表明在所考虑的位形和边界条件类别内，三种表述预言相同的半经典领头阶假真空衰变抑制。
classification.one_liner: 在 GR、TEGR 与 STEGR 中比较 Coleman-De Luccia 反弹，表明边界项不改变领头半经典假真空衰变指数。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Gravity with Non-Extensive Horizon Entropy and Topological Calibration
papers.abstract: We revisit Jacobson's thermodynamic derivation of gravity for generalized, non-extensive horizon entropies and develop a consistent framework in which modified gravitational dynamics emerge from horizon thermodynamics. By interpreting $S(A)$ as a coarse-grained entropy entering the thermodynamic constitutive relation, we show that only its local slope at a reference area $A_*$ contributes to macroscopic dynamics within a local Rindler-wedge construction. In this setting, the Clausius relation is reformulated as a stationarity condition for a Massieu functional at fixed Unruh temperature, allowing the entropy slope $s_0=(dS/dA)|_{A_*}$ to be identified as the parameter controlling the effective gravitational coupling. For entropy linear in area, Einstein's equations are recovered with $G_{\mathrm{eff}}=1/(4s_0)$. As a separate consistency check, we demonstrate that a scalar-response extension of the horizon entropy density, supplemented by internal entropy production, correctly reproduces the field equations of $f(R)$ gravity. Motivated by group-entropic arguments and generalized thermodynamics, we adopt a power-law entropy $S(A)=\eta(A/4G)^{\delta}$ and study its implications across scales. To remove the ambiguity in the coarse-graining scale, we introduce a Topological Calibration Principle linking the reference area to intrinsic geometric data through the Gauss-Bonnet theorem. For compact cross-sections admitted by the chosen theory or boundary conditions, this yields a topology-dependent effective coupling governed by the Euler characteristic. Consistency requirements constrain deviations from extensivity and generate scale-dependent modifications with potentially observable cosmological signatures. The resulting framework provides a systematic setting for testing non-extensive horizon thermodynamics and its phenomenological implications.

classification.title_zh: 非广延视界熵与拓扑校准的热力学引力
classification.abstract_zh: 论文重新审视Jacobson从视界热力学推导引力的框架，针对广义非广延视界熵S(A)建立一致描述。把S(A)视为进入热力学本构关系的粗粒化熵后，在局部Rindler楔构造中只有参考面积A_*处的局部斜率影响宏观动力学；Clausius关系被改写为固定Unruh温度下Massieu泛函的平稳条件，熵斜率s0控制有效引力耦合，线性熵恢复Einstein方程且G_eff=1/(4s0)。作为独立检验，标量响应扩展加内部熵产生可重现f(R)引力场方程。文章还采用幂律熵S(A)=η(A/4G)^δ，并引入基于Gauss-Bonnet定理的拓扑校准原则以消除粗粒化尺度歧义，得到由Euler示性数控制的拓扑相关有效耦合，并讨论对广延性的偏离及可能的宇宙学观测效应。

papers.title: Chaotic Imprints in Gravitational Waves from Extreme-Mass-Ratio-Inspirals Embedded in Dark Matter Halo
papers.abstract: We investigate imprints of chaos in gravitational waves from extreme-mass-ratio inspirals configuration, where a stellar massive object, confined in an external potential as a harmonic oscillators, orbits a supermassive Schwarzschild-like black hole embedded in a Dehnen-type dark matter halo. In our previous work (Das S, et al., Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals embedded in dark matter halo: Existence of homoclinic orbit and horizon-induced chaos, Sci. China-Phys. Mech. Astron. 69, 290413 (2026)), we demonstrated the system's transition from non-chaotic to chaotic dynamics by analyzing Poincar\'e sections, orbital evolution, and Lyapunov exponents across different energies and dark matter halo parameters. In this work, we compute the gravitational waveforms of the small celestial object along different chaotic and non-chaotic orbits by implementing the numerical kludge scheme. We further perform spectral analysis of the gravitational waveforms from such orbits. In particular, we show that when the system is in a chaotic state, the gravitational wave signals are characterized by broader frequency spectra with finite widths, irregular waveform modulations with comparatively large strain excursions for the chaotic trajectories considered here, together with modified energy-emission characteristics, distinctly differentiating them from the signals generated during the system's non-chaotic state. Furthermore, we discuss the potential detectability of these orbits for upcoming observatories like Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA), TianQin, and Taiji, emphasizing the significant potential for detecting chaotic imprints in gravitational waves to substantially enhance our understanding of chaotic dynamics in black hole physics and the dark matter environments of galactic nuclei.

classification.title_zh: 暗物质晕中极端质量比旋进引力波中的混沌印记
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究嵌于Dehnen型暗物质晕中的超大质量Schwarzschild类黑洞周围，一个受外部谐振子势约束的恒星级天体所构成极端质量比旋进构型中，引力波携带的混沌印记。基于此前用Poincaré截面、轨道演化和Lyapunov指数展示该系统由非混沌到混沌转变的工作，本文采用numerical kludge方案计算小天体沿不同混沌与非混沌轨道的引力波形，并对波形做谱分析。结果显示，当系统处于混沌态时，所考虑混沌轨道的引力波信号具有更宽且有限宽度的频谱、不规则的波形调制和相对较大的应变偏离，并伴随改变的能量辐射特征，从而明显区别于非混沌态信号。我们还讨论LISA、天琴和太极等未来探测器对这些轨道的潜在可探测性，强调探测引力波中的混沌印记对理解黑洞物理和星系核暗物质环境的意义。
classification.one_liner: 暗物质晕中的极端质量比旋进若处于混沌轨道，其引力波频谱更宽、调制不规则且能量辐射改变，并可能被LISA/天琴/太极探测。

papers.title: Extremal black hole mimickers: geometry, stability, and long-delay signal trains
papers.abstract: We present a spacetime that serves as a horizonless mimicker of extremal black holes. Unlike previously studied mimickers of black holes with non-degenerate horizons, whose geometries are of the wormhole type and consist of two asymptotically flat regions connected by a very long throat, the mimicker of an extremal black hole possesses a single asymptotically flat region at one end and an infinitely long throat at the other. In the throat region, the spacetime approaches the direct-product geometry $M_{1,1} \times S^2$, where $M_{1,1}$ is two-dimensional Minkowski spacetime and $S^2$ is the two-sphere. We investigate scalar-field dynamics and the fate of the Aretakis instability. Although Aretakis-like modes arise in a local analysis of the throat, they do not lead to a physical instability of the mimicker. A scalar perturbation initially localized in the throat gives rise, at late times, to a sequence of signals with a characteristic separation $t_{\rm delay}\sim 1/\lambda$, where $\lambda\ll 1$ is a deformation parameter. This timescale is parametrically larger than the echo time $t_{\rm echo}\sim \ln(1/\lambda)$ characteristic of non-extremal black-hole mimickers. We refer to this sequence as a {\it long-delay signal train}. Geometrically, the periodicity of the long-delay signals is associated with periodic geodesics on $S^2$. We then extend the construction to extremal Kerr. In this case, the throat region approaches a generalized product geometry involving $M_{1,1}$ and a two-dimensional surface $\Sigma_2$. The corresponding signals are expected to form a quasi-periodic signal train, reflecting the quasi-periodic geodesic motion on $\Sigma_2$. We also comment on the generalization to wormhole mimickers of non-extremal black holes and on the implications of these results for unitarity in the context of the AdS/CFT correspondence.

classification.title_zh: 极端黑洞模拟体：几何、稳定性与长延迟信号列
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种作为极端黑洞无视界模拟体的时空。与先前研究的非退化视界黑洞模拟体不同（其几何为虫洞型，由长喉道连接两个渐近平直区域），极端黑洞模拟体一端只有一个渐近平直区域，另一端为无限长喉道。在喉道区域，时空趋近于直积几何 M_{1,1}×S^2，其中 M_{1,1} 为二维闵可夫斯基时空，S^2 为二维球面。我们研究标量场动力学以及 Aretakis 不稳定性的命运。尽管在喉道的局部分析中出现类 Aretakis 模式，它们并不导致该模拟体的物理不稳定性。初始局域于喉道的标量扰动在晚期产生一系列信号，其特征间隔为 t_delay~1/λ，其中 λ<<1 为形变参数。该时间尺度在参数上大于非极端黑洞模拟体特征的 echo 时间 t_echo~ln(1/λ)。我们称此序列为长延迟信号列。几何上，长延迟信号的周期性关联于 S^2 上的周期测地线。随后我们将构造推广到极端 Kerr。此时喉道区域趋近于涉及 M_{1,1} 与二维曲面 Σ_2 的广义直积几何。相应信号预计形成准周期信号列，反映 Σ_2 上的准周期测地运动。我们还评论了对非极端黑洞虫洞型模拟体的推广，以及这些结果在 AdS/CFT 对应背景下对幺正性的启示。
classification.one_liner: 构造无视界极端黑洞模拟时空，分析标量场稳定性并发现由 S^2 测地线导致的长延迟信号列。

papers.title: A gravitational realization of Courant--Hilbert deformations
papers.abstract: Courant--Hilbert (CH) deformations unify broad classes of solvable stress-tensor flows including $T\bar{T}$ and root-$T\bar{T}$. However, a gravitational action that systematically yields such general deformations has remained unknown. In this Letter, we construct a two-dimensional massive gravity theory whose on-shell action reproduces the complete CH deformation. The gravity sector is defined via an arbitrary function of the eigenvalue ratio $y$ of the relative zweibein. To bypass the technical difficulty of directly eliminating the auxiliary zweibein, we reformulate the matter sector using a $2 \times 2$ spectral decomposition involving $y$ and a rank-one projector $K$. Sequentially solving the equations of motion---first for $K$ and subsequently for $y$---naturally maps the system onto the Russo-Townsend form of the CH flow. Our work extends Tolley's massive gravity formulation of $T\bar{T}$ flows to the CH landscape, providing a clear geometric mechanism for solvable stress-tensor flows.

classification.title_zh: Courant–Hilbert 变形的引力实现
classification.abstract_zh: Courant–Hilbert（CH）变形统一了包括 T\bar{T} 和 root-T\bar{T} 在内的多类可解应力张量流。然而，一个能够系统地给出这类一般变形的引力作用量此前仍属未知。本文构造了一个二维有质量引力理论，其在壳作用量可完整重现 CH 变形。引力部分由相对 zweibein 本征值比 y 的任意函数定义。为绕过直接消去辅助 zweibein 的技术困难，我们采用涉及 y 和秩一投影算符 K 的 2×2 谱分解来重新表述物质部分。依次求解运动方程（先对 K 后对 y）自然将体系映射到 CH 流的 Russo–Townsend 形式。我们的工作将 Tolley 关于 T\bar{T} 流的有质量引力表述推广到 CH 范围，为可解应力张量流提供了清晰的几何机制。
classification.one_liner: 构造二维有质量引力作用量，使其在壳作用量重现一般 Courant–Hilbert 变形，并将 Tolley 的 T\bar{T} 引力表述推广到 CH 范围。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及二维有质量引力与 CH/TTbar 变形，属于经典引力与全息变形方向，但与用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁、QNM 等具体支线无直接交集。

papers.title: BRST quantization of the induced gauge theory for the Higgs-branch CFT${}_2$
papers.abstract: We study Witten's induced gauge theory associated with the D1-D5 Higgs-branch CFT${}_2$, in which the non-dynamical vector multiplet becomes reanimated by integrating out the fundamental hypermultiplets. We propose a BRST quantisation of this theory and derive its induced propagators. We show that the ghost sector first contributes at subleading order, that the induced $A\phi^2$ vertex satisfies the Slavnov-Taylor identity and that gauge-invariant correlators are independent of the gauge parameter. Together with our chosen regularization prescription, this gives a perturbative framework for computing observables in the induced theory.

classification.title_zh: Higgs 支 CFT2 诱导规范理论的 BRST 量子化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Witten 提出的与 D1-D5 Higgs 支 CFT2 相关的诱导规范理论：其中非动力学矢量多重态通过积分掉基本超多重态而获得动力学。我们提出该理论的 BRST 量子化并推导诱导传播子。我们证明鬼场扇区首次在次领头阶贡献，诱导的 Aφ² 顶点满足 Slavnov-Taylor 恒等式，且规范不变关联函数与规范参数无关。结合所选正则化方案，这为计算诱导理论中的可观测量提供了微扰框架。
classification.one_liner: 为 D1-D5 Higgs 支 CFT2 的诱导规范理论建立 BRST 微扰量子化框架。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及 D1-D5 Higgs 支 CFT2 的诱导规范理论 BRST 量子化，属于全息 CFT/规范理论形式计算；未直接涉及所列全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等重点支线。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of Lorentzian Taub-NUT spacetimes in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS gravity
papers.abstract: We study the thermodynamics of Lorentzian Taub-NUT spacetimes in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS gravity in arbitrary even dimensions, constructed as $U(1)$ fibrations over Einstein-K\"ahler base manifolds. We compute the temperature from the surface gravity and the energy as the conserved charge associated with the stationary Killing vector using the off-shell Abbott-Deser-Tekin formalism. Within the same framework, we obtain the entropy as a horizon Noether charge. The result agrees with the Iyer-Wald formula and includes a Gauss-Bonnet correction to the Bekenstein-Hawking area law. Retaining the Misner strings whenever present, we formulate a first law of full cohomogeneity in which the NUT parameter varies independently of the horizon radius. This requires an additional NUT-related thermodynamic variable and its conjugate potential, which we determine explicitly. We also briefly discuss the static limit.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS引力中洛伦兹Taub-NUT时空的热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究任意偶数维Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS引力中洛伦兹Taub-NUT时空的热力学，这些时空构造为Einstein-Kähler底流形上的U(1)纤维丛。我们用表面引力计算温度，并使用离壳Abbott-Deser-Tekin形式将能量作为与稳态Killing矢量相关的守恒荷。在同一框架下，我们得到熵作为视界Noether荷。结果与Iyer-Wald公式一致，并包含对Bekenstein-Hawking面积律的Gauss-Bonnet修正。只要存在Misner弦就予以保留，我们建立具有完全同质性的第一定律，其中NUT参数独立于视界半径变化。这需要额外的NUT相关热力学变量及其共轭势，我们显式确定它们。我们还简要讨论静态极限。
classification.one_liner: 在任意偶数维EGB AdS中计算洛伦兹Taub-NUT时空的温度、能量、熵，并建立含Misner弦与独立NUT参数的第一定律。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力中的黑洞热力学与第一定律，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息字典、量子信息或凝聚态全息。

papers.title: Fortuity and fragility in supersymmetric SYK
papers.abstract: In the $\mathcal N=2$ supersymmetric SYK model with $N$ fermions, every BPS state is fortuitous: at fixed charge, it exists only over a finite range of $N$. Allowing the charge to increase, we show that BPS classes may instead be uplifted along lattice walks inside the fortuity window, potentially to arbitrarily large $N$. However, there is no canonical uplift. We therefore introduce a decoder $D$ whose spectrum quantifies exact uplift and its metric cost. We call the failure or increasing cost of uplifting harmonic representatives metric fragility. Chen's single-matrix model and the protected tower of the two-flavor SYK model realize bare and genuinely dressed mechanisms of perfect uplift, respectively. In the generic one-flavor model, exact uplift eventually fails. The Lin-Maldacena-Rozenberg-Shan-type operator $D^\dagger D$ exhibits level statistics consistent with the Gaussian unitary ensemble. Its eigenvalues quantify the metric continuity of BPS states across system size, while their correlations probe chaos within the BPS sector. Metric fragility and BPS chaos are thus encoded in complementary observables of the same operator, distinguishing chaotic BPS sectors from exactly solvable towers.

classification.title_zh: 超对称 SYK 中的偶然性与脆弱性
classification.abstract_zh: 在具有 N 个费米子的 N=2 超对称 SYK 模型中，每个 BPS 态都是偶然的：在固定电荷下，它只在一个有限的 N 范围内存在。让电荷增加，我们证明 BPS 类可以沿着偶然性窗口内的格点行走被提升，可能达到任意大的 N。然而不存在规范的提升。因此我们引入解码器 D，其谱量化精确提升及其度规代价。我们把提升调和代表的失败或代价增加称为度规脆弱性。Chen 的单矩阵模型和双味 SYK 模型的受保护塔分别实现完美提升的裸机制和真正着衣的机制。在一般单味模型中，精确提升最终失败。Lin-Maldacena-Rozenberg-Shan 型算子 D†D 的能级统计与高斯幺正系综一致。其本征值量化 BPS 态跨系统尺度的度规连续性，而其关联探测 BPS 扇区内的混沌。度规脆弱性与 BPS 混沌因此被编码在同一算子的互补可观测量中，从而区分混沌 BPS 扇区与精确可解塔。
classification.one_liner: 该文研究 N=2 超对称 SYK 中 BPS 态的偶然存在、跨 N 提升的度规脆弱性，以及 BPS 扇区混沌与可解塔的算子谱判据。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为超对称 SYK、BPS 态与 BPS 扇区混沌，未涉及用户重点的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、探针膜或经典引力。

papers.title: Combinatorial aspects of holographic quantum secret sharing
papers.abstract: We introduce combinatorial holographic quantum secret sharing (CHQSS) for a bulk subregion in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ to study how logical information of the bulk subregion is encoded in the boundary and protected from erasures of boundary subregions. We introduce a distance, a reconstruction threshold, and a secret threshold to characterize CHQSS schemes. We present the phase transitions of multipartite entanglement wedges in a symmetric setup and observe multiple distinct phase transition points. The distance and thresholds depend on the holographic phase and the choice of bulk subregion. We derive the maximum distance. Moreover, we derive the relations between the distance and the thresholds. We construct a family of CHQSS schemes in the symmetric setting that includes perfect threshold CHQSS and perfect non-threshold CHQSS.

classification.title_zh: 全息量子秘密共享的组合方面
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 中的体子区域引入组合全息量子秘密共享（CHQSS），以研究体子区域的逻辑信息如何编码在边界中，并如何免受边界子区域擦除的影响。我们引入距离、重构阈值和秘密阈值来刻画 CHQSS 方案。我们在对称设置中给出多部分纠缠楔的相变，并观察到多个不同的相变点。距离和阈值依赖于全息相以及体子区域的选择。我们推导了最大距离。此外，我们推导了距离与阈值之间的关系。我们构造了对称设置下的一族 CHQSS 方案，包括完美阈值 CHQSS 和完美非阈值 CHQSS。
classification.one_liner: 该文用组合方法研究 AdS3/CFT2 中体子区域的全息量子秘密共享，给出距离、重构/秘密阈值及其与纠缠楔相变的关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 纠缠楔与量子信息方向，但与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波、multi-trace、探针膜等具体重点标签不直接对应。

papers.title: A UV-Finite Refinement of the Ryu-Takayanagi Relation in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$
papers.abstract: We establish a refined Ryu--Takayanagi (RT) relation in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ using \emph{relative entropy} as the central object, in place of the ultraviolet-divergent von Neumann entanglement entropy. Adapting Hollands' exact result for the chiral relative entropy to a diamond region, we express the boundary relative entropy between the vacuum and a coherent state as a Schwarzian functional, which the Fefferman--Graham dictionary identifies with the asymptotic data of a Ba\~nados geometry; the rigidity of three-dimensional gravity promotes this boundary identification to the bulk. To linear order in the metric perturbation, the relative entropy then equals the variation of the RT geodesic length divided by $4G_N$. The construction rests only on the Bisognano--Wichmann/Borchers theorem and the holographic dictionary, giving a UV-finite, operator-algebraic counterpart to the RT relation.

classification.title_zh: AdS3/CFT2 中 Ryu–Takayanagi 关系的紫外有限精化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 AdS3/CFT2 中建立了一个精化的 Ryu–Takayanagi（RT）关系，以相对熵而非紫外发散的 von Neumann 纠缠熵为核心对象。将 Hollands 关于手征相对熵的精确结果适配到 diamond 区域，我们把真空与相干态之间的边界相对熵表示为 Schwarzian 泛函；Fefferman–Graham 字典将其等同于 Bañados 几何的渐近数据，而三维引力的刚性把这一边界识别提升到体。到度规微扰的线性阶，相对熵等于 RT 测地线长度变分除以 4G_N。该构造仅依赖 Bisognano–Wichmann/Borchers 定理与全息字典，给出 RT 关系的一个紫外有限、算子代数对应。
classification.one_liner: 用相对熵替代发散纠缠熵，在 AdS3/CFT2 中给出紫外有限的 RT 关系算子代数版本。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与全息纠缠方向，与用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7探针膜等无直接关联。

papers.title: Holonomies and Boundary Symmetries in the Discrete BF Formulation of Carroll Dilaton Gravity
papers.abstract: We construct a discrete realization of two-dimensional Carroll dilaton gravity based on a BF-type gauge structure with holonomy variables on lattice links. The bulk theory remains topological, while the physical dynamics is encoded in boundary degrees of freedom. Imposing admissible boundary conditions, we derive the asymptotic symmetry structure directly at the lattice level. The least restrictive conditions yield an affine extension of the Carroll algebra, while additional constraints reduce the symmetry to a conformal sector governed by a discrete Virasoro-type algebra. In the continuum limit, the lattice symmetry structure reproduces the expected affine Carroll algebra together with its conformal reduction. The construction therefore provides the ultra-relativistic counterpart of discrete Jackiw-Teitelboim(JT) gravity.

classification.title_zh: Carroll 膨胀子引力的离散 BF 表述中的和乐与边界对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们基于具有格点边上和乐变量的 BF 型规范结构，构造了二维 Carroll 膨胀子引力的离散实现。体理论保持拓扑性，而物理动力学编码在边界自由度中。施加容许边界条件，我们直接在格点层面导出渐近对称性结构。最宽松条件给出 Carroll 代数的仿射扩展，额外约束将对称性约化为由离散 Virasoro 型代数支配的共形部分。在连续极限下，格点对称性结构重现预期的仿射 Carroll 代数及其共形约化。该构造因此给出离散 Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力的超相对论对应。
classification.one_liner: 在格点 BF 框架中构造二维 Carroll 膨胀子引力，并在离散层面导出 Carroll 仿射代数及 Virasoro 型共形约化的边界对称性。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题属于 Carroll/JT 边界对称性，主要落在 dS/天球/平直时空/BMS-Carroll 与 JT/AdS2 方向；与所列重点标签仅通过经典引力有较弱关联，未涉及全息超导、探针膜、QNM 等。

papers.title: Kerr/CFT Traversable Wormhole with Fermionic Double-Trace Deformation
papers.abstract: The construction of a traversable wormhole with double-trace deformation has been achieved so far by using boson fields as the perturbation. In this work, we study double-trace deformation with fermion fields in the two-sided Kerr background to open a traversable wormhole. We construct the fermionic double-trace deformation within the Kerr/CFT framework. We consider the near-horizon, near-extremal Kerr geometry, which is dual to a conformal field theory. The lack of fermionic superradiance let us describe the wormhole at every region, even at the off-axis region where bosonic field experiences instability due to superradiance. By choosing a certain coupling between the left and right boundaries, the two-point function is modified, and its first order correction contributes the negative energy to open the wormhole. The wormhole is most traversable when the perturbation is turned on at early times, with opening that depends on the mode's frequency, the black hole temperature, and the fermion mass. At late times, the average null energy has damped oscillation behavior until eventually reaches zero. Wormhole with lower temperature have less traversability and it is completely closed at extreme limit. The same traversability can also be reproduced by using eikonal method. On the other hand, rotation and the number of fields involved in the deformation can increases the upper bound on information transfer up to the order of the entropy. Additionally, symmetrical effective potential bumps connected by the wormhole can produce observable echoes. We find that the echo time delay cannot exceed the scrambling time of the black hole.

classification.title_zh: 带费米子双迹形变的Kerr/CFT可穿越虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在Kerr/CFT框架下研究利用费米子场双迹形变构造可穿越虫洞。作者考虑近视界、近极端Kerr几何及其对偶共形场论，指出费米子不存在超辐射，因此可在包括玻色场因超辐射而不稳定的离轴区域在内的各个区域描述虫洞。通过选择左右边界的特定耦合，两点函数被修正，其一阶修正贡献负能量并打开虫洞。扰动在早期开启时虫洞最可穿越，其打开程度依赖模式频率、黑洞温度和费米子质量；晚期平均零能量呈阻尼振荡并最终趋于零。温度较低时可穿越性较弱，极端极限下虫洞完全闭合。eikonal方法可重现相同可穿越性。旋转和参与形变的场数可将信息传输上界提高至熵量级。此外，由虫洞连接的对称有效势垒可产生可观测回声，且回声时间延迟不超过黑洞的 scrambling time。
classification.one_liner: 在Kerr/CFT框架下用费米子双迹形变构造可穿越虫洞，并分析其可穿越性、信息传输上界与回声信号。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及multi-trace双迹形变与全息虫洞构造，并讨论信息传输和回声；但它不属于用户列出的全息超流/凝聚态主支线，主要属于黑洞全息与量子信息方向。

papers.title: D-instanton Effects on the Holographic Weyl Semimetals
papers.abstract: We investigate the effects of D-instantons on a holographic Weyl semimetal in a top-down approach. We find that the presence of D-instantons induces a novel phase transition from a Weyl semimetal to a gapped phase, providing a new mechanism for gap formation in strongly coupled systems. By analyzing the free energy of probe D7-brane embeddings, we construct the phase diagram in terms of the fermion mass, instanton density, and temperature, measured in units of the Weyl parameter. We show that, in addition to the conventional mass-driven transition associated with band inversion, the instanton density gives rise to a qualitatively different transition whose mechanism cannot be understood within the standard Dirac picture. We compute nonlinear electric conductivities from the regularity condition at the black hole horizon and demonstrate that the two types of transitions exhibit distinct transport behavior. In particular, the instanton-induced transition leads to a gapped phase with properties that differ from the conventional insulating phase. We also discuss possible interpretations of this phase in the boundary theory and comment on its relation to nonperturbative effects in strongly interacting systems.

classification.title_zh: D-瞬子对全息外尔半金属的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在自顶向下方法中研究D-瞬子对全息外尔半金属的影响。发现D-瞬子的存在会诱导从外尔半金属到有能隙相的新相变，为强耦合系统中的能隙形成提供新机制。通过分析探针D7膜嵌入的自由能，我们以Weyl参数为单位，构建了关于费米子质量、瞬子密度和温度的相图。我们表明，除了与能带反转相关的常规质量驱动相变外，瞬子密度还导致一种定性不同的相变，其机制不能在标准Dirac图像中理解。我们从黑洞视界处的正则性条件计算非线性电导率，并证明两类相变表现出不同的输运行为；特别地，瞬子诱导的相变导致的有能隙相性质不同于常规绝缘相。我们还讨论了该相在边界理论中的可能解释，并评论其与强相互作用系统中非微扰效应的关系。
classification.one_liner: D-瞬子在D3-D7自顶向下全息模型中诱导外尔半金属到有能隙相的新相变，并改变非线性电导输运。

papers.title: Holographic entanglement entropy and c-functions in conformal and confining backgrounds
papers.abstract: In this work we investigate holographic spacelike and timelike entanglement entropy using the Ryu-Takayanagi prescription, for slab-shaped and ball-shaped entangling regions. We work with an infinite family of 10-dimensional Type IIB supergravity solutions, which are gravity duals to an infinite set of linear quiver theories, with the backgrounds defined using the electrostatic potential formalism for brane configurations. The dual theories are 4-dimensional confining theories at low energy, but decompactify and flow to 5-dimensional SCFTs in the UV. We find that the entanglement entropy exhibits phase transition behaviour, and we use our results to investigate proposed c-functions constructed from the entanglement entropy. Comparing with the flow central charge, another proposed c-function, we find that each displays good behaviour, and reflects both UV and IR features of the dual theory.

classification.title_zh: 共形与禁闭背景中的全息纠缠熵与 c-函数
classification.abstract_zh: 本文利用 Ryu-Takayanagi 方案研究板状和球状纠缠区域的全息类空与类时纠缠熵。工作于无限族 10 维 IIB 型超引力解，这些解是全息对偶于无限族线性 quiver 理论的引力背景，背景由膜位形的静电势形式定义。对偶理论低能为 4 维禁闭理论，但在 UV 解紧致并流向 5 维 SCFT。发现纠缠熵表现出相变行为，并用结果研究由纠缠熵构造的 c-函数；与 flow central charge 比较，二者行为良好并反映对偶理论的 UV 和 IR 特征。
classification.one_liner: 在 10 维 IIB 超引力对偶的线性 quiver 背景中计算全息纠缠熵，并检验其相变与 c-函数行为。

papers.title: Environment-induced topological reconstruction of black-hole thermodynamics
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic topology describes black-hole (BH) equilibria as zeros, or defects, of a vector field built from the off-shell free energy. Studies with surrounding matter find that the topological class is unchanged, but not how the matter's spatial distribution affects individual equilibria. We ask whether the position of a localized environment can reorganize these equilibria at fixed total topological number. We model the environment as a radially localized energy bump peaked at $a_m$ and add its exterior energy to the generalized off-shell free energy. As $a_m$ varies, defects migrate and are created or annihilated in opposite-charge pairs, a process we call topological reconstruction. It changes the number and stability of equilibrium branches but preserves the total topological number, provided no zero crosses the boundary of the physical domain. We find this in Schwarzschild, Schwarzschild-AdS, Reissner-Nordstr\"om, and Reissner-Nordstr\"om-AdS BHs, with critical positions and required strength that depend on the background. In our examples, the required environmental energy ranges from below $1\%$ of the BH mass to a value comparable to it. The model is an effective fixed-background description without backreaction. Within it, the total topological number cannot capture the environmental response; local defects must be tracked.

classification.title_zh: 环境诱导的黑洞热力学拓扑重构
classification.abstract_zh: 热力学拓扑将黑洞平衡态描述为由离壳自由能构造的向量场的零点或缺陷。以往考虑周围物质的研究发现拓扑类不变，但未说明物质的空间分布如何影响单个平衡态。本文追问局域环境的位置能否在总拓扑数固定的情况下重组这些平衡态。作者将环境建模为峰值位于 a_m 的径向局域能量凸起，并把其外部能量加入广义离壳自由能。随着 a_m 变化，缺陷迁移并成对产生或湮灭相反电荷的缺陷，这一过程被称为拓扑重构。它会改变平衡分支的数量和稳定性，但只要没有零点穿过物理区域边界，总拓扑数保持不变。作者在 Schwarzschild、Schwarzschild-AdS、Reissner-Nordström 和 Reissner-Nordström-AdS 黑洞中发现了这一现象，临界位置和所需强度依赖于背景。在所给例子中，所需环境能量从低于黑洞质量的 1% 到与黑洞质量相当。该模型是无可反作用的有效固定背景描述；在此框架内，总拓扑数无法刻画环境响应，必须追踪局域缺陷。
classification.one_liner: 在固定背景有效模型中，局域环境能量凸起可改变黑洞热力学平衡缺陷的数量和稳定性，但总拓扑数保持不变。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于黑洞热力学与经典引力背景下的拓扑分析，不涉及全息对偶；与经典引力支线相关，但与全息超流、探针膜等主线较远。

papers.title: Angular Momenta in $4+1$ Vacuum Critical Collapse
papers.abstract: We investigate the critical collapse of gravitational waves that carry angular momenta. Working in five-dimensional vacuum Einstein gravity under an SU$(2)\times\mathbb Z_4$ symmetry ansatz, we numerically evolve several families of initial data near the threshold of black-hole formation. Near-critical data approaches the discretely self-similar Bizo\'n-Chmaj-Schmidt solution, which is irrotational. We find that the near-threshold mass scaling has a universal critical exponent, but the angular-momentum scaling has one of two critical exponents, depending on the family of initial data. The angular-momentum critical exponents are therefore not universal under this symmetry ansatz. Our results agree with predictions from perturbation theory about the critical solution.

classification.title_zh: 4+1 维真空临界坍缩中的角动量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在五维真空 Einstein 引力下，采用 SU(2)×Z4 对称性拟设，数值演化多族初态，研究携带角动量的引力波临界坍缩。近临界数据趋近于离散自相似的 Bizón-Chmaj-Schmidt 解，该解无旋。我们发现近阈值质量标度具有普适临界指数，但角动量标度依赖初态族而呈现两种临界指数之一，因此在该对称性拟设下角动量临界指数不普适。结果与关于临界解的微扰论预言一致。
classification.one_liner: 五维真空引力波临界坍缩的数值研究表明，近阈值质量标度普适，而角动量临界指数在 SU(2)×Z4 对称拟设下不普适。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与数值相对论中的临界坍缩和黑洞形成研究，符合经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息或其他量子引力主题。

papers.title: Dynamical entropy and thermodynamics of causal diamonds
papers.abstract: We study the dynamical entropy of causal diamonds using Wald-Zoupas charges and fluxes on their null boundaries. For a chosen boundary symplectic potential, the boost charge defines an entropy made of an area term plus an expansion correction, which reduces to one quarter of the area at the edge on the diamond. In Einstein gravity, we find an exact balance law relating the entropy on any two cuts of the null boundary to a signed flux, so the entropy decreases only when this flux is non-negative. We obtain a linearised physical process first law without assuming a background Killing symmetry, both in the presence and absence of external matter; and extend it for semiclassical gravity based on the improved quantum null energy condition. We also examine causal diamonds in maximally symmetric spacetimes and in Einstein-scalar gravity.
