classification.title_zh: 因果钻石的动力学熵与热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 本文利用零边界上的 Wald-Zoupas 荷与通量研究因果钻石的动力学熵。对选定的边界辛势，boost 荷定义的熵由面积项加膨胀修正组成，并在钻石边缘约化为面积的四分之一。在 Einstein 引力中，作者得到联系零边界任意两个截面熵与带符号通量的精确平衡律，因此熵仅在该通量非负时减小。文中还在不假设背景 Killing 对称性的情况下，分别在有、无外部物质时得到线性化物理过程第一定律，并基于改进的量子零能条件推广到半经典引力；最后考察最大对称时空和 Einstein-标量引力中的因果钻石。
classification.one_liner: 用 Wald-Zoupas 荷与通量建立因果钻石动力学熵的平衡律和线性化第一定律，并推广到半经典情形。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典引力中的因果钻石热力学与第一定律，匹配用户“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息。

papers.title: General Relativity in Three Lines
papers.abstract: We show that complex general relativity can be formulated directly in terms of three affine lines assigned to each spacetime point. The lines are represented by Pl\"ucker bivectors, and Urbantke's construction applied to the associated two-forms reconstructs the conformal spacetime metric. Starting from the chiral Pleba\'nski action, the simplicity constraints turn the three two-forms into a null internal basis of simple bivectors and thereby into three projective lines. A $3+1$ decomposition then yields a first-order canonical theory whose configuration variable is the weighted triple of lines and whose conjugate variable is a line momentum. The resulting constraint system consists of three internal Gauss constraints, three vector constraints, and one Hamiltonian constraint. A notable feature of the line formulation is that the equation obtained by varying the line momentum is pointwise algebraic after the spatial integrations by parts. Consequently the momentum can be eliminated explicitly wherever the corresponding Legendre map is invertible, giving a second-order action whose only dynamical configuration variable is the weighted triple of lines. The line curvature separates naturally into a cosmological trace and the Weyl matrix of the selected chiral sector. The Legendre map becomes singular on a distinguished null-evolution locus where the spacetime metric remains nondegenerate. There its rank drops from nine to six, giving three algebraic compatibility conditions. We construct a finite invariant partial Legendre transform and a smooth constrained second-order continuation through this locus. This analysis provides a regular framework for regimes in which the evolution direction becomes null and may be useful in the study of near-horizon geometries and related gravitational phenomena.

classification.title_zh: 三线表述的广义相对论
classification.abstract_zh: 本文表明，复广义相对论可以直接用赋予每个时空点的三条仿射线来表述。这些线由Plücker双矢表示，而对相关二形式应用Urbantke构造可重建共形时空度规。从手征Plebański作用量出发，简单性约束将三个二形式变为简单双矢的零内基，从而变为三条射影线。随后3+1分解给出一个一阶正则理论，其位形变量是加权三线，共轭变量是线动量。所得约束系统包括三个内禀Gauss约束、三个矢量约束和一个Hamiltonian约束。线表述的一个显著特征是，在对空间部分分部积分后，对线动量变分得到的方程是逐点代数的。因此，在相应Legendre映射可逆之处可显式消去动量，得到一个二阶作用量，其唯一动力学位形变量是加权三线。线曲率自然分解为宇宙学迹和所选手征扇区的Weyl矩阵。Legendre映射在一个特殊的零演化轨迹上变为奇异，而该处时空度规仍非退化；其秩从九降到六，给出三个代数相容性条件。作者构造了一个有限不变的部分Legendre变换以及穿过该轨迹的光滑约束二阶延拓。该分析为演化方向变为零的情形提供了正则框架，并可能有助于近视界几何及相关引力现象的研究。
classification.one_liner: 用三条仿射线/Plücker双矢和Plebański作用量给出复广义相对论的正则表述，并分析Legendre映射在零演化轨迹上的奇异与延拓。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究复杂GR的Plebański三线表述、3+1约束系统与Legendre映射奇异性；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Holographic two-point functions across a PT symmetry-breaking transition
papers.abstract: In parity-time (PT)-symmetric non-Hermitian systems, an exceptional point, where eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce, typically separates a real spectrum from complex-conjugate eigenvalues. In logarithmic conformal field theories (LCFTs), such an exceptional point appears in the spectrum of scaling dimensions. Holographic models of LCFTs, such as the dipole model, are built exactly at this point. Here, we deform the holographic dipole model so that its two coalescing scaling dimensions split into either two real ones or a complex-conjugate pair. We obtain the renormalized two-point functions in closed form. They change continuously from a linear combination of two power laws, through the logarithmic form of the LCFT at the exceptional point, to log-periodic oscillations. For any pair of scalar primary operators with real mixing under dilatations, the conformal Ward identities fix this form up to two normalization constants, which the holographic dictionary determines. In PT-symmetric theories with such a dilatation operator, real and complex-conjugate scaling dimensions correspond to the PT-unbroken and PT-broken phases. In the BTZ black hole at finite temperature, the difference between the quasinormal frequencies associated with the two scaling dimensions changes from purely imaginary to purely real across the real-to-complex spectral transition. Correspondingly, the linear response changes from overdamped to underdamped, with critical damping at the exceptional point.

classification.title_zh: 跨越PT对称破缺转变的全息两点函数
classification.abstract_zh: 在宇称-时间（PT）对称的非厄米系统中，本征值和本征矢合并的例外点通常将实谱与复共轭本征值分开。在对数共形场论（LCFT）中，这样的例外点出现在标度维谱中。LCFT的全息模型（如偶极模型）正是建立在该点。这里，我们形变全息偶极模型，使其两个合并的标度维分裂为两个实标度维或一对复共轭标度维。我们以闭合形式得到重整化两点函数；它们从两个幂律的线性组合，经过例外点处LCFT的对数形式，连续变为对数周期振荡。对于在膨胀下具有实混合的任意标量主算子对，共形Ward恒等式将该形式固定到两个归一化常数，而全息字典确定这些常数。在具有此类膨胀算子的PT对称理论中，实与复共轭标度维对应PT未破缺相与PT破缺相。在有限温度BTZ黑洞中，与两个标度维相关的准正频率之差在实到复谱转变前后从纯虚变为纯实。相应地，线性响应从过阻尼变为欠阻尼，并在例外点处临界阻尼。
classification.one_liner: 通过形变全息偶极模型，给出跨PT/LCFT例外点的闭合形式两点函数，并联系BTZ黑洞QNM与过阻尼-欠阻尼响应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文核心是全息LCFT两点函数和PT谱转变，并以BTZ黑洞QNM与线性响应为例；直接覆盖AdS/CFT字典和QNM支线，但不涉及超流超导、p波、探针膜或气泡成核标签。

papers.title: Timelike entanglement entropy with gravitational anomaly from complexified geometry
papers.abstract: We investigate the timelike entanglement entropy (TEE) in a two-dimensional conformal field theory with a gravitational anomaly, $c_L\neq c_R$, dual to topologically massive gravity in AdS$_3$. Holographically, the TEE is determined by the on-shell action of a massive spinning particle on a single complex geodesic anchored at the endpoints of the timelike interval. This action consists of the complex geodesic length and the twist of a parallel-transported normal frame. We carry out the computation in Poincar\'e AdS$_3$, non-extremal and extremal rotating BTZ backgrounds, and provide an equivalent Chern-Simons derivation in which the bulk connection stays real while only the saddle of the Wilson-line probe becomes complex. In each case, the holographic result matches the corresponding TEE in dual field theory. The real part of the TEE is fixed unambiguously whereas its imaginary part depends on the boundary $i\epsilon$ prescription and the orientation of the interval. In the bulk, the dependence on orientation reflects an ambiguity in the choice of framing. Along the complex geodesic, the residual frame group becomes $SO(2,\mathbb C)\simeq\mathbb C^*$, so the endpoint conditions determine the frame twist only up to integer multiples of $2\pi i$. The difference between the two orientations, $\frac{c_L-c_R}{6}\,i\pi$, is fixed entirely by the gravitational anomaly and persists for the R\'enyi pseudo-entropies.

classification.title_zh: 复化几何中的带引力反常时间向纠缠熵
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究二维共形场论中带引力反常（c_L≠c_R）的时间向纠缠熵（TEE），其对偶为 AdS3 中的拓扑大质量引力。全息上，TEE 由锚定在时间向区间端点的单条复测地线上大质量自旋粒子的 on-shell 作用量决定；该作用量包含复测地线长度和平行移动法标架的 twist。作者在 Poincaré AdS3、非极端与极端旋转 BTZ 背景中计算，并给出等价的 Chern-Simons 推导：体连接保持实，而 Wilson 线探针的鞍点变为复。各情形下全息结果与对偶场论 TEE 匹配。TEE 的实部唯一确定，虚部依赖边界 iε 规定和区间取向；在体中，取向依赖反映标架选择的不确定性。沿复测地线，剩余标架群为 SO(2,C)≃C*，因此端点条件只将标架 twist 确定到 2πi 的整数倍。两种取向之差 (c_L-c_R)/6 iπ 完全由引力反常固定，并在 Rényi pseudo-entropies 中持续存在。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3/CFT2 中通过复测地线与 Chern-Simons 表述计算带引力反常的时间向纠缠熵，并指出其虚部取向差由反常固定。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为 AdS3/CFT2 中带引力反常的时间向纠缠熵，属于全息纠缠熵基础；与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波/多分量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变气泡、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜及经典引力等具体支线无直接重合。

papers.title: Spinors, Doppelg\"angers and the Non-Perturbative Classical Double Copy
papers.abstract: We develop a geometric and spinorial formulation of the non-perturbative classical double copy between the Corrigan--Fairlie--'t Hooft--Wilczek sector of complexified SU(2) Yang--Mills theory and four-dimensional conformally flat gravity. We identify the gauge potential with the positive-chiral spin connection of the conformally flat metric, establishing an exact relation between the Yang--Mills field strength and the chiral projection of the Riemann tensor. This provides a four-dimensional realisation of the doppelg\"anger viewpoint, in which gauge and gravitational fields arise from different interpretations of common connection data. Within this sector, the sourceless Yang--Mills equations require constant scalar curvature, explaining the shared nonlinear scalar equation and extending the gravitational correspondence from traceless matter to matter with constant energy--momentum trace. By representing adjoint colour indices as symmetric pairs of spinor indices, we derive exact relations mapping the gauge field-strength spinors to the scalar-curvature and trace-free Ricci components of the gravitational curvature. These relations retain nontrivial curvature information despite the vanishing Weyl tensor. We illustrate the construction using anti-de Sitter and de Sitter spacetimes, together with $\mathrm{AdS}_{3}\times\mathbb{R}$ supported by a scalar field, demonstrating the extension to matter with nonzero constant trace

classification.title_zh: 旋量、二重身与非微扰经典双拷贝
classification.abstract_zh: 本文为复化 SU(2) Yang--Mills 理论中 Corrigan--Fairlie--'t Hooft--Wilczek 扇区与四维共形平坦引力之间的非微扰经典双拷贝建立几何与旋量表述。作者将规范势等同于共形平坦度规的正手征自旋联络，并给出 Yang--Mills 场强与 Riemann 张量手征投影之间的精确关系，从而在四维实现“doppelgänger”观点。该扇区中无源 Yang--Mills 方程要求常标量曲率，解释了共享的非线性标量方程，并将引力对应推广到具有常能量动量迹的物质。通过把伴随色指标表示为旋量指标的对称对，作者导出规范场强旋量到标量曲率与无迹 Ricci 分量的精确映射；即使 Weyl 张量为零，这些关系仍保留非平凡曲率信息。文中用 AdS、dS 以及由标量场支撑的 AdS3×R 时空说明该构造。
classification.one_liner: 构建复化 SU(2) Yang--Mills 与共形平坦引力之间非微扰经典双拷贝的旋量几何表述。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典双拷贝与共形平坦引力的经典引力/广义相对论支线，涉及 AdS/dS 示例，但不是 AdS/CFT 全息研究，也不直接涉及用户列出的全息超流、探针膜或 QNM 等焦点。

papers.title: Optical conductivity of holographic striped superconductors
papers.abstract: Based on a holographic model exhibiting Mott-like insulating behavior on an ionic lattice, we construct a holographic striped superconductor (SSC), which is characterized by the interplay between the charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity (SC). We present the phase diagram on the $e$-$T$ plane, where the SSC phase emerges within an intermediate window of $e$, revealing both cooperative and competitive relations between the CDW order and SC order. For small charge $e$, the system undergoes the phase transition from metallic phase to CDW phase, and then to SSC phase upon cooling; while for large $e$, it transitions from metallic phase to SC phase directly, and then to SSC phase. We compute the optical conductivity of the system for these two cases and demonstrate its distinct behavior. It turns out that the imaginary part of the conductivity exhibits a divergent behavior below the critical temperature $T_{\mathrm{SSC}}$ along both pathways, so that the superconductivity of SSC phase is justified for the first time in the holographic framework. Along the CDW-to-SSC pathway the pseudogap and the pinning effect are inherited from the CDW phase, whereas along the SC-to-SSC pathway the spontaneous stripe strongly suppresses the coherent normal-fluid channel while the superfluid pole is enhanced. In addition, we demonstrate the commensurate lock-in behavior of the striped superconductor in the $p$-$T$ diagram.

classification.primary_topic: 全息凝聚态/超流超导/强关联
secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 全息条纹超导体的光学电导率
classification.abstract_zh: 基于一个在离子晶格上表现出类 Mott 绝缘行为的全息模型，我们构建了全息条纹超导体（SSC），其特征是电荷密度波（CDW）与超导（SC）之间的相互作用。我们给出了 e-T 平面上的相图，其中 SSC 相出现在 e 的中间窗口内，揭示出 CDW 序与 SC 序之间既有合作也有竞争的关系。对于较小的电荷 e，系统在降温时经历从金属相到 CDW 相、再到 SSC 相的相变；而对于较大的 e，系统则直接从金属相进入 SC 相，然后进入 SSC 相。我们计算了这两种情形下系统的光学电导率，并展示了其不同行为。结果表明，沿两条路径，电导率虚部在临界温度 T_SSC 以下均表现出发散行为，从而首次在全息框架内验证了 SSC 相的超导性。沿 CDW 到 SSC 的路径，赝能隙和钉扎效应继承自 CDW 相；而沿 SC 到 SSC 的路径，自发条纹强烈抑制了相干的正常流体通道，同时增强了超流极点。此外，我们还在 p-T 相图中展示了条纹超导体的公度锁定行为。
classification.one_liner: 构建全息条纹超导体并计算光学电导率，展示CDW与超导的协同/竞争及SSC超导性的首次全息验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究全息超流超导与条纹/非均匀态，并计算光学输运，与用户重点方向高度相关。

papers.title: Hidden Supersymmetry in AdS/QCD models for Fermions
papers.abstract: We show that the chiral modes splitted from the Dirac equation satisfying Schrodinger-like equations in the context of deformed AdS/QCD model are isospectral, since the chiral effective potentials are SUSY partners. In particular, we show how to perform truncations of these potentials that preserve isospectrality of the chiral modes. Following this prescription, we compare a quadratic approximation of the deformed AdS model with the dressed soft wall model for fermions and show how the spectra of both models can coincide.

classification.title_zh: AdS/QCD 费米子模型中的隐藏超对称
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在变形 AdS/QCD 模型中，从狄拉克方程分裂出的手征模式满足类薛定谔方程且是同谱的，因为手征有效势是 SUSY 伙伴。特别地，我们展示如何对这些势进行截断并保持手征模式的同谱性。按照这一方案，我们将变形 AdS 模型的二次近似与费米子的 dressed soft wall 模型进行比较，并说明两个模型的谱如何能够重合。
classification.one_liner: 变形 AdS/QCD 费米子手征模式的有效势互为 SUSY 伙伴，可同谱截断并与 dressed soft wall 谱重合。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD 中费米子谱与隐藏超对称的研究，但不涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波序参量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜等方向。

papers.title: No cosmic horizons from a strengthened higher-dimensional strong energy condition
papers.abstract: Time-dependent supergravity compactifications lie beyond the setting of the Gibbons/Maldacena-Nu\~nez no-de Sitter theorem and can even support eternal cosmic acceleration, raising the question of whether they can also produce future cosmic horizons. For general higher-dimensional matter, the strong energy condition alone does not exclude such horizons. Here, we demonstrate that a theory fulfilling a strengthened version of the strong energy condition cannot be compactified down to a lower-dimensional theory able to support a future cosmic horizon. For 10d and 11d supergravities reduced to at least four large spacetime dimensions, this energy condition is fulfilled by the sources that already fulfill the strong energy condition in the higher-dimensional theory. Our assumption on the dimensional reduction is that it is performed on a smooth compact and boundaryless space.

classification.title_zh: 增强的高维强能量条件不产生宇宙视界
classification.abstract_zh: 含时超引力紧致化超出了 Gibbons/Maldacena-Núñez 无 de Sitter 定理的适用范围，甚至可支持永恒宇宙加速，因此问题在于它们是否也能产生未来宇宙视界。对于一般高维物质，仅强能量条件不能排除这类视界。本文证明，满足强能量条件增强版本的理论不能被紧致化到能够支持未来宇宙视界的低维理论。对于约化到至少四个大时空维度的 10 维和 11 维超引力，该能量条件由在高维理论中已满足强能量条件的源所满足。本文对维度约化的假设是：约化在光滑、紧致且无边界空间上进行。
classification.one_liner: 证明满足增强强能量条件的高维理论经光滑紧致无边界紧致化后，不能得到支持未来宇宙视界的低维理论，并应用于10维和11维超引力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于高维超引力紧致化与宇宙视界的经典/半经典引力 no-go 结果，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息字典；与用户“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关，但与其他全息重点标签无直接关联。

papers.title: Superstring theory in $AdS_5\times S^5$ background: half-BPS vertex operators
papers.abstract: In this paper, we construct all vertex operators associated with the gravity supermultiplet in the $AdS_5 \times S^5$ background, relevant for worldsheet scattering amplitude computations, via global $PSU(2,2|4)$ transformations. Although one such operator was previously constructed in the pure spinor formalism using a special superspace parametrization, implementing the full global symmetries proved challenging due to the mixing of bosonic and fermionic coordinates. We resolve this issue by introducing a judicious sequence of reparametrizations that disentangle these coordinates. We then advance the formulation of superstring theory in this background by constructing the corresponding integrated vertex operators in both the pure spinor and the B-RNS-GSS formalisms.

classification.title_zh: AdS_5×S^5 背景中的超弦理论：half-BPS 顶点算符
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过全局 PSU(2,2|4) 变换构造 AdS_5×S^5 背景中与引力超多重态相关的所有顶点算符，用于世界面散射振幅计算。此前在纯旋量形式中曾用特殊超空间参数化构造其中一个算符，但由于玻色与费米坐标混合，实现完整整体对称性颇具挑战。我们引入一系列精心选择的重参数化将这些坐标解耦，从而解决该问题；随后在纯旋量形式和 B-RNS-GSS 形式中构造相应的积分顶点算符，推进该背景下超弦理论的形式化。
classification.one_liner: 构造 AdS_5×S^5 超弦中 half-BPS 引力超多重态顶点算符，并给出纯旋量与 B-RNS-GSS 形式的积分顶点算符。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 AdS_5×S^5 超弦顶点算符与世界面散射振幅的形式构造，属于 AdS/CFT 基础与弦论技术，不直接涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、相变、QNM、探针膜等具体研究支线。

papers.title: A non-prompt null ray cures its own singularity
papers.abstract: In AdS/CFT correlators, bulk cone singularities arise when two points that are timelike separated on the AdS boundary may be connected by a null geodesic through the bulk. We consider corrections to these correlators away from the $G_N\to 0$ limit arising from the backreaction of this null geodesic. A peculiar property of this geodesic is that it is not prompt, meaning that there exist points on it that are timelike separated. This implies that it may gravitationally affect itself. We show that this leads to an energy-dependent delay in the time elapsed along this geodesic. This coupled with possible inelastic effects due to gravitational radiation are the leading mechanisms that resolve the singularity. The resolved singularity is accompanied by oscillations and hence zeroes in the real and imaginary parts of the correlator. We comment on the role that additional inelastic effects play in damping these oscillations. Finally, we provide a concrete example in $2+1$D where we can compute the energy-dependent time delay effect explicitly by studying the boundary graviton mode.

classification.title_zh: 非即时零射线治愈自身奇点
classification.abstract_zh: 在 AdS/CFT 关联函数中，当 AdS 边界上两个类时分离的点可通过体中的零测地线相连时，会出现体锥奇点。我们考虑该零测地线反作用对关联函数带来的、偏离 G_N→0 极限的修正。该测地线的一个特殊性质是它不是即时的，即其上存在类时分离的点，这意味着它可能对自身产生引力影响。我们证明这会导致沿该测地线经历的时间出现能量依赖的延迟；结合引力辐射可能带来的非弹性效应，这些是消解该奇点的主要机制。被消解的奇点伴随振荡，从而在关联函数实部和虚部中产生零点。我们讨论了额外非弹性效应在阻尼这些振荡中的作用。最后，我们给出一个 2+1 维的具体例子，通过研究边界引力子模式显式计算能量依赖的时间延迟效应。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS/CFT 中，非即时体零测地线的自引力反作用导致能量依赖延迟，从而消解体锥奇点并在关联函数中留下振荡零点。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于 AdS/CFT 关联函数与体几何反作用研究，与全息基础和经典引力支线相关；但不直接涉及全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、探针膜或 Floquet 驱动等用户重点支线。

papers.title: Dilaton-Axion Wormhole Partition Function Away from the BPS Endpoint
papers.abstract: I determine the leading finite-radius correction to the two-boundary response of a charged axion wormhole near its BPS endpoint. With $\delta=a_*^2$, exact radial matching in a product axion--dilaton/saxion system gives a boundary eigenvalue that vanishes as $O(\delta)$ and an off-diagonal Hessian entry of order $O(\delta^2)$. Their combination produces a cross-boundary covariance linear in $\delta$, with a negative first sub-leading correction on the branch studied here. I determine the semiclassical range in which the quadratic approximation remains controlled and identify the first finite-radius angular resonance, $\delta^2\log(\delta/\delta_0)$. Under a uniform rescaling of all active charges, the coefficient of the linear cross-boundary response scales as the inverse square of the charge scale. I then average the inverse response over the chiral Gaussian ensemble describing the BPS endpoint. Boundary reduction preserves the hard-edge index. Multiplication by the matched BPS sector weight converts the normalized response into the leading finite-radius two-source coefficient.

classification.title_zh: 远离BPS端点的膨胀子-轴子虫洞配分函数
classification.abstract_zh: 我计算了带电轴子虫洞在BPS端点附近对双边界响应的首个有限半径修正。取δ=a_*^2，在轴子-膨胀子/萨克斯子乘积系统中做精确径向匹配，得到按O(δ)消失的边界本征值以及O(δ^2)的非对角Hessian项；二者组合给出线性于δ的跨边界协方差，并在所研究分支上具有负的首个次领头修正。我确定了二次近似保持可控的半经典范围，并识别出首个有限半径角共振δ^2 log(δ/δ0)。在所有活跃电荷均匀重标度下，线性跨边界响应系数按电荷标度的平方反比缩放。随后对描述BPS端点的手征高斯系综平均逆响应；边界约化保持硬边指数。乘以匹配的BPS扇区权重后，归一化响应转化为首个有限半径双源系数。
classification.one_liner: 远离BPS端点的膨胀子-轴子虫洞双边界响应：有限半径修正、角共振与手征高斯系综平均。

papers.title: Exceptional points and near-extremal boundary response in rotating BTZ black holes
papers.abstract: We investigate whether the coalescence of long-lived quasinormal modes enhances the boundary response of rotating BTZ black holes. Using exact scalar solutions with mixed Robin boundary conditions and the retarded boundary correlator, we compare frequency-domain resonances and time-domain signals at fixed source and operator normalizations. An exceptional point (EP) can be crossed by varying the spin alone in a suitably selected fixed theory. Along a distinct near-extremal path that tracks the co-rotating EP surface by tuning the scalar mass and boundary coupling, a taller, narrower resonance coexists with a weaker but longer-lasting double-pole impulse response. The frequency-domain enhancement persists away from the EP and is therefore not unique to mode coalescence. Thus, the EP determines the double-pole structure and Jordan relaxation, but does not by itself determine the response strength, which also depends on the physical path and excitation protocol.

classification.title_zh: 旋转 BTZ 黑洞中的例外点与近极端边界响应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究长寿命准正规模的并合是否会增强旋转 BTZ 黑洞的边界响应。利用混合 Robin 边界条件下的精确标量解和推迟边界关联函数，我们在固定源与算符归一化下比较频域共振和时域信号。在适当选取的固定理论中，仅改变自旋即可穿过一个例外点（EP）。沿一条不同的近极端路径，通过调节标量质量和边界耦合来追踪共转 EP 面时，一个更高更窄的共振与一个较弱但持续时间更长的双极点脉冲响应共存。频域增强在远离 EP 处仍然存在，因此并非模式并合所独有。因此，EP 决定了双极点结构和 Jordan 弛豫，但本身并不决定响应强度；响应强度还依赖于物理路径和激发协议。
classification.one_liner: 在旋转 BTZ 黑洞中，例外点控制双极点响应与 Jordan 弛豫，但边界响应增强并非例外点独有。

papers.title: From the Test-Mass Limit to Binary Black-Hole Waveforms in Higher-Derivative Gravity
papers.abstract: Many higher-derivative theories predict stronger deviations from General Relativity for lower-mass black holes, while their nonlinear field equations often prevent reliable simulations of the full binary evolution. Here we develop a route from controlled black hole perturbation theory based on the modified Teukolsky formalism to comparable-mass waveforms, using parity-even cubic gravity as a representative example. We find that the tidal response of the secondary black hole enters at the same perturbative order as the direct higher-curvature correction and is therefore essential for a consistent leading-order waveform. The resulting strong-field fluxes and conservative dynamics produce an accumulated inspiral dephasing that grows toward merger. Embedding this test-mass information into an effective-one-body model, we construct inspiral-merger-ringdown waveforms for comparable-mass binaries and find coupling-dependent dephasing and waveform-peak shifts. Our results demonstrate how strong-field test-mass calculations can anchor waveform models for higher-derivative gravity when theory-specific numerical-relativity simulations are unavailable.

classification.title_zh: 高导数引力中从试验质量极限到双黑洞波形
classification.abstract_zh: 许多高导数理论预言低质量黑洞会表现出更强的广义相对论偏离，但其非线性场方程往往使完整双星演化模拟难以可靠进行。本文以宇称偶立方引力为例，发展了一条从基于修正 Teukolsky 形式的有控制黑洞微扰理论通向可比质量波形的路线。我们发现，次级黑洞的潮汐响应与直接高阶曲率修正处于同一微扰阶，因此对一致的首阶波形至关重要。由此得到的强场通量和守恒动力学产生累积的旋进相位退相干，并随并合增强。将试验质量信息嵌入有效单体模型后，我们为可比质量双星构建了旋进-并合-铃宕波形，并发现耦合依赖的相位退相干和波形峰值移动。结果表明，在缺乏理论特定数值相对论模拟时，强场试验质量计算可为高导数引力波形模型提供锚定。
classification.one_liner: 利用修正 Teukolsky 微扰与有效单体模型，将高导数引力中的试验质量黑洞信息转化为可比质量双黑洞的旋进-并合-铃宕波形。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论与黑洞波形研究，涉及修正引力、微扰和铃宕，与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论及 QNM 相关支线有关；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息超导、纠缠等全息主题。

papers.title: Vishveshwara's waveform revisited: insights from a Keldysh quasinormal mode expansion
papers.abstract: We revisit Vishveshwara's linear scattering on a Schwarzschild black hole to study the evolution of quasinormal mode activation along the full time-domain waveform. Specifically, by adopting a hyperboloidal approach we cast the scattering problem in a non-selfadjoint dynamics setting where a (Keldysh) resonant expansion in a bi-orthogonal system of quasinormal modes can be readily performed. The calculation reveals the neat correlation of the second peak in Vishveshwara's waveform to the fundamental mode and first overtones, closely following the ringdown waveform pattern of non-linear evolutions. The first peak is completely controlled, for even (Zerilli) perturbations, by the algebraically special mode and the nearby branch cut. This phenomenon is absent for odd (Regge-Wheeler) perturbations. These qualitative features are robust under change of initial data, extending to Reissner-Nordstr\"om and Kerr black holes but being absent when departing from asymptotic flatness to spacetime asymptotics without a branch cut. Underlying linear mechanisms might shed light on the role of algebraic speciality in the transition to the ringdown in non-linear evolutions.

classification.title_zh: 重访 Vishveshwara 波形：来自 Keldysh 准正规模展开的洞见
classification.abstract_zh: 本文重新研究 Schwarzschild 黑洞上的 Vishveshwara 线性散射，采用双曲型方法将散射问题表述为非自伴动力学，从而可在双正交准正规模系统中进行 Keldysh 共振展开，追踪准正规模在整个时域波形中的激活过程。计算表明，Vishveshwara 波形的第二个峰与基模及第一阶 overtone 密切相关，并类似非线性演化的 ringdown 波形；对于偶（Zerilli）扰动，第一个峰完全由代数特殊模及附近分支割线控制，而奇（Regge-Wheeler）扰动无此现象。这些定性特征在改变初始数据下稳健，并可推广到 Reissner-Nordström 和 Kerr 黑洞，但在离开渐近平直、转向无分支割线的时空渐近时消失。其线性机制或有助于理解非线性演化中向 ringdown 过渡时代数特殊性的作用。
classification.one_liner: 用 Keldysh 准正规模展开重访 Vishveshwara 波形，揭示各峰由基模、overtone、代数特殊模和分支割线控制。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究黑洞准正规模与经典引力波形，匹配“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息。

papers.title: Classical and Loop Quantum Cosmology of Interacting Dark Energy: A Dynamical System Analysis with Superfluid Dark Matter and Dust Matter
papers.abstract: We study the cosmological dynamics of interacting dark energy and dark matter in Classical Einstein Gravity and Loop Quantum Cosmology. Two dark matter scenarios are considered: superfluid dark matter described by a generalized cubic equation of state and the standard pressureless fluid. The dark energy component is modeled using both a generalized nonlinear equation of state and a constant equation of state. We examine two phenomenological interaction terms, $Q=\alpha\dot{\rho}_m$ and $Q=\beta\dot{\rho}_d$, which govern the energy transfer between the dark sectors. In classical gravity, the pressureless matter model exhibits stable late-time attractors, whereas the superfluid dark matter model admits only saddle and non-hyperbolic critical points. Extending the analysis to Loop Quantum Cosmology, quantum geometric corrections replace the Big Bang singularity with a nonsingular quantum bounce, and significantly modify the phase-space dynamics. As a result, the stable attractors of the classical pressureless matter model disappear, and all interacting models possess only saddle and non-hyperbolic critical points. These findings highlight the significant influence of both dark matter properties and quantum gravitational effects on the asymptotic evolution of interacting dark-sectors.

classification.title_zh: 相互作用暗能量的经典与圈量子宇宙学：含超流暗物质与尘埃物质的动力学系统分析
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在经典爱因斯坦引力与圈量子宇宙学中研究相互作用暗能量和暗物质的宇宙学动力学。考虑两种暗物质情形：由广义立方状态方程描述的超流暗物质，以及标准无压流体。暗能量组分分别用广义非线性状态方程和常数状态方程建模。我们考察两个现象学相互作用项 Q=αρ̇_m 和 Q=βρ̇_d，它们控制暗部门之间的能量转移。在经典引力中，无压物质模型具有稳定的晚期吸引子，而超流暗物质模型仅有鞍点和非双曲临界点。将分析推广到圈量子宇宙学后，量子几何修正以大爆炸前非奇异量子反弹取代奇点，并显著改变相空间动力学。因此，经典无压物质模型的稳定吸引子消失，所有相互作用模型仅具有鞍点和非双曲临界点。这些结果凸显暗物质性质与量子引力效应对相互作用暗部门渐近演化的显著影响。
classification.one_liner: 用动力学系统方法比较经典引力与圈量子宇宙学中相互作用暗能量模型，发现量子反弹修正会消除经典稳定晚期吸引子。

papers.title: Modified Teukolsky Formalism for Extreme Mass-Ratio Inspirals in Higher-Derivative Gravity
papers.abstract: In this work, we study a model problem involving a point particle spiraling into a non-rotating black hole in higher-derivative theories of gravity. In such theories, both the background spacetime and the generation and propagation of gravitational waves differ from those in General Relativity. We develop a modified Teukolsky formalism to describe gravitational waves sourced by the point particle and, as an illustrative example, compute the resulting fluxes to the black hole horizon and null infinity for a cubic gravity theory. The formalism is constructed in a way that can be naturally extended to rotating black holes. These results represent essential steps to build extreme mass-ratio-inspiral waveforms in modified gravity theories, which may also be rescaled to approximate waveforms from comparable-mass binary black hole systems, analogous to existing approaches in General Relativity.

classification.title_zh: 高导数引力中极端质量比旋近的修正Teukolsky形式
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究一个模型问题：点粒子旋入高导数引力理论中的非旋转黑洞。在这类理论中，背景时空以及引力波的产生和传播都不同于广义相对论。作者发展了修正的Teukolsky形式来描述点粒子源发出的引力波，并以立方引力理论为例计算了到达黑洞视界和零无穷远的通量。该形式可直接推广到旋转黑洞，为在修改引力理论中构建极端质量比旋近波形奠定基础，并可能通过重标度近似同等质量双黑洞波形。
classification.one_liner: 为高导数引力中的极端质量比旋近发展修正Teukolsky形式并计算点粒子源引力波通量。

papers.title: Families of regular spacetimes and energy conditions
papers.abstract: We present a systematic method for constructing static, spherically symmetric regular spacetimes of Kerr-Schild type in general relativity that satisfy the weak energy condition. Our approach relies on physically reasonable assumptions on the matter energy density, together with the boundedness of the Kretschmann scalar. The latter property ensures the finiteness of all curvature invariants and, for the configurations considered, is equivalent to the completeness of causal geodesics. By classifying admissible density profiles according to their complexity, we recover well-known regular black hole solutions such as the Bardeen, Hayward, and Dymnikova models, which are thus naturally embedded in a unified and broader framework. Within this setting, we also derive closed-form expressions for several new families of regular geometries involving hypergeometric or incomplete Gamma functions, which in many cases reduce to elementary functions including algebraic, logarithmic, arctangent, and exponential forms. The emergence of horizons and photon spheres, as well as their observational implications, is also investigated. Finally, we extend the analysis to rotating metrics generated through the Newman-Janis algorithm.

classification.title_zh: 规则时空族与能量条件
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种在广义相对论中系统构造Kerr-Schild型静态球对称规则时空的方法，这些时空满足弱能量条件。该方法基于对物质能量密度的物理合理假设以及Kretschmann标量的有界性；后者保证所有曲率不变量有限，并且对所考虑位形等价于因果测地线完备。通过按复杂度对允许的密度分布分类，我们重新得到Bardeen、Hayward和Dymnikova等已知规则黑洞解，将其自然纳入统一框架。在此框架内，我们还给出若干新规则几何族的闭式表达式，涉及超几何函数或不完全Gamma函数，许多情形可化为代数、对数、反正切和指数等初等函数。还研究了视界和光子球的出现及其观测意义。最后，将分析推广到由Newman-Janis算法生成的旋转度规。
classification.one_liner: 系统构造满足弱能量条件、曲率有限且测地线完备的静态球对称Kerr-Schild规则时空，并给出新解族与旋转推广。

papers.title: Cracking Gravitational Wave Multiple Ringdown Modes in Space
papers.abstract: Ringdown signals from perturbed black holes (BHs) offer a clean window into BH spacetime, strong-field gravity, and fundamental physics. Presently the quasi-normal modes of stellar-mass BH ringdowns have been successfully extracted in the ground-based gravitational wave (GW) observations. Looking ahead, the future space-borne observatories will listen to the ringdowns from massive BH binary coalescences more loudly and resolve multiple modes to unprecedented precision, which calls for efficient approaches to mitigate the sharply increasing computational burden. We develop a practical ringdown analysis pipeline for space-borne detectors by implementing FIREFLY, a novel acceleration algorithm validated in ground-based detectors, and for the first time demonstrate its compatibility and effectiveness with the time-delay interferometry (TDI) observables. With high fidelity, we achieve an over two-order-of-magnitude speedup for a simulated ringdown signal including six modes, providing a viable and scalable route for multi-mode ringdown analysis in the space context. This new approach has sound statistical interpretation and is extensible to other GW sources in band.

classification.title_zh: 在空间探测中解析引力波多重铃宕模式
classification.abstract_zh: 受扰黑洞的铃宕信号为研究黑洞时空、强场引力与基础物理提供了干净窗口。目前，恒星级黑洞铃宕的准正规模已在地基引力波观测中成功提取。未来空间引力波天文台将更响亮地听到大质量黑洞双星并合的铃宕，并以空前精度分辨多个模式，这要求有效缓解急剧增加的计算负担。我们为空间探测器开发了一套实用的铃宕分析流程，采用已在地基探测器中验证过的新型加速算法 FIREFLY，并首次证明其与时间延迟干涉（TDI）观测量的兼容性和有效性。对于包含六个模式的模拟铃宕信号，我们以高保真度实现了超过两个数量级的加速，为空间语境下的多模式铃宕分析提供了可行且可扩展的途径。该新方法具有可靠的统计解释，并可推广到频段内的其他引力波源。
classification.one_liner: 提出面向空间引力波探测器的FIREFLY加速铃宕分析流程，并在TDI观测量上对六模式信号实现两个数量级以上加速。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究黑洞铃宕准正规模与引力波数据分析，属于经典引力/QNM方向；不涉及AdS/CFT、全息字典或量子信息。

papers.title: Hidden symmetry group for particle orbits (timelike geodesics) in Schwarzschild spacetime
papers.abstract: For the timelike geodesic equations in Schwarzschild spacetime, three hidden conserved quantities were found recently, which are analogues of dynamical quantities related to the well-known Laplace--Runge--Lenz (LRL) vector in Newtonian gravity. In particular, the geodesic equations possess an LRL angle, an LRL Killing-vector time and an LRL proper time, each of which is a (piecewise) conserved quantity for all timelike geodesics. The present work provides a natural symmetry interpretation for these three quantities by applying Noether's theorem in reverse to the geodesic Lagrangian. This yields three new (hidden) LRL symmetry transformations. Unlike the Killing symmetries, which constitute point transformations on the geodesic configuration variables and close without the use of the geodesic equations, the new symmetries are dynamical transformations which essentially involve the geodesic momenta variables and close only on solutions of the geodesic equations. The commutator structure of the LRL symmetries is shown to depend on whether a geodesic is bounded or not, and horizon-crossing or not, while their physical meaning is connected to their action on the geodesic energy and angular momentum. Together with the Killing symmetries and re-parameterization symmetries of the geodesics Lagrangian, they generate the complete Noether symmetry group of the timelike geodesic equations.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild时空中粒子轨道（类时测地线）的隐藏对称群
classification.abstract_zh: 最近在Schwarzschild时空的类时测地线方程中发现了三个隐藏守恒量，它们类似于牛顿引力中与Laplace-Runge-Lenz（LRL）矢量相关的动力学量：LRL角、LRL Killing矢量时间和LRL固有时，均为所有类时测地线的（分段）守恒量。本文通过对测地线拉格朗日量反向应用Noether定理，为这三个量提供自然的对称性解释，得到三个新的隐藏LRL对称变换。与Killing对称不同——后者是测地线构型变量上的点变换，且无需使用测地线方程即可闭合——这些新对称是动力学变换，本质上涉及测地线动量变量，并且仅在测地线方程的解上闭合。文章表明LRL对称的对易子结构取决于测地线是否有界以及是否穿越视界，其物理意义与它们对测地线能量和角动量的作用相关。它们与Killing对称及测地线拉格朗日量的重参数化对称一起，生成类时测地线方程的完整Noether对称群。
classification.one_liner: 用Noether定理反向构造Schwarzschild类时测地线的三个隐藏LRL对称变换，并给出其完整Noether对称群。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究Schwarzschild时空中的经典测地线与广义相对论对称性，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线。

papers.title: Strong Lensing and Quasinormal modes of a Black Hole with a Global Monopole
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate various key aspects of a static and spherically symmetric black hole with a global monopole. Firstly, we analyze the deflection angle in the strong field limit of a spacetime with a global monopole. It shows that the angle of deflection increases when the two characteristic parameters for the monopole configuration, $\eta$ and $\lambda$, increase. The influence of the global monopole parameter on the lensing observables and the black hole shadow is studied. This shows that a larger monopole parameter corresponds to larger shadow radii. The dynamics of timelike geodesics is also investigated in the spacetime. General circular orbits and the innermost stable circular orbits (ISCO) of timelike particles are discussed, highlighting that the monopole parameter significantly affects the circular orbits and the ISCO. In particular, it is observed that the radius of ISCO rises monotonically with $\eta$. In addition, the Lyapunov exponent is used to analyze the stability of timelike geodesics. We also determine the quasinormal modes under electromagnetic perturbations for different values of $\eta$. Our findings indicate that increasing the monopole parameter gives rise to electromagnetic perturbations with more slowly damped oscillations. To further validate the derived quasinormal mode spectrum, we discuss the time-domain evolution of the perturbation, confirming the presence of the characteristic quasinormal ringing followed by late-time power-law tails. Finally, comparison with the EHT observations of M87* and Sgr A* determines the parameter combinations of $\eta$ and $\lambda$ compatible with current observations, and the observational prospects of the strong-lensing observables are discussed.

classification.title_zh: 带整体单极子黑洞的强透镜与准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究静态球对称带整体单极子黑洞的强场偏折角、透镜观测量与黑洞阴影，发现单极子参数η和λ增大使偏折角与阴影半径增大；分析类时测地线、圆轨道与ISCO，指出ISCO半径随η单调增大，并用Lyapunov指数讨论稳定性；计算电磁扰动下的QNM，发现η增大使振荡衰减更慢，并通过时域演化验证准正规模振铃与晚期幂律尾；最后用EHT对M87*和Sgr A*的观测限制η与λ组合并讨论强透镜观测量前景。
classification.one_liner: 研究整体单极子黑洞的强透镜、阴影、测地线与电磁QNM，并用EHT观测约束单极子参数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典黑洞时空中的强引力透镜、阴影、测地线、ISCO与电磁扰动QNM，属于经典引力/广义相对论和QNM方向；但不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Prospects for Simultaneously Detecting Long and Short Duration Gravitational Waves from Pulsar Glitches with Current and Future Detectors
papers.abstract: The internal mechanisms that drive the sudden change in rotation frequency in pulsar glitches could emit gravitational waves (GWs) at multiple time scales. The potential for GW analyses to detect both long and short forms of emission ("tCW-like" and "burst-like") improves as the detectors increase in sensitivity. We aim to examine how future detectors fare in making this joint measurement. By examining past glitches from the ATNF catalog, we quantify the double-detectability prospects of current- and next-generation GW detector networks. We further explore what astrophysical constraints could be placed following a double non-detection using extrapolations from the 2024 Vela pulsar glitch as a stand-in example. We find that a network with at least one next-generation detector greatly increases the probability of double-detection for many known glitching pulsars and improves the detection threshold in glitch energy by nearly two orders of magnitude over existing LIGO detectors. Additionally, double non-detections with networks with at least one next-generation detector could place dramatically improved limits on properties of the pulsar.

classification.title_zh: 利用当前和未来探测器同时探测脉冲星自转突变产生的长持续时间与短持续时间引力波的前景
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星自转突变（glitch）中自转频率的突然变化可能由内部机制驱动，并在多个时间尺度上发射引力波。随着探测器灵敏度提高，探测“类连续波”和“类爆发”两种发射的潜力也随之增强。本文旨在考察未来探测器进行这种联合测量的能力。通过分析ATNF星表中的历史glitch事件，我们量化了当前和下一代引力波探测器网络的双探测前景，并以2024年Vela脉冲星glitch的外推作为示例，探讨在双非探测情况下可给出的天体物理限制。我们发现，包含至少一个下一代探测器的网络会显著提高许多已知glitch脉冲星的双探测概率，并将glitch能量探测阈值相对现有LIGO探测器改善近两个数量级。此外，包含至少一个下一代探测器的网络在双非探测时，可对脉冲星性质给出显著改进的限制。
classification.one_liner: 评估当前与下一代引力波探测器网络联合探测脉冲星glitch长短时标引力波及双非探测限制天体物理性质的前景。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于经典引力与引力波观测天体物理，涉及中子星/脉冲星现象，但不涉及全息或其他重点全息支线；与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签相关。

papers.title: Analytic and numerical study of dark matter halos in the Horndeski theory
papers.abstract: The models of modified gravity that can explain the late-time accelerated expansion of the Universe must pass the local tests of gravity, introducing a screening mechanism so that any additional fifth force in gravity is suppressed at stellar scales. Dark matter halos, in contrast, by their extendedness in scale, may exhibit a transition of screening to small scales, providing a probe of modified gravity and the origin of the late-time acceleration. We perform comprehensive studies of dark matter halos with Vainshtein screening in the Horndeski theory. Given that dark matter is cold and a dark matter halo is spherically symmetric, we analytically clarify the conditions for the halo profile under which the Vainshtein screening works effectively. We find that the Vainshtein screening is less effective even within the Vainshtein radius as the profile approaches a core-like structure around the center of a halo, which motivates us to postulate that some features owing to the fifth force can survive during the dynamical evolution of a halo. We numerically examine our postulate by a $N$-body simulation for an isolated halo with the assumption of Newtonian two-body interactions with the spherical external fifth force. We make use of three proxies of the mass through hydrostatic dynamics, the Jeans equation, and gravitational lensing, all of which must be identical in the case of Newtonian gravity as a weak-field approximation to General Relativity. We find that these proxies can be biased relative to each other at a (quasi) equilibrium, quantitatively indicating that the fiducial model of gravity is not Newtonian. Our result affirmatively suggests that multiple mass proxies from observations are capable of testing gravity on halo scales.

classification.title_zh: Horndeski理论中暗物质晕的解析与数值研究
classification.abstract_zh: 能够解释宇宙晚期加速膨胀的修改引力模型必须通过局部引力实验，并引入屏蔽机制以在恒星尺度压制额外的第五力。暗物质晕由于尺度延展，可能在小尺度上出现屏蔽转变，从而成为检验修改引力和晚期加速起源的探针。本文对Horndeski理论中具有Vainshtein屏蔽的暗物质晕进行综合研究。在冷暗物质和球对称暗晕假设下，我们解析澄清了Vainshtein屏蔽有效发挥作用的暗晕轮廓条件。我们发现，当暗晕中心附近的轮廓趋近于核状结构时，即使在Vainshtein半径内，Vainshtein屏蔽也较不有效；这促使我们推测，由第五力导致的一些特征可能在暗晕动力学演化中存活。我们通过对孤立暗晕的N体模拟数值检验该推测，假设牛顿两体相互作用并加上球对称外部第五力。我们使用流体静力学、Jeans方程和引力透镜三种质量代理；在作为广义相对论弱场近似的牛顿引力情形下，它们必须完全相同。我们发现，在（准）平衡时这些代理彼此之间可以存在偏置，定量表明基准引力模型不是牛顿引力。我们的结果肯定地表明，来自观测的多个质量代理能够在暗晕尺度上检验引力。
classification.one_liner: 解析与N体模拟表明，Horndeski理论中Vainshtein屏蔽在核状暗晕中心可能失效，且不同质量代理可产生可观测偏置。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究Horndeski修改引力中暗物质晕的Vainshtein屏蔽、N体模拟和质量代理偏置，属于经典引力/修改引力宇宙学；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Observational Signatures of Kerr Black Hole Lensing
papers.abstract: Gravitational lensing by rotating black holes is modeled, and the null geodesic equations in the strong field regime are integrated numerically. Observational signatures of the black hole spin parameter are identified by comparing image locations and shapes of extended sources at different a values. For the black hole at the center of our galaxy, angular resolutions of the order of hundreds of micro arc seconds are needed to distinguish between the true source position and gravitationally lensed image position. Angular resolution below one micro arc second is needed to determine the spin parameter of the galactic black hole using gravitational lensing.

classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞引力透镜的观测特征
classification.abstract_zh: 本文对旋转黑洞的引力透镜效应进行建模，并在强场区域数值积分零测地线方程。通过比较不同自旋参数 a 下扩展源的像位置和形状，识别黑洞自旋参数的观测特征。对于银河系中心黑洞，区分真实源位置与引力透镜像位置需要约数百微角秒的角分辨率；而利用引力透镜确定该黑洞自旋参数则需要低于一微角秒的角分辨率。
classification.one_liner: 数值研究Kerr黑洞强场引力透镜并评估观测自旋参数所需的角分辨率。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论与黑洞透镜研究，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签，但不涉及全息或其他指定全息支线。

papers.title: Simulating dust collapse: the impact of gauge choices on primordial black hole formation
papers.abstract: We investigate why numerical relativity simulations of dust collapse in a matter-dominated era frequently fail before primordial black hole formation due to numerical limitations and inappropriate gauge choices. Using 3-dimensional fully non-linear simulations of a dust fluid, we detail the advantages of advanced numerical methods and the impact of the lapse and shift evolution equations. The challenge is twofold: 1) conventional lapse slicing evolution equations, highly effective in typical black hole simulations, must be adapted in a cosmological context. We demonstrate how different proposed lapse evolution equations perform, enabling fair comparison, and propose our own. 2) The shift evolution equation's role is to spread out the numerical grid observers for a stable simulation. However, the Gamma-driver evolution fails when confronted with shell-focussing of the dust fluid. We show how the shift damping choice depends on the resolution of the shell-focusing region, suggesting that future work should have spatially varying damping. Our improved gauge choices allow simulations to evolve significantly further and potentially reach black hole formation. The best-performing simulations reach close proximity to a black hole; however, further work on the gauge choice is required for this to be stable.

classification.title_zh: 模拟尘埃坍缩：规范选择对原初黑洞形成的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究物质主导时期尘埃坍缩的数值相对论模拟为何常在原初黑洞形成前因数值限制和不恰当规范选择而失败。利用三维全非线性尘埃流体模拟，我们详述先进数值方法的优势以及 lapse 和 shift 演化方程的影响。挑战有两方面：1）传统 lapse 切片演化方程在典型黑洞模拟中非常有效，但在宇宙学语境中必须调整；我们展示不同提议的 lapse 演化方程的表现，从而进行公平比较，并提出我们自己的方案。2）shift 演化方程的作用是分散数值网格观测者以稳定模拟，但 Gamma-driver 演化在尘埃流体壳层聚焦时失败。我们表明 shift damping 选择依赖于壳层聚焦区域的分辨率，提示未来工作应采用空间变化的 damping。改进的规范选择使模拟能显著推进更远，并有可能达到黑洞形成；表现最好的模拟接近黑洞，但还需进一步研究规范选择才能稳定。
classification.one_liner: 三维数值相对论表明，改进 lapse/shift 规范可让尘埃坍缩模拟更接近原初黑洞形成，但壳层聚焦处仍需空间变化阻尼。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/数值相对论与原初黑洞形成，直接匹配经典引力支线；但不涉及全息、量子信息或其他重点全息子方向。

papers.title: Uniqueness of Static Black Holes in Lovelock Gravity
papers.abstract: Black hole uniqueness is one of the fundamental predictions of general relativity: the spherically symmetric Schwarzschild--Tangherlini spacetime is the unique regular, asymptotically flat, static vacuum black hole solution of Einstein's equations. We show that an analogous result holds perturbatively in Lovelock gravity. Assuming the appropriate positive-mass rigidity statement, any regular, asymptotically flat, static vacuum black hole solution of Lovelock gravity on a generic branch admitting a regular Taylor expansion about general relativity is uniquely determined, at fixed ADM mass, by the corresponding spherically symmetric Lovelock black hole solution. In particular, Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity admits no distinct nonspherical static branch perturbatively connected to Schwarzschild--Tangherlini, and the unique solution is Boulware--Deser. The same recursive mechanism extends to the full Lovelock class. Our result shows that static black hole uniqueness can extend beyond general relativity and is not a property peculiar to the Einstein equations.

classification.title_zh: Lovelock 引力中静态黑洞的唯一性
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞唯一性是广义相对论的基本预言之一：球对称 Schwarzschild–Tangherlini 时空是 Einstein 方程唯一规则、渐近平直、静态真空黑洞解。本文证明 Lovelock 引力中微扰意义下有类似结果。在适当的正质量刚性假设下，任何位于允许关于广义相对论做规则 Taylor 展开的 generic 分支上的规则、渐近平直、静态真空 Lovelock 黑洞解，在固定 ADM 质量下，由相应的球对称 Lovelock 黑洞解唯一确定。特别地，Einstein–Gauss–Bonnet 引力不存在与 Schwarzschild–Tangherlini 微扰连接的非球对称静态分支，唯一解为 Boulware–Deser。同样的递归机制可推广到完整 Lovelock 类。结果表明静态黑洞唯一性可超越广义相对论，并非 Einstein 方程特有。
classification.one_liner: 证明在 Lovelock 引力微扰框架下，静态渐近平直真空黑洞在固定 ADM 质量下由球对称 Lovelock 解唯一确定。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 Lovelock 引力中的静态黑洞唯一性，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Modeling extreme mass-ratio inspirals in astrophysical and dark-matter environments
papers.abstract: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals offer a powerful probe of massive black holes and their environments, but interpreting their signals requires accurate models of orbital dynamics and radiation. Here we bring together advances in black-hole perturbation theory to establish a unified relativistic framework for adiabatic inspirals in perturbative astrophysical environments. Built on the modified Teukolsky formalism, the framework requires neither post-Newtonian nor slow-rotation approximations. As a first application, we calculate the leading cloud-induced corrections to gravitational-wave fluxes and conservative orbital dynamics for circular, equatorial inspirals around a rotating black hole surrounded by a synchronized ultralight scalar cloud, combining these corrections with the previously calculated scalar response. In our fiducial system, a cloud containing $10^{-4}$ of the black-hole mass produces about $-57.3$ radians of orbital dephasing over two years. The phase contributions from gravitational-wave flux corrections and background-induced orbital shifts each exceed the scalar contribution in magnitude and partially cancel, highlighting the need for coupled matter-gravity modeling. Extensible to other environments and modified gravity theories, our framework provides the relativistic inputs needed to assess detection losses and parameter biases, and to probe the nature of black-hole environments with future space-based gravitational-wave observations.

classification.title_zh: 在天体物理与暗物质环境中建模极端质量比旋近
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋近是探测大质量黑洞及其环境的强有力工具，但解读其信号需要准确的轨道动力学与辐射模型。本文汇集黑洞微扰论进展，建立统一相对论框架，用于微扰天体物理环境中的绝热旋近。该框架基于修改的Teukolsky形式，不需要后牛顿近似或慢转近似。作为首个应用，我们计算了围绕被同步超轻标量云包围的旋转黑洞、沿圆轨道赤道面旋近时的领头云致引力波通量修正与保守轨道动力学修正，并将这些修正与先前计算的标量响应结合。在基准系统中，包含黑洞质量10^{-4}的云在两年内产生约-57.3弧度的轨道退相位。引力波通量修正与背景致轨道移动的相位贡献在幅度上各自超过标量贡献，并部分抵消，凸显了耦合物质-引力建模的必要性。该框架可推广到其他环境和修改引力理论，为评估探测损失与参数偏差、以及利用未来空间引力波观测探测黑洞环境本质提供所需的相对论输入。
classification.one_liner: 建立无需后牛顿或慢转近似的修改Teukolsky框架，计算暗物质标量云环境下EMRI轨道与引力波通量修正。

papers.title: Geodesics in Black-Hole Spacetimes: A Qualitative Classification Using Vieta's Formulae
papers.abstract: This monograph classifies the geodesics of the Schwarzschild, Kerr and Schwarzschild-de Sitter black holes without solving for their turning points. In all three spacetimes, the radial and polar motions are governed by polynomials whose coefficients depend only on the constants of motion, and the qualitative behavior of a geodesic is fixed by the pattern of their roots. We read this pattern directly off the coefficients, using Vieta's formulae together with the discriminant, Descartes' rule of signs, and the values of the polynomials at the horizons and at infinity. In Schwarzschild spacetime, the reciprocals of the radial roots of every non-radial geodesic add up to $1/(2M)$, which gives the third root of a bound orbit in closed form and the separatrix $p=6+2e$. In Kerr spacetime, the signs of the coefficients show that no radially bound orbit has $\varepsilon^2\geq1$ and that vortical geodesics, timelike or null, have no radial turning point; a positive discriminant is necessary but not sufficient for bound motion, and Descartes' rule applied at the event horizon gives the exact criterion. Spherical orbits and their stability, the equatorial ISCO and light rings, and the photon shell follow from the same relations. In Schwarzschild-de Sitter spacetime, the timelike radial polynomial is a quintic with exactly one negative root, a bound branch requires $\varepsilon^2+\Lambda L^2/3<1$, and both marginally stable circular orbits lie beyond $6M$. Most of these results are known; the aim is to show that a single, elementary algebraic route leads to all of them. The text is meant for graduate students who have taken a first course in general relativity, and each chapter ends with worked examples.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞时空中的测地线：使用韦达公式的定性分类
classification.abstract_zh: 本专著在不求解转折点的情况下，对 Schwarzschild、Kerr 和 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 黑洞的测地线进行分类。三种时空中径向与极角运动由多项式控制，其系数只依赖运动常数，测地线的定性行为由根的模式决定。作者利用韦达公式、判别式、笛卡尔符号法则以及多项式在视界和无穷远处的取值，直接从系数读出根的模式。文中给出 Schwarzschild 时空中非径向测地线径向根倒数之和为 1/(2M)、束缚轨道第三根的闭式以及分界线 p=6+2e；在 Kerr 时空中讨论径向束缚轨道的条件、涡旋测地线无径向转折点、球轨道稳定性、赤道 ISCO、光环和光子壳；在 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 时空中讨论五次径向多项式、束缚分支条件以及边际稳定圆轨道位于 6M 之外。作者指出多数结果已知，目的是展示一条初等代数路径可统一得到这些结果，面向修过广义相对论入门课程的研究生，每章附有例题。
classification.one_liner: 用韦达公式、判别式和符号法则对 Schwarzschild、Kerr 与 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 黑洞测地线作统一的定性代数分类。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves as a Probe of Multi-Fluid Cosmologies: General Formalism and the Case of Cosmological Stasis
papers.abstract: Scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) provide a powerful probe of the expansion history of the universe prior to the Big Bang. Indeed, the production of such gravity waves depends on the evolution of first-order scalar perturbations within the early universe, while their subsequent propagation depends on the background equation of state. In this paper we extend previous discussions by studying SIGWs in cosmologies containing multiple fluids. As we shall demonstrate, the gravitational-wave signal within such multi-fluid cosmologies is modified in two distinct ways: not only are there new velocity effects which have no single-fluid analogues, but there are also significant alterations to the subsequent redshifting of modes that enter the horizon before the multi-fluid era ends. Thus SIGWs provide a probe of not only the overall expansion rate within such cosmologies, but also their internal multi-fluid composition. As an example, we then consider the case of gravitational waves arising during an epoch of cosmological stasis. During such an epoch, the abundances of energy components with different equations of state remain constant, thereby giving rise to a universe with a constant effective equation of state which nevertheless remains genuinely multi-fluid despite cosmological expansion. Despite their constant equations of state, we find that such stasis cosmologies also give rise to tensor power spectra and present-day gravitational-wave abundances which are significantly different from those expected within a standard radiation-dominated universe.

classification.title_zh: 引力波作为多流体宇宙学的探针：一般形式与宇宙学停滞情形
classification.abstract_zh: 标量诱导引力波可用于探测大爆炸之前宇宙的膨胀历史，其产生依赖早期宇宙一阶标量扰动的演化，传播则依赖背景状态方程。本文将相关讨论推广到包含多种流体的宇宙学，指出多流体宇宙学中的引力波信号会受到两类修正：一是存在单流体情形没有的新速度效应，二是进入视界早于多流体时代结束的模式在后续红移中发生显著改变。因此，标量诱导引力波不仅能探测整体膨胀速率，也能探测多流体组成。作为示例，文章考虑宇宙学停滞时期产生的引力波；该时期不同状态方程能量组分的丰度保持恒定，从而给出恒定的有效状态方程，但宇宙仍是多流体。作者发现，尽管状态方程恒定，这类停滞宇宙学仍产生张量功率谱和今日引力波丰度，且与标准辐射主导宇宙的预期显著不同。
classification.one_liner: 研究多流体宇宙学中标量诱导引力波的产生与红移，并以宇宙学停滞期为例表明其张量谱和今日丰度显著偏离辐射主导情形。

papers.title: LazyTB: Extended LTB-solutions with Multiple Interacting Fluids
papers.abstract: We present a low entry barrier numerical code LazyTB that solves the Einstein equations in the ADM-formulation for a general spherically symmetric problem with an arbitrary number of fluids with user defined equations of state and optional interactions between the fluids mediated by drag-vectors. We present the ADM equations in terms of carefully chosen dimensionless variables that avoid some numerical instabilities by analytic cancellation of potentially diverging terms. We demonstrate the code by applying it to a number of examples including the standard LTB model, a model with radiation and dark matter, a polytropic dark energy model with a non-vanishing sound speed and a model with coupled interacting dark matter and dark energy. We also implement a suite of diagnostic tools, including ray-tracing algorithms, that allow extracting physical observables such as luminosity distances for observers at arbitrary locations from the simulations. The code is built to be easy to extend also beyond the late-universe applications considered in the examples of this paper. LazyTB is available at https://github.com/ollijvaisanen/LazyTB.

classification.title_zh: LazyTB：含多种相互作用流体的扩展 LTB 解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个低使用门槛的数值代码 LazyTB，它在 ADM 表述下求解 Einstein 方程，用于处理具有任意数量流体的广义球对称问题；这些流体具有用户定义的状态方程，并可选地通过 drag-vector 介导相互作用。我们以精心选择的无量纲变量给出 ADM 方程，通过解析消去潜在发散项来避免一些数值不稳定性。我们通过若干示例展示该代码，包括标准 LTB 模型、包含辐射和暗物质的模型、具有非零声速的多方暗能量模型，以及耦合相互作用的暗物质和暗能量模型。我们还实现了一套诊断工具，包括光线追踪算法，使得能够从模拟中提取物理可观测量，例如任意位置观测者对应的光度距离。该代码被设计为易于扩展，也可用于本文示例之外的晚宇宙应用。LazyTB 可在 https://github.com/ollijvaisanen/LazyTB 获取。
classification.one_liner: LazyTB 是一个求解 ADM 形式 Einstein 方程的数值代码，用于具有多种相互作用流体的球对称 LTB/宇宙学模型。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线：在 ADM 形式下数值求解 Einstein 方程并研究球对称多流体 LTB 宇宙学，未涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: The formation of merging black holes via stable mass transfer in massive binary stars
papers.abstract: The vast majority of massive binary systems in the universe is evidently unsuited to produce merging binary black holes. However, several narrow evolutionary paths of isolated massive binaries towards this goal have recently been identified. Due to the high degree of simplification and assumptions applied in previous modelling of these paths, conclusions remained vague so far. For one of these paths, the stable mass transfer channel, we now construct detailed binary evolution models which include internal differential rotation as well as mass and angular momentum transfer between the stars, all the way from the zero-age main sequence to the formation of the black holes, only skipping the rapid late burning stages. This allows us to follow the mass and chemical structure evolution of the mass accreting component, which turns out to have a key influence on the phase of reverse mass transfer, that allows the obtained black hole spins and mass ratios to naturally fall into the regime observed for the gravitational-wave source in the 10--25$M_\odot$ primary black hole mass range. As for this channel, also a large number of progenitor binaries are known, we conclude that it likely contributes to the observed population of gravitational wave sources.

classification.title_zh: 大质量双星中通过稳定质量转移形成并合黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 宇宙中绝大多数大质量双星系统显然不适合产生并合双黑洞。然而，最近已经识别出若干条通向此目标的孤立大质量双星窄演化路径。由于先前对这些路径的建模高度简化并采用假设，结论迄今仍不明确。对于其中一条路径——稳定质量转移通道——我们现在构建了详细的双星演化模型，包括内部较差自转以及恒星之间的质量和角动量转移，从零龄主序一直到黑洞形成，仅跳过快速晚期燃烧阶段。这使我们能够追踪吸积质量组分的质量和化学结构演化；结果表明，该组分对反向质量转移阶段有关键影响，使得所得到的黑洞自旋和质量比自然落入在 10--25M⊙ 主黑洞质量范围内观测到的引力波源区域。对于这一通道，也已知大量祖先双星，因此我们得出结论：它可能对观测到的引力波源族群有贡献。
classification.one_liner: 详细双星演化模型表明，稳定质量转移通道能产生与观测相符的黑洞自旋和质量比，并可能贡献引力波源族群。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究大质量双星稳定质量转移形成并合黑洞及其对引力波源族群的贡献，属于经典引力/引力波相关的天体物理；不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

papers.title: Electrically charged regular black holes in higher dimensions: Maxwellian limit, branch point of the Lagrangian, and thermodynamics
papers.abstract: Electrically charged regular black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics are known to require a double-valued Lagrangian density $L(F)$, with a branch point at the radius where the electromagnetic invariant attains its extremum. We extend the construction of such black holes to an arbitrary number of spacetime dimensions $D\geq4$ and obtain a new family of solutions that unifies the Bardeen and Hayward black holes in a single analytic form, with a single nonlinearity parameter $\gamma$. We show that the Maxwellian weak-field limit is recovered if and only if $\gamma=D-3$, so that the Bardeen and Hayward black holes, which lack this limit in four dimensions, become Maxwellian in five and six dimensions, respectively. The matter sector is written in the dual $P$ framework as a Hamiltonian density $H(P)$ that contains only fixed coupling constants, so that the mass and the charge of the black hole appear as integration constants of a fixed theory; the regular solutions form a one-parameter subfamily in which the mass is tied to the charge. We locate the branch point of $\L(F)$ in closed form and find that it is always hidden inside the event horizon in four dimensions, whereas for $D\geq5$ it emerges from the horizon for near-extremal charges and becomes visible to a distant observer. The null and weak energy conditions are satisfied everywhere, the strong energy condition is violated only inside the horizon, and the dominant energy condition is violated at large distances only for $\gamma>D-3$. Finally, since the theory is fixed, the first law of black hole thermodynamics holds in its standard form; we derive the horizon potential in closed form, the extended first law with the couplings as thermodynamic variables, and the corresponding Smarr formula.

classification.title_zh: 高维带电正则黑洞：麦克斯韦极限、拉格朗日量的支点与热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论与非线性电动力学耦合中，带电正则黑洞已知需要双值拉格朗日密度 L(F)，其支点位于电磁不变量取极值的半径处。我们将此类黑洞构造推广到任意时空维度 D≥4，得到用单个非线性参数 γ 统一 Bardeen 与 Hayward 黑洞的新解析解族。证明当且仅当 γ=D-3 时恢复弱场麦克斯韦极限，因此四维中不具备该极限的 Bardeen/Hayward 黑洞，分别在五维和六维中变为麦克斯韦型。物质部分用对偶 P 框架写成仅含固定耦合常数的哈密顿密度 H(P)，黑洞质量和电荷成为固定理论的积分常数；正则解构成质量与电荷相联系的单参数子族。我们以闭式定位 L(F) 的支点，发现四维中支点总隐藏在事件视界内，而 D≥5 时对于近极端电荷支点可从视界露出并被远处观测者看到。零能量条件与弱能量条件处处满足，强能量条件仅在视界内被破坏，主能量条件仅在 γ>D-3 时于大距离处被破坏。最后，由于理论固定，黑洞热力学第一定律保持标准形式；我们给出闭式的视界势、以耦合为热力学变量的扩展第一定律及相应的 Smarr 公式。
classification.one_liner: 将带电正则黑洞推广到高维，用单一参数统一 Bardeen/Hayward 解并分析麦克斯韦极限、拉格朗日支点与热力学。

papers.title: Quadrupole and quadratic-in-spin effects in quasicircular, spinning, asymmetric binaries
papers.abstract: Next-generation gravitational-wave detectors will require significant improvements in current theoretical waveform models, particularly in the case of asymmetric-mass binaries. Here we provide one such improvement by calculating fully relativistic finite-size effects for small mass ratios -- primarily, fluxes of energy -- including quadratic-in-secondary-spin terms, spin-induced quadrupole terms, and tidally induced quadrupole terms, for quasicircular inspirals of a small companion into a Kerr black hole. We formulate these calculations within a multiscale waveform-generation framework in self-force theory, which could be used, with an energy-balance law we derive, to develop self-contained waveform models for asymmetric binaries involving stars orbiting black holes. Our results could additionally be used to improve other families of waveform models across all mass ratios. We present results both as complete numerical data sets on a Chebyshev grid and as analytical post-Newtonian expansions (to sixth PN order relative to the leading term in each contribution to the flux).

classification.title_zh: 准圆轨道、自旋、非对称双星中的四极矩与自旋二次效应
classification.abstract_zh: 下一代引力波探测器将要求对当前理论波形模型作出显著改进，尤其是在非对称质量双星情形。为此，我们通过计算小质量比下的完全相对论有限尺寸效应——主要是能量通量——提供了一项此类改进，其中包括次天体自旋二次项、自旋诱导四极矩项和潮汐诱导四极矩项，针对一个小伴星沿准圆轨道旋入 Kerr 黑洞的情形。我们在自引力理论的多尺度波形生成框架内进行这些计算；结合我们推导的能量平衡定律，该框架可用于为涉及恒星绕黑洞运动的非对称双星构建自洽的波形模型。我们的结果还可用于改进所有质量比下的其他类型波形模型。我们以 Chebyshev 网格上的完整数值数据集，以及解析后牛顿展开（相对于通量中每一项的领头项到六阶后牛顿阶）的形式给出结果。
classification.one_liner: 计算小质量比非对称双星中自旋二次、自旋诱导四极与潮汐诱导四极的完全相对论能量通量，以改进引力波波形模型。

papers.title: Extended parameterized spin expansion formalism for ringdown analysis with GW250114
papers.abstract: Parameterized descriptions of black-hole quasinormal-mode spectra are essential for testing gravity with ringdown observations. We extend the Parameterized Spin Expansion Coefficients (ParSpec) formalism by simultaneously sampling the characteristic length scale $\tilde{\ell}$ and the scaling index $\tilde{p}$, rather than fixing $\tilde{p}$ to a theory-motivated integer and constraining $\tilde{\ell}$. Physically, this extension promotes the scaling of the spectral corrections coming from higher-curvature operators to an observable quantity. Methodologically, it enables us to investigate the enlarged ParSpec parameter space and identify the prior geometry induced by conditions on the effective coupling $\gamma$. We examine the robustness of the framework by using the $220$ and $220+221$ ringdown models over different start times with informative priors on mass and luminosity for GW250114, and further study a joint constraint with GW231123. We pointed out that $\gamma<1$ avoids an artificial correlation between $\tilde{p}$ and $\tilde{\ell}$ among the coupling prescriptions considered, and the choices of ringdown starting time and QNM mode content in the ParSpec framework should be matched to the information content and resolving power of the data. Higher-SNR ringdowns and hierarchical analyses of a larger event population will be required to break the $\tilde{p}$-$\tilde{\ell}$ degeneracy and directly probe the scaling structure of corrections to GR.

classification.title_zh: 用于 GW250114 铃宕分析的扩展参数化自旋展开形式
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞准正规模谱的参数化描述对于利用铃宕观测检验引力至关重要。我们扩展了参数化自旋展开系数（ParSpec）形式，同时采样特征长度尺度 $\tilde{\ell}$ 和标度指数 $\tilde{p}$，而不是将 $\tilde{p}$ 固定为理论动机的整数并约束 $\tilde{\ell}$。物理上，这一扩展将来自高阶曲率算符的谱修正标度提升为可观测量。方法上，它使我们能够研究扩大的 ParSpec 参数空间，并识别由有效耦合 $\gamma$ 条件所诱导的先验几何。我们使用 220 和 220+221 铃宕模型、不同起始时间，并对 GW250114 的质量和光度采用信息先验，考察该框架的稳健性，还进一步研究了与 GW231123 的联合约束。我们指出，在所考虑的耦合规定中，$\gamma<1$ 可避免 $\tilde{p}$ 与 $\tilde{\ell}$ 之间的人为相关性，并且在 ParSpec 框架中铃宕起始时间和 QNM 模式内容的选择应与数据的信息量和分辨能力相匹配。需要更高信噪比的铃宕和更大事件样本的层级分析来打破 $\tilde{p}$-$\tilde{\ell}$ 简并，并直接探测对 GR 修正的标度结构。
classification.one_liner: 扩展 ParSpec 形式，将高阶曲率修正的标度指数与长度尺度同时作为可观测量，用于 GW250114 铃宕检验引力。

papers.title: Charged black string immersed in a quintessence fluid and string cloud
papers.abstract: We present a new static solution describing a charged black string immersed in a Kiselev-type quintessence fluid and a string cloud. The metric and field equations are solved for a general quintessence state parameter, with explicit results provided for the physically relevant case $w_q = -2/3$. We analyze the event-horizon structure and the Kretschmann scalar, verify energy-condition constraints, and derive thermodynamic properties including the Hawking temperature and heat capacity and the Helmholtz free energy. Finally, we investigate the existence of an exterior photon cylinder for circular null geodesics, finding that, under the parameter assumptions adopted here, no such cylinder occurs outside the outer horizon. The solution generalizes known charged black-string spacetimes by simultaneously including quintessence and a string-cloud parameter.

classification.title_zh: 浸没在精质流体和弦云中的带电黑弦
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个描述浸没在 Kiselev 型精质流体和弦云中的带电黑弦的新静态解。对一般的精质状态参数求解了度规和场方程，并对物理上相关的 w_q = -2/3 情形给出了显式结果。我们分析了事件视界结构和 Kretschmann 标量，检验了能量条件约束，并推导了热力学性质，包括 Hawking 温度、热容和 Helmholtz 自由能。最后，我们研究了圆轨道零测地线的外部光子柱的存在性，发现在这里采用的参数假设下，外视界之外不存在这样的光子柱。该解通过同时包含精质和弦云参数，推广了已知的带电黑弦时空。
classification.one_liner: 构造含 Kiselev 精质与弦云的带电黑弦静态精确解，并分析其视界结构、Kretschmann 标量、能量条件、热力学性质与外部光子柱存在性。

papers.title: Analytical solutions for timelike orbits around Damour-Solodukhin wormholes
papers.abstract: We investigate timelike geodesics around Damour-Solodukhin wormholes, which are Schwarzschild-like geometries characterized by a deformation parameter $\lambda$ that determines the radius of the throat, $r_{\rm th}$. The radial potential admits four roots, including the throat radius itself, allowing the throat to merge with other roots and form double, triple, and quartic degeneracies. Triple-root configurations associated with the throat, in principle, can determine the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO), which provides a potential observational distinction from Schwarzschild black holes. Using the Mino-time parametrization, we derive particle trajectories with closed-form analytical solutions in terms of incomplete elliptic integrals for both bound and unbound motion. Our focus is on the location of double or triple roots at the throat, where the azimuthal angle and coordinate time of orbital motion show logarithmic or power-law divergence as the particle approaches the throat. By contrast, trajectories remain regular when the throat corresponds to a simple root, allowing particles to traverse smoothly between the two asymptotically flat regions. We also derive exact homoclinic solutions associated with the throat and compute the corresponding Lyapunov exponent. In addition, inspiral and plunge trajectories through the throat are analyzed. These results provide analytic insights into the particle dynamics and possible observational signatures of the wormholes.

classification.title_zh: Damour-Solodukhin 虫洞周围类时轨道的解析解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Damour-Solodukhin 虫洞周围的类时测地线，这类虫洞是 Schwarzschild 型几何，由形变参数 λ 刻画，该参数决定喉部半径 r_th。径向势有四个根，其中包括喉部半径本身，使得喉部可以与其他根合并，形成二重、三重和四重简并。与喉部相关的三重根构型原则上可以确定最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO），这提供了与 Schwarzschild 黑洞潜在观测区分。使用 Mino 时间参数化，我们推导了束缚和非束缚运动的粒子轨迹，以不完全椭圆积分的闭式解析解表示。我们关注喉部处二重或三重根的位置，此时当粒子接近喉部时，轨道运动的方位角和坐标时间表现出对数或幂律发散。相反，当喉部对应单根时，轨迹保持正则，允许粒子在两个渐近平坦区域之间平滑穿越。我们还推导了与喉部相关的精确同宿解，并计算了相应的 Lyapunov 指数。此外，分析了穿过喉部的旋近和落入轨迹。这些结果为粒子动力学和虫洞可能的观测特征提供了分析洞见。
classification.one_liner: 本文给出 Damour-Solodukhin 虫洞周围类时测地线的解析解，并分析喉部简并、ISCO、同宿轨道与 Lyapunov 指数。

papers.title: Radial Oscillations of Viscous Stars
papers.abstract: Oscillation modes of neutron stars, a key target for third-generation gravitational wave detectors, encode key information about their constituent nuclear matter. In this work, we study the effect of viscosity on oscillations of cold, polytropic, spherically symmetric neutron stars. We focus on purely radial oscillations and work perturbatively to linear order within two hydrodynamic frameworks: the acausal covariant generalization of the Navier-Stokes equations proposed by Eckart, and the causal generalization formulated by Bemfica, Disconzi, Noronha, and Kovtun (BDNK). We find that viscosity damps the radial modes on millisecond timescales and induces fractional shifts in the oscillation frequency which increase both with the compactness and viscosity of the star, reaching up to the percent level for the fundamental mode with bulk viscosities $\zeta\sim10^{30}\mathrm{g}/\mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$. For more viscous stars, the oscillation frequency decreases, becoming zero (i.e., an overdamped mode) for $\zeta\gtrsim10^{31}\mathrm{g}/\mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$. We also study the linear threshold of gravitational collapse. Consistent with recent analytic results in the zero heat conductivity limit, we find that viscosity in Eckart theory cannot stabilize an unstable inviscid star. We provide numerical evidence that viscosity in BDNK theory is similarly unable to prevent gravitational collapse, but it slightly modifies the threshold of collapse. Overall, our results advance our understanding of the impact of viscosity on the oscillation modes of neutron stars, a key component of viscous asteroseismology with next-generation gravitational wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 黏性恒星的径向振荡
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星的振荡模式是第三代引力波探测器的关键目标，编码了其组成核物质的关键信息。在本工作中，我们研究黏性对冷、多方、球对称中子星振荡的影响。我们聚焦纯径向振荡，并在两个流体力学框架内微扰到线性阶：Eckart提出的Navier-Stokes方程的非因果协变推广，以及Bemfica、Disconzi、Noronha和Kovtun（BDNK）提出的因果推广。我们发现黏性在毫秒时标上阻尼径向模式，并引起振荡频率的分数偏移；该偏移随恒星的紧致度和黏性增加而增大，对于基本模式，当体黏性 ζ∼10^30 g/cm/s 时可达百分之一量级。对于黏性更大的恒星，振荡频率减小，当 ζ≳10^31 g/cm/s 时变为零（即过阻尼模式）。我们还研究了引力坍缩的线性阈值。与最近在零热导率极限下的解析结果一致，我们发现Eckart理论中的黏性无法稳定一个不稳定的无黏恒星。我们提供数值证据表明BDNK理论中的黏性同样无法阻止引力坍缩，但会略微修改坍缩阈值。总体而言，我们的结果推进了对黏性如何影响中子星振荡模式的理解，这是下一代引力波探测器时代黏性星震学的一个关键组成部分。
classification.one_liner: 研究黏性对冷中子星径向振荡的阻尼与频率偏移，并论证Eckart和BDNK框架下黏性不能阻止引力坍缩。

papers.title: Modeling the merger-ringdown of an eccentric test-mass inspiral into a Kerr black hole using the effective-one-body framework
papers.abstract: We characterize and phenomenologically model the merger-ringdown of gravitational waves emitted by a small compact object that plunges and merges into a Kerr black hole from equatorial-eccentric inspirals. The waveforms are generated employing a time-domain Teukolsky code sourced with trajectories computed using the effective-one-body framework. We span values of the Kerr spin $a\in[-0.9, 0.9] $, eccentricity at the last stable orbit (LSO) $ e_{\rm LSO} \in [0,0.9] $, and relativistic anomaly $ \xi_{\rm LSO} \in [0 , 2 \pi]$. We characterize the last peak of the waveform and ringdown features across the parameter space, finding that the eccentricity mainly affects the last peak features, while it has a smaller impact on the ringdown signal. In contrast, the relativistic anomaly measured at the LSO influences the morphology of the last peak in a restricted portion of the parameter space and has no impact on the ringdown part. We perform the analysis for all the spin-weighted spherical harmonic modes normally included in the $\texttt{SEOBNR}$ family of models, $(\ell,m)\in\{ (2,2), (3,3), (4,4), (5,5), (2,1), (3,2), (4,3)\}$. Finally, we introduce a merger-ringdown model for $\texttt{SEOB-TMLE}$, a forthcoming inspiral-merger-ringdown waveform model for eccentric spin-aligned binary black holes in the test-mass limit, whose features can be extended to comparable-mass regimes. The model also accounts for quasinormal mode mixing during the ringdown. It provides a first step toward incorporating the impact of residual eccentricity close to merger into spin-aligned effective-one-body merger-ringdown models for binary black holes.

classification.title_zh: 使用有效单体框架建模偏心试验质量螺旋并入 Kerr 黑洞的并合-铃宕
classification.abstract_zh: 我们表征并唯象建模由一个小致密天体从赤道偏心旋进后俯冲并并入 Kerr 黑洞所发射引力波的并合-铃宕。波形通过时域 Teukolsky 码生成，其源轨迹由有效单体框架计算。我们扫描 Kerr 自旋 a∈[-0.9,0.9]、最后稳定轨道（LSO）处偏心率 e_LSO∈[0,0.9] 和相对论近点角 ξ_LSO∈[0,2π]。我们在参数空间中表征波形的最后一个峰值和铃宕特征，发现偏心率主要影响最后峰值特征，而对铃宕信号影响较小。相比之下，在 LSO 处测量的相对论近点角仅在参数空间的有限部分影响最后峰值的形态，且对铃宕部分没有影响。我们对通常包含在 SEOBNR 模型族中的所有自旋加权球谐模式进行了分析，即 (ℓ,m)∈{(2,2),(3,3),(4,4),(5,5),(2,1),(3,2),(4,3)}。最后，我们为 SEOB-TMLE 引入一个并合-铃宕模型；SEOB-TMLE 是一个即将提出的、用于试验质量极限下偏心自旋对齐双黑洞的旋进-并合-铃宕波形模型，其特征可推广到可比质量区域。该模型还考虑了铃宕期间的准正规模混合。它为将接近并合时的残余偏心率影响纳入自旋对齐的双黑洞有效单体并合-铃宕模型提供了第一步。
classification.one_liner: 用 EOB 轨迹驱动的时域 Teukolsky 模拟表征偏心试验质量并入 Kerr 黑洞的并合-铃宕，并建立含 QNM 混合的 SEOB-TMLE 并合-铃宕模型。

papers.title: Gravitational light deflection and shadows in a warm plasma
papers.abstract: Analytical studies of light bending in a dispersive medium near compact objects, e.g., black holes or neutron stars, are most challenged by a suitable definition of the medium. The most realistic model would be a hot magnetized plasma. In such a medium, however, an analytical description of light rays is very difficult. Therefore, usually an isotropic dispersive medium is assumed in analytical calculations. While it is possible to formulate equations for a general refractive index, which some studies do, most attention in the literature is given to the particular case of a cold, non-magnetized electron-ion plasma. Whereas this model covers many astrophysically relevant situations, there are indications that in some cases the plasma temperature is so high that the approximation of a cold plasma is no longer valid. For this reason, we consider in this paper a warm, non-magnetized electron-ion plasma, where the temperature is not set equal to zero but assumed to be small enough, such that relevant equations can be linearized with respect to it. After discussing the general equations for light rays in such a medium on a general-relativistic spacetime, we specify to the axially symmetric and stationary case which includes the spherically symmetric and static case. In particular, we calculate the influence of a warm plasma on the bending angle. In the spherically symmetric and static case, we also calculate the shadow in a warm plasma. We illustrate the general results with a static (respectively corotating) and an infalling warm plasma on Schwarzschild and Kerr spacetimes.

classification.title_zh: 暖等离子体中的引力光偏折与阴影
classification.abstract_zh: 紧凑天体（如黑洞或中子星）附近色散介质中光线偏折的解析研究，最大困难在于对介质的合适定义。最现实的模型是热磁化等离子体。然而在这种介质中，光线的解析描述非常困难。因此，解析计算通常假设各向同性色散介质。尽管可以为一般折射率写出方程（部分研究如此），文献中最受关注的是冷、非磁化电子-离子等离子体的特殊情况。虽然该模型涵盖许多天体物理相关情形，但有迹象表明在某些情况下等离子体温度高到冷等离子体近似不再成立。为此，本文考虑暖、非磁化电子-离子等离子体，其中温度不设为零，但假设足够小，使得相关方程可关于温度线性化。在讨论广义相对论时空上此类介质中光线的一般方程后，我们具体到轴对称且稳态情形，其中包含球对称且静态情形。特别地，我们计算暖等离子体对偏折角的影响。在球对称且静态情形，我们还计算暖等离子体中的阴影。我们用 Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 时空上的静态（或共转）以及落入暖等离子体来展示一般结果。
classification.one_liner: 研究暖非磁化电子-离子等离子体对广义相对论时空中光线偏折和黑洞阴影的影响，并应用于 Schwarzschild 与 Kerr 时空。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究经典广义相对论中的光线偏折与黑洞阴影，属于用户重点关注的“经典引力/广义相对论”支线。

papers.title: Extracting the Central Sound Speed of Neutron Stars through Intrinsic Stellar Structure Scaling with Reduced Equation-of-State Model Dependence
papers.abstract: Inferring neutron star (NS) core properties remains sensitive to the assumed equation of state (EOS). Using a nonlinear Walecka model with generalized $\omega$-meson self-interactions, we construct six EOS families, each containing $10^3$ samples subject to identical nuclear and astrophysical constraints. Despite satisfying these constraints, the families predict markedly different high-density behavior and core properties; higher-order $\omega$ interactions can also generate interior sound-speed peaks within purely nucleonic matter. To reduce this model dependence, we use the intrinsic and perturbative analysis of the dimensionless Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff equations (IPAD-TOV) to derive an EOS-independent estimator $\Theta(\rm{X},\Psi)$ of the central squared sound speed $s_{\rm c}^2$, where $\rm{X}=P_{\rm c}/\varepsilon_{\rm c}$ is the central EOS-parameter and $\Psi$ characterizes the stellar-mass response to central energy density. For canonical $1.4\,M_\odot$ NSs, $\Theta$ correlates linearly with $s_{\rm c}^2$ across the families ($R^2\approx0.94$-$0.99$). The family-dependent relations converge toward a common optimum: minimizing their dispersion yields $s_{\rm c}^2\approx 0.523\pm0.044$ and $\rm{X}\approx 0.173^{+0.020}_{-0.018}$ for all six families, or $s_{\rm c}^2\approx 0.496\pm0.092$ and $\rm{X}\approx 0.167^{+0.030}_{-0.029}$ when the family without $\omega$ self-interaction is excluded. The corresponding radii are $11.73^{+1.08}_{-0.92}$ and $11.92^{+1.76}_{-1.28}\,\rm km$, respectively, with $95\%$ confidence intervals. A unified scaling fitted to all EOS samples supports both extractions. These results show how common stellar-structure relations can constrain NS core properties with reduced EOS-model dependence, even when existing observations cannot distinguish among the underlying EOS descriptions.

classification.title_zh: 利用内禀星体结构标度与降低状态方程模型依赖提取中子星中心声速
classification.abstract_zh: 推断中子星核心性质仍依赖于所假设的状态方程（EOS）。我们使用带广义 ω 介子自相互作用的非线性 Walecka 模型，构建六个 EOS 家族，每个包含 10^3 个样本，并施加相同的核物理与天体物理约束。尽管满足这些约束，各家族对高密度行为和核心性质的预言差异显著；更高阶 ω 相互作用也能在纯核子物质中产生内部声速峰。为降低这种模型依赖，我们利用无量纲 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程的内禀与微扰分析（IPAD-TOV），推导出与 EOS 无关的中心平方声速 s_c^2 估计量 Θ(X,Ψ)，其中 X=P_c/ε_c 是中心 EOS 参数，Ψ 刻画恒星质量对中心能量密度的响应。对典型 1.4 M⊙ 中子星，Θ 与 s_c^2 在各家族中线性相关（R^2≈0.94–0.99）。家族依赖关系收敛到共同最优：最小化离散度给出全部六个家族的 s_c^2≈0.523±0.044 和 X≈0.173^{+0.020}_{-0.018}，或排除无 ω 自相互作用家族后给出 s_c^2≈0.496±0.092 和 X≈0.167^{+0.030}_{-0.029}。相应半径分别为 11.73^{+1.08}_{-0.92} 和 11.92^{+1.76}_{-1.28} km（95% 置信区间）。对所有 EOS 样本拟合的统一标度支持这两组提取。这些结果表明，即使现有观测无法区分底层 EOS 描述，共同星体结构关系仍能以较低 EOS 模型依赖约束中子星核心性质。
classification.one_liner: 通过 IPAD-TOV 推导出弱模型依赖的中子星中心声速估计量，并给出 1.4 M⊙ 中子星的中心声速与半径约束。

papers.title: Formation of Trapped Surfaces for the Einstein-Euler System
papers.abstract: We prove the formation of trapped surfaces for the Einstein--Euler system in 3+1 dimensions beyond spherical symmetry. We consider smooth characteristic initial data in a short-pulse regime with rapid fluid injection. Starting from initial data containing no trapped surfaces, we obtain two sufficient criteria for trapped surface formation, corresponding to the shear and fluid contributions, respectively. In particular, for the fluid-driven criterion, we impose no positive lower bound on the shear flux. To handle the multiple propagation speeds associated with gravitational waves, sound waves, and fluid transport, our analysis combines three ingredients: a coercive fluid energy current whose null fluxes reflect the unequal velocity components, curvature renormalizations adapted to the matter terms, and weighted geometric estimates controlling derivatives in all spacetime directions. To ensure that fluid injection alone can lead to trapped surface formation, we use particle-number conservation in a designed spacetime region to control the focusing process and obtain the desired sphere-integrated fluxes.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Euler 系统的陷获面形成
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明在 3+1 维中，超越球对称情形，Einstein--Euler 系统的陷获面形成。我们考虑短脉冲区域中的光滑特征初始数据，并带有快速流体注入。从没有陷获面的初始数据出发，我们得到两个陷获面形成的充分判据，分别对应剪切贡献和流体贡献。特别地，对于流体驱动的判据，我们不对剪切通量施加正下界。为了处理与引力波、声波和流体输运相关的多个传播速度，我们的分析结合三个要素：一个强制性流体能量流，其零通量反映不等的速度分量；适应物质项的曲率重整化；以及控制所有时空方向导数的加权几何估计。为确保仅流体注入即可导致陷获面形成，我们在一个设计的时空区域中使用粒子数守恒来控制聚焦过程，并获得所需的球面积分通量。
classification.one_liner: 证明超越球对称的 Einstein-Euler 系统在快速流体注入短脉冲数据下可形成陷获面，并给出剪切与流体驱动的充分判据。
