papers.title: Breakdown of hydrodynamic universality in causal first-order viscous neutron star oscillations
papers.abstract: Hydrodynamic modeling of viscous neutron stars requires a choice of theory of relativistic hydrodynamics. That distinct formulations contain the same physical content in the long-wavelength limit is referred to as ``hydrodynamic universality.'' It has been recently shown that hydrodynamic universality can break down in radial neutron star oscillations: causality and finite-size effects restrict access to the long-wavelength universal hydrodynamic regime in sufficiently viscous stars. We show that this breakdown occurs for a broad range of causal hydrodynamic frames in Bemfica--Disconzi--Noronha--Kovtun (BDNK) theory. Increasing viscosity collectively pushes this class of causal frames away from the BDNK regime of validity, eventually forcing all to lie outside it at bulk viscosities in the range $\zeta\sim10^{30}$--$10^{31}\mathrm{g}/\mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$. This breakdown of universality is accompanied by material changes in the oscillation mode structure: non-hydrodynamic modes become damped on timescales comparable to those of hydrodynamic modes, the first overtone can become longer lived than the fundamental mode, and unphysical instabilities with sub-millisecond timescales can emerge. Even in regimes where universality has broken down, we find that the inviscid threshold of gravitational collapse remains unchanged in BDNK theory. These results provide evidence that first-order theories of relativistic hydrodynamics may be insufficient for modeling sufficiently viscous neutron stars.

classification.title_zh: 因果一阶粘性中子星振荡中流体力学普适性的破坏
classification.abstract_zh: 对粘性中子星进行流体力学建模需要选择一种相对论流体力学理论。不同表述在长波极限下包含相同物理内容，这被称为“流体力学普适性”。最近研究表明，流体力学普适性会在径向中子星振荡中破坏：因果性和有限尺寸效应限制了足够粘性的星体进入长波普适流体力学区域。我们证明，这种破坏在 Bemfica–Disconzi–Noronha–Kovtun (BDNK) 理论中的广泛因果流体力学框架内都会发生。增加粘性会共同将这类因果框架推离 BDNK 的有效性区域，最终在体粘滞系数 ζ ~ 10^30–10^31 g/cm/s 时迫使所有框架都位于其外。这种普适性破坏伴随着振荡模式结构的实质性变化：非流体力学模式在可与流体力学模式相当的时间尺度上被阻尼，第一泛音可以比基模寿命更长，并且可能出现亚毫秒时间尺度的非物理不稳定性。即使在普适性已经破坏的区域，我们发现 BDNK 理论中引力坍缩的无粘阈值保持不变。这些结果提供证据表明，一阶相对论流体力学理论可能不足以模拟足够粘性的中子星。
classification.one_liner: 在 BDNK 因果一阶粘性流体力学中，粘性中子星振荡会破坏流体力学普适性并显著改变模式结构，但无粘引力坍缩阈值不变。

papers.title: Numerical simulations of low-mass black hole-neutron star mergers with moderate eccentricities
papers.abstract: A confident detection of orbital eccentricity in gravitational-wave signals from black hole-neutron star systems would be a strong indicator of their dynamical formation origin. While eccentric waveform models have recently been developed, their validity for analyzing black hole--neutron star signals has yet to be tested against numerical-relativity simulations. Building upon our previous study of quasicircular black hole--neutron star mergers, we perform simulations of a subset of these systems with orbital eccentricities around five times larger than those inferred for GW200105_162426. Additionally, we perform simulations with magnetized matter to assess whether trapped $g$-mode oscillations persist in strongly magnetized disks. Regarding the emitted gravitational-wave signal, we find that the effective one-body waveform model SEOBNRv5EHM shows reasonable agreement unless tidal contributions become important, and the inspiral-only post-Newtonian models pyEFPE/pyEFPEHM show larger disagreement in the late inspiral. For the equal-mass system, which has the largest effective tidal deformability, eccentric tidal corrections have a small but noticeable impact on the phase, $\sim0.1$ rad. We find an almost negligible impact of eccentricity on the properties of the remnant black hole, and differences of up to a factor of two in the remnant disk mass. Trapped $g$ modes in the accretion disks have the same frequency regardless of the eccentricity, confirming that they depend mainly on the properties of the remnant black hole. We find that when accretion disks are strongly magnetized, they become less dense and have less pronounced structure, and that the trapped $g$ modes previously identified in the unmagnetized cases are efficiently damped.

classification.title_zh: 中等偏心率的低质量黑洞-中子星并合数值模拟
classification.abstract_zh: 在黑洞-中子星系统的引力波信号中，若置信地探测到轨道偏心率，将强有力地指示其动力学形成起源。尽管最近已开发出偏心波形模型，但它们用于分析黑洞-中子星信号的有效性尚未通过数值相对论模拟得到检验。在我们此前对准圆黑洞-中子星并合研究的基础上，我们对其中一部分系统进行了模拟，其轨道偏心率约为GW200105_162426推断值的五倍。此外，我们还进行了含磁化物质的模拟，以评估被困g模振荡是否在强磁化吸积盘中持续存在。关于发出的引力波信号，我们发现有效单体波形模型SEOBNRv5EHM表现出合理的一致性，除非潮汐贡献变得重要；而仅旋进的后牛顿模型pyEFPE/pyEFPEHM在旋进后期表现出更大的偏差。对于等质量系统，其有效潮汐形变性最大，偏心潮汐修正对相位有虽小但可注意到的影响，约0.1 rad。我们发现偏心率对残余黑洞性质的影响几乎可以忽略，而残余盘质量差异可达两倍。吸积盘中的被困g模频率与偏心率无关，这证实它们主要取决于残余黑洞的性质。我们发现，当吸积盘被强磁化时，它们变得密度更低、结构更不明显，并且此前在未磁化情形中识别出的被困g模被有效地阻尼。
classification.one_liner: 中等偏心黑洞-中子星并合的数值相对论模拟显示，偏心率对波形和残余黑洞影响有限，但会改变残余盘质量，且强磁场会阻尼吸积盘中的被困g模。

papers.title: Axial gravitational quasinormal modes of magnetically charged black holes
papers.abstract: In this paper, we consider axial perturbations on the magnetically charged string-inspired Euler-Heisenberg black hole. Since axial metric perturbation decouples from axial electromagnetic perturbation, here we mainly focus on axial gravitational perturbation. By using WKB approximation and AIM methods, we make a detailed analysis of the gravitational quasinormal frequencies by varying the characteristic parameters of gravitational perturbation and black holes. It is found these results obtained through the AIM method are in good agreement with those of obtained by WKB method, including these results extracted from the time-domain profiles. The greybody factor is calculated by WKB method. The effects of these parameters $Q_m$, $\epsilon$ and multipole number $l$ on the greybody factor are also studied.

classification.title_zh: 磁荷黑洞的轴向引力准正规模式
classification.abstract_zh: 本文考虑磁荷弦启发Euler-Heisenberg黑洞上的轴向扰动。由于轴向度规扰动与轴向电磁扰动解耦，我们主要关注轴向引力扰动。利用WKB近似和AIM方法，通过改变引力扰动与黑洞的特征参数，详细分析引力准正规频率。发现AIM方法得到的结果与WKB方法以及时域剖面提取的结果吻合良好。用WKB方法计算灰体因子，并研究了参数 Q_m、ε 和多极数 l 对灰体因子的影响。
classification.one_liner: 用WKB和AIM研究磁荷Euler-Heisenberg黑洞的轴向引力准正规模式及灰体因子。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究经典黑洞的引力准正规模式与灰体因子，符合用户重点标签中的QNM与经典引力/广义相对论支线。

papers.title: Displacement-noise-free gravitational-wave detector using quantum tomography of photon orbital angular momentum states
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves (GWs) induce quantum transitions between photon orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) states with amplitudes $\alpha_{\pm}$. Exploiting this effect, we present a displacement-noise-free detection framework that extracts GW information from the OAM Hilbert space. Parametrized quantum state tomography of the GW-induced OAM sidebands enables a single V-shaped detector to resolve all seven wave parameters: the frequency, propagation direction, two polarization amplitudes, and initial phase of each polarization. Direct detection of the sidebands yields a weak signal of approximately $10^{-15}\,\mathrm{W}$. We therefore introduce a stronger reference state $r |0>_{\mathrm{P}}$, with $r=0.01$, to enhance the detected signal. For an arm length of $L=4\,\mathrm{m}$, $N=160$ round trips, a paraxial parameter of $\gamma=0.1$, an incident light power of $P_{\mathrm{BS}}=10\,\mathrm{kW}$, a wavelength of $\lambda_{\mathrm{opt}}=1064\,\mathrm{nm}$, and GW amplitudes of $A=10^{-18}$, we estimate sideband transition amplitudes of $|\alpha_{\pm}|\sim10^{-10}$ and signal powers of order $1\,\mathrm{nW}$, scaling as $P_{\mathrm{BS}}\alpha_{\pm}\propto P_{\mathrm{BS}}ANL\gamma/\lambda_{\mathrm{opt}}$. The shot-noise-limited sensitivity floor is $S^{1/2}_n=1.6\times10^{-20}\,\mathrm{Hz}^{-1/2}$. Because the scheme measures OAM transition amplitudes rather than differential arm lengths, it is intrinsically free from displacement noise and provides a broadband probe of GWs, specifically bridging the $0.1$--$10\,\mathrm{Hz}$ mid-frequency gap.

classification.title_zh: 利用光子轨道角动量态量子层析的无位移噪声引力波探测器
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波会在光子轨道角动量（OAM）态之间诱导量子跃迁，振幅为 α±。利用这一效应，我们提出一种无位移噪声的探测框架，从 OAM 希尔伯特空间提取引力波信息。对引力波诱导的 OAM 边带进行参数化量子态层析，使单个 V 形探测器能够分辨全部七个波参数：频率、传播方向、两个偏振振幅以及每个偏振的初相位。直接探测边带得到的信号约为 10^-15 W。因此引入更强的参考态 r|0>_P（r=0.01）以增强信号。对于臂长 L=4 m、往返次数 N=160、近轴参数 γ=0.1、入射光功率 P_BS=10 kW、波长 λ_opt=1064 nm 以及引力波振幅 A=10^-18，估计边带跃迁振幅 |α±|~10^-10，信号功率约 1 nW，并满足 P_BS α± ∝ P_BS A N L γ/λ_opt。散粒噪声极限灵敏度底为 S_n^{1/2}=1.6×10^-20 Hz^-1/2。由于该方案测量 OAM 跃迁振幅而非差分臂长，它本质上不受位移噪声影响，并提供宽带的引力波探测，尤其可衔接 0.1–10 Hz 中频间隙。
classification.one_liner: 提出利用光子 OAM 态量子层析实现无位移噪声、宽带（尤其 0.1–10 Hz）引力波探测的方案。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波探测与经典引力/广义相对论相关方向，使用量子光学与 OAM 态层析，但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Optimal Strategies for Gravitational-Wave Memory Detection with Noise Marginalization in Pulsar Timing Arrays
papers.abstract: Current pulsar timing arrays could detect gravitational wave memory, which would provide a unique test of general relativity. In order to optimize our searches for gravitational wave memory in pulsar timing arrays, we integrate the optimal frequentist statistics for GW memory into the \texttt{enterprise} code suite. We additionally test a noise marginalized version of this statistic, and compare it's effectiveness to the simpler maximum posterior method. We perform these tests on simulated pulsar timing array with red and white noise content, as well as the NANOGrav $15$-year data set. We find no significant variations in our detection statistics between the noise-marginalized and the maximum-posterior methods for the simulated datasets, and only small variations in the NANOGrav $15$-year comparisons. We conclude that for realistic PTAs the noise-marginalization method could be useful for assigning a false alarm probability to Bayesian results, though the maximum posterior method is sufficient for identifying potentially detectable signals.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列中带噪声边缘化的引力波记忆探测最优策略
classification.abstract_zh: 当前脉冲星计时阵列可能探测到引力波记忆，这将为广义相对论提供独特检验。为了优化脉冲星计时阵列中引力波记忆的搜索，我们将引力波记忆的最优频率派统计量集成到 enterprise 代码套件中。我们还测试了该统计量的噪声边缘化版本，并将其有效性更简单的最大后验方法进行比较。我们在包含红噪声和白噪声的模拟脉冲星计时阵列以及 NANOGrav 15 年数据集上进行这些测试。我们发现，对于模拟数据集，噪声边缘化方法和最大后验方法之间的探测统计量没有显著变化，而在 NANOGrav 15 年比较中仅有小变化。我们得出结论，对于现实的脉冲星计时阵列，噪声边缘化方法可能有助于为贝叶斯结果分配误报概率，尽管最大后验方法足以识别可能可探测的信号。
classification.one_liner: 将引力波记忆的最优频率派统计量集成到 enterprise，并比较噪声边缘化与最大后验方法在模拟 PTA 和 NANOGrav 15 年数据中的表现。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究脉冲星计时阵列中引力波记忆的探测统计与噪声边缘化，属于广义相对论检验和经典引力波数据分析，对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes with NUT charge
papers.abstract: We construct an exact NUT-charged generalization of the Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole in the Einstein-phantom-scalar system. The solution is stationary, asymptotically locally flat at both ends and free of curvature singularities. It inherits characteristic features of the Taub-NUT geometry, including the Dirac-Misner string and closed timelike curves, while the absence of Killing horizons eliminates the horizon-induced infinite winding of geodesics and renders the spacetime geodesically complete. By allowing the phantom field to have a nontrivial scalar potential with an infinite sequence of AdS vacua, we also obtain an exact asymptotically locally AdS wormhole with a NUT charge, which interpolates between different vacua at its two asymptotic ends. Using the covariant phase space formalism, we show that the Hamiltonian charges associated with the two asymptotic regions are finite under appropriate scalar boundary conditions. By performing a double Wick rotation to Euclidean signature, we demonstrate that the conformal class of the resulting metric admits an ambi-K\"ahler structure.

classification.title_zh: 带 NUT 荷的 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 Einstein-phantom-scalar 系统中构造了 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞的精确 NUT 荷推广。该解是稳态的，两端渐近局部平坦，且无曲率奇点。它继承了 Taub-NUT 几何的特征，包括 Dirac-Misner 弦和闭合类时曲线，而没有 Killing 视界消除了视界导致的测地线无限缠绕，并使时空测地完备。通过允许 phantom 场具有带无限序列 AdS 真空的非平凡标量势，我们还获得了一个带 NUT 荷的精确渐近局部 AdS 虫洞，其在两端渐近区域之间插值不同真空。利用协变相空间形式，我们证明在适当的标量边界条件下，与两个渐近区域相关的哈密顿荷是有限的。通过双 Wick 旋转到欧几里得号差，我们证明所得度规的共形类具有 ambi-Kähler 结构。
classification.one_liner: 构造了带 NUT 荷的 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞精确解，包括渐近局部平坦和渐近局部 AdS 情形，并分析其因果/测地性质、守恒荷与欧几里得 ambi-Kähler 结构。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的精确解研究，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但主题不是 AdS/CFT 全息、量子信息或量子引力，因此对全息主线相关性中等。

papers.title: Polyakov backreaction in large D discretely self-similar collapse
papers.abstract: We study anomaly-induced semiclassical backreaction on an analytic family of discretely self-similar solutions of Einstein--Klein--Gordon theory at large spacetime dimension. Horizon regularity fixes a null-coordinate Floquet exponent and selects a unique regular quantum state. The Polyakov auxiliary field is affine-periodic rather than periodic, with a monodromy that is determined independently by a global zero-mode condition and by the conformal-coordinate scaling. Spherical reduction introduces a quantum coupling that grows toward the center, so the periodic first-order expansion is nonuniform. We construct the resulting nonlinear inner problem and find a critical dilaton surface. Generic crossings of this surface are singular, whereas matching to the regular zero-mass exterior selects a narrow, high-curvature throat. The anomaly also separates the effective null-energy boundaries from the classical matter flux and zero-curvature curves. These results show that the minimally coupled Polyakov model does not yield a generic smooth, exactly self-similar completion of the classical center.

classification.title_zh: 大 D 离散自相似坍缩中的 Polyakov 反作用
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在大时空维度下，Einstein--Klein--Gordon 理论的一类离散自相似解析解上由反常诱导的半经典反作用。视界正则性固定了一个零坐标 Floquet 指数，并选出一个唯一的正则量子态。Polyakov 辅助场是仿射周期的而非周期的，其单值性由一个整体零模条件以及共形坐标标度独立确定。球对称约化引入的量子耦合向中心增长，因此周期一阶展开是非均匀的。我们构造由此产生的非线性内部问题，并找到一个临界伸缩子面。对该面的一般穿越是奇异的，而将其与正则零质量外部匹配则选出一个狭窄的高曲率喉。反常还使有效零能边界与经典物质流及零曲率曲线分离。这些结果表明，最小耦合 Polyakov 模型不能给出经典中心的一般光滑且精确自相似的补全。
classification.one_liner: 在大 D 下，最小耦合 Polyakov 反作用无法为离散自相似坍缩的经典中心提供一般光滑的精确自相似补全。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究大 D 下 Einstein-Klein-Gordon 离散自相似坍缩与半经典 Polyakov 反作用，涉及黑洞坍缩的临界/非线性内区问题，与用户标注的经典引力方向直接相关。

papers.title: Constants of motion and fundamental frequencies for elliptic orbits at fourth post-Newtonian order: aligned-spin contributions
papers.abstract: For eccentric systems with aligned spins, we compute all spin contributions to the gauge-invariant conservative map between the constants of motion (energy and angular momentum) and the fundamental (radial and azimuthal) frequencies at the fourth post-Newtonian order. This extends the nonspinning map derived in [arXiv:2511.10735] to include terms that are linear, quadratic, cubic, and quartic in spin, as well as the associated spin-deformability parameters. We also obtain derived quantities such as the redshift and gyroscopic invariants, as well as circular links. We notice that the Blanchet-Iyer-Favata post-Newtonian stability criterion that determines the dimensionless frequency of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) is in fact intricately related to the periastron advance for circular orbits. Finally, in the case of unbound orbits, we complete the 4PN scattering angle with all spin contributions.

classification.title_zh: 四阶后牛顿阶椭圆轨道的运动常数与基本频率：对齐自旋贡献
classification.abstract_zh: 对于具有对齐自旋的偏心系统，我们计算了运动常数（能量和角动量）与基本（径向和方位角）频率之间规范不变的保守映射在四阶后牛顿阶的所有自旋贡献。这将 [arXiv:2511.10735] 中得到的无自旋映射扩展为包含自旋线性、二次、三次和四次项，以及相关的自旋形变参数。我们还得到了红移和陀螺不变量等派生量，以及圆轨道关系。我们注意到，决定最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）无量纲频率的 Blanchet-Iyer-Favata 后牛顿稳定性判据实际上与圆轨道的近星点进动密切相关。最后，对于非束缚轨道，我们用所有自旋贡献补全了 4PN 散射角。
classification.one_liner: 计算了对齐自旋偏心双星在 4PN 阶运动常数与基本频率之间的自旋修正映射，并关联 ISCO 稳定性与近星点进动，补全 4PN 散射角。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究后牛顿双星轨道动力学、ISCO 与散射角等经典引力现象，直接对应‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签；不涉及全息、量子引力或量子信息。

papers.title: ACT stands for Awkward Cosmology Theories
papers.abstract: Recent Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) observations, combined with Planck, favor a scalar spectral index in tension with Starobinsky inflation. Two main strategies have been proposed to reconcile Starobinsky inflation with these data: (i) including higher-curvature operators in the gravitational action, and (ii) modifying the post-inflationary reheating dynamics. We critically re-examine both approaches. When higher-curvature corrections are included, dimensional-analysis arguments allow introducing a second mass scale suppressing higher-dimensional operators, resulting in a one-coupling, two-scale effective theory. We show that fitting the ACT data drives this class of effective theories toward a regime of stronger sensitivity to UV physics, potentially implying fine-tuning of the inflationary observables. We illustrate our general point with two concrete models, namely no-scale supergravity and metric-affine gravity, showing that they provide different realizations of the same underlying $f(R)$ theory. On the reheating side, requiring the CMB modes to re-enter the horizon before recombination leads to stringent constraints on the reheating equation of state, and fitting the ACT data favors an exotic reheating phase with $\omega_{\rm reh} > 1/3$, incompatible with inflaton oscillations about the minimum of the standard Starobinsky potential. Finally, we explore the possibility that a phase of cosmological stasis, driven by a tower of decaying massive states, could play the role of the post-inflationary epoch. We find that accommodating ACT-preferred $n_s$ in this setup requires a tower of states with negative energy density. Taken together, our results suggest that reconciling Starobinsky inflation with the ACT data demands ingredients that are challenging to motivate from the perspective of UV-complete theories, undermining the minimality of the original Starobinsky model.

classification.title_zh: ACT 代表尴尬的宇宙学理论
classification.abstract_zh: 最近的阿塔卡马宇宙学望远镜（ACT）观测与普朗克数据结合，倾向于一个与 Starobinsky 暴胀相冲突的标量谱指数。为调和 Starobinsky 暴胀与这些数据，已提出两种主要策略：(i) 在引力作用量中引入高阶曲率算符；(ii) 修改暴胀后的再加热动力学。我们批判性地重新审视这两种方法。当包含高阶曲率修正时，量纲分析论证允许引入第二个质量标度来压低高维算符，从而得到一个单耦合、双标度的有效理论。我们表明，拟合 ACT 数据会将这类有效理论推向对紫外物理更敏感的区域，可能意味着对暴胀可观测量的精细调节。我们用两个具体模型——无标度超引力和度规-仿射引力——来说明这一普遍观点，表明它们提供了同一底层 f(R) 理论的不同实现。在再加热方面，要求 CMB 模式在复合之前重新进入视界，会对再加热状态方程产生严格约束，而拟合 ACT 数据倾向于一种奇异的再加热相，其 ω_reh > 1/3，这与暴胀子在标准 Starobinsky 势最小值附近的振荡不相容。最后，我们探索了由一系列衰变的大质量态驱动的宇宙停滞相，能否扮演暴胀后时期的角色。我们发现，在这种设置中容纳 ACT 偏好的 n_s 需要存在负能量密度的态塔。综上所述，我们的结果表明，将 Starobinsky 暴胀与 ACT 数据相协调所需的要素，从紫外完备理论的角度来看难以得到动机，从而削弱了原始 Starobinsky 模型的最小性。
classification.one_liner: 批判性审视调和 Starobinsky 暴胀与 ACT 数据的方案，指出高阶曲率修正和再加热修改均需引入难以从紫外完备理论中激发的要素。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于宇宙学与修改引力领域，与经典引力/广义相对论支线相关，但不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: New Massless Spectra from Cosmic String Cusps
papers.abstract: In the standard picture of cosmic strings, cusps are generic features of Nambu-Goto loops where the string momentarily reaches the speed of light. They have a characteristic sharp profile, following $y \sim x^{2/3}$ in the $(x,y)$ plane, and produce strong gravitational-wave (GW) bursts with waveform $\tilde\kappa(\omega) \propto \omega^{-4/3}$, making them key targets for GW searches. However, under certain conditions, this generic picture can differ. We identify novel cusp solutions with different, including smooth, shapes, and compute their massless GW and axion spectra. We derive a general expression for all possible Nambu-Goto cusp spectra with the asymptotic form $\tilde\kappa(\omega) \propto \omega^{-n/(2n-1)} \omega^{-m/(2m-1)}$ where $n, m\geq 2$. We calculate the effect on the waveform of realistic corrections to the Nambu-Goto description, such as those from backreaction and finite string width, which introduce a high frequency cutoff.

classification.title_zh: 来自宇宙弦尖点的新无质量谱
classification.abstract_zh: 在宇宙弦的标准图像中，尖点是 Nambu-Goto 环的普遍特征，此时弦瞬时达到光速。它们具有特征性的尖锐轮廓，在 (x,y) 平面中遵循 y ∼ x^{2/3}，并产生强引力波暴，波形为 κ̃(ω) ∝ ω^{-4/3}，使其成为引力波搜寻的关键目标。然而，在某些条件下，这一普遍图像会有所不同。我们识别出具有不同形状（包括光滑形状）的新尖点解，并计算其无质量引力波和轴子谱。我们推导出所有可能的 Nambu-Goto 尖点谱的通用表达式，其渐近形式为 κ̃(ω) ∝ ω^{-n/(2n-1)} ω^{-m/(2m-1)}，其中 n,m≥2。我们计算了 Nambu-Goto 描述的现实修正（例如反作用和有限弦宽带来的修正）对波形的影响，这些修正引入高频截断。
classification.one_liner: 识别出非标准宇宙弦尖点解，并给出其引力波/轴子谱及高频截断效应。

papers.title: Einstein-Cartan and Palatini-Cartan Gravity from Graded Poisson Geometry
papers.abstract: Using notions from graded Poisson geometry, we develop a framework that allows for concise formulations of field theories such as Einstein-Cartan and Palatini-Cartan gravity. We show that Einstein-Cartan gravity is equivalent to a variant of Palatini-Cartan gravity in which the vielbein fields are constrained to satisfy appropriate symmetry relations, which we refer to as constrained vielbein gravity. To that end, we relate these theories via a diffeomorphism of graded manifolds. We then show how to obtain the full Palatini-Cartan theory by removing the symmetry constraint. Finally, we show how our graded geometric framework allows for a direct incorporation of the minimal BV extension of the graded constrained vielbein and Palatini-Cartan theories.

classification.title_zh: 从分次泊松几何看 Einstein-Cartan 和 Palatini-Cartan 引力
classification.abstract_zh: 使用分次泊松几何中的概念，我们发展了一个框架，能够简洁地表述 Einstein-Cartan 和 Palatini-Cartan 引力等场论。我们证明 Einstein-Cartan 引力等价于 Palatini-Cartan 引力的一种变体，其中 vielbein 场被约束满足适当的对称关系，我们称之为约束 vielbein 引力。为此，我们通过分次流形的微分同胚将这些理论联系起来。然后，我们展示如何通过移除对称约束得到完整的 Palatini-Cartan 理论。最后，我们展示我们的分次几何框架如何直接纳入分次约束 vielbein 和 Palatini-Cartan 理论的最小 BV 扩展。
classification.one_liner: 借助分次泊松几何，Einstein-Cartan 引力可视为受对称约束的 Palatini-Cartan 理论，并可自然地纳入最小 BV 扩展。

papers.title: Generalised entanglement wedges in three dimensions
papers.abstract: Generalized entanglement wedges (GWs), proposed by Bousso and Penington for gravitating regions in general spacetimes, share many properties of ordinary entanglement wedges, including nesting, monotonicity and strong subadditivity of their generalized entropies. In AdS/CFT, the corresponding properties of entanglement wedges are consequences of the structure of the dual CFT. In this paper we ask whether the properties of GWs have a similar origin. We explore this question in vacuum AdS$_3$ at leading order in $G$. We first show that every GW on a static slice is a union of geodesically convex regions. Each such region is an intersection of ordinary entanglement wedges, so every GW is built from unions and intersections of entanglement wedges. We then use the Crofton formula of integral geometry to write the perimeter of a convex region as the measure of the set of geodesics that intersect it. In AdS$_3$ every geodesic is the Ryu--Takayanagi surface of a boundary interval, so this measure can be written in terms of the von Neumann entropies of CFT intervals. Strong subadditivity of the CFT entropy guarantees that the measure is positive. Monotonicity and strong subadditivity of GWs then follow from simple inequalities between sets of geodesics. The strong subadditivity of GWs is therefore a direct consequence of strong subadditivity on the boundary. Our results further suggest that GWs correspond to subsystems of the CFT that are more general than boundary subregions.

classification.title_zh: 三维中的广义纠缠楔
classification.abstract_zh: 由 Bousso 和 Penington 提出的广义纠缠楔（GWs）用于一般时空中的引力区域，具有普通纠缠楔的许多性质，包括嵌套、单调性以及其广义熵的强次可加性。在 AdS/CFT 中，纠缠楔的相应性质是对偶 CFT 结构的结果。本文追问 GWs 的性质是否也有类似起源，并在真空 AdS3 中于 G 领头阶展开探讨。我们首先证明，静态切片上的每个 GW 都是测地凸区域的并集；每个这样的区域是普通纠缠楔的交集，因此每个 GW 都由纠缠楔的并与交构成。随后利用积分几何的 Crofton 公式，将凸区域的周长写成与其相交的测地线集合的测度。在 AdS3 中，每条测地线都是某个边界区间的 Ryu-Takayanagi 面，因此该测度可用 CFT 区间的 von Neumann 熵表示。CFT 熵的强次可加性保证该测度为正，而 GWs 的单调性和强次可加性则可由测地线集合之间的简单不等式推出。因此，GWs 的强次可加性是边界强次可加性的直接结果。结果进一步表明，GWs 对应于比边界子区域更一般的 CFT 子系统。
classification.one_liner: 在真空 AdS3 中用积分几何与 CFT 强次可加性证明，广义纠缠楔的单调性和强次可加性源于边界 CFT 的熵性质。

papers.title: Effective Field Theory for Holographic Compact Objects
papers.abstract: We study heavy-heavy-light-light correlators in holographic CFTs when the heavy operator is dual to a compact object localized on scales much smaller than the AdS radius. In the long-wavelength regime, the internal structure of the heavy state is described by a worldline effective field theory, whose local operators encode finite-size response coefficients such as tidal Love numbers. Focusing on weakly self-gravitating objects, we show that the Witten diagrams generated by local heavy-light interactions reorganize into the Born series of an effective wave equation for the light bulk field. We reproduce the same correlator by solving this wave equation with localized interactions and identify how the worldline Wilson coefficients are encoded in the CFT data. Our results provide a direct relation between the finite-size response of compact objects in AdS and the dimensions and OPE coefficients of heavy-light and light-light composite operators in the dual CFT.

classification.title_zh: 全息紧致天体的有效场论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究全息 CFT 中的重-重-轻-轻关联函数，其中重算符对偶于一个局域在远小于 AdS 半径尺度上的紧致天体。在长波区域，重态的内部结构由世界线有效场论描述，其局域算符编码了诸如潮汐 Love 数这样的有限尺寸响应系数。针对弱自引力天体，我们表明由局域重-轻相互作用生成的 Witten 图会重组为轻体场有效波动方程的 Born 级数。我们通过求解带有局域相互作用的该波动方程复现同一关联函数，并确定世界线 Wilson 系数如何编码在 CFT 数据中。我们的结果为 AdS 中紧致天体的有限尺寸响应与对偶 CFT 中重-轻和轻-轻复合算符的维度及 OPE 系数之间提供了直接联系。
classification.one_liner: 通过世界线有效场论与 Witten 图，将 AdS 中紧致天体的有限尺寸响应（如潮汐 Love 数）与对偶 CFT 的算符维度和 OPE 系数联系起来。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 字典与全息紧致天体 EFT，涉及经典引力中的有限尺寸/潮汐响应；与所列全息凝聚态、超流、相变、QNM 等支线无直接关联，但与经典引力/广义相对论支线有交集。

papers.title: Spread Complexity for Local Operator Quenches with Conserved Momentum
papers.abstract: We study a family of locally excited states in two-dimensional conformal field theories in different setups, defined on the plane, on the cylinder, or at finite temperature. These states are constructed by assigning independent chiral and anti-chiral regulators to a local primary operator, leading to excitations carrying net momentum. We analytically calculate the first few Lanczos coefficients and the early time behaviour of the spread complexity associated with these states. Then, using numerical methods, we obtain the coefficients reaching larger Krylov indices and find the associated spread complexity for a longer range of time evolution. We also compare the rate of change of the resulting spread complexity with the proposed holographic dual quantity, related to the proper momentum of an infalling particle in the dual bulk, but we observe a mismatch.

classification.title_zh: 带守恒动量的局部算符淬火中的传播复杂度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了二维共形场论中不同设置下的一类局部激发态，分别定义在平面、柱面或有限温度下。这些态通过给局部 primary 算符分别指定独立的手征和反手征调节子来构造，从而产生携带净动量的激发。我们解析计算了与这些态相关的传播复杂度的前几个 Lanczos 系数和早期时间行为。随后，使用数值方法，我们得到了达到更大 Krylov 指数的系数，并求出更长时间演化范围内的相应传播复杂度。我们还把所得传播复杂度的变化率与所提出的全息对偶量进行比较，该量与被困在体中的下落粒子的固有动量有关，但观察到不匹配。
classification.one_liner: 在二维 CFT 中计算带净动量的局部激发态的 Lanczos 系数与传播复杂度，并发现其变化率与全息对偶量的预期不匹配。
classification.relevance_reason: 与全息复杂度/量子信息相关，但重点是二维 CFT 中的局部淬火计算，且不与所列重点标签直接对应。

papers.title: Gram--Wishart--Stiefel formulation of the $N=2$, large--$d$ gauge theory in 1D: towards emergent Grassmannian geometry
papers.abstract: We develop the Gram/Wishart/Stiefel formulation of the \(N=2\), large--\(d\) planar endpoint theory of lattice BFSS/BMN matrix quantum mechanics on the lattice. The endpoint variables become rank--two Wishart eigenvalues and relative Stiefel angles, expressing the holonomy invariants \(A\), \(B\), and \(R^2=A^2+B^2\) in radial and angular Gram data. The large-\(R\) aligned contribution \(-A\) is absorbed into the Gaussian sector, producing the shifted mass \((\alpha_\Lambda)_{\rm eff}=\alpha_\Lambda-1/2\). The exact \(O(2)\) angular integral encodes this sector in a rank--two Bessel kernel. The pure \(-A\) theory, exactly solvable in Cartesian variables, fixes the leading Bessel/HCIZ structure: its exponential selects alignment, while its prefactor removes the spurious doubled Wishart entropy. We then apply this structure to the transverse \(B\)-type expansion and its non-polynomial toy completion. Finite polynomial truncations lead to an apparent large--\(d\) perturbativity bound incompatible with the continuum limit, but this bound is shown to be an artifact of truncation. After summing the local transverse completion and balancing the compensating \(+A\) term, the Wishart saddle is recovered with the physical shifted mass. The resulting continuum behavior reproduces the universal \(-2d\) contribution of the \(D_\Lambda\)-channel, while the genuinely anisotropic \(\beta_\Lambda\)-channel lies outside the scope of a pure transverse \(B\)-type description. Finally, we outline the emergent Grassmannian geometry encoded by the two endpoint planes. Their relative angular fluctuations form a \(2(d-2)\)-dimensional sector, whose entropy interpretation is developed in the sequel. For \(d\ge4\), the two planes generically span a relational four-dimensional subspace of \(\mathbb R^d\).

classification.title_zh: 1D 中 N=2、大 d 规范理论的 Gram–Wishart–Stiefel 表述：走向涌现 Grassmann 几何
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为格点上 BFSS/BMN 矩阵量子力学的 N=2、大 d 平面端点理论发展了 Gram/Wishart/Stiefel 表述。端点变量变成秩二 Wishart 本征值和相对 Stiefel 角，用径向与角向 Gram 数据表达 holonomy 不变量 A、B 和 R^2=A^2+B^2。大 R 对齐贡献 -A 被吸收进高斯扇区，产生移位质量 (α_Λ)_eff=α_Λ-1/2。精确的 O(2) 角积分将该扇区编码为秩二 Bessel 核。纯 -A 理论在笛卡尔变量中精确可解，确定了领头 Bessel/HCIZ 结构：其指数选择对齐，而其前因子去除了虚假的双重 Wishart 熵。随后我们将此结构应用于横向 B 型展开及其非多项式玩具补全。有限多项式截断导致一个表观的大 d 微扰性界限，与连续极限不相容，但该界限被证明是截断的假象。在对局部横向补全求和并平衡补偿性 +A 项后，Wishart 鞍点以物理移位质量被恢复。所得连续行为重现了 D_Λ 通道的普适 -2d 贡献，而真正各向异性的 β_Λ 通道超出纯横向 B 型描述的范围。最后，我们概述了由两个端点平面编码的涌现 Grassmann 几何。它们的相对角度涨落形成一个 2(d-2) 维扇区，其熵解释将在后续文章中展开。对于 d≥4，这两个平面一般张成 R^d 中一个关系性的四维子空间。
classification.one_liner: 在格点上发展 BFSS/BMN 矩阵量子力学的 N=2 大 d 端点理论的 Gram/Wishart/Stiefel 表述，并用 Wishart 鞍点与 Bessel/HCIZ 核刻画端点及涌现 Grassmann 几何。

papers.title: Inner Horizon Saddles and a Spectral KSW Criterion
papers.abstract: The Bekenstein-Hawking entropy formula $\rho = e^{A/4G}$ receives significant corrections for charged black holes near extremality. Using standard results in JT gravity, the correction term can semiclassically be expressed as minus the exponential of the inner horizon area, $e^{A_{\text{inner}}/4G}$, and the cancellation between these two exponentials enforces a vanishing density of states towards extremality, when the two horizons collide. Building on arXiv:2402.10162, we argue that the correction term corresponds to a complex saddle geometry of the bulk gravitational path integral. The proposed geometry has a negative boundary length and caps off at the inner horizon; we refer to it as the inner horizon saddle. We discuss how the saddle, and its accompanying minus sign, contribute to the density of states through a Picard-Lefschetz analysis of the inverse Laplace contour, together with a stability analysis of the saddle. We also address the inner horizon saddle's violation of the Kontsevich-Segal-Witten (KSW) allowability criterion for the inclusion of complex metrics. Despite this violation, which is believed to cause unphysical divergences in path integral computations, one can describe one-loop effects on the inner horizon saddle by carefully treating wrong-sign modes. Motivated by this observation, we propose a weaker version of the KSW criterion, which we call the spectral KSW criterion. Its purpose is to characterize when one-loop corrections around complex gravitational saddles are well defined.

classification.title_zh: 内视界鞍点与谱 KSW 判据
classification.abstract_zh: Bekenstein-Hawking 熵公式 $\rho = e^{A/4G}$ 对近极端带电黑洞会收到显著修正。利用 JT 引力中的标准结果，该修正项可在半经典意义下表示为内视界面积指数的负值，即 $-e^{A_{\text{inner}}/4G}$，而这两个指数项之间的抵消使得当两个视界碰撞时，趋近极端极限的态密度趋于零。基于 arXiv:2402.10162，我们认为该修正项对应于体引力路径积分中的一个复鞍点几何。所提出的几何具有负的边界长度，并在内视界处封顶；我们称之为内视界鞍点。我们讨论该鞍点及其伴随的负号如何通过逆 Laplace 围道的 Picard-Lefschetz 分析，连同该鞍点的稳定性分析，对态密度作出贡献。我们还讨论内视界鞍点对 Kontsevich-Segal-Witten (KSW) 复度规可允许性判据的违反。尽管这种违反被认为会导致路径积分计算中的非物理发散，但通过仔细处理错误符号模式，可以描述内视界鞍点上的一圈效应。受此观察启发，我们提出 KSW 判据的一个较弱版本，称为谱 KSW 判据。其目的是刻画复引力鞍点周围的一圈修正何时是良定义的。
classification.one_liner: 该文将近极端带电黑洞熵的修正解释为体引力路径积分中的内视界复鞍点，并由此提出谱 KSW 判据以判定复引力鞍点周围一圈修正的良定义性。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 JT 引力与量子引力路径积分形式研究，但不直接对应所列全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力等重点支线。

papers.title: Entropic force in matrix
papers.abstract: We consider the entropic force in matrix theory. We find the gravity in bulk can be emergent from the entropic force.

classification.title_zh: 矩阵中的熵力
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑矩阵理论中的熵力。我们发现体引力可以从熵力中涌现。
classification.one_liner: 在矩阵理论中讨论熵力，并指出体引力可由熵力涌现。

papers.title: Brane-fused black hole operators
papers.abstract: We construct infinitely many new $\frac{1}{16}$-BPS cohomologies of the 4d maximal super-Yang-Mills theory and interpret them as a black hole wrapped by dual giant graviton hairs. Since the black hole inside a dual giant feels the RR 5-form flux reduced by one unit, its microstate should essentially be an $SU(N-1)$ cohomology. However, due to the fortuitous nature of the black hole microstates, promoting an $SU(N-1)$ black hole state to $SU(N)$ generally fails to yield a cohomology. We show at $N=3$ that suitable fusion products with the dual giants yield cohomologies. The core black hole size is probed by the minimal size of the dual giant which can wrap it. We also discuss two types of large black hole hairs: large conformal descendants of gravitons and large dual giants. We prove that any $SU(N)$ black hole cohomology admits infinitely many hairs of the first type.

classification.title_zh: 膜融合黑洞算符
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了 4d 最大超对称 Yang-Mills 理论的无穷多个新的 1/16-BPS 上同调，并将其解释为被对偶巨引力子毛发所包裹的黑洞。由于对偶巨引力子内部的黑洞感受到 RR 5-形式通量减少了一个单位，其微态本质上应属于 SU(N-1) 上同调。然而，由于黑洞微态的偶然性质，将 SU(N-1) 黑洞态提升到 SU(N) 通常不能得到上同调。我们在 N=3 时表明，与对偶巨引力子进行合适的融合乘积可以得到上同调。核心黑洞的大小由能够包裹它的对偶巨引力子的最小尺寸探测。我们还讨论了两类大黑洞毛发：引力子的大共形后代和大的对偶巨引力子。我们证明，任意 SU(N) 黑洞上同调都允许无穷多第一类毛发。
classification.one_liner: 构造 N=4 SYM 中无穷多新的 1/16-BPS 黑洞上同调，并用对偶巨引力子毛发解释其微态。

papers.title: Finite $N$ black hole cohomologies
papers.abstract: We study new cohomologies for the BPS operators of the $\mathcal{N}=4$ Yang-Mills theory with $SU(3)$ and $SU(4)$ gauge groups, to better understand the black hole microstates. We first study the index of these black hole operators and identify their apparent threshold levels. For $SU(3)$, we find many towers of states and partial no-hair behaviors. We explicitly construct the threshold cohomology in the $SU(3)$ theory. We study throughout this paper a subsector of the field theory corresponding to the BMN matrix theory. We also argue that the BMN sector exhibits a black hole like entropy growth at large $N$.

classification.title_zh: 有限 N 黑洞上同调
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 N=4 Yang-Mills 理论在 SU(3) 和 SU(4) 规范群下 BPS 算符的新上同调，以更好地理解黑洞微观态。我们首先研究这些黑洞算符的指标，并识别其表观阈值能级。对于 SU(3)，我们发现许多态塔和部分无毛行为。我们显式构造了 SU(3) 理论中的阈值上同调。贯穿本文，我们研究对应于 BMN 矩阵理论的场论子扇区。我们还论证 BMN 子扇区在大 N 下表现出类似黑洞的熵增长。
classification.one_liner: 通过 N=4 SU(3)/SU(4) Yang-Mills 的 BPS 算符上同调研究有限 N 黑洞微观态，并在 BMN 子扇区发现类黑洞熵增长。

papers.title: Exact algebraic separation of the gravitoelectromagnetic perturbations of Kerr-Newman-(anti-)de Sitter black holes
papers.abstract: We obtain an explicit separation of the coupled gravitational and electromagnetic radiative equations on nonextremal Kerr--Newman--(anti-)de Sitter black holes with nonzero charge and rotation. The construction uses a matrix with constant determinant, chosen independently of the frequency and azimuthal number, and treats the positive- and negative-spin sectors within the same formulation. We establish that this transformation is smooth and invertible throughout the open AdS exterior and between the event and cosmological horizons in dS. The resulting radial and angular systems are valid at arbitrary complex frequencies. We also express regularity of the radiative Newman--Penrose variables at the rotation axes and future horizons as conditions on the separated solutions. In the asymptotically flat limit, the transformation is related to Hintz's matrix integrating factor by the allowed frame freedom. These results provide a basis for studying quasinormal modes and black-hole stability in Kerr--Newman--(anti-)de Sitter spacetimes, as well as exploring holographic applications to strongly coupled systems.

classification.title_zh: Kerr-Newman-(反)德西特黑洞引力电磁扰动的精确代数分离
classification.abstract_zh: 我们获得了非极端、非零电荷与转动的 Kerr-Newman-(anti-)de Sitter 黑洞上耦合引力与电磁辐射方程的显式分离。该构造使用一个行列式为常数的矩阵，其选择不依赖于频率和方位角数，并在同一表述中处理正、负自旋扇区。我们证明该变换在整个开 AdS 外部以及 dS 中事件视界与宇宙视界之间是光滑且可逆的。所得径向和角向系统在任意复频率下有效。我们还将辐射 Newman-Penrose 变量在转轴和未来视界处的正则性表述为对分离解的条件。在渐近平直极限下，该变换通过允许的标架自由度与 Hintz 的矩阵积分因子相关。这些结果为研究 Kerr-Newman-(anti-)de Sitter 时空中的准正规模式和黑洞稳定性，以及探索对强耦合系统的全息应用提供了基础。
classification.one_liner: 对 Kerr-Newman-(A)dS 黑洞耦合引力电磁扰动给出精确代数分离，为 QNM、稳定性及可能的全息应用奠基。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力与黑洞扰动/QNM 支线，并提及全息应用作为展望；但摘要未给出具体 AdS/CFT 计算或量子引力结果。

papers.title: From Accelerating Rotating Black Holes to a Swirling Universe
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that the swirling universe can be recovered through a coordinated horizon-degeneration and scaling procedure applied to the Kerr C-metric. The construction exploits the horizon structure of accelerating, rotating black holes, which allows their inner and outer horizons to coalesce while simultaneously approaching the acceleration horizon. By magnifying the near-acceleration-horizon region faster than the black hole horizons approach it, the pair of accelerating, rotating black holes is pushed to an infinite proper distance, while a finite gravitomagnetic twist survives. The resulting geometry reproduces precisely the swirling universe, providing a physical interpretation of its intrinsic rotation as the gravitational remnant of rotating black holes sent to infinity.

classification.title_zh: 从加速旋转黑洞到涡旋宇宙
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，通过对 Kerr C-度规施加协同的视界退化与缩放程序，可以恢复涡旋宇宙。该构造利用了加速旋转黑洞的视界结构，使内、外视界并合，同时趋近加速视界。通过使近加速视界区域被放大的速度快于黑洞视界趋近它的速度，这对加速旋转黑洞被推到无限固有距离，而有限的引力磁扭曲仍然残留。所得几何精确再现涡旋宇宙，为其内禀旋转提供物理解释：它是被送到无穷远的旋转黑洞的引力残余。
classification.one_liner: 通过视界退化与缩放，从 Kerr C-度规导出涡旋宇宙，并解释其旋转为旋转黑洞的引力残余。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 Kerr C-度规与涡旋宇宙的精确解构造，属于经典引力/广义相对论；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: An exact Simpson-Visser family in bumblebee gravity
papers.abstract: We construct an exact Simpson-Visser solution in metric bumblebee gravity, supported by a phantom scalar, magnetic nonlinear electrodynamics, and a spacelike configuration of fixed norm. The independent vector equation determines a local Lagrange multiplier and a temporal component that permits a regular ingoing extension across metric horizons. Reconstruction of the matter functions identifies a continuous family of wormholes, null minimum geometries, and black-bounces within one action. In the black hole case, the areal photon sphere and critical timelike orbit radii retain their Schwarzschild values, whereas angular deflection, periapsis advance, and photon orbit instability depend on the bounce and bumblebee parameters. The metric shadow coincides with the Schwarzschild prediction at fixed lapse mass and areal observer position; in addition, the adopted Sgr A* shadow diameter and M87* angular mass comparisons do not determine these parameters separately. The coupled axial equations yield distinct tensor, metric, and transverse bumblebee characteristics. We compute fundamental auxiliary massless scalar and ordinary Maxwell probe resonances by Chebyshev spectral collocation and estimate the tensor and bumblebee resonance scales at leading geometric optics order. Nonnegative probe potentials exclude exponentially growing probe modes. For negative nonminimal coupling and a nonzero temporal case, however, the supporting electromagnetic field develops an angular gradient instability in its extraordinary polarization. The unstable characteristic persists in the coupled principal symbol, while a variational construction establishes growing modes on the fixed geometry and lower bounds on their growth rates.

classification.title_zh: bumblebee 引力中的精确 Simpson-Visser 族
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在度规 bumblebee 引力中构造了一个精确的 Simpson-Visser 解，它由幻影标量、磁非线性电动力学以及固定范数的类空位形支撑。独立的矢量方程确定了局域拉格朗日乘子和一个时间分量，使得度规视界上存在正则的向内延拓。重构物质函数后，在同一作用量内识别出虫洞、零最小几何和黑洞反弹的连续族。在黑洞情形，面积光子球和临界类时轨道半径保持 Schwarzschild 值，而角度偏折、近星点进动和光子轨道不稳定性依赖于反弹和 bumblebee 参数。在固定 lapse 质量和面积观测者位置下，度规阴影与 Schwarzschild 预言一致；此外，所采用的 Sgr A* 阴影直径和 M87* 角质量比较不能分别确定这些参数。耦合的轴向方程给出不同的张量、度规和横向 bumblebee 特征。我们用 Chebyshev 谱配置法计算基本辅助无质量标量和普通 Maxwell 探针共振，并在领头几何光学阶估计张量和 bumblebee 共振尺度。非负探针势排除了指数增长的探针模式。然而，对于负非最小耦合和非零时间分量的情形，支撑电磁场在其非常偏振中产生角梯度不稳定性。该不稳定特征在耦合主符号中持续存在，而变分构造在固定几何上建立了增长模式及其增长率下界。
classification.one_liner: 在 bumblebee 引力中构造精确 Simpson-Visser 解族，统一描述虫洞、零最小几何与黑洞反弹，并分析光子轨道、阴影及探针共振/不稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典/修改引力中的精确解、黑洞阴影、探针共振与稳定性，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶；但匹配用户“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线，并涉及 QNM 类共振。

papers.title: Quantum-Corrected and Hairy Black Holes via Analogue Gravity
papers.abstract: This thesis maps two exotic black-hole geometries onto the transonic flow of a de Laval nozzle and reads their perturbative response in aerodynamic variables. The first is the hairy black hole of gravitational decoupling, constrained by the dominant energy condition and by the existence of a horizon. The second is the Calmet-Kuipers metric, short-ranged and governed by the single Wilson coefficient of the dimension-six operator that the two-loop Goroff-Sagnotti divergence identifies. Perturbations of spin 0, 1/2, 1 and 2 reduce to a Schr\"odinger-type wave equation, whose spectrum the Mashhoon method returns as a whole overtone tower in closed form, every frequency damped. The two corrections are distinguished by which channel responds and by how strongly all of them do, the quantum coupling moving the quality factor by up to 37% in the scalar and Dirac channels and by about 10% in the other two, while the hair acts on every channel alike. Identifying the two tortoise coordinates turns the equality of the potentials into a Sturm-Liouville problem, so that the prescribed barrier fixes the wall profile and with it the flow variables and the thrust coefficient. The hair is felt across the whole divergent section, whereas the quantum correction registers only near the throat and grows as the inverse fourth power of the mass, which confines it to primordial black holes. The analogy is kinematical, so the duct reproduces the scattering of perturbations off these geometries without reproducing the field equations behind them.

classification.title_zh: 通过类比引力研究量子修正黑洞与毛发黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 这篇论文将两种奇异黑洞几何映射到 de Laval 喷嘴的跨声速流，并用空气动力学变量读取其微扰响应。第一种是由主导能量条件与视界存在性约束的引力退耦毛发黑洞。第二种是 Calmet-Kuipers 度规，其短程性由两圈 Goroff-Sagnotti 发散所确定的六维算符的单个 Wilson 系数控制。自旋 0、1/2、1 和 2 的扰动约化为薛定谔型波动方程，Mashhoon 方法以闭式给出整个泛音塔，每个频率均为阻尼。两种修正的区别在于哪个通道响应以及所有通道响应的强度：量子耦合在标量与狄拉克通道中使品质因子最多移动 37%，在另外两个通道中约 10%，而毛发对所有通道作用相同。识别两个乌龟坐标后，势的相等性转化为 Sturm-Liouville 问题，于是规定的势垒确定壁面轮廓，并由此确定流动变量与推力系数。毛发在整个扩张段都能被感受到，而量子修正只在喉部附近显现，并随质量的负四次方增长，这将其限制在原初黑洞。该类比是运动学的，因此管道复现了微扰在这些几何上的散射，但没有复现其背后的场方程。
classification.one_liner: 该论文用 de Laval 喷嘴类比研究量子修正黑洞与毛发黑洞的微扰，并以闭式给出准正规模塔及空气动力学对应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于黑洞微扰/QNM与类比引力，直接匹配“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息、AdS/CFT或量子信息，因此对全息方向相关性中等。

papers.title: Towards ultrarelativistic scattering near the light ring: asymptotic divergence of gravitational-wave fluxes
papers.abstract: Near the threshold between scattering and capture by a Schwarzschild black hole, a particle spends a long time close to an unstable circular orbit, which in the ultrarelativistic limit approaches the light ring. Here we study the behavior of the gravitational wave fluxes emitted by such an ultrarelativistic particle at first order in the mass ratio. The fluxes radiated to infinity and absorbed by the horizon diverge as the inverse distance from the light ring multiplied by its logarithm. Using the Wentzel, Kramers, and Brillouin (WKB) approximation to solve the Regge-Wheeler equation and treating the infinite harmonic sum analytically, we derive an exact expression for the coefficient of this logarithmic enhancement and show that it is identical for both fluxes. We then estimate the coefficients of the subleading pole contributions by combining numerical calculations at low multipoles with the exact asymptotics at large multipoles. We further conjecture an extension to equatorial circular orbits in Kerr. Interestingly, our results also inform the analytical structure of the energy and angular momentum losses of ultrarelativistic scattering orbits near the light ring. More broadly, our work illustrates how WKB methods can provide the asymptotic behavior of self-force observables in regimes where numerical mode sums become increasingly challenging.

classification.title_zh: 迈向光环附近的超相对论散射：引力波通量的渐近发散
classification.abstract_zh: 在 Schwarzschild 黑洞的散射与捕获阈值附近，粒子会在不稳定圆轨道附近停留很长时间，而在超相对论极限下该轨道趋近光环。本文研究这种超相对论粒子在质量比一阶所发射的引力波通量行为。辐射到无穷远和被视界吸收的通量以距光环距离的倒数乘以其对数的方式发散。通过使用 WKB 近似求解 Regge-Wheeler 方程并解析处理无限谐波求和，作者推导了这个对数增强系数的精确表达式，并表明两种通量具有相同系数。随后结合低多极的数值计算与大 l 的精确渐近，估计了次主导极点贡献的系数。文章进一步猜想将其推广到 Kerr 赤道圆轨道。结果表明，这些结果也有助于理解光环附近超相对论散射轨道的能量与角动量损失的解析结构。更广泛地说，本文说明 WKB 方法可在数值模求和日益困难的情形下给出自力可观测量的渐近行为。
classification.one_liner: 用 WKB 方法解析研究超相对论粒子在 Schwarzschild 黑洞光环附近散射时引力波通量的对数发散及其系数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究广义相对论中的黑洞散射、引力波通量与自力渐近，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线。

papers.title: Quantum critical collapse in the large $D$ limit
papers.abstract: In analytically tractable models of Einstein-scalar critical collapse, it has been shown that the quantum self-energy of the collapsing matter in the dominant $s$-wave sector grows with Lyapunov exponent $D-2$, eventually competing with the classical instability that controls black hole formation. This competition shifts the naked singularity threshold and produces a finite mass gap within semiclassical control, yet that control may appear threatened as the spacetime dimension $D\to\infty$. We study this quantum growing mode in both continuously (CSS) and discretely (DSS) self-similar critical spacetimes at large $D$ and establish that the universal Lyapunov exponent survives both forms of self-similarity. In CSS, the classical approach to a naked singularity is interrupted by the appearance of trapped surfaces. At large $D$, the horizon tracing reduces to a Bessel problem, yielding a quantum wall whose radius obeys $r_h\propto(D-2)^{-2}$. This radius can remain above the Planck scale at finite $D$, although maintaining this hierarchy becomes increasingly demanding as $D$ grows. In DSS, the same growth is modulated by echoing and can retain memory of previous echoes. The simplest anomaly-induced action exhibits accumulating memory but is singular at the spherical center. We construct a covariant one-loop action whose stress tensor remains smooth throughout the DSS domain and organize it into an echo-periodic structure without memory. This suggests that the smooth vacuum polarization of the genuine four-dimensional DSS Choptuik spacetime may similarly be governed by its exact echoing symmetry.

classification.title_zh: 大 D 极限下的量子临界坍缩
classification.abstract_zh: 在可解析处理的 Einstein-标量临界坍缩模型中，已表明主导 s 波扇区中坍缩物质的量子自能会以 Lyapunov 指数 D-2 增长，最终与支配黑洞形成的经典不稳定性竞争。这种竞争移动了裸奇点阈值，并在半经典控制范围内产生有限质量隙，然而当时空维度 D→∞ 时，这种控制可能看似受到威胁。我们研究大 D 下连续（CSS）和离散（DSS）自相似临界时空中的这种量子增长模式，并确立普适 Lyapunov 指数在两种自相似形式下都存活。在 CSS 中，向裸奇点的经典趋近被陷阱面的出现打断。在大 D 下，视界追踪约化为 Bessel 问题，产生一个量子墙，其半径满足 r_h∝(D-2)^{-2}。该半径在有限 D 下可保持在普朗克尺度以上，尽管随着 D 增大，维持这种层级变得越来越苛刻。在 DSS 中，同样的增长受到回响调制，并可保留先前回响的记忆。最简单的反常诱导作用量表现出累积记忆，但在球心处奇异。我们构造了一个协变单圈作用量，其应力张量在整个 DSS 域中保持光滑，并将其组织为无记忆的回响周期结构。这表明，真实四维 DSS Choptuik 时空的光滑真空极化可能同样由其精确回响对称性支配。
classification.one_liner: 在大 D 下研究 Einstein-标量临界坍缩的量子增长模式，揭示 CSS/DSS 自相似性、裸奇点阈值移动与量子墙，并构造 DSS 中光滑的回响周期单圈作用量。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题属于经典引力/广义相对论中的临界坍缩与半经典量子效应，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”相符，但不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息。

papers.title: Efficient numerical evolution of self-gravitating systems with dark-matter-baryon scattering
papers.abstract: We present a fast algorithm to numerically evolve a spherically symmetric system consisting of dark matter and gas, including dark-matter-baryon scattering. The method augments the spherical N-body code NSphere, which collapses the six-dimensional phase space of a spherical collisionless system to three dimensions, with a one-dimensional Lagrangian treatment of gas. Dark-matter-baryon scattering is implemented as a Monte-Carlo process between the dark-matter numerical particles and the gas shells. We also implement an algorithm for radiative gas cooling that is valid for weak cooling. The gas, as well as dark-matter-baryon scattering and cooling, adds only incrementally to the run time of the code, allowing systems to be evolved on a laptop computer, a tiny fraction of the computational resources required for a full 3D N-body/hydro simulation. To illustrate, we show the evolution of a $\sim 10^{13}\,M_\odot$ halo with a dark-matter-baryon scattering cross section $\sigma_{\rm tot}/m_\chi=0.1\,{\rm cm}^2\,{\rm g}^{-1}$ but no gas cooling. We then show examples with radiative gas cooling where the cooling is altered through interaction with dark-matter particles. The resulting code, NSphere-IDM, allows the implications of dark-matter interactions for galaxy evolution to be explored quickly over large volumes of the dark-matter parameter space, and other new physics (e.g., dark-matter self-interactions or anisotropy in the distribution function) is easily incorporated. The code can also provide useful calibrations and benchmarks for fully 3D N-body or hydrodynamical simulations.

classification.title_zh: 含暗物质-重子散射的自引力系统的高效数值演化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种快速算法，用于数值演化由暗物质和气体组成的球对称系统，并包含暗物质-重子散射。该方法在球对称 N 体代码 NSphere 基础上加入对气体的一维拉格朗日处理；暗物质-重子散射通过暗物质数值粒子与气体壳层之间的 Monte-Carlo 过程实现。我们还实现了在弱冷却下有效的辐射气体冷却算法。气体、暗物质-重子散射和冷却仅略微增加运行时间，使系统可在笔记本电脑上演化，所需计算资源远少于完整三维 N 体/流体模拟。作为示例，我们展示了一个约 10^13 M_sun 的晕在暗物质-重子散射截面 sigma_tot/m_chi=0.1 cm^2/g 且无气体冷却时的演化；随后展示有辐射冷却且冷却因与暗物质粒子相互作用而改变的示例。所得代码 NSphere-IDM 可快速在大范围暗物质参数空间探索暗物质相互作用对星系演化的影响，也易纳入其他新物理（如暗物质自相互作用或分布函数各向异性），并能为完整三维 N 体或流体模拟提供校准和基准。
classification.one_liner: 提出 NSphere-IDM，一种在球对称 N 体框架中高效模拟暗物质-重子散射与气体冷却的算法，用于快速探索星系演化中的暗物质物理。
classification.relevance_reason: 内容为暗物质-重子散射与气体冷却的数值天体物理，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Non-Coulomb $Q$-Cohomology and Quantum Lifting
papers.abstract: We study quantum lifting of classical BPS cohomology classes in four-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang-Mills theory. Certain powers of the gaugino bilinear $\mathcal S=\text{Tr}(\lambda_+\lambda_-)$ in orthogonal theories provide non-Coulomb monotones: multi-graviton classes that vanish upon Cartan restriction. For $SO(7)$, we identify $\mathcal S^4$ as a superconformal descendant of a known lifted monotone class, explaining the latter's non-Coulomb character, and explicitly construct a fortuitous lifting partner for $\mathcal S^4$. This construction provides a strategy for finding analogous partners for higher powers at higher ranks. Our main result establishes restrictions on the quantum lifting of classical BPS cohomologies for general gauge groups. We show that the one-loop correction $Q_1$ to the supercharge annihilates every monotone class in classical cohomology, while every non-zero $Q_1$ image is of non-Coulomb type. Thus every non-zero one-loop pairing has a fortuitous source and a non-Coulomb target, so that Coulomb monotones survive at this order at finite rank. In the BMN sector, our results imply that non-Coulomb monotones survive at one loop order as well. A crucial step in the argument shows that every non-Coulomb class, fortuitous or monotone, is annihilated in classical cohomology by a sufficiently high power of a scalar discriminant, which we interpret as a partial no-hair property.

classification.title_zh: 非库仑 Q-上同调与量子提升
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了四维 $\mathcal N=4$ 超杨-米尔斯理论中经典 BPS 上同调类的量子提升。在正交规范理论中，规范微子双线性 $\mathcal S=\text{Tr}(\lambda_+\lambda_-)$ 的某些幂给出非库仑单调量：即限制到 Cartan 子代数时消失的多引力子类。对于 $SO(7)$，我们辨认出 $\mathcal S^4$ 是某个已知的已提升单调类的超共形后代，从而解释了后者的非库仑特征，并显式构造了 $\mathcal S^4$ 的一个偶然提升伙伴。该构造为寻找更高秩下更高次幂的类似伙伴提供了策略。我们的主要结果给出了对一般规范群经典 BPS 上同调的量子提升的限制。我们证明，超荷的单圈修正 $Q_1$ 湮灭经典上同调中的每一个单调类，而每一个非零的 $Q_1$ 像都是非库仑型的。因此，每一个非零单圈配对都有一个偶然源和一个非库仑靶，使得库仑单调量在有限秩下在这一阶存活。在 BMN 扇区，我们的结果意味着非库仑单调量在单圈阶也存活。论证中的一个关键步骤表明，每一个非库仑类，无论偶然还是单调，都在经典上同调中被标量判别式的足够高次幂湮灭，我们将其解释为一种部分无毛性质。
classification.one_liner: 在四维 N=4 超杨-米尔斯中研究经典 BPS 上同调类的量子提升，证明单圈超荷修正湮灭所有单调类且其像均为非库仑型，并讨论 BMN 扇区中的存活。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦 N=4 SYM 的 BPS 上同调与量子提升，虽涉及 BMN 扇区，但未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、探针膜或经典引力。

papers.title: Aspects of Codimension two Holography in de Sitter Space
papers.abstract: Following \cite{Yadav:2024ray} we embark on a further study of the codimension two holography in de Sitter (dS) space. The $d$ dimensional bulk dS space is sliced by two end of the world $(d-1)$ dimensional branes which are bestowed with either Lorentzian dS or Euclidean AdS metric joining at a common $(d-2)$ dimensional space where the dual CFT lives. Through explicit computations of the holographic entanglement entropy, partition function, and Renyi entropy in both slicings for the bulk dS space emphasizing their similarities as well as differences we provide further evidence for this duality. We also make comments on further generalization of the codimension two holography.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 空间中余维二全息的若干方面
classification.abstract_zh: 继 Yadav:2024ray 之后，我们进一步研究 de Sitter（dS）空间中的余维二全息。d 维体 dS 空间被两个世界末端（end of the world）(d-1) 维膜切片，这些膜分别带有 Lorentzian dS 或 Euclidean AdS 度规，并在一个共同的 (d-2) 维空间相交，对偶 CFT 生活在该空间。通过在体 dS 空间的两种切片中显式计算全息纠缠熵、配分函数和 Renyi 熵，并强调它们的相似性与差异，我们为该对偶提供了进一步证据。我们还评论了余维二全息的进一步推广。
classification.one_liner: 在 dS 体空间中用两种 EOW 膜切片计算全息纠缠熵、配分函数与 Renyi 熵，为余维二 dS/CFT 对偶提供进一步证据。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 dS/CFT 与全息纠缠熵方向，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet 或经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Fortuitous BMN Cohomology at Every $N$
papers.abstract: Finite-$N$ trace relations can produce $Q$-cohomology classes with no stable large-$N$ ancestor. The brane-fused construction at $SU(3)$ suggests that such states can retain an $SU(2)$ nonabelian core accompanied by scalar hair. We develop this idea into a general construction for every $SU(N)$, $N\geq3$. Starting from the $SU(2)$ threshold operator $O_{24}$, we select pairs of eigenvalues of one scalar and construct corrected two-colour letters whose $Q$-transformations obey the $SU(2)$ rules exactly. Substitution into $O_{24}$ gives a closed rational operator for each pair. Multiplying by eigenvalue-separation factors removes the denominators, and summing over all pairs produces a gauge-invariant polynomial. An exact block-restriction identity recovers a nonzero multiple of $O_{24}$. The restriction maps every stable class to a stable $SU(2)$ class, proving that the resulting operator is non-exact and fortuitous, even when non-Coulombic stable classes are included. This proves the existence of fortuitous BMN cohomology at every $N\geq3$. The construction is an exact algebraic realization of a nonabelian core with scalar dressing.

classification.title_zh: 每个 N 处的偶然 BMN 上同调
classification.abstract_zh: 有限 N 的迹关系可以产生没有稳定大 N 祖先的 Q-上同调类。SU(3) 的膜融合构造表明，这类态可以保留一个带标量毛的 SU(2) 非阿贝尔核心。我们把这个想法发展为适用于每个 SU(N)、N≥3 的一般构造。从 SU(2) 阈值算子 O_{24} 出发，我们选择一个标量的两两特征值，并构造修正的双色字母，其 Q-变换精确遵守 SU(2) 规则。代入 O_{24} 后，对每一对给出一个闭的有理算子。乘以特征值分离因子去掉分母，并对所有对求和，产生一个规范不变多项式。一个精确的块限制恒等式恢复 O_{24} 的非零倍数。该限制把每个稳定类映射到一个稳定的 SU(2) 类，证明所得算子非恰当且偶然，即使包含非库仑稳定类时也如此。这证明了在每个 N≥3 处都存在偶然 BMN 上同调。该构造是非阿贝尔核心带标量修饰的精确代数实现。
classification.one_liner: 该文将 SU(3) 的膜融合构造推广到所有 SU(N)，证明每个 N≥3 都存在无稳定大 N 祖先的偶然 BMN 上同调类，其非阿贝尔 SU(2) 核心带标量修饰。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接处理有限 N 迹关系与 BMN 上同调，属于用户重点标签 multi-trace 的核心理论问题。

papers.title: Beyond the polynomial ansatz: regular $AdS_3\times M_8$ solutions of M-theory
papers.abstract: We study regular compact solutions of the cohomogeneity-one $AdS_3\times M_8$ system of Gauntlett, Mac Conamhna, Mateos and Waldram, where $M_8$ is an $S^2$ bundle over three constant-curvature Riemann surfaces. We find that an endpoint argument rules out every non-flat curvature-sign sector without a positive-curvature factor, while an analytic deformation gives regular families with four radial shape parameters in all remaining sectors, with the base geometry held fixed. The known polynomial solutions form a proper analytic locus in these families. Non-polynomiality is therefore generic in parameter space, although the deviation from an endpoint-matching polynomial can be very small. Apart from the completely flat exception, the curvature-sign criterion is necessary and sufficient within this ansatz. Four magnetic flux ratios give local coordinates near the reference solution and its small-curvature deformations, and a rational inverse reconstructs candidate endpoint data directly from finite flux ratios. In the fully positive sector we prove that one explicit four-dimensional finite-ratio neighbourhood lies inside the physical flux image. The magnetic periods and leading holographic central charge reduce to endpoint data, and, once the common Brown--Henneaux normalization is fixed, the nontrivial flux dependence of the equivariant localization formula agrees with the endpoint result as an exact algebraic identity. We also quantify the non-polynomial corrections and analyse finite degenerations under explicit convergence hypotheses.

classification.title_zh: 超越多项式拟设：M理论的正则 AdS3×M8 解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 Gauntlett、Mac Conamhna、Mateos 和 Waldram 的 cohomogeneity-one AdS3×M8 系统的正则紧致解，其中 M8 是三个常曲率 Riemann 面上的 S2 丛。我们发现端点论证排除了每一个没有正曲率因子的非平坦曲率符号扇区，而解析形变在所有剩余扇区中给出具有四个径向形状参数的正则族，同时保持底几何固定。已知多项式解在这些族中构成一个真解析轨迹。因此非多项式性在参数空间中是一般性的，尽管与端点匹配多项式的偏离可以非常小。除完全平坦例外外，曲率符号判据在该拟设内是充分必要的。四个磁通比给出参考解及其小曲率形变附近的局部坐标，而有理逆可直接从有限磁通比重构候选端点数据。在完全正曲率扇区，我们证明一个显式的四维有限比邻域位于物理磁通像内。磁周期和领头全息中心电荷约化为端点数据，并且一旦固定共同的 Brown-Henneaux 归一化，等变局域化公式的非平凡磁通依赖与端点结果作为精确代数恒等式一致。我们还量化了非多项式修正，并在显式收敛假设下分析了有限退化。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3×M8 超引力拟设中构造出超越已知多项式解的正则非多项式族，并联系磁通数据、全息中心电荷与 Brown-Henneaux/局域化结果。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与经典超引力解研究，并明确涉及全息中心电荷和 Brown-Henneaux 归一化，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但它不涉及全息凝聚态、p波/多分量序参量、QNM、multi-trace 等用户更具体的支线，因此相关度为中等。

papers.title: Exact AdS and pp-waves in multi-gravity beyond pairwise interactions
papers.abstract: We construct exact anti-de Sitter (AdS) waves and pp-waves in ghost-free multi-gravity beyond pairwise interactions for an arbitrary number $\mathcal{N}$ of vielbeins, in any spacetime dimension $D\geq3$. Deforming proportional AdS and Minkowski solutions along a common null direction reduces the full nonlinear field equations to coupled linear differential equations for the wave profiles, without restricting their amplitudes. The system is diagonalised in the same eigenbasis as the perturbative Fierz-Pauli mass matrix, separating the solutions into one massless and $\mathcal{N}-1$ massive eigenprofiles. We obtain explicit radial and transverse solutions and impose an AdS boundary falloff. This falloff admits the appropriate radial branch of every mode with non-negative squared mass and excludes profiles with negative squared masses, including logarithmic solutions at the Breitenlohner-Freedman threshold. We also relate the AdS waves to pp-waves through a local flat limit. Explicit examples exhibit wave configurations that cannot be reproduced by ghost-free pairwise theories, demonstrating that genuine multi-field interactions support new exact gravitational-wave solutions.

classification.title_zh: 超越成对相互作用的多引力中的精确 AdS 波与 pp 波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为任意数量 N 的 vielbeins、任意时空维度 D≥3，在超越成对相互作用的无鬼多引力中构造了精确的反德西特（AdS）波和 pp 波。沿共同零方向对成比例的 AdS 和 Minkowski 解作形变，将完整非线性场方程约化为波剖面的耦合线性微分方程，且不限制其振幅。该系统在与微扰 Fierz-Pauli 质量矩阵相同的本征基下对角化，将解分为一个无质量本征剖面和 N-1 个有质量本征剖面。我们得到显式的径向和横向解，并施加 AdS 边界衰减。该衰减允许每个非负质量平方模式的适当径向支，并排除负质量平方的剖面，包括在 Breitenlohner-Freedman 阈值处的对数解。我们还通过局部平坦极限将 AdS 波与 pp 波联系起来。显式例子展示了无法由无鬼成对理论重现的波构型，表明真正的多场相互作用支持新的精确引力波解。
classification.one_liner: 在无鬼多引力中构造精确 AdS 波和 pp 波，按 Fierz-Pauli 质量矩阵本征基分解并施加 AdS 边界衰减。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究多引力中的精确 AdS 波与 pp 波及其经典场方程解，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；未涉及全息对偶或量子信息。

papers.title: All Order Gravitational Wave Tails for Subleading Post-Newtonian Expansion
papers.abstract: The low-frequency gravitational waveform emitted in a classical scattering process contains an infinite tower of late- and early-time tail terms of the form $u^{-r}(\ln|u|)^{r-1}$, $r \geq 1$. In the Newtonian limit, the coefficients of this entire tower have recently been shown to be universal, i.e. fixed by the asymptotic data of the scattering objects alone. At the retained order in the velocity expansion, these leading-logarithmic tails are determined to all orders in Newton's constant $G$. We extend this result to the first subleading order in the post-Newtonian expansion of the asymptotic states. We consider scattering of an arbitrary number of incoming and outgoing nonrelativistic objects interacting only through gravity at long range, and we derive the complete tower of tail terms at this order. The correction arises from the first subleading term in the retardation expansion and is determined by the asymptotic Newtonian trajectories of the massive particles. Its coefficients are again determined entirely by the asymptotic trajectories and are independent of the details of the interaction. For $2\to2$ scattering, the leading-logarithmic series can be summed in closed form. Our results agree with a relativistic conjecture proposed in earlier work arXiv:2610.07134.

classification.title_zh: 次领头后牛顿展开的全阶引力波尾
classification.abstract_zh: 经典散射过程中发射的低频引力波形包含形式为 $u^{-r}(\ln|u|)^{r-1}$、$r\geq 1$ 的无穷多个晚时和早时尾项。在牛顿极限下，最近已有工作表明整个这一尾项塔的系数是普适的，即仅由散射物体的渐近数据确定。在速度展开所保留的阶，这些领头对数尾项被确定到牛顿常数 $G$ 的所有阶。我们将其结果推广到渐近态后牛顿展开的第一个次领头阶。我们考虑任意数目的入射和出射非相对论物体，它们仅通过长程引力相互作用，并推导出该阶完整的尾项塔。该修正来自推迟展开中的第一个次领头项，并由大质量粒子的渐近牛顿轨迹决定。其系数同样完全由渐近轨迹决定，且与相互作用细节无关。对于 $2\to2$ 散射，领头对数级数可以闭式求和。我们的结果与早期工作 arXiv:2610.07134 中提出的相对论猜想一致。
classification.one_liner: 将牛顿极限中由渐近数据普适决定的引力波尾项塔推广到后牛顿展开的次领头阶，并验证了先前提出的相对论猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，涉及引力波尾项与后牛顿展开；不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

papers.title: Finite-cutoff geometry from double-scaled SYK
papers.abstract: We develop a finite-cutoff holographic description of the double-scaled SYK (DSSYK) model. We construct microscopic deformations of Kourkoulou-Maldacena and thermofield-double SYK states whose double-scaling limits reproduce a lower-dimensional analogue of $\text{T}\overline{\text{T}}$ and $\text{T}\overline{\text{T}}+\Lambda_2$ deformations, which we denote $T^2$ and $T^2+\Lambda_1$, respectively. The ensemble-averaged theory describes wormhole states in finite-cutoff sine dilaton gravity, and finite-cutoff anti-de Sitter and de Sitter geometries in the low- and high-energy regimes, respectively. The analysis includes both perturbative and non-perturbative solutions to the energy spectrum flow equation, and the regions behind and beyond the respective horizons. Only the perturbative branch admits physical quantum states. We study how to incorporate end-of-the-world (ETW) branes in the finite cutoff holographic dictionary. The ETW brane leads to an additional boundary theory deformation, which leads to black hole or eternal traversable wormhole geometries depending on the existence of normalizable bound states. We extend the finite cutoff length evaluations for constant mean curvature (CMC) slices, and interpret them as complexity in the boundary theory. We discuss possible extensions with matter. Our results provide a microscopic framework for studying the finite-cutoff boundaries, CMC slices and branes in the holographic dictionary of DSSYK.

classification.title_zh: 双标度 SYK 的有限截断几何
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为双标度 SYK（DSSYK）模型发展了一种有限截断全息描述。我们构造了 Kourkoulou-Maldacena 和热场双态 SYK 态的微观形变，其双标度极限分别再现了 TTbar 与 TTbar+Lambda2 形变的低维类似物，我们分别记作 T^2 和 T^2+Lambda1。集合平均后的理论描述了有限截断正弦膨胀子引力中的虫洞态，并在低能和高能区域分别描述了有限截断反 de Sitter 与 de Sitter 几何。分析包括能谱流方程的微扰与非微扰解，以及各自视界之后和之外区域。只有微扰分支允许物理量子态。我们研究如何在有限截断全息字典中纳入世界端点（ETW）膜。ETW 膜导致额外的边界理论形变，这取决于是否存在可归一化束缚态，从而给出黑洞或永恒可穿越虫洞几何。我们将有限截断长度计算推广到常平均曲率（CMC）切片，并将其解释为边界理论中的复杂度。我们讨论与物质耦合的可能推广。我们的结果为 DSSYK 全息字典中研究有限截断边界、CMC 切片和膜提供了微观框架。
classification.one_liner: 在双标度 SYK 中构造有限截断全息对偶，联系 TTbar 式形变、正弦膨胀子引力、ETW 膜与 CMC 复杂度。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 DSSYK/JT/AdS2 与有限截断全息，涉及 TTbar 式形变、ETW 膜和 CMC 复杂度；与用户重点标签中的超流超导、p波、多迹、QNM 等具体支线没有直接对应。

papers.title: An SYK wormhole under the microscope
papers.abstract: We derive a large-N wormhole saddle in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model for the variance of the thermal one-point function of a heavy operator across realizations of the microscopic couplings. We propose that this saddle describes a double trumpet geometry. In the double-scaling limit, we express the wormhole as a transition amplitude in an emergent bulk Hilbert space of chords connecting the two boundaries. In the Schwarzian limit, the chords proliferate and the wormhole defines a quantum transition amplitude in the open-universe Hilbert space of Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity. Comparing the SYK wormhole amplitude with its counterpart in JT gravity coupled to matter provides a direct test of the heavy-operator randomness hypothesis in SYK. The microscopic SYK couplings specify the {\alpha}-parameters of the wormhole. For a fixed realization of the couplings, we compute the observable in the corresponding {\alpha}-state. We provide the bulk wavefunction of the associated half-wormhole, which exhibits erratic correlations in the length basis that do not self-average. We extend the bulk description to the Hilbert space of a closed universe. We point out that the correlation chords from which the wormhole geometry emerges structurally resemble local observer worldlines.

classification.title_zh: 显微镜下的 SYK 虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导了 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型中重算子热单点函数在微观耦合实现上的方差的大 N 虫洞鞍点。我们提出该鞍点描述一个双喇叭几何。在双标度极限下，我们将虫洞表示为连接两个边界的新兴体 Hilbert 空间中弦的跃迁振幅。在 Schwarzian 极限下，弦大量增殖，虫洞定义了 Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力开宇宙 Hilbert 空间中的量子跃迁振幅。将 SYK 虫洞振幅与 JT 引力耦合物质中的对应振幅比较，可直接检验 SYK 中的重算子随机性假设。微观 SYK 耦合指定虫洞的 α 参数。对于固定的耦合实现，我们计算相应 α 态中的观测量。我们给出关联半虫洞的体波函数，其在长度基中表现出不会自平均的无序关联。我们将体描述扩展到闭合宇宙的 Hilbert 空间。我们指出，虫洞几何从中涌现的关联弦在结构上类似于局部观测者世界线。
classification.one_liner: 用双标度/Schwarzian 极限和半虫洞波函数刻画 SYK 虫洞，并与 JT 引力耦合物质比较以检验重算子随机性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文讨论 SYK/JT 虫洞、半虫洞与 α 态，不属于用户列出的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7 或经典引力等重点支线。

papers.title: Worldsheet string theory on $\mathrm{AdS}_3 \times \mathbf{S}^3 \times \mathrm{K3}$
papers.abstract: The RNS formalism describing string theory on $\mathrm{AdS}_3 \times \mathbf{S}^3 \times \mathrm{K3}$ supported by pure NS-NS flux is in principle straightforward to write down. One can directly check that the worldsheet theory reproduces the correct chiral spectrum expected from supergravity by analyzing the BRST cohomology. However, when one attempts to construct the worldsheet partition function using the standard rules of the RNS formalism by appropriately summing over spin structures to ensure worldsheet modular invariance, one finds a result in tension with spacetime supersymmetry. We explain why this is the case and, more importantly, propose a resolution. Specifically, we fix the physical state projection for the partition function uniquely by requiring spacetime supersymmetry. Perhaps surprisingly, the projected worldsheet partition function does not factorize into a bosonic and a fermionic part and involves functions that are not modular covariant. As a consistency check, we show that our prescription for the worldsheet partition function reproduces the supergravity spectrum for both Type IIB and IIA theories. Furthermore, we compute the elliptic genus of the dual CFT from the worldsheet, which has both a holomorphic short string and a non-holomorphic long string contribution. The latter displays characteristics of a mock modular function, albeit with some key differences, while the former has the tantalizing structure of a symmetric orbifold. We also point out the worldsheet construction of a non-supersymmetric theory, whose spectrum is free of tachyons.

classification.title_zh: AdS₃ × S³ × K3 上的世界面弦理论
classification.abstract_zh: 描述 AdS₃ × S³ × K3 上由纯 NS-NS 通量支撑的弦理论的 RNS 形式原则上可以直接写出。通过分析 BRST 上同调，可以直接检验世界面理论是否再现超引力所预期的正确手征谱。然而，当试图按照 RNS 形式的标准规则构造世界面配分函数，并通过对自旋结构适当求和来保证世界面模不变性时，所得结果与时空超对称存在矛盾。我们解释其原因，更重要的是提出一种解决方案。具体来说，我们通过要求时空超对称，唯一地固定配分函数的物理态投影。也许令人意外的是，投影后的世界面配分函数并不分解为玻色部分和费米部分，并且涉及非模协变的函数。作为一致性检验，我们证明该世界面配分函数方案能够同时再现 Type IIB 和 IIA 理论的超引力谱。此外，我们从世界面计算对偶 CFT 的椭圆亏格，其中既有全纯的短弦贡献，也有非全纯的长弦贡献。后者显示出 mock 模函数的特征，但存在一些关键差异；前者则具有对称 orbifold 的诱人结构。我们还指出了一种非超对称理论的世界面构造，其谱中没有快子。
classification.one_liner: 通过要求时空超对称来固定 AdS₃ × S³ × K3 上纯 NS-NS 世界面配分函数的物理态投影，解决其与超引力谱的矛盾，并计算对偶 CFT 椭圆亏格。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息弦论与 AdS/CFT 基础方向，研究 AdS₃ × S³ × K3 世界面构造和对偶 CFT 椭圆亏格，但不直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、探针膜、经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: CHRONOS Science Program
papers.abstract: Cryogenic sub-Hz cROss torsion-bar detector with quantum NOn-demolition Speed meter (CHRONOS) is a proposed cryogenic torsion-bar interferometer for precision measurements in the 0.1-10 Hz band. A Sagnac speed-meter readout, power and signal recycling, and balanced homodyne detection provide control of the optical response and quantum measurement correlations. This White Paper describes the science program, detector design, calibration, and staged experimental development. The reference sensitivity uses a multi-input quantum model, including rear-mirror vacuum fields and measurement-back-action correlations, combined with classical noise. Two operating points are optimized for complementary power-law-integrated sensitivity objectives. Gravitational-wave forecasts use this common noise budget and state their source and observing assumptions. The program includes intermediate-mass black-hole binaries, stochastic backgrounds, quantum measurement, and terrestrial gravity perturbations. Dark-matter applications are discussed as response and feasibility studies. A differential gravitational calibrator provides a proposed Yukawa-gravity test whose systematic floor is improved by subtracting auxiliary harmonics. These are conditional projections: experimental reach requires validation of the noise, transfer functions, environmental backgrounds, and systematic uncertainties described here.
authors: Yuki Inoue (on behalf of CHRONOS collaboration)

classification.title_zh: CHRONOS 科学计划
classification.abstract_zh: 带量子非破坏速度计的低温亚赫兹交叉扭秤探测器（CHRONOS）是一个提议中的低温扭秤干涉仪，用于 0.1–10 Hz 波段的精密测量。Sagnac 速度计读出、功率和信号回收以及平衡零拍探测提供了对光学响应和量子测量关联的控制。本白皮书描述了科学计划、探测器设计、校准和分阶段实验发展。参考灵敏度使用多输入量子模型，包括后镜真空场和测量-反作用关联，并结合经典噪声。两个工作点针对互补的幂律积分灵敏度目标进行优化。引力波预测使用这一共同噪声预算，并说明其源和观测假设。该计划包括中等质量黑洞双星、随机背景、量子测量和地面引力扰动。暗物质应用作为响应和可行性研究进行讨论。差分引力校准器提供了一个提议的汤川引力检验，其系统本底通过减去辅助谐波而得到改善。这些都是条件性预测：实验能力需要验证本文描述的噪声、传递函数、环境本底和系统不确定性。
classification.one_liner: CHRONOS 白皮书提出低温扭秤干涉仪与量子非破坏速度计读出，用于 0.1–10 Hz 引力波探测、量子测量与引力/暗物质检验。

papers.title: Pseudo-spectral methods in gravitational lensing: Spin precession in loop quantum black hole spacetimes
papers.abstract: Gravitational lensing is usually treated as an initial value problem: for a given impact parameter of an unbound orbit, one computes the resulting deflection angle. In this paper we advocate the inverse point of view. For a prescribed deflection angle, the orbit is selected by two boundary conditions at spatial infinity, so that the lensing problem becomes a well-defined two-point boundary value problem, with the impact parameter playing the role of a nonlinear eigenvalue. We show that pseudo-spectral methods based on Chebyshev collocation solve this boundary value problem accurately at modest computational cost, and that the parallel transport equations governing the spin precession of the particle reduce to a single linear system on the same grid. As a concrete application, we compute the spin precession of massive particles in backward scattering off two black hole spacetimes from loop quantum gravity: the covariant effective metric and the self-dual loop quantum black hole. All equations are written for a general static, spherically symmetric line element with three free functions, so that both spacetimes are handled on the same footing. We find that the quantum corrections are most pronounced for slowly moving particles, while in the ultra-relativistic limit the universal spin flip is always recovered. The flip itself is universal, but the rate at which it is approached is not: the derivative of $\cos\xi$ with respect to the particle speed at $v=1$ is a strong-field quantity in every backward channel and depends clearly on the quantum parameters of both spacetimes. The framework is not restricted to the models studied here and applies to any static, spherically symmetric spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 引力透镜中的伪谱方法：圈量子黑洞时空中的自旋进动
classification.abstract_zh: 引力透镜通常被当作初值问题处理：对于无束缚轨道的给定碰撞参数，计算相应的偏转角。本文提倡反向视角。对于规定的偏转角，轨道由空间无穷远处的两个边界条件选出，因此透镜问题成为一个适定的两点边值问题，碰撞参数扮演非线性本征值的角色。我们表明，基于 Chebyshev 配点的伪谱方法能以适中的计算成本准确求解该边值问题，并且控制粒子自旋进动的平行输运方程在同一网格上约化为一个线性系统。作为具体应用，我们计算大质量粒子在来自圈量子引力的两个黑洞时空中的后向散射自旋进动：协变有效度规和自对偶圈量子黑洞。所有方程都写为含三个自由函数的一般静态球对称线元，因此两个时空以相同方式处理。我们发现，量子修正对缓慢运动的粒子最为显著，而在超相对论极限下总能恢复普遍的自旋翻转。翻转本身是普遍的，但趋近它的速率不是：cosξ 对粒子速度在 v=1 处的导数是每个后向通道中的强场量，并明显依赖于两个时空的量子参数。该框架不限于本文研究的模型，适用于任何静态球对称时空。
classification.one_liner: 将引力透镜视为两点边值问题，用 Chebyshev 伪谱法计算圈量子黑洞时空中的大质量粒子自旋进动。
classification.relevance_reason: 主要属于经典引力/广义相对论的引力透镜与自旋进动计算，并涉及圈量子黑洞度规；不属于 AdS/CFT 全息核心方向，但直接匹配经典引力/广义相对论支线。

papers.title: Impact of the Einstein Telescope's duty cycle on the estimation of binary black holes parameters
papers.abstract: The geometry of the Einstein Telescope, the proposed next-generation European gravitational-wave observatory, is yet to be finalized. Two competing designs are under consideration: a nested triangular configuration (ET-{\Delta}) and two separated L-shaped detectors (ET-2L). Extensive prior comparisons of ET designs established the scientific landscape using the Fisher-information-matrix formalism and identified that duty-cycle-induced single-detector operation is precisely the regime where this approximation becomes less reliable, underscoring the need for a refined, principled treatment of the duty cycle. In this manuscript, we build on that foundation by revisiting the comparison with full Bayesian parameter estimation of gravitational-wave signals from binary black-hole mergers, projected onto a simulated Einstein Telescope that incorporates a refined duty cycle modelled via continuous-time Markov chains and testing different detector maintenance strategies. We find that the redundancy inherent in the ET-{\Delta} design enables it to maintain at least two operational detectors for the majority of the observing time, whereas the ET-2L configuration is often limited to a single detector. Crucially, we show that, during partial network operation, ET-{\Delta} often outperforms ET-2L, and that the increased multi-detector uptime translates into tighter constraints on the luminosity distance and source-frame component masses. Notably, this remains true even when gravitational-wave events have a lower signal-to-noise ratio in ET-{\Delta} than in ET-2L.

classification.title_zh: 爱因斯坦望远镜占空比对双黑洞参数估计的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 爱因斯坦望远镜（拟议的下一代欧洲引力波天文台）的几何结构尚未最终确定。目前考虑两种竞争设计方案：嵌套三角形构型（ET-Δ）和两个分离的 L 形探测器（ET-2L）。此前对 ET 设计的广泛比较利用 Fisher 信息矩阵形式确立了科学前景，并指出占空比导致的单探测器运行正是该近似变得不太可靠的区间，凸显了对占空比进行更精细、有原则处理的必要性。在本手稿中，我们在此基础上，用对双黑洞并合引力波信号的完整贝叶斯参数估计重新审视这一比较，并将其投影到纳入经连续时间马尔可夫链建模的精细占空比、且测试不同探测器维护策略的模拟爱因斯坦望远镜上。我们发现，ET-Δ 设计固有的冗余使其在大部分观测时间内能保持至少两个探测器运行，而 ET-2L 构型则常常局限于单探测器。关键的是，我们表明在部分网络运行期间，ET-Δ 往往优于 ET-2L，并且多探测器运行时间的增加会转化为对光度距离和源架系分量质量的更紧约束。值得注意的是，即使引力波事件在 ET-Δ 中的信噪比低于在 ET-2L 中，这一点仍然成立。
classification.one_liner: 用完整贝叶斯参数估计比较 ET-Δ 与 ET-2L 设计，发现占空比和探测器维护策略会显著影响双黑洞参数约束，且 ET-Δ 在部分网络运行时常优于 ET-2L。

papers.title: Nonoscillatory gravitational quasinormal modes of Reissner-Nordstr\"om-de Sitter spacetime
papers.abstract: We revisit quasinormal modes of Reissner-Nordstr\"om-de Sitter black holes, a classical and seemingly well-understood solution of Einstein-Maxwell theory with a positive cosmological constant. While previous studies have focused almost exclusively on the oscillatory photon-sphere branch, we show that two additional branches of nonoscillatory, purely imaginary modes - associated with the de Sitter horizon and with the regime of near-extremal charge (zero-damped) - are essential for a complete description of the spectrum. These modes have so far remained largely unexplored for gravitational perturbations despite their relevance for late-time dynamics and stability. In particular, we derive accurate analytic expressions for the purely imaginary quasinormal frequencies in the slow-damping regime, providing a complete description of this sector of the spectrum.

classification.title_zh: Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter 时空的非振荡引力准正规模式
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视 Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter 黑洞的准正规模式，这是 Einstein-Maxwell 理论中带正宇宙学常数的一个经典且看似已被充分理解的解。以往研究几乎只关注振荡的光子球分支，而我们表明，另外两个非振荡、纯虚模式分支——分别与 de Sitter 视界和近极端电荷区（零阻尼）相关——对于完整描述谱必不可少。尽管它们与晚期动力学和稳定性有关，这些模式在引力扰动中迄今大多未被探索。特别地，我们在慢阻尼区推导了纯虚准正规频率的精确解析表达式，从而完整描述该谱扇区。
classification.one_liner: RN-dS黑洞的引力QNM除振荡光子球分支外，还存在dS视界和近极端零阻尼的非振荡纯虚分支，并给出慢阻尼区解析频率。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究经典黑洞时空中的准正规模式，属于经典引力/QNM方向；与全息AdS/CFT无直接关系，但对QNM谱和慢阻尼/零阻尼分支有参考价值。

papers.title: Binary-lens amplification of starlight: from magnification flares to quasi-periodic tracking of orbital evolution
papers.abstract: Supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHB) are expected at the center of galaxies as a result of galaxy mergers. The dynamics and evolution of SMBHBs shed light on the evolution and formation of galaxies, the gravitational wave background and the nature of gravity. Many methods have been proposed to identify sub-parsec SMBHBs via the detection of gravitational waves or the modulation of the emission from the surrounding gaseous environment. In a previous study, we proposed a new method of identifying SMBHBs in non-active galactic nuclei via gravitational lensing. The caustics, i.e. the source positions with a divergent magnification, exhibit a complex extended geometry which rotates with the binary period. Each caustic-crossing produces an extreme magnification by up to a factor of $10^{6}$. In this work, we generalize the previous study and describe the rich phenomenology of binary-lens amplification of starlight (BLAST). We explore the electromagnetic transients produced when accounting for the relative proper motion of the source, either a single or a binary star, the eccentricity and precession of the SMBHB, and the relative inclination. Systems where a star rapidly drifts across the caustic produce a single- or double-peaked flare. In the opposite limit, a star with no relative proper motion produces quasi-periodic lensed starlight (QPLS), i.e., repeated peaks that track the system's orbital evolution. We determine the expected magnification and peak duration in different circumstances, and calculate the magnification curves and their Fourier transforms. This study may help construct search pipelines to identify SMBHBs in electromagnetic time-domain surveys.

classification.title_zh: 双透镜对星光的放大：从放大率耀发到轨道演化的准周期追踪
classification.abstract_zh: 超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）预期存在于星系中心，由星系并合产生。SMBHB 的动力学与演化有助于理解星系的演化与形成、引力波背景以及引力的本质。已有许多方法被提出，用于通过探测引力波或周围气体环境辐射的调制来识别亚秒差距尺度的 SMBHB。在此前研究中，我们提出了一种通过引力透镜在非活动星系核中识别 SMBHB 的新方法。焦散，即放大率发散的源位置，呈现出复杂的延展几何结构，并随双星周期旋转。每次穿越焦散会产生高达 10^6 倍的极端放大。在本工作中，我们推广此前研究，描述双透镜对星光放大（BLAST）的丰富现象学。我们探索了在考虑源（单星或双星）相对自行、SMBHB 偏心率与进动以及相对倾角时产生的电磁暂现。恒星快速漂移穿过焦散的系统会产生单峰或双峰耀发。相反极限下，无相对自行的恒星会产生准周期透镜星光（QPLS），即重复峰值，追踪系统的轨道演化。我们确定了不同情形下的预期放大率和峰值持续时间，并计算了放大率曲线及其傅里叶变换。本研究可能有助于构建搜索流程，以在电磁时域巡天中识别 SMBHB。
classification.one_liner: 本文推广双透镜星光放大（BLAST）现象学，预测 SMBHB 焦散穿越产生的单/双峰耀发与准周期信号，可用于电磁时域巡天搜寻。
