papers.title: Superhorizon enhancement of the hydrodynamic GW tail in Standard Model embedded warm inflation
papers.abstract: Hydrodynamic fluctuations in the primordial plasma generate a gravitational-wave (GW) background that grows like $f^3_\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle 0}$ in terms of the current frequency. However, within the ($10^{-4}_{ } ... 10^4_{ })\,$Hz band of upcoming interferometers, the modes likely re-entered the Hubble horizon when the hydrodynamic noise was no longer at its maximal value. To address this situation, we define a model-independent transfer function for GWs generated by hydrodynamic (or other white-noise) fluctuations at any time. Employing appropriate variables, we show how this transfer function, together with the simpler vacuum one, can be determined numerically for a general expansion history. The results are illustrated for Standard Model embedded warm inflation scenarios, including both the vacuum and hydrodynamic parts. Following previous estimates, we find that a pre-exit-generated hydrodynamic tail becomes almost flat below $(10^5_{ } ... 10^7_{ })\;$Hz. Its small-$f^{ }_\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle 0}$ intercept remains finite, and can then moderately influence observational constraints through the tensor-to-scalar ratio ($r$).

classification.title_zh: 嵌入标准模型的温暴涨中流体力学引力波尾的超视界增强
classification.abstract_zh: 原初等离子体中的流体力学涨落会生成一个引力波（GW）背景，其随当前频率按 $f^3_0$ 增长。然而，在即将运行干涉仪的 $(10^{-4} ... 10^4)$ Hz 频段内，这些模式很可能在流体力学噪声不再处于最大值时重新进入哈勃视界。为处理这种情况，我们定义了一个模型无关的传递函数，适用于由任意时刻的流体力学（或其他白噪声）涨落生成的 GW。通过采用合适变量，我们展示了对于一般膨胀历史，如何数值确定该传递函数以及更简单的真空传递函数。结果在嵌入标准模型的温暴涨情形中得到展示，包括真空和流体力学部分。沿袭先前估计，我们发现出视界前生成的流体力学尾在 $(10^5 ... 10^7)$ Hz 以下变得近乎平坦。其小 $f_0$ 截距保持有限，因此可通过张量标量比 ($r$) 适度影响观测约束。
classification.one_liner: 定义了模型无关的引力波传递函数，数值计算一般膨胀史下流体力学与真空贡献，并用于标准模型嵌入温暴涨，发现低频流体力学尾近平坦且可影响张量标量比。

papers.title: Search for Sub-Solar Mass Binaries in the First and Second Part of LIGO's Fourth Observing Run O4a-O4b
papers.abstract: The observation of sub-solar mass neutron stars and black holes would signify a new class of astrophysical objects since these systems are not expected to form via standard stellar evolution. We present the first sub-solar mass search for binaries consisting of neutron star or black holes that uses the data from both the second part (O4b) and first part (O4a) of the fourth observing run of the Advanced LIGO detectors. The search covers primary masses 0.1 to 2 $M_\odot$ and secondary masses 0.1 to 1 $M_\odot$. Tidal effects up to $7\times10^5$ are accounted for in extremely low-mass neutron stars. No statistically significant candidates are identified. We place a $90\%$ confidence upper limit on the merger rate $\mathcal{R}_{90}$ for sub-solar mass black holes and neutron stars to be $< 5.2\times10^{2}\,\textrm{Gpc}^{-3}\,\textrm{yr}^{-1}$ for a chirp mass of 0.5 $M_\odot$, a factor $2.2 \times$ lower compared to previous O1-O4a searches. We constrain the effective local dark matter fraction to be $\tilde{f}_\textrm{PBH}<0.6\%$ for $M_{\textrm{PBH}}=0.8 \,M_\odot$, approximately $1.5$ factor improvement to previous O1-O4a constraints. Given our model assumptions, our local dark matter fraction constraints are $2-7$ times lower than the OGLE microlensing survey for $M_{\textrm{PBH}}\ge{0.6}~M_\odot$.

classification.title_zh: 在LIGO第四次观测运行O4a-O4b第一和第二部分中搜寻亚太阳质量双星
classification.abstract_zh: 对亚太阳质量中子星和黑洞的观测将标志着一类新的天体物理对象，因为这些系统预计无法通过标准恒星演化形成。我们给出了首个针对由中子星或黑洞组成的双星的亚太阳质量搜寻，使用了Advanced LIGO第四次观测运行第二部分（O4b）和第一部分（O4a）的数据。搜寻覆盖主星质量0.1至2 M⊙和伴星质量0.1至1 M⊙。对极低质量中子星的潮汐效应最高达7×10^5进行了考虑。未发现统计显著的候选者。我们对亚太阳质量黑洞和中子星的并合率给出90%置信度上限 R90 < 5.2×10^2 Gpc^-3 yr^-1（在啁啾质量0.5 M⊙处），比此前O1-O4a搜寻低2.2倍。我们将有效局域暗物质分数约束为 	ilde{f}_PBH < 0.6%（对于 M_PBH=0.8 M⊙），比此前O1-O4a约束改进约1.5倍。在我们的模型假设下，对于 M_PBH ≥ 0.6 M⊙，我们的局域暗物质分数约束比OGLE微引力透镜巡天低2-7倍。

papers.title: EMRIs in Kerr Spacetime: The Role of Inclination Diffusion
papers.abstract: Extreme mass ratio inspirals (EMRIs) are expected to be a major source of gravitational waves (GWs) for the future {\it Laser Interferometer Space Antenna} ({\it LISA}). An EMRI occurs when a compact object, driven by the emission of gravitational radiation, slowly inspirals into a massive black hole (MBH). The classical formation channel involves repeated two-body interactions within dense nuclear star clusters. However, both EMRI event rates and the expected distribution of their orbital parameters remain highly uncertain. A major source of this uncertainty is the poorly constrained ratio between gradually inspiraling EMRIs and direct plunges, which do not produce detectable GWs. While most studies of astrophysical EMRI production focus on the Schwarzschild limit, previous work examining the Kerr metric found that the spin of the central MBH can significantly affect the EMRI-to-plunge ratio. This enhancement depends sensitively on orbital inclination, yet earlier studies held inclination fixed. In this work, we develop the mathematical framework describing inclination evolution driven by two-body encounters evolving along Kerr geodesics. By implementing 3D diffusion into Monte Carlo simulations, we show that initially prograde orbits may evolve into retrograde states, thereby converting potential EMRIs into plunges or vice versa. We estimate the EMRI-to-plunge ratio and find that substantial MBH spin enhances the EMRI rate by a factor of $\sim 2.5$. Additionally, even for a non-spinning MBH, modeling the orbits as relativistic geodesics rather than Newtonian trajectories increases the number of EMRIs by a similar factor of $\sim 2.5$. The distribution of Kerr EMRI inclinations has a substantial prograde bias that may aid in identifying the subset of loss cone EMRIs within large future EMRI samples.

classification.title_zh: Kerr 时空中的 EMRI：倾角扩散的作用
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋进（EMRIs）预计是未来激光干涉空间天线（LISA）的主要引力波源。EMRI 发生在一个致密天体在引力辐射驱动下缓慢旋进一个庞大黑洞（MBH）时。经典形成通道涉及致密核星团内反复的两体相互作用。然而，EMRI 事件率和其轨道参数的预期分布仍高度不确定。这种不确定性的一个主要来源是逐渐旋进的 EMRI 与不产生可探测引力波的直接坠入之间比例约束不足。虽然大多数天体物理 EMRI 产生研究聚焦于 Schwarzschild 极限，但先前检查 Kerr 度规的工作发现中心 MBH 的自旋可显著影响 EMRI 与直接坠入之比。这种增强敏感依赖于轨道倾角，然而早期研究将倾角固定。在这项工作中，我们发展了描述沿 Kerr 测地线演化的两体遭遇所驱动的倾角演化的数学框架。通过将 3D 扩散实现到 Monte Carlo 模拟中，我们表明初始顺行轨道可能演化为逆行状态，从而将潜在 EMRI 转化为直接坠入，或反之。我们估计 EMRI 与直接坠入之比，发现显著的 MBH 自旋将 EMRI 率提高约 2.5 倍。此外，即使对于非自旋 MBH，将轨道建模为相对论测地线而非牛顿轨迹也会将 EMRI 数量增加约 2.5 倍。Kerr EMRI 倾角分布具有显著的顺行偏置，这可能有助于在未来大型 EMRI 样本中识别损失锥 EMRI 子集。
classification.one_liner: 在 Kerr 时空中纳入两体遭遇驱动的倾角扩散，发现黑洞自旋与相对论测地线处理均可将 EMRI 率提高约 2.5 倍，并给出顺行偏置的倾角分布。

papers.title: Identity Crisis: Untangling Mass-Ordering Artifacts from Compact-Object Pairing in Gravitational-Wave Populations
papers.abstract: Mass distributions of binary black hole mergers inferred from gravitational-wave observations offer clues to how binaries form. These distributions conventionally label the heavier component as the primary, with mass $m_1$, and the lighter as the secondary, with mass $m_2$, such that $m_1 \geq m_2$. This ordering folds the physically labeled mass distribution along the equal-mass line, potentially reshaping the underlying population structure. In this Letter, we determine which population features can arise from mass ordering and which require genuine astrophysical structure. We show that ordering alone can produce (1) an $m_2$ distribution that declines more rapidly than the $m_1$ distribution, without intrinsic differences between the physically labeled components, and (2) an apparent concentration along equal masses, without correlations that preferentially pair black holes of equal mass. Moreover, different physically labeled populations can produce the same ordered mass distribution. Crucially, however, a preferred companion mass that remains constant as $m_1$ increases requires a characteristic mass scale already present in the physically labeled population. Applied to binary black hole mergers in the fifth Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog, our model recovers such a scale near $m_2 \simeq 50\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$. Around this scale, the merger-rate density declines much more rapidly toward higher $m_2$ than toward lower $m_2$, ruling out an equal or weaker high-$m_2$ decline at 99.45% credibility. This structure therefore requires a characteristic mass scale in at least one physically labeled component, but masses alone cannot determine which component carries it. Any formation model reproducing the observed high-mass binary black hole merger population must contain such a scale.

classification.title_zh: 身份危机：从引力波族群中厘清质量排序假象与致密天体配对
classification.abstract_zh: 从引力波观测推断的双黑洞并合质量分布，为双星如何形成提供了线索。这些分布按惯例将较重的组成部分标为主星，质量记为 m1，较轻的标为次星，质量记为 m2，使得 m1 ≥ m2。这种排序把物理标记的质量分布沿等质量线折叠，可能重塑其背后的族群结构。在本快报中，我们确定哪些族群特征可能来自质量排序，哪些需要真实的物理天体结构。我们表明，仅排序本身就能产生：(1) 一个比 m1 分布下降更快的 m2 分布，而物理标记的两个组成部分之间并没有内禀差异；(2) 沿等质量线看似集中的现象，而并不存在偏好将等质量黑洞配对的关联。此外，不同的物理标记族群也可以产生相同的排序质量分布。然而关键的是，一个随 m1 增大而保持恒定的偏好伴星质量，要求物理标记族群中已经存在特征质量尺度。将模型应用于第五次引力波瞬变星表中的双黑洞并合，我们的模型在 m2 约 50 M_sun 附近恢复出这样一个尺度。在该尺度附近，并合率密度朝更高 m2 下降得比朝更低 m2 快得多，以 99.45% 的可信度排除了高 m2 端下降相同或更弱的可能。因此，这种结构要求至少在一个物理标记的组成部分中存在特征质量尺度，但仅靠质量无法确定哪个组成部分携带该尺度。任何能够重现观测到的高质量双黑洞并合族群的形成模型都必须包含这样一个尺度。
classification.one_liner: 引力波族群中按质量排序会制造 m2 下降更快和等质量聚集等假象，但 m2 约 50 M_sun 的偏好伴星质量仍需至少一个物理标记成分中的特征质量尺度。

papers.title: Constraining the Progenitor Orbits of Sequential Black-Hole Mergers in Hierarchical Triples: Peters-Based Estimates
papers.abstract: Two black-hole merger events may originate from sequential mergers in a pre-existing hierarchical black-hole triple if their spatial localizations overlap and the remnant mass of the first merger is compatible with a component mass of the second. In this scenario, the inner binary merges first, leaving a remnant that remains bound to the tertiary and subsequently undergoes a second merger. We present a method to constrain the progenitor triple's outer orbit by modeling the gravitational-wave-driven evolution of the remnant-tertiary binary using Peters' equations. Given an assumed upper bound on the recoil velocity of the first merger, the method requires only the black-hole masses, the time delay between the mergers, and the eccentricity at a reference frequency - quantities that can be inferred from the merger events themselves. We investigate the potential constraining power by constructing a constraint atlas spanning a range of system properties and identify the conditions under which the method places tight and reliable bounds on the progenitor triple's outer orbital parameters. By imposing an upper bound on the detector-band eccentricity, we also obtain meaningful constraints for candidate hierarchical mergers proposed in the literature, including GW190514-GW190521. We provide numerical tools for applying the method to user-specified systems and evaluating the reliability of the resulting Peters-based constraints. This framework offers a computationally inexpensive first step toward reconstructing hierarchical-merger progenitors and provides a foundation for extensions incorporating more sophisticated relativistic treatments.

classification.title_zh: 限制层级三体系统中顺序黑洞并合的祖先轨道：基于 Peters 方程的估计
classification.abstract_zh: 两个黑洞并合事件若空间定位重叠，且第一次并合的残余质量与第二次并合的一个组分质量相容，则可能起源于预先存在的层级黑洞三体中的顺序并合。在此情景下，内双星先并合，留下的残余仍与第三体束缚，随后发生第二次并合。我们提出一种方法，利用 Peters 方程建模残余-第三体双星的引力波驱动演化，从而限制祖先三体的外轨道。在给定第一次并合反冲速度上限的情况下，该方法只需黑洞质量、两次并合之间的时间延迟以及参考频率处的偏心率——这些量可由并合事件本身推断。我们通过构建覆盖系统属性范围的约束图集来研究潜在约束能力，并确定该方法能对祖先三体外轨道参数给出紧致可靠限制的条件。通过对探测频段偏心率施加上限，我们还对文献中提出的候选层级并合（包括 GW190514-GW190521）获得了有意义的限制。我们提供数值工具，用于将方法应用于用户指定系统并评估所得 Peters 限制的可靠性。该框架为重建层级并合祖先提供了计算成本低的第一步，并为纳入更复杂相对论处理的扩展奠定了基础。
classification.one_liner: 利用 Peters 方程与并合事件可观测量，限制层级三体中顺序黑洞并合祖先三体的外轨道参数。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论与黑洞并合动力学，匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；但不涉及全息对偶或其他全息研究支线。

papers.title: Cubic Quasinormal Modes in the Black-Hole Ringdown
papers.abstract: We formulate and numerically solve the nonlinear Teukolsky equations through third order, obtaining a first-principles calculation of cubic quasinormal-mode amplitudes for Kerr black holes. Our approach combines lower-order metric reconstruction in split light-cone gauges with a hyperboloidal, compactified formulation solved on complex radial contours. Spin-dependent complex coupling coefficients fix the cubic amplitudes from products of their linear parent amplitudes. We apply these predictions to a nonprecessing numerical-relativity waveform, including cubic products of the $(2,2)$ fundamental mode, its first overtone, and their conjugates. The predicted cubic terms improve agreement over selected early-ringdown fitting windows and shift inferred linear-overtone amplitudes without adding fitting parameters. $3M$ after the peak of $|h_{22}|$, the summed cubic contribution reaches approximately $38\%$ of the total $h_{22}$ signal; $M$ is the initial total mass. These results identify an appreciable cubic response in early ringdown.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞铃宕中的三次准正模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构建并数值求解至三阶的非线性 Teukolsky 方程，从第一性原理计算 Kerr 黑洞的立方准正模振幅。我们的方法结合了 split light-cone 规范下的低阶度规重构，以及复径向围道上的双曲型紧致化表述。自旋相关的复耦合系数由线性母振幅的乘积确定立方振幅。我们将这些预言应用于一个无进动数值相对论波形，包括 (2,2) 基模、其第一泛音及其复共轭的三次乘积。预言的立方项在选定的早期铃宕拟合窗口内改善吻合，并在不增加拟合参数的情况下移动推断出的线性泛音振幅。在 |h22| 峰值后 3M 处，求和后的立方贡献约达到总 h22 信号的 38%；M 为初始总质量。这些结果表明早期铃宕中存在可观的立方响应。
classification.one_liner: 从第一性原理计算 Kerr 黑洞三阶非线性准正模振幅，并在数值相对论波形中发现早期铃宕约 38% 的立方响应。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接对应重点标签“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；研究 Kerr 黑洞非线性铃宕中的三次准正模。

papers.title: Search for Compact Binary Coalescences with Sub-solar Mass Components in Data from the Second Part of LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA's Fourth Observing Run
papers.abstract: We report on a gravitational wave search for compact binary coalescences with secondary mass between 0.2 M and 1 M and primary mass between 0.2 M and 10 M, restricting the component mass ratio to lie between 0.1 and 1. The analysis uses data collected by the LIGO and Virgo detectors between 2024 April 10 15:00:00 and 2025 January 28 17:00:00, the second part of the fourth observing run of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration. Results from two out of three search pipelines show outlier candidates, but not at a sufficient level of significance to provide evidence for detection. We report the combined sensitivity of the current searches over the first and second parts of the observing run to the target sub-solar mass (SSM) black hole (BH) population, as well as to neutron star (NS) binaries with one or more sub-solar component. We place upper limits on the merger rate of SSM BHs, ranging from $50 {\rm Gpc}^{-3} {\rm yr}^{-1}$ to~$5000 {\rm Gpc}^{-3} {\rm yr}^{-1}$ (90% confidence) for different component mass combinations. We use the merger rate limits to constrain two illustrative dark matter (DM) scenarios that can form SSM compact objects: primordial BHs, and dark BHs forming in a dissipative DM model. Our search limits the fraction of DM in primordial BHs, assuming a monochromatic mass distribution, to be $\leq$ (0.018-0.032) at 1 M, and $\leq$ (0.10-0.18) at 0.35 M for early-forming binaries; or to be less than 1 at masses above (0.62-0.74) M for late-forming binaries. For the dissipative model, we constrain the fraction of DM for a range of minimum dark black hole masses below $1\,M$ to be as low as (1.0-1.1) x $10^{-5}$; we also exclude minimum masses above (0.62-0.74) M, if dark BHs constitute all of the DM. For binary NSs that include sub-solar mass components, assuming a simple, fixed population model we find a merger rate upper limit of $249 {\rm Gpc}^{-3} {\rm yr}^{-1}$.
authors: J. F. J. van den Brand

classification.title_zh: 在LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA第四次观测运行第二阶段数据中搜寻含亚太阳质量组分的致密双星并合
classification.abstract_zh: 我们报告了一项引力波搜寻，目标是次级质量在0.2 M⊙至1 M⊙之间、主质量在0.2 M⊙至10 M⊙之间，且组分质量比限制在0.1至1之间的致密双星并合。分析使用了LIGO与Virgo探测器在2024年4月10日15:00:00至2025年1月28日17:00:00期间收集的数据，即LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA合作组第四次观测运行的第二阶段。三条搜寻流程中有两条给出异常候选体，但显著性不足以提供探测证据。我们报告了当前搜寻对目标亚太阳质量黑洞族群，以及对含一个或多个亚太阳质量组分的中子星双星，在观测运行第一和第二阶段合并后的灵敏度。我们对亚太阳质量黑洞并合率给出上限，不同组分质量组合下为50 Gpc^-3 yr^-1至5000 Gpc^-3 yr^-1（90%置信度）。我们利用并合率上限约束两种可形成亚太阳质量致密天体的示意性暗物质情景：原初黑洞，以及耗散暗物质模型中形成的暗黑洞。对于原初黑洞，假设单色质量分布，早期形成双星情景下暗物质占比被限制为≤(0.018-0.032)（在1 M⊙处）和≤(0.10-0.18)（在0.35 M⊙处）；晚期形成双星情景下，在高于(0.62-0.74) M⊙的质量处占比小于1。对于耗散模型，我们将最小暗黑洞质量低于1 M⊙的范围内暗物质占比限制到低至(1.0-1.1)×10^-5；若暗黑洞构成全部暗物质，还排除了高于(0.62-0.74) M⊙的最小质量。对于包含亚太阳质量组分的双中子星，假设简单的固定族群模型，我们得到并合率上限为249 Gpc^-3 yr^-1。
classification.one_liner: 利用LVK O4b数据搜寻亚太阳质量致密双星并合，未发现显著信号，并对原初黑洞等暗物质情景给出并合率与丰度上限。

papers.title: Biases in Ringdown Tests of General Relativity from Gravitational-Wave Microlensing
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave (GW) ringdown signals provide a powerful probe of the strong-field regime of general relativity (GR) through black hole spectroscopy and tests of the Kerr hypothesis. However, unmodeled propagation effects can bias the inference of remnant properties and the interpretation of ringdown features. We investigate the impact of gravitational lensing on ringdown inference and tests of GR using GW150914-like simulated signals spanning the long-wavelength, wave-optics, and geometric-optics regimes. We perform complementary time-domain post-merger and frequency-domain full inspiral--merger--ringdown analyses using unlensed waveform models. We find that lensing in the wave-optics regime can produce substantial biases in the inferred remnant mass and spin and can strongly affect the inferred modal content of the ringdown. In particular, it can spuriously favor the presence of the first overtone, with $\log_{10}\mathcal{B}^{221}_{220}\sim40$, even though the injected signal has no support for it. Parameterized ringdown tests can likewise yield strong apparent support for deviations from the Kerr quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum, with $\log_{10}\mathcal{B}^{\rm modGR}_{\rm GR}\sim8$. In contrast, the evidence for higher-order modes remains largely unchanged for the simulated signals considered here. The parameterized analysis using the entire signal further shows that microlensing can bias the inferred frequency of the dominant $(2,2,0)$ QNM. These results demonstrate that unmodeled microlensing can produce systematic biases and spurious signatures in ringdown analyses, potentially affecting precision tests of the Kerr hypothesis.

classification.title_zh: 引力波微引力透镜对广义相对论铃宕检验的偏差
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波（GW）铃宕（ringdown）信号通过黑洞光谱学和 Kerr 假设检验，为强场广义相对论（GR）提供了有力探针。然而，未建模的传播效应可能偏差对残余天体性质的推断以及对铃宕特征的解读。我们使用类似 GW150914 的模拟信号，覆盖长波长、波光学和几何光学区域，研究引力透镜对铃宕推断和 GR 检验的影响。我们使用未透镜波形模型进行互补的时域后合并和频域全 inspiral-merger-ringdown 分析。我们发现，波光学区域的透镜效应可对推断的残余质量和自旋产生显著偏差，并能强烈影响推断的铃宕模态内容。特别地，它可以虚假地偏好第一个 overtone 的存在，log10 B^{221}_{220} ~ 40，即便注入信号并无支持。参数化铃宕检验同样可以对偏离 Kerr 准正规模（QNM）谱给出强的表观支持，log10 B^{modGR}_{GR} ~ 8。相反，对于这里考虑的模拟信号，高阶模的证据基本不变。使用整个信号的参数化分析进一步表明，微引力透镜可偏差推断的主导 (2,2,0) QNM 频率。这些结果表明，未建模的微引力透镜可在铃宕分析中产生系统偏差和虚假特征，可能影响 Kerr 假设的精确检验。
classification.one_liner: 未建模的微引力透镜会在黑洞铃宕推断和广义相对论/Kerr 检验中造成显著偏差，甚至虚假偏好 overtone 和偏离 Kerr QNM 谱。

papers.title: Testing Charged Black Holes Embedded in Anisotropic Matter and Surrounded by Plasma through Gravitational Lensing: Bounds from the Sloan Lens ACS Survey
papers.abstract: We investigate weak gravitational lensing by a charged black hole surrounded by anisotropic matter, described by the two-component Kiselev metric, and immersed in a homogeneous plasma. We first examine the black hole geometry and horizon structure and then derive the weak-deflection angle from the Hamiltonian description of light propagation in plasma, using an expansion with a fixed turning point that we verify against direct numerical integration. Using the gravitational lens equation, we obtain the Einstein-ring angle, the image positions, the total magnification and the fractional magnifications of the primary and secondary images. We then confront the model with the Einstein radii of two galaxy-scale lenses of the Sloan Lens ACS Survey, J0008$-$0004 and J0029$-$0055. Because the Einstein angle cannot be smaller than the reduced deficit deflection, the observed radii give the mass-independent bounds $K<6.5\times10^{-6}$ and $K<4.2\times10^{-6}$, respectively. The charge correction to the Einstein radius is suppressed by $r_s/R_E\approx 5\times10^{-6}$ and is unobservable, while the plasma parameter at the optical wavelengths of the SLACS imaging is of order $10^{-22}$ and cannot be constrained. Our results show that galaxy-scale strong lensing data place stringent limits on anisotropic matter surrounding the lens, whereas plasma effects can be probed only at low radio frequencies.

classification.title_zh: 通过引力透镜检验嵌入各向异性物质并被等离子体包围的带电黑洞：来自斯隆透镜ACS巡天的限制
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由被各向异性物质包围的带电黑洞引起的弱引力透镜效应，该黑洞由双分量Kiselev度规描述，并浸没在均匀等离子体中。我们首先考察黑洞几何与视界结构，然后从等离子体中光传播的哈密顿描述推导弱偏折角，使用固定转向点的展开，并用直接数值积分进行验证。利用引力透镜方程，我们得到爱因斯坦环角、像位置、总放大率以及主像和次像的分式放大率。随后我们将模型与斯隆透镜ACS巡天中两个星系尺度透镜J0008−0004和J0029−0055的爱因斯坦半径进行对照。由于爱因斯坦角不能小于约化亏损偏折，观测到的半径给出与质量无关的限制K<6.5×10^-6和K<4.2×10^-6。爱因斯坦半径的电荷修正被r_s/R_E≈5×10^-6压低，不可观测；而在SLACS成像的光学波段，等离子体参数为10^-22量级，无法被限制。结果表明，星系尺度强透镜数据对透镜周围各向异性物质给出严格限制，而等离子体效应只能在低频射电波段探测。
classification.one_liner: 利用SLACS星系尺度强透镜检验Kiselev各向异性物质带电黑洞：对物质参数给出严格上限，电荷与光学波段等离子体效应不可观测。

papers.title: Quantum noise and torque correlations in a torsion-bar Sagnac speed meter
papers.abstract: Quantum fluctuations entering through weakly transmitting mirrors can limit a torsion-bar Sagnac speed meter for low-frequency gravitational-wave detection, even when its optical layout suppresses radiation-pressure back action. We show that, in the Cryogenic sub-Hz cROss torsion bar detector with quantum NOn-demolition Speed meter (CHRONOS), vacuum fields entering from behind the end and middle test masses can dominate the low-frequency quantum noise despite cancellation of the torques on opposite ends of each bar. For a reference configuration with mirror power transmissions of only $10^{-7}$, these fields contribute $89.7\%$ of the total quantum-noise power spectral density at 0.1 Hz. Omitting them would underestimate the amplitude spectral density by a factor of 3.11. Our input-output model connects the correlations produced by successive optical interactions to the forces on each bar and the measured signal. This connection shows why strong torque cancellation does not, by itself, ensure a corresponding improvement in detector sensitivity. Replacing mirror transmission with absorption at fixed reflectivity leaves the excess quantum noise essentially unchanged for the two operating points studied. The predicted signal response and quantum noise agree with independent FINESSE 3 calculations as recycling detuning and homodyne angle are varied. These results establish rear vacuum fields as a limiting noise source in this torsion-bar speed meter and provide quantitative requirements for its mirror and readout design.

classification.title_zh: 扭转棒 Sagnac 速度计中的量子噪声与力矩关联
classification.abstract_zh: 通过弱透射镜进入的量子涨落可以限制用于低频引力波探测的扭转棒 Sagnac 速度计，即使其光学布局抑制了辐射压反作用。我们表明，在 CHRONOS（Cryogenic sub-Hz cROss torsion bar detector with quantum NOn-demolition Speed meter）中，从端部与中间测试质量背后进入的真空场可以主导低频量子噪声，尽管每根棒两端力矩相互抵消。对于镜面功率透射率仅为 10^{-7} 的参考配置，这些场在 0.1 Hz 处贡献了总量子噪声功率谱密度的 89.7%。若忽略它们，会将幅度谱密度低估 3.11 倍。我们的输入-输出模型将连续光学相互作用产生的关联与每根棒所受的力以及测量信号联系起来。这一联系表明，强力矩抵消本身并不能保证探测器灵敏度相应改善。在固定反射率下用吸收替代镜面透射，对于所研究的两个工作点，过量量子噪声基本不变。随着循环失谐和零差角变化，预测的信号响应与量子噪声与独立的 FINESSE 3 计算一致。这些结果确立了后向真空场是该扭转棒速度计中的限制性噪声源，并为其镜面和读出设计提供了定量要求。
classification.one_liner: CHRONOS 扭转棒 Sagnac 速度计中，后向真空场在 0.1 Hz 主导低频量子噪声，强力矩抵消本身不足以改善灵敏度。

papers.title: A catalog of long, eccentric and precessing binary black hole simulations from ICTS-TIFR
papers.abstract: We present a catalogue of 31 binary black hole simulations performed with the Spectral Einstein Code (SpEC) on the Sonic cluster at ICTS-TIFR, Bengaluru between August 2023 and December 2024, targeting the sparsely covered corner of parameter space in which orbital eccentricity and spin-orbit precession are present simultaneously: 17 configurations are both eccentric and precessing, spanning mass ratios $1 \le q \le 11$ and initial eccentricities up to $\hat{e}_0 = 0.40$. The longest, EccPrecDiff002, inspirals for 80 orbits (159 gravitational-wave cycles), to our knowledge the longest simultaneously eccentric and precessing binary black hole evolution to date. Compile-time optimisation of SpEC and its third-party library stack for the AMD Zen-2 architecture delivered a 90% speedup of the initial-data solver and a 40% speedup of the evolution, roughly half of the latter traceable to a single defect in how pre-2.34 glibc reported cache topology on AMD processors. The campaign consumed $1.18 \times 10^{6}$ CPU-hours. We document the post-processing pipeline and validate the frame transformation and waveforms. Eccentricity is measured from the waveforms and compared against the initial data. The first law of binary black hole mechanics, a test of approximate helical symmetry, is satisfied to better than 0.54% for every configuration with $e_{\omega} < 0.2$, and we show that even precessing systems can be regarded as possessing approximate helical symmetry in the co-precessing frame. Using the aligned-spin simulations to calibrate the numerical floor, the co-precessing approximation's mirror-symmetry violation lies three to four ordersof magnitude above it, growing from 0.7% to 5.3%with opening angle. EccPrecDiff002 spans the band above 5 Hz without hybridisationfor $M \le 62\,M_\odot$, giving a single-interferometer signal-to-noise ratio of 961 in Cosmic Explorer at 1 Gpc.

classification.title_zh: ICTS-TIFR 的长、偏心且进动双黑洞模拟目录
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示了使用 Spectral Einstein Code (SpEC) 在 ICTS-TIFR, Bengaluru 的 Sonic 集群上，于 2023 年 8 月至 2024 年 12 月期间进行的 31 个双黑洞模拟目录，针对参数空间中轨道偏心率和自旋-轨道进动同时存在的稀疏覆盖角落：17 个构型既偏心又进动，质量比范围 1 ≤ q ≤ 11，初始偏心率最高达 ê0 = 0.40。最长的 EccPrecDiff002 螺旋下降 80 圈（159 个引力波周期），据我们所知是迄今最长的同时偏心且进动的双黑洞演化。针对 AMD Zen-2 架构对 SpEC 及其第三方库栈的编译时优化使初始数据求解器加速 90%，演化加速 40%，其中约一半可追溯到 pre-2.34 glibc 在 AMD 处理器上报告缓存拓扑的一个缺陷。该活动消耗了 1.18×10^6 CPU 小时。我们记录了后处理流程并验证了框架变换和波形。偏心率从波形中测量，并与初始数据进行比较。双黑洞力学第一定律（近似螺旋对称的检验）对于每个 eω < 0.2 的构型满足优于 0.54%，并且我们表明，即使在进动系统中，在共进动框架中也可视为具有近似螺旋对称。使用对齐自旋模拟校准数值地板，共进动近似的镜面对称违反比该地板高出三到四个数量级，并随开角从 0.7% 增加到 5.3%。EccPrecDiff002 在 M ≤ 62 M⊙ 时无需混合即可跨越 5 Hz 以上的频带，在 Cosmic Explorer 中在 1 Gpc 处给出单干涉仪信噪比 961。
classification.one_liner: 该论文发布了一个包含 31 个长、偏心且进动双黑洞数值相对论模拟的目录，并验证了共进动框架中的近似螺旋对称及波形精度。

papers.title: Hierarchical Parameter Estimation for Intrinsic Parameters of Extreme-mass-ratio Inspirals Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) stand as prime targets for future space-borne gravitational wave (GW) detectors, yet their precise parameter estimation is severely hindered by waveform complexity and high-dimensional parameter spaces. In this work, we propose a deep learning framework capable of recovering the seven intrinsic EMRI parameters without relying on detailed priors for extrinsic parameters. Our approach first employs a U-Net to extract robust signal features from noisy time-frequency data. These features are then fed into a multi-channel convolutional neural network (CNN) equipped with a dual attention mechanism, which decouples the time and frequency dimensions to jointly model long-range temporal evolution and persistent spectral structures, thereby enhancing sensitivity to EMRI time-frequency ridges in noisy data. Remarkably, this method reduces the search ranges for the parameters $\{\log M, a, \mu, e_0, p_0 \}$ and $\{t_p, {x_I}_0 \}$ by factors of $\sim 10^{2}$ and $\sim 10^{1}$, respectively, effectively shrinking the total volume of the seven-dimensional parameter space by $\sim 10^{8}$. Such a dramatic reduction enables a rapid pre-screening of the intrinsic parameter space, substantially saving computational cost for subsequent full parameter estimation. Although our framework is developed with Taiji mission specifications in mind, the methodology is applicable to data from other space-borne GW detectors.

classification.title_zh: 使用深度学习对极端质量比旋近内禀参数进行分层参数估计
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋近（EMRIs）是未来空间引力波探测器的首要目标，但其精确参数估计受到波形复杂性和高维参数空间的严重制约。本工作提出一个深度学习框架，能够在不依赖外禀参数详细先验的情况下恢复七个EMRI内禀参数。该方法首先使用U-Net从含噪时频数据中提取稳健信号特征。这些特征随后输入配备双重注意力机制的多通道卷积神经网络（CNN），该机制解耦时间和频率维度，以联合建模长程时间演化和持续频谱结构，从而增强对含噪数据中EMRI时频脊的敏感性。值得注意的是，该方法将参数 {log M, a, μ, e0, p0} 和 {t_p, x_I0} 的搜索范围分别缩小约 10^2 和 10^1 倍，有效将七维参数空间总体积缩小约 10^8 倍。如此显著的缩减使得能够快速预筛选内禀参数空间，大幅节省后续全参数估计的计算成本。尽管该框架按太极任务规格开发，该方法也适用于其他空间引力波探测器的数据。
classification.one_liner: 提出U-Net加双注意力多通道CNN的深度学习框架，对EMRI七个内禀参数进行快速预筛选并大幅缩小搜索范围。

papers.title: Detectability of Gravitational Waves from Extreme-Mass-Ratio Inspirals on Periodic Orbits around Bardeen Black Holes
papers.abstract: We investigate gravitational wave (GW) signatures from extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) around a Bardeen black hole, modeling the small object as a test particle, and provide a framework for probing strong-field spacetime geometry. We first present the equations of motion for test particles around a Bardeen black hole and characterize circular orbits in the parameter space of energy and angular momentum. Using Levin's classification, we adopt the extended classification scheme to classify periodic orbits around a Bardeen black hole. We then compute GW waveforms in both the time and frequency domains, as well as the corresponding characteristic strains, for these periodic orbits and compare them with the sensitivity curves of the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA), the evolved Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (eLISA), the TianQin mission, the Big Bang Observer (BBO), and the Decihertz Interferometer Gravitational wave Observatory (DECIGO). We find that detectability is controlled primarily by the luminosity distance. At a luminosity distance of 200 Mpc, the signals can exceed the sensitivity curves of BBO and DECIGO and are comparable to the LISA sensitivity curve, whereas at 2 Gpc, they remain below the sensitivity curves of all detectors considered. These results suggest that EMRIs on periodic orbits around Bardeen black holes offer a promising avenue to probe strong-field gravity and the properties of Bardeen black holes.

classification.title_zh: Bardeen黑洞周围周期轨道上极端质量比旋近的引力波可探测性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究Bardeen黑洞周围极端质量比旋近（EMRI）的引力波（GW）特征，将小天体建模为测试粒子，并提供一个探测强场时空几何的框架。我们首先给出Bardeen黑洞周围测试粒子的运动方程，并在能量和角动量参数空间中刻画圆轨道。利用Levin分类法，我们采用扩展分类方案对Bardeen黑洞周围的周期轨道进行分类。然后，我们计算这些周期轨道在时域和频域中的GW波形以及相应的特征应变，并将其与激光干涉空间天线（LISA）、演化LISA（eLISA）、天琴计划、大爆炸观测者（BBO）和分赫兹干涉仪引力波天文台（DECIGO）的灵敏度曲线进行比较。我们发现可探测性主要由光度距离控制。在200 Mpc的光度距离处，信号可以超过BBO和DECIGO的灵敏度曲线，并与LISA灵敏度曲线相当；而在2 Gpc处，它们仍低于所有考虑探测器的灵敏度曲线。这些结果表明，Bardeen黑洞周围周期轨道上的EMRI为探测强场引力和Bardeen黑洞性质提供了一个有前景的途径。
classification.one_liner: 研究Bardeen黑洞周围周期轨道EMRI的引力波波形与LISA/TianQin/BBO/DECIGO可探测性，发现可探测性主要由光度距离决定。

papers.title: The WDM time-frequency transform in gravitational-wave data analysis II: Evolutionary spectrum and noise covariance
papers.abstract: Noise cannot be treated as stationary over the timescales required for upcoming gravitational-wave detectors, minutes for ground-based and months for space-based detectors. Nonstationarity leads to a non-diagonal frequency-domain noise covariance matrix, thus motivating a shift to the time-frequency domain. We introduce \emph{evolutionary power spectra} for describing nonstationary noise in the Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer time-frequency basis. Under the framework of oscillatory processes, we show that, to leading order in the ratio of the Meyer filter and the nonstationarity timescales, the evolutionary spectrum is a power-frequency distribution that can be estimated from a single noise realization. We derive the corresponding noise covariance matrix and show that it is band tri-diagonal, like its stationary counterpart. The exact covariance to all orders is positive semi-definite by construction and dense depending on the noise. We further derive the optimal tiling of the time-frequency plane that minimizes the error of a diagonal covariance approximation and show that coarse-graining the plane suppresses correlations quadratically. Using simulated data with a LISA Galactic foreground and a drifting powerlaw spectrum, we show that the stationarity approximation leads to signal-to-noise ratio loss and severely biases inference. For realistic LISA data, approximating the covariance as diagonal in the Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer domain is accurate for the narrow-band analysis of a single resolved Galactic binary, but insufficient for a broad-band analysis. Finally, we provide mitigation strategies for the wraparound correlations induced across the data time edges whenever the spectrum differs between the start and the end of the data.

classification.title_zh: 引力波数据分析中的 WDM 时频变换 II：演化谱与噪声协方差
classification.abstract_zh: 对于未来引力波探测器所需的时标，噪声不能视为平稳：地面探测器为分钟量级，空间探测器为月量级。非平稳性导致频域噪声协方差矩阵非对角，因此促使转向时频域。我们引入演化功率谱，用于在 Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer 时频基下描述非平稳噪声。在振荡过程框架下，我们证明，在 Meyer 滤波器与非平稳时标之比的首阶近似下，演化谱是一个功率-频率分布，可由单次噪声实现中估计。我们推导相应的噪声协方差矩阵，并表明它与平稳情形类似，是带状三对角的。所有阶的精确协方差按构造为半正定，并依噪声而稠密。我们进一步推导时频平面的最优铺砌，使对角协方差近似的误差最小，并表明对平面粗粒化会以二次方式抑制关联。使用含 LISA 银河系前景和漂移幂律谱的模拟数据，我们表明平稳性近似会导致信噪比损失并严重偏置推断。对于真实 LISA 数据，在 Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer 域中将协方差近似为对角，对于单个已分辨银河双星的窄带分析是准确的，但对于宽带分析则不足。最后，我们给出缓解策略，用于处理当数据开始与结束处谱不同时，在数据时间边缘跨边引起的回绕关联。
classification.one_liner: 本文在 WDM 时频基下引入演化功率谱和噪声协方差矩阵，分析非平稳噪声对引力波（尤其 LISA）数据分析的影响，并给出对角近似与边缘关联缓解策略。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于引力波数据分析与噪声协方差方法，与经典引力/引力波观测支线相关；但不属于全息、量子引力或所列全息重点方向。

papers.title: Black Hole Fine Structure
papers.abstract: In General Relativity, axial and polar black-hole perturbations share identical quasinormal-mode spectra, a property known as isospectrality. New physics can break this degeneracy, producing a spectral splitting analogous to atomic fine structure. We perform a theory-agnostic search for such splitting in gravitational-wave observations. We find no evidence for isospectrality breaking and place a combined $90\%$ upper limit of $<28.5\%$ on the relative frequency splitting. We map these constraints onto several modified-gravity theories, constraining the coupling-lengths to be $\lesssim 28\,\mathrm{km}$.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞精细结构
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论中，轴向和极向黑洞扰动具有相同的准正规模谱，这一性质称为等谱性。新物理可以打破这种简并，产生类似于原子精细结构的光谱分裂。我们对引力波观测进行理论不可知搜索以寻找这种分裂。我们没有发现等谱性破缺的证据，并对相对频率分裂给出联合 90% 上限 <28.5%。我们将这些约束映射到若干修改引力理论，将耦合长度限制为 ≲28 km。
classification.one_liner: 利用引力波观测搜索黑洞准正规模等谱性破缺，未发现证据并给出修改引力耦合长度约束。

papers.title: Strong-Field Gravitational-Wave Lensing from Ray-Traced Arrival-Time Surfaces
papers.abstract: The diffraction integral formalism has been greatly successful in describing gravitational wave lensing effects in scenarios where the wavelength of the signal is comparable to the characteristic length scale of the lens, known as the wave optics regime. However, the assumptions required to construct its integrand break down as the source approaches the strong gravity region of a black hole lens. In particular, we are interested in the lensed signal from a binary (the source) near a massive black hole (the lens). We present a new formalism for obtaining low frequency corrections to sources being lensed in the strong field regime of gravity by leveraging the fact that null geodesics obey the Hamilton--Jacobi equations. In doing so, we are able to construct a time delay surface without relying on the thin lens approximation, and solve the diffraction integral for the resulting surface directly. For a stationary source at $10M$, deep in the strong field regime, when comparing the results with a relativistic wave scattering model, we find $6.5\%$ and $0.3\%$ agreement in the peak amplification and first diffractive fringe, respectively. Furthermore, we find a $< 1\%$ agreement with the amplitude of the point mass lens with a source at $10^4 M$ in the weak field, but noticeable dephasing between the peaks of the amplification function at higher frequencies. This work allows for clean interpolation between otherwise separate regimes, valid for sources from $\sim 6M \to \infty$. It provides a transparent, physically motivated framework for computing beyond-geometric optics lensing effects in the strong field regime.

classification.title_zh: 基于射线追踪到达时间面的强场引力波透镜
classification.abstract_zh: 衍射积分形式在描述引力波透镜效应方面取得了很大成功，适用于信号波长与透镜特征长度尺度相当的情形，即波动光学区。然而，当源接近黑洞透镜的强引力区域时，构造其被积函数所需的假设会失效。我们特别关注双星（源）靠近大质量黑洞（透镜）时被透镜化的信号。我们提出一种新形式，利用零测地线满足 Hamilton--Jacobi 方程这一事实，来获得引力强场区被透镜化源的低频修正。由此，我们能够不依赖薄透镜近似地构造时间延迟面，并直接求解对应于该面的衍射积分。对于位于 10M、深处强场区的静止源，将结果与相对论波散射模型比较，我们在峰值放大率和第一衍射条纹上分别发现 6.5% 和 0.3% 的一致性。此外，对于弱场中位于 10^4 M 的源，我们发现与点质量透镜振幅有 <1% 的一致性，但在更高频率下放大函数峰值之间存在明显退相位。这项工作使得在原本分离的区域之间进行干净插值成为可能，适用于从 ~6M 到无穷远的源。它为计算强场区超越几何光学的透镜效应提供了一个透明且具有物理动机的框架。
classification.one_liner: 提出不依赖薄透镜近似的射线追踪到达时间面方法，用于计算黑洞强场区引力波透镜的低频衍射修正，并可在强场到弱场之间插值。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接属于“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线，研究强场引力波透镜、黑洞透镜与波动光学修正。

papers.title: Spinformation: do gravitational-wave events carry information beyond effective spins?
papers.abstract: While the spin vectors of binary black holes offer insight into the astrophysical formation channels of these systems, individual spins are less precisely measured through gravitational-wave observations than the effective inspiral spin $\chi_\mathrm{eff}$ and the effective precession spin $\chi_\mathrm{p}$. Reducing to effective parameters discards information in the data, but how much information is lost has yet to be demonstrated. Here we show how to quantify whether individual mergers carry information about component spins beyond the constraints implied by effective parameters (a.k.a. spinformation) and apply the technique to GWTC-5. Thresholding on information loss $\gtrsim 0.25$ bits, over $80\%$ of gravitational-wave events in GWTC-5 have component spin posteriors described by $\chi_\mathrm{eff}$ alone. Only $\sim3\%$ of gravitational-wave events have substantial spin information not explained by $\chi_\mathrm{eff}$ and $\chi_\mathrm{p}$. The catalog's component spin information is effectively two-dimensional in $\chi_\mathrm{eff}$ and $\chi_\mathrm{p}$. Using simulated signals, we find the noise realization can create or destroy over a bit of beyond-$\chi_\mathrm{eff}$ information: the structure in real data may therefore be driven by noise. At current sensitivity, component spins provide interpretive\textemdash rather than informational\textemdash advantage over effective parameters.

classification.title_zh: 自旋信息：引力波事件是否携带有效自旋之外的信息？
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞的自旋矢量可为这些系统的天体物理形成通道提供线索，但通过引力波观测，单个自旋的测量精度低于有效旋进自旋 χ_eff 和有效进动自旋 χ_p。约化为有效参数会丢弃数据中的信息，但究竟丢失多少信息尚未得到证明。本文展示如何量化单个并合事件是否携带超出有效参数所蕴含约束的分量自旋信息（即 spinformation），并将该技术应用于 GWTC-5。以信息损失 ≳0.25 bit 为阈值，GWTC-5 中超过 80% 的引力波事件的分量自旋后验可由 χ_eff 单独描述。只有约 3% 的引力波事件具有无法由 χ_eff 和 χ_p 解释的显著自旋信息。该目录中的分量自旋信息在 χ_eff 和 χ_p 中实际上是二维的。利用模拟信号，我们发现噪声实现可以产生或破坏超过 1 bit 的 beyond-χ_eff 信息：因此真实数据中的结构可能由噪声驱动。在当前灵敏度下，分量自旋相对于有效参数提供的是解释性优势，而非信息性优势。
classification.one_liner: 对 GWTC-5 的分析表明，多数引力波事件的分量自旋后验可由 χ_eff 单独描述，仅约 3% 事件存在显著超出 χ_eff 与 χ_p 的自旋信息，且噪声可能产生或消除这种表观信息。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波观测与黑洞自旋数据分析（经典引力/引力波方向），不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力；与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”相关，但不是全息主线。

papers.title: Strong Field Gravitational Lensing in Full Wave Optics
papers.abstract: Compact binaries evolving in the vicinity of massive black holes may be commonplace in the Universe, and their gravitational waves carry signatures of their environment. We study the strong lensing of these signals by the massive companion, a configuration that violates the standard assumptions of the lensing literature: geometric optics and thin lenses. Using a perturbative framework, we compute the full wave optics amplification factors for face-on and edge-on binaries, including spinning lenses. In the edge-on configuration, peak amplification does not occur at perfect source--lens--observer alignment, even for a non-spinning lens. This is a consequence of the anisotropic, coherent quadrupolar emission of the stellar-mass binary breaking the axisymmetry of the system. Restricting to the equatorial plane near the optical axis, we then find that the frequency dependence of the amplification factor is universal across every configuration studied, persisting deep into the wave optics regime. Comparing against a strong-field ray tracing calculation, we find agreement at the $\sim10\%$ level for a face-on binary lensed by a Schwarzschild black hole. In the less symmetric edge-on case only the angular peak shift and fringe spacing is reproduced to this accuracy. For a Kerr lens, the face-on amplification factor is described by its Schwarzschild counterpart to the same $\sim 10 \%$ accuracy once the effect of frame dragging is corrected for. A point mass lens, by contrast, fails to reproduce the features of the system, which may have strong implications for forecasts that adopt it for lensing by massive black holes in the strong field.

classification.title_zh: 全波光学中的强场引力透镜
classification.abstract_zh: 在巨大黑洞附近演化的致密双星在宇宙中可能很常见，其引力波携带环境特征。我们研究这些信号被大质量伴星的强透镜效应，这一构型违背了透镜文献中的标准假设：几何光学和薄透镜。使用微扰框架，我们计算了正面和侧向双星的完整波光学放大因子，包括自旋透镜。在侧向构型中，即使对于非自旋透镜，峰值放大也不发生在源-透镜-观测者完美对齐处。这是恒星质量双星各向异性、相干四极辐射打破系统轴对称性的结果。然后限制在光轴附近的赤道面，我们发现放大因子的频率依赖性在所有研究构型中是普适的，并深入波光学区域。与强场光线追踪计算比较，对于由 Schwarzschild 黑洞透镜化的正面双星，我们在约 10% 水平上一致。在对称性较低的侧向情况中，只有角峰移和条纹间距以此精度重现。对于 Kerr 透镜，一旦校正参考系拖拽效应，正面放大因子可由其 Schwarzschild 对应物以同样约 10% 精度描述。相比之下，点质量透镜无法重现系统特征，这可能对采用它进行强场大质量黑洞透镜预测有强烈影响。
classification.one_liner: 用波光学微扰框架计算强场引力透镜放大因子，发现频率依赖普适并与强场光线追踪约 10% 一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究强场引力透镜、波光学与黑洞时空，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点方向。

papers.title: Nonlinear Perturbations of Relativistic Stars
papers.abstract: We extend the general relativistic Lagrangian perturbation formalism of Friedman and Schutz [Astrophys. J. 200, 204 (1975)] beyond linear order, retaining full time dependence of the perturbations. We provide general formulae to relate the Lagrangian and Eulerian perturbations to any general perturbative order. As a proof of principle, we apply the framework to tidally perturbed relativistic stars in Regge-Wheeler gauge and reduce the second-order field and conservation equations to master equations with a nonlinear source. Projecting the source onto the star's eigenmodes, we obtain a nonlinear equation of motion for the mode amplitudes and the coupling coefficients, which describe the interactions among the eigenmodes and with the external tidal field. Approximating the tidal field and the coupling coefficients, we compute the static quadratic Love number from the quadrupolar fundamental mode alone and find that it reproduces the direct metric-matching value to a reasonable accuracy of $4\%$, up to a further correction arising from the Hamiltonian and momentum constraints of the second-order tidal field.

classification.title_zh: 相对论性星体的非线性微扰
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将 Friedman 和 Schutz [Astrophys. J. 200, 204 (1975)] 的广义相对论拉格朗日微扰形式推广到线性阶以上，并保留微扰的完整时间依赖。我们给出将拉格朗日微扰与欧拉微扰联系到任意微扰阶的一般公式。作为原理验证，我们将该框架应用于 Regge-Wheeler 规范下受潮汐扰动的相对论性星体，并把二阶场方程和守恒方程约化为带非线性源的 master 方程。将源投影到星体本征模上，我们得到模振幅与耦合系数的非线性运动方程，这些系数描述本征模之间以及与外部潮汐场的相互作用。在近似潮汐场和耦合系数后，我们仅从四极基频模计算静态二次 Love 数，发现它以约 4% 的合理精度重现直接度规匹配值，此外还有来自二阶潮汐场哈密顿约束和动量约束的进一步修正。
classification.one_liner: 将广义相对论拉格朗日微扰形式推广到非线性阶，并应用于受潮汐扰动的相对论性星体以计算静态二次 Love 数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论与相对论性星体非线性微扰/潮汐响应，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息，因此与全息主线关联较低。

papers.title: Stability and Formation of Solitonic Boson Stars
papers.abstract: We extend a previous study of the radial stability of solitonic boson stars by nonlinearly evolving them under aspherical perturbations, and by studying their formation from the collapse of scalar clouds. We focus in particular on models previously identified as radially stable, despite having positive binding energy, which ordinarily suggests that dispersion of all scalar matter is energetically preferred. A mode analysis of our 3+1 evolutions produces no evidence for the presence of a non-radial instability in any radially stable model, including those with positive binding energy. However, we do find evidence that such models do not generically form via gravitational cooling. We also find that it is possible to form another kind of compact object, which undergoes long-lasting radial oscillations and hence cannot be described as a stationary boson star. These objects may be characterized, we suggest, by energetically favoured multi-oscillating solutions to the Einstein-Klein-Gordon equations, present in certain regions of the parameter space.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 孤子玻色星的稳定性与形成
classification.abstract_zh: 我们扩展了此前关于孤子玻色星径向稳定性的研究，在非球对称微扰下对它们进行非线性演化，并研究它们由标量云塌缩形成的过程。我们尤其关注此前被认定为径向稳定、但具有正结合能的模型；正结合能通常意味着所有标量物质在能量上更倾向于弥散。对我们的 3+1 演化进行模式分析后，没有发现任何径向稳定模型（包括正结合能模型）中存在非径向不稳定性的证据。然而，我们确实发现证据表明，这类模型通常不能通过引力冷却形成。我们还发现，可以形成另一种紧致天体，它经历长时间持续的径向振荡，因此不能描述为稳态玻色星。我们认为，这些天体可能由 Einstein-Klein-Gordon 方程中能量上更有利的多振荡解来刻画，这类解存在于参数空间的某些区域。
classification.one_liner: 通过非线性演化和标量云塌缩研究孤子玻色星：径向稳定模型未显示非径向不稳定性，但通常不能经引力冷却形成，并出现长寿命径向振荡的紧致天体。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论，研究孤子玻色星的稳定性、非线性演化和形成，并涉及孤子/非均匀紧致天体，契合“经典引力/广义相对论”与“畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀”重点方向；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Classical soft theorems meet the post-Newtonian expansion
papers.abstract: Classical soft theorems govern the non-analytic structure of electromagnetic and gravitational radiation in the low-frequency regime, with the gravitational memory effect providing the canonical realization of the classical soft graviton theorem. While the soft behavior of radiation from hyperbolic scattering is well understood, its realization in gravitationally bound systems remains less explored. In this work, we study the soft structure of gravitational waveforms generated by compact binaries, focusing on the scattering of emitted radiation off the static background curvature within the multipolar post-Newtonian framework. We isolate the infrared (IR) logarithms associated with hereditary effects, including the tail-of-memory, and their higher generalizations with n-tail insertions. The resulting amplitudes exhibit a Laurent expansion in frequency space consistent with the Sahoo-Sen logarithmic soft theorems, thereby establishing a direct correspondence between gravitational memory effects, their higher-order tail corrections, and the soft expansion. We also comment on ultraviolet (UV) logarithms arising from short-distance sensitivity of the multipole expansion and their associated renormalization-group running.

classification.title_zh: 经典软定理遇上后牛顿展开
classification.abstract_zh: 经典软定理支配电磁与引力辐射在低频区间的非解析结构，引力记忆效应是经典软引力定理的典型实现。虽然双曲散射辐射的软行为已被很好理解，但它在引力束缚系统中的实现仍研究较少。本文研究致密双星产生的引力波形的软结构，重点关注在多极后牛顿框架内，发射辐射被静态背景曲率散射的过程。我们分离出与遗传效应相关的红外对数，包括记忆尾及其带 n 次尾插入的高阶推广。所得振幅在频率空间呈现洛朗展开，与 Sahoo-Sen 对数软定理一致，从而在引力记忆效应、其高阶尾修正与软展开之间建立直接对应。我们还评论了由多极展开短距离敏感性产生的紫外对数及其相关联的重整化群跑动。
classification.one_liner: 在多极后牛顿框架下分析致密双星引力波中的红外对数、记忆尾及高阶尾插入，并将其与 Sahoo-Sen 对数软定理和引力记忆效应对应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论，研究后牛顿近似下致密双星引力波波形的经典软定理、引力记忆效应与尾项对数，与重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”直接对应；不涉及全息。

papers.title: Probing scalar-tensor-induced gravitational waves in the nHz band: NANOGrav and SKA
papers.abstract: Scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) have recently attracted considerable interest, both as a possible explanation for the nanohertz signal reported by the Pulsar Timing Array (PTA) collaboration and for their connection with primordial black hole (PBH) physics. In addition to SIGWs, scalar-tensor-induced gravitational waves (STGWs) have emerged as a promising cosmological source of the stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB). In this paper, we compute the STGWs generated during a generic matter-dominated (MD) era, as well as during an early matter-dominated (eMD) epoch followed by a sudden transition to the standard radiation-dominated (RD) stage, working in the Poisson gauge. We find that, in a purely MD age, the corresponding energy density rapidly dilutes, whereas in the presence of an eMD phase it remains non-vanishing due to the short duration of the eMD period. We then investigate whether the STGW signal could provide a dominant contribution to the \texttt{NANOGrav 15-year} dataset and we forecast the prospects for its detection with future observations by the Square Kilometre Array (SKA). In particular, we consider STGWs generated during both eMD and RD eras, including their linear-order contributions. We further inject the scalar-induced contribution, both as an additional component and as the only signal, and compare the spectra against the same datasets. Our results show that, although the SIGWs still appear to provide the dominant contribution and the posteriors are tightly constrained by the requirement of avoiding PBH overproduction, the GWs induced by scalar-tensor mixing constitute a viable target for future, more sensitive nano-Hz detectors of the SGWB.

classification.title_zh: 在纳赫兹频段探测标量-张量诱导的引力波：NANOGrav 与 SKA
classification.abstract_zh: 标量诱导引力波（SIGWs）近来引起广泛关注，既可能解释脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）合作组报告的纳赫兹信号，也与原初黑洞（PBH）物理相关。除 SIGWs 外，标量-张量诱导引力波（STGWs）已成为随机引力波背景（SGWB）的一个有前景的宇宙学来源。本文在 Poisson 规范下计算了在一般物质主导（MD）时期，以及在早期物质主导（eMD）阶段随后突然过渡到标准辐射主导（RD）阶段时产生的 STGWs。我们发现，在纯 MD 时期，相应能量密度迅速稀释，而在存在 eMD 阶段时，由于 eMD 持续时间较短，能量密度保持非零。然后，我们研究 STGW 信号能否对 NANOGrav 15 年数据集提供主导贡献，并预测平方公里阵列（SKA）未来观测探测它的前景。特别地，我们考虑在 eMD 和 RD 时期产生的 STGWs，包括其线性阶贡献。我们进一步注入标量诱导贡献，既作为附加成分也作为唯一信号，并将谱与同一数据集进行比较。结果表明，尽管 SIGWs 似乎仍提供主导贡献，且后验受到避免 PBH 过量产生的紧密限制，但由标量-张量混合诱导的引力波构成未来更灵敏的纳赫兹 SGWB 探测器的可行目标。
classification.one_liner: 在 Poisson 规范下计算物质主导/早期物质主导时期的标量-张量诱导引力波，并评估其对 NANOGrav 15 年数据及 SKA 未来探测的贡献。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/宇宙学中的随机引力波背景与脉冲星计时观测，非 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶方向；但与用户标注的经典引力/广义相对论支线相关。

papers.title: Dirac Observables for Gowdy Cosmologies Regular at the Big Bang
papers.abstract: Gowdy cosmologies are exact, spatially inhomogeneous solutions of the vacuum Einstein equations which describe nonlinear gravitational waves coalescing at the big bang singularity. With toroidal spatial sections they provenly have the asymptotic velocity domination property, in that close to the big bang dynamical spatial gradients fade out and the dynamics is governed by a Carroll-type gravity theory. Here we construct an infinite set of exact Dirac observables for Gowdy cosmologies, valid off-shell, strongly, and without gauge fixing. These observables stay regular at the big bang and can be matched to much simpler Dirac observables of the Carroll-type gravity theory. Conversely, in an adapted foliation there is a systematic anti-Newtonian expansion (in inverse powers of the reduced Newton constant) of the full Dirac observables whose leading terms are the Carroll ones. In particular, this provides an off-shell generalization of the asymptotic velocity domination property.

classification.title_zh: 大爆炸处正则的 Gowdy 宇宙学的 Dirac 可观测量
classification.abstract_zh: Gowdy 宇宙学是真空 Einstein 方程的精确、空间非均匀解，描述在大爆炸奇点处汇聚的非线性引力波。对于环面空间截面，它们已被证明具有渐近速度主导性质：靠近大爆炸时，动力学空间梯度消失，动力学由 Carroll 型引力理论支配。本文为 Gowdy 宇宙学构造了一组无穷多的精确 Dirac 可观测量，有效于离壳、以强等式成立且无需规范固定。这些可观测量在大爆炸处保持正则，并可与 Carroll 型引力理论中简单得多的 Dirac 可观测量相匹配。反过来，在适配叶状结构中，完整 Dirac 可观测量存在系统的反牛顿展开（按约化 Newton 常数的逆幂展开），其领头项正是 Carroll 项。特别地，这给出了渐近速度主导性质的一个离壳推广。
classification.one_liner: 为 Gowdy 宇宙学构造在大爆炸处正则的精确 Dirac 可观测量，并推广 Carroll 型主导性质。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 Gowdy 宇宙学、真空 Einstein 方程精确解、Dirac 可观测量与 Carroll 型引力，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息。

papers.title: All toric Hermitian ALE gravitational instantons
papers.abstract: We prove that the only smooth, Ricci flat, ALE gravitational instanton with a toric Hermitian non-K\"ahler structure is the Eguchi-Hanson instanton. The proof is analogous to the classification of toric Hermitian ALF instantons by Biquard and Gauduchon, although we avoid the use of toric K\"ahler geometry and instead perform a direct global analysis of the Tod form of the metric in Weyl-Papapetrou coordinates. This supports a conjecture by Gibbons and Bando-Kasue-Nakajima which states that any Ricci flat ALE instanton is self-dual.

classification.title_zh: 所有环面 Hermitian ALE 引力瞬子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，具有环面 Hermitian 非 Kähler 结构的唯一光滑、Ricci 平坦、ALE 引力瞬子是 Eguchi-Hanson 瞬子。证明类似于 Biquard 和 Gauduchon 对环面 Hermitian ALF 瞬子的分类，但我们避免使用环面 Kähler 几何，而是在 Weyl-Papapetrou 坐标中对度量的 Tod 形式进行直接的整体分析。这支持 Gibbons 以及 Bando-Kasue-Nakajima 的猜想：任何 Ricci 平坦 ALE 瞬子都是自对偶的。
classification.one_liner: 证明在环面 Hermitian 非 Kähler 情形下，唯一光滑 Ricci 平坦 ALE 引力瞬子是 Eguchi-Hanson 瞬子，支持 ALE 瞬子自对偶猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于用户列出的“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线，研究 Ricci 平坦 ALE 引力瞬子的分类；但它不属于全息/AdS-CFT 研究。

papers.title: Conformal Anomalies and Generalised Energy Conservation in De Sitter Spacetime
papers.abstract: We show that for bulk discrete series fields whose dual operators have integer conformal dimensions, the Generalised Energy Conservation (GEC) condition for de Sitter (dS) scattering amplitudes defined in even-dimensional extended Poincar\'e spacetime corresponds precisely to the absence of boundary conformal anomalies, including beta-function contributions, at the level of tree-level contact interactions. In contrast, holographic consistency in AdS/CFT enforces only the locality of the conformal anomaly. We find novel, unique four-point interactions involving three identical conformally coupled scalars and one discrete series scalar by performing both GEC and holographic bootstraps. This demonstrates that the solutions to GEC form a measure-zero subset of the holographically consistent solutions. Our holographic analysis agrees precisely with the expected renormalisation conditions for conformal field theory correlators. In addition, the constraint for a particular four-point configuration may be relevant for testing holographic consistency of scale-separated non-supersymmetric AdS$_4$ vacua.

classification.title_zh: 德西特时空中的共形异常与广义能量守恒
classification.abstract_zh: 我们表明，对于对偶算符具有整数共形维数的体离散系列场，在偶数维扩展庞加莱时空中定义的德西特（dS）散射振幅的广义能量守恒（GEC）条件，在树级接触相互作用层面，精确对应于边界共形异常的缺失，包括 beta 函数贡献。相比之下，AdS/CFT 中的全息自洽性仅强制要求共形异常的局域性。通过执行 GEC 和全息 bootstrap，我们发现了涉及三个相同的共形耦合标量和一个离散系列标量的新颖且唯一的四点相互作用。这表明 GEC 的解构成全息自洽解的测度为零子集。我们的全息分析与共形场论关联函数所期望的重整化条件精确一致。此外，特定四点构型的约束可能有助于检验尺度分离的非超对称 AdS4 真空的全息自洽性。
classification.one_liner: 论文比较 dS 散射振幅的广义能量守恒条件与 AdS/CFT 全息自洽性，发现 GEC 解是全息自洽解的测度为零子集，并给出新的四点相互作用。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 dS/AdS 全息与共形异常方向，涉及全息自洽性和 bootstrap，但不直接落在用户列出的全息超流超导、p波多分量、畴壁孤子涡旋、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 或经典引力等重点支线上。

papers.title: Coherent Release Fronts in Krylov Chains and Thermal AdS$_2$ Response
papers.abstract: We study coherent release from a finite serial Krylov sector into an exact conformal tail with asymptotically linear Lanczos coefficients. We derive the cumulative occupation up to a cut that moves to greater Krylov depth with time, tracking the probability accumulated behind the propagating front. This quantity separates the release dynamics of the finite sector from subsequent propagation through the tail. The tail sets the logarithmic transit scale, while the finite sector shapes the resulting distribution. The early edge records the number of serial steps before emission, while the late edge reflects slow resonances and interference and can also exhibit logarithmic enhancements. Thus, one- and two-site sectors can share the same leading resonance in their continued-fraction descriptions yet produce distinct cumulative occupation patterns. We illustrate this framework in thermal AdS$_2$, where a dressed oscillator yields, in the weak-coupling limit, a two-site shallow sector coupled to the conformal tail.

classification.title_zh: Krylov 链中的相干释放前沿与热 AdS2 响应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究从有限序列 Krylov 扇区向具有渐近线性 Lanczos 系数的精确共形尾的相干释放。我们推导了截至一个随时间移动到更大 Krylov 深度的切割的累积占据数，追踪在传播前沿之后积累的概率。该量将有限扇区的释放动力学与随后穿过尾的传播分离开来。尾设定了对数渡越尺度，而有限扇区决定了最终分布的形状。早期边缘记录了发射前的序列步数，晚期边缘反映了慢共振与干涉，并可表现出对数增强。因此，单格点和双格点扇区可在其连分数描述中共享相同的主导共振，却产生不同的累积占据模式。我们在热 AdS2 中说明该框架，其中一个缀饰振子在弱耦合极限下给出一个耦合到共形尾的双格点浅扇区。
classification.one_liner: 研究有限 Krylov 扇区向共形尾的相干释放，并在热 AdS2 中用缀饰振子给出弱耦合双格点浅扇区示例。
classification.relevance_reason: 未命中用户列出的重点标签；主题为 Krylov 复杂度与热 AdS2 响应，属于全息量子信息相关，但不属于指定研究支线。

papers.title: Numerical Sasaki--Einstein metrics and harmonic forms on del Pezzo links
papers.abstract: We numerically construct the Sasaki--Einstein metric on the link of the cone over the second del Pezzo surface $\mathrm{dP}_2$ and two primitive harmonic basic $(1,1)$-forms at its irregular volume-minimizing Reeb vector. Being toric, the metric in symplectic coordinates is encoded in a single convex function on a polygon. We approximate the correction to the canonical Guillemin potential in two ways: polynomial expansion and neural networks. The polynomial fit achieves a held-out mean-squared Monge--Amp\`ere residual below $10^{-13}$, in contrast to the $10^{-2}$ plateau for the non-volume-minimizing regular Reeb vector. We validate our method against closed-form metrics of $Y^{p,q}$ using curvature invariants, and also against the numerical result of Doran et al. (2007) for the K\"ahler--Einstein metric of $\mathrm{dP}_3$ using the Laplacian spectrum of low torus-invariant modes. The integrated Riemann-squared curvature of the $\mathrm{dP}_2$ link agrees to two parts in $10^{9}$ with the closed form conjectured from the dual field theory. Our data for the metric and harmonic forms can be used to study warped non-conformal holographic IIB backgrounds, the analogues of the Klebanov--Tseytlin solution on the conifold.

classification.title_zh: del Pezzo 链环上的数值 Sasaki-Einstein 度规与调和形式
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在第二 del Pezzo 曲面 dP2 上锥的链环上数值构造了 Sasaki-Einstein 度规，并在其非规则的体积最小化 Reeb 矢量处构造了两个原初调和基本 (1,1)-形式。由于该几何是环面的，辛坐标中的度规可由多边形上的单个凸函数编码。我们用两种方式近似对规范 Guillemin 势的修正：多项式展开和神经网络。多项式拟合在留出集上的 Monge-Ampère 均方残差低于 10^{-13}，而对非体积最小化的规则 Reeb 矢量则停留在 10^{-2} 的平台。我们用曲率不变量对 Y^{p,q} 的闭式度规验证了方法，并利用低环面不变模的 Laplacian 谱对 Doran 等人 (2007) 关于 dP3 的 Kähler-Einstein 度规的数值结果进行了验证。dP2 链环的积分 Riemann 平方曲率与由对偶场论猜出的闭式结果吻合到十亿分之二。我们的度规与调和形式数据可用于研究翘曲非共形全息 IIB 背景，即 conifold 上 Klebanov-Tseytlin 解的类似物。
classification.one_liner: 数值构造 dP2 链环上的 Sasaki-Einstein 度规与两个调和基本 (1,1)-形式，并验证其曲率积分与对偶场论猜想一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息对偶的几何/超引力背景构造，涉及 Sasaki-Einstein 度规与 IIB 背景，但不直接落在用户列出的全息超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/Floquet 等重点支线。

papers.title: Tripartite Form Universality in Holographic Entropy Inequalities
papers.abstract: To elucidate the meaning of holographic entropy inequalities (beyond subadditivity) which characterize the entanglement structure of geometric states in holography, arXiv:2309.06296 proposed the "tripartite form" for these inequalities, consisting of tripartite information and conditional tripartite information terms with unit coefficients. While this provides a compact and useful packaging of the inequalities, it is not a priori guaranteed that all inequalities can be recast in this form. Here we conjecture that they can, and present substantial evidence, by proving that the two known infinite families of holographic entropy inequalities found in arXiv:2309.15145 can indeed be written in the tripartite form. This is significant because such recasting is particularly nontrivial for these families. Apart from providing the explicit tripartite form expressions for every member of these two infinite families, we detail how we arrived at them, in the process deriving several useful identities which may serve as stepping stones to formulate further repackaging of the corresponding information quantities. We also illustrate the power of the tripartite form by proving a number of structural properties satisfied by any holographic entropy inequality.

classification.title_zh: 全息熵不等式中的三分体形式普适性
classification.abstract_zh: 为阐明全息熵不等式（超越次可加性）的含义——这些不等式刻画全息中几何态的纠缠结构——arXiv:2309.06296 提出了这些不等式的“三分体形式”，由系数为 1 的三分体信息和条件三分体信息项组成。尽管这为不等式提供了紧凑且有用的打包方式，但先验地并不能保证所有不等式都能重写为此形式。这里我们猜想它们可以，并提供大量证据：证明 arXiv:2309.15145 中发现的已知两个无限族全息熵不等式确实可以写成三分体形式。这一点很重要，因为对于这些族而言，这种重写尤其非平凡。除了给出这两个无限族每个成员的显式三分体形式表达式外，我们还详述了如何得到它们，并在此过程中推导出若干有用恒等式，这些恒等式可能成为进一步重新打包相应信息量的垫脚石。我们还通过证明任何全息熵不等式都满足的若干结构性质，说明了三分体形式的能力。
classification.one_liner: 论文猜想并证明已知两个无限族全息熵不等式均可重写为三分体形式，并证明若干结构性质。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息纠缠熵/量子信息理论，但与你列出的全息超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、经典引力等具体支线不直接对应。

papers.title: Genus-One Rigidity of Bounded Virasoro Pairings for 3D Gravity
papers.abstract: We study whether varying the topological boundary of the doubled Virasoro TQFT can produce distinct torus pairings for an ensemble interpretation of 3D gravity. In the ordinary nondegenerate sector, every bounded pairing that commutes with the modular transformations is scalar, and vacuum normalization selects the diagonal pairing. The proof identifies the modular transformations with the even Weil representation and applies the Cowling--Steger lattice-restriction theorem. Under the ordinary block-diagonal vacuum--continuum ansatz, positivity and the two vacuum marginals also make a Borel-measure pairing bounded, without assuming absolute continuity; modular invariance then forces the same diagonal pairing. These two classes therefore contain no distinct torus pairings to average. A nontrivial Virasoro boundary ensemble must involve genus-one data outside these classes, additional sectors or vacuum--continuum couplings, or information invisible in the torus pairing. Elementary proofs in explicit regular sectors explain the rigidity mechanisms, and numerical calculations provide independent checks.

classification.title_zh: 三维引力中有界 Virasoro 配对的亏格一刚性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究改变双倍 Virasoro TQFT 的拓扑边界能否为三维引力的系综解释产生不同的环面配对。在通常的非退化 sector 中，每个与模变换对易的有界配对都是标量，真空归一化选择对角配对。证明将模变换等同于偶 Weil 表示，并应用 Cowling--Steger 格限制定理。在通常的块对角真空--连续谱 ansatz 下，正性以及两个真空边际也使得 Borel 测度配对有界，而不必假设绝对连续性；模不变性随后强制同样的对角配对。因此这两类中没有可供平均的不同环面配对。非平凡的 Virasoro 边界系综必须涉及这些类别之外的亏格一数据、额外 sector 或真空--连续谱耦合，或者环面配对中不可见的信息。显式正规 sector 中的初等证明解释了刚性机制，数值计算提供了独立检验。
classification.one_liner: 在双倍 Virasoro TQFT 中，与模变换对易的有界环面配对在通常非退化 sector 和真空--连续谱 ansatz 下均被迫为对角配对，因此亏格一层面上不存在可供平均的不同配对。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于 AdS3/CFT2、Virasoro TQFT 与三维引力系综的数学结构研究，未直接涉及用户列出的全息超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7 或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Universal Closed Form for Dynamical Love Numbers of Black Holes
papers.abstract: Black hole static Love numbers vanish, but their dynamical counterparts do not. We present the entire scheme-independent dynamical response $\bar{F}_{\ell,s}$ of a Schwarzschild black hole in closed form, to all orders in $G$, and for every spin $s$ and multipole $\ell$. The result is $\bar{F}_{\ell,s}/4\pi R_S^{2\ell+1}=\Phi_{\ell,s}(\bar{y})-\tfrac12\eta\,\Phi_{\ell,s}'(\bar{y})$ with $\bar{y}=-\tfrac12\eta^2\tau$ and $\eta=i\omega R_S$. Here $\Phi_{\ell,s}$ is simply the leading-log solution to the renormalization group equation, but lifting the running logarithm to $\tau=\log(R_S/R)-2\sum_{k\ge2}\zeta_k\,\eta^{k-1}$ resums it to all orders. This tower of Riemann zeta values is the Newtonian phase in disguise: it originates from the long-range $1/r$ potential in the far zone, and is universal across multipole and spin. Our result exhibits a factorization pinned to three ingredients: the strength of horizon absorption, the running rate in the near zone, and the dressed logarithm in the far zone. Using shell effective field theory, we independently verify our formula for scalar, electromagnetic, and gravitational perturbations, reaching $\mathcal O(G^{15})$.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞动态 Love 数的普适闭式表达式
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞静态 Love 数消失，但其动态对应量不为零。我们以闭式给出 Schwarzschild 黑洞的完整、与方案无关的动态响应 \bar{F}_{\ell,s}，精确到 G 的所有阶，并适用于任意自旋 s 和多重极 \ell。结果为 \bar{F}_{\ell,s}/4\pi R_S^{2\ell+1}=\Phi_{\ell,s}(\bar{y})-\tfrac12\eta\,\Phi_{\ell,s}'(\bar{y})，其中 \bar{y}=-\tfrac12\eta^2\tau，\eta=i\omega R_S。这里 \Phi_{\ell,s} 只是重正化群方程的首个对数解，但将跑动对数提升为 \tau=\log(R_S/R)-2\sum_{k\ge2}\zeta_k\,\eta^{k-1} 后，可将其重求和到所有阶。这串 Riemann zeta 值实际上是伪装的牛顿相位：它源于远区长程 1/r 势，并在多重极和自旋上具有普适性。我们的结果呈现一种由三个要素决定的因子化：视界吸收强度、近区跑动率以及远区修饰对数。利用壳层有效场论，我们独立验证了标量、电磁和引力扰动情形下的公式，达到 \mathcal O(G^{15})。
classification.one_liner: 给出 Schwarzschild 黑洞动态 Love 数的全阶普适闭式，并揭示其由视界吸收、近区跑动和远区修饰对数因子化。

papers.title: Some universalities in the partition functions of low-dimensional gravity models
papers.abstract: In this work, first, we discuss the connections between various low-dimensional quantum gravity models, including 3d Chern-Simons, 2d Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT), 2d background field (BF) theory, 2d Liouville, 2d Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW), and 1d Schwarzian, which are related through holography and dimension reduction, and discuss some universalities in their partition functions. Then, we specifically examine the JT partition function and the partition function of $\mathcal{N}=(2,2)$ on $S^2$ and $\text{AdS}_2$ and discuss their similarities and therefore examine our proposed universalities. We change the parameters in each model and based on the change in the structure of the partition functions, strengthen our conjectures. We also use eigenfunctions, spectra and the behaviors of Wheeler-DeWitt wavefunctions to generate more universalities between these low-dimensional quantum gravity models, specifically in their partition functions. Finally, we use entanglement entropy, complexity and RG flows, particularly in the context of wormholes, to find more universalities in quantum gravity models.

classification.title_zh: 低维引力模型配分函数中的若干普适性
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，首先，我们讨论了各种低维量子引力模型之间的联系，包括3d Chern-Simons、2d Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT)、2d背景场(BF)理论、2d Liouville、2d Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW)和1d Schwarzian，它们通过全息和对偶降维相关联，并讨论了它们配分函数中的一些普适性。然后，我们特别研究了JT配分函数以及S^2和AdS_2上N=(2,2)的配分函数，讨论了它们的相似性，从而检验我们提出的普适性。我们改变每个模型中的参数，并根据配分函数结构的变化，加强我们的猜想。我们还使用本征函数、谱和Wheeler-DeWitt波函数的行为来在这些低维量子引力模型之间产生更多的普适性，特别是在它们的配分函数中。最后，我们使用纠缠熵、复杂度和RG流，特别是在虫洞的背景下，来寻找量子引力模型中更多的普适性。
classification.one_liner: 探讨低维量子引力模型（3d CS、2d JT/BF/Liouville/WZW、1d Schwarzian）配分函数间的普适性，并用谱、Wheeler-DeWitt波函数、纠缠熵、复杂度和RG流加以检验。

papers.title: Quantum simulation of traversable-wormhole-inspired quantum teleportation in a chaotic binary sparse SYK model
papers.abstract: We report the experimental signature of holographically motivated quantum teleportation on a quantum processor, driven by the highly entangled, chaotic dynamics of a many-body system. Specifically, we implement the traversable-wormhole (TW) protocol utilizing a \textit{chaotic} binary sparse $N = 8$ Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (SYK) model. This optimized approach dramatically reduces circuit depth for noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware while rigorously preserving the spectral chaos required for gravitational duality. Diagnosing the teleportation signal via mutual information, we find that while inherent noise in NISQ hardware precludes perfect quantitative agreement with exact numerical simulations, our experimental results provide evidence for the essential qualitative signature: a sign-dependent asymmetry. This work establishes a practical framework for holographic quantum simulations, offering a novel empirical testbed for exploring holographic quantum gravity.

classification.title_zh: 混沌二值稀疏 SYK 模型中可穿越虫洞启发的量子隐形传态的量子模拟
classification.abstract_zh: 我们报道了在量子处理器上实现全息启发的量子隐形传态的实验特征，其由多体系统的高度纠缠、混沌动力学驱动。具体地，我们利用混沌的二值稀疏 N=8 Sachdev–Ye–Kitaev (SYK) 模型实现可穿越虫洞协议。这种优化方法大幅降低了 NISQ 硬件的电路深度，同时严格保持了引力对偶所需的谱混沌。通过互信息诊断隐形传态信号，我们发现，尽管 NISQ 硬件的固有噪声使结果无法与精确数值模拟完全定量吻合，但实验结果为关键定性特征提供了证据：符号依赖的不对称性。本工作为全息量子模拟建立了实用框架，为探索全息量子引力提供了新的经验检验平台。
classification.one_liner: 在量子处理器上用混沌二值稀疏 SYK 模型实现可穿越虫洞启发的量子隐形传态，并观测到符号依赖的不对称信号。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接涉及 AdS/CFT 全息、SYK/JT 对偶与可穿越虫洞量子传态，属于全息量子信息与量子引力核心主题。

papers.title: Three Point Amplitudes in Matrix Theory
papers.abstract: We compute the three graviton amplitude in the Banks-Fischler-Shenker-Susskind matrix model for M-theory. Even though the three point amplitude is determined by super Poincare invariance in eleven dimensional M-theory, it requires a non-trivial computation in the matrix model. We consider a configuration where all three gravitons carry non-zero longitudinal momentum. To simplify the problem, we compactify one additional dimension and relate the amplitude to a supersymmetric index computation. We find agreement with the expected answer even at finite values of $N$.

classification.title_zh: 矩阵理论中的三点振幅
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了 M 理论中 Banks-Fischler-Shenker-Susskind 矩阵模型的三引力子振幅。尽管三点振幅在十一维 M 理论中由超庞加莱不变性决定，但在矩阵模型中它需要非平凡计算。我们考虑三个引力子均携带非零纵向动量的位形。为简化问题，我们紧致化一个额外维度，并将振幅与一个超对称指数计算联系起来。我们发现，即使 N 取有限值，结果也与预期答案一致。
classification.one_liner: 在 BFSS 矩阵模型中计算三引力子振幅，并将其归约为超对称指数，在有限 N 下与 M 理论预期一致。

papers.title: Analytical Time-Domain Waveforms for Black-Hole Scattering in the Post-Minkowskian Expansion
papers.abstract: We present the first analytic computation of the time-domain multipoles of the gravitational waveform from hyperbolic black-hole scattering at leading order in the post-Minkowskian expansion, to all orders in velocity. We perform the partial-wave projection as a cut loop integral, which enables the use of dimensional regularization and associated integration techniques. As opposed to the frequency domain, the time-domain multipoles are logarithmic and do not contain Bessel-like functions. Our results pave the way for the incorporation of post-Minkowskian fluxes in waveform models for binary mergers.

classification.title_zh: 后闵可夫斯基展开中黑洞散射的解析时域波形
classification.abstract_zh: 我们首次给出了后闵可夫斯基展开领头阶下双曲黑洞散射引力波形时域多极矩的解析计算，且结果保留到速度的所有阶。我们将分波投影表示为切割圈积分，从而能够使用维数正规化及相关积分技术。与频域不同，时域多极矩呈现对数形式，且不含贝塞尔型函数。我们的结果为将后闵可夫斯基通量纳入双星并合波形模型铺平了道路。
classification.one_liner: 首次解析计算后闵可夫斯基领头阶黑洞双曲散射的时域波形多极矩，为双星并合波形模型纳入 PM 通量铺路。

papers.title: Analytical Time-Domain Waveforms for Black-Hole Scattering in the Self-Force Expansion
papers.abstract: We obtain a systematic understanding of the time-domain gravitational waveform of hyperbolic black-hole scattering at first order in the self-force expansion and all orders in the post-Newtonian/post-Minkowskian (PN/PM) expansion. The continuous frequency spectrum of unbound orbits makes the inverse Fourier transform to the time domain diverge order by order; we introduce a dimensional-regularization-inspired prescription that cures this uniformly. We show that the full waveform then follows, at any PM and PN order, from a single family of integrals, generated by the Lauricella function $F_D^{(3)}$, which we calculate using strategies familiar from the study of Feynman integrals. As a proof of principle, we use this understanding to compute the quadrupolar 1SF waveform through relative 10PM-20PN, that is to order ${\cal O}(G^{10} v^{42})$, the full 1SF waveform to 10PM-10PN, as well as the asymptotic fluxes and the dissipative scattering angle at the corresponding accuracy.

classification.title_zh: 自作用力展开中黑洞散射的解析时域波形
classification.abstract_zh: 我们系统理解了在自作用力展开一阶、后牛顿/后闵可夫斯基（PN/PM）展开所有阶下双曲黑洞散射的时域引力波形。无界轨道的连续频谱使得逐阶逆傅里叶变换到时域发散；我们引入一种受维度正则化启发的方案一致地消除该发散。我们表明，完整波形在任何PM和PN阶都来自由Lauricella函数 $F_D^{(3)}$ 生成的一族积分，我们使用费曼积分研究中熟悉的策略计算它。作为原理验证，我们利用该理解计算了四极1SF波形至相对10PM-20PN，即到 ${\cal O}(G^{10} v^{42})$，完整1SF波形至10PM-10PN，以及相应精度的渐近通量和耗散散射角。
classification.one_liner: 用维度正则化启发的方案解析计算黑洞双曲散射在自作用力展开下的时域引力波形，并给出高精度PN/PM结果。
